title: Attribute Swap Fix
description: Fixes the attribute swapping bug without breaking PVP entirely
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/SM1Izeo92jE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Attribute Swap Fix

This is a mod that brings back **attribute swapping** (a.k.a. swap hitting) for PVP. Switch to another weapon and your next hit lands right away — no waiting for the attack cooldown to recharge.

## Why

In Minecraft 26.2 pre-release 2, Mojang accidentally removed attribute swapping. In the snapshot after that the change was reverted, but Mojang said they'd get around to fixing attribute swapping properly later on. This mod is just my idea of how that fix could work — there are probably other ways to do it, but this is mine. ;)

## Dependencies

- Fabric API
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Java 25

## Supported Versions

| Minecraft Version | Supported |
| :---------------: | :-------: |
|    26.2-pre-2     |    ✅     |

## Features

- Swap to another weapon and immediately land a follow-up hit — no cooldown wait
- Your swapped-to weapon keeps its full enchantments and can still crit and sweep
- Charge weapons like the Mace and Spear can swing right after a swap
- Chain swaps together for fast back-to-back hits
- The attack indicator shows your swap timing, so you always know your window
- A little marker flashes when you land a swap hit, and particles pop on the target you hit
- Fully configurable in-game with the `/asf` command
- Works in singleplayer and on servers (install it on both the client and the server for multiplayer)

## Configuration

Everything is configured in-game with the `/asf` command:

- Turn the whole feature on or off
- Change how long the swap window lasts
- View or set any option on the fly

## Upcoming Features (Hopefully, no promises ;)

- More tuning options for chained swaps
- Visual options for the swap indicator and particles

title: FindTrade
description: Plugin to locate enchanted book trades
body:
# FindTrade

A Minecraft plugin for finding villagers with specific enchantment trades using visual particle guidance.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Sbt-IjB3o1A" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features

- **Enchantment Search**: Find nearby villagers selling specific enchantment books
- **Pathfinding**: Realistic walkable path visualization using the [pathetic-bukkit](https://github.com/bsommerfeld/pathetic-bukkit) library
- **Region Management**: Define regions to identify villager locations easily
- **Interactive TUI**: Text-based user interface for search results and region management
- **Customizable Particles**: Configure multiple particle types for pillar and path effects

## Commands

### `/findtrade search <enchantment>`
Search for nearby villagers offering a specific enchantment book.

- Displays results in an interactive TUI
- Click on a result to show particle effects guiding you to the villager
- Shows region name if the villager is within a defined region

### `/findtrade region`
Opens the region management TUI for creating, editing, and deleting regions.

- **Create**: Define a region with a name and coordinates (supports WorldEdit selection)
- **List**: View all defined regions
- **Edit**: Modify region name or coordinates
- **Delete**: Remove a region

**Aliases**: `/ft`

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `findtrade.use` | Use search and view regions | `true` |
| `findtrade.write` | Create, edit, and delete regions | `op` |

## Configuration

The configuration file is located at `plugins/FindTrade/config.yml`.

### Particle Effects

```yaml
particle-effects:
  duration: 30  # How long particles are displayed (seconds)

  # Pillar particles above villager location
  pillar:
    enabled: true
    interval: 1
    particles:
      - type: "HAPPY_VILLAGER"
        height: 20
        count: 10
      - type: "END_ROD"
        height: 20
        count: 5

  # Path particles between player and villager
  path:
    enabled: true
    use-pathfinding: true  # false = straight line (lower server load)
    update-interval: 0.1
    particles:
      - type: "END_ROD"
        count: 1
        offset-x: 0.5
        offset-y: 0.5
        offset-z: 0.5
        randomness-x: 0.0
        randomness-y: 0.0
        randomness-z: 0.0
        speed: 0.0
```

### Pathfinding

The plugin uses A* pathfinding to show realistic walkable paths. This runs asynchronously and has minimal server impact. If you experience performance issues, set `use-pathfinding: false` to use simple straight-line visualization.

## Localization

Language files are located in `plugins/FindTrade/localization/`. Supported languages:
- English (`en.yml`)
- Korean (`ko.yml`)

## Dependencies

- **WorldEdit** (optional) - For region selection using WorldEdit wand

## Installation

1. Download the latest release from the releases page
2. Place the `.jar` file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server

## Changelog

### 0.4.0
- **Major refactor**: Consolidated commands into `/findtrade`
- Added A* pathfinding for realistic path visualization (pathetic-bukkit)
- Added interactive TUI for search results and region management
- Configurable multiple particle types for pillar and path effects
- Added particle offset, randomness, and speed settings
- Improved fallback to straight line when pathfinding fails

### 0.3.0
- Added EasyVillagerTrade integration with TUI interface
- Added interactive Text User Interface for enchantment management
- Enhanced search to include both registered and nearby villagers
- Added clickable chat messages for better interaction

### 0.2.0
- Added region-based villager trade management
- Enhanced `/findvillager` command to search for specific enchantments
- Added WorldEdit integration for region selection

### 0.1.0
- Initial release
- Basic villager trade management
- Enchantment search functionality
- Particle effect visualization

## License

This project is licensed under the MIT License.

title: Chandler's Optimizations
description: This mod updates the beta chunk renderer in to much more efficient, taking inspiration from optimizations in modern minecraft and mods like sodium. Increases the render distance limit to 64.
body:
Chandler’s Optimizations improves Better than Adventure’s terrain renderer so larger render distances are more practical.

The mod raises the render distance limit to 64 chunks and reworks parts of the old beta-style chunk renderer to reduce wasted CPU work. It uses a smarter chunk rebuild queue, avoids repeatedly scanning and sorting huge numbers of chunk renderers, and caches more of the renderer’s internal terrain state instead of recalculating it constantly. There are also options to prioritize loading chunks in the Frustum and turn on Multidraw to make fuller use of the GPU.

The result is smoother performance and faster terrain loading especially at high render distances.

The mod also includes an in-game profiler overlay (can change hotkey in controls) and benchmark tools used during development to measure frame time, chunk rebuild work, and terrain rendering cost.

Requires BTA Fabric 7.3_04 and HalpLibe 5.4.0.

Note: This seems to run best with Multidraw Terrain Renderer ON and Frustum Priority OFF. You can find this at the bottom of Video settings under Chandler's Optimizations.

Frustum priority will make terrain load in faster but for an fps hit. It needs improvement.

title: Rainfall
description: realistic dynamic rain, puddles and streams (very WIP)⚠️
body:
Rainfall is a dynamic weather simulation mod that transforms Minecraft’s rain into a fully interactive water system.

# Help me improve this mod! 
[Join my Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/6wRDwVuBbB)

Instead of simple visual rain, precipitation accumulates on surfaces, forming realistic puddles that grow over time. Water spreads based on terrain shape, collects in low areas, and gradually develops into flowing streams that follow natural slopes. These streams can merge, create small runoff paths, and visually connect different water bodies, all without altering or destroying blocks.

The system is designed to be performant while still delivering detailed and immersive behavior. It simulates water flow, surface spread, evaporation, and drainage in a way that feels natural and responsive to the environment.

For debugging and visualization, a built-in debug renderer is available.
Press P to toggle the debug view, which displays internal simulation data such as flow directions, basins, and water distribution.

**InstaSchem** is a plugin designed for builders who use FAWE and want to place their schematics in the blink of an eye.  
It allows you to load, preview, and place schematics instantly without going through the lengthy commands of WorldEdit.  
Everything is done using simple and configurable tools.

---

## ✨ Features

With InstaSchem, you can:

- 🖱️ Place a schematic instantly with a right-click of the tool  
- 🔗 Link a schematic to an item to use it  
- 🔄 Rotate the schematic in 90° increments using a left-click  
- ⚙️ Use a simple system designed for both beginners and experienced builders  

---

## 🚀 Overview

InstaSchem makes building smoother, faster, and much more enjoyable.  
It's the perfect tool for players who want to:

- Save time  
- Test ideas  
- Lay out large projects in seconds  

---

## 🧾 Commands
`/instaschem help`

`/instaschem info`

`/instaschem give <tool> <schematic/pw> [-flags]`

`/instaschem bind <schematic/pw> [-flags]`

`/instaschem unbind`

`/instaschem list`

`/instaschem reload`

You can also use `/is` instead of `/instaschem` ; 0.4+ `/ischem`

---

## 🎛️ Flags (0.3 BETA and newer)

- `-a` : Ignore air (removes air from the schematic)  
- `-r` : Random rotation (randomly rotates the schematic on placement)  
- `-m <blocks>` : Place only certain blocks  

---

## 🎲 Multi-Schematic (0.4 BETA and newer)
- Added multi-schematic support
  
  `/ischem bind schem1,schem2,schem3 [-flags]`

- Allows selecting multiple schematics  
- A random schematic is chosen each time the item is used  

---

title: Madoku Craft: Attributes
description: Madoku Craft: Attributes is a configurable Attribute system. It modifies existing Attributes such as Health, Hunger, Armor, Luck, etc.
body:
## Overview:

Madoku Craft: Attributes is a configurable attribute system. You can modify attributes to customize the game's experience to your needs. Most of these features are customizable in the CONFIG files.

![Health System](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1ffbb3a231b8ffe8c88dc69fcd6f8ad4f0037a7.gif)

## Dependencies:

- Fabric API
- Madoku Craft API

## Implementation:

**Health:**

- Minecraft's Regeneration was removed entirely.
- Health automatically regenerates by draining Hunger.

**Hunger:**

- Saturation was removed entirely.
- Hunger now depletes from reaching certain goals, such as walking, breaking blocks, etc.

**Armor:**

- Armor now reduces damage by a flat amount.
- Fall damage is now reduced by Armor.

**Oxygen:**

- Water breathing effects no longer prevent players from drowning.
- Oxygen is only extended by those effects.

**Luck:**

title: Customizable Player Spawn
description: Customizable Player Spawn lets you control where players first appear in the world. It supports .nbt structures, marker-based spawn points, external templates, and direct spawning in another dimension without placing a structure.
body:
Customizable Player Spawn is a config-driven spawn control mod for Forge, NeoForge and Fabric.

It is made for worlds and modpacks where the first spawn should happen in a prepared place: a starter ruin, house, island, lobby, intro area, or any other `.nbt` structure. The mod can place that structure, find the real spawn point inside it, save the result, and keep using the same assigned spawn later.

### What it can do

- place structures from mod resources, datapacks, other mods, world files, or loose `.nbt` files in `config/customizableplayerspawn/structures`
- use a marker block, a vanilla `DATA` structure marker, a relative position, or the structure center as the spawn anchor
- create one shared spawn for everyone or separate per-player spawn structures
- choose the target dimension and allowed biomes
- search by heightmap, by smart surface validation, or by fixed Y level
- check the structure footprint, dangerous blocks, fluids, tree overlap, and surface height difference
- clear the placement volume, fill support gaps, refresh lighting, and process markers after placement
- optionally protect generated spawn structures from blocks, placement, containers, explosions, fire, and fluids

### Profiles

The recommended setup is a profile file:
`config/customizableplayerspawn/profiles/<profile>.toml`

Loose structure files go here:
`config/customizableplayerspawn/structures/<structure>.nbt`

Minimal example:
```toml
schemaVersion = 2
id = "starter_ruin"
enabled = true
priority = 100
dimension = "minecraft:overworld"
structure = "config:starter_ruin.nbt"

[anchor]
mode = "MARKER_BLOCK"
markerBlock = "customizableplayerspawn:player_spawn_marker"
removeMarkerBlock = true
offsetX = 0
offsetY = 0
offsetZ = 0
angle = 0
fallback = "SAFE_NEARBY"

[placement]
strategy = "FLAT_FOOTPRINT"
surfaceSearchMode = "SMART"
searchRadius = 2048
searchAttempts = 128
maxSurfaceStep = 3
allowFluidsBelow = false
allowReplaceableAtFeet = true
allowReplaceableAtHead = true
forbiddenSurfaceBlocks = ["minecraft:lava", "minecraft:magma_block"]
```

Issues and suggestions: https://github.com/mayorovyf/CustomizablePlayerSpawn/issues

body:
Tacz_R_WhiteSun — 47 weapons for Spigot 1.20.1
Standalone port of 47 firearms from the TACZ mod (Timeless and Classics Zero) for pure Spigot/Paper servers. No client mods required — resource pack only.

⚠️ Resource Pack Required
Download the resource pack here:
https://download.mc-packs.net/pack/af9ea93246d0157535b4605ccddcbe78cd7dc24e.zip
Paste the link into plugins/Taczgun_R_WhiteSun/config.yml → resource-pack.url

🔫 Weapons
47 weapons from TACZ mod with original 3D models and sounds:
Pistols — Glock 17, M1911, P320, Desert Eagle, Desert Eagle Golden, CZ75, Timeless 50, B93R, Uzi
SMG — HK MP5A5, P90, UMP45, Vector 45
Assault Rifles — AK-47, M4A1, AUG, SCAR-L, SCAR-H, HK416D, HK416A5, G36K, M16A1, M16A4, QBZ-95, QBZ-191, Type-81, FN FAL, HK G3, SKS Tactical, MK14
LMG — M249, FN Evolys, RPK, Minigun
Shotguns — M870, AA12, SPAS-12, M1014, DB Long, DB Short
Snipers — M700, AI AWP, M107, M95, Springfield 1873, SPR15HB
Launchers — RPG-7, M320
⚙️ Mechanics
Shooting:
Hitscan system — instant raycast, no projectile arrows
Armor penetration, headshot multiplier (×1.5–2.0)
Hit markers: white on hit, gold on headshot, red on kill
Bullet tracers colored by weapon type
Auto, semi-auto, burst — switchable fire modes
Bullet Physics:
Bullets pass through leaves, grass, flowers
Bullets pass through glass (glass breaks)
Bullets pass through cobwebs (with pierce loss)
Ice breaks — regular and frosted ice turns to water, packed and blue ice disappears
Launchers can destroy blocks (configurable)
Ammo System:
21 ammo types with original TACZ textures
Physical ammo required in inventory to shoot
Creative mode — ammo is not consumed
Weapon Modules:
Extended magazines I/II/III (standard, light for LMGs, sniper, shotgun)
Ammo modules: FMJ (+pierce), HE (explosive), HP (+damage), Incendiary, Slug (shotguns only)
Installed via weapon settings menu

🛒 Crafting System
Weapons, ammo and modules are purchased for materials (iron ingots, copper ingots, gold ingots, diamonds, redstone). Prices are configured in individual YAML files per item. Crafting can be disabled per weapon or made free for OPs.

📦 GUI Menu /gun menu
Clean menu with 4 sections:
Weapons — full catalog with stats and prices, buy for resources
Ammo — all ammo types, one-click purchase
Magazines / Modules — extended mags and ammo modules
Weapon Settings — switch fire mode, install/remove module

📋 Requirements
Server: Spigot / Paper 1.20.1
Java: 17+
Client: Minecraft Java 1.20.1 + resource pack (sent automatically)
Port: 8765 (TCP) for built-in resource pack HTTP server

🔧 Installation
Drop the JAR into plugins/
Start the server
Open port 8765 in your firewall
Paste resource pack URL into config.yml → resource-pack.url
Resource pack is sent to players automatically on join
All models, textures and sounds are taken from the TACZ mod (Timeless and Classics Zero). This plugin is not an official product of the TACZ team.

title: WorldRulesManage
description: Professional world management with customizable settings to restrict what players can or cannot do in specific worlds or within defined radius areas, such as placing blocks, interacting with entities, triggering blocks, and more.
body:
# WorldRulesManage Plugin Overview

**WorldRulesManage** is a professional plugin for managing world rules. It allows you to freely configure player behavior (e.g., blocking block breaking, block triggering, block interaction, etc.) and world behaviors (e.g., blocking fire spread, liquid flow, etc.) in specific worlds. You can also define radius-based rules using coordinates to restrict player or world actions within a certain area.  
**Use cases:** Server lobbies, spawn protection, and controlled world zones.
> English [README.md](https://github.com/MaddyJace/WorldRulesManage/blob/5.0/README.md)

> 中文简体 [CN-README.md](https://github.com/MaddyJace/WorldRulesManage/blob/5.0/CN-README.md)
---

## 📦 Plugin Features
- Supports global and radius-based world rules: prevent fire spread, prevent leaf decay, prevent block ignition (non-player), prevent entity block destruction, and block liquid flow (e.g., lava and water).
- Supports global and radius-based player rules: custom permission control, prevent block ignition, block breaking, block placing, item pickup/drop, bucket usage (e.g., collect water), hunger,  
  auto-restore hunger to full, prevent player damage, block all portals (overrides Nether/End), block Nether portal, block End portal, block specific item usage (configured by you),  
  block interaction with specific entities/blocks, block triggering of specific blocks.
- Radius rule shapes (for world and player): 2D Circle (ignores Y), 3D Sphere (includes Y), 2D Square (ignores Y), 3D Cube (includes Y), custom origin and radius values.
- Supports blacklist/whitelist configuration
- Supports multiple worlds
- Supports auto-hot-reload of configuration files

---

# ⚙️ WorldRulesManage Configuration Guide
> [config.yml](https://github.com/MaddyJace/WorldRulesManage/blob/5.0/src/main/resources/config.yml)

> [world.yml](https://github.com/MaddyJace/WorldRulesManage/blob/5.0/src/main/resources/world.yml)

> [radius.yml](https://github.com/MaddyJace/WorldRulesManage/blob/5.0/src/main/resources/radius.yml)

> [message.yml](https://github.com/MaddyJace/WorldRulesManage/blob/5.0/src/main/resources/message.yml)

### ✅ `worldName: <world>`             # Name of the world (e.g., world)
### ✅ `globalRules:`                   # Rules applied to the world, regardless of player permissions
- `flameSpread: true`                  # Prevent fire from spreading
- `leavesDecay: true`                  # Prevent leaf decay
- `blockIgnite: true`                  # Prevent block ignition
- `entityBlockBreak: true`             # Prevent entities from breaking blocks
- `liquidFlow: true`                   # Prevent liquid flow

### ✅ `playerRules:`                   # Rules applied to players without permission
- `permission: "wm.world"`             # Permission node
- `blockIgnite: true`                  # Prevent players from igniting blocks
- `blockBreak: true`                   # Prevent players from breaking blocks
- `blockPlace: true`                   # Prevent players from placing blocks
- `itemPickup: false`                  # Prevent players from picking up items
- `itemDrop: false`                    # Prevent players from dropping items
- `usePail: true`                      # Prevent players from using buckets (e.g., to collect water)
- `food: true`                         # Prevent hunger
- `foodSatiety: true`                  # Restore hunger to full
- `playerDamage: true`                 # Prevent player damage
- `portalAll: false`                   # Prevent all portal access (overrides portalNether and portalEnder)
- `portalNether: false`                # Prevent Nether portal access
- `portalEnder: false`                 # Prevent End portal access

######
- `🎯playerUseItem:`                   # Block item usage
    - `type:` `BLACKLIST` / `WHITELIST`
    - `list:`
        - "EGG"                           # Egg
        - "FLINT_AND_STEEL"              # Flint and Steel

######
- `🧍PlayerInteractEntity:`            # Block entity interaction
    - `type:` `BLACKLIST` / `WHITELIST`
    - `list:`
        - "ITEM_FRAME"                # Item Frame

title: NetworkNick
description: Lightweight nickname plugin for networks using REDIS. /nick & /hide
body:
# NetworkNick

**NetworkNick** is a lightweight, network-aware nickname plugin for **Paper and Spigot** that provides persistent, Redis-backed nicknames with full support for **PlaceholderAPI**, **LuckPerms**, and modern multi-server environments.

Designed for modern servers and proxy networks, NetworkNick focuses on **correctness, timing, and compatibility** — ensuring nicknames apply **before join messages**, **sync instantly across servers**, and respect **offline permissions**.

---

### Changelog

**1.0.1**

- Network-wide nicknames via Redis
- Join-time correctness (`%player_displayname%` works in join messages)
- Offline-safe nickname exemption (LuckPerms integration)
- Hide / unhide system with prior nickname restoration
- Robust enforcement against late plugin overrides
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Clean reload support
- Paper & Spigot compatible (no NMS, no ProtocolLib)

---

## Overview

NetworkNick allows players to set nicknames that:

- Persist across restarts and reconnects
- Synchronize instantly across multiple backend servers
- Appear correctly in join messages, chat, TAB, and scoreboards
- Respect permissions, formatting rules, and offline exemptions

The plugin is built around a Redis source of truth, with careful handling of join timing to ensure `%player_displayname%` always reflects the correct nickname.

---

## Core Features

### Nicknames
- Set custom nicknames with `/nick`
- Supports legacy color codes (`&a`) and hex colors (`&#RRGGBB`)
- Optional formatting permissions (`&l`, `&o`, `&k`, etc.)
- Safe length enforcement (3–16 visible characters)

### Hide / Unhide
- `/hide` obfuscates your name using `&k`
- `/unhide` restores your previous nickname or real name
- Prior nicknames are stored safely and restored correctly

### Network Sync
- Redis-backed nickname storage
- Real-time updates across all servers
- Automatic re-application on join, reload, and reconnect

### Exempt Players
- `networknick.exempt` prevents other players from changing or unhiding your nickname
- Uses the LuckPerms API to check permissions even when the player is offline
- Safe asynchronous handling (no main-thread blocking)

### Enforcement System
- Optional short-term enforcement to beat late plugin overrides
- Protects against plugins that reset display names after join

### Placeholder Support
- PlaceholderAPI integration
- Custom placeholders for network-aware name handling

---

## Requirements

- Java 21
- Paper or Spigot 1.20+
- Redis server (required)
- Optional but recommended: LuckPerms
- Optional: PlaceholderAPI

---

## Installation

### Single-Server Setup

1. Download `NetworkNick-1.0.0.jar`
2. Place it in your server’s `plugins/` directory
3. Start the server
4. Configure permissions (LuckPerms recommended)
5. Restart or run `/networknick reload`

---

### Multi-Server Setup

Recommended for Velocity or BungeeCord environments.

**Requirements**
- Shared Redis instance
- Identical plugin configuration across all backend servers

**Steps**
1. Configure Redis connectivity
2. Ensure all backend servers connect to the same Redis instance
3. Restart all servers

**Features**
- Network-wide nicknames
- Instant synchronization across servers
- Consistent join messages everywhere

Redis acts as the source of truth  
Local caches are ephemeral and safe

---

## Commands

### Player Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|-------|-------------|------------|
| `/nick <name>` | Set your nickname | `networknick.nick` |
| `/nick off` | Clear your nickname | `networknick.nick.clear` |
| `/hide` | Hide your name | `networknick.hide` |
| `/unhide` | Restore your name | `networknick.unhide` |

### Admin Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|-------|-------------|------------|
| `/nick <player> <name>` | Set another player’s nickname | `networknick.nick.others` |
| `/nick <player> off` | Clear another player’s nickname | `networknick.nick.others.clear` |
| `/unhide <player>` | Unhide another player | `networknick.unhide.others` |
| `/networknick reload` | Reload config and Redis | `networknick.reload` |

---

## Permissions

### Core

| Permission | Description | Default |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `networknick.nick` | Use `/nick` | op |
| `networknick.nick.clear` | Clear own nickname | op |
| `networknick.hide` | Use `/hide` | op |
| `networknick.unhide` | Use `/unhide` | op |

### Moderation

| Permission | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `networknick.nick.others` | Set others’ nicknames |
| `networknick.nick.others.clear` | Clear others’ nicknames |
| `networknick.unhide.others` | Unhide others |

### Formatting

| Permission | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `networknick.nick.colors` | Color and hex codes |
| `networknick.nick.format.k` | Obfuscated |
| `networknick.nick.format.l` | Bold |
| `networknick.nick.format.m` | Strikethrough |
| `networknick.nick.format.n` | Underline |
| `networknick.nick.format.o` | Italic |
| `networknick.nick.format.r` | Reset |

### Protection

| Permission | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `networknick.exempt` | Prevent others from changing or unhiding your nickname |

---

## (PlaceholderAPI)

| Placeholder | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `%networknick_name%` | Visible nickname (or real name) |
| `%networknick_unhidden%` | Real name or prior nickname |
| `%networknick_hidden%` | `true` or `false` |

Note: `%player_displayname%` will also reflect the nickname, as NetworkNick applies it before join messages are processed. Just make sure if you're using essentials you have change-displayname set to false in their config.

---

## Planned Enhancements

- None currently. Open to suggestions

---

title: Otherside  (Remake)
description: The Otherside is a corrupted dimension datapack that expands the Deep Dark’s lore with deadly biomes, powerful artifacts, and unique mechanics. Face escalating danger the longer you stay, uncover legendary loot, and survive a world consumed by Sculk.
body:
![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f328e7f0fe3f79f53972603d078408079c8eb4ca.jpeg)The Otherside
Remake by SimonNetzack (Original by Moxvallix & Wulfian)

Original Code & Datapack Design: Moxvallix

Original Lore, Textures & Loot Tables: Wulfian

Remake, Bug Fixes & Improvements: SimonNetzack
permission has been obtained from the owner while this datapack was being edited
The Otherside makes use of the wonderful TagLib datapack by HeDeAn.
Originally created for the third Datapack Jam, under the theme "Corrupted", this version is a faithful remake of the original concept with numerous bug fixes, performance adjustments, and minor balancing improvements, made by SimonNetzack, while keeping the soul of the original untouched.

At the outer fringes of our universe there has been a force – a great force, but terrible – skulking at the edges and slowly devouring it, changing it, corrupting it.

Worlds have fallen, civilizations consumed, twisted… all feeding the endless madness, the endless hunger.

It waits, skulks, and hungers in the dark.

– Wulfian the Wise

What is The Otherside?
The Otherside is a corrupted dimension, overwhelmed by Sculk, full of rich lore and danger. It expands on the mythology of Ancient Cities and the Deep Dark.

You’ll find legendary artifacts, new mechanics, and deadly biomes. But be warned – the longer you stay, the more corrupted you become.

How to Enter
The Otherside is end-game content. You’re expected to have full diamond gear or better before attempting entry.

To enter:

Defeat a Warden to obtain a Warden’s Key.

Use the key at an Ancient City.

The portal will activate – good luck.

Survival Tips
Time is your enemy – the dimension becomes more hostile the longer you stay.

Water is toxic. Avoid it.

Exit portals are rare, but they exist.

Items & Features
Use this command to preview items in a test area:
/place template sculk:demo

You’ll discover many legendary items in loot chests or as mob drops. A few highlights:

Bundles

Enhanced capacity compared to vanilla.

Crouch + Right Click: Fill

Right Click: Withdraw

Ignore unstackables and stack-16 items

Use from offhand and scroll to pick items

Inven-tree Roller

Offhand + crouch + scroll = Navigate inventory rows.

Item Magnet

Attracts items while crouching. Limited use, mends with XP.

Totems

Provide passive effects when held.

Many more legendary items await – no spoilers.

title: Dmerger
description: Spigot plugin that merges items to reduce lag.
body:
## 🧲 Dmerger – Automatic Item Merger

**Dmerger** is a lightweight Spigot plugin designed to reduce lag by automatically merging nearby dropped items into a single stack. Perfect for survival and economy servers, this plugin helps optimize item entities and improve performance without breaking gameplay balance.

---

### 🔧 Features
- ✅ Automatically merges similar dropped items within a configurable radius
- ⏱️ Customizable merge delay (ticks after drop)
- 📏 Adjustable max merge limit per item
- ⚙️ Real-time config reload with `/dmerger reload`
- 🧪 Optional debug mode for development & testing
- 📉 Reduces lag from excessive item entities

---

### ✅ Supported Platforms
- Spigot
- Paper
- Purpur
- Other Spigot forks

---

### 🛠 Compatible Minecraft Versions
- ✅ 1.21+
- ⚠️ Likely compatible with 1.20.x and older, but not officially tested

---

### 📦 Commands
- `/dmerger info` – View current config
- `/dmerger reload` – Reload configuration on the fly

---

### 📜 Permissions
- `dmerger.admin` – Access to reload and info commands

---

### 📂 Configuration Example
```yaml
merge-delay: 40
merge-radius: 2.5
max-merge-items: 512
debug: false
```

---

### 🧑‍💻 Author
Developed with care by **Daimy**  
[GitHub Repository](https://github.com/itzdaimy/Dmerger)
[Discord Support](https://discord.gg/daimy)

title: End Campfire
description: A Simple Mod That Adds Campfires That Freeze you
body:
# End Campfire

## Description
The End Campfire mod adds a special campfire, a mod commission from al1en.

## Features

- **Freezing Effect**: When enabled through game rules, entities that come into contact with the End Campfire experience slowed movement and freezing effects, contrasting with the burning effect of regular campfires.
  
- **Cooking Functionality**: Like vanilla campfires, this block allows you to cook food items by placing them directly on the campfire.

- **Customizable Behavior**: The mod includes a custom game rule (`/gamerule shouldEndCampfireFreeze`) that lets server administrators toggle the special collision behavior of the End Campfire.

## Game Integration

- The End Campfire can be found in the "Functional Blocks" creative tab
- Fully compatible with vanilla campfire cooking recipes
- Provides light level equivalent to vanilla campfires (level 15 when lit)

Whether you're looking to add atmospheric lighting to your End builds or create functional cooking stations with a unique twist, the End Campfire offers an interesting alternative to vanilla campfires with its distinctive End-themed visuals and optional freezing mechanics.

title: Abyssal Sands: Fracture of Time
description: "Abyssal Sands: Fractures of Time" is a mod that adds three unique biomes, time-manipulating items, and a powerful boss. Explore the world, harness time, and conquer the Time Lord.
body:
# Abyssal Sands: Fractures of Time

**Abyssal Sands: Fractures of Time** is a mod that introduces three unique biomes, powerful time-manipulating items, and a challenging boss fight. Explore the mystical **Forgotten Sands**, eerie **Abyssal Abyss**, and serene **Celestial Grove**, each with their own distinctive blocks and resources. Harness the power of time with advanced tools, relics, and artifacts that let you manipulate the environment and defeat powerful enemies.

## Key Features:

### 1. Forgotten Sands:
- A golden desert biome with **Golden Sandstone** and **Sands of Time**, which are now used in crafting recipes.
- Small ruins scattered across the landscape.

### 2. Abyssal Abyss:
- A dark and mysterious biome full of **Abyssal Stones** and **Abyssal Water**.
- Geodes containing **Abyssal Crystals**.

### 3. Celestial Grove:
- A glowing forest filled with **Starlight Logs** and **Celestial Leaves**.
- **Glowblossom Flowers** and **Ethereal Dirt** add to the atmosphere.

## Items & Tools:

- **Lunar Clock of Abyssal Sands**:  
  Manipulate the environment with this rare clock, applying a **Bone Meal** effect to crops nearby.

- **Celestial Blade**:  
  A powerful sword that becomes stronger at night, crafted using **Celestial Shards** and **Starlight Logs**.

- **Abyssal Pickaxe**:  
  A fast and efficient pickaxe crafted with **Abyssal Crystals**.

## Time Lord Boss:

- **Time Lord**: A boss spawned by using the **Starlight Advancer** to shift the time. When the world time is divisible by 24000, the **Time Lord** will appear. Defeat the **Time Lord** for powerful drops like the **Time-Lord’s Belt**.

---

**Abyssal Sands: Fractures of Time** offers an immersive experience with unique biomes, time-manipulating items, and challenging new content. Dive into the world of time itself and explore, craft, and conquer the mysteries of the **Abyssal Sands**!

title: PackOfMods
description: This pack was made to play survival with a few friends without too many mods.
body:
**Note** It is recommended you asign 4GB of RAM or more to your Minecraft instance when running the pack.

A nice relaxed survival modpack with tweaks and fixes to vanilla. The main mods are Create, Farmer's Delight, Terralith, Tectonic, Better Nether, Better End, Yung's World Gen mods and Dungeons and Taverns. There is a [Server Version](https://modrinth.com/modpack/packofmodsserver) of the pack which only has the server mods if you want to host a server.

This pack was made to play survival with a few friends without too many mods.

I have decided to use this page to document some useful information for the pack

## Create

Using **EMI** you can see a lot of what create and it's addons do. Clicking on blocks or items will tell you how to make them and right clicking tells you what they can be used to make. You can also hold W on some items to see an animation on how to use it. Some tools also allow you to hold shift when hovering over them to see a description.

The [Create: Getting Started](https://create.fandom.com/wiki/Getting_started) wiki page is also useful if you are completly new to the mod and the wiki page as a whole is very good although it does not included all the addon mods in the pack.

## Farmers Delight

For progression in Farmer's Delight a good method is to follow the advancements. The default key to view them is L. This is a nice expansion on farming and food in minecraft and also comes with some nice addons for the new biomes added by Better Nether, Better end and some of the YUNG's worldgen mods.

There is also a good [Getting Started Page](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/wiki/Getting-Started) for this mod.

## World Gen

There are quite a few world gen mods. **Yung's Mods** and **Dungeons and Taverns** add or improve various structures in the game. **Better Nether** and **Better End** improved the nether and end respectively and **Terralith** and **Tectonic** make large updates to the overworld to make it far grander in scale.

## Other Bits

- **Carry on Allows** you to pick up any block, even blocks you can't normally break, if both of your hand are empty and you right click. This can be useful for things like moving spawners.

- **Accessories** - Adds inventory slots for new items such as backpacks, charms and quivers.

- **Lighty** allows you to see where mobs will spawn. If you press F7 and select a display mode. Red means monsters can always spawn, Green means never and amber at night.

- **Diggus Maximus** allows you to mine connected blocks of the same type if you hold down a key when breaking them. By default the key is `.

- **Zoomify** allows you to zoom by holdin C.

- **Distant Horizons** increases your render distance and is quite efficent but will be quite intensive. If you are having trouble running the pack disable this mod or reduce the settings.

- **Complemetary Shaders** is included in the pack. If you aren't struggling using Distant Horizons these can be enabled in the video settings for some nice visuals.

- There are a bunch of building mods in this pack such as **chipped**, **rechisled**, **handcrafted**, **Beautify** and **Twigs**. These are great for adding more variety to builds.

- **Better Statistics Screen** replaces the vanilla statistics screen and even allows you to pin some statistics to your HUD.

- **Immersive Aircraft** gives you the ability to make various flying machines.

- **Animal Feeding Troughs**, **Dark Utilities** and **Supplementaries** add simple blocks and items with new functionality. For example the feeding trough allows animals to breed automatically.

- **Sophisticated Storage** and **Sophisticated Backpacks** expand on the storage systems in the game allowing you to upgrade them with various interesting upgrades and have much easier to access portable storage.

- **Simple Voice Chat** adds proximity chat to the game and **Simple Voice Radio** adds radios so you can communicate over a distance.

- There are also a few resources packs included in the pack. Most of these can be used at the same time. I use Minecraft Eating Animation, Visual Armor Trims, Skeleton Physics, Simple Grass Flowers, Recolourful Containers, Qrafty's Capitalized Font, Fresh Animations, Fancy Crops, Enchant Icons, EBE, AL's Creeper Pack, Simple Create Radios and Classic Icons (For Voice Chat). These can be mixed and matched however you like though.

**No64 may cause errors or problems**.

Opposite mod [No32](https://modrinth.com/mod/no32)

The mod **works only on the client side**.

title: SimpleDailyRewards
description: Daily Rewards System
body:
# SimpleDailyRewards

A simple reward system designed to be set up as quickly as possible, focusing on delivering rewards efficiently and allowing quick customization by administrators.

## Features

- **Automatic rewards:** Players can receive rewards automatically.
- **Ease of use:** Simple and quick configuration, suitable fot both novice and experienced administrators.
- **Variety of rewards:** Allows delivery of different types of rewards, such as items, experience, and custom commands.
- **Customizable Messages:** All messages can be customized to fit the server's style and theme.
- **SQLite Database:** Utilizes SQLite for efficient and reliable data storage.

![config.yml](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb0f3352518ea9e9c62c65ba652fd19efbf22bba.png)

## Commands

- **/sdr on** - Enables the reward system.
- **/sdr off** - Disables the reward system.
- **/sdr reload** - Reloads the plugin configuration.
- **/sdr reset** - Resets reward times for all online players.
- **/sdr time [time in seconds]** - Changes the reward interval time.
- **/deliverdailyreward | /ddr | /reward** - Manually deliver the reward to the executting player.

## Permissions

- **sdr.toggle:** Allow enabling or disabling the reward system.
- **sdr.reload:** Allow reloading the plugin configuration.
- **sdr.reset:** Allow resetting the reward time of connected players.
- **sdr.time:** Allow changing the reward interval time.
- **sdr.deliver:** Allow players to receive their reward. (**initially by default**)

title: Yarn Mapping Provider
description: Provide Yarn mapping for MappingResolver
body:
# Yarn Mapping Provider Description

Yarn mapping is a project that aims to create a human-readable mapping file for the Minecraft codebase. Mapping files are used to translate obfuscated class, field, and method names to their original names.

Minecraft's codebase is obfuscated, which means that the names of classes, fields, and methods are intentionally obfuscated to make it more difficult for others to understand and modify the code. This is done for legal reasons and to prevent cheating in multiplayer environments.

However, this obfuscation can make it difficult for developers to read and understand the code. Mapping files provide a way to translate the obfuscated names to their original names, making it easier to read and understand the code.

## Features

- Automatically download mapping file.
- Provide "named" mapping to [MappingResolver](https://maven.fabricmc.net/docs/fabric-loader-0.14.14/net/fabricmc/loader/api/MappingResolver.html) without having to use development environment. But runtime namespace still the same.

title: Glowstick
description: Emissive Textures via JSON
body:
## Glowstick: Emissive Textures via JSON, for Quilt Loader + Quilted Fabric API (1.19.2+)
Glowstick is a mod that adds a simplistic emissive/'glowing' textures feature to vanilla's generated item textures (nearly all items that use a set of texture layers).

Currently (as of 0.1.0), *only item models are supported*, and armor overlay support is planned for the near future.

Tested to be compatible with [Chime](https://modrinth.com/mod/chime)'s item predicate extensions.

### How to use Glowstick:

In the main json object for an item model, add an array object with the name `"emissive_texures"`, and put the *texture ids* (not the layer names themselves!) for which you want the emissive effect to apply to within.

Example: (at `assets/minecraft/models/item/stick.json`)
```
{
  "parent": "minecraft:item/handheld",
  "textures": {
    "layer0": "testpack:item/glowstick",
    "layer1": "testpack:item/glowstick2"
  },
  "emissive_textures": [
    "testpack:item/glowstick2"
  ]
}
```
### License:
Glowstick is licensed under the *Mozilla Public License, Version 2.0*

AxoProtectionBlock is a modern and highly optimized protection plugin for Paper and Folia servers that allows players to create protected regions simply by placing configurable protection blocks.

Unlike traditional protection plugins, AxoProtectionBlock includes its own independent region engine without depending on WorldGuard for normal protection handling.

The plugin includes advanced region management, visual menus, configurable flags, multilingual support, rent and tax systems, custom recipes, SQL storage, migrations, and optional integrations.

---

title: CustomTPA
description: Modern TPA plugin for Paper, Purpur, Folia, Spigot & Bukkit with 70 languages, auto-accept, countdown sound, and full MiniMessage.
body:
# 🌐 CustomTPA – Modern Teleport Requests

**The ultimate TPA plugin for Paper, Purpur, Folia, Spigot & Bukkit. 70 languages, auto‑accept, countdown sound, chat buttons, GUI, update checker, bypass permissions, daily limits, warm welcome, visual effects, request logging, TPA Back, Force TPA, World Whitelist/Blacklist, Vault economy integration, and MiniMessage formatting.**

![Servers](https://img.shields.io/bstats/servers/32220?label=Servers&style=flat-square)
![Players](https://img.shields.io/bstats/players/32220?label=Players&style=flat-square)

---

## ✨ Features

- 🌍 **70 Languages** – Automatic per‑player language detection. Full list includes English, Russian, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil & Portugal), Turkish, Italian, Polish, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Finnish, Korean, Swedish, Dutch, Czech, Hungarian, Romanian, Norwegian, Danish, Greek, Indonesian, Arabic, Vietnamese, Slovak, Bulgarian, Hebrew, Thai, Filipino (Tagalog), Hindi, Croatian, Slovenian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Serbian, Macedonian, Catalan, Bengali, Urdu, Persian, Malay, Swahili, Afrikaans, Icelandic, Galician, Basque, Esperanto, Punjabi, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Nepali, Sinhala, Burmese, Kazakh, Uzbek, Azerbaijani, Georgian, Armenian, Khmer, Lao, Mongolian, Somali, Zulu.
- 💰 **Vault Economy** – Configurable cost for `/tpa` and `/tpahere`. Permission `customtpa.bypass.cost` to skip payment.
- ⚡ **Auto‑Accept Mode** – `/tpaauto` instantly accepts all incoming requests with a configurable delay.
- 🔊 **Countdown Sound** – Configurable sound plays each second of the teleport countdown.
- 🔔 **Request Sound** – Optional sound when receiving a teleport request.
- 🛡 **Bypass Permissions** – Granular permissions for VIPs/admins: `customtpa.bypass.delay`, `customtpa.bypass.cooldown`, `customtpa.bypass.blacklist`, `customtpa.bypass.limit`, `customtpa.bypass.cost`.
- ⏱ **Daily Request Limit** – Configurable limit for sent requests per day (0 = unlimited).
- ⏳ **Configurable Timeout** – Set request expiration time in config.yml.
- 🗺 **World Whitelist / Blacklist** – Choose between blacklist (block specific worlds) or whitelist (allow only specific worlds). Perfect for servers with many worlds.
- 💬 **Chat Buttons** – Clickable `[✔ Accept]`, `[✘ Deny]`, and `[✘ Cancel]` with descriptive prompts.
- ⏳ **Teleport Delay** – Configurable countdown shown in the action bar; movement cancels the teleport.
- 🖼️ **GUI** – `/tpa gui` opens an inventory with player heads and control buttons; fully localized.
- 🎨 **MiniMessage + Legacy Colors** – Supports `<gradient>`, `<rainbow>`, `<#ffaa00>`, `&a`, `&l`, `§a`, `&#RRGGBB` and `§x§R§R§G§G§B§B`.
- 🔄 **PlaceholderAPI + LuckPerms** – Use `%other_luckperms_prefix%` or any placeholder for the involved player.
- 📊 **Player Statistics** – `/tpastats` shows sent, accepted, and denied requests.
- 🌟 **Warm Welcome** – Send a configurable message to new players on their first join (per‑language).
- 📜 **Request Logging** – Log all TPA actions to a file for moderation. Auto‑cleanup included.
- 🎆 **Visual Effects** – Spawn particles on teleportation (configurable type and count).
- 🔙 **TPA Back** – `/tpaback` returns you to your previous location after a teleport.
- ⚡ **Force TPA** – `/tpaforce` lets admins instantly teleport to players (hidden from regular players).
- ⚙️ **Fully Configurable** – All messages, sounds, cooldowns, limits, blacklists, whitelists, and new features are in `config.yml`.
- 📁 **Easy Translation** – Add new languages by dropping a `messages_XX.yml` into the `lang/` folder.
- ⚡ **Reload Command** – `/customtpa reload` applies changes without restarting the server.
- 🔔 **Update Checker** – Admins receive join/console notifications when a new version is available. Can be toggled.
- 🛡️ **Cross-Platform** – Works on Paper, Purpur, Folia, Spigot, and Bukkit (1.21.1+).

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/tpa <player>` | Request to teleport to a player |
| `/tpahere <player>` | Invite a player to teleport to you |
| `/tpaccept [player]` | Accept a request (or select from list) |
| `/tpadeny [player]` | Deny a request |
| `/tpcancel` | Cancel your outgoing request |
| `/tpatoggle` | Toggle receiving requests |
| `/tpaauto` | Toggle automatic acceptance of all requests |
| `/tpa gui` | Open the graphical request menu |
| `/tpastats` | View your teleport statistics |
| `/tpaback` | Return to your location before the last teleport |
| `/tpaforce <player>` | Force‑teleport to a player (admin only) |
| `/customtpa reload` | Reload configuration (`/ctpa`) |

---

title: CrystalRewards
description: A simple reward plugin using UltraEconomy to reward player with a Right Click on PlayerHeads or Armor-Stands
body:
###### **Update for this plugin incoming!! (Support for 1.21.x...)**

# Crystal Rewards

**Crystal Rewards** provides an easy way to create and distribute rewards in Minecraft that are perfectly integrated with the **[Econix](https://modrinth.com/plugin/econix)** plugin. Players can reward with Armostands(For server with resource pack) or with Player Heads.

### Features:
- **Integration with Econix**: Rewards are integrated directly into the economy system, allowing players to earn credits in real time.
- **Reward Types**: Use armorstands when using a server resource pack or if you want to customize them in another cool way. Or playerheads to give your players a small reward.
- Easy creation of rewards: With a single command you can create rewards with custom values.

---

### Instructions: Using Crystal Rewards

1. **Create a reward**
   To create a reward, use the command:
   /crystalrewards create <amount>
   - <amount>: Specifies the amount that will be credited when the reward is collected.
   - Set up an Armorstand or Playhead for yourself and use the command.

2. **Display of the rewards**
   - Player Heads: Use player heads from head plugins or via commands to create the rewards.
   - Armor Stands: Armor Stands offer a visually impressive way to display rewards, but you should have special models in the resource pack to make it look nicer or you can position them nicely.

3. **Interaction with rewards**
   - Players can interact with the “Rewards” by clicking on the Player Head or Armor Stand. The specified amount will be added to the player's Econix account and the player will receive a customizable message.

4. **Example**
   To create a reward of 500(e.g. $), enter the following command:
   
```
/crystalrewards create 500
```
   A reward will be created at the next Armor-stand/Playerhead.

---

### Technical details:
- **Prerequisites**:
  - [Econix](https://modrinth.com/plugin/econix) plugin (for economy integration)
  - Resource Pack (optional, for user-defined Armor Stand models)
  
- **Customization**:
  - The plugin automatically recognizes whether Player Heads or Armor Stands are to be used.
  - All messages are customizable in the config
  - The currency is customizable in the config

- **Coming in the Future**
  - Add Vault Support
  - Add MySQL/MariaDB Support

With Crystal Rewards, server owners can offer their players exciting, visual rewards and make the economy system even more interactive. Ideal for servers that want to utilize custom designs and richer reward mechanics. 🎉

title: Ice Boat Racing
description: A powerful plugin for your ice boat races
body:
# 🧊 IceBoatRacing

**IceBoatRacing** is a fast, lightweight, and competitive **ice boat racing plugin** for Minecraft servers.

Create custom race tracks with checkpoints and sectors, spawn race boats ("cars"), track lap times, and run full races with live updates.

Perfect for minigame servers, events, and competitive boat racing maps.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🏁 Full race system with start/end control
* ⛵ Custom boat "cars" with owner support
* 📍 Checkpoints & sector checkpoints
* ⏱ Lap completion time tracking
* 📊 Live sidebar / scoreboard display
* 🌍 Multi-language message system
* ⚙️ Fully configurable plugin settings
* 🛠 Admin-friendly setup commands

---

## 🏎 Cars System

IceBoatRacing uses a **car system** (boats used as racing vehicles):

* Create cars with a step-by-step setup wizard
* Assign an owner to each car
* Remove or manage cars easily
* Players are automatically placed into their car during preparation mode

---

## 📍 Checkpoints & Sectors

Track progression through the race course using:

* Start line and finish line
* Multiple checkpoints
* Optional sector checkpoints
* Admin tools to list, remove, and normalize checkpoints

---

## 🏁 Race Management

Races can be controlled easily:

* Start a race instantly
* Enable preparation mode (players placed automatically)
* End races at any time

---

## 📜 Commands

### `/race`

| Command         | Description              |
| --------------- | ------------------------ |
| `/race start`   | Starts the race          |
| `/race end`     | Ends the current race    |
| `/race prepare` | Enables preparation mode*|

*Players will be teleported to their car when they join (or if they're already online)

---

### `/checkpoint`

| Command                   | Description                 |
| ------------------------- | ----------------------------|
| `/checkpoint pos1`        | Set checkpoint position 1*  |
| `/checkpoint pos2`        | Set checkpoint position 2*  |
| `/checkpoint create`      | Create a checkpoint         |
| `/checkpoint setFinish`   | Save the start/finish line**|
| `/checkpoint list`        | List all checkpoints        |
| `/checkpoint remove <id>` | Remove a checkpoint         |

*You can also use a shovel to define the positions. (use it like the WorldEdit axe)

**This defines the start line. Define 2 of them if your track doesn't have the same start and finish line

---

### `/car`

| Command                    | Description                   |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `/car create`              | Start the car creation wizard |
| `/car list`                | List of the cars, and buttons |
| `/car remove <id>`         | Remove a car*                 |
| `/car owner <id> <player>` | Change car owner*             |

*Just use `/car list`, it's easier


---

## 🌍 Language Support

IceBoatRacing supports multiple languages.

Select the language in `config.yml`:

```yml
language: en_US
```

Messages are stored in:

```
plugins/IceBoatRacing/lang/en_US.yml
plugins/IceBoatRacing/lang/fr_FR.yml
```
### How to add your own language

1. Duplicate the file `plugins/IceBoatRacing/lang/en_US.yml`
2. Rename it to `your_language.yml`
3. Actually translate (you can ask an AI to do it if you want)
4. Change the config from:
```
language: en_US
```
to
```
language: your_language
```

But if you want the language to be added directly to the plugin, contact me on Discord (@mattmunich)!

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

* Customizable messages
* Prefix support
* Sidebar title & join/quit formatting
* Fully editable race text and feedback

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar`
2. Put it into your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Configure everything in:

```
plugins/IceBoatRacing/config.yml
plugins/IceBoatRacing/lang/
```

5. Setup your track:

* Set the start line using `/checkpoint setFinish` (it will act as *start and finish*)
* Create checkpoints using `/checkpoint create`
* Define sectors using `/checkpoint create SECTOR [sectorID]`
> -> Sectors will tell your current lap-time in chat when you cross them
* Create race cars using `/car create`
* Start racing with `/race start`!

---

## ✅ Requirements

* Minecraft **1.21+**
* Paper / Spigot compatible server
* Adventure API supported

---

## ⚙️ Bugs/issues
***Please*** report any bugs you encounter on GitHub: https://github.com/mattmunichYT/IceBoatRacing/issues

Or contact me on Discord (@mattmunich)

Thank you very much, this helps me a lot!

---

## 🧊 Made for Competitive Ice Boat Racing

IceBoatRacing is designed to provide a clean and fun racing experience with proper timing, checkpoints, and full race control.

If you enjoy fast-paced boat racing, this plugin is for you.

---

title: Better Beaches
description: Enhance the beach biomes with new plants, blocks, creatures and more!
body:
Better Beaches completely expands all beach biomes with new vegetation, creatures, mechanics, and survival features. Beaches become far more alive and immersive with palm trees, rock formations, shells, plants, decorative blocks, plastic trash, and creatures. The mod also introduces new weather effects, heat mechanics, ocean-related items, and dangerous nighttime threats. From relaxing tropical atmospheres to surviving hostile cannibal tribes, this mod transforms beaches into dynamic environments filled with exploration, decoration, survival, and horror elements.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► How do I disable heat?

You can disable the heat by setting the gamerule "enableHeat" to false

► How do I disable the water pulling me down during thunderstorms?

You can disable the stormy water by setting the gamerule "enableStormyWaters" to false

► How do I disable cannibals to spawn?

You can disable the spawning of cannibals by setting the gamerule "enableCannibals" to false

► How do I disable Ocean trash to spawn?

You can disable Ocean trash from spawning by setting the gamerule "enableOceanTrash" to false

► How do I reset Karma?

You can reset the karma by using a Karma Totem, which will take 50 karma points.

Otherwise you can also use the command "/reset_karma" to reset the karma to 0.

► How does the heat work?

Heat affects only beach, deserts and badlands biomes. If a player stands under direct sunlight during the noon time, heat will be applied to the player which will increases if the player stays longer under direct sunlight. You will start to sweat, getting nausea for a short time and damage. Wearing armor will only increase the heat.

You can avoid heat by doing multiple things:
● Stay under solid blocks
● Be in water
● During Rain or Thunder
● Eating Popsicles
● Taking Sunscreen
● Getting hit by a water gun projectile
● During the night
● Leave the beach, desert or badlands biome


</details>



![Karma](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ead13f2e9a253e84318979a0349f28ac3413f9c1.png)

Karma is a hidden survival mechanic represented by a skull icon in the inventory. Your actions influence the Karma level over time, and the higher it becomes, the more dangerous the beaches turn at night. Violent or desperate actions such as killing animals, murdering villagers or players, starving, dying, cutting yourself, or simply surviving during storms and nighttime will slowly increase Karma. There are 6 total levels of Karma and a maximum of 100 Karma Points. As the level rises, players receive unsettling warnings, the symbol of the skull changes and stronger cannibal variants begin appearing. Karma can be reduced using Karma Totems, removing 50 Karma Points and allowing players to temporarily calm the shoreline once again. 



![Plastic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2fcc8c20f84e62e693882e54dad59f53a65b983.png)
Plastic is a resource found across beaches and oceans in the form of bottles, bags, sticks, and rings. While appearing as trash washed ashore during storms, plastic can be collected and recycled into useful crafting materials. During storms, more plastic can be found in the ocean. Using recycling bins, players can process plastic into smaller components used for creating a wide variety of items, including tools, armor, shields, fishing equipment, decorative blocks, beach items, and survival gear. These new plastic items can also get recycled in the recycling bin.

title: HiddenVision
description:
[ENG]This mod allows you to see invisible Mob/Players.
[TR]Bu mod, görünmez yaratıkları/oyuncuları görmenizi sağlar.
body:
[ENG]
# HiddenVission

A lightweight, high-performance client-side utility mod for Minecraft Fabric that allows you to easily reveal and visualize invisible entities with a single keypress.

---

## 🚀 Features

- **Toggle Visibility:** Press the **G** key (configurable in control settings) to instantly reveal all invisible players, mobs, and armor stands.
- **Server-Friendly:** 100% client-side. It does not send any packets to the server or leave logs, making it safe and clean to use.
- **Actionbar Alerts:** Provides a clean screen overlay notification (ON/OFF) when toggling, so you always know your current state.
- **ModMenu Integration:** Fully compatible with ModMenu. It will display correctly in your mods list with custom graphics and author info.

---

## 🛠️ Requirements & Installation

1. Make sure you are using **Fabric Loader** (version `>=0.16.0`).
2. Put the `hiddenvision-1.0.0.jar` into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
3. **Fabric API** is required.
4. (Optional) Install **ModMenu** to view the mod in your mod list.

## ⚙️ Configuration

Simply go to Minecraft **Controls -> Keybinds** menu to rebind the toggle key if you don't want to use the default **G** key.

---

*Developed by Th3Fuzzy. Licensed under the MIT License.*
[TR]
# HiddenVission

Minecraft Fabric için geliştirilmiş, tek bir tuşla görünmez varlıkları (oyuncular, yaratıklar, zırh askıları) görmenizi sağlayan hafif ve yüksek performanslı bir istemci (client-side) modudur.

---

## 🚀 Özellikler

- **Görünürlüğü Aç/Kapat:** **G** tuşuna basarak (kontroller menüsünden değiştirilebilir) tüm görünmez oyuncuları ve mobları anında görünür hale getirin.
- **Sunucu Dostu:** %100 client-side çalışır. Sunucuya paket göndermez veya sunucu tarafında iz bırakmaz.
- **Aksiyon Çubuğu Bildirimleri:** Modu açıp kapattığınızda ekranın alt kısmında temiz bir ON/OFF bildirimi gösterir.
- **ModMenu Entegrasyonu:** ModMenu ile tam uyumludur. Özel ikonu ve yapımcı bilgileriyle mod listenizde şık bir şekilde görünür.

---

## 🛠️ Gereksinimler & Kurulum

1. **Fabric Loader** (sürüm `>=0.16.0`) kullandığınızdan emin olun.
2. `hiddenvision-1.0.0.jar` dosyasını `.minecraft/mods` klasörüne atın.
3. **Fabric API** gereklidir.
4. (İsteğe bağlı) Mod listenizde görmek için **ModMenu** modunu kurabilirsiniz.

## ⚙️ Tuş Ayarı

Varsayılan **G** tuşu yerine başka bir tuş kullanmak isterseniz, Minecraft ayarlarından **Kontroller -> Tuş Atamaları** kısmından kolayca değiştirebilirsiniz.

---

title: SimpletpPro
description: A simple teleportation mod....
body:
SimpleTP Pro is a lightweight, survival-friendly, cheat-free teleport mod built for vanilla survival and multiplayer servers. All commands are available to every player by default—no cheats, no OP permissions, no extra setup required. It adds safe, fair, and convenient teleportation to make your survival world more enjoyable and cooperative.
Features
# 📌 Player Teleport (TPA System)

/tpa <player>

## Send a teleport request to another player.

/tpaccept

## Accept a pending teleport request.

/tpdeny

Deny a pending teleport request.

Clickable chat buttons – Accept or deny directly from chat.

60-second timeout – Requests expire automatically if ignored.
# 🏠 Home Teleport System (Multi-Home Support)

/sethome <name>

Set a home at your current location.

/home <name>

Teleport to a saved home.

/home list

View all your saved homes.

/delhome <name>

Delete an existing home.
# ⚰️ Death Return

/back

Teleport back to your last death location to retrieve items easily.
# 🌍 Warp Points System

/warp

Open the warp list and click entries to teleport directly.

Sign Teleport Usage: Write warp on the first line of a sign and the warp name on the second line. Left-click the sign to teleport instantly.
# Highlights
✅ Survival-friendly & cheat-free

✅ No OP permissions required

✅ All players can use all commands

✅ Clickable chat interface

✅ Automatic request timeout

✅ Multiplayer & server-ready

✅ Lightweight – no extra items/blocks

✅ Full language file support
# How to Use
Install the mod and launch Minecraft.

Use /tpa <player> to send a teleport request.

Use clickable buttons in chat to accept or deny.

Use /sethome, /home, /delhome to manage homes.

Use /back after death to return to where you died.

Use /warp to open the warp list for one-click teleport. You can also place a sign: put warp on the first line and the warp name on the second line, then left-click the sign to teleport.
# Perfect For
Survival players

Multiplayer servers

Builders & explorers

Anyone who wants QoL teleports without cheats
# Update Log
## 1.0.1

Fixed the issue where Tab completion could not be used after using /tpa

Help has been added, use /help tppor to view help
## 1.0.2

Optimized the execution method and added the /tphere command, now you can use this command to teleport players to your location
## 1.0.3

Fixed the issue where home would be lost after exiting the game

Added /tpa to teleport to coordinates
## 2.0.0

Refactored the mod. Removing MCR made the mod smaller in size.

Routine fixes.
## 2.0.1

Added cross-dimension support for /home and /back

Optimized the code architecture
## 3.0.0

Fixed some bugs

Added multi-version support
## 3.0.1

Added the /warp command, along with click-to-teleport functionality in the list.

Added sign-based warp teleport: Create a sign with warp on the first line and the warp name on the second line, left-click the sign to teleport.

# SimpleTP Pro 是一款轻量、适配生存模式、无作弊的传送模组，专为原版生存和多人服务器打造。默认所有玩家均可使用全部指令 —— 无需开启作弊、无需管理员权限、无需额外配置。模组为生存世界增加安全、公平又便捷的传送功能，让你的生存联机游玩更有趣、更方便协作。

/warp

打开地标列表，点击列表选项即可直接传送

✅ 体量轻量，不新增任何物品 / 方块

✅ 完整支持自定义语言文件

安装模组并启动我的世界

点击聊天栏按钮快速同意 / 拒绝

# 适用人群

title: Grippers
description: A horror-comedy mod featuring a custom dimension, cryptic secrets, explore carefully, there's more going on than it seems.
body:
# 🦶 Grippers

**Fabric · Minecraft 1.21.1 · Beta**

```
Gripp first or be gripped
```


Something is wrong with your world and nobody's talking about it. Dig deep enough, explore far enough, and you'll start finding things that don't belong, messages left behind by people who aren't people anymore.

There's a way through. You'll know it when you see it. What's on the other side isn't for the faint of heart.

---

## What is this

Grippers is a horror-comedy mod built around exploration, discovery, and 3 bossfights that will make you want to uhhh, idk tbh. I'm not going to spoil the details here half the fun is figuring out what's going on.

What I will say:

- There is a **custom dimension**. It is grippy.
- There are 3 **bosses**. They are grippy.
- There are **things living there** that shouldn't be there.
- There are items, lore, and secrets scattered everywhere. Explore. Pay attention.
- Killing the bosses will not be the end. Try bringing him back. 

~~There's no going back...~~

---

## Heads up

- ⚠️ **Shaders are not optimized for the custom dimension** - they may cause visual issues or performance drops. The mod will handle this for you, but just know going in.
- 🧪 This is an **beta release**. The core content is fully playable but I have a ton of ideas still in the works. More is coming soon.
- 🐛 Bug reports and feedback are appreciated - this is just the beginning.

title: Death Log
description: A persistent /deaths list of where you last died (coords, dimension, day, cause) so you can walk back to your stuff. No gravestone, no map mod.
body:
# Death Log

A persistent list of where you last died — coordinates, dimension, in-world day, and cause — kept across restarts. No gravestone block, no map mod: run `/deaths` and walk back to your stuff.

The recovery compass is single-use, and gravestone mods add blocks that can clash with minimaps. Death Log is a lightweight server-side history instead: it records each death and lets you look it up any time.

```
Death Log — your last 3 deaths (newest first):
#1 · day 12 · (210, 64, -88) overworld — Slain by Zombie
#2 · day 9 · (-44, 12, 301) overworld — Fell from a high place
#3 · day 4 · (88, 70, -150) the_nether — Walked into fire
```

`/deaths` shows your own history (last 10, newest first); `/deaths <player>` is op-only and resolves currently-online players. Cause text is the vanilla death message captured at the time of death, stored in vanilla world data so it survives restarts.

It's read-only and server-side — no mixin, no config, no blocks or items — so it can't conflict with other mods. Pairs with the sibling mod Death Forensics, which explains a single death in depth.

Server-side — install on the server only.

Free to use in any modpack. Source and issues: https://github.com/KURONAMI333/death-log

title: ¿Still There? AFK Screen
description: Automatically detects when you are AFK, blurring the screen and limiting the game to 10 FPS to save PC resources and lower temperatures.
body:
**REQUIRED ARCHITECTURY API**

Still There? (AFK Screen) is a 100% Client-Side Quality of Life (QoL) mod designed to protect your computer's performance and temperature when you step away from the keyboard.

Main Features:

Smart Detection: Automatically monitors mouse and keyboard activity.

Extreme Resource Saving: After a configurable period of inactivity (5 minutes by default), the mod opens a blurred cinematic screen and throttles the game down to 10 FPS. This allows your CPU and GPU to rest, drastically reducing power consumption and heat.

Instant Restoration: click, or press any key. The mod will close instantly and restore your exact original framerate so you can continue playing smoothly.

Highly Configurable: Includes a config file (pausescreen-client.toml) that lets you decide exactly how many minutes must pass before the screen triggers.

Multilingual Support: Fully translated into English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Russian, and Chinese.

---

Descripción en Español:

Still There? (AFK Screen) es un mod de Calidad de Vida (QoL) 100% del lado del cliente (Client-Side), diseñado para proteger el rendimiento y la temperatura de tu computadora cuando te alejas del teclado.

Características principales:

Detección Inteligente: Monitorea de forma constante la actividad del ratón y el teclado para saber si sigues ahí.

Ahorro de Recursos Extremo: Tras un periodo de inactividad configurable (5 minutos por defecto), el mod activa una pantalla cinemática con desenfoque y "estrangula" el rendimiento del juego a solo 10 FPS. Esto permite que tu CPU y GPU descansen, reduciendo drásticamente el consumo eléctrico y el calor generado.

Restauración Instantánea: No pierdas ni un segundo. Solo haz clic o presiona cualquier tecla; el mod se cerrará al instante y devolverá el juego a tus FPS originales.

Totalmente Configurable: Incluye un archivo de configuración (pausescreen-client.toml) para que elijas exactamente cuántos minutos de espera prefieres.

Soporte Multilingüe: Totalmente traducido al Inglés, Español (España, México y Argentina), Portugués, Francés, Ruso y Chino.

title: Fancy DamageIndicator
description: Plugin displaying damage for survival experience. Support rainbow and MiniMessage!
body:
# DamageIndicator

DamageIndicator is a Paper plugin that displays damage dealt to entities. This provides a visual representation of combat feedback, enhancing the player experience on your survival server. ## Features - **Floating Damage Text**: Clearly see how much damage you deal to mobs and other players. - **Configurable**: Customize various aspects of the damage indicators, including: - Enabling/disabling the plugin. - Ignoring specific entity types. - Ignoring specific worlds. - **Configurable indicator lifetime**: Set how long damage indicators remain visible. - **Formatting**: Control the color and style of the displayed damage text. - **Lightweight**: Designed to be efficient and not impact server performance significantly. ## Damage ![](https://github.com/tantaihaha4487/assets/blob/main/DamageIndicator/dmg.gif?raw=true) ## Critical Damage ![](https://github.com/tantaihaha4487/assets/blob/main/DamageIndicator/crit.gif?raw=true) ## Heal ![](https://github.com/tantaihaha4487/assets/blob/main/DamageIndicator/heal.gif?raw=true) ## Installation 1. Download the latest version of the plugin from [https://github.com/tantaihaha4487/DamageIndicator/releases/latest]. 2. Place the `DamageIndicator-2.x.x.jar` file into your server's `plugins/` folder. 3. Restart or reload your server. 4. (Optional) Configure the `config.yml` file located in `plugins/DamageIndicator/` to suit your server's needs. ## Configuration The plugin generates a `config.yml` file in the `plugins/DamageIndicator/` directory upon first run. Here are some key configuration options:
config.yml ```yaml # # Enable or disable the plugin. # enable: true indicator: # Format for displaying in indicators # # You can generate your own format below: # https://www.birdflop.com/resources/rgb/ # select Color format to MiniMessage # health-indicator-format: "+{healamount} [{currenthealth}/{maxhealth}❤]" damage-indicator-format: "-{damage} [{currenthealth}/{maxhealth}❤]" critical-damage-indicator-format: "✧ -{damage} [{currenthealth}/{maxhealth}❤]" # The lifetime of the indicators in ticks before they disappear lifetime: 12 # List of entities and worlds to ignore blacklist: entities: - "item_frame" - "item" worlds: - "world_example" ```
## Commands | Command | Description | Permissions (Assumed) | |--------------------|---------------------------------------------|-----------------------| | `/damageindicator` | Base command for plugin information/reload. | `damageindicator.use` | ## Support & Contributing If you encounter any issues, have suggestions, or would like to contribute, please visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/tantaihaha4487/DamageIndicator/) or open an issue there. **Authors**: TantaiHaha, Thanachot **Version**: 2.0.3 **Version**: 1.21.x

title: Mace-Limit Datapack
description: This Datapack adds the "one-mace-rule"
body:
This datapack implements the "One-Mace Rule" – a gameplay mechanic that ensures only one mace can be crafted globally.

When a player crafts a mace, the datapack checks the maces scoreboard value. If it is already 0, the newly crafted mace is immediately removed, preventing multiple maces from entering the game. The game will also announce the creation of the mace in chat with the player who crafted it.

**BUT players can use crafters to bypass this**

Setup the datapack by typing: /function maces:setup as an operator

### Brief Description
A (relatively) lightweight create modpack with a heavy emphasis on its addons while being mostly themed around machining and automating as opposed to adventure and combat.

### Core Principles
1. **No other tech mods** – Applied Energistics and similar technology mods are excluded. While *Create* is technically a tech mod, its focus on rotational power keeps it closer to a vanilla-style experience.  
2. **No terrain generation mods** – to maintain a lightweight modpack and preserve the classic Minecraft world feel. 
3. **No large-scale content mods** – with the main exceptions being Create and, to an extent, Farmer’s Delight, which fit the pack’s balanced, semi-vanilla theme. 
4. **No diesel or overpowered energy systems** – excludes modern or unfitting power generation to maintain the vanilla-style mechanics.

### Modlist

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)
  - Special Note: as of 5.5.0 (1.21.9), pack formating now has minor versions. All minor versions for any given major versions are intended to fully compatible (i.e. - 88.0, 88.1, etc.) and listed as only the major version (i.e. - 88).
- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

Major breaking changes to each version:
 - 2.0.0 MC 1.17: Advancement Format change - custom recipe "condition" ("items")
 - 3.0.0 MC 1.20.5: Recipe Format change - recipe "result"
 - 4.0.0 MC 1.21: Folder Name change
 - 5.0.0 MC 1.21.2: Recipe Format change - shaped "key" and shapeless "ingredients"
