title: Strike Cannon
description: Aim at a target, fire the cannon, and rain massive concentric rings of TNT from the sky, obliterating everything below.
body:
## ☄️ Strike Cannon

**Strike Cannon** is a high-impact **Paper 1.21+** plugin that lets players craft and deploy a devastating orbital weapon.
Aim at a target, fire the cannon, and rain **massive concentric rings of TNT from the sky**, obliterating everything below.

Designed for **SMPs, factions, events, and chaos servers** — fully configurable and recipe-locked.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🔨 **Craftable Weapon**
  Players must **craft** the Orbital Strike Cannon — no free nukes.

* 🎯 **Targeted Strike System**
  Right-click to fire a **particle beam** that locks onto where you’re looking.

* ☄️ **Massive TNT Orbital Bombardment**
  Spawns **hundreds to thousands of TNT** in **multiple concentric rings** at high altitude (Y=120+), creating cinematic destruction.

* 🌌 **Orbit-Style Visuals**
  Particle beam + falling TNT smoke trails for a true “from space” effect.

* ⚙️ **Fully Configurable**

  * Number of rings
  * Ring spacing & density
  * TNT fuse times
  * Explosion power
  * Cooldowns
  * Safety TNT cap (TPS-friendly)

* 🔐 **Permission Support**
```yml
   orbitalstrike.use
```
* 🧠 **Persistent Item Tagging**
  Cannon is safely detected via NBT/PDC — no exploits or renaming tricks.

---

## 📦 Requirements

* **Paper** `1.21+`
* **Java 21**
* No dependencies

---

## ⚠️ Performance Warning

This plugin can spawn **a LOT of TNT** (by design).
Use the built-in **`max-tnt-per-strike`** setting to protect your server TPS.

Recommended for:

* Event worlds
* Controlled PvP areas
* Late-game SMP content

---

## 🛠️ Configuration Preview

```yml
strike:
  ring-start-radius: 3
  ring-end-radius: 75
  ring-step: 3
  arc-spacing: 2.5
  max-tnt-per-strike: 1800
```

Adjust these values to go from **tactical strike** → **total annihilation**.

---

## 💥 Perfect For

* SMP end-game rewards
* Factions super-weapons
* Admin-controlled events
* Content creators & clips
* Chaos servers 😈

title: Terrors In The Dark
description: A mechanically overcomplicated horror mod which adds too many new game mechanics, and some truly spine chilling monsters. Will make you suffer... a lot.
body:
**THIS MOD REQUIRES [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) & [Kleiders Custom Renderer API](https://modrinth.com/mod/kleiders-custom-renderer-api)**

###  WARNING: THIS IS A HORROR MOD!
_**THIS MOD CONTAINS A LOT OF CONTENT WHICH SOME MAY FIND DISTURBING, ESPECIALLY BODY HORROR.**_

**_THIS MOD IS RECOMMENDED TO BE PLAYED BLIND, HOWEVER, READING THE BASIC INFO SECTION PROBABLY WON'T HURT YOU._**

**_THERE IS A SPOILERS SECTION BELOW IF YOU DON'T WANT TO PLAY FULLY BLIND OR NEED INFO._**

**_ALSO BEWARE... THIS MOD IS INFESTED WITH "Weathergirl" REFERENCES._** (Peak song)

## **BASIC INFO ABOUT THE MOD:**

**Hello! Do most Minecraft horror mods bore you? Well, my dear friend... you have come to the worst place possible!** (Except if you are a digital masochist)

Welcome to TITD! Everything about this mod sucks... a lot. TITD aims to make everything spooky by adding random things that make too much sense, while also adding spooky monsters and consequence inflicted emotional damage! Yeah, sure... the scary monster outside your window **COULD** kill you, however, that sepsis on your right arm which was caused by that one random skeleton, **WILL** kill you. 

This mod adds multiple different kinds of "Terrors" into the game. Most of these "Terrors" follow certain rules, meaning most of them are VERY different from each other... and while some "Terrors" are easier to deal with than others, they can all be very dangerous in certain situations. (The term "Terror" just means entity/monster from this mod... since calling the monsters in this mod just "entities" would have been incredibly boring)

This mod also adds A LOT of new mechanics to the game, which directly or indirectly influence the player experience... for example: Carelessly taking damage from mobs may end up with you getting an injury, which further develops into an infection and then into sepsis, leading to you losing your arm.
![Injury Tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0650ee78582eb9d4ac7c3cfb5f7229bda4aaccb9.png)![Fleshified Injury Tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/164f79138e3b50d8fd136da6086d149518a59661.png)

Many structures can also be found in the world, most of them containing scraps of lore, a few items, or useful information. ![A Hidden Structure](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d3e784cf23aa4207c6b218c967f6891e9e3c868.png)

You can play this mod in any way you want. However, remember that your actions DO have consequences... you aren't the most powerful thing out there, and to be honest... you probably don't want to be.

The mod has some extra features for multiplayer, so perhaps consider playing with a few friends!

**A FEW THINGS TO KEEP IN MIND BEFORE PLAYING:**
- This mod can often feel EXTREMELY unfair and/or boring.
- Sometimes, the player should just learn from their mistakes and create a new world.
- This mod is VERY slow paced, and simply waiting for things to happen is useless.
- Some Terrors ignore time, and occur more often if the player plays in a specific way.
- Read the starting papers, it makes everything slightly more bearable. 
- This mod contains a lot of secrets and hidden things.
- Info on some of the Terrors can be found by searching for documents.
- This mod does have lore... however, exploration is REQUIRED to find it.
- Your experience is HEAVILY influenced by how you play.
- If you heard something, then it probably means something.
- Not an ARG mod.
- EXTREMELY janky if the player is in creative mode, as this mod was designed for survival.
- Visual mods are recommended.
- If not using [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei), then consider taking a look at the recipe book. (Advancements reveal recipes)
- Please don't jump down a mountain, seeing the testers do that caused me physical suffering.
- Bees are more important than almost every other resource. Put your base near a hive... trust me.
- Mining copious amounts of redstone is highly recommended.
- Regular mobs are almost as bad as Terrors, don't underestimate them.
- Some Terrors are capable of breaking blocks, but only when attacking.
- Expect bugs, I couldn't get a lot of people to test this thing.
- Meant to be played for a long time, as some of this mod's content can't be explored in just a few hours.

## SPOILER TERRITORY!

**A LIST OF STRUCTURES ADDED BY THIS MOD**


<details>
<summary>Slight Spoilers</summary>

- **Small Powerline.** *(What happened...?)* A common decorative structure... doesn't contain anything important. Found... essentially everywhere.
- **Transmission Tower.** *(No loot!? Useless!)* A common decorative structure... doesn't contain anything important, except if you love Iron Bars for some reason. Found... essentially everywhere.

- **Herald's Resting Place.** *(I don't think they are sleeping...)* A somewhat common stone brick structure. Contains a few shotguns shells, documents, and a book with the instructions on becoming a "Red Herald". Found... essentially everywhere.

- **Herald's Altar.** *(Such a cruel religion...)* A rare deepslate brick structure that contains the "Blood Altar", which is used for becoming a "Red Herald". Found in taiga biomes and dark forests.

- **Unknown Survivor Igloo.** *(I don't think he survived...)* A somewhat common structure made out of snow and wood. Contains a few bandages and a book. Found in snow plains.
- **Venator Campsite.** *(Did he... survive?)* A somewhat rare, well camouflaged campsite made out of spruce leaves and logs. Contains a few bandages, a book, and a gun template. Found in taiga biomes.

- **Harvest Cross.** *(I swear... I've seen this thing somewhere!)* Rarest structure in the mod. Contains a few organs, a scalpel, a cleaver, and a terror document. Found... essentially everywhere.

- **Small Lab Ruins.** *(This is getting confusing...)* A somewhat common concrete structure. Contains a crude prosthetic arm, a book, and a piece of unholy flesh. Found in deserts, badlands, and savannas.

- **VRS Victim.** *(The disease... it can do that!?)* A common oak log structure, resembling tangled roots. Contains a singular book. Found in forest biomes.

- **Old Asylum.** *(That place gives me the creeps...)* One of the rarest and largest structures in the mod, you can't miss it if it's on your screen. Contains... a lot of lore books, medical items, and other shenanigans. Also, this structure contains two unique "Terrors"... so don't be an idiot. Found in meadows, badlands, and dark forests.

- **Poet's Resting Place.** *(Useless!)* A somewhat common brick structure. Contains just some garbage, and a singular book with poetry. Found... essentially everywhere.

- **Large Lab.** *(Huh, this place seems important...)* A rare large quartz building... the inside area filled with tendrils of unholy flesh. Contains documents, a clock, a book, and the anomaly shard. If the player is in a certain radius of this structure, they may sometimes feel as if they are being called. Found underground in the deepslate layer.

- **Flesh Infected House.** *(Okay, this has to be the rarest structure!)* A very rare simple house, except it's infected. Contains a lot of stuff, but the main things are... a gun template and a book. Found in carnosolari biomes.

- **Cannibal House.** *(They say my hunger's a problem...)* A somewhat rare crudely built bulding, made out of mud and dirt. Contains a cleaver, a book, and some human meat. Found in swamps.

- **Old Destroyed Van.** *(So many documents...)* A somewhat common structure... it's a car, no better way to describe it. Contains a lot of paper, documents, and a singular book. Found... essentially everywhere.

- **Survivor Cabin.** *(They had everything... how did they die!?)* A rare cabin structure, also has an outhouse. Contains a lot of crops, and a singular book. Found in taigas.

- **Submarine Wreck.** *(Down to the bottom they went...)* A common submarine wreck, nothing much to say. Contains a few pipes, and a book. Found in any ocean biome.

- **Junkie Corner.** *(Huh, maybe this world isn't so bad after all...)* A somewhat rare old wall segment. Contains a lot of empty syringes, an umbrella, and a book. Found in plains biomes.


</details>



**A LIST OF NEW GAME MECHANICS ADDED BY THIS MOD** 

<details>
<summary>Medium Spoilers</summary>

- **Injuries.** *(Hold on, let me check if there's fall damage)* Essentially works as a punishment for those who act stupid. Injuries often cause bleeding, infections, pain, or everything mentioned. Almost everything that can hurt you can cause an injury, with the type of injury dependent on what hurt you. Types of injuries include: Bruises, Lacerations, Punctures, Incisions, Burns. And yes, armor does reduce injury chances. More info can be found on the starting item given by the mod.
- **Pain.** *(Uhm, mentally or physically?)* Pain is often caused by injuries, addiction, phantom pain, or crude eye prostheses. Pain just passively lowers your mood and prevents sleep, while also increasing the chance of a specific Terror spawning. Pain can be reduced or eliminated by being happy, or by consuming poppium-based crafts. More info can be found on the starting item given by the mod.
- **Bleeding.** *(Don't worry, it's just ketchup!)* Deals damage and drains hunger, with the speed dependent on how much you are bleeding. Having specific injuries on your arms causes more bleeding if you mine blocks or attack entities, while specific injuries on legs causes more bleeding when sprinting. More info can be found on the starting item given by the mod.
- **Infections/Sepsis/Diseases.** *(Microbes... the deadliest things to exist)* Certain injuries are prone to infections, which doesn't do anything on its own... but can evolve into sepsis after 10 minutes. Infections can be treated with honey-based crafts. Unlike infections, Sepsis often cannot be treated anymore, and it will kill you. After 5 minutes of living with sepsis, you will quickly die and lose the limb affected by sepsis... except if it's a torso sepsis, then it will instead infect two random body parts after you respawn. More info can be found on the starting item given by the mod.
- **Body part removal.** *(Heh, need a hand?)* While your character might be technically immortal, your body parts certainly aren't. Certain Terror attacks, sepsis, or amputation, can lead to the loss of an body part, causing immense debuffs. The loss of an arm makes mining slower and attacks less powerful, while loss of a leg makes you slower, and loss of an eye makes seeing harder. The loss of body parts can be corrected with prostheses, which come in two tiers: Crude and Advanced. Crude prosthetics are worse than your original limbs, but still better than none, while advanced prosthetics are as good as your original limbs and slightly less prone body part removal. Limb loss may sometimes cause phantom pain. More info can be found on the starting item given by the mod.
- **Mood.** *(Pumpkin pie... now!)* Yeah, you aren't that soulless in this world... you're gonna have to keep your character happy. High mood will cause your player to be happy, which grants many buffs... while low mood will cause your player to be sad, which serves as a warning that your character isn't doing so good. If your mood goes too low, your character will become depressed. Certain items and activities increase or lower mood, so be aware. More info can be found on the starting item given by the mod.
- **Depression.** *(Oh, mentally it seems)* Essentially works as a punishment for neglecting your mood. Depression comes in stages, which increase and get worse as the time goes on. At first depression just causes slowness due to lethargy, however, it quickly causes other nasty effects, like mining fatique and the emergence of Depression Terrors. Depression can be treated/"cured" by the use of poppium-based crafts/anti-depressants, or randomly with a low % chance if the depression is at its worst... though, a specific "Terror" can help increase this chance. More info can be found on the starting item given by the mod.
- **Panic.** *(No, you aren't a fearless action hero)* Prevents some cheese strategies, while also drastically lowering mood. Makes you run faster, but prevents block placement, mining, makes seeing harder, and makes drowning VERY fast. More info can be found on the starting item given by the mod.
- **Morality.** *(The world is horrible, why be good?)* Changes certain interactions in the mod, a lot. Morality slowly goes up if it's not at max already, however, immoral actions may slow down this process. Morality goes down if the player: kills baby animals, kills or does surgery on villagers, kills too many animals in a single day, is a Red Herald or a Freshborn.
- **Addiction.** *(What do you mean I can't abuse meds!?)* Yeah... just don't. Poppium-based crafts, while effective at dealing with pain or depression... do often have a chance of addiction. If the player is addicted, they NEED poppium to function normally, otherwise they go into withdrawal. Withdrawal happens when an addicted player doesn't consume enough poppium, and its effects will slowly worsen as the time goes on. Addiction goes away if the player fully goes through withdrawal.

- ### **Events.** *(Why do I hear boss music?)*
- **Bewitching Hour:** An event that may happen at midnight... causes a thick reddish fog to appear, despawns all non-terror hostile mobs, while boosting the spawn rates of almost ALL Terrors and removing some of their spawn limits. This event only lasts for 1 minute, but the amount of Terrors spawned makes it terrible nonetheless.
- **Harvest Moon:** An event that may happen when the night first starts... causes a thick red fog to appear, despawns all non-Terror hostile mobs, makes Freshborn Terrors spawn normally, and highly increases the spawn chance of a specific Terror. This event lasts the entire night.
- **Dark Purge:** An event that may happen when the night first starts... causes a black fog to engulf everything to the point of partial blindness, despawns all non-Terror hostile mobs, and makes Purgers spawn normally. This event lasts the entire night.
- **Shimmering Skies:** An event that may happen when the night first starts... causes a slight cyan fog to appear. The only event that doesn't prevent sleep, exposure to the outside makes moral players happy... and the event makes most Terrors and non-Terror hostiles unable to spawn. The only good event in this cruel horrible realm, savor it. This event lasts the entire night.
- **Ashen Pall:** The only event that may happen during the day... causes everything to become shrouded by a thick white fog. Negates happiness gain from daylight, Mist Slitter becomes active, and increases some Terror spawn chances. This event lasts the entire day.

- ### Player Beings. *(You're a monster...)*
 - **Cannibal:** Eat too much human flesh, and you turn into a cannibal. You can only eat human meat and organs now... but, your attacks against players have a higher chance of causing injury through armor. Looking at other players might cause them to panic for a bit. This is the most lenient "Player Being" as it changes you the least.
 - **Red Herald:** Find a book, and do the ritual it describes. You can only eat organs now, a few specific "Terrors" feels immense hatred towards you, and your morality is forced to 0. However, you are stronger than normal... and some "Terrors" ignore you now.
 - **Freshborn:** Fall victim to the Star-Flesh Infection... or accept it. The game is completely different for you now, as you can now gather "Biomass" and evolve... your body parts are randomized, but you can re-roll your body structure with biomass, granting different buffs and effects depending on what kind of body parts you have. Most "Terrors" ignore you now, as you are fully one of them now. You can even hide your grotesque body, just so that you can still pretend to be a person. However, this new form doesn't come without downsides... as you are now EXTREMELY weak to fire, your morality is forced to 0, you cannot wear armor, you cannot effectively use tools without specific body parts, you need to eat living things for any fulfilling hunger gain, and every food that isn't raw meat causes you to just become more hungry. This "Player Being" is the least lenient, and almost completely changes the way you are supposed to play... this "Player Being" can also override every other one.
- **Psycho:** Kill dozens of Villagers in the span of a few days, and you become a Psycho. You have strength 2, sneaking turns you invisible, killing things grant happiness, Purgers ignore you, and Players who look at you become panicked. However, your morality is forced to 0, and you MUST kill something at least once every 3 minutes... otherwise your mood will rapidly decrease.

*"Monsters... they are quite subjective, aren't they? Who's to say that you aren't one yourself?"*
<iframe width="230" height="157" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ZXKC54kTXQ4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
An old very crudely made video that showcases the player being transformations of this mod.
(Man, the quality on this... is truly something to behold)

</details>

**A LIST OF "TERRORS" ADDED BY THIS MOD**

<details>
<summary>EXTREME Spoilers</summary>

- **The Darkness.** *(A force of nature)* The lack of light itself is perilious... being in darkness for too long causes "The Darkness" to slowly appear, before quickly killing you and destroying a body part or two.

- **The Claustrophobia.** *(A force of nature)* Tight spaces themselves are unsafe... being in tight spaces for too long causes "The Claustrophobia" to slowly appear, before slowly killing you and destroying a body part or two.

- **Mangler.** *(A common mindless brute)* Mangers are the most basic of "Terrors..." they are common, but deadly. Manglers merely appear, wander around, and disappear if no targets are found. However, if a player does get too close to a Mnagler, they will immediately rush their target, often destroying body parts. Holding out organs when a Mangler is attacking you will cause the Mangler to get distracted, as it starts eating one of the organs held... granting you enough time to hopefully run away.

- **Heartless.** *(A soul filled with self-loathing)* The Heartless... they are quite basic, as they can only move or attack players when not looked at. The Heartless deal a lot more damage than most "Terrors..." however, their footsteps are particularly loud. A Heartless can be pacified by giving them a heart, as that makes it feel things again... even if only momentarily. Always knows where you are.

- **Skin Lurker.** *(A skittish stalker)* Skin Lurkers are one of the more complicated "Terrors" one may face, as they can only approach the player when they aren't looked at... however, unlike the Heartless, a Skin Lurker will sprint away when looked at, often trying to approach again after a few seconds. Skin Lurkers make no noise when moving... so they are naturally stealthy. If a Skin Lurker gets close enough to a player, it will loudly hiss at its target, before giving chase. Once a Skin Lurker has begun chasing a target, it will not be stopped by sight anymore. Skin Lurkers are one of the most dangerous "Terrors," as they have a high chance of dismemberment, and are VERY fast when giving chase. Always knows where you are.

- **Depression Terror.** *(A phantasmal opportunist)* Depression Terrors only appear if a player has been suffering from depression for at least 5 minutes. The behavior of Depression Terrors is tied to the level of depression the player is suffering from... stage 1: they don't even exist, stage 2: they only watch the player, which causes the depression to worsen if allowed, stage 3: the Depression Terrors now actively move towards their victim, trying to kill them. As long as the player doesn't neglect their mood, these "Terrors" won't be a problem.

- **Visiofur.** *(A hunter using your own sight)* Visiofurs are quite simple... look at one for more than a few milliseconds, and you will be chased. Visiofurs are particularly nasty, as they primarily target the player's eyes... meaning dying or getting damaged by one might result in the loss of an eye. One can wear a pumpkin to look at a Visiofur safely.

- **Purger.** *(A mysterious class of violent humanoid creatures)* Purgers only come out during the "Dark Purge" world event, and there are multiple variants of this "Terror." The abilities and damage of a Purger completely depend on their headpiece and arm equipment. Always knows where you are.

- **Storm Eye.** *(A lonely somber wanderer)* Storm Eye... the only "Terror" that actively doesn't want to harm anyone, she only spawns when it's raining(Minecraft is buggy so she may sometimes spawn even when it's not raining). Storm Eye only attacks players with a low morality... while players with high morality may activate a small questline from her. Completing Storm Eye's questline will reward you with Storm Eye joining you on your travels, helping you with combat and mood management. 

- **Cold Heart.** *(A hollow self-accepting Heartless)* Cold Heart, a living, breathing skill/action check. Cold Heart spawns after the player has played for a long while, and returning later with its next spawn time being dependent on your choices. When Cold Heart spawns, it isn't aggressive, and you get to choose between multiple actions: FIGHT, OFFER, SPECIAL. All of these actions have three choices in them, most of which make Cold Heart go away if successful. However, certain choices like "Threaten" and "Ambush" check the player's equipment, before choosing if Cold Heart will instead attack the player or leave. Trying to run away from Cold Heart will immediately make it aggressive, and dying to Cold Heart will result in the loss of two body parts.

- **Harvest.** *(A self-proclaimed man of God)* Harvest, is easily one of the most dangerous "Terror" in the entire mod. Harvest's spawn chance increases by 1% each night, while lowering by 10% when he does spawn. However, if a player has pain, half of that pain will be added as a % chance on top of the original spawn chance... also, doing surgery on villagers also increases the chance that Harvest may spawn. During Harvest Moon, Harvest's spawn chance is temporarily increased by 50%. When Harvest is about to spawn, the player will be warned a whole minute in advance... since once Harvest spawns, they HAVE TO run. When Harvest is chasing a player, he often swaps between a state of sprinting, and exhaustion... when Harvest is sprinting, he is extremely fast and can easily catch up to the player, however, when in his exhausted state, Harvest will move slowly, allowing the player to gain distance. Harvest can also teleport ever so often, but cannot attack for a few seconds after doing so. When teleporting, Harvest may switch targets if another player other than it's target is closer. Dying to Harvest will result in the loss of two body parts.

- **Backscratcher.** *(A sadistic psychological tormentor)* Backscratcher, another quite simple "Terror." Backscratchers occasionally appear behind players, breathing behind them and talking to them. Low morality causes Backscratchers to target a player more often, and stay around for longer. If a player looks at the ground, the Backscratcher itself, or forces themselves against a wall... the Backscratcher will immediately attack, instantly killing its victim if their armor value isn't high enough, and tearing off an arm. (CURRENTLY BEING REWORKED. NOT INGAME FOR NOW)

- **Agony.** *(A confused eternally tortured soul)* Agony... easily the most dangerous "Terror" in the entire mod. The chances of Agony spawning are always very low, however, being a Red Herald, and doing surgery on villagers increases the chances... a lot. When Agony spawns, there is a 33% chance that everyone in a 120 block radius get warned of its arrival, also, when Agony spawns, it will always check the "worst person" to choose as its victim. Once Agony has spawned, it will turn invisible until it is close enough to its victim... if Agony is too far away from its victim, then it will also go invisible. When Agony is visible, it cannot move, and will try to stare at its victim. If Agony gets to look at its victim for long enough, it will go into a state of frenzy... which will ALWAYS lead to the victim getting pinned to the ground and mutilated. Always knows where you are.

- **Striding Horror.** *(A rare cognitohazard of immense size)* Striding Horrors are extremely simple, yet rare. Striding Horrors always spawn quite far away from players, always standing still without doing anything. However, if a player even glances at a Striding Horror, they will be immediately forced to stare at it... as it slowly opens its eye. While being forced to stare at a Striding Horror, the player's mood will be rapidly depleted... and if the player is depressed, their depression will advance much faster. Striding Horrors often won't stick around for long.

- **Fleshworm.** *(A common relentless biohazard)* Fleshworms are quite common, and aren't dangerous themselves. However, getting attacked by a Fleshworm will ALWAYS cause a puncture wound, as the worm digs inside of your body... inflicting the player with Star-Flesh Infection. Fleshworms may also attack certain animals, burrowing inside them instead... which turns them into Freshborn "Terrors."

- **Freshborn Cow/Pig/Chicken/Villager.** *(A class of flesh based creatures)* Freshborns... one may find that they aren't too uncommon. Freshborns created by Fleshworms will often hide themselves as normal animals, only attacking if the player tries to kill them. However, Freshborns can also spawn during the "Harvest Moon" world event, or in a rare new biome. Attacks from Freshborns can also inflict Star-Flesh Infection, so one must take care when facing them.

- **Asylum Ghoul.** *(A blind tortured brute)* Asylum Ghouls can only be found in abandoned mental asylums, and only one spawns per asylum. Asylum Ghouls are deceptively dangerous, as despite their blindness... they will still know if you are too close. Running inside an asylum will immediately alert the Asylum Ghoul, causing it to beeline to your position. If the Asylum Ghoul goes outside the asylum, it will immediately attempt to retreat back inside.

- **Asylum Spirit.** *(A fragment of the past)* Asylum Spirits can only be found in abandoned mental asylums, and only 6 can exist in one at a time. Asylum Spirits merely exist, not moving at all... they despawn ever so often, causing a new one to spawn somewhere else. If a player looks at an Asylum Spirit, they will disappear and cause the player's screen to be blocked, while also alerting the Asylum Ghoul to the player's position.

- **Heed.** *(An anomalous sore eyed listener)* Heeds are one of the slightly rarer "Terrors" one may face, especially since they can only spawn after 5 days have passed. When the player is in the Heed's hearing radius, certain actions causes a "Loudness Meter" to rise. If the "Loudness Meter" gets full, ALL Heeds in a radius will become awake. Normally a Heed isn't aggressive, however, they become aggressive towards ALL players when awake. When awake, a Heed can be flashed with a "Redstone Flash Beacon" which stuns it for 7 seconds instead of the normal 3... this can also be used to save yourself from a Heed's grab. Like Agony, Heeds have an unique attack type... when in open spaces, instead of just attacking the player, the Heed will proceed to grab the player, lifting them off the ground before directly attempting to tear off a body part.

- **Mist Slitter.** *(The unseen killer of the fog)* During an Ashen Pall one may hear something ghastly in the distance... which is followed by footsteps, belonging to the Mist Slitter. After the footsteps end, the victim will have white mist attack the corners of their screen while a text appears on their screen, saying "Stop Moving!" If the player moves while a Mist Slitter is checking them, it will quickly slit their throat, instantly killing the victim. The chance of a Mist Slitter encounter is increased while sprinting, and lowered while sneaking.

(A picture containing some of the Terrors)
![Humorous Picture With many Terrors3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cdefc3e535df943e5c1061ebbb24b6ab37d1ddfc.png)

- *"Hey Visiofur, we are the most annoying Terrors in the mod... so wanna like, hang out?"* - Mangler
- *"Uhhhh... alright, sure! Should we camp the player's door again for 4 minutes?"* - Visiofur
- *"Harvest, I'm coming for you after this group photo! I hate you!"* - Agony
- *"Oh, but my actions were merely the will of God... wherefore I am not in the wrong."* - Harvest
- *"Oh, hi! Didn't you see the news today?"* - Storm Eye
- *"Morals are useless in this world, don't be like Storm Eye... she's pathetic."* - Cold Heart
- *"Guys... Am I in the picture?"* - Striding Horror
- *"My my... what a nice, exposed back you have here, Cold Heart~"* - Backscratcher
- *"Me needs new human disguise, me want kill camera person... now!"* - Skin Lurker
- *"Stop being so loud..."* - Heed
- ***"TOGETHER, we are Terrors In The Dark!"* - Everyone**

(This is stupid. But at least writing corny stuff is fun!)

</details>

**A LIST OF MISCELLANEOUS STUFF ADDED BY THIS MOD**


<details>
<summary>Some Spoilers</summary>

<details>
<summary>Special Item Info</summary>

**Gun Template:** This item is kind of important, so here's all the ways to get one. The first way is to use a fishing rod to fish, and get lucky. The second way is to kill a Skeleton, Mangler, or a Purger and get lucky. The third way is to find it from one of two structures.

**Double Barrel Shotgun:** This weapon's spread is affected by your "stance". When sneaking, the shotgun has the least spread. While sprinting, the spread is at its maximum.

**Cordiline AND Gunpowder:** Cordiline OR Gunpowder can be used to cauterize wounds if you have a Flint & Steel... this instantly heals all of the bleeding wounds on a body part, but leaves you with a burn instead.

**Ice:** Can be used to instantly heal bruises.

**Music Disc - Screams For Heaven:** If put in a jukebox while certain "Terrors" are nearby, they will have something to say about the horrid recording. Here's all of the "Terrors" that can react to this: Lily, Harvest, Backscratcher, Agony. Additionally, you can right-click Agony with this for a special reaction, also.

**Redstone Flash Beacon:** A life-saving tool that stuns things, and can be used in a pinch to save yourself from The Darkness... however, not everything can be stunned with this. Here's a list of all of the stunnable entities: Illagers, Visiofurs, Skin Lurkers, Manglers, Lily/Storm Eye, Harvest, Heeds, Players. Almost everything gets stunned for 3 seconds upon use, but Harvest and Heeds have different stun durations... Harvest only gets stunned for 1.5 seconds, while Heeds get stunned for 7.5 seconds. "Reloading" this item takes 4.5 seconds, however, this time turns into 9 seconds if panicked.

**Swords:** In PVP, swords can cause incision wounds to other players... with the chance being affected by damage taken, and armor.

**Advanced Prosthetics:** These prosthetics have a singular "hidden" feature, and it's that they all have a 50% chance to resist body part removal attempts.

**Rose Tinted Glasses:** You can actually give this to Lily, as long as she isn't too unhappy. These also reduce mood loss from sources that reduce mood.

**Panacea Syringe:** This item says it cures all diseases, so here's a list of things this item actually does: Prevents all infections for 10 minutes, cures ALL infections and sepsis, cures SFI regardless of its state, cures VRS regardless of its state, "cures" depression, forces your mood to neutral range if in depression range, has a 33% chance to cure the player if the Player is a Freshborn.

**Laudanum Syringe:** If addicted to poppium, this item maximizes your hidden addiction meter... keeping withdrawal away for a very long time.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Patchworks</summary>

**Patchworks** is not a place where you want to be... it's nothing but corridors, and a few forested outside areas. It should not exist, yet it does. It is a creation, a crude one at that... a rudimentary, chaotic patchwork made from different aspects of reality.
(THIS DIMENSION IS STILL HEAVILY WORK IN PROGRESS)

**Patchworks biomes:**
- **Blank Corridors:** A biome that is nothing but blank, boring hallways... one can find crates here which contain some resources for you to hopefully survive with.

- **Flesh Corridors:** A biome that is similar to the Blank Corridors, except that the walls and roof are covered in infectious flesh. This biome has crates which often contain Human Meat, Organs, and Unholy Flesh. 

- **Patch Forest:** These biomes are often surrounded by Flesh Corridors, and are the most unique out of the all of the biomes. Patch Forests contain grass, water, and trees... making survival possible here, but certainly not easy.

**Ways to enter the Patchworks:**
- Find a rare black portal in the Overworld and enter it.
- Stand near an Anomaly Shard.
- Right-click an Anomaly Shard. (10% chance)

**Ways to exit the Patchworks:**
- Find an EXTREMELY rare black portal somewhere in the Patchworks and enter it.

(WARNING: This dimension was never made to be fair, and getting soft-locked is a very real possibility!)


</details>

<details>
<summary>Effects</summary>

**Painkilled:** Reduces all pain to 0, except if suffering from poppium withdrawal.

**Flammable:** If set on fire, the Player can't be extinguished without the use of water. Additionally, the Player will occasinally take extra damage from being on fire... with the occurrence dictated by the Player's fire protection enchantments, or if they have Fire Resistance.

**Braced:** Prevents limb removal from most terror attacks.

**Injury Regeneration:** Increases injury healing speed by 0.5 per level.

</details>






</details>



## USELESS INFO HERE!


<details>
<summary>Non-Important Stuff</summary>

**THIS IS JUST A LITTLE LIST OF STUFF THAT INSPIRED THINGS IN THIS MOD:**
- Creator's own fear of darkness. (When I'm alone in the darkness, my mind tends to wander)
- Real life. (Many of this mod's mechanics are based on real life, with some liberties of course)
- Project Zomboid. (The injury tab is heavily inspired by Project Zomboid's health tab)
- RimWorld. (Best game- Oh, sorry... I meant, best story generator ever made!)
- Another project of mine. (Nothing to say about this one)
- Many pieces of music. (Weathergirl/Butcher Vanity/Fight Fire With Gasoline/Down At The Bottom)
- H. P. Lovecraft's works. (At the Mountains of Madness/Color Out of Space)

**DUMB THINGS:**
- The horror of this mod... definitely comes from how stupidly complex I made this piece of garbage.
- Weathergirl is the best song ever made.
- Amogus is still funny.
- Anti-Youtuber mod, since there are no scawy sounds played every 17 seconds.
- We love Storm Eye... hands down best "Terror" in the entire mod.
- This mod got scope creeped... hard. (Was supposed to only add 5 Terrors and dismemberment)
- I wasted almost 6 months on this mod. (I did take breaks, but not for long)
- This mod... it's a horrible amalgamation of semi-random concepts and ideas.
- My first attempt at making a mod that isn't for just personal use.
- I don't like making GUI's, which is why they look so bad in the mod.
- Heh, this mod might be absolute garbage... but at least it's unique, which I take pride in.
- Purgers need a visual rework... they look horrible.
- I had to remake the whole injury system at one point, which was REALLY fun! (No)
- There truly are a lot of terrors in the dark. (Holy mackerel, they said the thing!)
- This TITD-1.5 thing is taking a long time... definitely biting a lot more than I can chew.
</details>

title: All The Commands(API)
description: bings a ton of usefull commands for your pvp or other kind of mods!!
body:
Welcome to All The Commands. If you are putting together a cinematic, combat-focused, or PvP Minecraft mod, this library is your toolkit. It brings over 35 commands and a full Java API to make your fights look and feel amazing.

Entity Visuals & Flair

/afterimage [color] [interval] [lifetime] - The ultimate style tool. Leaves trailing ghost copies behind a moving player. These afterimages perfectly copy the player's current animations and are 100% compatible with the Player Animator API!

/aura <targets> <particle> <duration>
  Persistent particle aura around entity.

/glow <targets> <duration> [color]
  Outline glow with color (16 vanilla colors).

/trail <targets> <particle> <duration>
  Particle trail behind moving entity.

Screen Effects & Visuals

/screenshake <targets> <intensity> <duration>

  Shakes a player's camera. Great for impacts.

/screenflash <targets> <color> <duration>

  Flashes the screen briefly. Use for hits, ults.

/vignette <targets> <color> <intensity> <duration>

  Dark/colored edges fading to center. Low HP, domain vibes.

/cinematicbars <targets> <true|false>

  Adds black bars top + bottom for cinematic moments.

/skytint <targets> <color> <intensity> <duration>

  Tints the player's whole view a color. Domain expansion-style.

/popup <targets> <color> <duration> <scale> <text...>

  Big styled centered text. Technique callouts, boss intros.

/timer <targets> <label> <durationTicks> <color>

  Countdown timer in the top-right. Cooldowns, match clocks.

Status & Control

/stun <targets> <duration>
  Locks position and disables damage output.

/silence <targets> <duration>
  NBT flag for ability/technique blocking (modder-readable).

/iframes <targets> <duration>
  Cancels all incoming damage for the duration.

/disarm <targets>
  Drops the entity's held item.

/cantblock <targets> <duration>
  Disables shield use.

/cantheal <targets> <duration>
  Cancels all healing events.

/exhaust <targets>
  Empties hunger/saturation, applies exhaustion.

Damage Manipulation

/truedamage <targets> <amount>
  Bypasses armor + resistance.

/lifesteal <attacker> <target> <amount>
  Damages target, heals attacker.

/reflect <targets> <duration>
  Next incoming hit bounces back to the attacker.

/damagemult <targets> <multiplier> <duration>
  Multiplies outgoing damage.

/incomingmult <targets> <multiplier> <duration>
  Multiplies incoming damage.

/maxhealth <targets> <bonus> <duration>
  Temp max-HP buff or debuff.

/heal <targets> <amount>
  Instant heal with heart particles.

Movement & World Mechanics

/launch <targets> <x> <y> <z>
  Sets entity velocity. Supports ^ relative coords.

/pull <targets> <x> <y> <z> <strength>
  Pulls entity toward a point.

/fling <targets> <fromX> <fromY> <fromZ> <power>
  Pushes entity away from a point.

/dash <targets> <distance>
  Forward velocity burst in look direction.

/blink <targets> <distance>
  Instant teleport in look direction.

/teleportbehind <caster> <target> <distance>
  Anime-style flank teleport.

/float <targets> <duration>
  Hover in air, slow falling.

/shockwave <pos> <radius> <power>
  AOE outward push from a point.

/marker <pos> <color> <duration>
  Particle pillar marker at a position.

Utility & API

/sfx <targets> <sound> <volume> <pitch>
  Play any sound for player(s).

/mark <targets> add|remove|has <tag>
  Custom tag system (modder-readable).

/runchain <delay> <command>
  Schedule a command to run after a delay.

Color Formatting Any command that asks for a color accepts simple names like red or gold, hex codes(hex codes are a little glitchy), or ARGB integers.

For Java Modders You do not have to rely entirely on in-game commands. Every single feature listed above is exposed as a static method in the API. You can call them directly from your own Java code by referencing msi.lotto.usefullcommands.UsefullCommandsAPI.

title: AE2 Terminal Mouse Wheel Scrolling
description: (Client side) Scroll through your installed terminals using the mouse wheel!
body:
Allows you to cycle through your installed terminals using the mouse wheel.

## Features

*   Scroll through your active terminals by holding down a key (not bound by default, will not work if unbound) and scrolling.
*   Uses your installed terminal order, as it would normally by the Universal Terminal.

## Requirements

*   [Applied Energistics 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2)
*   [Applied Energistics 2 Wireless Terminals](https://modrinth.com/mod/applied-energistics-2-wireless-terminals)

## Compatibility

Should work with any terminals that can be added to the Universal Terminal.

Tested with so far:

*   ME Requester
*   Extended AE
*   Expanded AE
*   Advanced AE

## Usage

1.  Bind "Scroll Modifier".
2.  Open a compatible terminal, hold the key, and scroll away.

## Credits

*   [Applied Energistics 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2)
*   [Applied Energistics 2 Wireless Terminals](https://modrinth.com/mod/applied-energistics-2-wireless-terminals)

title: DogDog
description: Overhauls Minecraft wolves with unique personalities, treasure-hunting abilities, and epic life-saving mechanics!
body:
# DogDog: Personalities, Treasures, and True CompanionshipDog 

Completely overhauls the vanilla Wolf AI, transforming them into irreplaceable companions with deep affinity systems, critical survival mechanics, and distinct personalities that fundamentally change gameplay.

General Mechanics
Affinity & Soul Bond: Interact with your dog empty-handed to build Affinity. Reach 100 Affinity to unlock the "Soul Bond", enabling powerful personality-specific abilities.

Tactical Command: Sneak + Right-Click with an empty hand to toggle between Home Patrol (32-block radius) and Follow modes.

Critical State & Sacrifice: Dogs no longer die instantly. Upon taking fatal damage, they enter a 60-second "Critical State". Use a Golden Apple to save them, or they will turn into a permanent Stone Statue memorial.

Featured Personalities
Craft a Golden Bone to reroll your dog's personality and unlock unique behaviors:

The Coward (Brave Heart): Normally flees from monsters. However, at max Affinity, it will override its fear to teleport and block a fatal blow for you, granting a Totem effect at the cost of its own health and a 5-minute cooldown.![brave heart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86f31afef99ff7c33252c392bfac0fcfad071181.png)

The Treasure Hunter: Throw a Golden Bone to trigger a heist. The dog enters a portal to raid structures (Villages, Mansions, Nether, etc.) for high-tier loot. Success brings treasures; failure brings a squad of angry pursuers.![treasure dog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d4071eeca1a3968c92f8213fd1e401929b22f80.png)

## 宝藏神犬 (DogDog)：多重性格与真正的羁绊
DogDog 彻底重构了原版狼的底层 AI，将其转化为不可替代的伙伴。通过深度的亲密度养成、濒死抢救机制以及独立的性格系统，为玩家带来全新的宠物交互体验。
基础机制
亲密度与灵魂羁绊： 空手抚摸或喂食可提升亲密度。达到 100 点将触发“灵魂羁绊”，这是解锁性格终极技能的唯一钥匙。

战术指令： 保持空手状态，按住 Shift 右键可切换居家巡逻（32格半径）或跟随模式。

濒死与纪念： 狗狗受致命伤后会进入 60 秒濒死倒计时。及时使用金苹果可救活，否则它将化作永恒的石化雕像。

核心性格
使用黄金骨头即可重置狗狗性格，每种性格拥有独特的 AI 逻辑：

胆小鬼 (勇敢的心)： 平时会躲避怪物，但在亲密度满级时，它会瞬间传送到你面前替你挡下致死伤害。触发后进入 5 分钟冷却。

寻宝专家： 丢出黄金骨头可启动潜入寻宝。狗狗会穿过传送门搜刮各类遗迹（村庄、府邸、地狱等）并带回极品奖励。若潜行失败，则会引来敌对守卫的追击。

### PS
Project Status: Active Development
Implemented Personalities: Coward (Brave Heart), Treasure Hunter, Angel, Shura.
Note: More hidden mechanics and personalities are currently under development. 
项目状态： 持续更新中
已实装性格： 胆小 (Coward)、寻宝 (Treasure)、天使 (Angel)、修罗 (Shura)
备注： 更多隐藏性格与互动机制正在紧锣密鼓地开发。发。发。发。发。发。

title: FroggyCraft
description: A vanilla+ pack with lots of frog-related mods like Ribbits, tons of fun & useful mods like Create, and mods for those who love to build & decorate! Frogs, toads, & axolotls - this pack is an amphibian's paradise. 𓆏🐸𓆏
body:
This modpack provides a vanilla+ experience that adds new biomes, new and overhauled mobs, powerful tools, quality-of-life improvements, under-the-hood fixes, performance enhancements, and so much more. Oh and I almost forgot, the pack has a whole bunch of mods and other content related to **frogs**! I like frogs, and I hope you do too :] If you have an older or lower power PC that struggles with demanding mods like Create or you want nothing more than frogs and performance optimizations, you might prefer the [**FroggyCraft Lite**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/frogycraft) modpack – all the frog-related content from FroggyCraft with none of the extras! Join the [**FroggyCraft Discord**](https://discord.gg/WBQRfBgQEY) to report bugs, get help, and chat with other FroggyCrafters!
### **Frog-Related Stuff**

![Frog-Related Mods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7951b553aea5a3eca3dce5c27253048478109c1a_0.webp) - [**_Bucket of Frog_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bucket-of-frog) (mod): lets you carry frogs in buckets just like axolotls and other aquatics. Warning: this mod is only compatible with the three vanilla variants of frogs, modded frogs from More Frogs 2 will revert to a vanilla variant if placed in a bucket. - [**_Frog Legs_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/froglegs) (mod): adds new block variants for froglights and froglight end rods. Also adds a bunch of new food drops, but that's not important, don't look into it. Remember, frogs are friends not food! - [**_Holdable Frogs_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/holdable-frogs) (mod): lets you pick up frogs and use than as tools – their tongues can grab stuff from far away and drag them towards you. - [**_More Frogs 2_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/morefrogs) (mod): this mod adds new frog variants that will spawn and can be breed only in certain places (the nether, the end, the deep dark, above y=250), they have their own drops, with one unique drop, the Light at the End block. - [**_Ribbits_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits) (mod): adds villager-like mobs called Ribbits to the came, frog people with their own villages, trades, special items, and fun behaviors. - [**_SpaceFrog's Forever Young Tadpoles_**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spacefrogs-forever-young-tadpoles) (datapack): showing a tadpole a slime ball causes a quantum-superposition/magic allows the tadpole to clone itself into an ageless tadpole – keep your tadpole friends in their cute tadpole form forever! - [**_SpaceFrog's Hungry Hungry Frogs_**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spacefrogs-hungry-hungry-frogs) (datapack): frogs will eat hostile mobs. Adds a rare frog variant, The ÜberFrog, an immortal, insatiable frog that can one-shot kill any hostile mob, never taking any damage - makes for a great guard-frog for your base. - [**_SpaceFrog's Recolored Frogs_**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spacefrogs-recolored-frogs) (resource pack): replaces the skin of the warm variant frogs with something a bit less sickly and pale. So if those pale/whitish frogs ever weirded you out, worry not - they're now a beautiful shade of bright, froggy green. - [**_Villager Frog House_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-frog-house) (mod): now swamp villagers finally have a home, they get to live in a giant frog! Well, more of a frog-shaped communal building, still pretty cool. - **And tons more frog-related customizations and easter eggs implemented through special datapacks and [_KubeJS_](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs) scripts.**

### **Fun & Immersive Game Expansions**

- [**_Better End_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend) and [**_Better Nether_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/betternether) (mods): overhauls The End and The Nether adding new biomes, mobs, loot, and structures. The End has never looked better, and The Nether has never been more fun and challenging. - [**_Bosses of Mass Destruction_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bosses-of-mass-destruction) (mod): adds 4 new bosses to the game, each with unique and challenging battle mechanics and drop loot that can be combined to make incredibly powerful tools like anti-gravity devices and a staff that prevents hostile mobs from spawning in a 64-block radius. - [**_Create_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) (mods): brings the industrial revolution to Minecraft! There's way too much to describe, check out the mod's [wiki](https://wiki.createmod.net/). Several addon mods are also included like [_Create Steam 'n' Rails_](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails), [_Create Copycats+_](https://modrinth.com/mod/copycats), [_Create Slice & Dice_](https://modrinth.com/mod/slice-and-dice), and [_Create Enchantment Industry_](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantment-industry-fabric-legacy). - [**_Emotecraft_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/emotecraft) (mod): adds player emotes like in Bedrock edition and allows you to make your own custom emotes. - [**_Explorations_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/explorations) (mod): adds a variety of vanilla-style structures to the world like temples with great loot and other structures that make your world feel lived in. - [**_Immersive Paintings_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-paintings) (mod): adds customizable paintings to your world; use any image and map paints of any size the vanilla paintings come in. - [**_More Axolotl Variants_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/mavm) (mod): adds more axolotl variants - the more variants of amphibians, the better! - [**_Mystic's Biomes_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/mystics-biomes) (mod): adds brand new biomes to world generation - Strawberry Fields, Lavender Meadow, Bamboo Blossom Forest, Autumnal Grove, Lush Oasis, Lagoon, and Tropics. - [**_Nyctophobia_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/nyctophobia) (mod): adds new spooky biomes to world generation - Haunted Forest, Haunted Lakes, Eroded Haunted Forest, Ancient Dead Coral Reef, and Deep Dark Forest. - **_YUNG's mods_**: [Better Desert Temples](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-desert-temples), [Better Dungeons](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-dungeons), [Better Jungle Temples](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-jungle-temples), [Better Mineshafts](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-mineshafts), [Better Nether Fortresses](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-nether-fortresses), [Better Ocean Monuments](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-ocean-monuments), [Better Strongholds](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-strongholds), [Better Witch Huts](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-witch-huts), [Bridges](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-bridges), [Cave Biomes](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-cave-biomes), and [YUNG's Extras](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-extras).

### **Quality-of-Life Improvements**

- [**_Beacon Overhaul Reloaded_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/beacon-overhaul-reloaded) (mod): upgrades beacons to have additional effect options including the unique effects nourishment and long reach. Beacon pyramids can be built taller and with more type of blocks to extend beacon effects over larger areas. - [**_Carry On_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/carry-on) (mod): pick up most of the friendly mobs and transport them anywhere you like. Also lets you pick up chests and barrels and move them without needing to empty them. - [**_Custom Villager Trades_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/custom-villager-trades) (mod): makes wandering traders useful! They'll sell you mini-blocks thanks to Vanilla Tweaks, but this mod also adds lots of useful and powerful, but rare, trades including an easy source for wind charges and some of the loot from Bosses of Mass Destruction. - [**_Inmis_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/inmis) (mod): adds backpacks to the game, adding dozens of new player inventory slots in a banked configuration. - [**_Music Control_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/music-control) (mod): gives you full control of Minecraft music - reduce or eliminate delays between background music tracks and skip over tracks. - [**_Reinforced Shulker Boxes_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/reinforced-shulker-boxes) (mod): adds new craftable shulker boxes that can store up to 108 stacks of items. - [**_Simple Voice Chat_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) (mod): does exactly what is says and adds voice chat to Minecraft. - [**_Smarter Farmers_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/smarter-farmers-farmers-replant) (mod): farmers will replant the crops they farm, no more gardens turning into fields of wheat! - [**_Vanilla Tweaks_**](https://vanillatweaks.net) (datapacks): a selection of the available Vanilla Tweaks datapacks that adds new tools and game rules, makes quality of life improvements, and adds new recipes – name tags are now craftable! For more options, see: [vanillatweaks.net/picker/datapacks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/datapacks) - [**_Vertical Slabs Compat_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/vertical-slabs-compat) (mod): adds vertical slabs to the game, enough said! - [**_Wraith Waystones_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fwaystones) (mod): adds craftable waystones let you instantly teleport to other waystones in the world. It's like having “/tp” but implemented in a very survival vanilla way. - [**_Xaero's World Map_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) and [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) (mods): world map and mini map HUD that shows what areas you've explored in the world, set waypoints, and display players and mobs. - [**_You're in Grave Danger_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/yigd) (mod): adds functional grave stones to the game. When a player dies, a grave stone is left in their place that contains their entire inventory – you never have to worry about your gear despawning before you can get back to it.

### **Visual Enhancments**

- [**_3D Skin Layers_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers) (mod): changes the rendering of the top layer of player skins to be 3D and more consistent with the way mobs render in the game. - [**_Better Clouds_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds) (mod): adds amazing looking, customizable clouds that still look Minecrafty. - [**_Bobby_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby) (mod): cashes chunks that have rendered in you work and displays them without loading them, making you able to see far beyond your render distance and makes you world feel so much bigger with minimal performance penalties. - [**_Dramatic Skys_**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/dramatic-skys) (resource pack): makes the skies HD with realistic clouds and lighting. - [**_Fresh Animations_**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) (resource pack): beings new life and expressiveness to vanilla mobs reminiscent to Element Animations' Minecraft shorts. - [**_Iris Shaders_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) (mod): a popular shader pack loader, included are three preinstalled shader options: [Miniature Shader](https://modrinth.com/shader/miniature-shader), [Nostalgia Shader](https://modrinth.com/shader/nostalgia-shader), and [Rethinking Voxels](https://modrinth.com/shader/rethinking-voxels) - [**_Lamb Dynamic Lights_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights) (mod): adds dynamic lighting and emissive lighting from items held by the player like Optifine. - [**_Vanilla Tweaks_**](https://vanillatweaks.net) (resource packs): a selection of the available Vanilla Tweaks resource packs that fix visual bugs in Minecraft and add other visual enhancements that conform to the vanilla aesthetic. For more options, see: [vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs)

### **Technical & Performance Improvements**

- [**_BetterF3_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3) (mod): massively improves the F3 screen with customizable fields and color-coding. - [**_Chunky_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/chunky) (mod): allows you to pre-generate chunks over large definable areas in specific patterns (square, circular, oval, etc.) improving server performance and rendering. - [**_CreateBetterFps_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/createbetterfps) (mod): improves performance around Create mod components that typically trash frame rates like water wheels. - [**_Dynamic FPS_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) (mod): improves client system perfornace by reducing resource usage while Minecraft is in the background, idle, or on battery. - [**_KubeJS_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs) (mod): a powerful Javascript-based scripting mod that enables users and server admins to implement customizations that go far beyond the capabilities of datapacks. - [**_Ksyxis_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ksyxis) (mod): speed up world loading and reduce resources utilization by removing the requirement to keep spawn chunks loaded at all times. - [**_Madgique's Tickrate Changer_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/madgique-tickrate-changer) (mod): lets you change the world tickrate to custom values similar to the 1.20.3+ command '/tick'. - [**_Memory Leak Fix_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/memoryleakfix) (mod): fixes random memory leaks for both the client and server and includes other performance improvements. - [**_MiniHUD_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/minihud) (mod): adds a 'mini F3' screen and various overlays like light level, spawn chunks, slime chunks, and custom shapes like de-spawn spheres. - [**_Roughly Enough Items (REI)_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei) (mod): similar to JEI, view and search the full registry of blocks and items in the game, view recipes, item tags, etc. - [**_Sodium_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) (mod): Makes massive improvements to performance and give you more control of your video settings. - [**_Tweakeroo_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/tweakeroo) (mod): adds an enormous amount of new tools for power users including auto-clickers and freecam.

### **Mods for Builders**

Mods that add tons of custom blocks and items you can use to spruce up your builds: [**_Additional Additions_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/addadd), [**_Adorn_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/adorn), [**_Beautify Refabricated_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/beautify-refabricated), [**_Better Lily Pads_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-lily-pads), [**_BetterEnd Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-cutting-betterend), [**_Chipped_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped), [**_Decorative Blocks_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/decorative-blocks), [**_Ender's Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/enders-delight), [**_Every Compat (Wood Good)_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/every-compat), [**_Expanded Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/expanded-delight), [**_Farmer's Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated), [**_Hearth & Home_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/hearth-and-home), [**_Nethers Delight Refabricated_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/nethers-delight-refabricated), [**_Paladin's Furniture Mod_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/paladins-furniture), [**_Re:Deco_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/redeco), [**_Rustic Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/rustic-delight), [**_Storage Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/storage-delight), [**_Supplementaries_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries), [**_Valhelsia Furniture_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/valhelsia-furniture)

### **Backports for Minecraft 1.20.1** - [**_Autocrafter Early_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/autocrafter-early) (mod): adds the autocrafter, uses the original block texture - [**_Backport Paintings 1.21_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/backport-paintings-1.21) (mod): adds the new set of paintings introduced in 1.21 - [**_Backported Spears_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/backported-spears) (mod): adds spears and related enchantments - [**_Backpost Wolves_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/backported-wolves) (mod): adds the new wolf variants from 1.20.5 - [**_Bundle Backport-ish_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bundle-backportish) (mod): adds the bundle scrolling and dyeing mechanics from 1.21.2 - [**_Copper and Tuff Backport_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/copper-and-tuff-backport) (mod): adds the copper and tuff blocks from 1.21 along with copper tools and armor - [**_Faithful Mace_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/faithful-mace) (mod): adds the mace, related enchantments, and the wind charge - [**_Happy Ghast_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/happy-ghast) (mod): adds the Happy Ghast, Ghastling, and Dried Ghast - [**_Pale Garden Backport_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/pale-garden-backport) (mod): adds The Creaking, resin blocks, the Pale Gardens biome, and the rest of the Pale Garden update
### **Mob Overhauls & Additions**

[**_Companion_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/companion), [**_Creeper Overhaul_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/creeper-overhaul), [**_Critters and Companions_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/critters-and-companions), [**_Earth2Java_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/earth2java), [**_Enderman Overhaul_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderman-overhaul), [**_Happy Ghast_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/happy-ghast), [**_More Axolotl Variants_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/mavm), [**_More Frogs 2_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/morefrogs), [**_Naturalist_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/naturalist), [**_Promenade_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/promenade), [**_Ribbits_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits).

### **And so much more!**

There are so many more under the hood enhancements and fixes, quality of life improvements, and powerful tools like [**_Axiom_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom) and [**_Litematica_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) – really, just too many to summarize.

Guide for Installation on Servers The following is a step-by-step guide on how to install FroggyCraft on a server hosted by Modrinth, but the general points should be applicable to other hosting services:

  1. Join the FroggyCraft Discord and download the PATCHED_MODS_FOR_SERVERS.zip file from the pinned comment in the "troubleshooting" chat. Unzip the files to your PC.
  2. Log into your account on the Modrinth website. Start a new server or reset an old server and select the installation type "Modpack base".
  3. In the modpack search bar, enter "FroggyCraft", select the modpack, and set the properties you want for the server (e.g., game mode, difficulty, etc.).
  4. Under the "Options" tab you'll see a button labeled "Platform" – click this button and select the option to "Unlink Modpack".
  5. Under the "Content" tab you'll find the mods and datapacks associated with FroggyCraft. Disable all of the mods with the yellow warning triangle indicating they're client-side only mods with the exception of the mod "Athena" – do not disable this mod. In case you're not installing the modpack on a Modrinth hosted server, a complete list of mods to disable is found in the PATCHED_MODS_FOR_SERVERS.zip file.
    Note: You'll see that some mods have updates ready, but do not update any mods or it will likely break compatibility between the various mods of FroggyCraft.
  6. There are three mods that need to be DELETED and replaced with patched versions – Bucket of Frog, Re:Deco, and Structurify. Make sure you delete these mods, don't just disable them, the original files need to be absent from the server before the patched files are uploaded.
  7. Click the "Upload files" button and upload the patched .jar files Bucket of Frog, Re:Deco, and Structurify found in the folder on your PC where you unzipped the PATCHED_MODS_FOR_SERVERS.zip file. The patched file names end in "FROGGYCRAFT_SERVER.jar" so as to avoid confusion with their unpatched versions.
    Note: Do not replace these mods with their patched version on your local client – FroggyCraft will run perfectly fine on your PC without any modifications and will be able to log into any server running the same version of FroggyCraft so long as the server's mods have been patched.
  8. You're all done setting up the server. Start the server and try logging into it from your PC. You might get an error when first logging in, but just try again, and it should work (this seems to be a sporadic issue related to Modrinth servers). For trouble shooting, join the Discord and ask for help in the troubleshooting chat.
Known Bugs
  • Items in the hotbar might be invisible upon first login; open your backpack once to resolve this.
  • Aquarium from Additional Fishing does not render vanilla fish/aquatics; they still exist and can be retrieved with a bucket but can’t be seen in the aquarium.
  • If you rename an ÜberFrog and place it in a bucket, it will lose its special ÜberFrog traits and become a normal frog. This only affects the ÜberFrog when placed in a bucket; otherwise, renaming an ÜberFrog will not remove its special traits.
  • The mods Bucket of Frog, Re:Deco, and Structurify have bugs that crash servers. To run FroggyCraft on a server, you'll need to use patched versions of these mods – links and instructions are found above in the "Guide for Installation on Modrinth Servers" section.
Future Plans Plans for FroggyCraft v1.2 or later:

  • Pick Your Poison (mod): adds tiny poison dart frogs to the world, and you can lick them and get cool effects! For legal purposes: do not lick poison dart frogs in game or IRL.
  • SpaceFrog's FrogCoin Currency (datapack): pay for villager trades with FrogCoin instead of lousy old emeralds. Your server economy can also run on FrogCoin - FrogCoin for everyone!
  • The modpack won't be updating to a version of Minecraft newer than 1.20.1 until the fabric version of Create Mod updates. Until then, I'll be adding mods that backport features of newer versions of Minecraft when possible.
  • If you have suggestions or features or changes to the next version of FroggyCraft, let me know by joining the FroggyCraft Discord (see the link at the top of the page).
Credits
  • Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/
  • All resources that have titles beginning with "SpaceFrog" are written by me, SpaceFrog1984.
  • All other mods and resources are downloadable through Modrinth and have attributions listed on their Modrinth page.

title: Wizardcraft

title: Simulatrix Revival
description: An addon for Gravestone:Herotime that revives the Simulatrix from the 1.12.2 era
body:
This mod is an addon to the well known mod called Gravestone:Herotime, this addon aims to revive an old custom omnitrix of mine that appeared breifely back in 1.12.2 for the lucraft core mod. (For lore reasons) The Simulatrix is, in essence, just an omnitrix but it's glitched causing choas and mayhem but also does a lot of good.

The rought lore draft:

Azmuth prime created a simulated copy of his universe to digitally preserve all life forms in case the omnitrix failed, however the simulated Azmuth was made too smart for his own good causing him to realise he was in a simulation. Upon learning this he created a way to manipulate the simulated universe condensing a copy of it into an omnitrix of his own but it was too unstable making the simulatrix glitch beyond repair. Simulated Azmuth tried to destroy the simulatrix to no avail causing even worse glitches, at this point Azmuth was distraught worried about the consequences of his creation. Simulated Azmuth later blasted the simulatrix into the far reaches of his universe thinking it’ll never be found, however it landed on earth where a human child no older than 10 discovered it.


It is recommended to use JEI for the recipes!!!

Huge thanks to Deaded and Fsang for their help in developing this addon

title: Snowball and Egg Knockback
description: Returns the snowball and egg knockback mechanics of old Minecraft, for fun! Inspired by HalfloveJAR's original 2016 plugin.
body:
[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/donate/kofi-singular-alt_vector.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/derexxd) 

> If this project helped you, please consider leaving some stars [on the Github](https://github.com/Derec-Mods)! 

# Snowball Damage

Snowball Damage is an extremely lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows you to modify the damage dealt by **snowballs** and **eggs** to any entity. If y'all are old enough, you should remember when snowballs could do 0 damage but still affect players with knockback, which was especially used on minigames like Skywars. This was removed in 1.9 Minecraft.

This project is **forked from halfloveJAR** full credit to them for the original work. I've made my own additions I wanted to add, and optimized their code. 


## Features

- Configurable damage
- Works with Snow Golem snowballs
- Option to restore vanilla knockback mechanics for eggs & snowballs

## Configuration

A default configuration file looks like this:  
http://pastebin.com/3fYh0gkq

### Important Note
Whatever damage value you set in the config is **divided by 2 in-game**.

**Example:**
- Config value: `6`
- In-game damage: `3 hearts`

This follows Minecraft’s internal damage calculations.

## Credits

- **Original Plugin:** halfloveJAR  

Huge thanks to **halfloveJAR** for the base implementation.

## License

Please respect the original license from halfloveJAR when redistributing or modifying this plugin.

title: Bundled Arrows
description: Use arrows from bundles with bows and crossbows. Smart inventory management with Infinity support.
body:
![#Bundled Arrows](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86034e1415155f21695678d8b7cdcac226ff9a85.png)

![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-green)
![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modloader-Fabric-blue)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow)

Use arrows stored in bundles with your bow and crossbow! Never run out of arrows in the heat of battle.

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Smart Arrow Management
- **Bundle Integration** - Use arrows directly from any colored bundle
- **Intelligent Priority** - Automatically uses inventory arrows first, then bundle arrows
- **Infinity Compatible** - Respects Infinity enchantment for normal arrows
- **Special Arrow Support** - Infinity consumes special arrows (spectral, tipped) as intended

### 📦 Bundle Support
- **All Bundle Colors** - Works with white, orange, magenta, and all other bundle variants
- **Order Preservation** - Bundle contents maintain their original order
- **Performance Optimized** - Efficient caching system for minimal performance impact

### ⚔️ Weapon Compatibility
- **Bows** - Full support with all enchantments
- **Crossbows** - Automatically works with crossbows
- **All Arrow Types** - Normal, spectral, tipped, and modded arrows

## 🚀 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Download [Bundled Arrows](https://modrinth.com/mod/bundled-arrows/versions)
4. Place the JAR file in your `.minecraft/mods/` folder

## 🎮 How to Use

1. Place arrows in any bundle
2. Keep the bundle in your inventory
3. Use your bow/crossbow normally
4. Arrows from bundles are used automatically when inventory arrows run out

### 💡 Tips
- Bundle arrows are used **after** inventory arrows are depleted
- Infinity enchantment works correctly (doesn't consume normal arrows)
- Special arrows (spectral, tipped) are always consumed, even with Infinity
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer

## 🔧 Technical Details

- **Client & Server compatible** - Works in multiplayer
- **Requirements**:
    - Minecraft 1.21.11
    - Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
    - Fabric API 0.141.1+
- **Performance**: Optimized caching system with minimal overhead
- **No configuration needed** - Works out of the box

## 🤝 Compatibility

- Compatible with most arrow-related mods
- Works alongside inventory management mods
- No conflicts with texture packs or resource packs
- Server-side installation optional (works client-only)

## 🛠️ Reporting Issues

Found a bug or have a suggestion?
[Open an issue](https://github.com/Astralis-B/bundled-arrows/issues)

Please include:
- Minecraft version
- Mod version
- Other installed mods
- Steps to reproduce the issue

## 🙏 Credits

- **Astralis** - Development
- **FabricMC** - Modloader foundation

## 📜 License

Licensed under MIT License. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.

title: SSaVS MOD
description: Server Security and voting system - add custom ui (not inventory) and way to PAPER servers block ANY mods/rp in client. Support ONLY for 1.21.4
body:
### IMPORTANT!

My english very bad. Sorry for this english description, it`s created with AI. If you see some mistakes - please, give me know. My Discord\: Kanorto
Russian normal description below english.

---

## English

**Purpose**

The system verifies client mods and resource packs (**with a paper server plugin**), manages interactive votes with flexible duration and background and give you option to create custom UI. It includes modules that can be enabled or disabled independently. Built specifically for the ReHard project and published to let people download it quickly. For questions or support: **discord\: `kanorto`** 

Important: this is a client-side mod only, designed as a companion to a server-side plugin. The plugin NOW (planned release free version of plugin with some base features) is NOT included in this project and is optional: the mod runs without it, but many features are enabled only when the server has the plugin installed. 

## Features

* **Client verification:**

  * The server requests the player’s list of installed mods, user hwid hash and active resource packs.
  * The list is checked against a blacklist (regex supported, case-insensitive). If there’s a match, the player is kicked.
  * When the Verification module is disabled, the server does not request the mod list.

* **Interactive voting:**

  * Full-screen client UI, world dimming, movement lock (unless explicitly allowed).
  * Supports a title, description, choice list, background image (base64 or public URL), and per-vote duration (`--duration=`).
  * Supports early termination via the `/securityvote end` command.
  * Live vote statistics; the server sends updates only to participating players.
  * The Voting module can be disabled; in this case all `/securityvote` commands are rejected.

* **Flexible menus:**
  * **Rich server-driven menus** – displays JSON menus with textured buttons, text inputs, toggles, dropdowns, MiniMessage text, placeholders, conditional visibility, per-click actions, breadcrumbs and real-time updates. Many types of subjects and actions availible now, and more soon.
  * All menus transfer to client in security channel with encryption handshake.

* **Security:**
  * **Secure encrypted handshake** – establishes a per-session AES key, encrypts menus, button presses and form data, reports installed mods, resource packs and a hardware ID, queues menu requests and automatically retries so the server can verify the client.
  * Unrecognized sub-packets are ignored.
  * Immediate kick upon detecting prohibited mods/resource packs.

---

## Русский

Мод нужен для:
* Кастомных меню. Мод позволяет получить с сервера меню, с расположением кнопок и текстур в любой части. Меню не зависит от инвентаря, и уже позволяет реализовать множество функций, которые раньше было невозможно или сложно реализовать (например ввод текста, переключатели, выпадающие списки, картинки в любых местах, условия показа пользователю и постоянные обновления например для показа времени(КРАЙНЕ НАГРУЖАЕТ СЕРВЕР ПРИ БОЛЬШОМ КОЛИЧЕСТВЕ!)). Вы также можете реализовать многостраничные меню (с полуавтоматическим возвратом на предыдущую страницу).
  
* Голосования внутри игры. Позволяет запускать голосования прямо внутри игры, с пагинацией и реалтайм статистикой, которую можно скрыть нажатием одной клавиши. 
  
* Клавиша для главного кастомного меню сервера позволяет пользователям легко без дополнительных команд и модов открывать меню по нажатию клавиши.
  
* Защиты серверов. Он отправляет на поддерживаемые сервера с помощью зашифрованного канала список модов и ресурспаков человека. Таким образом плагин на стороне сервера может обеспечить защиту, кикнув или сообщив о некорректных модификациях.

title: Better Tipped Arrows
description: Enhances tipped arrows by adding lingering potion effects when they hit the ground.
body:
**Better Tipped Arrows** improves the behavior of vanilla tipped arrows by making their effects more intuitive and useful.

When a tipped arrow hits the ground, instead of requiring players to shoot entities directly, it releases a **vanilla-style lingering potion cloud** at the impact location.  
The cloud uses the **exact potion, duration, and amplifier** of the arrow, creating a behavior consistent with lingering potions.

### Features :

*   Works with **all vanilla tipped arrows**
*   Spawns a **lingering potion effect cloud on impact**
*   Uses **original potion data** (type, duration, amplifier)
*   Fully **vanilla-balanced behavior**
*   No custom items or arrows added
*   Server-side safe and lightweight

Perfect for support gameplay, tactical combat, and utility effects without awkward self-inflicted shots.
