title: The Moonjester
description: When the clock strikes midnight, the curtain rises. Perform the ritual, summon the Lucky Star, and trade for items that twist fate itself.
body:
## The Moonjester Mod

Centered around The Moonjester (also known as The Lucky Star, The Harlequin, or The Performer, depending on where you hail from), this mod rewards curiosity, exploration, and those bold enough to climb the highest peaks or plunder from the deepest of darks. 

Craft the Divination Table and seek out the jagged peaks of the world. When the moon is high and the clock strikes midnight, present your offerings.

### Items

Speak with the curious Moonjester to obtain items that manipulate the fundamental rules of Minecraft:

- **The Enigma Coin:** A gambler's charm. Imbue the tool in your off-hand with powerful luck-based enchantments.

- **The Jester's Bell:** A disorienting tool that swaps your position with your target instantly.

- **Lucky Cards:** Villagers seem to treat you as a friend with a card that gives you a sense of unearned heroism.

- **Getaway Cards:** Disappear from the scene and return straight to your respawn point.

- **The Jester's Mask:** Gamble with fate and receive a random status effect.

Or, you can just play with it! The Moonjester is a curious and fascinated creature, and would love to see what's around your world. Try focusing the stars to your Divination Table elsewhere in your world to give it an opportunity to explore.

You may also find relics of a long forgotten past throughout your world.

- Faded Cards: Sparks of magic from lucky ones of the past. Combine them into a Faded Deck for a true boost.

### Getting Started
Find a Wandering Trader to purchase your first Lore Scrap. They can't always be fully trusted, though.

Decipher the clues to learn the components of the Divination Table. 

Prepare for the Curtain Call.


<details>
<summary>Author's Notes :)</summary>

## Author's Notes :)
Hi I'm plourples I made this mod mainly as a lore showcase for my character. It's cryptic and weird and I adore it. I tried to make this feel Vanilla-plus-ish, trying my best to retain things to what Minecraft is on its own, but still representing my character fairly accurately. 

This is my first mod, so it isn't perfect but I think it's neat! I tried refining this into an experience worth keeping in a pack. It's only got a few additions and it's super easy to generally ignore the deeper part of the mod if you're not interested, while still getting some additions and benefits just on the surface. Generally, I hope this is an enjoyable mod for you however deep you choose to explore. 

Also this hasn't been tested on multiplayer, let me know how it goes!!

</details>

title: Searchr
description: Reverse-search ported from your favourite shell to Minecraft
body:
# Searchr

Reverse-search ported from your favourite shell to Minecraft.

## What is Searchr

Searchr is a minimalistic utility that allows you to search your chat / command history, inspired by the reverse-search feature of various terminal
shells.

## Usage

Keybinds:

- `CTRL+R` to start searching
- `Esc or CTRL+C` to stop searching
- `Tab or Enter` to select the suggestion and exit the search

Searchr integrates with [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and provides a bunch of settings you can change (for example the colors).

## Alternative mods

The following mods also provide search functionality and might be better suited for you:

- [darmiel/fuzzy](https://modrinth.com/mod/fuzzy) is a [fzf](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf) inspired search utility with a neat user
  interface.

## License

Searchr is licensed under the [MIT license](LICENSE).

title: PrivateMessage
description: A Simple /msg Plugin
body:
# CustomMessage

Bring private messaging to your Bukkit/Spigot server with ease! **CustomMessage** gives your players a clean, familiar DM system complete with clickable usernames, reply & ignore functionality, social-spy for staff, spam control, and fully-customizable formats.

---

## 🚀 Key Features
- **`/msg <player> <message>`** – Send a private DM with a teal ✉ envelope prefix  
- **`/r <message>`** – Quickly reply to your last DM without re-typing the recipient  
- **`/ignore <player>`** / **`/unignore <player>`** – Block or unblock DMs from specific users  
- **`/socialspy`** (staff only) – See **all** DMs in real time with a 🛡 **SPY** prefix  
- **Spam-control** – Configurable cooldown between messages to prevent abuse  
- **Clickable JSON chat** – Click any “Me”, player name, or “You” in DMs to open a `/msg` prompt  
- **Fully configurable** – Change every prefix, color, usage message, cooldown, and more in `config.yml`

---

## 📋 Commands & Permissions

| Command        | Permission                  | Default | Description                                      |
| -------------- | --------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `/msg`         | `custommessage.msg`         | **✔️**  | Send a private message                           |
| `/r`           | `custommessage.msg`         | **✔️**  | Reply to your last private message               |
| `/ignore`      | `custommessage.ignore`      | **✔️**  | Toggle ignoring DMs from a player                |
| `/unignore`    | `custommessage.ignore`      | **✔️**  | Stop ignoring a player’s DMs                     |
| `/socialspy`   | `custommessage.socialspy`   | **OP**  | Toggle social-spy (staff only) to watch every DM |

> **Staff note:** Anyone with `custommessage.socialspy` (default: OP) will see every DM prefixed with 🛡 **SPY**.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yaml
# config.yml

# ─── Chat formats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
formats:
  msg:    '&7[Msg] &f%sender% &8→ &f%target% &8: &7%message%'
  spy:    '&7[Spy] &f%sender% &8→ &f%target% &8: &7%message%'

# ─── Spam control ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# seconds between allowed /msg’s per player
cooldown-seconds: 2
# warning when you hit cooldown (%seconds% will be filled in)
cooldown-message: '&cSlow down! Wait %seconds%s before messaging again.'

# ─── /r (reply) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
reply:
  usage:     '&eUsage: /r <message>'
  no-partner: '&cNo one to reply to.'
  offline:   '&cYour last chat partner is offline.'

# ─── /ignore & /unignore ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
ignore:
  usage:   '&eUsage: /ignore <player>'
  on:      '&cYou are now ignoring &f%target%'
  off:     '&aYou are no longer ignoring &f%target%'
  invalid: '&cInvalid player.'
  self:    '&cYou cannot ignore yourself.'
  blocked: '&cThat player is ignoring you.'

unignore:
  usage: '&eUsage: /unignore <player>'
  on:    '&aYou are no longer ignoring &f%target%'
  off:   '&eYou were not ignoring &f%target%'

# ─── /socialspy ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
socialspy:
  on:            '&aSocialSpy on'
  off:           '&cSocialSpy off'
  no-permission: '&cYou must be OP to toggle social spy.'

# ─── Generic fallbacks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
no-permission:   '&cYou don’t have permission for that.'
only-players:    '&cOnly players can run that command.'
usage-msg:       '&eUsage: /msg <player> <message>'

title: TypingInChat Plugin
description: Bukkit plugin, that allows server to show when players are writing in chat.
body:
![Plugin logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/557312a3f6e2bfb893952c71360c1e36852a8287.png) ![Basic chat typing animation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1c7e0d0b2e7d5e402333888c9fb597565a60d4e.gif) Enable your server players to see when someone actively writing in chat. Server admins should install this plugin on their server. Then everyone who install [TypingInChat client side mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/typinginchat-mod) will have visual indication while they are mashing keys in chat interface. Players who do not have client-side mod will only see other player's indicators and will not have their own. # Features - Animated and highly customizable. Looks defined by server admins. - Permissions support to show or hide indication for specific users or groups. - Visible for players that don't have clientside mod. - Based on packets and text-display entities. - Text-displays are attached to players. # Customization Examples Colored indicator, indentation enabled, text-shadow disabled: [GIF](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d6efe5a2-e311-4d05-87dc-89802a8ff5bd)
Colored everything, no indentation, text-shadow enabled: [GIF](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/619383d6-2cf2-483d-bbd0-aa488d97e00f)
Default colors, player name hidden: [GIF](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a1d01a4f-9e06-446b-969f-ef562f6f6ddf) # Installation You need to put typinginchat-spigot.jar into server plugins folder. Also, you need to have [packetevents 2.6.0](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents) and [HologramAPI 1.6.0](https://modrinth.com/plugin/hologramlib) or newer installed. # Configuration You may change TIC indicators appearance with config.yml. ```yaml config.yml #Show player display names show-names: true #Indentation style of typing icon icon-indentation: true #Hologram visibility radius view-range: 16 #Hologram visibility through blocks visible-through-blocks: false #UNICODE character or text for typing animation typing-char: "✎" #Color customization names-color: "#ffffff" typing-icon-color: "#ffffff" background-color: "#000000" #From 0 to 255 background-transparency: 50 #Shadow outline of text font text-shadow: false #use /tic reload command to apply changes ``` # Permissions **tic.display** - allows player to have tic indication. True by default, but you can remove it from players or groups.
**tic.admin** - required for _/typinginchat reload_ command usage. # Related Link for client-side mode (required only for players who want to show when they typing in chat): [TypingInChat-Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/typinginchat-mod)

title: Horde Piggies
description: Pigs reproduce themselves, and gonna take the whole world under their pack!
body:
This mod adds some special pigs which reproduce themselves and evolve into stronger variants, consuming everything on their way.

How they work?
1. Queen pig gets spawned and starts to produce lesser pigs.
2. Lesser pigs will kill surrounding creatures and share resource themselves, especially to queen pigs.
3. When lesser pigs gain certain resource, they will evolve!
4. Also as the queen pigs get many resource, pigs that are made by them will get stronger.
5. When queen pigs enough resource, they will produce a special pig. (For now, there's only a pig golem for it)
6. Queen pigs can order the pigs in their pack to attack their target. (Which means provoking only one queen pig may make the whole horde attacks towards you.)

All pigs are also able to gain resources from killing other mobs, and can be healed when attacked by mobs in same pack.

Also, please note that the color of the pigs are chosen completely randomly, based on their alpha queen's uuid. And they will also attack the pigs that have different pack id between them!

title: BlockSwapper
description: Serverside plugin that automatically refills a survival players hotbar as they are building!
body:
Supports Spigot, Paper and Folia servers!

![Visualisation of the plugins functionality](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53301d36a182e9cbce2f2917d96f64263252d57b.png)

BlockSwapper is a simple, lightweight plugin that automatically refills a players hotbar when they are building, if they have additional blocks of the same type in their inventory. It does this by detecting when a survival mode player places the last block in a stack and automatically searches their inventory for stacks of the same material. It then moves the first stack it finds into their hotbar.

## Installation
Simply drop the .jar file into your servers plugins folder. This plugin requires Java 17 or newer to be installed.

## Permissions
There is only one permission: blockswapper.use - this allows a player to benefit from this plugin. This permission defaults to true.

## Config
There is no configuration for this plugin.

## Support and Suggestions
If you have a suggestion for how to improve this plugin, or an issue while using it, please join the support discord https://discord.gg/yJthQdW5Ja

body:
# Nod3py's Customs
Hey there! I wanted to make a mod that encapsulated every cosmetic addition I wanted as servers like Hypixel started switching over to later versions of the game (1.21.1).

Recently, I created a mod that stops the rendering of not only armor, but also textured player skulls when worn.

As I developed that mod, I figured I would add more and more features to a seperate mod-- a mod I've wanted for ages but never got. A mod that could add cosmetic functionality for servers I play on, and maybe y'all could benefit too!

This is the result of that.

![1.8 Sword Blocking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f174e328cd50d994bf7ac1729e598b6329810e6.png)


## Features
### General
- Enabling/Disabling of Armor and Worn Skulls

![ArmorDisabling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06293147ddfed3c3a18da7a374a2ed0618531485_0.webp)
  - Incompatible with ShowMeYourSkin
- Reintroducing 1.8 Sword Blocking WITHOUT THE NEED FOR SHIELDS BEING EQUIPPED
  - Works with custom item models/textures

### Skyblock-Specific
- /pd or /i4 <player> to get an overlay color for the spirit leap menu in dungeons
- **Dungeon Map**

![Dungeon Map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e67a0bc857200cbde9fff772f05f19a22ccc93aa.png)

title: Renk - Color Customization
description: A plugin for name color customization via hex codes or predefined colors.
body:
# Renk - A Simple Color Plugin

Renk is a plugin that allows players to customize their display name color.  It uses hex color codes and translates them to the closest supported Minecraft color for team-based name tag coloring.

## Features

- Players can change or reset their color using commands.
- Admins can set the color of other players.
- Player colors are saved to a JSON file (`plugins/Renk/player_colors.json`) and applied when they join.
- Supports hex color codes (e.g., `#FF0000`) and predefined color names (e.g., `red`, `blue`, `green`).
- Utilizes the [MiniMessage](https://docs.advntr.dev/) library for formatting color codes and messages.
- Uses Scoreboard Teams to approximate the player's display name color on their nametag.
- Configuration file (`config.yml`) for customizing messages.

## Commands

- `/renk <#hex | color_name>`: Changes the player's own color to the specified hex color or predefined color name.  Examples: `/renk #FF0000`, `/renk red`.
- `/renk set <player> <#hex | color_name>`: Allows admins to set the color of another player. Examples: `/renk set Kikaru #00FF00`, `/renk set Kikaru green`.
- `/renk reset`: Resets the player's own color to the default.
- `/renk reset <player>`: Allows admins to reset another player's color.

### Predefined Colors
The following color names can be used instead of hex codes: `black`, `dark_blue`, `dark_green`, `dark_aqua`, `dark_red`, `dark_purple`, `gold`, `gray`, `dark_gray`, `blue`, `green`, `aqua`, `red`, `light_purple`, `yellow`, `white`.

### Permissions

- `renk.use`: Allows the use of the `/renk` command.
- `renk.set.other`: Allows the use of the `/renk set` command to change the color of other players.
- `renk.reset.other`: Allows the use of the `/renk reset` command to reset the color of other players.

## Configuration

The plugin uses a `config.yml` file located in the `plugins/Renk/` directory to store configurable messages.  You can customize the messages that are displayed to players by modifying this file.  Use color codes with MiniMessage.

title: Auto Freeze
description:
一个能让服务器中无人游玩时自动暂停，上线后自动恢复的模组。可有效帮助节省CPU资源和电费。

A plugin that automatically pauses the server when no players are online and resumes when a player joins. This can effectively save CPU resources and electricity costs.
body: ### [中文](#ch-section) [English](#en-section) # 自动冻结 ## 功能介绍 ### 基础功能 1. **自动暂停和恢复游戏** 当服务器中无人游玩时，自动暂停游戏，节省服务器资源和电费。当有玩家上线时，自动恢复游戏。 2. **可配置的日志记录** 可通过`settings.yml`文件配置“在日志中和控制台记录在线人数的时间间隔”。 3. **可配置的玩家检测频率** 可通过`settings.yml`文件配置“检测玩家人数并冻结/解冻游戏的频率”。 ## 配置文件 ```yaml # 配置文件 # 设为0即禁用 # 单位：游戏刻 tick (1/20s) # 在日志中和控制台记录在线人数的时间间隔 logPlayerCountInterval: 0 # 监测玩家人数而冻结/解冻游戏的频率 # 该值越小 对游戏公平性影响越小 <=10t 几乎不可能作弊 # 该值不宜 >20t playerCountCheckInterval: 10 ``` ## 同作用 其他加载器的类似模组 ### Fabric: Tick Stasis [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/tick-stasis "链接") --- # AutoFreeze ## Features ### Basic Features 1. **Automatic Game Pausing and Resuming** Automatically pause the game when no players are online to save server resources and electricity. Resume the game automatically when a player joins. 2. **Configurable Logging** You can configure the "interval for logging the number of online players in the logs and console" through the `settings.yml` file. 3. **Configurable Player Detection Frequency** You can configure the "frequency for checking player counts and freezing/unfreezing the game" through the `settings.yml` file. ## Configuration File ```yaml # Configuration File # Set to 0 to disable # Unit: game tick (1/20s) # Interval for logging the number of online players in the logs and console logPlayerCountInterval: 0 # Frequency for checking player counts to freeze/unfreeze the game # The smaller the value, the less impact on game fairness <=10t almost impossible to cheat # It is not recommended to set this value >20t playerCountCheckInterval: 10 ``` ## Similar Modules for Other Loaders ### Fabric: Tick Stasis [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/tick-stasis "Link")

title: ZombPlayer
description: Spawns a zombified player when a player is killed by zombified creature
body:
# Introduction

This mod will spawn a zombified player when a player is killed by zombified creature.

## Features

- When a player is killed by zombified creature (including husks, drowneds etc.), a zombie will be spawned in the place.
- The zombie will inherit player's equipment and inventory. Players need to kill the zombie to retrieve them. _This feature won't work when the gamerule `keepInventory` is set to true._
- The head of the zombie is same as the player's, and will drop if killed by a __charged creeper__.
- The zombie will convert to the drowned when drowned like normal zombies.
- The zombie won't burn in sunlight.
- Type command `/gamerule doPlayerInfected [false/true]` to switch the mod. (Default true)

## Gallery

title: Potion Effects Set
description: Grant potion effects to your items
body:
# Potion Effects Set Datapack-driven item potion effects, set bonuses, Curios support, and loot table injections. This project exists in two versions: - `Forge 1.20.1` - `NeoForge 1.21.1` Both versions share the same core idea and almost the same datapack workflow, so pack makers can use one system across both branches. ## What The Mod Does With this mod, you can: - give passive effects while an item is equipped - give on-hit effects when the player attacks - give on-hurt effects when the player takes damage - target one item, many items through tags, or special variants through `nbt` - create tiered sets such as 2-piece, 3-piece, and 4-piece bonuses - count Curios pieces, including duplicate accessories such as two matching rings - inject custom rewards into existing loot tables without replacing them ## Versions ### Forge Version - Loader: `Forge` - Minecraft: `1.20.1` - Branch/mod: `Potion Effects Set` Important note: - in the Forge version, `nbt` matches normal item NBT data ### NeoForge Version - Loader: `NeoForge` - Minecraft: `1.21.1` - Branch/mod: `Neo Pot Effect Set` Important note: - in the NeoForge version, you still write `nbt` in the JSON - internally, that matcher is checked against the item's `custom_data` component That means the config format stays familiar, even though Minecraft changed how custom item data is stored. ## Shared Datapack Features Both versions support: - exact item entries like `minecraft:diamond_sword` - root tag entries like `#mymod:guardian_armor` - advanced `rules` matchers - `sets` and `set_bonuses` - `loot_table_injections` ## Quick Example ```json { "minecraft:diamond_sword": { "on_hit_effects": [ { "effect": "minecraft:poison", "amplifier": 1, "duration": 100, "chance": 0.3, "slot": "mainhand" } ] } } ``` This applies `Poison II` for `5 seconds` with a `30% chance` when the sword hits in the main hand. ## Tags Use tags when many items should share the same effect setup. ```json { "#mymod:guardian_armor": { "passive_effects": [ { "effect": "minecraft:resistance", "amplifier": 0, "permanent": true } ] } } ``` ## Special Variants With `rules` Use `rules` when the same base item can exist in different variants. ```json { "rules": [ { "match": { "item": "minecraft:diamond_chestplate", "nbt": { "pem": { "set_id": "guardian" } } }, "passive_effects": [ { "effect": "minecraft:resistance", "amplifier": 1, "permanent": true, "slot": "chest" } ] } ] } ``` Recommended pattern: - store your custom data under your own root, such as `pem` - use fields like `set_id`, `role`, `variant`, or `rarity` ## Sets Sets let you unlock stronger bonuses as more matching pieces are equipped. ```json { "sets": [ { "id": "guardian", "display_name": "Guardian Set", "piece_match": { "tag": "mymod:guardian_set" }, "tiers": [ { "required_pieces": 2, "passive_effects": [ { "effect": "minecraft:resistance", "amplifier": 0, "permanent": true } ] }, { "required_pieces": 4, "passive_effects": [ { "effect": "minecraft:resistance", "amplifier": 1, "permanent": true }, { "effect": "minecraft:absorption", "amplifier": 0, "permanent": true } ] } ] } ] } ``` Set counting includes: - main hand - offhand - armor - Curios Curios note: - duplicate matching accessories count separately - two matching rings can count as two set pieces ## Loot Table Injections The mod can add your custom items into existing loot tables without replacing them. ### Inject a custom loot table ```json { "inject": [ { "targets": [ "minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon", "minecraft:chests/abandoned_mineshaft" ], "loot_table": "mypack:chests/arcane_rewards", "rolls": 1, "chance": 0.25 } ] } ``` ### Inject items directly ```json { "inject": [ { "targets": ["minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon"], "rolls": 1, "chance": 0.2, "items": [ { "item": "minecraft:totem_of_undying", "name": "Offhand Totem", "nbt": { "pem": { "role": "offhand_totem" } } } ] } ] } ``` ## How Players Obtain Custom Items Simple rule: - if you use exact `item` or `#tag`, players can obtain the base item normally - if you use `nbt`, the game needs some way to generate that special variant Common ways to generate those items: - loot tables - loot injections - functions - advancement rewards - scripting mods like `KubeJS` or `CraftTweaker` ## Conflict Rules If multiple active sources grant the same mob effect: - they do not stack as multiple copies - the strongest one wins - higher amplifier wins first That means a 2-piece set can give `Strength I`, and a 4-piece tier can upgrade that to `Strength II`, while another set can still coexist if it gives a different effect like `Speed`. ## Tooltips Tooltips can show: - direct effects on the item - matching set bonuses - current set piece count when player context is available ## Summary If you want one datapack-driven system for: - equipment-based potion effects - item tags - custom item variants - set bonuses - Curios counting - survival-friendly loot integration this mod is built for exactly that. For a more detailed tutorial and extra help, join the Discord: - https://discord.gg/sZ64CgX3JN { "effect": "minecraft:regeneration", "amplifier": 1, "duration": 100, "chance": 0.5, "slot": "chest" } ] } } ```
👟 Example: Speed Boots Gives Speed II while worn. ```json { "minecraft:golden_boots": { "passive_effects": [ { "effect": "minecraft:speed", "amplifier": 1, "permanent": true, "slot": "feet" } ] } } ```
💍 Example: Invisibility Ring (Curios) Grants Invisibility while worn in a 'ring' slot. ```json { "curios:ring_gold": { "passive_effects": [ { "effect": "minecraft:invisibility", "amplifier": 0, "permanent": true, "slot": "ring", "is_curio": true } ] } } ```
--- ## **🔧 Configuration Guide** ### **📁 Location** `world/datapacks//data/potioneffectsmodify/potion_effects/your_file.json` ### **⚙️ Options** | Property | Type | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `effect` | ID | The potion effect ID (e.g., `minecraft:strength`) | | `amplifier` | Int | Level of the effect (0 = Level I, 1 = Level II) | | `duration` | Int | Duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second) | | `chance` | Float | Probability (0.0 to 1.0) for On Hit/On Hurt | | `slot` | String | Required slot (`mainhand`, `head`, `feet`, `curios:ring`, etc.) | | `permanent`| Bool | If true, effect refreshes automatically (for passive) | | `is_curio` | Bool | Set to `true` if targeting a Curios slot | --- ## **📦 Installation** 1. **Download** the mod and place it in your `mods` folder. 2. *(Optional)* Install **Curios API** if you want accessory support. 3. **Launch** the game. 4. **Create** your JSON configs in a datapack (see examples above). 5. Run `/reload` in-game to apply changes instantly! --- Please join our Discord for support, suggestions, or to share your configs! [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Us-7289da?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/sZ64CgX3JN)

title: Restricted Inventory
description: Restrict player inventory slots to specific items or item tags. Configure which slots accept which items via JSON config — server-wide or per-client. Restricted slots display a visual preview of what belongs there.
body:
# Restricted Inventory

**Lock player inventory slots to specific items or item tags.**

Ever wanted to keep a dedicated slot for your sword, always have slot 0 as your torch, or enforce item organization across your server? Restricted Inventory lets you do exactly that — configure any inventory slot (0–35) to only accept a specific item or item tag, server-wide or per player.

## Features

- **Slot restrictions** — Lock any hotbar or inventory slot to a specific item (e.g. `minecraft:torch`) or an entire item tag (e.g. `#minecraft:swords`)
- **Server or per-client mode** — Apply the same rules to all players from the server config, or let each player define their own restrictions in their client config
- **Visual feedback** — Restricted slots display a ghost preview of the required item so players always know what goes where
- **Slot index overlay** — Hold **Tab** in any inventory screen to reveal each slot's index number, making config setup a breeze
- **Smart item routing** — Picked-up items automatically go to their designated slots first before filling unrestricted ones

## Commands

All commands use the `/restrictedinventory` prefix.

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/restrictedinventory config` | Opens the Restriction Config Screen | Admin (OP level 4), or any player when `useClientRestriction` is enabled |

### Permission rules

- When `useClientRestriction` is **false** (server-wide mode): only server operators (OP level 4) can open the config screen.
- When `useClientRestriction` is **true** (per-client mode): every player can open their own config screen.

## Restriction Config Screen

The config screen is the in-game GUI for editing slot restrictions. Open it with `/restrictedinventory config`.

### Item / Tag picker (top panel)

- **Items tab** — lists every registered item at ¾ scale. Hover for the item name and registry ID. Click to select.
- **Tags tab** — lists every registered item tag. Each tag cycles through its members as a live preview. Hover for the tag ID. Click to select.
- Scroll with the mouse wheel or drag the scrollbar on the right.

### Slot grid (middle panel)

- Displays all 36 player inventory slots (0–35) laid out in the standard inventory arrangement.
- Each slot shows a cycling preview of its current restriction, or is empty if unrestricted.
- Left-Click a slot to **select** it (highlighted in white). The selected slot will receive the item or tag chosen in the picker.
- Right-Click a slot to remove the item or tag chosen.
- Hover a slot to see its current restriction value as a tooltip.

## Configuration

Restrictions are defined in a simple JSON config file. Both specific items and item tags are supported.

```json
{
  "useClientRestriction": false,
  "restrictedSlots": {
    "0": "minecraft:torch",
    "1": "#minecraft:swords",
    "8": "minecraft:totem_of_undying"
  }
}
```

| Slot range | Location |
|------------|----------|
| 0–8 | Hotbar (survival mode only) |
| 9–35 | Main inventory |

> **Note:** Slot indices 0–8 correspond to the hotbar in survival mode. In creative mode, the hotbar uses a different inventory layout and slot restrictions will **not** apply there.

## Compatibility Note

This mod hooks into vanilla's slot placement and item pickup logic via Mixin. Mods or block entities that insert items directly into the player inventory (bypassing standard slot logic) may not respect the restrictions. Mods that also modify `Slot`, `Inventory`, or `AbstractContainerScreen` may conflict.

title: ArrowHitMSG
description: A plugin which tells you when you hit someone and for how much
body:
**ArrowHitMSG - Instant Arrow Hit Feedback**

This lightweight plugin enhances archery combat on your Minecraft server by providing immediate feedback when players hit others with arrows. The plugin delivers a seamless experience for archers by showing critical information right when you need it.
Key Features

Instant Hit Confirmation: Get immediate visual feedback when your arrow finds its target

Damage Display: See exactly how much damage your shot dealt

Remaining Health Display: Know your target's remaining health after your shot

Customizable Notifications: Choose between chat messages, action bar, or title notifications

Sound Effects: Optional sound confirmation for successful hits

Full Color Customization: Match the plugin's appearance to your server's theme

Performance Friendly: Minimal impact on server resources

Simple Configuration: Easy to set up with well-documented config file

Permission-Based: Admin reload command with appropriate permission checks
**
Why Choose This Plugin?**

This archery feedback tool fills an important gap in Minecraft's combat system. In vanilla gameplay, you often can't tell if your arrow hit or how effective it was, especially at longer ranges or in chaotic combat situations.

With this plugin, you'll gain valuable tactical information that can help you improve your archery skills and make better decisions in PvP combat. The customizable notification system lets server owners decide exactly how this information is presented to players.

**Server Benefits**

For server administrators, this plugin enhances PvP gameplay without altering the core mechanics. It's perfect for:

Combat-focused servers where archery skill matters

Survival servers with PvP elements

Minigame servers featuring bow combat

Any server looking to enhance player feedback during combat

The plugin is designed to be lightweight and efficient, using modern Bukkit/Spigot APIs for optimal performance. It works well alongside other combat enhancement plugins and won't conflict with most server setups.

**Getting Started**

title: PR1SMLITE
description: PR1SMLITE is a Minecraft shader built for budget and integrated GPUs. If you want the most performance this is the one.
body:
![A luscious cave exposing expansive lighting. This image is including moss, glow berries, and lava as the main showcase.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc16c077a721d6aef3025dda31fa1941fd4e0f46.jpeg)

#

PR1SMLITE is a Minecraft shader built from dozens of iterations for budget and integrated GPUs. This shaderpack includes sharpening, bloom, color clarity, and a shadow rendering process. If you want the most performance out of shaders, but don't want bad quality, this is your next choice.
Developed on an AMD Ryzen 5 7520U (with Radeon 610M integrated-GPU), it was made to achieve high framerates at low costs. When using Iris and Sodium we achieved larger framerates above most shaders due to the less complex rendering processes. Using no special upscaling tricks, no heavy rendering algorithms, but only using a very little amount of math that makes staying close to vanilla performance possible.
Outsourcing more frames or performance has become the new want of today, and this shader fills in that slot in the shader-side of Minecraft. If your GPU struggles with every other shaderpack, or if you want a level of beauty while still wanting a playable game, this shader was built exactly for you. Download it and try it for yourself, no configurations needed.

## Installation:

This installation process requires both [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) and [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) for installation. Once you have installed Sodium and Iris, you can place them into your mods folder for Minecraft! After this make sure you have at least ran Minecraft one time to make sure your shaderpack folder is built. Now since the game has already ran one time, open to where your Minecraft Java folder is and search for a "shaderpack" folder. Open this folder and drop PR1SMLITE inside. You can now open Minecraft again and you should see the shaderpack if you open your options menu, go to Video settings, and look for a button that says "Shaders" or "Shaderpacks." Now you should be able to find "PR1SMLITE" as a option, once selected you can enable shaders and experience the true looks of lightweight shaders

The Carnivorous Central Nervous System adds a new creature. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-1027 also known as the Carnivorous Central Nervous System.


SCP-1027 resembles a fully exposed human nervous system that searches for living beings. It is extremely aggressive toward players and villagers, and it possesses the ability to take control of certain undead creatures, turning them into extensions of itself. SCP-1027 is fast and highly dangerous, capable of overwhelming victims quickly and creating new instances upon killing them.

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

title: Cobblemon Full Restore
description: Recover your lost Pokémon after crashes, disconnects, or save corruption.
body:
**Cobblemon Full Restore** adds a simple and safe `/cfr` command suite that lets you backup and restore a player's Cobblemon PC and Party data using snapshot files (`.dat.old`).

Perfect for singleplayer players who frequently lose Pokémon due to crashes or connection issues.

**Commands**
- `/cfr backup`  - ``Everyone`` - Backup your own Pokémon data
- `/cfr backup <player>`  - ``OP 2+`` - Backup another player's data
- `/cfr restore`  - ``Everyone`` - Restore your own data (confirmation required)
- `/cfr restore <player>`  - ``OP 2+`` - Restore another player's data
- `/cfr restore cancel`  - ``Everyone`` - Cancel a pending restore
- `/cfr status`  - ``Everyone`` - Check if backup files exist
- `/cfr status <player>`  - ``OP 2+`` - Check another player's backup status
- `/cfr help`  - ``Everyone`` - Show command reference

How It Works

- `/cfr backup` creates safe snapshot files (.dat.old) of your current PC and Party.
- `/cfr restore` replaces the active .dat files with the backup snapshots.
- **Safety First**: Requires two-step confirmation (run command twice within 30 seconds). Before restoring, your current data is automatically saved as `.dat.crash.<timestamp>` so nothing is permanently lost.

# Modern Creator

**Modern Creator** is a modern-style furniture mod with a **playable music system**.
This release is a **backport for 1.12.2**, updated with a large sound library (~**580** tracks) and the core furniture/decor set.

## Highlights

* 🎵 **Playable instruments** – guitar, electric guitar, bass, piano, drums. Multiple libraries (acoustic/metal/rock/bass/drum) for rich, realistic tone.
* 🛋️ **Modern furniture set** – refrigerator, sofa, living table, chair, counter (top/bottom), curtain, door, louver, showcase, multiple lamps (table/wall/top/high).
* 🚿 **Bathroom set** – bathtub and **shower** with dedicated SFX.
* 🌹 **Bottle-flower decor (reserve series)** – allium, daisy, dandelion, houstonia, orchid, rose, tulip (red/white/orange/pink) plus a water bottle for displays.
* 🔔 **Utility items** – home ring (doorbell), craft “hammer” SFX, creative tools.
* 🌐 **Language** – includes `en_us`.

> Note: Some minor variants from the 1.20.1 line are intentionally simplified for **stability and performance** on 1.12.2.

## Quick Start

* Furnish your house or studio with the modern set.
* Use instruments to play notes using the bundled sound libraries.
* Decorate with the **reserve_*** bottle-flower series.
* Try the **shower** for ambient sound effects.

## Compatibility

* **Minecraft 1.12.2 + Forge**.
* Works well alongside common mods. If **RealSurvivor** is installed, certain internal systems are detected automatically.

## Performance

* Resources reorganized for 1.12.2; unnecessary variants trimmed; sound mappings optimized to reduce load and improve FPS.

Enjoy building modern interiors and making music in Minecraft—and share your screenshots with us!

description: Allow players to be their actual (real-life) height in Minecraft!
body:
![Dependencies](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/Dependencies.png?raw=true)
* [**BukkitOfUtils**](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bukkitofutils)

![Discord](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/JoinTheDiscord.png?raw=true)
Please join the Streamline Hub Discord in order to get updates and for me to fully assist you with bugs, questions, or suggestions.

Discord: [**click here**](https://drak.gg/discord)

![Summary](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/Summary.png?raw=true)
Allow players to be their actual (real-life) height in Minecraft!

![Why This?](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/WhyThis.png?raw=true)
Extremely easy to use with drag and drop functionality.

Ever wanted to see what your Minecraft friends would look like in real life when compared to you? Well, it isn't VR, but it sure is close! You get to see exactly how tall your friends are and there will definitely be a lot of good laughs when you find out who is actually the shortest, or tallest!

This plugin was officially made for Drak SMP: `play.drak.gg`

Comes with RESTful API hooks so if your players have used this plugin elsewhere, they can remain the same height from server to server. This is toggle-able of course! And, players will still have to **set their height upon first use**!

This also has database support for cross-network SMPs or height syncing.

![How to Install](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/HowToInstall.png?raw=true)
1. Download and install BukkitOfUtils. Found here: [**BukkitOfUtils**](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bukkitofutils)
2. Download the correct version of this plugin for you server version.
3. Place in your `plugins` folder.
4. Stop server.
5. Start server.
6. Use to your liking.

![More Info](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/MoreInfo.png?raw=true)
## How to set your height
1. Install plugin. (Shown above.)
2. `/heights set <integer or decimal>(i/c/f/m)` - where `(i/c/f/m)` is replaced with one of those characters (`i`= `inches`, `c` = `centimeters`, `f` = `feet`, and `m` = `meters`) and `<integer or decimal>` is replaced with a positive number (between `1 foot` and `9 feet` - or equivalent).

## Notes
* `i`= `inches`
* `c` = `centimeters`
* `f` = `feet`
* `m` = `meters`
* Defaults to feet if none of the above.

![Commands and Permissions](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/CommandsAndPermissions.png?raw=true)
## Argument Key
* `<required>` = argument described by "required" is required in the command
* `(optional)` = argument described by "optional" is optional in the command
* `(unit "i/c/f/m")` = argument described by "unit" is optional in the command and must be one of "i", "c", "f", or "m" **verbatim**.

## Commands
* `/heights`
  * `/heights set <integer or decimal>(unit "i/c/f/m") (player)`
    * Sets the height of a player or self.
  * `/heights get (player)`
    * Gets the height of a player or self.
  * `/heights reset (player)`
    * Resets the height of a player or self.

- MojoLauncher or PojavLauncher

 Installation
1. Add `audio-shim.jar` to your mods folder
2. Launch Minecraft
3. Open Simple Voice Chat settings and select the new microphone source

 Notes
- The mod will not appear in the mod list — this is expected
- To remove the error message in chat: open `voicechat-client.properties` and set `use_natives=false`
- Only tested with Simple Voice Chat, other voice mods are not guaranteed to work

 Compatibility
- Forge and Fabric
- Minecraft 1.12.2+

- Lightweight and performance-friendly

## Installation
### Datapack 
Works on both singleplayer worlds and servers.

1. Download the datapack .zip file
2. Place it in your world's `/datapacks` folder
   - Singleplayer: `.minecraft/saves/[WorldName]/datapacks`
   - Server: `[ServerFolder]/[WorldName]/datapacks`
3. Run `/reload` ingame or restart your server
4. Check with `/datapack list` to verify.



## Roadmap

- Add support for older versions (1.20.x, 1.19.x, etc.)
- Standalone mod version for Forge/Fabric
- Config file for customizing the recipe!
- Customizing the Light Block brightness via recipe

title: [MRU]竞速实用工具
description: This mod adds a racing management system to Minecraft
body:
本模组为MC提供了一个竞速工具，建议在多人游戏内使用。
**模组提供指令：**
- /jinsu create <竞速名称> 创建竞速
- /jinsu delete <竞速名称> 删除竞速
- /jinsu join <竞速名称> [玩家名称] 加入竞速，玩家名称不输入则默认自己
- /jinsu join <竞速名称> another 让所有人加入竞速
- /jinsu quit <竞速名称> another 把所有人踢出竞速并结束、删除该竞速
- /jinsu quit <竞速名称> [玩家名称] 退出竞速，玩家名称不输入则默认自己
- /jinsu ready 准备（所有玩家准备后即可开始竞速）
- /jinsu unripe 取消准备
- /jinsu readylist 查看所有准备好的玩家
- /jinsu start <竞速名称> 开始竞速（不输入名称即默认自己加入的竞速），若有人未准备，则不会开始。如竞速暂停，输入此指令则继续竞速
- /jinsu end <竞速名称> 结束竞速（不输入名称即默认自己加入的竞速）
- /jinsu pause <竞速名称> 暂停竞速（不输入名称即默认自己加入的竞速）
- /jinsu set <竞速名称> startpoint [ <x> <y> <z> ]设置指定竞速的起点坐标（放置钻石块表示）
- /jinsu set <竞速名称> endpoint [ <x> <y> <z> ]设置指定竞速的终点坐标（放置红石块表示）
- /jinsu set <竞速名称> waypoint [ <x> <y><z> ]设置指定竞速的途经点坐标（仅限一个）（放置金块表示）若不输入坐标，则默认脚下方块
- /jinsu alllist 查看所有正在进行的竞速列表
- /jinsu get <竞速名称> startpoint查看指定竞速的终点坐标
- /jinsu get <竞速名称> endpoint查看指定竞速的终点坐标
- /jinsu get <竞速名称> waypoint查看指定竞速的途经点坐标
- /jinsu get <竞速名称> playerlist 查看所处竞速的所有玩家
- /jinsu get <竞速名称> startdis 查看自己距离该竞速起点的直线距离
- /jinsu get <竞速名称> enddis 查看自己距离该竞速终点的直线距离
- /jinsu get <竞速名称> waydis 查看自己距离该竞速途经点的直线距离

为什么是Jinsu？因为作者服务器中有一位玩家经常以jinsu代表想要参加竞速游戏的意思

title: BotanyPots × Farmer’s Delight – Improved Compatibility
description: Adds Rich Soil as a valid substrate for all crops that grow on dirt blocks in Botany Pots, and enables tilling into Rich Farmland.
body:
# Overview

This datapack improves compatibility between Botany Pots and Farmer’s Delight by fixing Rich Soil behaviour inside Botany Pots.


# What this datapack does
## ✅ **Rich Soil compatibility**

Allows all crops and trees that normally grow on dirt or farmland to also grow on Farmer’s Delight Rich Soil in Botany Pots

Fully tag-based: compatible with many other botany pot crop and tree mods automatically

## 🌱 **Growth bonuses**

Rich Soil: +12.5% growth speed (a small increase of 2.5% over Minecraft farmland and the vanilla Botany Pot value due to the work required to generate Rich Soil). 
Note: this means that on average, mushrooms that exclusively use rich soil will grow ~1 second faster.

Rich Soil Farmland: +15% growth speed (vanilla value determined by the Botany Pots mod)


## ⛏️ **Hoe tilling inside Botany Pots**

Right-clicking a Botany Pot containing Rich Soil with any hoe (only vanilla Minecraft hoes tested) converts it to Rich Soil Farmland

This interaction recipe was missing from newer versions of vanilla Botany Pots, and mimics the behaviour of using a hoe on a botany pot containing dirt.

## 🔪 **Harvest crops with knives**

V1.1 update - Use knives in the tool slot! This allows Sandy Shrubs, Wheat, & Grass to drop straw in a botany pot!

Use my companion datapack, [Botany Pots More Crop Compatibility](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botany-pots-more-crop-compatibility) to enable Rice to also drop straw!

# Compatibility

Requires [Botany Pots](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-pots) - (Fabric version tested)

Requires [Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) for Rich Soil + Knife compatibility

## 🧩 **Compatible with:**

[Botany Pots Tiers](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-pots-tiers)

[Botany Trees](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-trees)

Safe to add or remove from existing worlds

## 📦 Works well with my other data packs

[BotanyPots More Crop Compatibility](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botany-pots-more-crop-compatibility) for more crops and fixes Rice harvesting)

[Botany Trees x Farmer's Expanded Compatibility Pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botany-trees-x-farmers-delight-expanded-compatibility) for more Tree support, missing cutting board recipes, axes and more!

# Instructions

## 📥 **Installation**

Download the datapack

Place the ZIP file into:

```
<world folder>/datapacks/
```

## ⚙️ **Customising growth bonuses (optional)**

You can edit the growth speed values yourself:

Open the datapack .zip

Navigate to:
```
data/botanypots/recipe/farmersdelight/soil/rich_soil.json
```

Change

```
"growth_modifier": 0.125
```

Example values:

0.10 = 10% faster (default value from the Botany Pots mod, same as Minecraft Farmland)

0.15 = 15% faster (same as Rich farmland)


Changes apply after /reload or world restart.

## **Versions**

I'm sure this probably works on more versions than just 1.21.1, but that's all I tested it for at the moment! Feel free to test it if you wish.

# Kaydel 3.0
_**A "Vanilla-like" QoL & Adventure Modpack**_

Welcome to the Kaydel 3.0 Community Server Modpack! With over 180 mods, it offers wide range of performance, aesthetics, and gameplay improvements while trying to maintain the essence of vanilla Minecraft.

Performance is at the heart of this multiplayer focused modpack, featuring optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore that ensure smooth framerates.

Visually, the modpack brings Minecraft to life with Iris Shader support for stunning lighting effects and new advanced particle effects adding depth and immersion. AmbientSounds and Sound Physics Remastered create rich environmental atmospheres that make every location feel genuinely alive.

Exploration receives a massive upgrade through the complete Dungeons and Taverns series, Towns & Towers and Explorify, which overhaul every major structure into epic adventures. Additionally, Tectonic reimagines world generation with dramatic terrain, making the Overworld much more realistic.

Quality of life improvements are the key to this modpack: fast travel with Waystones, massive improvements to inventory management, Simple Voice Chat implementation, schematic support provided by Litematica, massive GUI improvements and much much more.

To enhance the multiplayer experience, this modpack contains many essentials for players and server admins. Open Parties and Claims enables team building and land protection with an intuitive system, while LuckPerms provides robust permission management. The integration of Simple Voice Chat makes coordination seamless, whether you're building together or embarking on dungeon raids.

## Installation
**Please notice that I recommend using the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app) with this Modpack.**

To install and play the Modpack, download the newest Modpack Version on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/modpack/kaydel-v3-community-server-modpack/versions) or in the Modrinth App. If you don't use the Modrinth App, [follow this guide](https://support.modrinth.com/en/articles/8802250-modpacks-on-modrinth) to install the Modpack.
Then, you need to check the assigned RAM for the Modpack Instance. I currently recommend to allocate at least 8 GB of RAM. Please refer to your launchers documentation on how to change the allocated RAM of an instance in your launcher. When finished, you are ready to go.

For Servers, I recommend you to download the server variant of each version. The server variant is a stripped down version of the modpack, made for better compatibility and performance with servers. 
**NOTE: The server variant does _not_ contain any Mod which is not already present in the normal variant.**

## Questions and Issues
If you have any Questions about this Modpack or found an Issue, feel free to [join our Discord Server](https://discord.gg/xq3f8urxYx).

## Known Issues
(beta versions b0.3.1 and below) There is one known issue caused by Carry On: Players might get kicked out of their Singleplayer world or from a Server when they die. Kicked players just need to rejoin, their items and progress are safe.

title: Stonecutter Tweaks
description: Lets you convert polished andesite, granite, diorite, and tuff to their unpolished variants. Also allows conversion of stone and deepslate to their cobbled variants
body:
Allows you to convert polished andesite, granite, diorite, and tuff into their unpolished variants using the stonecutter. This change helps make getting most of these stones easier; you can trade with mason villagers for the polished blocks then convert them to their unpolished variants.

Also allows you to convert stone and deepslate into their cobbled variants so you can use your silk touch pickaxe everytime you mine.

title: AnvilBoundless
description: Removes the constraints of the anvil and makes the process of combining items more predictable
body:
# AnvilBoundless

A plugin, which removes the constraints of the anvil and makes the process of combining items more predictable.

## Features

- **Bypass "Too Expensive!"** – Removes the 39-level limit, allowing any items to be combined
- **Control Maximum Cost** – Customizable repair cost limit
- **Preserve Overleveled Enchantments** – Protects enchantments above the maximum level from being downgraded during combination

## Configuration

After the first run, a `config.yml` file will be created:

```yaml
# AnvilBoundless Configuration

# Bypass the "Too expensive!" limitation
bypass-too-expensive: true

# Maximum cost in the anvil (if 0, then unlimited)
max-repair-cost: 39

# Preserve over-maximum level enchantments
keep-overleveled-enchants: true
```

### Configuration Options

- **`bypass-too-expensive`** (true/false) – Completely disables the "Too expensive!" limitation
- **`max-repair-cost`** (number) – Maximum cost displayed in the anvil (0 = unlimited)
- **`keep-overleveled-enchants`** (true/false) – Preserves enchantments above the maximum level during combination

## Commands

- **`/anvilboundless reload`** – Reloads the plugin configuration (requires the `anvilboundless.reload` permission)

## Permissions

| Permission              | Description                                | Default     |
|-------------------------|--------------------------------------------|-------------|
| `anvilboundless.reload` | Allows reloading the plugin configuration  | op          |

## How It Works

### Bypassing the "Too Expensive!" Limitation
The plugin automatically sets the maximum repair cost to the highest possible value when the `bypass-too-expensive` option is enabled. This allows combining items that would normally be unavailable due to the 39-level limit.

### Preserving Overleveled Enchantments
If the `keep-overleveled-enchants` option is enabled, enchantments above the maximum level (obtained through commands or other plugins) retain these levels on the new item.
Example:
- Item 1: Sharpness VI enchantment (max level V)
- Item 2: Unbreaking IV enchantment (max level III)
- Result: Sharpness VI and Unbreaking IV
- If the option is disabled: Sharpness VI and Unbreaking III

## Installation

1. Download the latest version of `AnvilBoundless.jar`
2. Place the file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart or start the server
4. Configure the plugin via `plugins/AnvilBoundless/config.yml` and execute `/anvilboundless reload` to apply the changes

title: Fast Sleep – Single Player Sleep
description: A lightweight and lag-free One Player Sleep datapack that lets only one player skip the night or stop phantoms for everyone. Works on singleplayer & multiplayer without commands, mods, or plugins.
body:
🌙 Single Player Sleep Datapack
This datapack allows any one player to sleep and instantly skip the night for the entire world — just like popular servers do. No more waiting for all players to get in bed!

Perfect for multiplayer, friends world, or singleplayer QoL.

✅ Features

✔ Skip night when only one player sleeps
✔ Works in all dimensions where beds are allowed
✔ Removes phantoms automatically (optional)
✔ Lightweight – 0 lag, pure functions
✔ Supports Minecraft 1.21+
✔ Works on servers + realms + singleplayer
✔ No setup required — plug and play

⭐ How It Works

A player enters a bed

Datapack checks if sleep is valid

Night instantly skips for everyone

Weather optionally clears

A clean good morning message appears

No commands required from players!


👍 Perfect For

SMP servers

LAN worlds

Friends survival

Hardcore worlds

Solo players who hate waiting

📦 Installation

Download the .zip

Put it into:
world/datapacks/

Run:
/reload

Enjoy!

title: Majesty
description: Forged behind muddied barnyards and royal kingdoms... an unforgiving rpg set in the late middle ages
body:
# **MAJESTY**
**FOR VERSION 1.20.1**

""_b side middle age deliverance rpg II dragon simulator_""

**MAJESTY** began as a fork off my other modpack, [**ADVENTURE MOD**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/adventure-mod) (3 heart survival)
I'd excluded a ton of medieval mods and other types of mods in favor of other ideas for that pack... here, i used that framework & gave it a different coat

Leaning toward a bit more less intensive and grounded RPG, easing back heavily on the fantasy/dimensional stuff, this here's experience is centered around the middle ages, knights, kings, crowns, cannons...

title: NoVillagerTrading
description: Disables trading with villagers if configured.
body:
# 🧑‍🌾 NoVillagerTrading

A lightweight **Minecraft Spigot/Paper plugin** that completely **disables trading with villagers**.  
Perfect for survival, economy, or hardcore servers where villager trading should be restricted or replaced with other systems.

---

## ⚙️ Features

- 🚫 Prevents players from opening the **villager trading interface**  
- 💬 Sends a message to players when they attempt to trade  
- ⚡ Lightweight and efficient — no commands or dependencies  
- 🔒 Great for economy servers that use custom shop systems  

---

## 📁 Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar` file  
2. Place it in your server’s `plugins/` folder  
3. Start or reload your server — it works right away!  

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yaml
# Enable or disable Totem blocking
NoTotems: true
```

---

## 💬 Example Message

When a player tries to trade with a villager:

> §cTrading with villagers is disabled!

You can change this message in the source code if needed.

---

## 🧩 Developer Information

**Main class:**  
`de.scholle.noVillagerTrading.NoVillagerTrading`

**Event listener:**  
`de.scholle.noVillagerTrading.VillagerTradeBlocker`

**Event used:**  
`PlayerInteractEntityEvent`

---

## 🧰 Compatibility

- ✅ Works on **Spigot**, **Paper**, and **Purpur**  
- 🧱 Compatible with **Minecraft 1.18+**  
- ⚙️ Requires **Java 17+**

---

## 🧑‍💻 Author

**Developed by:** Scholle  
**Package:** `de.scholle.noVillagerTrading`

# This Mod adds some Vanilla-friendly Ores, Gear and Food:
- This Mod also adds Crafting Recipes for the Enchanted Golden Apple & all Vanilla Horse Armors
## Armors (Copper, Emerald, Ruby, Enderite) ![Armors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/2a07663b2787d81226ebca588fa164cd2500835c.png)

- Copper Armor is the **SAME** as it's Vanilla version (Recipes, Attributes etc.) , just ported back to older Minecraft 1.21.X versions.
- Emerald Armor recipes are the **SAME** as every other Vanilla Minecraft Armor.
- Emerald Armor is a little stronger than Iron.
- Ruby Armor recipes are the **SAME** as every other Vanilla Minecraft Armor.
- Ruby Armor is slightly stronger than Emerald.
- You can get Enderite Armor by upgrading your already existing Netherite Armor in the Smithing Table using an Enderite Upgrade Smithing Template.
- Enderite Armor is 1.5x stronger than Netherite.

## Tools (Copper, Emerald, Ruby, Enderite) ![Tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/c597c9968c7a36f57fa95870d065880a1d2ec991.gif)

- Copper Tools are the **SAME** as their Vanilla versions (Recipes, Attributes etc.) , just ported back to older Minecraft 1.21.X versions.
- Emerald Tools recipes are the **SAME** as every other Vanilla Minecraft Tool.
- Emerald Tools are slightly stronger than Iron but can't break items that require Diamond Tools.
- Ruby Tools recipes are the **SAME** as every other Vanilla Minecraft Tool.
- Ruby Tools are slightly stronger than Emerald but can't break items that require Diamond Tools.
- You can get Enderite Tools by upgrading your already existing Netherite Tools in the Smithing Table using an Enderite Upgrade Smithing Template.
- Enderite Tools are 1.5x stronger than Netherite and can Insta-Mine most blocks when fully enchanted.

## Ores & Blocks (Ruby & Enderite) ![Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/a4789f5e929112d05983892c10b6233f751cbbd1.gif)
- Ruby Ore & Deepslate Ruby Ore generates from Y-64 to Y180.
- Ruby Ore & Deepslate Ruby Ore requires at least Iron Tools to be mined.
- Ruby Blocks can be crafted using 9 Rubies.
- Enderite Ore **ONLY** generates inside the End.
- Enderite Ore requires at least Diamond Tools to be mined.
- Enderite Blocks can be crafted using 9 Enderite Ingots.

## Items (Ruby & Enderite) ![Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/21e77027efd00560ce99b44afaa493d02f987798.gif)
- Rubies drop from mining Ruby Ores.
- Enderite Shards drop from mining Enderite Ore.
- Enderite Shards are used to craft Enderite Ingots.
- Enderite Upgrade Smithing Templates can only be found inside End City chests.
- Enderite Upgrade Smithing Templates can be duplicated.

## Horse Armors (Copper, Emerald, Ruby, Netherite, Enderite) ![Horse Armors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/608761121ce4992085b6979207b65df7e762c655.png)
- Copper Horse Armor is the same as it's Vanilla version (Attributes etc.).
- Emerald Horse Armor is a little better than Iron Horse Armor.
- Ruby Horse Armor is a little better than Emerald Horse Armor.
- Netherite Horse Armor is a little better than Diamond Horse Armor.
- Enderite Horse Armor is 1.5x stronger than Netherite Horse Armor.
- All Horse Armors have the same Crafting Recipe as Leather Horse Armor just with their respective materials.

## Apples (Ruby & Emerald) ![Apples](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/5c09cb3fe6f6b17a646e30d5cb0266c9c5559193.png)

- Ruby Apples give you effects that make you stronger in fights.
- Emerald Apples give you effects that make you a bit more lucky.
- Ruby & Emerald Apples can be crafted like Golden Apples just with their respective materials
- Enchanted Ruby & Emerald Apples can be crafted with Ruby/Emerald Blocks.
- The recipe for the Enchanted Golden Apple has been reimplemented and remains the same as it's old Vanilla version.

## Fredo's Armor Trim

- Fredo's Armor Trim can only be found inside Dungeon chests.
- Fredo's Armor Trim can be duplicated.

## Coming Soon:

- Advancements
- Custom Sounds & Updated Textures
- Translation for more languages

## Update Schedule:

- Currently, updates are scheduled to drop at least once per week until all planned features are implemented.

## THE WIKI WILL BE UPDATED AND FULLY FINISHED AFTER THE CUSTOM ARMOR TRIM HAS BEEN IMPLEMENTED

## THE MOD WILL BE UPDATED TO NEWER VERSIONS (1.21.3 etc.) ONCE ALL FEATURES HAVE BEEN IMPLEMENTED AND VERSION 1.0.0 HAS BEEN RELEASED

description: Elytra Speed Limit is designed to dynamically control and limit flying speeds for players to prevent exploits, maintain performance, and ensure fair gameplay.
body:
# 🚀 Elytra Speed Limit

**Elytra Speed Limit** is a lightweight Bukkit/Spigot plugin that limits the gliding speed of players using Elytra.  
It helps prevent speed exploits, reduce lag, and maintain balanced gameplay on your Minecraft server.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Horizontal Speed Cap**  
  Restrict how fast players can fly when gliding level or upward.  
  **Default:** `1.5 blocks/tick` (≈ 30 blocks/second)

- **Downward Speed Cap**  
  Allows faster gliding when diving downward for a more natural experience.  
  **Default:** `3.0 blocks/tick` (≈ 60 blocks/second)

- **Vertical Speed Cap**  
  Prevents excessive vertical movement.  
  **Default:** `3.0 blocks/tick`

- **Fully Configurable**  
  All speed thresholds are adjustable in the `config.yml` file.

# View Distance Command
This is a really simple client side mod that lets you change your minecraft view/render distance with an in game command.

## Important
This mod **requires** the [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)  
  
If you want a view distance higher than the Minecraft limit of 32, or are playing on a server with a view distance cap, you can use a mod like [Bobby](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby) to allow larger view distances!

## Command Options
/viewdistance set [distance] - Set your current render distance to [distance]  
/viewdistance get - Prints your current view distance in the chat  
/viewdistance help - Displays the help message (see the help message below!)  

> You can also use the alias `vd` in place of `viewdistance` in all commands!

## Support
If you encounter any issues, please join my [development discord](https://discord.gg/GMkjWd2Kun). I also welcome any suggestions for improving the mod!

## Donation
This mod is coded entirely on my free time so if you like it and want to help me out, consider supporting me!

## 指令Commands
- /suicide
- lightsuicide <help|about|reload>  
#### 别名aliases
- suicide: sui, zisha, "自杀"
- lightsuicide: lsuicide, ls

## 权限permissions
```
lightsuicide.suicide: {default: true}    # /suicide
lightsuicide.about: {default: op}        # /lightsuicide about
lightsuicide.help: {default: op}         # /lightsuicide help
lightsuicide.reload: {default: op}       # /lightsuicide reload
```

## 配置文件configuration files
- config.yml
```
# 使用自定义的消息，如果为false则不会修改死亡消息
# use customize messages, if not will not modify broadcast die messages
use-custom-messages: true

# 是否应该广播自定义的死亡消息
# should broadcast custom suicide message
broadcast-suicide-message: true

# 是否向执行suicide的玩家发送单独的死亡消息
# should send messages to who suicided
send-msg-who-suicided: false

# 是否使用随机死亡消息，如果为false则始终使用第一个消息
# should use random suicide message, if not will always use first message
random-suicide-broadcast-message: true

# 是否向执行suicide的玩家使用随机死亡消息，如果为false则始终使用第一个消息
# should send random message to who suicided, if not will always use first message
random-send-player-message: true

# 消息颜色格式化器(MINIMESSAGE或LEGACY(&符号))
# messages color formatter(MINIMESSAGE or LEGACY(&))
formatter: MINIMESSAGE

# 位置占位符格式设置
# location placeholder format
location-format: "[%x%, %y%, %z%, %world%]"

# 自定义广播的死亡消息
# Customize the broadcast suicide message
broadcast-messages:
  - "%player% disappeared suddenly"

# 自定义单独发送的死亡消息
# Customize the death message that is sent separately
send-player-messages:
  - "you suicided at %location%"
```

title: Individual Keep Inventory Fork
description: Server-side Fabric mod that makes keepInventory work on an individual basis
body:
**NOTICE**: This is just a fork of a project. The goal is to support newer versions of Minecraft, as the [original project](https://modrinth.com/mod/individual-keep-inventory) is no longer maintained

## IndividualKeepInv
**Do you have that one friend who keeps dying on your server, and keeps asking for keepInventory to be turned on, which you would gladly do... that is, if it wasn't forced on the rest of your players, none of whom want it?**

Individual Keep Inventory is a Fabric mod for making keepInventory work on an individual basis.

The vanilla /gamerule keepInventory command does (or should do) absolutely nothing with this mod, whether it be true or false.

To control the mod to your liking:

``/ikeepinv set <username> <true/false>`` will change a player's individual inventory state, with the default being false.

``/ikeepinv get <username>`` shows you a player's current inventory state.

``/ikeepinv default <true/false>`` will change the default inventory state for new players, set to false by default.

Individual Keep Inventory is completely server-side, meaning vanilla clients should have no issue joining servers with it installed.

Please do submit any feature requests or issues to the Issues page, as this is my first mod.

title: BalancedVanilla
description: Balanced Vanilla is a Minecraft mod that aims at balancing some vanilla concepts, while adding a few quality of life changes and machanics to the game, without being too invasive or non-vanilla friendly.
body:
Balanced Vanilla is a Minecraft mod that aims at balancing some vanilla concepts, while adding a few quality of life changes and machanics to the game, without being too invasive or non-vanilla friendly.


Following you can find all the features and changes included in Balanced Vanilla:



Balanced Vanilla adds a new series of tools to the vanilla game to add an intermidiate step between stone and iron.
I believe that going straight from stone to iron is a steep step, and the abundance of copper makes it a perfect sabstitute candidate. In addition to the complete tool set, the mod adds a new type of nugget which, like vanilla, is obtainable both from copper ingots, as well as by smelting copper items. (more on this later)



Balanced Vanilla adds four new seets of copper armors. Just like the in-game Copper Block, the copper armors can be exposed to the air and weather to slowly degrade them overtime.
From left to right the four stages the armors go through their oxidation cycle: Unaffected, Exposed, Weathered, and Oxidized.

Oxidized armors (regardless their current level of oxidation) can be reverted to their original copper, shiny look, simply by placing the armor piece in the Crafting Table, together with an Axe. The Axe will be damaged accordingly to the level of item oxidation. The higher the oxidation level, the higher the damage applied to the Axe.

> **TIP:**
> There is a hidden feature regarding the copper armor. Let's see if you can figure it out!


Balanced Vanilla also adds a new craftable horse armor made out of copper. To obtain this object, you simply need some copper and a saddle. But be aware, the horse's armor is made out of copper just like yours, so you'll have to work to keep it nice and shiny!



Balanced Vanilla adds a new Furnace block. What this new Nether Furnace does is simply bring the heat of the Nether right to the Overworld. This allows the player to have a machine capable of reaching incredibly high temperatures and keep their furnace warm longer than ever before.

### What does this mean gamplay-wise? (You might be asking)

Well simply enough, the Nether Furnace is capable of smelting for twice as long as the regular Furnace. Unlike the Blast Furnace it does not smelt items quicker. It can only smelt more. This comes at a hefty price tho: the Nether Furnace is capable to reach such temeperatures only with Blaze Rods and Lava Buckets.



Balanced Vanilla offers a variety of quality of life changes to balance out Minecraft a little better, and avoid useless head-aches. Following you can find a list of all the changes included in the mod.

- **Smelting tools and armors actually gives a reasonable output**:
I always found it so unbalanced that when smelting tools and armors the base logic just gives you back **1 NUGGET**. If, for example, you smelt a new Iron Chestplate, you get only 1 nugget out of 72 nuggets needed to make the item; and that is just bad. The mod simply balances this by allowing the Furnace(s) to output a countable result. The result also takes into consideration the durability of the item you are trying to repurpose. - **Enchanting tables have an inventory**:
This is nothing new, many mods do this, but I thougt it could be nice to include as a quality of life change. Enchanting tables now support a 2 slot inventory that allows the player to store an Item and Lapis Lazuli inside of the block. Be aware though, because the inventory **is not** personal. (It pretty much works like a Chest) - **Ladders can now finally float**:
Have you ever tried to build up a ladder going up your house and having to deal with those bulky, unnecessary pillars, right in the center of your brand-new living room? Well, worry no more, Balanced Vanilla has got you covered. The mod allows Ladders to stay in their position even after you have removed the structure behind them. Simply pillar up, place your Ladders and remove the building structure. - **Villagers follow emeralds**:
If you are a passionate player, you might have tried building your own village next to your kingdom, just like me, and we both know how annoying it can be to move the villagers around. Balanced Vanilla simply makes Villagers fall in love with you whenever you hold Emeralds or any emerald block. Next time don't build a useless railway, just show them some money. title: Tag Game
description: Play tag in your Minecraft server!
body:
![https://i.imgur.com/Fssd88y.png](https://i.imgur.com/Fssd88y.png)
Tag Game is a plugin that will allow users to play tag in Minecraft, where one or multiple people must tag other players. Some features are:

* MySQL or SQLite support.


* 1.16.5 - 1.21 support.


* Minimessage and legacy colors support.


* Multiple arenas. Players can play in different arenas with different game modes and times!


* In-game setup. You can setup the arena in-game easily!


* Multiple modes.


* Limited and unlimited time.


* One or more taggers in the same arena.


* Fully customizable. Items and messages can be customised.


* Scoreboards.


* PlaceholderAPI support. Use placeholders in your messages or use the plugin's placeholders in messages from other plugins.


* Saves inventory, xp, health, gamemode and more before joining an arena and restores it later.


* Commands on arena end (for losers and for winners).


* Join signs.


* Developer API.


* And more!

![https://i.imgur.com/0sMMpts.png](https://i.imgur.com/0sMMpts.png)

* /tag createArena [name] - tag.createarena - Creates an arena


* /tag removeArena [name] - tag.removearena - Removes an arena.


* /tag join [name] - tag.join - Join an arena.


* /tag leave - none - Leave the arena you are in.


* /tag setLobby - tag.setlobby - Sets the main lobby to your current position.


* /tag setup [arena] <setWorld / setFinishTime / setTaggersNumber> <value> - tag.setup - Modify an arena and its settings.


* /tag finishSetup - tag.setup - Stop setting up an arena.


* /tag stop [name] - tag.stop - Stops an arena that is running.


* /tag reload - tag.reload - Reloads the plugin.


* /tag help - none - Shows information about the commands that THE USER has access to.

![https://i.imgur.com/JY9ibK4.png](https://i.imgur.com/JY9ibK4.png)

title: Tools, Armor and Shields
description: A vanilla-friendly collection that expands your arsenal with Amethyst, Emerald, and Obsidian gear, custom shields, and powerful mining tools.
body:
# Tools, Armor and Shields

A vanilla-friendly Fabric mod that significantly expands your survival and terraforming capabilities. This project consolidates five individual modules into a single, cohesive mod, introducing new tiers of equipment based on Amethyst, Emerald, and Obsidian, alongside powerful multi-block mining tools and uniquely customized shields.

## Features

### Heavy-Duty Tools (Hammers & Excavators)

Hammers function as upgraded pickaxes for mining stone-like materials, while Excavators function as upgraded shovels for digging dirt, sand, and gravel. Both tools mine multiple blocks simultaneously and feature a dynamic visual block outline to show precisely which blocks will be destroyed before you mine them.

The tools are available in four tiers, each with varying mining radiuses and depths:

- **Iron Tier**: Mines a **3x3x1** area (1 block deep).
- **Redstone Tier**: Mines a **3x3x3** area (3 blocks deep).
- **Emerald Tier**: Mines a massive **5x5x1** area (1 block deep).
- **Diamond Tier**: Mines an ultimate **5x5x5** area (5 blocks deep).

_Note: The tools dynamically skip blocks they are not designed to mine (e.g., an Excavator will not break stone), preventing accidental damage to your world._

### Tiers & Armor Set Bonuses

The mod introduces full toolsets, weapons, and armor for three materials: 
Amethyst, Emerald, and Obsidian. Equipping a full set of armor grants unique, persistent abilities:

- **Amethyst Armor**: Acts as a dynamic light source. Wearing the full set emits a continuous light level of 15 around the player (True Lantern Behavior).
- **Emerald Armor**: Grants a Villager Discount. Wearing the full set provides better trading prices with villagers, functioning similarly to the Hero of the Village effect.
- **Obsidian Armor**: Grants permanent Fire Resistance. Wearing the full set protects you from all fire and lava damage.

### Custom Shields

A variety of new shields are included, such as Wooden, Iron, Diamond, Emerald, Obsidian, and specialized round variants.

- Each shield features its own distinct blocking and equip sound effects, providing a more immersive combat experience.
- All shields are neatly organized in a dedicated Creative Mode tab for easy access.

## Compatibility

This mod is optimized and thoroughly tested for Minecraft **26.1** and **26.2**. It utilizes a dynamic cross-version rendering system to ensure the block outlines and features work perfectly on both versions using a single `.jar` file.

## Requirements

- **Fabric Loader** (>=0.19.2)
- **Fabric API** (>= 0.145.1+26.1)

Welcome to the official client-side companion modpack for **SquareIO**, the ultimate unlimited, open-world Skyblock Infinite server!

* **Plasmo Voice:** Fully configured to hook straight into the server's dedicated voice ports. Talk seamlessly with your neighbors across the open void without needing third-party software. Press **`V`** in-game to set up your microphone!

* **Sodium:** Massive FPS multiplication using a completely rewritten modern rendering engine.

* **Dynamic FPS:** Automatically lowers resource usage when you alt-tab to check Discord or guides.

### 🎭 Visual & Animation Overhauls
* **Iris Shaders:** Full, seamless support for your favorite modern shader packs.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life Utilities
* **Shulker Box Tooltip:** Preview Shulker box contents instantly by hovering and pressing `Shift`.
* **AppleSkin:** Visualizes exact hunger and saturation values directly on your food bar.
* **Inventory Profiles Next:** Sleek client-side inventory and chest sorting mechanics.
* **Axolotl Client Side:** Allows you to safely walk and navigate while looking in your inventory.

---

## 🌌 About the Server: SquareIO

SquareIO is a borderless, multiplayer world driven by Modrinth's revolutionary **Skyblock Infinite** progression mechanics. Instead of traditional bedrock box islands, travel across an endless void, build massive bridges, meet neighbors, and team up naturally.

* **♾️ Open-World Skyblock:** Fully seamless, infinite void exploration.

* **🤝 Vanilla Friendly:** Powered by Patbox's server-side mods, meaning un-modded vanilla friends can still join you any time.

---

1. Click **Install** on this modpack inside the Modrinth App.

本追加包適合用於台灣風格車站、RTM 鐵路地圖、月台場景與自訂運轉展示。

## 主要特色

- 台鐵風格月台列車資訊顯示器模型
- 支援大型、小型、左右方向與雙面顯示版本
- 可顯示車次、目的地、路線、列車種別、時間與停靠月台
- 支援即時時間或 Minecraft 遊戲內時間
- 透過指令方塊設定顯示器參數
- 透過外部 JSON 檔案管理時刻表
- 內附 `timetable_editor.html` 視覺化時刻表編輯器
- 編輯器支援繁體中文、簡體中文、日文與英文
- 支援匯入、下載 JSON、複製 setting、手動拖曳排序與自動排序

## 基本使用方式

1. 將本追加包安裝到你的 mods 資料夾環境中。
2. 在遊戲中放置 TIDS 顯示器。
3. 在 TIDS 正下方同一直線、32 格範圍內放置指令方塊。
4. 使用 `timetable_editor.html` 製作時刻表 JSON。
5. 將時刻表 JSON 放到 `filePath` 指定的位置。
6. 在 HTML 編輯器中按下「複製 setting」。
7. 將 setting JSON 貼到指令方塊內。
8. 回到遊戲確認 TIDS 是否正常顯示。

## 注意事項

- 本追加包不是獨立 Mod，需要 RealTrainMod / RTM 環境。
- 時刻表資料由 JSON 檔案提供，請確認 `filePath` 指向正確位置。
- 指令方塊需放在 TIDS 正下方同一直線、32 格範圍內。
- 本作品為非官方粉絲製作內容，與台鐵或任何官方單位無關。

---

## English

**TR-TIDS** is a **RealTrainMod / RTM** add-on pack that adds Taiwan TRA-style platform train information display systems.  
It provides placeable TIDS display models for station platforms and can show train numbers, destinations, routes, train types, departure times, and platform information through an external JSON timetable.

This pack is designed for Taiwan-style stations, RTM railway maps, platform scenes, and custom operation displays.

## Features

- Taiwan TRA-style platform train information display models
- Large, small, left/right, and double-sided display variants
- Displays train number, destination, route, train type, time, and platform
- Supports real-world time or Minecraft in-game time
- Display settings are configured through a command block
- Timetables are managed with external JSON files
- Includes `timetable_editor.html`, a visual timetable editor
- Editor supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and English
- Supports JSON import, JSON download, setting copy, drag-and-drop ordering, and automatic sorting

## Basic Usage

1. Install this pack in your mods folder environment.
2. Place a TIDS display in game.
3. Place a command block directly below the TIDS, within 32 blocks on the same vertical line.
4. Use `timetable_editor.html` to create a timetable JSON file.
5. Put the timetable JSON at the location specified by `filePath`.
6. Click “Copy setting” in the HTML editor.
7. Paste the setting JSON into the command block.
8. Return to the game and check that the TIDS displays correctly.

## Notes

- This is not a standalone mod. RealTrainMod / RTM is required.
- Timetable data is loaded from a JSON file, so make sure `filePath` points to the correct location.
- The command block must be placed directly below the TIDS, within 32 blocks on the same vertical line.
- This is an unofficial fan-made project and is not affiliated with TRA or any official railway operator.
