title: AdvanceDrop
description: Complete advancements, earn chests, unbox your loot. Nine tiers from dirt to netherite — the harder the grind, the better the drop.
body:
# AdvanceDrop

Finish the advancement. Roll the drop. Open the case.

Nine chest tiers. Hundreds of possible drops. One secret chest nobody sees coming. AdvanceDrop turns every Minecraft advancement into a case opening — and the grind never felt this good.

---

## How It Works

Complete any vanilla advancement, receive a chest item, right-click to open and collect your loot.

---

## Chest Tiers

| Tier | Loot |
|------|------|
| Dirt | Basic blocks, starter food, simple resources |
| Copper | Starter ores, coal, utility items |
| Iron | Iron tools, weapons, survival gear |
| Gold | Golden apples, gold ingots, intermediate gear |
| Emerald | Emeralds, enchanted books, villager loot |
| Diamond | Diamonds, diamond gear, obsidian |
| Netherite | Netherite ingots, ancient debris, top tier gear |
| Secret | 3% chance on ANY advancement, rare easter eggs and OP gear |
| Troll | Configurable chance for a trick chest filled with dummy drops |

---

## Difficulty System

- **Easy** - Story and basic crafting advancements
- **Medium** - Nether and exploration advancements
- **Hard** - End dimension, hidden, and Challenge advancements

Recipe unlocks are automatically filtered out so you never get spammed with chests.

---

## Crafting

Most chest tier can also be crafted directly in game.

| Tier | Recipe |
|------|--------|
| Dirt | Chest surrounded by Dirt |
| Copper | Chest surrounded by Copper Ingots |
| Iron | Chest surrounded by Iron Ingots |
| Gold | Chest surrounded by Gold Ingots |
| Emerald | Chest surrounded by Emeralds |
| Diamond | Chest surrounded by Diamonds |
| Netherite | Chest surrounded by Diamond Blocks |
| Secret | Secret recipe — figure it out yourself |
| Troll | Troll recipe — good luck |

---

## Effects and Animations

- Animated HUD popup with tier color on screen
- Screen shake on Netherite and Secret drops
- Particle explosions scaling with tier rarity
- Custom sounds on chest unlock

---

## Config and Commands

JSON config file auto-generated at `config/advancedrop.json`

Configurable options:
- `modEnabled` - Toggle the mod on or off
- `minChestsPerAdvancement` / `maxChestsPerAdvancement` - Set chest count range
- `trollChestChance` - Control troll chest probability (default 5%)
- `playLevelUpSound` - Toggle reward sounds

Admin command (permission level 2+):
- `/advancedrop chest <tier> [count]` - Spawn a specific chest tier for testing

---

## Compatibility

- Loader: Fabric
- Minecraft: 1.21 to 26.1.2
- Java: 21 or later
- Required: Fabric API, Cloth Config, ModMenu

title: Thermia
description: A temperature mod for Terrafirmacraft, A complex temperature system that can also be extended to non player entities.
body:
# **Alpha, Subject to changes**

## Summary:
A temperature mod for Terrafirmacraft, A complex temperature system that can also be extended to non player entities.

**Keeping Warm:**
- Seeking sunlight
- Sheltering from wind
- Heat sources such as fire, TFC sources are also supported
- Heated items such as ingots, pots, etc.
- Insulation or clothing

**Keeping Cool:**
- Seeking shade
- Seeking wind
- Swimming
- Contact with cold blocks such as ice
- Insulation or clothing

**Interiors:**
- Dynamic flood fill system allowing for any structure
- Thermodynamic based model, Internal volume requires energy and time to warm
- Block porosity allows for functional differing block states, Eg. trapdoor as windows.

## Data Driven:

**Entity Temperature Data Map:** _data/thermia/data_maps/entity_type/entity_temperatures.json_


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Entity Temperature is the primary data map that you'll encounter and is the method to add or remove the temperature system to entities. It has the following data:

- **max_entity_temperature:** Maximum temperature or climate for an entity.
- **min_entity_temperature:** Minimum temperature or climate for an entity.
- **is_mob:** This is for deciding if the entity receives the simple or complex player model.
- **is_tamed:** If the entity requires taming for the temperature system to enable.

</details>




**Block Temperature Data Map:** _data/thermia/data_maps/block/block_temperature.json_

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


Block Temperature is another primary data map. It's what tells thermia what block has what temperature and if it's hot and radiative or cold and conductive. It has the following data:

- **temperature:** Temperature of the block or default temperature if it has blockstates, If hasTFCHeat is true this must be 0.
- **search_cap:** How many should thermia look for and save in each nearby block search.
- **has_tfc_heat:** If the block has TFC's heat mechanic, If this is true the temperature must be 0.
- **is_radiative:** If this block should be treated like a radiation source. If this is false it's treated as a contact source, Eg. Ice.
- **is_home_block:** Deprecated, Ignore it.
- **state_temps:** This is more complex. This allows for specific blockstates to have different temperatures, The bloomery for example has "state_temps":{"lit=true":1200}. With a temperature value of 0, this means the bloomery will be 0 temperature until it's blockstate lit = true.

</details>




**Fluid Temperature Data Map:** _data/thermia/data_maps/fluid/fluid_temperature.json_


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Much like Block Temperature, This handles fluid temperature. It will also allow you to define radiative temperatures for blocks containing these fluids such as tanks. Note this data map does not have special block state handling. It has the following data:

- **temperature:** Temperature of the fluid.
- **search_cap:** How many should thermia look for and save in each nearby block search.
- **is_radiative:** If this block should be treated like a radiation source. If this is false it's treated as a submersion source, Eg. Water.

</details>




**Block Porosity Data Map** _data/thermia/data_maps/block/block_porosity.json_


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The Block Porosity Data Map is for defining the leakiness of a block for interiors. As the interior system only uses Block Porosity and isSolidRender to determine boundaries, Block Porosity also acts as a white list to allow non solid blocks as walls or edges. It should be noted that porosity is inverted, so a solid block would be near 1.0 and an open block would be near 0.0. It has the following data:

- **state_porosity:** Much like the **state_temps** value for Block Temperature, This is a complex entry for allowing a block with multiple block state values to have differing porosity or leakiness values. Eg. The trapdoors entry: "state_porosity":{"open=false":0.1,"open=true": 0.95}. As with trapdoors their vertical position is considered "open" however closed for the purpose of a window.
- **default_porosity:** The default porosity if none of the **state_porosity** values apply.

</details>




**Item Insulation Data Map:** _data/thermia/data_maps/item/item_insulation.json_

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


Item insulation is a key part of Thermia's thermal system. It isolates you from the environment slowing or even stopping environmental temperature change. Insulation is averaged by number of item slots occupied and not by number of items. Armour/Clothing has it's own averaging. It has the following data:

- **insulation_modifier:** The single value in this data map. Positive values insulate and slow environmental effects, Negative values increase environmental effects, Eg. Metal Armour.

</details>

title: Zone Miner Single Use
description: Zone Miner is a mod that adds enchantment-free area mining with switchable 1x1, 3x3x3, 5x5x5, and custom modes, live block previews, and vanilla-friendly tool behavior.
body:
## Zone Miner is a NeoForge mod that adds configurable area mining.

 

Switch between simple mining, 3x3x3, 5x5x5, or a fully custom mining shape, all while keeping vanilla-style durability handling and tool restrictions.

 

### Features

- Multiple mining modes:
  - `1x1`
  - `3x3x3`
  - `5x5x5`
  - `Custom`
- In-game keybinds to switch modes and open the custom area settings
- Mining direction follows the player's look direction
- Live white block outline preview before breaking
- Only breaks extra blocks when the held tool is appropriate
- Ore vein support
- Vanilla block breaking logic is preserved for drops and interactions

 

## Two Versions Available

This project is available in two separate versions for NeoForge :

### Zone Miner
The standard version uses `legacy durability`.
Your tool loses durability based on the number of blocks actually broken.
[You'll find it here!](https://modrinth.com/mod/zone-miner-legacy)

### Zone Miner Single Use
This version keeps the same mining features, but only uses `one durability point` for the whole area break.
_You're on the right page!_
 

## Controls

- `Y` : Cycle mining mode
- `U` : Open custom area settings

## Custom Area Settings

The custom mode lets you configure:

- Left
- Right
- Up
- Down
- Depth

 

**Zone Miner is designed to stay simple and practical**
no enchantment requirement, no complicated setup, just configurable area mining with two durability variants depending on how you want to play.

title: CensorSigns
description: A plugin that censors bad words on signs
body:
**CensorSigns: Keep Your Minecraft Server Signs Family-Friendly**

CensorSigns is a lightweight but powerful Minecraft server plugin designed to automatically detect and filter inappropriate language on signs. This plugin provides server administrators with the tools they need to maintain a clean, family-friendly environment without having to constantly monitor player-created signage.

Key Features

**🛡️ Comprehensive Filtering System**

Customizable Banned Word List: Easily add, remove, or modify the words that should be censored through the configuration file.

Smart Word Detection: Identifies inappropriate words even when players try to bypass filters with special characters or spacing.

Context-Aware Filtering: Distinguishes between acceptable uses of words and inappropriate contexts to minimize false positives.


**⚙️ Flexible Configuration Options**

Customizable Censoring Style: Choose whether to replace entire words or maintain word length with replacement characters.

Replacement Character Selection: Set any character as your preferred censoring symbol (* by default).

Permission-Based Bypassing: Grant trusted players permission to bypass the filter when necessary.

**👮 Staff Notification System**

Real-Time Alerts: Staff members receive instant notifications when players attempt to place signs with inappropriate content.

Customizable Notification Messages: Personalize the format and content of staff alerts.

Detailed Logging: Optional logging of all censoring actions for administrative review.

**🚀 Performance Optimized**

Minimal Impact: Designed with performance in mind, ensuring no server lag or slowdowns.

Memory Efficient: Consumes minimal resources while maintaining effectiveness.

Compatible: Works seamlessly with other plugins and across multiple Minecraft versions.

**🧩 Administrator Tools**

Simple Commands: Easy-to-use commands for reloading configuration and viewing plugin information.

Permission System: Granular permission nodes for different administrative functions.
**
Why Choose This Plugin?**
Server administrators face the challenge of maintaining appropriate content in their communities while allowing creative freedom. This plugin offers the perfect balance by automatically filtering inappropriate content on signs while being completely customizable to fit your server's specific needs and community standards.

The plugin integrates seamlessly into your existing server setup with minimal configuration required, though more advanced customization options are available for those who want fine-grained control over the filtering system.

Whether you're running a family-friendly public server, a school environment, or simply want to maintain certain standards of language among your players, this plugin provides the tools you need to enforce those standards consistently and automatically.

By implementing this plugin, you'll save valuable administrative time that would otherwise be spent monitoring and removing inappropriate signs, allowing you to focus on more important aspects of server management and community building.

title: FastFlow
description: FastFlow is a Minecraft plugin that speeds up hoppers and improves server performance by allowing faster item transfers for farms, storage, and sorting systems.
body:
FastFlow is a Minecraft plugin designed to improve hopper speed and reduce lag on servers. Instead of using the slow vanilla hopper system, the plugin allows hoppers to transfer more items at a faster rate, making farms, storage systems, and sorting machines more efficient.

In this configuration, each hopper can move up to 8 items every transfer instead of the normal 1 item, while the cooldown is reduced from the vanilla 8 ticks to only 2 ticks. This makes item transportation much faster without completely breaking furnace mechanics. The plugin can also pull items from containers above hoppers and collect dropped items from the world. Additional settings such as limiting hopper processing and skipping invalid destinations help improve server performance and reduce unnecessary lag.

If there is any bugs or glichs please inform via email kaysadi11239@gmail.com

description: Fully server-side mod that adds cool animated flintlocks to your game. Possible thanks to the Polymer library.
body:
# About
This is a server-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that adds functional muskets and pistols. It uses the Polymer framework, which means it works entirely on the server and players don't need to install any client-side mods to see the custom models or animations.

I built this to feel authentic and immersive without being overly complicated. It handles things like custom poses, particle effects for muzzle flashes, and specific enchantment behaviors entirely through server-side logic.

[_*MY MINECRAFT SERVER*_](https://nationscraft.hax4.fun)
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/8yTYbllRT9s" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Key Features

- **No Client Mods Needed:** Everything is handled server-side.
- **Pistol Dual-Wielding:** You can carry and fire a pistol in each hand.
- **Custom Animations:** Players will actually raise their weapon to aim when it's ready to fire.
- **Visuals:** Includes muzzle flashes, smoke trails, and impact effects.
- **Crafting System:** Build weapons from specific parts like barrels, stocks, and lock plates.
- **Enchantments:** Support for Power, Piercing, and Flame with custom visuals.

## Weapon Statistics

### The Musket
Heavy hitting and long range, but the reload is slow. Best used for picking off targets from a distance.
- **Damage:** 20.25 (roughly 10 hearts)
- **Range:** 150 blocks
- **Reload:** 5.5 seconds
- **Notes:** High accuracy, long cooldown.

### The Pistol
Faster and lighter but less powerful than the musket. Good for close-quarters or dual-wielding.
- **Damage:** 15.75 (roughly 8 hearts)
- **Range:** 50 blocks
- **Reload:** 3.5 seconds
- **Notes:** Projectiles have gravity, so you'll need to account for drop. Supports dual-wielding.

## Enchantments

I've integrated a few vanilla enchantments to work specifically with these weapons:
- **Piercing (I-IV):** Bullets will go through enemies.
- **Power (I-V):** Increases damage. At level 5, weapons get a unique magenta trail.
- **Flame:** Adds fire particles to the shot and ignites whatever you hit.

## Crafting

You first craft the components and then combine them into the final weapon.

### Components
- **Barrel / Short Barrel:** Made from Netherite Scrap.
- **Lock Plate:** Made from Iron Ingots and Iron Nuggets.
- **Stock:** Made from Oak Planks.
- **Handle:** Made from Oak Planks.
*See full crafting in video.*

### Final Weapons
- **Musket:** Combine a Musket Barrel, Lock Plate, and Stock.
- **Pistol:** Combine a Short Barrel, Lock Plate, and Handle.

## Installation

This mod is for Fabric servers or clients running 1.21.11.
It requires:
- **Fabric API**
- **Polymer Core**
- **The Resourcepack**

This mod might also run on versions 26.1.x but it has not been tested on them, use at your own risk.

- **Framework:** Polymer by Patbox, Fabric by FabricMC

title: DialogWindow
description: A powerful, fully configurable dialog UI system for version 1.21.6+. Create dynamic, interactive GUI dialogs entirely from YAML files
body:
# DialogWindow

Turn any command into a clean in-game GUI — no code required.

DialogWindow lets server admins build fully custom dialog menus for Minecraft using simple YAML files. Built on top of Minecraft's native Dialog API (1.21.6+), it gives commands that normally just print text in chat a proper graphical interface instead: buttons, checkboxes, dropdowns, sliders, text fields, and custom item displays.

Perfect for warp menus, rule acceptance screens, shop confirmations, settings panels, rank pickers, PvP toggles, or any admin tool that deserves more than a wall of chat text.

## What it does

- Define entire GUIs in YAML — no plugin development needed
- Add labels, buttons, checkboxes, select menus, sliders, and text inputs
- Show custom items with names, lore, skull textures, glow effects, and more
- Trigger console and player commands based on what the user picks
- Plug in PlaceholderAPI placeholders anywhere — titles, labels, item lore, commands
- Organize dozens of menus in subfolders without losing track of anything
- Works on both Paper and Spigot

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.6 or newer
- Java 17+
- PlaceholderAPI (optional, but recommended)

Older versions aren't supported since the plugin relies on Minecraft's built-in Dialog API.

## Getting started

1. Drop the jar into your `plugins` folder
2. Restart the server
3. DialogWindow generates `config.yml`, `messages.yml`, and an `interfaces/` folder with working examples
4. Edit or add your own interface files
5. Run `/dwreload` — done, no restart needed

## Commands

| Command | What it does | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/dwreload` | Reloads config, messages, and all interfaces on the fly | `dialogwindow.reload` |
| `/dwreport` | Generates a diagnostic report for support requests | `dialogwindow.report` |

## How an interface looks

Each YAML file in `interfaces/` defines one command and its dialog. A minimal warp menu:

```yaml
command:
  name: "warpui"
  description: "Warp selection menu"
  permission: "dialogwindow.warpui"

dialog:
  title: "<gold>Warp Menu</gold>"
  can-close-with-escape: false

ui:
  - label: "<yellow>Select your destination:</yellow>"

  - item:
      type: item
      material: PLAYER_HEAD
      name: "<gold>%playername%</gold>"
      skull-owner: "%playername%"
      glow: true

  - input:
      type: checkbox
      key: confirm
      label: "<green>Confirm teleport</green>"

  - buttons:
      - label: "<green>Teleport</green>"
        console-commands:
          - "warp ${destination}"
```

Elements render top to bottom, exactly as listed: labels, items, inputs, buttons — mix and match freely.

### Inputs you can use
- **text** – free text field
- **checkbox** – on/off toggle with custom return values
- **single_option** – select menu / dropdown
- **number_range** – slider with min/max/step

### Item display (Paper only)

### Placeholders

Plus full PlaceholderAPI support in titles, labels, item names/lore, input defaults, button commands, and hover text — if PAPI is installed, it just works.

## Use cases

Warp menus · shop confirmations · rule acceptance dialogs · PvP toggles · rank selection · settings panels · command configuration UIs · admin tools

## Web Editor

Build your YAML visually instead of by hand: [morelaid.com/dwe](https://www.morelaid.com/dwe)

## Support

Discord: https://discord.gg/5zuC36R

Before reaching out, please run `/dwreport` and bring the result with you — it speeds up troubleshooting a lot. Questions are welcome in German or English.

title: Thor
description: Summon a lightning bolt at your crosshair the /thor command. Fully configurable.
body:
# Thor Lightning command 

> **Summon a lightning bolt at your crosshair with a command. Fully configurable. OP-only by default with optional LuckPerms support.**

---

## What does it do?

Type `/thor` and a lightning bolt strikes exactly where you're looking, up to **100 blocks away** (configurable up to 1,000).

Perfect for server admins who want to smite things dramatically or anyone who wants to feel like a god.

(This mod pairs well with a command macro mod on the client)

---

## Features

- **`/thor`**, Strikes lightning at your crosshair (uses configured range)
- **`/thor <range>`**, One-time range override (1–1,000 blocks) for a single strike
- **`/thor reload`**, Reloads the config file instantly without restarting the server
- **Ray-cast targeting**, Hits the exact block surface you're looking at; strikes at max range if looking at sky or air
- **Fully configurable** via `config/thor.json` and an **in-game ModMenu screen**
- **OP-only** by default (vanilla gamemaster level 2)
- **Optional LuckPerms support**, grant the `thor.command` permission node to any group
- **Fine-grained control** over what the bolt does:
  - **Start Fires** toggle, prevent the bolt from igniting blocks or activating nether portal frames
  - **Convert Mobs** toggle, prevent pigs → zombified piglins, villagers → witches, creepers → charged creepers
  - **Visual Only** mode, purely cosmetic bolt with no damage, fire, or conversions

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/thor` | Strike lightning at your crosshair using the configured range |
| `/thor <range>` | Strike with a one-time custom range (1–1,000 blocks) |
| `/thor reload` | Reload `thor.json` from disk without restarting |

All commands require OP level 2 (or the `thor.command` LuckPerms node).

---

## Configuration

All settings are editable in `config/thor.json` or live in-game via ModMenu (requires Cloth Config):

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `range` | `100` | Ray-cast range in blocks (1–1,000) |
| `visualOnly` | `false` | Cosmetic-only bolt — no damage, fire, or conversions |
| `fire` | `true` | Whether the bolt can ignite blocks / light nether portals |
| `convertMobs` | `true` | Whether the bolt converts mobs |
| `permissionMode` | `"op"` | `"op"` for vanilla OP, `"luckperms"` for LP node |

---

## Permissions

**Vanilla (default):** Requires OP level 2 (gamemaster). Works in singleplayer with cheats enabled.

**LuckPerms (optional):** Set `permissionMode` to `"luckperms"` in the config, then grant the node:
```
/lp group <group> permission set thor.command true
```
Falls back to OP check automatically if LuckPerms is not installed.

---

## Dependencies

**Required:**
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

**Optional (for in-game config screen):**
- [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)

**Optional (for permission node support):**
- [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net)

---

## Server & Client

This mod only needs to be installed **server-side** (or in singleplayer). It does **not** need to be on the client.

(Disclaimer: Code and assets are mostly ai generated)

title: ScoreFixer
description: Prevent scores from getting lost after player name changes.
body:
# ScoreFixer
A robust Minecraft Data Pack library that prevents scoreboard values from getting lost after a player name change.\
For inquiries, please contact **@silicatYT** on Discord.\
\
Download: [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/score-fixer)\
Issue tracker: [GitHub](https://github.com/CMDred/ScoreFixer)

## Why is this necessary?
In Minecraft, scores are tied to usernames rather than UUIDs. As such, changing your name resets your previously held scores (which can break Data Packs or lose progress), and anyone joining with your old name can take over your previous scores.\
**ScoreFixer** tackles this issue and lets you automatically transfer scores to your new name without conflicts.

## Features
- Automatically transfer certain scoreboard objectives' values to the new player name upon a name change
- Read/write offline players' scores using their UUID or specific scoreboard values (e.g. ID score) as selectors
- Events (function tags): `#score_fixer:changed_name`, `#score_fixer:joined_game` & `#score_fixer:left_game`

## How to use
<details>
<summary>Make scores transfer on name change</summary>

To make ScoreFixer automatically transfer objectives (e.g. "foo" & "bar") on name changes, run `/function score_fixer:util/track_objectives {Objectives:["foo", "bar"]}`.

To untrack objectives again, run `/function score_fixer:util/untrack_objectives {Objectives:["foo", "bar"]}`.

Alternatively, you can directly add or remove `{Name:"foo"}` to/from the `score_fixer:objectives List` data storage.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Access offline players' scores</summary>

  <details>
  <summary>Load</summary>

You can access offline players' scores with their UUID by running `/function score_fixer:util/load_with_uuid {UUID:...}` (accepts hexadecimal and int array format). If a player is found, their data is copied to `score_fixer:loaded Players`. From there, you can make changes (adjust score values, remove objectives from the list to reset them, etc).\
Alternatively, you can manually copy data from every player that matches your custom condition like so:
```
/data modify storage score_fixer:loaded Players append from storage score_fixer:zprivate Maps[{Objectives:[{Name:"foo",Value:10}]}]
```

  </details>

  <details>
  <summary>Save</summary>

After applying changes to the objectives in `score_fixer:loaded Players`, run `/function score_fixer:util/save` to save the data for all loaded players at once.

  </details>

</details>

<details>
<summary>Events</summary>

- `#score_fixer:changed_name`: When a player joins with a new name, this function tag is executed **as** that player. The data storage `score_fixer:event Data` contains `Name`, `OldName` and `UUID`.
- `#score_fixer:joined_game`: When a player joins, this function tag is executed **as** that player. The data storage `score_fixer:event Data` contains `Name` and `UUID`.
- `#score_fixer:left_game`: When a player leaves, this function tag is executed. The data storage `score_fixer:event Data` contains `Name` and `UUID`.

The data inside `score_fixer:event Data` is also directly accessible using **macros**.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Upgrade or uninstall ScoreFixer</summary>

- **Uninstall:** Run `/function score_fixer:uninstall`.
- **Upgrade:**
  - Uninstall the current version (keep the associated data), replace the Data Pack with the new version, then `/reload`.
  - **(v1.2.0+)** Upgrading from v1.2.0 to a higher version can be done without uninstalling the current version first.

</details>

## Good to know
<details>
<summary>Caveats to ScoreFixer</summary>

- Scores manually set while the player is offline (e.g. `/scoreboard players set SilicatYT foo 1`) cannot be transferred if they join with a new name. Use the `load` and `save` utilities instead.
  - Reason: While a player is offline, the game becomes case insensitive to that name, making it impossible to copy scores from the previous name to the new name if a player only changed their name capitalization.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Lantern Load</summary>

ScoreFixer supports [Lantern Load](https://github.com/LanternMC/load), a convention that lets you specify dependencies (incl. versions) and control the order in which Data Packs run. **It is vital that ScoreFixer loads and ticks before your Data Pack**, so that scores can be assigned to the new player names before your Data Pack checks them.
- **Make ScoreFixer load and tick before your Data Pack:** Specify ScoreFixer as a Lantern Load dependency (makes it load first), and make your `load` function start a self-scheduled `tick` function instead of using `#minecraft:tick`.
- `#ScoreFixer load.status`: This score is set once ScoreFixer loads. Its value tells you **whether ScoreFixer has loaded already**. Negative values are error codes:
  - 1: ScoreFixer loaded correctly and can be used
  - <unset>: ScoreFixer could not load (e.g. not installed)
  - -1: Multiple incompatible ScoreFixer versions installed
  - -2: Tried to load a ScoreFixer version while a newer one was previously installed and not manually uninstalled
  - -3: Tried to load a ScoreFixer version while a different unknown version was previously installed and not manually uninstalled
- `#ScoreFixer.Version load.status`: This score is set once ScoreFixer loads. Its value tells you **what ScoreFixer version is installed**. It's a single integer that increments whenever a potentially breaking change is made (e.g. behaviour change, utility function renamed etc). If the value does not change (e.g. only optimizations were made), any Data Packs that use ScoreFixer should not require any changes either.

</details>

## Credit
From CMDred:
- **SilicatYT**

Additional help:
- Leinad677YT (Consulting & ideas)

As per the MIT License, you are allowed to redistribute, modify and use ScoreFixer as long as you provide credit for the original work.

title: MTD Offline Addon
description: MyTotemDoll addon which adds offline-mode player skins support
body:
My Totem Doll for Offline Mode!



##
Feel free to report any issues!


**MTD Offline Addon** makes [My Totem Doll](https://modrinth.com/mod/my_totem_doll) mod work with offline mode players. My Totem Doll alone pulls skins from Mojang API, and if a player plays in offline mode and has skin set by server (for example by [Skins Restorer](https://modrinth.com/plugin/skinsrestorer) plugin), then MTD would not displays their skin on totem named after them, because Mojang API has no info about it. This addon fixes it, making MTD try to pull the skin from local client data first. This addon also provides caching of offline skins, so when offline player leaves the server (and therefore their skin cannot be found in client data) their skin is loaded from cache. Cache is prioritized even for licensed accounts, but it is configurable with [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and [YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl).

body:
# 🧨 Creeper Apocalypse Escalation
(BETA! SOME DON"T WORK AND SOME WORK!)
**Every mob spawn becomes a creeper. Every day, more spawn. Can you survive?**

This mod turns your Minecraft world into a chaotic challenge run. It features a sophisticated replacement system that swaps normal mobs for Creepers, slowly ramping up the difficulty day by day until you are facing swarms of explosive enemies.

---

## 📋 Features

### 🔄 Mob Replacement System
*   **ALL mobs spawn as Creepers!**
*   **Safe exceptions:** Blazes, Villagers, and the Ender Dragon remain normal so the game is still beatable.
*   **Configurable:** Choose which mobs get replaced in the config menu.

### 📈 Auto-Escalation System
*   **Day 1:** Normal spawn rates (1x)
*   **Day 10:** Chaos (10x spawns!)
*   Spawn multiplier increases automatically every day.

### 🧬 9 Special Creeper Variants
New variants spawn starting from Day 3, each with unique abilities:

| Variant | Special Ability |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🐁 **Mini Creeper** | Tiny, super fast, hard to hit |
| 🦖 **Giant Creeper** | Massive size, slow, huge explosion radius |
| 🕷️ **Spider Creeper** | Climbs walls like a spider |
| 🥷 **Ninja Creeper** | Turns invisible when standing still |
| 🌈 **Rainbow Creeper** | Drops random loot when killed |
| 🏀 **Bouncy Creeper** | Jumps incredibly high |
| 🤠 **Jockey Creeper** | Rides other creepers into battle |
| 💖 **Happy Creeper** | Friendly! Buffs players instead of hurting them |
| ⚡ **Lightning Creeper** | Boss-tier, always charged, extreme speed |

**Unique Feature:** The **Super Charged Lightning Creeper** (Day 7+) features a custom PURPLE energy aura!

### 🎯 Milestone Events
*   **Day 5 - Blood Moon:** All creepers glow red and can be seen through walls.
*   **Day 7 - Charged Day:** 25% of all creepers spawn naturally charged.
*   **Day 10 - The Swarm:** Spawn rates gain a massive +50% bonus.

### 📊 Full Statistics & GUI
*   **In-Game Menu:** Press `K` (or use Pause Menu) to configure spawn limits, disable "No Day" mode, or adjust variant chances.
*   **Stats Overlay:** Press `J` to see your kills, death count, and survived explosions in real-time.
*   **Streamer Ready:** Features auto-screenshots on death and chat commands.

---

## 🔧 Installation

1.  Requires **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.21.11
2.  Requires **Fabric API**
3.  Drop `creeper-apocalypse-escalation-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods` folder.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Press `ESC` -> `Creeper Challenge Settings` to configure everything in-game!
*   Adjust spawn rate caps
*   Toggle specific variants
*   Enable/Disable the entire mod
*   Set "No Day Mode" for a randomized challenge

title: Heroes Reborn
description: I am developing my first mod Heroes Reborn. Currently in the process of porting Lucraft Heroes Expansion stuff into my mod as well.
body:
I am trying to make a faithful addition and recreation of Heroes Expansion in my own right under the name Heroes Reborn. I whole heartedly plan on expanding and refining what I already have and I am currently finishing up what I have developed so far. I do hope you enjoy what I have cared for.

Credit - https://gitlab.com/threetag/legacy/LucraftCore

Current How To (W.I.P)

Getting started!
First things first you're going to want to find an Aetherbloom. They can usually be found in meteor crashes (hard to miss) where you can find them at the heart of the crash. If you want up to one with a pair of shears and right click you will get Aetherium!. But I advise finding more. So what do you do with Aetherium? well first you need a Mortar and Pestle. If you put Aetherium in your off hand and hold the Mortar and Pestle in your main hand and right click the ground you get Aetheron!... or not, theres a 50% chance you dont get Aetheron. But lets say you did get Aetheron, going off that you know can progress to your next step.

You will need to craft and find room for the Centrifuge! You should also get your self a Empty Serum! which is crafted by surrounding one quarts in a crafting grid with glass panes. Once you have the Empty Serum you must find yourself a water source, then you need to right click water with the Empty Serum and BOOYA. H20 Serum, now we can move onto the next step!

Go over to your Centrifuge and place the H20 Serum in one input and then place the Aetheron in the other input. Fuel this with Coal on the left hand side of the GUI. After some time you should get Irradiated Serum. Now we are ready to move onto the SUPER stuff.

Next thing you want to do is place the Irradiated Serum in the Centrifuge with 1 Enchanted Golden Apple. You will need that to progress. Now if you do the Centrifuge will mix into the Super Serum! At this point the Centrifuge is no longer needed if you are just one person.

Moving on to the end game portion of Heroes Reborn. 
Once you have the Super Serum you will need ONLY one of the 6 different crafting items needed for your desired Serum. Now you once you have everything good! Now you need to craft a Genesis Engine, which requires a Genesis Core. Once the Genesis Engine is crafted (I recommend JEI) I recommend placing the Genesis Engine far away from your Base of Operations. Once you have placed your Genesis Engine go ahead and peak inside. There you will see two fuel inputs both requiring Ender Pearls. You will also see two inputs, this is where your Super Serum and your Serum Ingredient will go. The Genesis Engine draws a tremendous toll on our Earthly plain causing Electro Magnetic disturbances so I advice leaving the area until you hear the crackling when its finished. At which point you will see your desiginated Serum. Upon drinking this Serum you should feel POWER like no other but weak at the same time.

The Skill Tree!
Right away you will need to craft the Book Of Genesis, this is fairy cheap at this level. Enter your crafting grid with 2 Diamonds and one book and go ahead and grab yourself the BOG! Right click and bomb voyage you are now on your Super Journey.

Each power has their own requirement.
Ender Serum = Consume Ender Orbs
Icarus Serum = Soar through the sky!
WayBig Serum = Hold your form!
Mimic Serum = Kill Mobs!
Spectral Serum = Phase more!
Infernal Serum = Stay in Infernal Form! 

There are Uru Meteor that spawn with Mjölnir as well. These Meteors start spawning 1000 blocks away from spawn! I advise you to do /hrwc before you get your hopes up though.

 
Commands;
/heroesreborn givepoints
/heroesreborn removepoints 
/hrwc (Checks worthiness)

 - Aetherium in off hand with Mortar and Pestal in main hand on right click = 1 Aetheron
 - Empty Serum - Glass panes all around one quarts in the middle.

title: Beacon Boost
description: Beacons done right. Range now scales with **every** block upgraded in your pyramid (counted as configurable groups), designed to feel like it always belonged in Minecraft. Server-side only and singleplayer compatible.
body:
# Beacon Boost

**Beacon Boost** is a Fabric mod that makes beacon range scale with the materials you use to build the pyramid, using only vanilla mechanics. It works in singleplayer, and as a server‑side-only mod.

## Features

### Default behavior

By default, Beacon Boost counts base blocks in small groups and adds extra range based on the material. All of these values (group size, per‑material bonuses, max range, vertical behavior, unloaded‑chunk behavior) can be tuned in config/beaconboost.json. 

The default behavior is set as follows:

- Group size: 2 blocks 

- +0 blocks of range per group of iron blocks  
- +1 block of range per group of gold blocks  
- +2 blocks of range per group of emerald blocks  
- +4 blocks of range per group of diamond blocks  
- +6 blocks of range per group of netherite blocks  

- Maximum horizontal range: 500 blocks (radius)

- Vertical range now extends infinitely downward as well as upward.

### Additional notes

- Beacon Boost is built with servers in mind: it tracks beacons efficiently, continues to apply effects from cached data even when beacon chunks are unloaded (given player is still within the radius), and adds no client‑side UI requirement.

- Target version: Minecraft 1.21.11+ with Fabric. Earlier 1.21.x versions may work but are not officially tested.

- Currently, only valid vanilla beacon base materials are supported.

## Feedback and feature requests

Found a bug, have a suggestion, or want a new config option?

Please feel free to open an issue on the GitHub repository that describes your setup (Minecraft version, Fabric/Loader version, other relevant mods) and what you’d like to see changed. I actively use these issues to plan fixes and new features, so don’t hesitate to file bug reports, balance feedback, or feature requests. :)

## Inspiration

This mod is inspired by the datapack **“Increased Range Beacons”** by brisai:  
https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/increased-range-beacons-multiplayer-compatible/

BeaconBoost is a from‑scratch reimplementation in Java for the Fabric modding ecosystem. Please support the original datapack and its author.

See the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.

title: Flame, Fuel, Farm, and Forge
description: A Minecraft mod that adds realism, challenge, and historical flavor.
body:
**Flame, Fuel, Farm & Forge** (FFFF) is a lightweight realism-focused mod inspired by a coding class project. It began as an experiment to make torches burn out — and quickly grew into a full early-game progression overhaul, adding tin, bronze, lantern fueling, animal fat, accurate ore names, and more.

This mod is great for players who enjoy:

- Survival challenge
- Base-building
- Historical immersion
- Automation experiments
- Early-game resource progression

## Torches Burn Out

Regular and copper torches now behave more realistically:

Torch Lifespans

- Regular Torch: ~1 Minecraft day
- Copper Torch: ~3 Minecraft days

When a torch burns out, it becomes a Burnt Torch:

- Mining a burnt torch drops ashes (nothing)
- Mining a torch before it burns out drops Kindling
- Kindling works as a low-grade furnace fuel

## Torches Cause Fire Damage

Torches are now mildly dangerous:

- Walking through a torch’s hitbox can cause small fire damage
- Mobs take the same damage
- Hitting a creature with a torch ignites it — works for all torch types
- Regular torches can ignite flammable blocks they’re placed on
- Copper torches do not ignite blocks
- Anthracite (coal ore) is flammable — place carefully!

## Smarter World-Gen Lighting

Village torches and other world-generated torches are replaced with:

- Copper Torches, or
- Lanterns (preferred when placement allows)

Copper torches from world-gen can still burn out naturally.

## Animals Drop Fat

Some animals now drop Animal Fat, used for:

- Furnace fuel
- Lantern fuel
- Oil production

## Lantern Fueling

Lanterns now require fuel:

- All Lanterns
  - Have one internal fuel slot
  - Holds 16 units of fuel (Oil or Animal Fat)
- 1 Animal Fat = 1 day of light
- 1 Bottle of Oil = 3 days of light

Bronze Hoppers are included:

- 3 slots (smaller capacity)
- Slower than iron hoppers

## Copper Kettle

A new container similar to a cauldron, but:

- Max capacity 2
- Cannot hold hot liquids
- Accepts Animal Fat, Oil, or Water

Placed over heat → converts Animal Fat → Oil

Bonus:
- Composters now drip Oil whenever they produce bone meal. A Copper Kettle or Cauldron placed beneath catches the oil.

## Ore items have been renamed for historical realism:

- Raw Copper → Malachite
- Coal → Anthracite

The functionality is exactly the same, they are just renamed.

## Tin, Bronze & Early Tools

Adds Cassiterite Ore → Tin Ingots, craftable into nuggets and blocks.

### Bronze

Combining tin + copper allows crafting:

- Bronze Tools
- Bronze Weapons
- Bronze Armor
- Bronze Blocks / Ingots / Nuggets

Copper equipment is disabled (historically inaccurate).
Stone swords, pickaxes, and shovels are disabled (unrealistic tools).

### Brass

We have added Sphalerite Ore, which can be smelted in a Blast Furnace into Zinc Ingots.

For now you can't do much with it, but we have massive plans for the Brass Age future. Think steampunk!

title: Event Horizon
description: large-scale Survival Multiplayer (SMP) modpack that merges Rust's intense, player-driven conflict with Hermitcraft's long-term technical creativity.
body:
# **Event Horizon**
is a highly competitive and cooperative modpack that throws players into a new frontier where advanced technology clashes with raw, untamed dimensions. Designed for large-scale Survival Multiplayer (SMP) gameplay, this pack merges the intense, player-driven conflict and industrial progression of a survival title like Rust with the long-term creativity and community building of a technical SMP like Hermitcraft.

## **Gameplay Focus**
In Event Horizon, you must master new industrial machinery, harness the power of custom new dimensions, and arm yourself for both PvE threats and inevitable PvP conflict.

## **Industrial Warfare**
Build sprawling factories and fortified bases using a suite of high-tech industrial and automation mods.

## **Armored Conflict**
Fight to control valuable resources and territories using modern guns, vehicles (including helicopters), and explosives.

## **Dimensional Exploration**
Venture past the namesake Event Horizon into vast, custom-built dimensions containing unique resources and dangerous new structures.

## **Community & Commerce**
While conflict is inevitable, the pack supports complex economic systems and massive collaborative projects. Will you build a thriving trade empire or raid your way to the top?

Event Horizon is a high-stakes, long-term challenge where engineering skill, strategic combat, and sheer survival instinct are your only currency. Suit up, mobilize, and establish your dominance in the new world.

title: MeteorCraft
description: Transform your server's survival experience with random meteorite events, unleashing valuable, ore-rich craters guarded by epic, highly-configurable custom boss encounters.
body:
# MeteorCraft

Tired of a predictable survival world where players know exactly what to expect? **MeteorCraft** is a plugin designed to inject chaos, challenge, and immense reward into your server by introducing dynamic, server-wide meteorite impact events.

Periodically, an alert will sound across the world, and a `BossBar` will begin a tense countdown. Players must band together (or compete) and race to the announced coordinates, where a star will fall from the sky. Upon impact, the meteorite creates a valuable, ore-rich crater filled with rare resources like Diamonds and Ancient Debris, but these treasures are not undefended!

Each crater is protected by a randomly selected pack of powerful, custom guardians, turning every event into a unique and unpredictable PvE battle. Will players face the legendary Four Horsemen, a single colossal Meteoric Golem that leaves a trail of lava in its wake, or the deadly Wither's Herald? As a server owner, you have complete control to create and customize your own epic boss encounters.

---

### **Core Features**
*   **Random, Timed Events:** Meteorites fall automatically within a configurable time range, keeping the world dynamic and exciting.
*   **Valuable Craters:** Each impact site is a treasure trove of rare ores, rewarding players who brave the danger.
*   **Custom Guardian System:** Instead of the same mobs every time, the plugin randomly chooses a "guardian pack" from a list you define in the config. This creates incredible variety and replayability.
*   **Epic Boss Encounters:** Create true mini-bosses with custom health, names, equipment, and unique special abilities, such as:
    *   **The Four Horsemen:** Fast-moving skeleton horsemen with powerful bows.
    *   **The Meteoric Golem:** A massive golem that leaves a temporary trail of lava.
    *   **The Wither's Herald:** A powerful Wither Skeleton that applies the Wither effect on hit.
*   **Immersive Experience:** Global announcements and a `BossBar` countdown build anticipation for every impact.
*   **Highly Configurable:** Control everything! Adjust event frequency, crater size, explosion power, ore rewards, and every detail of your guardian packs—all from an easy-to-use `config.yml`.

---

### **Commands & Permissions**

*   `/meteor start`
    *   Forces a meteorite event to begin immediately. Perfect for testing or admin-run events.
    *   **Permission:** `meteorcraft.admin` (defaults to OPs only)
*   `/meteor reload`
    *   Reloads the entire `config.yml` file without needing a server restart.
    *   **Permission:** `meteorcraft.admin` (defaults to OPs only)

title: Grasses - Tinted Realms
description: 'Grasses' allows to dye grass blocks, leaves, and plants in dozens of different colors.
body:
![Grasses](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f97b93b403ff80b86063f4616fce4db48c8e872_0.webp)

[![yt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f87fc4ee0444b634cf723813cf6b13d3c69dd2c.png)](https://www.youtube.com/@dantetoomaycry)[![DC](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/015f73f467e19fdb2392024055b01df4cc868c01_0.webp)](https://discord.gg/SqvjnqBHUZ)[![GH](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7578e6b144db482edc425fa3fb094eca1a326b86_0.webp)](https://github.com/DanteTooMayCry/Grasses)[![CF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9c8365c9e590155cf4a8bce8faa52f921fa86e4_0.webp)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/grasses-tinted-realms)[![p](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfa5f4fb6ae81ebc8e4f958bf011a6e425c2d8c2_0.webp)](https://patreon.com/DanteTooMayCry?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=copyLink)[![BC](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0718f3082dae3955c4ec4e882c11f0844b5fd747.png)](https://coff.ee/dantetoomaycry)
![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65c7852f0bf727f9a575bc3d717f729b43dccc62_0.webp)
![important](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/778f1d991e2b30243c034dfe8164ac9f8e3bce55.png)

This is my first adventure with modding - I didn't know the Minecraft environment or Forge before. I also didn't know Java before. Despite everything, I made every effort to write the mod as best as possible. If it has problems, please be understanding and report - I will make every effort to correct errors as soon as possible. No AI was used!

The mod was created as a response to a personal need that no previous mods had met, which only added similar blocks, or only decorative ones, without functionality. The idea was supposed to simply add functional grass blocks in vanilla colors, but it quickly grew as I learned about modding.


### Latest Update Info:

The mod is still available in beta. To see the files, uncheck the "Show Alpha Files" box.

Version 0.3 has been released, but I haven't had much time for full testing. Unfortunately, it was released on the last day I could. Now, I won't be back online until October. If any bugs appear, it have to wait. This applies to both Forge and Neoforge.

Neoforge 1.20.6 is almost ready, but I haven't had time to polish it yet. It will be released in October. After that, I'll start preparing version 1.21.

The current version introduces a new additional drop system, which you can read more about on the wiki:

https://github.com/DanteTooMayCry/Grasses/wiki/Additional-Drop-System

In short, the system allows you to modify the original drops and add your own, without having to manipulate jar files.


![about](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e82841dc7655b4c97506af6953914d3ba7a5ed8a.png)

In Vanilla Minecraft, grasses blocks, leaves, and various plants have a color that changes automatically depending on the biome. The mod breaks this rule and adds blocks that do not take the biome color. So, for example, you can use a jungle grass block in any other biome. At the same time, the block retains all other properties - including, for example, the ability to spread (but does not affect other grass blocks, including the vanilla Grass Block).

![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48507684109c67ddf4442f11dff59fae3323967e.png)

- 'Grasses' currently provides 56 new colors, including an improved Cherry Grove Biome color,
most of the mod's features can be configured or disabled in the config file!,
- provides a Lexicon that describes all of its aspects (Patchouli mod is required for the Lexicon to appear),
- blocks and slabs of grass that can be dyeing,
- leaves and plants (including potted ones) that have dyeing (including leaves that have two color variants - a darker and a lighter diamond color),
- bars block with grass, fern and vine (also dye ones),
- new station and tools for dyeing and preparing for dyeing - Dye, Dyeing Tool, Automatic Pruner (better shears), Dyeing Station, Dyeing Bonemeal,
- the ability to apply Silk Touch and Channeling Enchantments on Shears,
- most blocks have a "Fertile" state, which can be changed to false with shears, which prevents blocks from spreading, being destroyed, and plants from growing. To restore fertility, use bone meal,
- a grass block and slab that mimic the vanilla grass block, which can be used to replace when another mod affects the vanilla grass block (e.g. Immersive Weathering, which causes plants to spread),
- blocks and slabs imitating mycelium, podzol and nylium,
- a slab version of many vanilla blocks (like dirt, sand, ice, magma, soul sand etc),
- allows you to use vanilla and dyed bone meal on plants and blocks to spread or grow new plants (also on vanilla ones - e.g. vines, cactus, lilipad, mycelium)
ability to dye entire tree crowns at once (including vines - by applying Channeling Enchantment to the dyeing tool, you can dye only leaves or only vines)
- ability to cut the entire crown at once and the entire tree trunk separately (also works for Huge Fungus). Trees with Mod Dynamic Trees will cut according to its own mechanics. It is currently not possible to dye leaves on such trees.
- potted plants have been given audio and visual effects when interacting with them. The vanilla behavior of removing plants from pots has also been changed, so that a removed plant no longer blocks further removal. You can also directly swap plants in a pot.
- several new recipes for vanilla items (currently - Ice, Ender Stone, String, Paper, Quartz burn from Diorite, Andesite and Granite)
- the ability to disable the End Portal by removing the Eye of Ender.
- ability to create an End Portal Frame - you can extract and move the created frame (you still can't move the one in Stronghold)
-  extensive achievement tree
-  integration with mods: Jade (shows information about colored plants), JEI, and BOP (allows coloring leaves and plants from this mod), more in plans.
-  an axe with Silk Touch Enchantment will show the amount of logs, leaves and vines on the Tree/Huge Fungus if Jade mod is present.
-  shader support - plants and leaves will move in the wind
-  after starting the game, information about how long it took to start is displayed (especially useful when there are many mods installed)
-  ability to disable the default behavior of plants such as grass placed on the ground, which have a random offset (they will appear perfectly centered)

Q: Is it safe to add this mod to an already existing world?
A: Yes. There should be no problems.

Q: How can I report bugs/issues/suggestions?
A: I invite you to head over to GitHub and create a topic there. The link can be found at the top of the page.

Q: I don't want some of the things the mod adds, how can I disable them?
A: Most of the things the mod adds or changes can be disabled in great detail in the config file.

Q: Does the mod work with OptiFine?
A: 'Grasses' does not directly support OptiFine and does not recommend using it - it is an outdated mod. It is better to use mods based on Sodium (Embeddium) and Iris (Oculus). Nevertheless, everything should work.

Q: Will 'Grasses' be available on other Mod Loaders?
A: Yes. Future versions of the mod will be available on NeoForge (Forge will only have the current version 1.20.1). If I have time, I will also try to port the mod to Fabric.

Q: When will the new version be available?
A: There's no way to say. It all depends on how much time I can devote to creating. Supporting me will definitely allow me to spend more time on modding and less time on work. The development is an unpaid free-time activity, so any support helps being able to spend more time on it.

Q: Do you have any plans on backporting?
A: Very unlikely. Mayby, 1.19.2 in future. But first I want migrate to neoforge and update for all +1.20.1.

Q: How can I support?
A: You can support me on Patreon, BuyCoffe (links are on the top of this page) or just spreading the word around. Any support is greatly appreciated

Q: Can I add a mod to a modpack?
A: Of course, just credit me and with a reference to this page.

Q: Can I make Videos/Screenshoots?
A: Again of course. In fact, I encourage you to do so. Create videos or take screenshots and post them anywhere you want. I just ask that you note what the mod is and let people know where to get it.

Q: I can translate the mod to my language. How can I do that?
A: Go to my github. Download the en-us.json file and edit it. Next just make topic on issue tracker with translation label.

title: EnchantShop
description: A simple, powerful, and fully configurable GUI-based shop for enchanting items using your server's economy.
body:
# EnchantShop
A complete enchanting system with a GUI shop, a high-stakes enchantment gambler, a disenchanter, and powerful admin tools.


![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d41c85f9d9e28396f458e50b036badd274a3032e.png)

[![Requires Vault](https://img.shields.io/badge/Requires-Vault-yellow?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/)
[![Built for Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20For-Paper%201.21+-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://papermc.io/)

After a long battle with the code demons, EnchantShop has emerged victorious! This plugin provides a seamless way for your players to spend their hard-earned in-game money to get the exact enchantments they want, bypassing the randomness of the vanilla enchanting table. (YES I'M PUTTING THIS BECAUSE THIS IS MY FIRST PLUGIN AND I WANT TO SHOW YOU HOW HARD IT WAS)

---

## Features ✨

-   **NEW! Enchantment Gambler:** A high-stakes "double or nothing" system! Players can wager the existing enchantments on an item for a chance to win a new random enchant, but risk losing them all if the gamble fails!
-   **Intuitive GUI Menu (`/eshop`):** A main menu lets players choose between the classic, safe Enchant Shop and the risky new Gambler.
-   **Enchanted Book Support:** The shop works for both enchanting items directly and creating tradable Enchanted Books.
-   **Disenchanting System (`/disenchant`):** A separate GUI allows players to remove enchantments for a configurable refund.
-   **Powerful Admin Tools:**
    -   `/enchanter <player> <enchant> <level>`: Instantly apply any enchant.
    -   `/eshop reload`: Reload the config on the fly.
-   **Deep Configuration:** Control everything from costs, gamble chances, blacklisted enchants, and max level overrides to all messages and sounds.

---

## Installation ⚙️

**Important:** If updating from a previous version, you **must delete your old `config.json`** to allow the new gambling settings to generate.

1.  **Stop your server.**
2.  Download the latest `EnchantShop.jar` from the Modrinth page.
3.  **Install the dependencies:** You must have [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) and an economy plugin (like [EssentialsX](https://essentialsx.net/)) installed.
4.  Place all `.jar` files into your server's `/plugins` folder.
5.  **Start your server** to generate the new `config.json`.
6.  Edit the `config.json` to your liking, then use `/eshop reload`!

---

## How to Use 🎮

**For Players:**
-   `/eshop`: Hold an item to open the main menu, then choose "Enchant Item" or "Gamble Item".
-   `/disenchant`: Hold an enchanted item to open the disenchanting menu.

**For Admins:**
-   `/eshop reload`: Reloads the configuration file.
-   `/enchanter <player> <enchant> <level>`: Gives an enchant to a player.

---

## Configuration 🔧

You can configure every aspect of the shop in the `plugins/EnchantShop/config.json` file. The file is automatically generated with sane defaults.

```json
{
  "costFormula": "base_cost * (level * level)",
  "enchantmentBaseCosts": {
    "minecraft:sharpness": 1000.0,
    "minecraft:mending": 10000.0
  },
  "mainMenuTitle": "&8Main Menu",
  "successSound": "ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP",
  "failSound": "ENTITY_VILLAGER_NO",
  "gambleTickSound": "BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_HAT",
  "gambleWinSound": "ENTITY_FIREWORK_ROCKET_TWINKLE",
  "gambleLoseSound": "ENTITY_VILLAGER_DEATH",
  "gambleDoubleSound": "UI_TOAST_CHALLENGE_COMPLETE",
  "gambleChanceToWinPercent": 50,
  "gambleChanceForSecondEnchantPercent": 20,
  "messages": {
    "prefix": "&8[&6EnchantShop&8] &r",
    "gamble_no_enchants": "&cThe item you are holding must have at least one enchantment to gamble!",
    "gamble_win": "&a&lVICTORY! &fYour item has been enchanted with &e{enchant} {level}&f!",
    "gamble_win_extra": "&6&lJACKPOT! &fYou won an &eEXTRA&f random enchantment!",
    "gamble_lose": "&c&lDEFEAT! &fAll enchantments on your item have been &cWIPED&f!"
  },
  "perEnchantPermissions": false,
  "enchantmentBlacklist": [
    "minecraft:binding_curse"
  ],
  "maxLevelOverrides": {},
  "disenchantRefundPercentage": 50.0
}
```

---

## Permissions 🛡️

EnchantShop has a robust permission system for ultimate control.

-   **`enchantshop.disenchant`**: Allows use of the `/disenchant` command. (Default: true)
-   **`enchantshop.reload`**: Allows use of the `/eshop reload` subcommand. (Default: op)
-   **`enchantshop.enchanter`**: Allows use of the `/enchanter` admin command. (Default: op)
-   **`enchantshop.buy.<enchant_name>`**: Required to buy an enchant if `perEnchantPermissions` is enabled.
-   **`enchantshop.admin`**: A parent node that grants all administrative permissions.

---

## Join Our Community! 💬

Have a question, a suggestion, or just want to hang out? Join the official Duckalds' Mods Discord server! Click the banner below to join.

[![Join Our Discord!](https://discord.com/api/guilds/1399734531719692318/widget.png?style=banner2)](https://discord.gg/pWMgxggj)

title: DSEG7
description: Adds the DSEG7 font (by keshikan) that imitates a seven-segment display as a font and banner patterns.
body:
This mod adds the **[DSEG7 font by keshikan](https://www.keshikan.net/fonts-e.html) that imitates a seven-segment display**, as well as **43 banner patterns**: 39 based on the characters, and 4 for single segments that don't correspond to a character *(the remaining 3 individual segments are i, -, _)*.

The font can be used by any [JSON text](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Text_component_format) (it has id `dseg7:dseg7`), such as with the `/tellraw` or `/title` commands on in custom item names. If you have [Bookshelf](https://modrinth.com/mod/bookshelf-lib), you can also use the `/bookshelf font` command for easy uses.

The font supports:
* All 26 latin letters A to Z (upper and lowercase are displayed the same),
* All 10 arabic numerals 0 to 9,
* Dash (-), dot (.), colon (:), underscore (_) and degree (°).

**To get the banner patterns, craft the Banner Pattern item** and use it in a Loom, as you would with any other. It is crafted with one each of Paper, Redstone, and Glowstone.

![Screenshot of all 43 banner patterns.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jtToH2NW/images/51ebd072cb7a805f2a1204d1d006d0bc6e150eb3.png)

This was inspired by Darkhax's font mods, such as [Nyctography](https://modrinth.com/mod/nyctography).

title: Regius
description: Breed ball pythons in Minecraft using actual genetics!
body:
**Do you like collecting critters?**

Do you like breeding those critters to make prettier critters?



Regius is a mod that aims to re-create the ball python breeding hobby in Minecraft to a reasonable degree of realism, including a genetics system similar to (But more expansive than) vanilla's Pandas.



Don't know much about ball pythons or genetics? No problem! Regius includes an in-game guidebook, Ball Pythons and You, to help complete newcomers learn everything they need to know to use the mod. It can be crafted with a vanilla book and a piece of sphagnum moss.



### Sphagnum Moss ### 
Sphagnum moss is a plant that can be found growing occasionally in swamps. You can't grow more of it (yet!), but you can use it as decoration or compact it into a block and grow grass, flowers, etc in it! It can also be dried in a furnace, and then re-hydrated by placing it in water.



### Hollow Logs ###
You ball python will need something to crawl in! Hollow logs can be crafted from any vanilla wood by placing 8 logs in a ring on a crafting table. (Like the chest recipe)



### Ball Pythons ###
Ball pythons can be found in savannas, and then carried home with you in an empty bucket. On rare occasions, your new pet will have a special morph that makes it look different from most other ball pythons! If you have two pythons, you can breed them with raw rabbit meat and they have a chance of passing whatever morphs they have down to their children. (Some morphs are recessive however, so it won't always be immediately obvious that this has happened)



### Genetics ###
Regius currently includes three morphs: Albino (Recessive), pastel (Incomplete dominant), and pinstripe (dominant). That might not sound like a lot, but a dedicated breeder can create 11 different patterns with just these morphs! Genetics in Regius are simulated using a Punnett square system, so a baby ball python can carry genes from its parents that aren't immediately obvious!



### Coming in the Future ###
- Growable sphagnum moss
- Naturally generating hollow logs
- More customization with tags
- Dynamic python behavior (Hiding, basking, etc.)
- More morphs!

If you enjoy Regius, you should check out its inspirations: [Bettas](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bettas) and [Baby Fat](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/baby-fat)!

NeoBeta Remastered LTSC is the definitive experience for Minecraft purists who crave the authentic feel of the Beta era. Unlike its modern-looking counterpart, LTSC prioritizes legacy gameplay over visual polish. It’s lightweight, stable, and ideal for long-term survival worlds or servers that want to recapture the Beta spirit. body:
Ribbon is sunsetting with v0.3.2!

This plugin is no longer maintained and will not receive any updates.

If you want to continue using Ribbon, please fork the repository and maintain it yourself.

----

# Ribbon

Ribbon is a debug utility plugin for Paper.

*Support Minecraft Version: 1.21.4*.

## Function

- Instant game mode switching (Creative / Survival)
- OP toggle
- Toggle difficulty (Normal / Peaceful)

## Introduction

1. Download the latest version of Ribbon from [GitHub](https://github.com/m1sk9/Ribbon/releases/latest) or [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/project/ribbon).
2. Move the downloaded file to the `plugins` folder.
3. Start the server.

## Usage

Get items in `/ribbon`. Each item can be used by right-clicking or **shifting** right-clicking. Each item has a different effect.

### Notes

- Ribbon is a debugging tool. It is not recommended to use it in the production environment for the following reasons.
    - Ribbon is a debugging tool, so its usage is not restricted by permissions (to avoid installing permission management plugin).
    - It includes a function to easily switch OPs, etc.
    - Other functions specialized for debugging are included.
- Events for item use (`PlayerInteractEvent`, etc.) are given low priority so as not to interfere with other plugin processing.
- Ribbon is optimized for Paper. It is not guaranteed to work with other server software such as Spigot.

<summary>General Gameplay Help</summary>

**Dino revival**

To resurrect the dinosaurs you must first find their fossils. Some fossils will be generated near the surface, while some will be generated farther underground. You can also find the bone blocks required in the Boneyard dungeon.

Once you have acquired the necessary bones for the dino of your choice you must use various machines to bring them back to life, the recipes for which are in the recipe section. The required machines are:
- DNA Extractor
- DNA Splicer
- Egg Incubator

Once you have the egg block you must place it down somewhere, preferably with enough room not to suffocate the dinos when they hatch. It will take around 15 minutes to hatch.

**Scrap blocks**

Inside some structures, you will find scrap blocks. These are what you can find in the various scrap blocks.

Village
- Ricochet Ball
- Figure shards
- Greenana Tree Sapling
- Greenberrys
- Geed
- Random other stuff

Wizard
- Wizard clothing
- Neutral Spellbooks
- Greenberrys
- Geed
- Random other stuff

**Magic**

To do magic you must first obtain a magic staff. You can do so by defeating a dark wizard in a wizard tower basement. Once you have a depowered wizard staff you must bring it up to the wizard at the top of the tower where you can buy upgrades for your staff. The stronger your staff the better your spells will be, currently there are 3 tiers. 

While using a better staff will improve the spell, another way to make your spells better is by wearing wizard clothing. If you are wearing wizard clothing that aligns with the type of spell you are using, it will boost the spell power for that spell.

To use a spellbook put the book in your off hand, and hold your staff in your main hand. Then right-click to activate the spell. Currently, there are 16 spells, however, more are likely to be added eventually in the future.

This is a list of all the spellbooks you can obtain:

Water
- Water beam

- Water spout

Earth

- Sandstorm

Fire
- Flamethrower

Neutral

- Levitation

title: WAIAB
description: This resource pack allows you to rename a carved pumpkin to almost any item or block in Minecraft, changing its model to that of the chosen item or block and wear it on your hat
body:
# WAIAB: Wear All Items and Blocks!

**Ever wanted to wear a block of Diamond Ore on your head? With WAIAB, you can without needing the item itself!**

This resource pack allows you to rename a carved pumpkin to almost any item or block in the Game, changing its model to that of the chosen item or block.

If you want to remove the Pumpkin Blur and doesnt wanna use a resourcepack to remove it entirely i recommend this datapack of mine to remove the Pumpkin Blur per Item: 
- [No Pumpkin Overlay (Recipe)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/no-pumpkin-overlay-recipe)




**No mods required!** This resource pack uses the new possibilities of [Item Model Definitions](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Items_model_definition). Specifically, it utilizes [Component Value dependent](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Items_model_definition#component_2) item models and textures to dynamically change the pumpkin's appearance based on its name.

**Important Note for Block Items:**

For certain block items that have distinct item forms, you'll need to append "**Item**" to the name in the anvil. For example, to wear the item model of a Turtle Egg, rename the carved pumpkin to "**Turtle Egg Item**". This distinction is necessary to differentiate between the block model ("Turtle Egg") and its corresponding item model.

**See it in Action!**

![Animated GIF showcasing the resource pack in action. Renaming a carved pumpkin to "Flowering Azalea" changes its model accordingly.](https://i.imgur.com/Tb2lU62.gif)

title: ChestAlertPlugin
description:
Perfect for servers where you want to keep the thrill of conflict without protection plugins. Get notified when someone opens your chest and grant permissions to trusted players. Stay informed, stay in control!
DISCORD CHANNEL ADVISOR SUPPORT!
body:
# **Minecraft Chest Guard Plugin**

## **Overview**

The Minecraft Chest Guard Plugin is designed for servers that want to maintain the excitement of unprotected gameplay while offering essential notifications and permission controls. This plugin alerts you when someone opens or breaks your chests, and allows you to manage permissions for trusted players.

## **Features**

- **Chest Access Notifications**: Receive instant notifications when someone opens or breaks your chest.
- **Ownership Tracking**: Track and save chest ownership data, even after server restarts.
- **Permission Management**: Allow or revoke access to your chests for specific players.
- **Detailed Chest Logs**: View logs of who accessed your chests and when.

## **Installation**

1. **Download the Plugin**: Place the plugin JAR file in your server's `plugins` folder.
2. **Start the Server**: Start your Minecraft server to generate the necessary configuration files.
3. **Configure Settings**: Edit the `config.yml` file located in the `plugins/ChestGuard/` directory to adjust settings to your liking.

## **Configuration**

### **Discord Integration (Optional)**

To receive notifications on Discord:

1. Create a Discord bot and invite it to your server.
2. Copy the bot token and paste it into the `config.yml` file under the `discord` section.
3. Specify the channel ID where you want to receive notifications.

Example `config.yml`:
```yaml
discord:
  token: "YOUR_BOT_TOKEN"
  channel-id: "YOUR_CHANNEL_ID"
#TICKS BETWEEN THE SERVER CHECKS FOR CHEST THAT HAVE BEEN DESTROYED BUT NOT DETECTED 6000=5MINUTES
check-interval-ticks: 5000

title: AutoTorch
description: Do you have torch fatigue? Then AutoTorch is the solution.
body:
**Have you or your players had enough of placing torches when you are mining, exploring a cave or just wondering at night? Then this plugin is for you!**
## Main features:
- WorldGuard region support (don't place torches in build deny)
- Support Spigot/Paper 1.16.5+
- Torches can be taken from inventory, off hand or primary hand
- Torches can be placed at certain light levels with a radius
- Blacklist of blocks that torches can be placed on
- Boundaries for the y axis
- Place torches on walls
- Translate file for player-facing UI

## Permissions:
- autotorch.auto - Permits the player to turn on auto torch placing on and off
- autotorch.admin - Allows the player to view plugin information, reset the config, reset the list of players who have autotorch enabled and check for updates
- autotorch.* - All permissions listed above

## Commands:
- /at - Open the AutoTorch GUI where players can enabled/disable torch placing. They can also modify their settings.
- /ata - Plugin details

## Installation:
All you need to do is to download and copy the file into your plugins folder. If you need to configure anything you will first need to start up the server, then you can go into the AutoTorch folder where you can find global.yml (for settings that apply to all users) and player.yml where you can specify the player's default settings.

title: Laza Plaza Horror
description: Adventurous Modpack that features both realistic survival and horror aspects. Don't stay out in the night. Well optimized.
body:
Immerse yourself in a world where the boundaries between reality and nightmare blur with the Laza Plaza Horror Modpack for Minecraft. This meticulously crafted modpack combines the gritty realism of survival mechanics with spine-chilling horror elements, creating an unparalleled gaming experience.

**Hunger and Thirst:** Manage your character’s needs by finding and preparing food and sourcing clean water. Starvation and dehydration can be as deadly as the monsters lurking in the shadows.

**Haunting Atmosphere:** Navigate through dark, foreboding environments with eerie soundscapes that keep you on edge. The world around you is filled with ominous whispers and unsettling noises.

![The man from the fog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/483d0e122b968a8f5c998582b24b18a82500a2d0.png)

**Terrifying Creatures:** Encounter a variety of horrific entities, from The knocker, The man from the fog and Dwellers to Siren head and Slenderman. Each monster has unique behaviors and attack patterns, ensuring that no two encounters are the same.



**Dynamic sanity:** In addition to physical survival, you must also manage your mental health. Stay sane by finding sources of light, avoiding prolonged darkness, and taking breaks from the relentless tension. As your sanity declines, the world becomes more distorted and unpredictable.

**Hallucinations:** Low sanity levels lead to terrifying hallucinations. You might see fleeting shadows, hear disembodied voices, or encounter phantom enemies. These hallucinations blur the line between reality and delusion, making every moment fraught with uncertainty.

**Some of the featured mods:** Biomes of plenty, Tinker's construct, Farmer's delight, Security craft, Mr. Crayfish's gun mod, Born in chaos, Tough as nails, Dynamic sounds, Simple Voice chat, Sanity, Supplementaries, Corpse, Siren head, The knocker, The man from the fog, Slenderman, True herobrine, Cave dweller, Christmas dweller, etc.
