title: L18 Trim Runes
description: Unleash the power hidden within ancient armor trims! From now on, any armor customization that uses armor trims also bestows unique bonuses, ranging from minor special effects to major new abilities.
body:
Trim runes – datapack that adds a special thematic ability to each unique engraving you apply to your armor using trims, regardless of the material (but this may change in the future). At the moment there are 16 unique customization templates in the game which create a different pattern depending on the slot used by a piece of armor, a total of 16 * 4 = 64 designs at all... Which means 64 new features added by this datapack!

## A brief description for each set of trims and their effects:

<details>
<summary>Sentry</summary>

Helmet - illuminates pillagers and undead nearby.

Chestplate - strengthens the wearer if they take damage.
  
Leggings - if the wearer is sneaking, their next jump is boosted. 
 
Boots - speeds up the wearer if there are pillagers or undead nearby.  

</details>

<details>
<summary>Vex</summary>

Helmet - the wearer's gaze illuminates, slows and weakens creatures, consuming user experience in return.

Chestplate - keeps vexes away from the wearer and gains experience when enchanting (the faster the wearer enchants items, the more enchantment rolls on the table will be free, and some will start generating experience), along with the normal enchantment also enchants any books in the mainhand and offhand.

Leggings - the wearer floats up into the air if sneaking

Boots - the wearer's fall from a height high enough to take damage becomes smooth.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Wild</summary>

Helmet - grants the wearer night vision in the dark.

Chestplate - brings primal terror to aggroed mobs freezing them in place for a while (mobs like wolves, bees, endermans and zombie piglins) + consuming raw meat makes the wearer stronger and hungrier.

Leggings - grants invisibility to the wearer in the dark.

Boots - gives the wearer speed in the dark.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Coast</summary>

Helmet - at the cost of experience, creates a treasure map from a blank map in the wearer's mainhand.

Chestplate - while the wearer remains hydrated, grants them a shield, renewing it every few seconds (it is enough to be in water or just drink any potion/water).

Leggings - extinguishes fire underfoot, turns the layer of lava the wearer steps on into obsidian/stone, and also soaks concrete

Boots - Standing on sand speeds up the wearer.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Tide</summary>

Helmet - grants the wearer the conduit power

Chestplate - boosts the wearer depending on the ocean they are in.

Leggings - gives the wearer a dolphin's grace.

Boots - the wearer is almost gravity-defying underwater.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Dune</summary>

Helmet - the sun nourishes the wearer, restoring hunger (provided there are no obstacles above the wearer).

Chestplate - grants the wearer immunity to hunger and poison effects, as well as the ability to eat falling sand to strengthen, haste, and satiate them.

Leggings - teleports the wearer to the highest point in the world by pouring sand on themselves.

Boots - Standing on sand or sandstone, the wearer gains a shield that refreshes every few seconds.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Wayfinder</summary>

Helmet - Guides the wearer to nearby points of interest by creating a halo of colored spheres around them.

Chestplate - Replenishes the wearer's HP if he is wounded and has not taken damage for some time.

Leggings - Gains experience while traveling around the world.

Boots - Greatly speeds up the wearer as he walks on a dirt path.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Host</summary>

Helmet - Tames nearby animals if they have not been loyal to anyone before.

Chestplate - Anyone who damages the wearer will be attacked by nearby mobs capable of aggro.

Leggings - The wearer can use the leash to saddle any "rideable" animal.

Boots - Gives the wearer's mount speed and regeneration.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Raiser</summary>

Helmet - The wearer's gaze awakens the animal's instinct to breed.

Chestplate - The bearer does not waste bone meal as long as they have enough experience.

Leggings - By putting crop seeds in offhand, the wearer exchanges them for others randomly by experience.

Boots - If the wearer drops no more than 6 blocks, the wearer will not trample the farmland and will not take damage from falling on it.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Shaper</summary>

Helmet - Enlightens the wearer, granting them knowledge of all recipes.

Chestplate - The wearer's tools destroy blocks much faster (stacks with the beacon effect resulting in insta-mining deepslate).

Leggings - When crouching, the wearer pulls the nearest items to themselves.

Boots - If the wearer holds a scaffold in their offhand, it is automatically placed underneath them (if there is enough space).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Ward</summary>

Helmet - Senses vibrations of entities and items, giving the wearer a positioned sound to indicate the direction and type of object ( item/living creature).

Chestplate - Standing still, the wearer gains resistance to all types of damage.

Leggings - The shield in the wearer's offhand allows them to wipe out ALL projectiles in a certain area around them.

Boots - While the wearer is running, their next strike will be stronger.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Silence</summary>

Helmet - While holding Echo Shards in the main hand, the wearer can create a sonic boom while sneaking, spending 1 level and dealing significant damage to the area in front of them like a warden (requires a cooldown, after which the wearer will hear a distinctive sound).

Chestplate - Consuming the echo shards in the second hand, the wearer is healed rapidly + standing on a sculk infestation makes the wearer stronger, also making them immune to weakness and poison + damaging a creature infects it with a sculk disease, if the creature dies from the disease, the sculk infestation will explode.

Leggings - Standing on sculk infestation the wearer is immune to slowing and has increased speed (effects are enhanced if the wearer is sneaking).

Boots - Draws experience to the wearer + while standing on sculk infestation, the wearer becomes satiated, cleansing hunger + turns amethyst shards in the wearer's offhand into echo shards in exchange for 1 level.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Snout</summary>

Helmet - Eating golden carrots gives the wearer an absorption effect.

Chestplate - Absorbs gold nuggets in the offhand, generating a shield of gold and granting resistance to fire and haste if the wearer has gold hearts BUT immersion in water will destroy the gold hearts.

Leggings - The wearer does not waste fire charges as long as they have enough experience.

Boots - Standing on a Netherrak or a Nylium speeds up the wearer.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Rib</summary>

Helmet - Creatures near the wearer are subjected to an all-consuming withering when they take damage, this effect saturates the wearer and withers all afflicted as long as the wearer is nearby indefinitely.

Chestplate - Gives the wearer immunity to wither, as well as enhancing the wearer in proportion to the amount of HP they are missing.

Leggings - Damaging a creature, the wearer collects its blood in a bottle (if there is one in the offhand), this potion restores the wearer's HP and withers them.

Boots - Speeds up the wearer in proportion to the HP missing.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Eye</summary>

Helmet - Illuminates and slows down all invisible creatures around the wearer.

Chestplate - In darkness, the wearer is weak but fast, if the wearer is invisible, the wearer gains additional damage resistance + In light, the wearer is strong but slowed, if the wearer is invisible, the invisibility fades, creating a bright flash of light that burns the nearest creature.

Leggings - The wearer does not spend ender pearls as long as they have enough experience (also wearer heals on each throw).

Boots - An ender pearl thrown by the wearer while sneaking is unaffected by gravity and will teleport the wearer to itself if it doesn't hit an obstacle.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Spire</summary>

Helmet - The wearer does not waste chorus fruit as long as they have enough experience (also chorus fruit replenishes more saturation).

Chestplate - Eating chorus fruit grants the wearer a temporary shield + End crystals near the wearer are destabilized, healing them after a few seconds and disappearing without exploding (the crystals themselves are invulnerable during the countdown).

Leggings - If the wearer is sneaking, they become immobilized, weakened, blinded, but invulnerable.

Boots - Allows the wearer to avoid the void (for a while).

</details>

title: Buoyant
description: Makes items that shouldn't float; not.
body:
In Minecraft, all items float, yes, even that 21 ton gold block will float. This mod changes that, now, some items float, some don't, and everything in-between!

## Buoyancy Types
There are a few forms of buoyancy that can be seen in the game, they are shown here from most buoyant to least.
- Super Buoyant (think items that contain air, like a glass bottle)
- Buoyant (things that naturally float, such as wood)
- Neutral (Fall at a normal speed but don't come back up, this applies to all objects that aren't already under a tag, such as Bricks)
- Dense (These items fall at faster speeds and certainly don't come back, such as gold blocks)
- Super Dense (These items fall very quickly, such as bedrock and other unobtainables)
##
If you'd like to see a modded item changed from Neutral buoyancy or a Vanilla item changed from it's current buoyancy, you're free to either modify it using a Datapack or make a [Pull Request](https://github.com/dev-slayer/Buoyant/pulls).

title: Voicechat Utils
description: Utility plugin for Simple Voice Chat that adds group chats for players who don't use microphones!
body:
This (PaperMC-only) plugin adds a command for messaging other players in your current Simple Voice Chat group!

- ```/mg <message>``` -
This command forwards a message to the other users in your group, allowing for users who wish to not use a microphone but still use Simple Voice Chat's groups feature.

- ```/mgtoggle [<on|off>]``` -
This command toggles a mode where if you are in a group, all chat messages will be sent as `/mg` messages instead.

- Adds messages for when players join or leave a group which can be configured and disabled in the config.yml.

- Has support for prefixes and suffixes set by plugins such as Luckperms. Note: this requires the Vault plugin (can be found [here](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) or [here](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/vault))  to be installed to work.
  
Feel free to offer ideas, bug reports and feedback on the Discord channel!


<details>
  <summary>Permissions</summary>
  
  ```voicechatutils.chat.use``` - Use /mg
  
  ```voicechatutils.chat.spy``` - See messages from players using /mg
  
  
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Default Configuration</summary>
  
```
# Thanks for using Voicechat Utils by Its_Padar!
# https://modrinth.com/plugin/voicechat-utils

# Do not edit this unless you absolutely know what you are doing
CONFIG_VERSION: 2



# Whether /mg and /messagegroup should be enabled.
# true/false
enable_messagegroup: true

# Whether messages sent with /mg should be forwarded to everyone with the voicechatutils.chat.spy permission.
# true/false
enable_messagegroup_spying: false

# Customise the message sent to players from /mg.
# Use https://webui.advntr.dev/ to test what it looks like and help customise it with colours.
# <group> is replaced by the name of the group, <name> is replaced by the name of the player, and <message> is replaced by the message that is sent
messagegroup_text: <gray>[<group>]</gray> <prefix><<name>><suffix> <message>


# How messages should be sent to players if they join/leave a group
# chat - Send message in chat
# actionbar - Send message to the player's actionbar in the middle of the screen
# disable - Disable join/leave messages
join_leave_group_messages_mode: chat

# Customise the join/leave messages sent if join_leave_group_messages_mode is not set to disable
# Use https://webui.advntr.dev/ to test what it looks like and help customise it with colours.
# <group> is replaced by the name of the group, and <name> is replaced by the name of the player
join_group_message_text: <gray>[<group>]</gray> <green>+</green> <prefix><name><suffix>
leave_group_message_text: <gray>[<group>]</gray> <red>-</red> <prefix><name><suffix>


# Enable <prefix> and <suffix> being replaced by the prefix/suffix of the player.
# This requires the Vault API and a permissions plugin such as Luckperms to be installed to work!
# Vault can be found at https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/ or https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/vault
enable_prefix_suffix_support: true
```

  
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Planned Potential Features</summary>

  - toggle vc join leave messages?
  
  - create/manage group commands
    
  - broadcasting voice to all online players with simple voice chat
    
  - more moderation, eg a mute command /vc mute?

  - chat filtering (regexes, replacement and blocking)?
</details>

title: Nodewire
description: A Minecraft NeoForge 1.21.1 mod that replaces redstone with a node-based logic system. Build logic visually in an in-world editor, then export it as a reusable graph — across sub-level boundaries (Sable) and alongside Create + Create Aeronautics.
body:
#

Nodewire

A Minecraft NeoForge 1.21.1 mod that replaces redstone with a node-based logic system. Build logic visually in an in-world editor, then export it as a reusable graph — across sub-level boundaries (Sable) and alongside Create + Create Aeronautics.

## Features - **Visual node editor** opened on a placed Nodewire block. Pan, zoom, drag nodes, draw wires. - **Unified selection model** — nodes, groups, and comments share the same press / drag / marquee / Del / accent-border logic. Marquee selects all three kinds; drag on a selected item moves the whole selection (including group members and nested sub-groups) in one undoable step. - **Save & load graphs** to client-side files (`/nodewire-graphs/.snbt`) and reuse them between worlds. - **Node groups** — collapse parts of a graph into a reusable subgraph. Groups can be nested, saved as standalone templates, renamed inline (double-LMB), and live-synced when you edit the master template. - **Comments + wire labels** — annotate the editor with floating text boxes and label individual wires for legibility. - **Cross-sub-level logic** — designed to function across Sable sub-level boundaries (e.g., Aeronautics aircraft). Sable Companion provides safe no-op defaults so the mod runs without Sable installed. - **Create-friendly** — works alongside Create 6.0.10 + Ponder + Flywheel. Reads/writes Create wireless-redstone frequencies. - **Create Aeronautics integration** — `Aeronautics Input` node binds to per-block state (propeller RPM, burner signal, vent pressure, …) across ~33 channels on 7 block kinds. - **Tweaked Controllers integration** — `Controller Input` node binds gamepad axes/buttons to graph signals. ## Stack - Minecraft **1.21.1** + NeoForge **21.1.230** - Kotlin **2.0.20** + Kotlin for Forge (NeoForge) **5.5.0** - Build plugin: **`net.neoforged.moddev` 2.0.141** (ModDevGradle, non-legacy) - Java toolchain: **21** - Custom UI framework on top of **Compose runtime 1.7.0** (no Skiko, no AWT) + **Yoga** (AppliedEnergistics fork, rebuilt for Java 21) - Integrations: Sable (via Sable Companion), Create 6.0.10, Create Aeronautics 1.2.1, Tweaked Controllers 1.2.7, JEI, EMI ## In-game See [`docs/usage.md`](docs/usage.md) for the editing workflow, keybinds, node categories, and mod-integration details. ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 nitka

title: SRVInfo
description: A plugin that gives important info to ppl
body:
ServerInfo Plugin


ServerInfo is an intuitive and comprehensive Minecraft server information plugin designed to provide players with essential server details at their fingertips. With a focus on simplicity and customization, this plugin bridges the communication gap between server administrators and players by presenting important information in an organized, accessible format.

Key Features

📋 Server Details at a Glance

ServerInfo provides players with immediate access to crucial server information, including:

Server name and description

Current version and supported Minecraft client versions

Server rules and guidelines

Contact information for server staff

Important announcements

🧰 Custom Command Showcase

Server administrators can configure a list of essential commands that players should know, complete with descriptions and examples. This helps new players navigate your server ecosystem more effectively and reduces repetitive questions in chat.

📏 Server Rules Integration

Clearly communicate your server's rules to all players through a dedicated command. Rules are fully customizable through the configuration file and can be updated on-the-fly without server restarts.

🎨 Full Color Support

All messages support Minecraft color codes, allowing server owners to maintain consistent branding and create visually appealing information displays that match their server's aesthetic.

🔄 Live Configuration Reloading

Administrators can update the plugin's configuration without restarting the server, making it easy to keep information current and respond to changes in server structure or policies.

💼 Permission-Based Access

Control who can access different features of the plugin with a granular permission system, allowing staff members to reload configurations while restricting certain commands to specific player groups.


Why Choose ServerInfo?

User-Friendly Experience

ServerInfo was designed with both players and administrators in mind. The intuitive command structure makes it easy for players to find exactly what they need, while the straightforward configuration gives administrators flexibility without complexity.

Resource Efficiency

Built with performance in mind, ServerInfo has minimal impact on server resources. It loads quickly, responds instantly to commands, and doesn't create any unnecessary server lag.

Community Building

By providing clear information, ServerInfo helps create a more welcoming environment for new players. When players understand the rules, know how to use essential commands, and can easily find help, they're more likely to become active members of your community.

Seamless Integration

ServerInfo works alongside your existing plugins without conflicts. It enhances the player experience without changing fundamental gameplay aspects or interfering with other systems.


How to Use

Players can access information using simple commands:

/serverinfo - View main server information
/serverinfo help - Display available commands
/serverinfo rules - Show server rules
/serverinfo commands - List important commands
/serverinfo version - Display version information

The plugin also includes convenient aliases (/sinfo and /si) for faster access.

Technical Details

Compatible with Spigot, Paper, and other Bukkit-based servers

Supports Minecraft versions 1.20 and newer

Lightweight design with minimal performance impact

Extensive configuration options through YAML

Proper permission integration

Experience the difference clear communication makes on your server with ServerInfo - where information meets innovation.

title: Weight of Steel
description: Armor Weight system, mods compatible, configurable & cross platform mod
body:
# Weight of Steel

Weight of Steel is a lightweight armor-weight mod
It slows the player based on the actual weight of equipped armor.

## Features

- No vanilla `Slowness` effect.
- Speed reduction is applied through the player's real movement speed logic.
- Armor tooltip shows the weight used by the calculation.
- JSON config supports global tuning and per-item overrides.
- Modded armor can be tuned by exact item id such as `modid:custom_chestplate`.

## How it works

The mod calculates armor weight from the equipped pieces and converts it into a movement speed penalty.
By default it uses armor stats such as armor, toughness, and knockback resistance.
If an item has a manual override in the config, the custom value is used instead.

## Configuration


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Config file:

```text
config/armorweight.json
```

Example:

```json
{
  "showTooltip": true,
  "weightToSlowdown": 0.013,
  "maxSlowdown": 0.35,
  "toughnessWeight": 0.5,
  "knockbackWeight": 8.0,
  "itemOverrides": {
    "minecraft:netherite_chestplate": {
      "useCustomWeight": true,
      "customWeight": 25.0
    },
    "modid:custom_helmet": {
      "useCustomWeight": true,
      "customWeight": 7.5
    }
  }
}
```
Key fields:

- `showTooltip`: show weight in the item tooltip.
- `weightToSlowdown`: converts total weight into slowdown.
- `maxSlowdown`: hard cap for the speed penalty.
- `toughnessWeight`: extra weight taken from armor toughness.
- `knockbackWeight`: extra weight taken from knockback resistance.
- `itemOverrides`: per-item manual weights.

</details>

## Notes

- The mod is designed to work with modded armor too.
- New armor entries are synced into the config after launching the game.
- If the config becomes invalid, the mod recreates it and keeps a backup.

title: HeightBoxLib
description: Hitbox related Library that gets the entity's height!
body:
# HeightBoxLib
 Hitbox related library for Minecraft: Java Edition that gets the height of an entity's hitbox

## How to use
 Execute as either yourself or any other entity and run `hblib:util/get_height` or any of it's variants.
 You will get both the height of both the position of the entity's eye anchor and the entity's hitbox height (eye and out)
### Example of use: Making an entity face a torso of a player

```
##This is from the targetted entity
scoreboard players set #Player hblib.number 1
function hblib:util/get_height

##Full - Eye height
scoreboard players operation #Temp plate_havoc.temp = #Total hblib.number
scoreboard players operation #Temp plate_havoc.temp -= #Eye hblib.number
#Full /2
scoreboard players operation #Temp2 plate_havoc.temp = #Total hblib.number
scoreboard players operation #Temp2 plate_havoc.temp /= #2 plate_havoc.temp
#Halved + Temp
execute store result storage plate_havoc:custom torso double 0.01 run scoreboard players operation #Temp plate_havoc.temp += #Temp2 plate_havoc.temp

execute anchored eyes as 00000000-0000-0005-0000-0001000007e9 run function plate_havoc:game/misc/face_torso/execute with storage plate_havoc:custom
```

 ## Variants
 `hblib:util/get_height` | Gets height of entity's hitbox\
 `hblib:util/get_height_dy` | Height of entity's hitbox but subtracted by 0.01\
 `hblib:util/get_halved` | Height of entity's hitbox but halved\
 `hblib:util/get_height_specific_scale` | Needs a macro $(scale) to run. It gets the entity's hitbox but aims for a decimal point depending on the scale. Examples: (1=180.0, 2=360.0, 0.5=90.0, 0.01=1.8)\

title: Mini-game "Challenges"
description: This datapack will turn your world into a mini-game called "Challenges"
body:
<details>
<summary>RU</summary>
Все игроки получают различные челленджи, по типу: добыть предмет, съесть еду, убить моба и так далее. Задача же игроков - выполнить все эти челледжи за определённое время. Или же, если выбран соревновательный режим, просто выполнить как можно больше челленджей за определённое время.
  
Сама мини-игра понравиться тем, кто любит спидранить.

В этой мини-игре есть 2 режима:
1. Обычный - задача игроков выполнить заданное число челленджей за определённое время.
2. Соревновательный - игроки должны выполнить как можно больше челленджей за отведённое время.

В этой игре нет ограничения по игрокам и есть 2 варианта игры: Одиночный, где каждый сражается сам за себя; и Командный, в котором игроки могут сразиться в забегах 2x2, 3x3 или даже больше. Также, никто не запрещает и попробовать свои силы, сразившись одному против нескольких игроков!

Датапак имеет доступное меню настройки, вызываемое командой - _/function chall:settings_, запуск игры происходит из этого же меню. В самом меню выбираются: режим игры, настраивается время для забега (можно поставить -1 и тогда игра не закончится, пока не будут выполнены все челленджи, **ставить только в режиме "Обычный"!**), так же количество самих челленджей и несколько других настроек. **При выборе настроек крайне сильно рекомендую смотреть на все подсказки, там тоже есть важная информация.**

Если выданный челлендж был вами забыт, то пропишите _/trigger show_task_

Датапак полносью на русском

У датапака есть минус:
После завершения игры придётся пересоздавать мир, так как мир в котором вы только что играли, не сможет обновиться автоматически.

Но этот минус не настолько значительный, ведь одна игра затянет вас минимум на полтора часа.
(Да, это вызов, попробуй выполнить хотя бы 5 челленджей за менее 90 минут в обычном режиме)

Изначальная идея была взята у этого крутого ютубера:
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q4oSP3n50Xg&list=PLRqDngBSUxpwgHv2l-ZJqlG4AnHQkTNt9&index=7](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q4oSP3n50Xg&list=PLRqDngBSUxpwgHv2l-ZJqlG4AnHQkTNt9&index=7)

> ### Игровые изменения:
1. > Увеличен шанс выпадения черепов визер-скелетов (5%, +1,5% за каждый уровень добычи)
2. > Черепахи имеют шанс сбросить щиток при смерти (10%, +1,5% за каждый уровень добычи)
3. > Увеличен шанс выпадения шаблона "Прилив" с древних стражей (40%)
4. > Увеличен шанс выпадения яйца нюхача (40%)
5. > Шанс нахождения шаблона "Хранитель" в сундуках древнего города - 12,8%
6. > Шанс нахождения шаблона "Тишина" в сундуках древнего города - 6,4%
7. > Шанс нахождения шаблона "Рыло" в сундуках бастиона - 16,7%
8. > Шанс нахождения шаблона "Шпиль" в сундуках эндер города - 25%
9. > Шанс нахождения шаблона "Дебри" в сундуках джунглевого храма - 75%
10. > Шанс нахождения шаблона "Ребро" в сундуках незерской крепости - 20%
11. > Шанс нахождения шаблона "Страж" в сундуках аванпоста - 100%

</details>


<details>
<summary>EN</summary>
All players receive different challenges, by type: get an item, eat food, kill a mob, and so on. The task of the players is to complete all these challenges in a certain amount of time. Or, if the competitive mode is selected, just complete as many challenges as possible in a certain amount of time.
  
The mini-game itself will appeal to those who like to speedrun.
  
There are 2 modes in this mini game.:
1. Regular - the task of the players is to complete a set number of challenges in a certain time.
2. Competitive - players must complete as many challenges as possible in the allotted time.

There is no player limit in this game and there are 2 game options: Single Player, where everyone fights for themselves; and Team, in which players can compete in 2x2, 3x3 or even more races. Also, no one forbids you to try your hand by fighting one against several players!

The datapack has an accessible settings menu, called by the command - _/function call:settings_, the game is launched from the same menu. In the menu itself, you can select: the game mode, the time for the race is set (you can set -1 and then the game will not end until all the challenges are completed, **set only in the "Normal" mode!**), as well as the number of challenges themselves and several other settings. **When choosing settings, I strongly recommend looking at all the tips, there is also important information there.**

If you forgot the issued challenge, then write _/trigger show_task_

The datapack is completely in Russian

The datapack has a disadvantage:
After completing the game, you will have to recreate the world, since the world you just played in will not be able to update automatically.

But this disadvantage is not so significant, because one game will drag you out for at least an hour and a half.
(Yes, it's a challenge, try to complete at least 5 challenges in less than 90 minutes in normal mode)

The original idea was taken from this cool YouTuber:
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q4oSP3n50Xg&list=PLRqDngBSUxpwgHv2l-ZJqlG4AnHQkTNt9&index=7](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q4oSP3n50Xg&list=PLRqDngBSUxpwgHv2l-ZJqlG4AnHQkTNt9&index=7)

> ### Game changes:
1. > Increased chance of dropping wither-skeleton skulls (5%, +1.5% for each looting level)
2. > Turtles have a chance to drop their scute when they die (10%, +1.5% for each looting level)
3. > Increased chance of getting the "Tide" pattern from the Elder Guardians (40%)
4. > Increased chance of sniffer egg drop (40%)
5. > The chance of finding the "Ward" template in the chests of the ancient city is 12.8%
6. > The chance of finding the "Silence" pattern in the chests of the ancient city is 6.4%
7. > The chance of finding the "Snout" pattern in bastion's chests is 16.7%
8. > The chance of finding the "Spire" template in the chests of ender City is 25%
9. > The chance of finding the "Wild" template in the chests of the jungle temple is 75%
10. > The chance of finding the "Rib" template in the chests of the Nether fortress is 20%
11. > The chance of finding the "Sentry" template in the outpost chests is 100%

</details>

title: When Pigs Fly 「猪萝纪」
description: A wildly absurd adventure that completely defies the laws of gravity! 一场彻底颠覆重力法则的荒诞冒险！
body:
## Remember to Download Resource Pack: 记得下载资源包：[When Pigs Fly RP](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/when-pigs-fly-rp)

### From 1.5 :
**Technoblade** joined the game  
**Enchanted Golden Carrot** joined the game

## **Datapack Introduction: "When Pigs Fly"**  
—— A wildly absurd adventure that completely defies the laws of gravity! Watch as Minecraft’s mounts, villagers, and even creepers break free from Earth’s pull and embark on a hilarious journey of airborne chaos!  

### ✨ **Classic Features**  
1. **Disturbing Dreams: Villagers Take Flight**  
   When you sneak up on **a sleeping villager**, they will instantly launch out of bed! Is it a prank or magic? Either way, they won’t be sleeping tonight…  

2. **Teamwork Makes the Float Work**  
   When you approach **a teammate (or any other player)**, cooperative adventure? No—cooperative floating! Hold hands and enjoy the view from above!  

3. **Mounts Hover Gracefully**  
   While **riding any creature (pigs, horses, llamas, even skeleton horses)**, both the mount and the player enter "light-step mode"—slow, floating movement! Say goodbye to running and hello to elegant aerial strolls!  

4. **Floating Creeper: Explosions Leave Clouds**  
   If **a levitating creeper explodes**, it doesn’t just vanish—it leaves behind a **lingering area effect cloud**! Any creature (including players) touching this cloud will continue to float… triggering a chain reaction of airborne danger!  

5. **And more...**  
- Player approaches a pig → Both float (Pig: "**I’m flying, what about you?**")  
- Creature approaches player → Triggers levitation (Creeper: "**I look cooler exploding mid-air!**")  
- Creature hit by an arrow → Immediately ascends (Hit a Blaze? **It becomes a moving target!**)  

### 🎯 **Advancement Overview**

| Advancement Name | Icon | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **When Pigs Fly** | Pig Spawn Egg | That's what'll happen |
| **Pig Feed** | Carrot | Eat 'em all |
| **Rudder** | Carrot on a Stick | Why did you make that? |
| **UFO** | Creeper Head | Suspended Explosive |
| **Gold Rush** | Flint | All that glitters is not gold |
| **Sss...Sss...Sss...** | Gunpowder | BOOM!!! |
| **I'm Hit!** | Skeleton Skull | Tell my pig I love her... |
| **Bow** | Bow | Nothing special |
| **Arrow of Magic** | Arrow of Levitation | Recyclable |

<details>
<summary>Hidden Advancements</summary>

| Advancement Name | Icon | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **The Wonderful Adventures of Nils** | Saddle | As you could imagine |
| **Chaos Combo** | Golden Carrot | Hit a Creeper when riding a pig |
| **Visiting Relatives** | Crimson Nylium | Ride a pig into the Nether |
| **Unwelcome Guest** | Piglin Head | Hit by Hoglins, Piglins, Piglin Brutes, Zoglins & Zombified Piglins |
| **Interstellar** | Damaged Elytra | Ride a pig into the End |
| **It doesn't hurt at all** | Enchanted Golden Carrot | Hit by Shulkers when riding a Pig |

</details>

### 🌟 **Design Highlights**  
- **Multiple Triggers**: Sleeping, riding, exploding, approaching… every interaction might send you skyward!  
- **Physics Defied**: Villager wakefulness becomes lift, creeper explosions leave "float clouds"—science? Not here!  
- **Multiplayer Mayhem**: Prank teammates, scare villagers, ride pigs into the sky—perfect for server shenanigans and explosive entertainment!  

### 🐷 **Author’s Note**  
> "This datapack proves it:  
> In **Minecraft**, not only can’t **Newton’s coffin** stay closed—it gets **blown sky-high** by creepers!  
> Welcome to the **absurd world** where everything can float!"  

---

**Supported Versions**: Minecraft Java Edition 1.14+  
**Installation**: Place the datapack into your world’s `datapacks` folder and restart the game.  
**Warning**: Watch out for floating creepers—they might **explode on your roof**!  

---

### 自1.5起：
**Technoblade**加入了游戏  
**附魔金胡萝卜**加入了游戏

## 数据包介绍：**「猪萝纪」（When Pigs Fly）**  
—— 一场彻底颠覆重力法则的荒诞冒险！让 Minecraft 的坐骑、村民甚至苦力怕都摆脱地心引力，开启空中乱舞的爆笑旅程！

### ✨ **经典特性**  
1. **惊扰美梦：村民飞天**  
   当你悄悄靠近**正在睡觉的村民**，村民会瞬间从床上弹射起飞！是恶作剧还是魔法？反正今晚他不用睡觉了……  

2. **队友同心，齐力升天**  
   当你接近**队友（或其他玩家）**，合作冒险？不，是合作飘浮！——快手拉手一起俯瞰大地吧！  

3. **坐骑凌波微步**  
   **骑乘任意生物（猪、马、羊驼甚至骷髅马）** 时，坐骑与玩家将进入“凌波微步”模式——缓慢飘浮移动！从此代步不再是奔跑，而是优雅的空中漫步！  

4. **漂浮苦力怕：爆炸留云**  
   如果**漂浮的苦力怕被引爆**，它不会普通消失——而是留下一片 **持续漂浮的区域效果云**！任何接触这片云的生物（包括玩家）都会继续飘浮……连锁反应，空中危机四伏！ 
5. **还有更多……**  
- 玩家靠近猪 → 双方漂浮（猪：“**我飞了，你呢？**”）  
- 生物靠近玩家 → 触发漂浮（苦力怕：“**我飘着炸更帅！**”）  
- 生物被箭射中 → 立即升空（射中烈焰人？**它变身移动标靶！**）  

### 🎯 **进度体系**  

| 进度名称 | 图标 | 描述 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **猪萝纪** | 猪刷怪蛋 | 命中注定 |
| **猪饲料** | 胡萝卜 | 全部吃掉 |
| **方向舵** | 胡萝卜钓竿 | 你为什么要做那个？ |
| **不明飞行物** | 苦力怕头颅 | 悬浮爆炸物 |
| **淘金热** | 燧石 | 闪光的未必都是金子 |
| **嘶...嘶...嘶...** | 火药 | 砰！！！ |
| **我中箭了！** | 骷髅头 | 告诉我的猪我爱她…… |
| **弓** | 弓 | 平常之物 |
| **魔法之箭** | 漂浮箭矢 | 可回收物 |

<details>
<summary>隐藏进度</summary>

| 进度名称 | 图标 | 描述 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **尼尔斯骑猪旅行记** | 鞍 | 如你所愿 |
| **大杂烩** | 金胡萝卜 | 骑猪时击中苦力怕 |
| **走亲访友** | 绯红菌岩 | 骑猪进入下界 |
| **不速之客** | 猪灵头颅 | 被疣猪兽、猪灵、猪灵蛮兵、僵尸疣猪兽和僵尸猪灵攻击 |
| **星际穿越** | 损坏的鞘翅 | 骑猪进入末地 |
| **一点也不疼** | 附魔金胡萝卜 | 骑猪时被潜影贝攻击 |

</details>


### 🌟 **设计亮点**  
- **多重触发机制**：睡眠、骑乘、爆炸、靠近……每种交互都可能让你离开地面！  
- **物理法则崩坏**：村民起床气化作升力，苦力怕爆炸留下“浮力云”，科学？不存在的！  
- **多人欢乐联动**：坑队友、吓村民、骑猪飞天——服务器整蛊必备，节目效果爆棚！  

### 🐷 **作者吐槽**  
> “这个数据包证明了：  
> 在**Minecraft**，**牛顿的棺材板**不仅盖不上，还会被苦力怕**炸上天**！  
> 欢迎来到——万物皆可浮空的**离谱世界**！”

---

**适用版本**：Minecraft Java版 1.14+  
**安装方式**：将数据包放入存档的 `datapacks` 文件夹，重启游戏即可生效。  
**注意**：小心漂浮的苦力怕——它们可能会**在你的屋顶上爆炸**！

#### Installation:
- Put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/saves/[Your World Here]/datapack" folder.
- ***DO NOT put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/resourcepacks" folder.***
- If you changed where Minecraft loads from, find that location and use that "saves" folder.
- For servers, put it in your world folder that matches where your server.properties file says.

- IF you want to store it in your ".minecraft" folder, CREATE a folder called "datapack" and put it there.
- From there, when you create a world and go to add datapacks, you can simply go to this folder and grab what you need.

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)
  - Special Note: as of 5.5.0 (1.21.9), pack formating now has minor versions. All minor versions for any given major versions are intended to fully compatible (i.e. - 88.0, 88.1, etc.) and listed as only the major version (i.e. - 88).
- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

Major breaking changes to each version:
 - 2.0.0 MC 1.17: Advancement Format change - custom recipe "condition" ("items")
 - 3.0.0 MC 1.20.5: Recipe Format change - recipe "result"
 - 4.0.0 MC 1.21: Folder Name change

title: ChatPing
description: Plays a sound for the player if someone sends a message with the player's name
body:
## English

**ChatPing Mod** is a lightweight Fabric server-side mod for **Minecraft 1.21.8-.10**.  
When a player is mentioned, plays a sound to a specific player; the mod also supports `@everyone`.

### Features
- If a message contains a player’s nickname → only that player hears a sound.
- If a message contains `@everyone` → all online players hear the sound.
- Ping also works in **private messages** (`/w`, `/tell`, `/msg`).
- Works fully **server-side** — players don’t need to install the mod on their client.

---

## Русский

**ChatPing Mod** — это лёгкий серверный мод для Fabric (**Minecraft 1.21.8-.10**).  
Когда упомянут игрок, мод воспроизводит звук для конкретного игрока; также поддерживается `@everyone`.

### Возможности
- Если сообщение содержит ник игрока → звук услышит только он.
- Если сообщение содержит `@everyone` → звук услышат все онлайн игроки.
- Пинг также работает в **личных сообщениях** (`/w`, `/tell`, `/msg`).
- Работает полностью **на стороне сервера** — игрокам не нужно устанавливать мод.

title: Copper Kit
description: A simple mod to add more stuffs to do with copper
body:
The Copper Tools & Armor Mod expands the early-game Minecraft experience by introducing a comprehensive set of copper-based tools and armor. This mod addresses the often underutilized resource of copper, giving it a practical and appealing purpose beyond decorative blocks and lightning rods.

![Gear](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08494887f28fb70bf5105e884d783d7e51a6c885.png)

This mod adds:

1. Copper Tools: A full set of tools, including a sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, and hoe, all crafted from copper ingots. These tools offer a tier between wood and stone, providing a smoother progression in the early game. Copper tools are slightly more durable than wooden tools and offer faster mining speeds, bridging the gap before stone tools are readily available.
   
2. Copper Armor: A complete set of copper armor, consisting of a helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots. This armor provides a decent level of protection, again fitting between leather and iron armor. It offers a stylish, reddish-brown alternative to other early-game armor options.
3. This mod fills a noticeable gap in the early game, providing players with a useful stepping stone between wood and stone/iron, also it gives copper a valuable purpose, making it more than just a decorative resource.

4. The copper armor provides a distinct visual style, offering a refreshing change from the standard early-game options, and is designed to be lightweight and compatible with most other mods, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable gameplay experience.

title: SL(SimpleLog)
description: Server logs become easier to read.
body:
# SimpleLog　plugin
A lightweight and straightforward logging plugin for Spigot/Paper servers, designed to keep a clear and organized record of server activities.

## Overview
SimpleLog is a simple, "drop-and-play" plugin that automatically logs key server events into well-structured text files. It's designed for server administrators who need an easy way to monitor player activities and server health without the complexity of larger plugins. Once installed, it runs silently in the background, requiring no configuration.

# Features
- Player Connection Logging: Records every time a player joins or leaves the server.

- Chat Logging: Captures all public player chat messages.

- Command Logging: Logs all commands executed by players.

- Warning Logging: Captures and saves all [WARN] messages from the server console.

- Kill Logging: It allows you to easily grasp who was killed, where, and under what circumstances.

- Organized File Structure: Automatically organizes logs into separate folders (join-left, chat, command, warn).

- Daily Log Files: Creates a new log file for each day, named with the current date (e.g., 2025-08-28.log).

- High Compatibility: Built for Minecraft 1.21.x and compatible with Spigot, Paper, and Bukkit.

- Zero Configuration: No setup required. Just drop it into your plugins folder and it works.

## Installation
1. Download the latest SimpleLog-vX.X-x.jar from the Releases page.

2. Place the downloaded .jar file into your server's /plugins directory.

3. Restart or reload your server. The plugin will automatically generate the required folders and start logging.

## Log File Structure
All logs are stored within the plugins/SimpleLog/ directory. The structure is as follows:


```
plugins/
└── SimpleLog/
    ├── chat/
    │   └── 2025-08-28.log
    ├── command/
    │   └── 2025-08-28.log
    ├── join-left/
    │   └── 2025-08-28.log
    └── warn/
　　│   └── 2025-08-28.log
    └── kill/
        └── 2025-08-28.log
```

Log Formats
Each log entry is formatted for easy reading and parsing.

- ```join-left/YYYY-MM-DD.log```

```join-player:uuid-time```
```left-player:uuid-time```
- ```chat/YYYY-MM-DD.log```

```player:uuid-time-message```
- ```command/YYYY-MM-DD.log```

```player:uuid-time-command```
- ```warn/YYYY-MM-DD.log```

```HH:mm:ss-The full warning message from the console.```
- ```kill/YYYY-MM-DD.log```
```player:uuid by cause-time-coordinates```

# ChatQuiz
> ChatQuiz transforms the way players interact on your Minecraft server by giving them fun and engaging global chat quizzes that make chatting more interactive and rewarding. The plugin introduces simple math questions focused on addition and subtraction, presenting them to all online players at configurable intervals. Players who answer correctly are rewarded with Vault-based currency, giving them a tangible incentive to participate. Winners receive their reward privately while the correct answer announcement is broadcasted to everyone, keeping the experience fair and exciting. Questions, rewards, quiz intervals, and timeout settings are fully configurable in config.yml, making the plugin flexible and easy to manage. Server owners are automatically notified in-game whenever a new version of the plugin is available, keeping them up to date with the latest improvements and fixes. This ensures that ChatQuiz remains compatible, enjoyable, and fun over time. # Pre-Alpha v1.1.1 Painting Textures

### Just a small and simple texture pack that replaces the _"Seaside"_ & _"The Stage Is Set"_ paintings with their original textures, which were changed in Alpha v1.1.1.
### 
This started with me browsing the Minecraft wiki and discovering that these two paintings had a different texture when they were first added. I really dislike how the _"Seaside"_ painting looks like, so when I saw that it had an original version, which in my eyes fixes all that is wrong with it and resembles the original painting by Zetterstrand more closely, I had to make a simple texture pack to have it replaced. This lead me to deciding to do the same with _"The Stage Is Set"_ painting, and eventually publish them here, just in case someone else wants to bring back these relics. An afternoon well spent!

# 🌑 SOULIFIED CREEPER OVERHAUL

Dark Souls difficulty addon for **Creeper Overhaul** mod. All 15 biome variants get permanent charged state + tier-based buffs.

---

## ⚠️ REQUIREMENTS

**Both required:**
1. **Creeper Overhaul Mod** 
2. **Soulified** & **Soulified Creeperoverhaul** (base datapack OR mod - required)

---

## 💥 WHAT IT DOES

**15 Creeper Variants Enhanced:**

### 🔥 **All Variants Get:**
- **Permanently Charged** - 2x explosion radius (~12 blocks)
- **+50% HP** - 20→30 health (harder to kill)
- **Speed I** - Faster approach and pursuit
- **Resistance I-II** - Takes less damage from attacks

### 🌡️ **Biome-Specific Adaptations:**
- **Desert/Badlands:** Fire Resistance II (lava immunity)
- **Ocean/Beach:** Dolphin's Grace (faster swimming)
- **Cave/Dripstone:** Night Vision (sees in darkness)
- **All Others:** Standard buffs

**Variants:** Badlands, Beach, Birch, Cave, Dark Oak, Desert, Dripstone, Hills, Jungle, Mushroom, Ocean, Savanna, Snowy, Spruce, Swamp

---

## 📥 INSTALLATION

1. Install Creeper Overhaul mod in mods folder
2. Install Soulified Datapack OR Mod in datapacks OR mods folder
3. Place `soulified_creeperoverhaul` in datapacks OR mods folder
4. Run `/reload` in-game (only for the datapack versions of soulified)

---

## 🐛 TROUBLESHOOTING

- **Creepers not charged?** Verify Creeper Overhaul mod is installed
- **Explosions normal size?** Charged = 2x radius (~12 blocks)
- **Works on servers?** Yes, install mod + both datapacks
- **All Soulified projects are datapacks but also packaged as a mod for convenience of not using a datapack loader like openloader etc So be sure to use all the datapack versions or all mod versions**

---

title: LilWorlds
description: LilWorlds is a performant, modern world management plugin for Minecraft servers.
body:
# 🌍 LilWorlds - Advanced World Management

**A performant and modular world management plugin for Minecraft servers supporting versions 1.16 to 1.21.6.**

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🌍 **World Management**
- **Create worlds** with custom environments and generators
- **Clone existing worlds** with all their data
- **Load/unload worlds** dynamically
- **Import external worlds** seamlessly
- **Universal spawn system** for cross-world teleportation

### 📦 **Separate Inventories**
- **Per-world/group inventories** - Players can have different inventories in different worlds
- **World groups** - Share inventories between worlds in the same group
- **Configurable separation** - Choose what to separate: inventory, health, experience, gamemode, flight, effects, location, ender chest

### ⚡ **Performance Focused**
- Optimized world loading/unloading
- Asynchronous operations where possible
- Minimal server impact
- Rate limiting protection

### 🔧 **Modular Design**
- Custom generator system with YAML configuration
- Complete configuration options
- PlaceholderAPI integration
- bStats metrics integration

---

## 🎮 Commands

### World Commands (`/world` or `/w`)
```
/world create <name> [environment] [-g generator]  # Create new world
/world clone <source> <target>                     # Clone existing world
/world load [world]                                # Load world(s)
/world unload [world]                              # Unload world(s)
/world import <name> [environment]                 # Import external world
/world setspawn                                    # Set world spawn
/world setuniversalspawn                           # Set universal spawn
/world info [world]                                # Show world information
/world list                                        # List all worlds
```

### Plugin Commands (`/worlds`)
```
/worlds reload [target]                            # Reload plugin components
/worlds inventory <action>                         # Manage separate inventories
/worlds groups <action>                            # Manage world groups
```

---

## 🛠️ Custom Generators

Create custom world generators using YAML files in the `generators/` folder:

```yaml
display-name: "Custom Flat World"
type: "FLAT"
generate-structures: true
biomes: ["PLAINS", "FOREST"]
layers:
  - "minecraft:bedrock"
  - "minecraft:stone:5"
  - "minecraft:dirt:3"
  - "minecraft:grass_block"
```

---

## 📊 Separate Inventories System

Advanced inventory separation system allowing players to have different inventories in different worlds or world groups:

```yaml
features:
  separate-inventories:
    enabled: true
    separate:
      inventory: true
      health: true
      experience: true
    world-groups:
      survival: ["world", "world_nether", "world_the_end"]
      creative: ["creative_world", "build_world"]
```

---

## 🔗 PlaceholderAPI Support

Extensive placeholder support for integration with other plugins:

- `%lilworlds_current_world%` - Current world name
- `%lilworlds_total_worlds%` - Total loaded worlds
- `%lilworlds_world_players_<world>%` - Players in specific world
- And many more...

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.16 - 1.21.5 (Bukkit/Spigot/Paper)
- **Java**: 8 or higher
- **Dependencies**: None (PlaceholderAPI optional)

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

1. Download and place in `plugins/` folder
2. Restart server
3. Create your first world: `/world create myworld`
4. Enable separate inventories: `/worlds inventory enable`
5. Configure in `plugins/LilWorlds/config.yml`

---

## 📚 Links

- **[📖 Documentation](https://hydr4.mintlify.app/lilworlds)** - Complete guides and tutorials
- **[💬 Discord](https://discord.gg/phVzDFAZ3v)** - Community support
- **[🐛 Issues](https://github.com/QQuantumBits/LilWorlds/issues)** - Bug reports and feature requests
- **[⭐ GitHub](https://github.com/QQuantumBits/LilWorlds)** - Source code and releases

---

**LilWorlds** - Making world management simple, fast, and powerful.

title: World TP Plus
description: World TP Plus is a lightweight Paper plugin that enhances the vanilla /TP command by allowing you to teleport across dimensions/worlds. Use an optional fourth argument to teleport to the Overworld, Nether, or End with the same coordinates.
body:
---

**🌍 World TP Plus**
**A simple cross-dimension teleport plugin for Paper 1.21+**

**By RetroSapien**

---

**✨ Features**

* Extends `/tp <x> <y> <z> [dimension]` with an optional 4th argument:

  * `overworld` *(default)*
  * `nether`
  * `end`
* Fully preserves vanilla `/tp` behavior and permissions when no dimension is specified
* Tab completion for dimensions
* Friendly error message for unknown dimensions
* Works from both console and in-game

---

**📋 Usage Examples**

* `/tp 0 80 0`
  → Vanilla teleport in current world

* `/tp 0 80 0 nether`
  → Teleport to same coords in the Nether

* `/tp Steve 10 70 10 end`
  → Teleport player "Steve" to coords in the End

---

**🔐 Permissions**

* `minecraft.command.tp` *(same as vanilla)*
  Requires permission level 2

---

**⚙️ Requirements**

* **Java 21+**
* **Paper 1.21+**
  Works on forks that support the Paper API

---

**📦 Installation**

1. Drop the JAR into your `plugins/` folder
2. Restart or reload your server

---

**🔗 Links**

* Discord for support : [https://discord.gg/tHeFGB7Et4](https://discord.gg/tHeFGB7Et4)

title: Erdmen's Quest 2
description: Tough Enemies, Special Experienceable Sword and Shield.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/lWElwY9g8wE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


**Quest Village**

Find the "Quest Village" that spawns on the surface. In this village, there are 3 different Quester NPCs and tower guards that shoot arrows at hostile Minecraft mobs. Check with one of the 3 Quester to receive your first task. The first quest is fixed. Place the 4 items requested by the Quester in their respective slots to receive the quest book.

**Quest Book**

With the quest book, there are two different types of quests that you can obtain from the second Quester in exchange for Quest Gold: Item Quest and Quest Trial.

Quest Gold can drop from any hostile mob with a certain chance. The higher the maximum health of the mob, the more gold it may drop.
Item Quest
When you receive an Item Quest using the quest book, you will be shown 3 items that you need to collect. Once you place these items in the quest book's inventory section, they grant XP to the book. These XP can then be transferred to special items—the Quest Sword and Quest Shield—from the third Quester. As you gather more XP, these special items will level up.

**Quest Trial**

When you accept a Quest Trial, a random trial coordinate is assigned. A compass appears in your quest book, which only shows the direction when you're facing close to the trial's location. By heading in the correct direction, a staircase will generate that takes you to the Quest Trial area (even if you're flying, the staircase can appear from the world height limit and descend! 😄).
If Quest Book's compass If it points towards your base,move on low coordinates or move away immediately and get the Trial quest again. 

**Quest Sword**

The Quest Sword is a powerful sword that, with a certain chance, fires a tornado that pulls in all mobs around it. As the tornado moves further away, it drags mobs with it and deals continuous, low damage. The chance to fire a tornado increases as the sword levels up. Each time you kill an entity with the sword, there is a small chance to gain 1 Sword XP. Defeating certain bosses like the Winged Panda, Winged Boss, Dark Wander, or Boss Wander grants extra XP.

There are also mob-killing quests associated with the Quest Sword. When you kill the specified mob using the sword, you gain extra Sword XP. Every time you kill a mob, there is a 20% chance that the target mob and the reward amount will change randomly.

**Quest Shield**

The Quest Shield is a durable magical shield. When used in your main hand, there is a chance to summon a "Decoy Man" with 4 hearts of health. The Decoy Man distracts all hostile mobs targeting you and draws their attention to itself. As the Quest Shield levels up, the chance to summon a Decoy Man increases, and the summoned decoy gains higher levels of health and resistance effects (the decoy always has a fixed level 1 regeneration effect).

When the Quest Shield is in your off-hand, there is a small chance to gain 1 Shield XP for every blocked attack.

**Quest Trial Mobs**

TrialGuard

TrialGuard appears frequently in Quest Trial room. Has high health. Rarely, it can also spawn in the dark.

Winged Panda
The Winged Panda appears frequently in Quest Trial rooms. It uses a tornado attack similar to the Quest Sword, pulling you in and dealing damage. The tornado disappears after some time, or you can break free by attacking it.

Dark Wander
The Dark Wander is one of the most annoying mobs in Minecraft's history and appears frequently in Quest Trial rooms. When it targets you, it teleports behind you and leaves cursed items in your inventory. These cursed items give you negative potion effects as long as they remain in your inventory.

Winged Boss
The Winged Boss has a 7% chance to spawn in Quest Trial rooms. It rapidly fires multiple tornado attacks. If you’re unprepared, you’ll likely spend your time flying against walls trying to avoid them. It has a 20% chance to drop the Quest Sword.

Boss Wander
The Boss Wander has a 7% chance to spawn in Quest Trial rooms. It teleports behind you and leaves dangerous items in your inventory. Additionally, it summons powerful mobs each time it teleports.

Zemoria

This mob has totem of undying. After using this mob totem, it can recreate its totem in a short time. (every tick %2 chance)

Bossemoria

It does not drop special items yet, it gives high xp to quest sword. (every tick %2,6 chance it can recreate its totem)

title: CloudUtilities

body:
# CloudUtilities

A Minecraft velocity/paper plugin providing useful utilities for running the CloudCraft network.

## Download info

> Note:
> Depends
> on [CloudCore](https://modrinth.com/project/cloudcore).

## Content

### Content: Paper

- Disabling PvP using `/allowpvp`
- Toggling fly mode using `/fly`
- Replying to incoming/outgoing messages using `/reply`
- Temp-banning players with `/tempban` or ip addresses with `/tempban-ip`
- Configurable broadcast message when the night gets skipped

### Content: Velocity

- `/hub`/`/lobby`/... command for leaving to server lobby
- `/ping` command for checking player to server latency
- Internal `/connect` command for connecting to temporary backend servers
- Internal `/loop` command for repeating a phrase or command multiple times
- Configurable animated tablist footer and header
- Configurable supported versions shown in server list on ping

## Usage

Just drop the specific paper/velocity jar in the `plugins` directory and restart the server.

![Immersive Valley](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/adce9207d2379ccb1926e857a4c19c68928bf674.png)

**_A compilation of mods for singleplayer gameplay improvement, optimizations included._**

## Improved and optimized graphics
![Nether with shaders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4f4ced14341b880693dce0021c748834c87485d.jpeg)
It was _essential_ to include mods that **improve graphics** and **optimize** the game's rendering and frames.

Popular graphics and optimization mods were featured such as Sodium, Iris Shaders Entity Culling and etc.

Shaderpack _**Complimentary Shaders**_ is installed with custom configurations included!


## Increased immersion
![Pillager with animations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a56c78b0a521cf40226af107a92db8b2b4f9e780.jpeg)
The _vision_ for this modpack was **to be as aesthetically pleasing as possible** outside of only adding shaders.

Mods such as Not Enough Animations bring life to otherwise dull and static vanilla mobs, while adding flare to player animations as well.
Other mods like Ambient Sounds, Presence Footsteps and Sound Physics Remastered rework the ambience of the game and allows you to sink into the enviroments you enter with _amazing_ SFX, and etc.


## Client-side improvements
![What-am-I-looking-at and Item Notifier GUI Improvements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e283feef8a938c19bb50914a9d5a9b25a0c2298a.jpeg)
![Item highlight and food UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73937411a32ff14c668fdae8f7d9d7febd90d8ee.jpeg)
It was _important_ to set some priorities and add some **non-intrusive client-side gameplay and UI improvments** to the game.

While exploring, sometimes it's useful to know what you're looking at and know what you pick up on the fly, so, mods Jade and Pick Up Notifier do just that (_custom configurated_)!
Mods like AppleSkin and Item Borders allow you to know how much saturation and healing food will provide and show item rarity in item slot respectively, for example, the Golden Apple in the screenshot below demonstrates those 2 mods!


## Vanilla+ mods
### New additions

![Shaders with End City](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e47ea5b185f215793a7e3f2aaa62b69e88775591.jpeg)
To keep the game **interesting** and less stale, some mods were added to **improve long-term vanilla-style gameplay without adding too much content**.

Moog's End Structures, as it implies, adds more structures to the End dimension, the exploration there will feel a bit less empty and will still feel incredibly vanilla, while Tidal Towns adds a new type of village in the oceans, completely unobtrusively and blending in with the game's style.

### Improvements and tweaks
![Anvil and enchanting table improvements showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/242a2201ce5dd644a9dfdfe8dc97b5a14390f18c.jpeg)
These next mods were _purposefully_ added to **improve quality of life**, simple as that.

The compilation of Easy mods such as Easy Anvils and Easy Magic make gameplay mechanics for anvils and enchanting tables so much more convenient, allowing those entities to hold storage.
Other compilation of tweaks like Mooshroom Tweaks, Realistic Bees and Spawn-Proofed Villagers change behavior and aesthetics of these mobs for better experience.

_For a full list of mods, keep reading!_


## Resource pack compatibility
![Nether with shaders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc9a27dbd220f16243f647d679acf2d39d422d0f.jpeg)
![3D resource pack compatibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5b9f06d5d953acbbd1b8b430e56512784b37913.jpeg)

This assembly contains mods for an ideal game in Minecraft, and some optimization mods.
It also includes some visual tweaks, quality of life changes, and a couple of bug fixes.
You shouldn't get banned or kicked out for joining the 1.20.x version of the game, but there may be problems with older versions. **_I am not responsible for any bans you may receive!_**
# 🎯Goals
### 🔥Performance improvement
Perfect Assembly strives to significantly improve rendering and game logic performance, as well as memory and hardware usage, without any compromise to the game's appearance or functionality. This is done through various optimization mods that are actively tested for stability and improvement.
### 🪛OptiFine features
Perfect Assembly uses a variety of mods that offer the same features as OptiFine, but are modular so you can remove features you don't need or features that aren't compatible with other mods. This includes, but is not limited to:
- Significant performance gains
- Built-in shader support
- OptiFine Resource Pack Features
- Dynamic lighting from held objects
### 🧹Stay light
I only choose the combination of mods that work best with each other, and do not include performance mods that are unnecessary or often break compatibility with other mods or device hardware. I also do not include any quality of life mods in the package with the sole purpose of keeping it simple and flexible.
# ✅ Hardware compatibility
Perfect Assembly supports the use of video cards with drivers compatible with OpenGL 4.6. Most graphics cards released in 2010 or later are compatible. This includes the following equipment:
- Intel HD Graphics 500 series (Skylake) or later
- Nvidia GeForce 400 series (Fermi) or later
- AMD Radeon HD 7000 series (GCN 1) or later

In some cases, older video cards may also work (provided they have drivers that support OpenGL 3.3), but they are not officially supported and may not be compatible in the future.

_Most of the information was taken from Sodium's hardware compatibility section. I'll update this accordingly if anything changes._

description: A Bukkit plugin which automatically closes doors after they have been opened.
body:
Do you hate it when someone walks into your house and keeps the door opened? Then DoorCloser is the right plugin for you!

DoorCloser tracks opened doors and automatically closes them after a configurable time (60 seconds by default).

The plugin also supports defining a list of door types which should be automatically closed. In that way, you might let the plugin only close oak doors while keeping jungle doors open all the time.

## How to use it?

The plugin doesn't use any commands. Just open any door and it will close it for you after the defined timeout has been elapsed.

body:
# ⭐ Thumbnail Modpack
A lightweight, creator-focused modpack made specifically for Minecraft **thumbnail makers** and screenshot artists.

This pack gives you everything you need to create clean, high-quality, cinematic Minecraft shots — fast performance, improved visuals, powerful posing tools, and high-resolution screenshot features — all while staying fully vanilla-friendly.

---

## 🎯 What This Modpack Is For
Designed for:
- YouTube thumbnail creators  
- TikTok / Shorts creators  
- Map makers  
- Screenshot artists  
- Anyone who needs beautiful Minecraft images  

---

# ✨ Key Features

## 🧍‍♂️ Mannequin — The Ultimate Thumbnail Tool
The **Mannequin mod** is the centerpiece of this pack.

It lets you create fully poseable, customizable player models in-game — perfect for thumbnails without needing a second player.

**Mannequin lets you:**
- Pose arms, legs, head, and body freely  
- Load ANY skin (files, URLs, or your own)  
- Duplicate mannequins for consistent scenes  
- Position models with precision  
- Save and reuse poses  
- Create thumbnails solo with zero effort  

If you make thumbnails, this feature alone saves HOURS.

---

## ⚡ Boosted Performance
Built on the full Fabric optimization stack:
- Sodium  
- FerriteCore  
- Lithium  
- FastQuit  
- RRLS  
- ImmediateFast  
- EntityCulling  

Expect **higher FPS**, faster loading, smoother chunk rendering, and stable performance even with shaders.

---

## 🎨 Clean Visual Enhancements (Vanilla-Friendly)
- Continuity (connected textures)  
- LambDynamicLights  
- BetterGrassify  
- Entity Texture Features  
- Entity Model Features  
- Polytone  
- Shader support via Iris  
- Included shaderpacks (CMS & WEM)  

Your game stays faithful to vanilla — just brighter, smoother, and more cinematic.

---

## 📸 Screenshot-Focused Tools
### **Fabrishot**
Take ultra-high resolution screenshots (4K, 8K, 16K+ depending on GPU).

### **Zoomify**
Smooth OptiFine-style zoom for tight framing.

### **Gamma Utils**
Control brightness for perfect lighting in dark scenes.

### **Controlify**
If you pose with a controller, this adds flawless controller support.

---

# ❓ Q&A

### **Q: What makes this modpack different?**
**A:** It’s built specifically for thumbnail creators — mannequins, shaders, high-res screenshots, dynamic lighting, and clean visuals.

---

### **Q: Can I use this for normal survival?**
**A:** Yes! It’s still vanilla-friendly with no gameplay changes.

---

### **Q: Do I need a good PC?**
**A:** No — Sodium and optimization mods make it run smoother than vanilla.  
Shaders are optional.

---

### **Q: Why include shaders?**
**A:** For instant cinematic lighting without setup.

---

### **Q: What version does it use?**
Minecraft **1.21.1** — Fabric loader.

---

# 📦 Included Highlights
- Mannequin (poseable characters for thumbnails)  
- Fabrishot (ultra-high-res screenshots)  
- Iris + Sodium (shaders + FPS)  
- Continuity / Entity Features (visual polish)  
- Zoomify (cinematic zoom)  
- Dynamic Lights (realistic lighting)  
- Optimization mods for smooth gameplay  

---

# 🏁 Summary
Thumbnail Modpack gives creators a fast, clean, and powerful toolkit for making professional Minecraft thumbnails, screenshots, and promotional images — without changing the vanilla feel.

Perfect for content creators who want their visuals to stand out.

title: bomboaddons
description: BomboAddons is a comprehensive utility mod for Hypixel SkyBlock on Fabric. It provides a wide range of essential Quality of Life (QoL) overlays, solvers, and advanced mechanics to help players optimize their efficiency in the Garden, Dungeons, and beyond.
body:
## ⚙️ 1. General Settings

Contains broad quality-of-life additions, auto-solvers, tooltips, and client performance enhancements.

- __Sign Calculator:__ shows the results on calcs on signs for easier buying/selling.

- __SBE Commands:__ Enables custom commands and behaviors mimicking SkyBlock Extras (SBE), such as networth and skills checks.
  
- __Copy Chat:__ Adds a the option to copy chat messages with a click (supports color codes).

- __Left Click Etherwarp:__ Allows left-clicking to activate your Aspect of the Void (AOTV) Etherwarp.

- __Sphinx Solver:__ Assists in solving the Sphinx puzzle in SkyBlock.

  - *Hollow Wand Fix:* Fixes the block interactions and allows clicking through players when holding a Hollow Wand.

- __Auto Accept Carnival:__ Automatically accepts Carnival prompts.

- __Lowest BIN Tooltip:__ Shows the lowest Buy-It-Now (BIN) Auction House and bazaar prices to item tooltips.

- __NPC Sell Price Tooltip:__ Displays NPC sell prices to item tooltips.

- __Auto Trevor Quest:__ Automatically accepts Trevor the Trapper hunting quests.

- __Hoppity Egg Finder:__

  - *Egg Finder Chat Alerts:* Alerts you in chat when an egg is located.
  - *Egg Finder Waypoints* Shows a waypoint with the egg location.
  - *Egg Finder Beacon:* Renders a beacon at the egg's location.

- __Ignore Caps Lock:__ Makes keybinds function properly even when Caps Lock is toggled on.

- __Server List Button & Reconnect Button:__ Direct shortcuts added to in-game menus for easier navigation and server rejoin.

- __Quick Join Commands:__ Shortcuts like `/f1` (floor 1), `/m1` (master 1), etc., for joining SkyBlock instances quickly.

- __Auto Reconnect:__ Automatically attempts to rejoin the server upon a connection loss.

- __Party Commands:__

  - *Toggle:* Enables/disables processing of commands issued by party members.
  - *Prefixes:* Configures prefixes (such as `!`, `.`, `?`).
  - *Built-in Commands:* Includes `!timer` (starts countdowns), `!warp` (warps the party), and `!psa` (allows the all invite setting).

- __Hypixel Shortcut Button:__ Fast access button directly added onto main GUI screens.

- __Smart Disconnect:__ Adds a confirmation when trying to disconnect from a server.

- __Borderless Fullscreen:__ Forces the game into borderless windowed mode.


---

## 📊 2. HUDs & Overlays

Customizable visual indicators that render vital information directly on the HUD.

- __Dice Tracker HUD:__ Tracker to check how much you win gambling.

- __Feast Bakery HUD:__ Shows the best item in terms of coins/kernel on the Feast event.

- __RNG Profit HUD:__ Displays the most profit book from the enchanting table for metter.

- __Custom Timers HUD:__ An overlay showing all custom countdown timers active.

- __Item List Sidebar:__ An in-game sidebar listing active items.

---

## 🏡 3. Garden Settings

A comprehensive suite of indicators, macro checkers, and helpers for farming in the Garden.

- __Garden Movement Keybinds:__ Custom key mappings for Forward, Backward, Left, Right, Break, and Use.

- __Lock Mouse on Movement:__ Locks cursor inputs to stabilize angles during movement.

- __Direction Helper Warning:__ Tells you when you start farming again on the wrong side (usefull when killing pests).
  

- __Pest Highlights:__

  - *Pest Waypoints:* Highlights active pest locations with custom highlights.
  - *Tracers with Custom Colors:* Draws line tracers pointing directly to active pests.

---

## ⌨️ 4. Hotkeys

Fast-access keybind definitions to trigger actions instantly:

- __Trade / Recipe / Usage:__ Opens quick-lookup recipes and trade menus.
- __Show Info / Count Items:__ Displays metadata and counts matching items.
- __Copy NBT:__ Copies the NBT tag data of any item you hover over.
- __GFS Max / GFS Stack:__ Quick replenishment from your Sack.
- __Chat Peek:__ Peeks at chat history without opening the full chat interface.
- __Menu Page Navigation:__ Next Page, Previous Page, Go Back, and Smart Back buttons.
- __Run Clipboard Cmd:__ Executes whatever command is currently on your clipboard.

---

## 👤 5. Profiles & Binds

- __Profile Management:__ Set up separate profiles (e.g., `default`, customized setups) to quickly toggle entire groups of keybinds.

- __Multi-Conditional Keybinds:__ Map keys to commands with strict conditions:

  - *Required Island:* Bind only triggers if you are in a specific zone (e.g., Garden, Crimson Isle).
  - *Required Armor:* Bind only triggers if you are wearing specific armor sets.

---

## 🎯 6. Clickers

- __ GUI Keypress Clicker:__ Custom triggers that click slots or interact with custom item names in specified container GUIs when a mapped key is pressed (similar to wardrobe keybinds).

---

## 🔦 7. Custom Mob Highlights/tracer

- __Custom Mob Highlights:__ Add mob names to draw entities/mobs bounding boxes around those entities to highlight them.

---

## 👗 8. Wardrobe Keybinds

- __Disable Unequip:__ Prevents accidental removal of your armor sets.
- __Slot Keybinds:__ Map direct keybinds for Wardrobe Slots 1 through 9.

---

## 🐙 9. Kuudra Settings

Modules tailored for Boss fights in the Kuudra fight.

- __Blindness Timer & Disable Blindness:__ Shows a timer when you are gonna get eaten by kuudra (useful for insta stun).


- __Auto GFS Toxic & Twilight:__ Gets arrows when kuudra is gonna get stunned.

- __Pearl Waypoints:__ Predicts and solves throw angles and timers:

  - *Pearl Throw Timer:* Shows countdowns for throws.
  - *Pearl Positions:* Configurable filters for Flat, Sky, and Double pearl locations.

---

## 🐾 10. Pets

- __Pet Hotkeys:__ Quickly swap pets with custom keybinds.
- __Disable Unequip:__ Prevents unequipping active pets with keybind.

---

## 🗺️ 11. Custom Waypoints

- Manage custom coordinates (X, Y, Z) bound to specific SkyBlock zones. Includes:

  - *Show Through Walls:* View indicators through solid blocks.
  - *Show Beacon:* Renders a vertical light beam.
  - *Customizable Colors.*
  - *Only on specific Islands and profiles*

---

## 🔀 12. Command Aliases

- Map custom commands to short aliases (e.g., instead of /warp dh > /dh).

---

## 💬 13. Chat Triggers

- Define specific chat matching phrases. When detected in chat, they can:

  - *Run a customized Command.*
  - *Render a custom title overlay on screen.*

---

## 💀 14. Dungeons

- __Dungeon Secrets Tracker:__ Shows teammates secrets at the end of the dungeon run.
- __Pad Timers:__ Shows a custimizable timer for storm crush (useful for py).

---

## 📍 15. Coord Binds

- Triggers commands when you walk within a certain radius of specified coordinates. Highly customized with *island filters*, *min/max random delays*, and *auto-waypoints*. (useful to tell teammates when you are at ee for example)

---

## ⛏️ 16. Mining (Corpse highlight)

- __Corpse highlight:__ Highlighting boxes and line tracers pointing directly to mining corpses.
- __Hide Opened Corpses:__ Filters out corpses that have already been looted.
- __Custom Colors:__ Specify distinct outline and fill colors for each corpse tier: *Lapis*, *Tungsten*, *Umber*, and *Vanguard*.

---

## 🧱 17. Block & Particle Highlights

- __Block Highlights:__ Customizable highlights for blocks (e.g., blocks matching specific names/IDs).
- __Particle Highlights:__ Draw custom colors on specified visual particle groups.

---

## 🎯 18. Custom Crosshair

- Fully design custom reticles inside a pixel grid, or choose from standard presets with adjustable *chroma*, *static colors*, and *outline options*.

**Saros Log Saver** is a practical Forge mod that helps protect your valuable wood logs from accidental stripping. Designed with builders, landscapers, and forest managers in mind, this mod makes it easy to selectively safeguard specific logs or entire areas, ensuring that your decorative builds and natural forests remain pristine.

![https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Saros_Log_Saver/MP_SarosLogSaver_Description.webp](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Saros_Log_Saver/MP_SarosLogSaver_Description.webp)


### 1. Individual Log Protection
- **Easy to Use:** Right-click a log with the Log Saver Tool to protect it.
- **Reversible:** Simply right-click again on a protected log to remove the protection.
- **Prevents Stripping:** Once protected, logs cannot be stripped with an axe.

### 2. Bulk Protection with Multi-Selection
- **Initiate Selection:** Hold Shift and right-click on the first log to start the selection process.
- **Select Area:** Move to the second point and right-click (without holding Shift) to protect all logs within the defined area.

### 3. Bulk Unprotection with Multi-Selection
- **Initiate Removal:** Hold Shift and right-click on the first log to begin the unprotection selection.
- **Select Area:** Move to the second point and press Shift + Right-Click to remove protection from all logs in the area.

### 4. Visual Feedback
- **Color-Coded Outlines:**
  - **Green:** Indicates logs that are currently protected.
  - **Yellow:** Marks the first selection point during multi-selection.
  - **Blue:** Provides a live preview of the logs that will be affected by your bulk action.
- **Tool-Specific Visibility:** Outlines appear only while holding the Log Saver Tool, ensuring a clean interface during normal gameplay.

### 5. Live Preview for Multi-Selection
- **Immediate Feedback:** Once the first point is selected, a live preview shows all logs within the selection area.

### 6. Multi-Language Support
- **Language Support:** Provides full support for both English and German.

## Use Cases

- **Preserve Decorative Builds:** Protect critical or decorative logs from accidental stripping.
- **Maintain Natural Forests:** Keep forests intact by preventing unwanted modifications.

title: IOLogger

body:
This plugin captures all chat lines and commands entered and stores them in matching log files, one per day. You're then free to access your log files, through FTP or otherwise, to see what was logged on any given day.

00:00:45 | Doctacosa@world(248,65,65): [Doctacosa joined]

00:02:42 | Doctacosa@world(2598,59,-1959): [Doctacosa left]

00:01:20 | Doctacosa@world(350,70,72): /time
```
