body:
**Gather** is a mod that I decided to build when I found myself needing to collect materials for an automatic storage system. It goes without saying that the development of the mod delayed the storage system project quite a bit lol. ### **Current Features**: - **HUD** - shows base materials needed with have/need counts - **Auto recipe breakdown** - goals auto-break to leaf materials - **World block outlines** - highlights source blocks for needed materials - **Block xray** (toggle) - see outlines through terrain to find needed ore/resource blocks - The above feature is not accessible by default, turning it on requires an admin to use _**/gatherop xray on**_ command
- **Chest scanning** - track nearby chests containing needed items - **Shulker collector** - auto-pulls needed items into carried shulker

- **Crafting overlay** - crafting table panel showing craftable goals - **Trade Calculator** - trade calculator menu, calculate sell items needed to buy a certain amount of items - **Item finder** - find any item inside of tracked chests - **G-menu** - main functionalities menu - **HUD layout editor** - drag/resize HUD modules - **Imports/Exports** - copy goal lists across worlds and friends - **Settings screens** - allows you to fully customize every inch of the mod ### Requirements: - **Minecraft version**: from 1.21.1 on - **Fabric loader**: 0.19.2+ - **Fabric API**: Any version appropriate for the selected mc version - **Mod menu**: Any (suggested for more settings customization) - **Where Is it**: Any (required for Xray feature) ### Possible environments - **Single player**: install the mod on the client. - **Multiplayer / dedicated server**: install the mod on both the server and each client. ### Versioning - From now on, unless requested, only 1.21.11+ versions will be updated with new features ### What's coming: - Mod UI themes: modern, vanilla feel, light/dark modes, ... - Broader loaders support - Import goals from schematics and litematica 👀 ### Notice: Gather can check the official Gather website for the latest available version and show an in-game update notice. This check does not upload gameplay data and can be dismissed in-game.

title: TFC Glass Workshop
description: Adds a TFC-style mechanical glass press for batch glass production, reusable molds, ceramic molds, and powder-dyed glass recipes.
body:
## Description

TerraFirmaCraft: Glass Workshop expands TFC glass production with one focused machine: the Glass Press.

Instead of replacing TerraFirmaCraft's glass systems, this add-on builds on them. You still heat glass batches with TFC mechanics, still work with metal and ceramic molds, and still rely on TFC-style progression. The press simply gives you a batch-production step for turning hot glass batches into finished glass products.

The Glass Press requires mechanical power from above. Faster rotation means faster pressing. It can produce glass blocks, glass panes, TFC glass bottles, jars, lamp glass, and lenses depending on the installed mold.

For colored glass, the press includes three powder slots and supports the same powder combinations used by TFC glassworking. Add the right powders, install a block or plate mold, and press dyed glass blocks or panes directly.

## Features

- Glass Press machine for TFC-style batch glass production
- Requires TFC mechanical power from the top
- Uses hot TFC glass batches and TFC heat data
- 6 mold shapes:
  - Plate
  - Block
  - Bottle
  - Jar
  - Lamp Glass
  - Lens
- Permanent wrought iron and steel molds
- Ceramic molds made with clay knapping and firing
- Ceramic molds have a chance to break during pressing
- Powder dyeing for glass blocks and panes
- JEI recipe category for pressing recipes
- Integrated TFC Field Guide entries
- Bottom hopper extraction only pulls finished output

## How To Use

1. Heat a TFC glass batch to at least Faint Red.
2. Place it in the Glass Press input slot.
3. Insert a matching press mold.
4. For dyed glass, add the required powders to the three powder slots.
5. Power the Glass Press from the top with TFC mechanical power.
6. Collect the output manually or with a hopper underneath.

## Automation

The Glass Press is automation-friendly:

- Top: mechanical power input
- Bottom: output-only item access
- Other sides: inventory access for automation setups

This prevents a hopper below the press from stealing glass batches, molds, or powders.

![title image with logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/147bf2fbbb52b61cca6354e6a65e74d43c5a98db.png)

This mod is a fan mod of _Your Turn to Die_ and it adds Sou that is tameable.

![Sou after the raining](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4067796c401995707ad93d2d697d8fa9a92b1ef9_0.webp)

He spawns in these following biomes when it is raining in the provided world

- Forest
- Flower Forest
- Birch Forest
- Old Growth Birch Forest
- Dark Forest
- Taiga
- Old Growth Pine Taiga
- Old Growth Spruce Taiga

As you see, untamed Sou wears red scarf so you can easily recognize whether he is already tamed or not.

## What Does Needs to Tame Him?
 
If you want to tame him just feed him one of these following food items(custom items included)
![french pottage, apple sauce, and beetroot soup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ace373ae9e581b4970fd32f4184c6f2eb0b1cb70.png)

title: Rigel's Ultimate Specular
description: A resource pack adding specular reflections to the textures from Ashen 16x
body:
![Title image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27b2524a55e1fd666643acd9277b1301a3e22511.jpeg)

## About Rigel's Ultimate Specular

This resource pack is designed to add specular reflections and material properties to the Ashen 16x resource pack. It does not contain any original or modified Ashen assets.

Rigel's Ultimate Specular is in very early development, and only has support for every copper block and item so far. Updates will be slow, but high-quality! 

This pack is being designed and tested using Merlin1809's [Eclipse Shader](https://github.com/Merlin1809/Eclipse-Shader). 

## Credits & Authorship
* **Base Textures:** This texture pack only adds normal and specular textures, not original pixel art. The base textures this pack is built off of were created by the incredibly talented **Aim_Boot**, author of the [Ashen 16x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ashen) resource pack.
* **PBR Maps:** The maps in this pack were entirely hand-painted and configured by me. They are built directly on top of Aim_Boot's original textures to faithfully preserve Ashen's intended aesthetic. 

## Dependencies
To actually see the reflections in-game, you must install the following: 
- [Ashen 16x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ashen)
- A shader loader and a shader with LabPBR support. 
- [Better Block Entities (BBE)](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities): Without this mod (and Indium), Minecraft will fail to properly add the specular and normal textures to block entities like chests or signs. 

## Installation
1. Download this pack and Ashen 16x
2. In your resource pack screen, place Rigel's Ultimate Specular _above_ Ashen 16x
3. Load your shader with LabPBR and specular reflections enabled!

DM me on X for resource pack support:
[Rigel](https://x.com/user_rigel)

title: Soul Eater
description: A horror mod add creature stalking you in night.
body:
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________<details>
<summary>Spoiler!</summary>

![The Creature](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/963693ae8106f326560084e73668704ec745a1ee_0.webp)

This mod introduces a highly immersive and tension-driven entity designed to add a strong horror element to the game. Powered by an advanced AI system, the entity dynamically adapts to player behavior, creating unpredictable and engaging encounters.

Behavior System (AI)
The entity operates in two primary phases:

Observation phase – it watches the player from a distance, analyzing movement and actions
Hunting phase – it actively pursues and attacks once certain conditions are met

The transition between these phases is directly influenced by the player’s behavior, making each encounter unique.

Aggression Mechanics
The mod tracks player combat activity:

Each kill increases the entity’s aggression level
As aggression rises, the entity becomes more active and closes distance faster
Eventually, it initiates a direct and dangerous attack

Nocturnal Behavior

The entity is tied to the night cycle and low-light conditions
During the day, it remains mostly inactive or hidden
This adds a layer of strategy and realism to gameplay.

Atmospheric Effects

Custom sound cues signal the entity’s presence and proximity
Visual effects such as lighting and fog indicate its current state
These elements work together to create constant psychological pressure

Requirements

Client side: Required for rendering, animations, and sound
Server side: Required for AI logic, aggression tracking, and spawning
The mod must be installed on both client and server for full functionality

</details>

## 🎨 Color Challenge - Competitive Dye Collection Challenge

**A competitive dye collection mod for Minecraft**

Race to collect and deliver all 16 dye colors to the staff NPC — the first player to deliver them all wins!

---

## ✨ Features

### 📦 Delivery Area at Spawn
- **Auto-Generated Delivery Area**: A delivery area structure spawns automatically at the world spawn point
- **NPC Staff**: A staff NPC stands ready to accept your dye deliveries
- **Starter Equipment**: Each player receives an Instructions item and bread from a chest

### 📋 Instructions Item
- **Delivery Status Screen**: Right-click to view which dye colors you've delivered and which are still needed
- **16-Color Grid**: Visual grid showing all dye colors with delivered/undelivered status

### 🎨 Dye Collection
Collect and deliver all 16 Minecraft dye colors:
- White, Orange, Magenta, Light Blue, Yellow, Lime, Pink, Gray
- Light Gray, Cyan, Purple, Blue, Brown, Green, Red, Black

Craft dyes from flowers, cacti, cocoa beans, ink sacs, and other materials found throughout the world!

### 🏘️ Village Loot
- **Crafting Materials**: Village chests contain jungle saplings, cacti, and sea pickles to help with dye crafting

### 📊 Real-Time HUD
- **Delivery Count**: Track how many dyes you've delivered (X / 16)
- **Play Time**: See your elapsed time in MM:SS format
- **Rankings**: View finished players and their times
- **Delivery Area Marker**: Always know which way to the delivery area

### 🎮 Game Flow
- **Game Start Block**: Press to begin a 5-second countdown, then the race starts
- **Game Reset Block**: Double-click within 5 seconds to reset the game
- **Night Vision**: All players receive permanent night vision
- **Victory Notifications**: Announcements when players deliver all 16 colors

---

## 📖 How to Play

1. **Create a New World**: Start a new world with the mod installed
2. **Find the Delivery Area**: A delivery area structure is generated at the spawn point
3. **Grab Your Gear**: Take an Instructions item and bread from the chest
4. **Start the Game**: Press the Game Start block to begin the countdown
5. **Collect Dyes**: Explore the world, gather materials, and craft all 16 dye colors
6. **Deliver to Staff**: Return to the delivery area and right-click the staff while holding a dye
7. **Deliver All 16 Colors**: The first player to deliver all 16 dye colors wins!

---

## 🛠️ Technical Details

### Multi-Loader Support
This mod is built with **Architectury** and supports **multiple mod loaders**!
- **1.21.1–1.21.11**: Fabric and NeoForge
- **1.20.1**: Fabric and Forge

title: Cinema Scope
description: CinemaScope is a simple client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft `1.21.11` that draws cinematic black bars (letterbox) in-game.
body:
# CinemaScope

CinemaScope is a simple client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft `1.21.11` that draws cinematic black bars (letterbox) in-game.

## Features

- Draws black bars while in-world (including GUI screens like inventory/chat, behind UI)
- Toggle visibility with a keybind (default: `K`)
- ModMenu config screen support
- Persistent config via JSON

## Environment

- Minecraft: `1.21.11` (Java Edition)
- Fabric Loader: `0.18.4`
- Java: `21`

## Build

```bash
gradle clean build
```

Output jar is generated under `build/libs/`.

## Config (ModMenu)

Open `ModMenu -> Cinema Scope -> Configure` and edit:

- `Enabled`
- `Toggle Key`
- `Target Aspect Ratio` (`1.60` to `3.00`)
- `Bar Opacity` (`0` to `100`)
- `Show While HUD Hidden (F1)`

Buttons:

- `Cancel` (left)
- `Reset` (center, restore defaults on the screen)
- `Done` (right, save and close)

## Default Values

- Enabled: `true`
- Toggle Key: `K`
- Target Aspect Ratio: `2.39`
- Bar Opacity: `100`
- Show While HUD Hidden (F1): `true`

Internal runtime toggle state is persisted and restored across restarts.

## Config File

Saved at:

- `config/cinema_scope.json`

If the file is corrupted on load, it is backed up as:

- `config/cinema_scope.json.bak`

title: Roguelike Waves
description: Roguelike Monster Waves, choose a kit and survive as long as possible!
body:
# Monster Waves every 60 seconds. Can you beat the game? 



**The clock is ticking.** Are you ready for a restless survival experience?

This datapack changes the rules of the game: there are no breaks, and nowhere to hide. 

**Every 60 seconds**, a new wave of monsters spawns to hunt you down.

Survive the waves and see how long you can last! 

Can you beat the game?

---

## 🚀 Key Features

### ⏱️ The 60-Second Timer
Peaceful building is a thing of the past. A global timer is constantly running. The moment it hits zero, a fresh wave of hostile mobs spawns directly around you.
> **Warning:** You cannot sleep away the danger. The waves will find you.

### 📈 Scaling Difficulty
Don't get too comfortable after the first few minutes. The waves get stronger over time:
* **Early Game:** Basic mobs to get you warmed up.
* **Mid Game:** Enemies start spawning with more HP.
* **Late Game:** Beware of the blazes.

### 🎁 Custom Loot & Sustainability
Since you won't have much time to farm or mine, the mobs are your lifeline.
* 🍖 **Food Drops:** Mobs have a chance to drop food so you don't starve during battle.
* 🛡️ **Armor & Gear:** Defeat enemies to get new gear. The only way to upgrade is to fight!

### 🎒 Choose Your Starter Kit
Upon loading the world (or via command), you get to choose a **Starter Kit**. Pick the kit that suits your survival strategy.



### **Think you have what it takes? Download the datapack now and face the horde!**
---

## 🎮 How to Play

1.  **Install:** Drop the datapack into your world folder.
2.  **Start:** Enter the world. You should see a barrel to select your **Starter Kit**.
3.  **Survive:** The timer begins immediately. Gather resources quickly between waves.
4.  **Progress:** Survive as many waves as possible. The longer you live, the harder it gets.

---

## ⚙️ Installation

1.  Download the `.zip` file.
2.  Navigate to your Minecraft folder: `.minecraft/saves/<YourWorldName>/datapacks`.
3.  Place the file inside the `datapacks` folder (no need to unzip usually).
4.  Type `/reload` in-game or restart your world.

---

title: headmate
description: Resize, rotate and customize Minecraft heads more than ever before!
body: # headmate Resize, rotate and customize Minecraft heads more than ever before! A PaperMC plugin. **This requires another plugin (or method) to obtain skinned player heads to work properly.** See the gallery tab for images. ## Controls headmate uses a [Breeze Rod](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Breeze_Rod) as its wand item. To create your first merged head, hold a player head in your offhand and the wand in your main hand, then click the block you want to place it on. If you wish to place it inside, hold the Sneak key and click a block. You will now enter editor mode. Editor mode features on-screen instructions. In editor mode, you can move, rotate and scale the head. Press movement keys to move horizontally, or Jump/Sprint to move vertically. Press Sneak to enter transform mode. In transform mode, you can rotate and scale the head. Press Forward/Backward to scale, Left/Right to rotate. Press Sneak to toggle back to move. To save the change, hold Sneak for a second. You can add more heads (this is why it's called merged heads!) to the same block by doing the same thing you did to create the first head. To edit a head you placed earlier, hold nothing and click the head with the wand, or shift-click the block to see a list of all the heads in the block. You can edit or delete heads from this list. You can alternatively delete all heads in the block by Left-clicking with the wand and a Lava Bucket. To change the hitbox of the head block, press Left Click while holding the wand. This will toggle between a pass-through and a solid block. You can also add a custom block by simply placing it while in pass-through mode.

title: Essor
description: Essor is a Minecraft mod that enhances your experience by adding a leveling system to your equipment. Make it grow stronger over time and become the most powerful entity in the world you shape.
body:
# Welcome to Essor
Essor is a Minecraft mod designed to transform your adventure into a deep and rewarding progression experience. With Essor, every tool, weapon, and piece of armor you use gains levels, grows stronger, and adapts to your playstyle. Dive into a unique progression system that lets you shape your gear and dominate the world you explore!

## Leveling system
Every piece of equipment (swords, pickaxes, armor, etc.) earns experience and levels up as you use it. The more you use it, the more powerful it becomes, with enchantment rewarding for leveling up.

## Prestige system
Once your gear reaches the maximum level, it can ascend through prestige tiers. Each prestige resets your item’s level but grants permanent bonuses and increases the maximum level before next prestige, pushing your limits even further.

## Experience Boosters
To speed up your progression, Essor introduces experience boosters specifically designed for prestige levels. These boosters help you maximize your gear’s potential and reach new heights of power faster than ever.

## Smart Balancing
The mod is designed to integrate seamlessly with vanilla Minecraft, offering a challenging yet balanced progression that enhances—rather than disrupts—the core gameplay experience.

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)
  - Special Note: as of 5.5.0 (1.21.9), pack formating now has minor versions. All minor versions for any given major versions are intended to fully compatible (i.e. - 88.0, 88.1, etc.) and listed as only the major version (i.e. - 88).
- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

title: Pathway
description: Library in aid of controlling entities
body:
There are still a few issues, so feel free to open pull requests to help improve this project! 😁

## ✅ Features
- Automatic Movement of Entities to their Destination

## 📖 Usage
Add the `pathway` tag to an entity and set the destination by setting `data.pathway.target` to a list with three doubles, e.g., Player's Position

### Config
Defined by attributes, except:\
`scoreboard players set @s pathway.maxDistance <any>` — **default: unset** — maximum distance it will pathfind at once — Change at your own discretion. Recommended: 100\
`scoreboard players set @s pathway.maxStepHeight <any>` — **default: unset** — maximum blocks to step up at once

### Example usage
```
#code:loop.mcfunction:

execute as @e[tag=my_entity] at @s run data modify entity @s data.pathway.target set from entity @p[distance=..50] Pos
```

body:
✅ Project Description
🔮 Overview
This modpack takes a Vanilla+ approach to Minecraft, enhancing the core game while keeping it intuitive and immersive. It focuses on expanding all four dimensions—Overworld, Nether, End, and Aether—and introduces Create mod engineering, fantasy mobs, and exploration-focused gameplay.

Whether you want to build working contraptions with gears and shafts, raid massive underground dungeons, or explore mystical new biomes, this modpack provides an exciting survival experience without overwhelming complexity.

⚙️ Features
🛠 Engineering with Create

Full Create suite: Create, Create Addition, Create Contraptions, Create Structures.

Build kinetic machines, automated farms, elevators, and steampunk tech.

🌍 Biomes & Structures

World generation enhanced with Terralith, Nullscape, Better Nether, and Deep Aether.

Massive dungeons, ruins, temples, and structures added by When Dungeons Arise, Yung’s Better series, and more.

🧭 Exploration & Immersion

New content in every dimension: Aether, Lost Aether Content, Ocean’s Delight, End’s Delight, Tide, and Incendium.

Expanded NPC and mob variety with Friends and Foes, Citadel, and Happy Ghast.

New foods and farming systems via Farmer’s Delight and related addons.

🚀 Performance & QoL

Smoother performance with FerriteCore, Embeddium, EntityCulling, and Clumps.

Exploration tools like Xaero’s Minimap and World Map.

Useful UI improvements including JEI, Appleskin, and shader support via Oculus.

🌐 Multiplayer & Compatibility
Client + Server Required – All players need the modpack installed locally.

Uses Forge 1.20.1.

Designed for private multiplayer use but fully supports single-player.

Focused on fair, survival-based gameplay with no unfair client-side advantages.

📦 Who Should Play This?
This modpack is perfect for players who:

Want a balanced survival experience with new biomes, dungeons, and structures

Enjoy Create mod machines and light RPG/fantasy elements

Prefer performance-optimized Vanilla+ packs that are easy to get into and stable for servers

title: Rules Plugin
description: A simple Minecraft plugin to display and edit server rules.
body:
# 📜 Rules

A simple and flexible **Minecraft Spigot/Paper plugin** that allows server administrators to **manage and display custom server rules** using a `rules.yml` file.  
Perfect for servers that want to provide easily editable in-game or chat-displayed rule messages.

---

## ⚙️ Features

- 🧾 Loads and manages rules from an external `rules.yml` file  
- ✏️ Easily update or replace your server rules  
- 💾 Automatically creates a default `rules.yml` on first launch  
- ⚡ Lightweight and efficient — only loads when needed  

---

## 📁 Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar` file  
2. Place it inside your server’s `plugins/` folder  
3. Start or reload your server  
4. A file named `rules.yml` will be generated in the plugin folder  

You can open and edit this file at any time to change your server’s rules.

---

## 🧩 Developer Information

**Main utility class:**  
`de.scholle.rules.RulesManager`

**Key methods:**
- `getRulesText()` → Returns the rules text stored in the YAML file  
- `setRulesText(String text)` → Updates the rules text and saves it  
- `loadRules()` → Initializes or reloads the rules file  

**Default file created:**  
`plugins/Rules/rules.yml`

---

## 🧰 Compatibility

- ✅ Works on **Spigot**, **Paper**, and **Purpur**  
- 🧱 Compatible with **Minecraft 1.18+**  
- ⚙️ Requires **Java 17+**

---

## 🧑‍💻 Author

**Developed by:** Scholle  
**Package:** `de.scholle.rules`

---

title: NeoPluginHide
description: NeoPluginHide is a lightweight Paper/Spigot plugin 1.21.x that hides discovery commands and customizes your server identity in the F3 screen.
body:
[ ![erly acces](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2334cf3eb4b13ee2695bae533f8044f6237efd83.png)](https://discord.gg/uuZ6VPVMvP)

![Protect your server, hide your secrets, define your identity.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/876330a0163bdef982ebe6239623453920f3bc4b.png)

**NeoPluginHide** is a lightweight Paper/Spigot plugin (1.19 → 1.21.x) that hides all discovery commands like `/plugins`, `/version`, `/about`, `/help`, and removes tab completion for them.  
It also allows you to **customize the Server Brand** shown in the F3 debug screen, and supports **multiple languages (English, French, Spanish)**.

---

## 🧩 Features

- 🔒 Blocks `/plugins`, `/version`, `/about`, `/help`, `?`, `icanhasbukkit`, and aliases  
- 🪄 Custom **fake plugin list** for `/plugins`  
- 🎭 Customizable **Server Brand** (replaces “Paper” in F3)  
- 🗣️ Multi-language support: `en`, `fr`, `es`  
- 💬 Fully configurable messages  
- 🚫 Removes tab-completion for hidden commands  
- ⚙️ Reload via `/neopluginhide reload`  
- 👑 Permissions for admin and bypass  

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Example `config.yml`:

```yaml
settings:
  language: "en"                # en, fr, es
  server-brand: "NeoServer"     # shows in F3
  hide-tab-suggestions: true
  bypass-permission: "neopluginhide.bypass"

  blocked-commands:
    - "pl"
    - "plugins"
    - "ver"
    - "version"
    - "help"
    - "about"
    - "icanhasbukkit"

  fake-plugins:
    - "WorldEdit"
    - "Essentials"
    - "LuckPerms"
```

---

## 🧰 Commands

| Command | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/neopluginhide reload` | Reloads the configuration file |

---

## 🧠 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|-------------|--------------|----------|
| `neopluginhide.admin` | Access to `/neopluginhide reload` | OP |
| `neopluginhide.bypass` | Skip all protections and see everything | OP |

---

## 🧾 Compatibility

- ✅ **Paper**, **Spigot**, **Purpur**  
- ✅ **Minecraft 1.21.x**  
- ✅ **Java 21+**  

---

## 🌍 Localization

The plugin supports **English**, **French**, and **Spanish** messages.

Change the language in your config:

```yaml
settings:
  language: "fr"
```

---

## 📸 F3 Custom Brand

Change the text displayed in F3 (“Server Brand”):

```yaml
settings:
  server-brand: "YourCustomName"
```

---

**pierrecreeper**

![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6e157818fc4eeaf10cf511e933e58bbdd2e0aa9.png)

*   **No more berry damage when wearing armor:** Players wearing tagged leggings are immune to berry bush and cactus damage. All vanilla leggings are enabled by default.
*   **Let's be honest, villagers aren't the brightest:** Villagers, iron golems, and wandering traders are immune to damage from berry bushes and cactus by default. 
*   **Datapack Support:** Add more damage sources, entities and leggings, for vanilla and modded items, using the optional data pack.
*   **Debug Mode:** Enable verbose logging for tag matching.
*   **Configure options:** In-game via the config screen, or at '_config/berryproof.json_
*   **Requires:** _[MidnightLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/midnightlib)_

#### Enjoy a safer **_berry pricking_** experience for you and your villagers!

Berry Proof is also available on [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/berry-proof)

title: KyverEco
description: The best free modern and lightweight economy plugin
body:
# 💸 NexusEco
**Economy done right** – A modern, lightweight, and fully configurable Minecraft economy plugin.

---

## ❓ What is NexusEco?

**NexusEco** is a **free**, **modern**, and **lightweight** economy plugin built to deliver **high performance**, a **simple setup**, and **full control** for server owners.

---

## ⚡ Optimized for Speed

Built for performance, NexusEco uses minimal resources while providing a seamless experience.

---

## 🗃️ Flexible Storage

Supports **MySQL**, **SQLite**, and **MongoDB** utilizing **HikariCP**, out of the box.

---

## 🛠️ Easy to Configure

Get started in minutes with **clean**, **beginner-friendly** config files.

---

## 📑 Transaction History

Whenever a **transaction** is made, it's saved into the sender and receiver's **transaction history**, which can be viewed with the `/history` command.

Example:
- **Type:** Admin Received  
- **From:** You  
- **To:** You  
- **Amount:** 500  
- **Date:** 03/05/2025 14:22  
- **ID:** `#B47DDA8695`

---

## 🏆 Balance Leaderboards

View the top player balances on your server in a **paginated GUI** using the `/baltop` command.

Example:
- **Rank:** 1  
- **Name:** Harfull  
- **Balance:** $600  
- *Click to view profile*

---

## ⚙️ Fully Configurable

All **messages**, **GUIs**, and other aspects of the plugin are highly **customizable** to fit your server’s needs.

---

## 🧾 Commands

A detailed list of all the **commands** that NexusEco offers:

```
/balance <player>          - nexuseco.balance  
/pay <player>              - nexuseco.pay  
/history                   - nexuseco.history  
/baltop                    - nexuseco.baltop  
/profile <player>          - nexuseco.profile  

/economy                   - nexuseco.economy  
/nexuseco reload           - nexuseco.admin  
/nexuseco version          - nexuseco.admin  
```

Example command config (`config.yml`):
```yaml
commands:
  balance:
    enabled: true
    aliases:
      - bal
    permission: nexuseco.balance

  pay:
    enabled: true
    aliases:
      - transfer
    permission: nexuseco.pay
```

---

## 🎁 Placeholders

A list of all the **placeholders** NexusEco supports:

- `%nexuseco_balance%` – Displays the raw balance of the player  
- `%nexuseco_formatted_balance%` – Displays the formatted balance of the player

These can be used anywhere PlaceholderAPI is supported.

---

## 🧩 Dependencies

NexusEco requires [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) for smooth server-wide **economy** integration.  
It also supports [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) to show your **placeholders** in messages, scoreboards, and GUIs.

---

🟣 Try NexusEco today and make your economy system lightweight, modern, and powerful — without compromising on speed or customization!

title: ePotions
description: A lightweight Bukkit/PaperMC plugin for adding custom potions using a simple config.yml configuration.
body:
## RU
Простой плагин, позволяющий делать кастомные зелья и крафты для них. Работает на версиях 1.21-1.21.8, в будущем будет реализована поддержка низких API (1.16-1.21.8) но это маловероятно.

В плагине уже есть пару кастомных shapeless-крафтов чтобы показать механику плагина:
- Кактус-Кола,
- Аметистовая Вода,
- Зелье мертвых душ.

Чтобы создать свои зелья, вам могут пригодиться такие ресурсы как:
- minecraft.wiki/ru.minecraft.wiki,
- idpredmetov.ru/id-zelij/,
- или банальный ChatGPT/Deepseek.

Плагин также поддерживает формат сообщений через MiniMessage.

## EN
A simple plugin that allows you to make custom potions and crafts for them. Works on versions 1.21-1.21.8, support for low APIs (1.16-1.21.8) will be implemented in the future, but this is unlikely.

The plugin already has a couple of custom shapeless crafts to demonstrate the plugins mechanics:
- Cactus Cola,
- Amethyst Water,
- Dead Souls Potion.

To create your own potions, you may find the following resources useful:
- minecraft.wiki/ru.minecraft.wiki,
- idpredmetov.ru/id-zelij/,
- or the common ChatGPT/Deepseek.

The plugin also supports the MiniMessage message format.

title: Fantasie II - Lite
description: A performance-optimized version of Fantasie II — fewer mods, same legacy.
body:
## Fantasie II (Lite)

**Fantasie II (Lite)** is a streamlined version of the original Fantasie II modpack, created for better compatibility and performance — especially for Modrinth users.

Due to licensing and hosting restrictions, the following mods could not be included in this version:
Mowzie’s Mobs, Astral Sorcery, BiblioCraft, Thaumcraft, Primitive Mobs, BuildCraft, and others.

This results in the removal of some magical systems, complex mobs, and certain decorative or performance-heavy features. However, the core experience of *Fantasie* remains intact — a world in ruins, powerful magic rising once more, and a final hero called to restore balance.

> 🔗 Looking for the **full experience**?  
> 👉 [Play Fantasie II on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/fantasie-ii)  
> 👉 [Or get the full version on Modrinth (Unlisted)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fantasie-ii)

---

### 🧙 What’s still included?

The world of Fantasie lies in ruins.  
Once, mighty heroes ruled the land, building majestic castles and mastering the art of magic. Among them was a powerful mage — a peacemaker — who conquered enemy fortresses not for power, but to bring balance and unity to the realm. For a time, it worked.

But many years have passed since the era of Fantasie I.  
The castles have crumbled, reclaimed by nature or seized by darkness. The mage’s staff is lost. His wisdom, forgotten. The fragile peace he fought for has long since shattered.

But not everything is lost.

A spark of hope still glimmers in the darkness.  
You are the last of a long-forgotten line. The world calls for a new hero — one who can restore the harmony between magic and machine, and defy the growing shadow that now blankets the land.

---

### 🛠️ Technology and Progress

- Harness the power of **Mekanism** to build advanced machines, process resources, and fortify yourself against the chaos.  
- With **Thermal Expansion** and **Immersive Engineering**, engineer vast systems to make survival sustainable — and powerful.

### 🔮 Magic and Mysteries

- Rediscover forgotten spells with **Electroblob’s Wizardry**, and recover ancient tomes lost in time.  
- Use **Botania** to channel the life force of plants, or delve into **Blood Magic** for strength drawn from sacrifice.

### 🗺️ Exploration and Adventure

- Venture through mystical dimensions such as the **Twilight Forest** and the **Aether**, each filled with secrets, challenges, and rewards.  
- Navigate ruins and dangerous strongholds from **Dungeon Tactics** and **Chocolate Quest**, long untouched by mortal hands.

### 🛡️ Gear and Survival

- Arm yourself with unique and powerful items.  
- Through **Artifacts** and **Curios**, discover ancient relics and unlock new abilities to survive what lies beyond the veil of light.

## 📜 Credits

These mods are part of Fantasie II and require attribution. Many thanks to the mod authors!

- [**BiblioCraft**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bibliocraft) – Adds stylish furniture and functional storage options.
- [**Waddles**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/waddles) – Adds cute penguins to cold biomes for more atmosphere.
- [**Hexxit Gear**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hexxit-gear) – Brings back classic Hexxit-style armor sets.
- [**Dynamic Trees for Atum 2**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dynamic-trees-atum-2) – Adds dynamic trees to the Atum dimension.
- [**Mowzie’s Mobs**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mowzies-mobs) – Intelligent cinematic mobs with unique behavior and animations.
- [**LunatriusCore**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lunatriuscore) – Required core mod for several utility-based mods.
- [**Astral Sorcery**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/astral-sorcery) – A complex magic system based on starlight and constellations.
- [**MultiMob Library**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/multi-mob-core) – Shared mob dependency library for other creature mods.
- [**Dynamic Trees for Thaumcraft**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dttc) – Adds dynamic magical trees for Thaumcraft.
- [**BuildCraft**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/buildcraft) – Adds pipes, engines, and automation from the early modding days.
- [**Straw Golem Reborn**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/strawgolem-reborn) – A tiny straw golem that helps harvest crops.
- [**Guilt Trip**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/guilt-trip) – Adds morality and consequences for killing passive mobs.
- [**WeissCore**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/weisscore) – Core library used by various Weiss-based mods.
- [**Just A Few Fish**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/just-a-few-fish) – Adds animated, swimmable fish to Minecraft waters.
- [**Primitive Mobs**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/primitive-mobs) – Adds a variety of mobs with drops and behavior similar to vanilla.
- [**AbyssalCraft Integration**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/abyssalcraft-integration) – Connects AbyssalCraft to other mod systems.
- [**Dynamic Trees Thaumcraft Addon**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dynamic-trees-thaumcraft-addons) – More Thaumcraft-based tree integration.
- [**RFTDimTweak**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/rftools-dimension-tweaker) – Compatibility tweaks for RFTools Dimensions.
- [**Bee Barker**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bee-barker) – Adds a barking bee as a humorous pet mob.
- [**Baubles**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/baubles) – Adds extra equipment slots like rings and amulets.
- [**Thaumcraft**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/thaumcraft) – The legendary arcane research magic system.

---

Fantasie II Lite is lighter, faster, and more accessible — but still true to its core.  
The world is watching. The ruins are whispering. The magic is waiting.

**Answer the call. Reclaim the past.**  
**Become the hero Fantasie desperately needs.**

This mod adds structures and dungeons that will be randomly generated in the normal world to improve and make your exploration and adventure in the world of Minecraft fun! (ATTENTION: This mod is under development and the first version to be released will be an Alpha Version)

This mod is aimed at people who want adventure and better exploration, this mod will make your adventure more fun and will also improve the look of your world with natural generation of structures and dungeons.

•Structures and dungeons spawn in the overworld and caves.

•Structures mainly spawn in biomes: Plains, Forest, Desert.

•Some dungeons may contain Mobs (the larger the dungeon, the greater the number of Mobs and the greater their strength)

Compatibility: Simply Dungeons is compatible with other mods that include structure generation!

title: Sir_Potates Playing Cards
description: Explore the overworld making and using playing cards for pure power.

title: TNT's Useful Copper
description: Makes copper useful by adding copper tools, weapons, and armor, that oxidizes over time, plus new redstone components!
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/hUnwG9aDLDQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Ever thought copper was useless? This mod fixes that! Just like in real life, this mod adds both copper and bronze tools, weapons, and armor. It also adds redstone components, including copper wire and logic gates.

# Copper Equipment

![Copper/bronze tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e119100d029d1d0136866cd859a60564c77c158b.png)

This mod allows you to craft copper tools, weapons, and armor out of copper ingots, just like you would with stone, iron, etc. This is required for progression, because you'll need copper tools to mine iron! Copper (and bronze) armor is compatible with vanilla armor trims.

## Oxidation

Just like copper blocks, copper equipment will oxidize over time. You can change how often the check runs and what the chances of oxidizing are in the config file. This will not be affected by tick speed.

You can stop oxidation by throwing the item onto the ground and throwing a honeycomb ontop of it. This will use the honeycomb and show a tooltop on the item saying it's waxed. To remove the wax, throw the item back on the ground and throw an axe ontop of it. This will use the axe's durability.

Due to game limitations, unwaxed copper equipment placed in a container will not oxidize until it's removed, at which point it will oxidize based on how long it was in the container.

# Bronze

## Bronze Equipment

![Bronze pickaxe recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79a991b51a6a20ae4ca9073edaa5d5809d0b907b.png)

This mod adds bronze as an optional tier between copper and iron. Crafting bronze equipment is more difficult than copper. Like netherite, you'll need to use a smithing table. Steps:
1. Get a smithing table
2. Acquire a bronze upgrade smithing template, which can be found in chests or obtained from killing early game monsters, like zombies, skeletons, creepers, and spiders. You can duplicate it by surrounding it with copper ingots in a crafting table.
3. Craft bronze ingots from 4 copper ingots and 2 iron ingots.
4. Use the smithing table to apply the bronze upgrade.

## Bronze Blocks

![Bronze block/stairs/slab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4099f20532493b8f6a752276dff3ccb84c8e868e.png)

You can craft bronze blocks with 9 bronze ingots. From that, you can craft slabs and stairs like you would with any other material. Unlike copper, blocks of bronze do not oxidize and can be used for beacons.

# Progression

This mod reworks progression to make copper a *required* tier between stone and iron. You'll need stone to mine copper and copper (or bronze) to mine iron. Bronze is an *optional* tier between copper and iron. The vanilla tool tiers have been rebalanced to use different mining speeds, attack damage, defense values, etc.

# Redstone Components

![Copper wires, rectifiers, a divider, 2 copper lamps, and a lever](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41b0db32ff498e95d60cb20c0579a8a67f6932ba.png)

## Copper Wire

![Copper wire recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d982d392dcb8c90adf83c3f6df4435a47cfee703.png)

Copper wire is crafted with two copper ingots and one redstone dust, as shown above. This can be placed in the world and used as an alternative to redstone that isn't washed away by water, doens't need a block below it, can easily go vertically, and doesn't cause as much lag.

## Rectifier
![Rectifier recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2b841fd602aa39fc89298e95c1f1058fbb0913e.png)

However, you'll need to use a rectifier (or logic gate) to convert redstone power to and from the kind of power used by copper wires. It can also be used in the same way as a repeater, to replenish the signal if it becomes to weak. The signal cannot go backwards.

A rectifier can be crafted with six copper ingots and one copper wire, as shown above.

The input has a dark colored square, while the output has a red square, which will be lit up when the rectifier is powered on.

## Divider
![Divider recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/385f56c51851a09c64e8fa94ae58c6bd9c34afa5.png)

If you want to turn a corner or split your wires into multiple branches, you can use a divider. However, this only takes a single input, shown with a red square, and the current will not be able to go backwards.

## Logic Gates

This mod adds several logic gate blocks to the game. These can be used with both copper wires and normal redstone to simplify your contraptions and make redstone much easier! Most gates will automatically detect when an input is added and react accordingly. The following gates are added:
1. NOT gate - output is on when every input is off (can be used as a NOR gate)
2. AND gate - output is on when every input is on
3. NAND gate - output is off when every input is on (inverted AND gate)
4. XOR gate - output switches every time an input is changed
5. XNOR gate - inverted XOR gate

The OR gate was not included due to its functionality easily being replicated with a redstone wire, divider, etc. The NOR gate was removed before release due to having the same functionality as the NOT gate.

Recipes can be found in the gallery.

# Compatibility

This mod has been tested and is compatible with:
- [TNT's Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/tnts-combat)
- [TNT's Harder Beds]([https://modrinth.com/mod/tnts-harder-beds](https://modrinth.com/mod/tnts-harder-beds))
- [TNT's Zombie Apocalypse]([https://modrinth.com/mod/tnts-zombie-apocalypse](https://modrinth.com/mod/tnts-zombie-apocalypse))
- [Beddium](https://modrinth.com/mod/beddium)

## Adding Compatibility

If you want to add compatibility for your mod:
1. Make a folder called "tnts_useful_copper" in your mod's data folder
2. Make a folder inside of it called "tags"
3. Make a folder inside the tags folder called "blocks"
4. Add the json files you need, including the IDs of your blocks

can_provide_power.json - add anything capable of providing a redstone signal here
needs_copper_tool.json - add blocks you want to be mineable with copper, but not stone or wood
powered_by_copper_wire.json - add blocks capable of providing a redstone signal to wires

This plugin will help you in survival.
If you wanted to have auto sorting items into barrels, you now can.

## Commands
- /s - Opens GUI where you can pass items to be sorted into barrels.
- /s r - Opens GUI where you can pass resources (Barrels, signs) to be used when building barrels and signs on barrel. (Required ofc)
- /s chunks [start|end] - Create a new chunk where barrels will be placed. All barrels will have 1 gap between them to be able to place signs on barrels. You need to look at the block when executing the command from where to where you want to create chunk. Only [end] creates new chunk if all criterias meets.
- /s reset - Admin command to erase database, barrels and chunks. **(use with caution as this will delete all items inside the barrels and won't give them back to owner)**
- /s s - Will check if you have currently holding item in your hands an barrel.
- /s hl [Material] - You can highligh an sign to show where the item is. (Supports tab completion thank god, or you can just hold item and leave [material] empty)

title: Firesparks
description: Small Bukkit plugin for Minecraft that tweaks natural health regeneration in interesting way.
body:
# Firesparks
### Requires [GSit](https://hangar.papermc.io/Gecolay/GSit) to work!
If you find a bug - please, [report an issue](https://github.com/rindefault/Firesparks/issues)!

![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/JCzRE7B.png)

Small Bukkit plugin for Minecraft that tweaks natural health regeneration in an interesting way.

..and not only regeneration, but also adds some other features.
## Coldness system
![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/EbFrce3.png)

When a player is not standing next to a campfire or does not have armor - he will freeze.

## Item burning feature
![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/php5Ny6.png)

You can put items in campfire, like food. After the item burns - it spreads some potion effects. You can configure this feature in `config.yml`.

## Highly customizable config
Now you can configure **comfort growth**, that allows you to gain more comfort per data-update.

### Config settings
`growth-amount: 6`
> By default, player gains 6 comfort per 2 seconds.
> To fill the comfort bar - you need 1000 comfort.

`progressbar-name: "&lComfort"`
> The name speaks for itself

`coldness.enable: true`
> Enables coldness system.
> In cold biomes player can freeze to death, if it doesn't wear any armor.
> You can stand next to the campfire to keep warm.

`item-burn.enable: true`
> Enables item burning feature.
> You can right-click with an item from config to burn it in campfire.
> Use this template to add items:
> ```yaml
> MATERIAL: # https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Material.html
>     effect: EFFECT # https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/potion/PotionEffectType.html
>     duration: INTEGER
>     time-to-burn: INTEGER
>     color: '#HEXCOLOR'
> ```

## Kosmopack!

Quality of Life, client-only modpack for vanilla players. Made with friends in mind.

* Keeps the game vanilla - you can still connect to vanilla servers and play vanilla game.
* The pack is intended to be non-invasive and playable out of the box.
* No new blocks are added; the pack is just quality of life (and sometimes arbitrary weirdness).
* All mods can be enabled/disabled to suit your taste and needs.

## Included Mods

The list is bound to change - skrem if it's badly out of date!

* Performance: Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, Spark, Borderless Mining, Dynamic FPS, Smooth Boot, Entity Culling
* Visual: Iris, Indium, Axolotl Buckets, LambDynamicLights, Sodium Extra + Reese's Options
* Mapping: JourneyMap, VoxelMap, Xaero's Map
* Masa Mods: Litematica, Tweakeroo, Minihud, Itemscroller + Craftfix, Servux, Masa Gadget, Syncmatica
* Technical: Carpet, Carpet Extra, Carpet Autocrafting Table, Essential Client
* Aesthetic: 3D Skin Layers, Blur, Capes, Continuity, Distant Horizons, Not Enough Animations, Falling Leaves, Fabric Sky Boxes, Eating Animation
* Design: WorldEdit + CUI, Geodesy
* Utility: In-Game Account Switcher, Controlling, Command Macros, Cherished Worlds, Creative One-Punch, Logical Zoom, Inventory Profiles Next
* Informational: Roughly Enough Items, WTHIT, Horse Stats Vanilla, Better Mount HUD, Mod Menu, AppleSkin, Advancement Info
* Bugfixes: Model Gap Fix, Tooltip Fix, View Distance Fix, Head Name Fix, Chat Up, More Chat History, Don't Clear Chat History
* Network: ViaFabric, Twitch Chat Bridge, No Chat Reports

## Optional Mods

Some mods are disabled by default since they change the way you interact with the game in ways that might be considered disruptive if you're not used to them. These include Itemscroller (changes bulk inventory operations), Entity Culling (might cause entities to disappear when using freecam) and others. Check the mod list if you're interested in those extra mods.

## Migration

When migrating from a previous version of the modpack you can copy all your settings & saves so there's less time spent configuring things.

Copy the following files/folders from the old instance to the new instance; when asked, choose "Overwrite":

* journeymap
* voxelmap
* config
* itemscroller
* options.txt
* optionsof.txt
* saves
* schematics
* screenshots
* servers.dat
* XaeroWaypoints
* XaeroWorldMap

It's okay if some files/folders are missing in your instance.

## Source Code

This pack may contain custom builds of mods, especially whenever a new Minecraft version lands and official ports are not available yet. These mods are marked with `Kosmolot` in the version number. Source code for the ports is available on [my Github account](https://github.com/kosma).

## Credits

* Modpack icon: heroeant

title: Land Ahoy!
description: An exploration focused biome overhaul!
body:
![land ahoy banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ab89d05543e50583e9405fc95cea9cb116daeff_0.webp)
## Set sail for new lands!

Land Ahoy! is my biome overhaul datapack over a year in the making! I originally conceived it as something of a middle ground between Geophilic and CliffTree (two of my all time favorite datapacks, go check them out if you somehow haven’t) but it quickly developed an identity of its own. Every surface biome has been reinterpreted, from minor flourishes to major facelifts to make something for builders, adventures, and players that love to get lost. Something is always on the horizon!

## Features:

Some blocks and blocksets have been shuffled and relocated. Cherry and mangrove trees now grow in flower forests and swamps. Dry grass now sprouts from snow blocks in icy biomes. Mud now lines the shores of swamps and the beds of rivers. Firefly bushes dot the grass of savannas and birch forests, no longer awkwardly clustered against bodies of water.

Biome colors are tweaked across the board. The look of the sky now correlates with each biome’s temperature, ranging from a sun-bleached blue to a frosty indigo, with vanilla’s classic coloration squarely in the middle. Water colors follow suit with a more inviting palette designed to iron out jagged borders on the edges of ocean biomes. Just about every instance of grass or foliage has been tweaked. Savannas swap their murky olive grass for a scorched yellow, and dark forests get some bold, autumnal hues to better suit their spooky atmosphere.

The old guard of endless poppies and dandelions have been uprooted to make way for a more curated distribution of flowers. Forests and taigas feature vivid reds, meadows and birch forests host lively whites and yellows, flower forests and cherry groves star dazzling pinks and swamps and jungles grow a bouquet of cool blues and purples. If the Wilder Flowers mod is installed, the blocks it adds will be shuffled around to reflect these modified color palettes. Collect them all!

Trees and flowers are not the only thing shifted around… The skeletal trio of Strays, Bogged and Parched have been on the prowl, hunting unlucky explorers in unexpected locales! Venomous arrows whizz past the trees in jungles, dark forests and old growth taigas, and long-desiccated archers pick off targets at a distance over swaths of badlands and savanna. Speaking of the undead, zombie villagers are much more common but stay within the bounds of the biomes they once called home in another life…

## Special Thanks:

- misode's datapack generator
- inventivetalent's MC Assets explorer
- the Raspberry Flavoured discord server
- You, for reading this far!

title: CGRocket
description: A mod that adds various missiles, a satellite surveillance system and other various mechanics.
body:
Make sure to use **JEI**.

At the moment, the mod adds two types of missiles: Orbital and Ground-based.

**1. Orbital Missile (SS-X-31)**

To launch an orbital missile, you will need:

1.Laptop

2.Launchpad

3.Nuclear Tablet bound to you (press right-click)

4.The "SS-X-31" item

**Instructions:**
Place the SS-X-31 missile and your bound Nuclear Tablet into their respective slots in the Launchpad. Activate the pad with a redstone signal to send the missile into orbit.
Next, use the Laptop to set the target coordinates and press "Launch". The missile will strike the target immediately.

You can send several missiles into orbit first and launch them all later. The missile counter will not reset until all orbital missiles have been fired at their targets.

**2. Ground-based Missile (Tomahawk, Sculk Rocket, M612(Napalm))**

To launch a ground-based missile, you will need:
1. Laptop
2. Launchpad
3. Nuclear Tablet bound to you (press right-click)
4. Tomahawk missile item

**Instructions:**
Place the Tomahawk missile and your bound Nuclear Tablet directly into the Launchpad slots.
Open your Laptop, select the **"Tomahawk"** missile type, set the coordinates, and press "Launch" to fire(Also, after the missile disappears from the sky, it will begin to fall to the ground after 3 seconds). Unlike orbital missiles, these do not require a separate orbiting phase.

**Missile defense system**

To activate it, you need to use a *nuclear tablet* to right click on a *radar station* block and place it in the *launchpad* along with a *Patriot* missile.

If the *radar station* detects an incoming missile within 100 blocks, it will send a *Patriot* missile to intercept it (the *Patriot* missile must be within 100 blocks of the *radar station*).

Radar will launch up to four *Patriots* to intercept missile.

**Satellite Surveillance System**

You can launch an *Orbital Observation Satellite* via a carrier rocket to unlock satellite surveillance and targeting features on your *Nuclear Laptop*. (Don’t forget to have your *Nuclear Tablet* linked to you) To select target coordinates simply click the desired location on the map the coordinates will be entered automaticall leaving you only to launch the missile. If you open a location with ungenerated chunks the map may take a moment to load.

Satellite surveillance can be jammed using a *Jammer Block*. Jammer is activated by a redstone signal.

---

**General Info:**

*Crafting missiles requires a significant amount of redstone, so it is recommended to have mods that help you mine resources faster.

The mod features a simple quarry that is activated by a lever. After mining a certain number of blocks, the quarry will run out of power. To recharge it you need to click it with a 3x Compressed Redstone Block. While the quarry has its own internal storage it’s best to place an external container on top to collect the loot. If the quarry's internal storage becomes full it will stop working.

*There is also a command "/rocket x z" available, which launches a strike without requiring any rockets to be in orbit or crafted(requires administrator rights on the server).

The Fabric version of the mod requires the latest version of the **Fabric API**.

title: Cobblemon Radiant
description: Adds a rare Radiant variant for shiny Cobblemon Pokémon, with purple star effects, UI badges, alerts, commands, and small configurable IV/EV bonuses.
body:
# CobblemonRadiants

**CobblemonRadiants** adds a rare **Radiant** variant for shiny Cobblemon Pokémon.

Radiant Pokémon are designed as a special shiny-like variant: rarer than regular shinies, visually distinct, and slightly more valuable to catch without becoming overpowered.

## Overview

A Radiant Pokémon is still a shiny Pokémon at its core, but with an additional Radiant identity.

Radiants can appear from shiny Pokémon based on a configurable chance. By default, a shiny has a chance to become Radiant, making Radiants rarer and more rewarding to find.

The goal is simple: make shiny hunting more exciting without turning Radiants into boss forms or unbalanced Pokémon.

## Features

* Adds a new **Radiant** variant for shiny Cobblemon Pokémon.
* Radiants keep their shiny appearance.
* Adds a dedicated `radiant` aspect.
* Adds purple star visual effects around Radiant Pokémon.
* Adds a custom Radiant sound.
* Adds a Radiant UI badge in the Pokémon summary and PC.
* Keeps the normal shiny indicator visible.
* Adds configurable built-in Radiant alerts.
* Adds optional compatibility behavior with CobbleSpawnAlert Reforged.
* Adds configurable gameplay bonuses for Radiant Pokémon.
* Adds admin commands for testing, spawning, and giving Radiant Pokémon.
* Includes English and French translations.
* Includes a default configuration file.

## Radiant Bonuses

Radiant Pokémon can receive a small configurable quality bonus when they become Radiant.

By default, Radiants receive:

* 1 guaranteed perfect IV.
* A small EV bonus.
* Bonus applied only once.
* Optional protection against stacking too strongly with Alpha Pokémon.

These bonuses are intentionally lightweight. Radiants are meant to feel more valuable to catch, not to replace normal training or become unfairly stronger than other Pokémon.

## Visual Identity

Radiant Pokémon use a purple star theme:

* Purple star particles.
* Radiant UI badge.
* Radiant icon.
* Shiny icon remains visible.

Radiant is meant to feel like a rare shiny variant, not a boss or legendary form.

## Commands

### General

```mcfunction
/radiant status
```

Displays the current mod status.

```mcfunction
/radiant reload
```

Reloads the configuration.

### Debug / Admin

```mcfunction
/radiant debug make-nearest-radiant
```

Turns the nearest Cobblemon Pokémon into a Radiant Pokémon.

```mcfunction
/radiant debug spawn-radiant <pokemon> [level]
```

Spawns a Radiant Pokémon in the world.

```mcfunction
/radiant debug test-alert
```

Tests the built-in Radiant alert.

### Give Commands

```mcfunction
/giveradiant <pokemon> [level]
```

Gives yourself a Radiant Pokémon.

```mcfunction
/giveradiantother <player> <pokemon> [level]
```

Gives another player a Radiant Pokémon.

If the player’s party is full, Cobblemon will send the Pokémon to the PC when possible.

## Configuration

The config is generated here:

```text
config/CobblemonRadiants/cobblemonradiants.json
```

A default configuration is also included in the mod resources.

Main configurable options include:

* Enable or disable the Radiant system.
* Radiant chance from shiny Pokémon.
* Radiant visual effects.
* Built-in alerts.
* Alert sound.
* Radiant IV bonus.
* Radiant EV bonus.
* Alpha stacking behavior.
* CobbleSpawnAlert Reforged compatibility behavior.

## Compatibility

### Required

* Fabric API
* Cobblemon

### Optional

* CobbleSpawnAlert Reforged

If CobbleSpawnAlert Reforged is installed, CobblemonRadiants can disable its built-in alerts automatically, depending on the config. This avoids duplicate alert systems on servers using CSAR.

## Notes

CobblemonRadiants does not replace Cobblemon’s shiny system.

Radiant Pokémon are intended to be:

* Shiny-based.
* Rarer than normal shinies.
* Visually unique.
* Slightly more valuable to catch.
* Configurable for servers.

They are not intended to be overpowered boss Pokémon.

title: Jugs' Calories
description: A mod adding a calories based hunger system and a lot more.
body:
## About
Jugs' Calories adds new survival related mechanics like thirst, body-temperature, food-freshness and crop-nutrient system as well as a revamped, caloric based hunger system.

## Gameplay
Instead of the traditional hunger bar, you now have to consume an activity based amount of calories. Food will decay over time, which can be helped with by building a cellar and keeping your food stored in there. When growing crops, they now take much longer to grow and consume nutrients, which will slowly replenish over time when an area of farmland is not being used. You also need to manage your body temperature by utilizing hot and cold blocks and items like a bucket of snow or staying near a campfire. Health now regenerates much more slowly over time, making Golden Apples and Healing Potions much more useful now. Lastly, you need to sleep. Yes, I know. Groundbreaking idea.

## Features
- Ring overlay for water, food, temperature and fatigue with configurable colors
- Spoilage system for food
- Dynamic cellar building to reduce food spoilage
- Body temperature
- Much longer crop growth and farmland nutrients (taking into account chunk unloading)

# 🎨 Name Color Editor

Enhance your Minecraft server's identity! **Name Color Editor** is a lightweight Fabric mod that allows every player to express themselves by choosing a custom color for their username and chat messages.

![GUI of the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1588e5abe017087c96ef71032250f1106e0afe97_0.webp)

## ✨ Features

*   **Professional HSB Picker**: Open a beautiful, clean color editor with `/namecolor`.
    *   **16 Classic Swatches**: All standard vanilla Minecraft colors.
    *   **Hue-Saturation Square**: Pick any hue with precision.
    *   **Brightness Slider**: Fine-tune the luminosity of your chosen color.
*   **Chat Coloring Toggle**: Choose between coloring just your **name** or both your **name and chat messages**.
*   **Responsive UI**: Optimized layout that works on all screen sizes and GUI scales.
*   **Hex Support**: Type or paste any `#RRGGBB` code for total precision.

    *   💬 **Chat messages** (optional)
    *   📜 **Tab list**

*   **Server-Side Sync**: Colors are synchronized automatically across all online players.
*   **Persistent Storage**: Your color preferences are saved to the server and persist across restarts.

## 🚀 Installation

### 🖥️ Client & Server
**This mod is required on both the Client and the Server.**
1.  Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for **1.21.1**.

title: Death Recap
description: See where you died, track lost items, and find your way back with a recovery compass. Client-side — works on any server.
body:
# Death Recap

  Never lose your items again. When you die, Death Recap shows you exactly where it happened and guides you back.

  ## Features

  ### Death Screen Overlay
  When you die, an info panel appears showing:
  - **Exact coordinates** (X, Y, Z)
  - **Dimension** (Overworld / Nether / End)
  - **Biome**
  - **Items you had** at the time of death

  ### Recovery Compass HUD
  After respawning, a compact HUD appears at the top of your screen:
  - **Directional arrow** pointing toward your death location
  - **Distance** in blocks
  - **Despawn countdown timer** (5:00 → 0:00)
  - Auto-dismisses when you arrive within 5 blocks

  ### Death History Log
  Press **H** to open a full history of your past deaths:
  - Scrollable list of up to 50 deaths per world
  - Shows cause, coordinates, dimension, biome, and time
  - Click any entry and set it as a compass waypoint
  - Saved between sessions

  ## Controls

  | Key | Action |
  |-----|--------|
  | **H** | Open Death History |
  | **X** | Dismiss Recovery Compass |

  Both keys are rebindable in Controls → Miscellaneous.

  ## Configuration

  All features can be toggled individually in `config/deathrecap.json`:
  - Death screen overlay (coordinates, dimension, biome, inventory preview)
  - Recovery compass (despawn timer, distance, auto-hide distance)
  - Max history entries

  ## Why Death Recap?

  - **Client-side only** — install it and join any server, no server setup needed
  - **Lightweight** — no custom blocks, items, or entities
  - **Modpack-friendly** — works alongside grave mods, minimaps, and other utility mods
  - **Zero configuration** — works out of the box

title: PermaClicker
description: Simulates continuous left mouse button holding. Ideal for farming while AFK. Optionally suppresses the pause screen, allowing it to run in the background. Motion lock can be activated.
body:
PermaClicker keeps client-side mining/click input active while the mod is enabled, e. g. to provide a cobblestone farm while you're AFK. It is intended for single-player or explicitly allowed environments, with configurable safety limits.

## Anti-cheat notice ⚠️

PermaClicker automates input behavior. Use it only where this is explicitly allowed. On many servers this may violate rules and can result in penalties such as kick/ban.

## Quick start for players 🎮

1.  Put `PermaClicker` and `TurtleLib` (required dependency) in the `mods` folder.
2.  Start the game.
3.  Configure Hotkeys in Minecraft key binds. Defaults: `o` for Options, `F4` toggle on/off.
4.  Configure PermaClicker in-game via the config screen.

If you need PermaClicker for Minecraft 26.1 and earlier, you can find previous releases on the GitHub page.

## What PermaClicker provides ✨

*   configurable toggle key
*   in-game config screen for Fabric and NeoForge
*   overlay output
*   runtime mode: **Focused** or **Background**
*   auto-stop timer (`0..9999` minutes)
*   optional movement lock while active
*   optional update checks (Stable / Beta / Alpha)

## Runtime behavior 🧭

*   While PermaClicker is active, opening chat is intentionally blocked.
*   In **Focused** mode, `ESC` stops PermaClicker and opens the pause menu.
*   In **Background** mode, pause opening stays blocked while active.

## Tool durability

If you care about tool durability (breaking while PermaCLickers runs), you can use [Inventory Profiles Next](https://inventory-profiles-next.github.io/en/downloads/) to replace them before they break or after they're broken.

## Configuration ⚙️

Most settings are managed directly in the in-game config screen.

## Supported languages 🌍

PermaClicker bundles each locale as a JSON file. Included languages:

*   🇺🇸 English (en\_US)
*   🇩🇪 German (de\_DE)
*   🇸🇦 Arabic (ar\_SA)
*   🇪🇸 Spanish (es\_ES)
*   🇫🇷 French (fr\_FR)
*   🇮🇹 Italian (it\_IT)
*   🇯🇵 Japanese (ja\_JP)
*   🇰🇷 Korean (ko\_KR)
*   🇳🇱 Dutch (nl\_NL)
*   🇵🇱 Polish (pl\_PL)
*   🇵🇹 Portuguese (pt\_PT)
*   🇹🇷 Turkish (tr\_TR)
*   🇺🇦 Ukrainian (uk\_UA)
*   🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese (zh\_CN)

## More stuff
Check out my other projects:

![Logo of TImberella](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/D39NyyLa/1d13b2ec5691693a651df0c98d6e86cb404d268e_96.webp)
**Timberella:** Tree capitator / cutting / felling, leaves decay and replanting abilities. Completely configurable.
[Get it!](https://modrinth.com/plugin/timberella)

![Logo of Underwater Trees](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VTlC5BzA/e3fbc1bdc8059b66d300c06adc6e107c53b3c3b4_96.webp)
**Underwater Trees:** Allows placing and growing tree saplings underwater, with optional lightning requirements override.
[Get it!](https://modrinth.com/plugin/underwatertrees)

## Quick start for devs 🛠️

PermaClicker ships loader-local Gradle wrappers, so no global Gradle install is required.

*   Fabric build entrypoints: `fabric/gradlew` (Linux/macOS), `fabric/gradlew.bat` (Windows)
*   NeoForge build entrypoints: `neoforge/gradlew` (Linux/macOS), `neoforge/gradlew.bat` (Windows)

Typical tasks: `build`, `test`, `tasks`.

## AI support & privacy transparency 🤖

Parts of the source code and documentation were created with AI assistance.

*   **No personal player data is used** in this process.
*   Ideas, design decisions, and quality standards come from humans.
*   Quality assurance is reviewed and validated by humans.

title: Dungeons Essence
description: Content of Minecraft Dungeons in a new Minecraft Vanilla experience.
body:
---

🌟 Introduction

This mod aims to introduce a Minecraft Dungeons content experience into Minecraft Vanilla, bringing new combat mechanics, gear, and RPG elements straight to your world!


⚔️ New Gear

Click to see the New Weapons Arsenal






Click to see the New Armors




⚠️ Note: At the moment i just added 3 sets of armors, only for testing, all of them are functional.
---

🖥️ GUI Overhaul

Click to see the Custom RPG HUD


⚠️ Note: The Custom RPG HUD replaces the vanilla health and hunger bars. Visual features from mods like AppleSkin will not render on the RPG HUD. You can always disable the RPG HUD in the mod configs if you prefer the vanilla look!
---

📊 New Custom Stats

Welcome to the new RPG-style combat system! Your custom HUD now displays a variety of advanced statistics. Here is exactly what each stat does to help you build the ultimate character:



💡 Tip: You can toggle the Stats Box visibility at any time by pressing the "O" key (default keybind, fully customizable).


⚔️ Core Offensive & Defensive Stats (Click to expand) * **Attack Damage / Ranged Damage:** Shows your exact damage output. The HUD dynamically swaps between melee and ranged damage depending on the weapon in your main hand. * **Attack Speed:** Indicates how fast you can swing your melee weapons. * **Draft Speed:** A custom multiplier for Ranged Weapons. It dictates how fast you can draw a bow or load a crossbow. For example, a **2.0x** Draft Speed means you charge your weapon twice as fast. *(Highly synergistic with the Accelerate enchantment!)* * **Armor:** Reduces incoming physical damage. The HUD now calculates and displays the exact percentage (%) of physical damage you mitigate based on our custom RPG armor formula. * **Magic Resistance:** A brand-new defensive layer! Reduces incoming magical damage (e.g., Evoker fangs, Witch potions, Harming arrows, and magic weapons). Just like Armor, it displays the exact percentage of magic damage mitigated.
🗡️ Penetration & Lethality (Click to expand) * **Lethality (Physical):** Flat physical armor negation. It directly subtracts a fixed amount of Armor from your target before calculating your physical damage. Excellent for bursting down lightly armored targets. * **Armor Penetration:** Percentage-based physical armor negation. It ignores a specific % of the target's total Armor. The absolute best stat for shredding heavily armored bosses! * **Magic Lethality:** Flat magic resistance negation. Subtracts a fixed amount of Magic Resistance from your target, allowing your magic attacks to hit harder. * **Magic Penetration:** Percentage-based magic resistance negation. It ignores a specific % of the target's total Magic Resistance, making it essential against magically fortified enemies.
💥 Criticals & Extra Damage (Click to expand) * **Critical Chance:** The percentage probability that your attacks (both melee and ranged) will land a devastating Critical Strike. * **Critical Damage:** The damage multiplier applied when you successfully land a crit. For instance, a **1.5x** multiplier means your critical strikes deal 50% bonus damage. * **Additional magic damage on-hit:** Deals a fixed amount of extra magical damage with every successful strike. This damage is mitigated by the target's Magic Resistance. * **Additional true damage on-hit:** Deals a fixed amount of pure, unmitigated damage with every strike. True damage completely bypasses all Armor and Magic Resistance.
🩸 Sustain & Vitality (Click to expand) * **Additional Health Regeneration:** Grants passive health recovery over time, accurately measured and displayed in HP per second. * **Heal and shields power:** Amplifies your survivability by increasing the effectiveness of all incoming healing and applied shields by a specific percentage. * **Omnivamp:** The ultimate life-steal stat. It heals you for a percentage of *all* damage you deal to enemies, keeping you alive in the heat of battle!
---

✨ New Enchantments

Dungeons Essence introduces a massive variety of new enchantments, completely overhauling the combat experience. Whether you want to unleash devastating area-of-effect magic or become a rapid-firing archer, there is a build for you!

⚔️ Melee Enchantments (Click to expand) * **Ambush:** Deals massive extra damage when attacking unaware enemies while invisible. * **Bane of Illagers:** Deals significant bonus damage against all types of Illagers. * **Chains:** Attacks have a chance to chain nearby enemies together, heavily slowing them down. * **Committed:** Deals bonus damage against enemies that are already wounded. * **Critical Hit:** Grants a chance to inflict massive critical damage on every hit. * **Dual Wielding:** Boosts your attack damage when holding a matching synergistic weapon in your offhand. * **Echo:** Attacks have a chance to instantly trigger a second, follow-up strike. * **Exploding:** Defeated enemies explode, dealing damage to other nearby mobs. * **Freezing:** Chills enemies on hit, slowing their movement and attack speed for a few seconds. * **Gravity:** Creates a gravitational pull that drags nearby enemies toward the impact point of your attack. * **Mechanized:** Hold right-click to unleash a rapid flurry of attacks until the weapon overheats. * **Poison Cloud:** Attacks have a chance to conjure a lingering poison cloud that damages enemies over time. * **Rapier Flurry:** Unleashes a rapid flurry of consecutive strikes when using rapiers. * **Shared Pain:** When you defeat an enemy, any excess overkill damage is shared among other nearby enemies. * **Shattering Impact:** Your strikes shatter the ground, dealing a portion of your attack damage to all nearby enemies. * **Shockwave:** The final combo strike unleashes a forward shockwave that damages enemies in a straight line. * **Stunning:** Attacks have a chance to temporarily stun enemies, leaving them unable to move or attack. * **Swirling:** The final combo strike unleashes a swirling slash that damages all enemies around you. * **Thundering:** Attacks have a chance to summon a lightning bolt that damages the target and nearby enemies. * **Void Strike:** Applies a Void mark. The longer you wait before striking again, the more bonus damage your next attack deals. * **Weakening:** Your attacks weaken the target and nearby enemies, reducing the damage they deal. * **Wide Sweep:** Your attacks sweep through a much larger area, damaging more enemies at once.
🏹 Ranged Enchantments (Click to expand) * **Accelerate:** Increases fire rate for each consecutive shot. Resets if you stop firing for a second. * **Automatic:** Automatically and continuously fires arrows at a high fire rate while holding down the use button. * **Bonus Shot:** Fires an additional, weaker arrow at a secondary nearby target. * **Bubble Burst:** Traps the hit enemy inside a floating water bubble. The bubble bursts if they take damage. * **Chain Reaction:** Arrows have a chance to split into five additional arrows in all directions upon impact. * **Crossbow Burst:** Fires a rapid burst of multiple arrows in a single shot. * **Exploding Arrow:** Arrows violently explode upon impact, dealing area-of-effect damage. * **Growing:** Arrows grow in size and deal increased damage the longer they remain in the air. * **Harped:** Fires a wide, fan-shaped spread of additional arrows with each shot. * **Harpooned:** Arrows ignore water resistance, traveling at full speed while submerged. * **Hunter's Promise:** Marks the target, forcing your tamed pets to focus their attacks on them. * **Poison Trail:** Fired arrows leave a trail of poison clouds behind them. * **Ratchet Fire:** Fires a devastating burst of arrows, but requires a cooldown period to recharge. * **Reliable Ricochet:** Fully charged arrows are guaranteed to bounce between multiple nearby enemies. * **Ricochet:** Arrows have a chance to bounce off the initial target and strike another nearby enemy. * **Roll Charge:** When you perform a roll, your next ranged attack within the timing window will automatically be fully charged. * **Shadow Barb:** Allows you to fire a few shots without breaking Shadow Form, perfect for stealthy attacks. * **Shadow Shot:** Defeating an enemy grants a chance to briefly enter Shadow Form (Invisibility). * **Supercharge:** Fully charged shots deal significantly more damage and travel with enough force to knock enemies back. * **Tempo Theft:** Steals a portion of a mob's movement speed and gives it to you for a few seconds. * **Wild Rage:** Hits have a chance to enrage the target, forcing it to attack other nearby monsters instead of you. * **Wind Pull:** Arrows create a wind vortex on impact, pulling hit enemies toward the shooter.
🛡️ Armor Enchantments (Click to expand)
Here are the powerful enchantments you can apply to your new armor sets!



👻 Souls & Utility Enchantments (Click to expand) * **Absorption:** Absorbs incoming damage and unleashes it as extra damage on your next attack. * **Busy Bee:** Defeating an enemy has a chance to summon a friendly bee to fight for you. * **Dynamo:** Moving builds up energy, adding bonus damage to your next attack for every block traveled. * **Enigma Resonator:** Grants a chance to deal double damage, with the odds increasing based on the number of souls you hold. * **Prospector:** Greatly increases the chance to find Emeralds dropped by defeated enemies. * **Radiance:** Hits have a chance to spawn a radiant aura that instantly heals you and nearby allies. * **Rampaging:** Defeating an enemy has a chance to trigger a rampage, temporarily boosting your attack speed. * **Rushdown:** Grants a temporary burst of movement speed after defeating an enemy. * **Soul Siphon:** Hits have a chance to instantly grant you multiple extra souls.
