title: Box'd
description: A Modpack for random, vanilla-esque mods that tries not to stray too far from the regular, boxy gameplay.
body:
BOX'D

pronounced as boxed ; is a Fabric/Quilt Modpack that's basically my (the creator's) attempt at making some sort of "Vanilla+" styled pack.

Most mods included will be pretty basic, but there will also be a small sprinkling of spice that is sure to give the player a more fun experience overall while also not straying *too* far from usual.

Features

Some of my main focuses will be Decorations and Extra Features. But of course, there will be some mods that include some Optimization, QoL and even some random mods that are there simply because of their fun features.
While i did say this was trying to go for a "Vanilla+" style, do expect a lot of quirky mods that mess around with the game quite a bit.

I'M NOT SURE IF THIS WILL WORK ON MULTIPLAYER! While it's entirely possible for you to run these mods on a server with your friends, I'm not 100% sure how the experience will be as i'm mainly focusing on the Singleplayer side of things.

Afterall, this started mostly as a way to share what mods i use to my friends.

Some notable Mods w/ Descriptions

(Note: These aren't ALL the mods included.)

Main/X-tra Features

| **Mod Name** | **Description** | | :-----: | :------: | | [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra) | Focusing on Technology and Exploration, this mod will allow you to explore the stars beyond using rockets! | | [BetterEnd](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend)
[BetterNether](https://modrinth.com/mod/betternether) | Tired of how little there is to do in the other dimensions? These 2 mods will make sure your experience in the End + Nether is vastly different than your normal vanilla gameplay. | | [CustomSkinLoader](https://modrinth.com/mod/customskinloader) | Mainly here for those that want to use HD Bedrock skins on Java, this mod allows you to load skins from various Skin Servers (including locally)! | | [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi) | A mod like this is essential with so many mods! title: Ore Miner
description: Ore miner from nothing
body:
This mod is made for **Technical Modpacks**
The main task of the mod - It gives players opportunity to concentrate on automatization, not on the dull mining of ore.

# How it works?
When you put the miner in a chunk, it randomizes whether or not there will be ore in the chunk as well as the amount of ore that is in that chunk.

You can put only one miner in a chunk. It does **NOT** dig ore out of the chunk, it **GENERATES** it out of nothing. If the ore in the chunk runs out you can simply move it to another chunk where ore will be. You cannot randomize ore simply by breaking and putting a miner because the information about what block generated and "vein" size is stored in the world. For example you put the miner in a chunk and get a gold ore you can't change that by breaking it and putting it in again, you will get gold ore again.

**The miner uses FE energy to do this, so you will need other mods to generate it.**
   
Every 63 chunks or 1008 blocks from the spawn the amount of ore will be multiplied by a multiplier.
You can configure all of this in the config. By default "vein" size randomized between 800 and 2000 blocks multiplied on "multiplier" (by default 1.0 + 0.1 for each 1008 blocks from spawn). 

## How to craft:
![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/PpWtivp.png)

## Miner Screen:
By default screen show count of ore:
* 0  - no ore!
* <500 - Very Few!
* <1000 - Few
* <1500 - Medium
* 1500+ - Large

Это тщательно несбалансированный сборник визуальных штучек, уютных звуков, улучшений производительности и специальных модов для PepeLand 10.
Основан на официальной сборке из ТГ-канала PepeLand с дополнениями по собственному вкусу.

🐸 Специальные моды для PepeLand 10:
- 🧩 PepeLand Helper
- 🆙 Action Bar Info (тот самый мод с координатами и информацией о сервере со стрима)
- 🏷️ PepeLand Badges (серверные значки из Tab-листа отображаются рядом с никнеймами игроков прямо в мире)
- 🛠️ Pochatok (сборная солянка небольших удобств и приколов для игры и строительства)

... и ресурспаки:
- 🌿 оф. ресурспак PepeLand
- 🎞️ PepeLand Loading Screen (экран загрузки в стиле PepeLand)
- 📕 PepeSPLASH (сплэши на главном экране Minecraft в стиле PepeLand)
- 🏙️ Pepeland 9 Panorama (панорама спавна PepeLand, в паке стоит ТЗ, доступны также другие варианты - [ссылка](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/panorama-mp1-ppl-9))

Здесь есть все распространённые на PepeLand моды, в том числе (но и не только) следующие:

Для большой прорисовки используется Bobby (сохраняет чанки локально), а для путешествий — Xaero's World Map. Строить помогают Axiom, Litematica с предпросмотром схем и Freecam. Flashback позволяет записывать игру, пересматривать записи и экспортировать красивые кинематографичные кадры.

В сборке есть Simple Voice Chat, e4mc для открытия одиночного мира друзьям без отдельного сервера и Figura для глубокой кастомизации модели игрока. Также установлены Stendhal (улучшение редактирования табличек) и ImagineBook (картинки в книгах). Включён мод на динамическое освещение LambDynamicLights, добавлена сортировка инвентаря. В меню креатива поддерживается многоязычный поиск (благодаря моду Language Reload по умолчанию можно искать на русскомъ дореформенномъ, русском и английском (США)). Появление чанков анимировано (возможно отключить в настройках).

Улучшения и исправления производительности включают Sodium, ModernFix, C2ME, Entity Culling, FerriteCore, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, BadOptimizations, ScalableLux, AsyncParticles, Dynamic FPS, FastBoot, FastQuit и другие. Iris отвечает за шейдеры, а все необходимые моды для работы сложных ресурспаков (Polytone, Puzzle, Continuity, EMF и ETF) уже добавлены и настроены.

### О красивом:

Добавлены различные улучшения чата (длина, плавная анимация, калькулятор), интерфейса (предпросмотр карт, мешочков, шалкербоксов). Для стиля есть красивые курсоры, частицы в инвентаре и целая компания небольших украшений мира: более живой дождь, брызги и пузырьки, падающие листья, следы на воде, улучшенные взрывы, небо и освещение.

Sound Physics Remastered добавляет объём и отражения звука, а набор небольших звуковых модов — уютные звуки воды, капель, пузырьков, интерфейса и окружения. В сборку уже входят BSL, Complementary Reimagined, Kappa, Solas и шейдеры Sildur's: их можно выбрать по настроению или не включать вовсе.

В меню ресурспаков можно включить иммерсивные интерфейсы, анимации моделей игроков, альтернативные полосы боссов, SummitMC и множество небольших тематических паков. Количество здоровья мобов отображается на их моделях, добавлены анимации еды, специальные текстуры для книг зачарований, светящиеся элементы и более выразительные модели существ.

### О весёлом:
Добавлены TetrisMC, «Сапёр» прямо в меню игры, PatPat и OrthoCamera для особенно убедительного изометрического Minecraft. В ресурспаках есть ножи из Counter Strike (CStrikify), звук достижений из Стима, коты потолще, головные уборы для некоторых существ и другие вещи разной степени необходимости. Головы игроков увеличиваются, когда они говорят в голосовой чат.

Предложения по добавлению новых штуковин принимаются в лс в дискорде (@krutosh2). Не стесняйтесь адаптировать сборку под себя. Назначения клавиш по умолчанию могут показаться странными - возможно стоит поменять. Из коробки включён русскiй дореформенный.

Также выражаем благодарность авторам всех модов, ресурспаков и шейдерпаков, которые включены в сборку; ссылки на них можно найти в разделе зависимостей версии модпака.

# **🇬🇧 EN**:
> "Exquisitely pointless — because sometimes, that’s the point."

This is a carefully unbalanced collection of visual tweaks, cozy sounds, performance improvements, and special mods for PepeLand 10.
Based on the official build from the PepeLand Telegram channel with some personal additions and adjustments.

🐸 Special mods for PepeLand 10:

- 🧩 PepeLand Helper
- 🆙 Action Bar Info (the one that shows coordinates and server info from the stream)
- 🏷️ PepeLand Badges (server badges from the Tab list are displayed next to player names directly in the world)
- 🛠️ Pochatok (an assorted collection of small conveniences and oddities for playing and building)

... and resource packs:
- 🌿 official PepeLand resource pack
- 🎞️ PepeLand Loading Screen (a loading screen in the PepeLand style)
- 📕 PepeSPLASH (main menu splashes in the PepeLand style)
- 🏙️ Pepeland 9 Panorama (PepeLand spawn panorama; the included one is TradeZone, other variants are also available — [link](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/panorama-mp1-ppl-9))

This includes all the popular mods used on PepeLand, including (but not limited to) the following:

For extended render distance it uses Bobby (which saves chunks locally), while Xaero's World Map takes care of travelling. Axiom, Litematica with schematic previews, and Freecam help with building. Flashback can record gameplay, replay it, and export rather lovely cinematic shots.

The build includes Simple Voice Chat, e4mc for opening a singleplayer world to friends without running a separate server, and Figura for extensive player-model customisation. There is also Stendhal (improved sign editing) and ImagineBook (images in books). LambDynamicLights provides dynamic lighting, and inventory sorting has been added. The creative menu supports multilingual search (thanks to Language Reload, you can search in pre-reform Russian, Russian, and English (US) by default). Chunk loading is animated and can be disabled in the options.

Performance enhancements and fixes include Sodium, ModernFix, C2ME, Entity Culling, FerriteCore, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, BadOptimizations, ScalableLux, AsyncParticles, Dynamic FPS, FastBoot, FastQuit, and others. Iris handles shaders, while everything needed by advanced resource packs (Polytone, Puzzle, Continuity, EMF, and ETF) is already included and configured.

### About the beautiful:

Various chat improvements have been added (length limit, smooth animation, calculator), as well as interface tweaks (previews for maps, bundles, and shulker boxes). For style, there are custom cursors, inventory particles, and an entire gathering of small world embellishments: livelier rain, splashes and bubbles, falling leaves, wakes on water, improved explosions, skies, and lighting.

Sound Physics Remastered gives sound proper space and reflections, while a collection of smaller audio mods adds cozy water, drip, bubble, interface, and ambient sounds. BSL, Complementary Reimagined, Kappa, Solas, and Sildur's shaders are already included: choose one to suit the mood, or leave them disabled entirely.

The resource pack menu offers immersive interfaces, animated player models, alternative boss bars, SummitMC, and plenty of smaller themed packs. Mob health is displayed directly on models; food has eating animations; enchanted books have special textures; and creatures gain more expressive models, emissive details, and animations.

### About the fun:

Added TetrisMC, Minesweeper directly in the game menus, PatPat, and OrthoCamera for an especially convincing isometric Minecraft. The resource packs include Counter-Strike knives (CStrikify), Steam achievement sounds, fatter cats, hats for selected creatures, and other additions of varying necessity. Players' heads get bigger when they talk in voice chat.

Suggestions for new additions are welcome via Discord DMs (@krutosh2). Feel free to adapt the pack to your liking - the default keybinds might feel unusual and could use adjusting. By default, pre-reform Russian orthography is enabled.

### To install via Prism Launcher:
Click Add instance -> select Modrinth -> Search for this modpack -> Click OK.

### Updating via Prism Launcher:
You can also easily update your build to the latest version (released slightly less than once a month) via Prism Launcher. Select Build -> Modify -> Modrinth tab -> Update.

### Afterword and acknowledgements
If you are looking for a serious and truly comfortable modpack, I recommend checking out [Xleb's work](https://modrinth.com/user/Xleb/modpacks). When creating this monster, we borrowed several mods from his modpack and also used his [loading screen](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-loading-screen). We would also like to express our gratitude to the authors of all the mods, resource packs, and shader packs included in the build; links to them can be found in the modpack version dependencies section.

title: EoA Auction House and Economy
description: Server-side Fabric auction house and economy with SQLite persistence, buyouts, bidding, claims, and configurable branding.
body:
Echoes of Aegis Auction House is a server-side Fabric auction house mod built for Minecraft/Fabric `26.1.2`.

It adds a simple chest-based auction interface where players can list items, buy items outright, bid on auctions, and claim won, bought, expired, or cancelled items. It also includes a built-in SQLite economy with balance commands, player payments, admin controls, starting balances, and configurable playtime rewards.

Features

- Server-side only Fabric mod
- Simple chest GUI
- Buyout listings
- Bidding with previous-bid refunds
- Claim system for bought, won, expired, and cancelled items
- 10 active listings per player
- No taxes or listing fees
- SQLite persistence
- Built-in SQLite economy
- `/money`, `/pay`, and `/eco` commands
- Configurable currency names
- Configurable starting balances
- Configurable playtime rewards
- Async database handling
- Auction expiration scheduler
- Configurable auction house display name
- Hover details showing seller, buyout, current bid, next bid, top bidder, and time remaining

Requirements

- Minecraft `26.2`
- Fabric Loader `0.19.2` or newer
- Fabric API
- Java `25` or newer

Commands

- `/ah` opens the auction house.
- `/ah page <page>` opens a specific page.
- `/ah sell <buyout> [minBid] [hours]` lists the item in your main hand.
- `/ah bid <listingId> <amount>` places a bid.
- `/ah buy <listingId>` buys out a listing.
- `/ah claim` opens claim pickup.
- `/ah cancel <listingId>` cancels one of your active listings.
- `/ah balance` shows fallback economy balance.
- `/ah admin balance add <player> <amount>` adds fallback money.
- `/ah admin expire` manually runs auction expiration.
- `/ah admin reload` reloads the config.
- `/money` shows your balance.
- `/money top` shows the richest players.
- `/pay <player> <amount>` pays another player.
- `/eco balance <player>` checks another player's balance.
- `/eco set <player> <amount>` sets a balance.
- `/eco add <player> <amount>` adds money.
- `/eco take <player> <amount>` removes money.
- `/eco top` shows the richest players.

Configuration

On first server start, the mod creates:

```json
world/echoesauctionhouse/config.json
```

Example:

```json
{
  "auctionHouseName": "Aegis Market",
  "currencySingular": "coin",
  "currencyPlural": "coins",
  "startingBalance": 100,
  "payCommandEnabled": true,
  "playtimeRewardsEnabled": true,
  "playtimeRewardAmount": 10,
  "playtimeRewardMinutes": 15
}
```

Use `/ah admin reload` or restart the server after changing the config.

title: OMWH
description: Adds /home and /spawn teleport commands that stay in the player's current dimension, with configurable cooldowns, messages, aliases, and mount/passenger support.
body:
# OMWH — On My Way Home

OMWH adds practical `/home` and `/spawn` commands for Fabric servers and singleplayer worlds. It gives players a way back to safe points without turning those commands into cross-dimension warps.

`/home` sends a player to their current respawn point, such as a bed or respawn anchor. `/spawn` sends them to the spawn point for the dimension they are already in: Overworld spawn, Nether spawn, or the End's obsidian platform.

## What it does

- Adds `/home` and `/spawn` teleport commands
- Keeps teleports inside the player's current dimension
- Brings mounts and vehicle passengers along for the ride
- Supports server-side installs, so players do not need the mod on their client
- Lets admins configure cooldowns for normal use, PvP, recent damage, and joining the server
- Supports custom command names, custom messages, sounds, and particles
- Creates a JSON config at `config/omwh.json` on first launch

## Good to know

OMWH is meant for servers that want useful travel commands without giving players global warp buttons. It helps players get home, regroup, or recover from awkward spots while still leaving dimension travel to portals and normal gameplay.

The mod works in singleplayer too. For dedicated servers, install it on the server and make sure Fabric API is installed.

## Links

- [PyreHaven Discord](https://discord.gg/tZ6Hx2ETA3)

- [Source code](https://github.com/ff-tech-xyz/omwh)

title: EasyNiceTab
description: Minimalist Minecraft tab list plugin
body:
# EasyNiceTab

## Description:
EasyNiceTab is a minimalist plugin for Minecraft (Spigot/Paper/Purpur) version 1.21.x/26.1.X that allows you to manually update each player's TAB list. The plugin is lightweight, easy to configure, and does not require any external libraries.

## Main Features:
 – Updates the TAB list for all players when the /tabreload command is executed. 
 – Supports Minecraft color codes (&a, &b, &c, etc.). 
 – Uses custom placeholders for dynamic information. 
 – TAB texts are fully configurable via config.yml. 

## Supported Placeholders:
 – (name) — the player's nickname. 
 
 – (ping) — the player's ping in milliseconds. 
 
 – (ple) — number of online players. 
 
 – (world) — the name of the world the player is currently in. 
 
 - (PlayersLine) - Line where should be nicknames of players
 
## NEW Version 1.2:
> Small changes to the config. (now you can choose the animation update time yourself)

<details>
<summary>Config</summary>
==========================================
# EasyNiceTab v1.2 - Advanced Visual Config
# ==========================================

# This block is active when animation_enabled: false
# (PlayersLine) marks where the player list will appear
Normal TAB:
  - "&8&m-------&r &b&lMY SERVER &8&m-------"
  - "              &7Welcome back, &f(name)&7!"
  - "(PlayersLine)"
  - "&3World: &f(world)  &eOnline: &f(ple)"
  - "&8&m--------------------------"

# Legacy mode — simple header/footer text at top and bottom of the tab
Use Old Tab Type: false
header: "&aWelcome, (name)!"
footer-left: "&ePing: (ping)"
footer-right: "&bPlayers: (ple) &dWorld: (world)"

settings:

> Now you can sync your settings via MySQL/MariaDB. Just apply changes to your config and run /tabreload. The plugin will save them to the database, and all other servers will automatically pull your config when you reload them.

<details>
<summary>database.yml</summary>
# ==========================================
# EasyNiceTab Database Configuration
# ==========================================

# Choose the storage type.
# 'local' - Uses only the local config.yml (MySQL is disabled).
# 'mysql' - Connects to MySQL/MariaDB to sync config.yml across multiple servers.
storage_type: local

mysql:
  host: "XX.XX.XX.XX"
  port: 3306
  database: "easynicetab"
  username: "root"
  password: "password"

  # Set to true if your database server requires an SSL connection.

  useSSL: false

  # Note: You do not need to create any tables manually.
  # The plugin will automatically create the 'easynicetab_sync' table if it doesn't exist.
</details>

title: Chat Tabs
description: Client-side Fabric mod that adds tabbed chat with automatic channel switching. Filter messages by Global, Local, and Private channels.
body:
# Chat Tabs

A lightweight **client-side** Fabric mod that adds a tabbed chat interface to Minecraft. Automatically sorts messages into channels like Global, Local, and Private messages.

## Features

- **Tabbed Chat Interface** - Switch between chat channels with clickable tabs
- **Automatic Sorting** - Messages are automatically categorized based on command prefixes
- **Channel Support** - Works with /g (global), /l (local), and /tell (private)
- **Clean UI** - Minimal, non-intrusive tab bar above the chat
- **Lightweight** - Client-side only, no server installation needed

## Supported Channels

| Tab | Commands | Description |
|-----|----------|-------------|
| All | - | Shows all messages |
| Global | /g | Server-wide chat |
| Local | /l | Nearby players |
| Private | /tell, /msg | Direct messages |

## How to Use

1. Install the mod and join a server
2. Chat tabs appear above the chat window
3. Click a tab to filter messages by channel
4. Type commands as usual - messages auto-sort

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21+
- Fabric Loader 0.16.0+
- Fabric API
- Java 21+

## Compatibility

- Works with servers using standard chat channel plugins
- Compatible with other client-side mods
- Server-side installation not required

---

*Found a bug or have a suggestion? Open an issue on GitHub!*

# Blad Modpack (WIP)
a modpack originally designed for a two week minecraft session that lasted too long. 

It now is technical, automation and adventure modpack, with the idea of making vanilla mechanics neccessary for progression.

# Work in Progress
The modpack is still in a alpha stage, expect frequent updates, game breaking changes, mods addition or removal!

# What to Expect
## Automation and Progression:
We’ve included mods that allow for the automation of key processes, making tasks easier as you advance through the game. Whether you lean towards technical setups like Mekanism or prefer the farming-centered Mystical Agriculture, the choice is yours.

## Exploration and RPG Enhancements:
A richer Overworld, Nether, and End, with improved structure generation and new dimensions like The Aether.
Unique artifacts, backpacks, and treasures waiting to be discovered.
More immersive survival mechanics: thirst, temperature, and seasonal farming cycles that challenge your skills.
Dangerous mobs to add excitement to every encounter.

## Balanced Crafting and Gameplay:
To maintain a satisfying story progression, we’ve adjusted some crafting recipes:
Incorporating Netherite for high-tier items, using Shulker Boxes instead of chests for backpacks, incorporating some Aether materials into other mods crafting recipes and so on for a more rewarding endgame feeling.

## Write Your Own Story
With just the right balance of difficulty and rewarding gameplay, this is the perfect modpack for those who seek a refined minecraft experience with a touch of survival, exploration, and RPG elements.

The adventure is yours to create!

title: SafeChest
description: Never lose your items again! SafeChest automatically saves your inventory in a protected chest when you die. Teleport or fetch it back with simple commands.
body:
---

## 📦 SafeChest v0.0.5 — The Ultimate Player Safety & Server Management System

> **Tired of losing everything when you die?** SafeChest automatically saves your entire inventory, armor, and off-hand item into a chest at your death location. Recover it easily — no more rage-quitting after falling into lava!
>
> **Version 0.0.5 is a REVOLUTION.** We’ve added professional admin tools, sound effects, animated holograms, PlaceholderAPI integration, pagination, live GUI updates, and fixed critical performance bugs. This isn’t just a Death Chest plugin — it’s the **ultimate safety net and server management suite** for your players and staff.

---

## ✨ Key Features — v0.0.5 Edition

🛡️ **Auto-Protection & Anti-Griefing**  
Only you (or admins) can open or break your chest. Configurable protection from entity/block explosions. **Breaking your own chest now instantly restores your inventory — no more misclicks!**

⏳ **Live Multi-Line Animated Hologram Timer**  
Floating display shows your name, item count, and real-time countdown. **Survives server restarts.**  
✨ **NEW:** Holograms now **blink in red/yellow** when time is running out (configurable threshold and colors).  
✨ **NEW:** Option to blink **only the `{time}` placeholder** for subtle, elegant alerts.

🧭 **`/sctp` — Teleport to Chest (Index Support)**  
One click, and you’re back at your death spot. Use `/sctp 2` to teleport to a specific chest from your list. Configurable "force teleport" if no safe spot is found.  
🔊 **NEW:** Play a configurable sound on teleport.

🧲 **`/scfetch` — Bring Chest to You**  
Perfect for deaths in the void, lava, or caves. The chest (and its hologram) move with you.  
🔊 **NEW:** Play a configurable sound on fetch.

👁️ **`/scpreview` — Live Peek Inside (Auto-Refresh & Close Button)**  
View chest contents without moving — safe and read-only. Fully customizable GUI.  
✨ **NEW:** GUI **auto-refreshes every 5 seconds** from the database. If the chest expires while you’re viewing it, the GUI closes automatically.  
✨ **NEW:** Dedicated **BARRIER close button** in slot 44 for explicit closure.

📋 **`/sclist` — All Active Chests (With Pagination!)**  
Clickable list of all your chests. Teleport to any instantly. Sort by time, filter by world, show UUIDs.  
✨ **NEW:** Results are now **paginated (5 per page)** with clickable `[Previous]` and `[Next]` buttons. Use `/sclist 3` to jump to page 3.

💰 **Vault Economy Support (With Logging)**  
Charge players for `/sctp` or `/scfetch` — configurable per group. Action Bar feedback on payment.  
📝 **NEW:** All payments and chest interactions are now **logged to the server console** for auditing and debugging.

👥 **Group-Based Configuration (With Custom Chest Materials!)**  
Define custom rules for `default`, `vip`, `admin` — different durations, limits, prices, **and even chest materials** (e.g., VIPs get Barrels, Admins get Shulker Boxes).  
> 💡 Players are assigned to the **first group** they have permission for.

💬 **Interactive Death Messages (With Dynamic Cost & Time)**  
After dying, get clickable buttons: **[TP]**, **[FETCH]**, **[PREVIEW]**. **Fully configurable per button.**  
✨ **NEW:** Hover text for buttons now shows **dynamic placeholders** like `{cost}` and `{time}`. Example: `"Cost: 50 coins. Expires in: 2m 30s."`

💾 **Persistence & Auto-Restoration**  
Supports **SQLite or MySQL** storage. **Chests and holograms are restored on server start.**  
⚠️ **IMPORTANT:** Table name changed from `angelchests` to `safechests` — **manual migration required** on update.

⚙️ **Ultra-Configurable**  
Control **everything**: particle types, action bar messages, GUI titles, button visibility, world restrictions, explosion protection, **sounds, hologram animations, and much more** — all editable in `config.yml`.

🔄 **`/safechestreload`**  
Reload configs without restarting the server — essential for live admins. Safer than `/reload`.

🎨 **Visual & Audio Feedback**  
❤️ Configurable particles on creation. ✨ Configurable particles on recovery. Optional Action Bar messages.  
🔊 **NEW:** Configurable **sounds** on creation, restore, teleport, and expiration.

🌐 **Multi-World Support**  
Enable or disable the plugin in specific worlds. Filter `/sclist` to show only the current world.  
✨ **IMPROVED:** Configuration now uses `behavior.disabled-worlds` (a blacklist) for clearer logic.

🧠 **PlaceholderAPI Integration**  
✨ **BRAND NEW:** Use placeholders like `%safechest_time_left%`, `%safechest_item_count%`, `%safechest_location%` in **any plugin that supports PlaceholderAPI** (scoreboards, chat, menus, etc.).

🛠️ **Admin Command Suite (`/safechestadmin`)**  
✨ **BRAND NEW:** A powerful toolkit for server staff:
*   `inspect <player>`: List all active chests for a player (click to teleport).
*   `delete <uuid>`: Delete a specific chest by its UUID.
*   `purge`: Manually purge all expired chests from the database.
*   `stats`: Show server-wide statistics (total active/expired chests, players with chests, etc.).

⚠️ **Critical Bug Fixes:**
*   **🐞 Fixed: Deadlock on Chest Interaction/Breaking** — No more server freezes when clicking or breaking chests. Operations are now fully asynchronous.
*   **🐞 Fixed: Hologram Timer Inactive on Restart** — Holograms now start their countdown timer correctly after a server reboot.
*   **🐞 Fixed: Economy Errors Not Logged** — Payment failures are now logged to the server console for easy debugging.

---

## 📘 Wiki: How to Use SafeChest v0.0.5

### 🧭 1. Basic Usage (For Players)

#### 💀 When You Die
- A chest will automatically appear at your death location.
- All your items (inventory, armor, off-hand) are stored inside.
- You’ll receive a **configurable** chat message with clickable buttons:
  - **[TP]** → `/sctp` — Teleports you to the chest. Hover shows cost and time remaining.
  - **[FETCH]** → `/scfetch` — Brings the chest to you. Hover shows cost and time remaining.
  - **[PREVIEW]** → `/scpreview` — Shows chest contents without moving. Hover shows time remaining.

#### 📥 To Recover Your Items
- **Walk to the chest** and **right-click it** to restore your inventory.
- Or use **`/sctp`** to teleport to it.
- Or use **`/scfetch`** to bring it to you.

#### 👀 Preview Your Chest (No Movement Needed)
```bash
/scpreview
```
- Opens a virtual inventory showing all your stored items.
- Completely safe — you can’t take or modify anything.
- The GUI **updates live** every 5 seconds. If the chest expires, the GUI closes automatically.
- Click the **red BARRIER** in the bottom row to close it manually.

#### 📋 List All Your Active Chests (Paginated!)
```bash
/sclist
```
- Shows all your active chests in pages of 5.
- **Configurable**: Filter by current world, sort by expiration time, show UUID in hover.
- Click any entry to teleport directly to that chest (if you have permission).
- Use `/sclist 2` to jump to page 2.

---

### ⚙️ 2. Configuration (For Server Admins)

#### 📁 Files You Can Customize

- `config.yml` — **Main settings**: storage, chest material, hologram text, particle types, death message buttons, GUI options, world restrictions, explosion protection, **sounds, hologram animations, logging, and much more**.
- `groups.yml` — Define player groups (e.g., `default`, `vip`, `admin`) with custom durations, chest limits, command prices, **and chest materials**.
- `lang.yml` — Translate or customize every message in the plugin, including **new messages for pagination, admin commands, and logging**.

#### 🎯 Example: Creating a VIP Group

In `groups.yml`:

```yaml
vip:
  safechest-duration: 600      # 10 minutes
  max-allowed-safechests: 10   # Can have up to 10 active chests
  price-teleport: 50.0         # Costs 50 coins to teleport
  price-fetch: 100.0           # Costs 100 coins to fetch
  material: "BARREL"           # ✅ NEW: VIPs get Barrels instead of Chests!
```

Then, give players the permission:  
`safechest.group.vip`

> 💡 Players are assigned to the **first group** they have permission for.

#### 🖋️ Customizing the Hologram & Death Message

In `config.yml`:

```yaml
angelchest:
  hologram-text: "&a&l[SafeChest]&r\n&b{player}\n&7{items} items / {time}"

# ✅ NEW SECTION: HOLOGRAM ANIMATION
hologram-animation:
  enabled: true
  threshold-seconds: 10 # Start blinking when 10 seconds or less remain
  color-on: "RED"
  color-off: "YELLOW"
  blink-only-time-placeholder: true # Only blink the {time} part

death-message:
  enabled: true
  show-buttons: true
  show-button-tp: true
  show-button-fetch: false # Disable fetch globally
  show-button-preview: true
```

Placeholders (for `hologram-text`, `lang.yml`, and death message hovers):
- `{player}` — Player’s name.
- `{items}` — Total number of items in the chest.
- `{time}` — Time remaining until expiration.
- `{cost}` — Cost of the action (for death message hovers).

> ✅ **Multi-line holograms are now fully supported and restored on server restart.**

#### 🎮 Customizing the Player Experience

In `config.yml`:

```yaml
messages:
  use-action-bar: true # Show "Chest Created!" in action bar instead of chat
  use-particles: true
  particle-on-create: "HEART"
  particle-on-restore: "END_ROD"

# ✅ NEW SECTION: SOUNDS
sounds:
  enabled: true
  on-create: "ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP"
  on-restore: "ENTITY_ENDERMAN_TELEPORT"
  on-teleport: "ENTITY_ENDERMAN_TELEPORT"
  on-expire: "ENTITY_ITEM_BREAK"

commands:
  preview-gui:
    title: "&6My Items - SafeChest" # Change the GUI title
    info-item-material: "BOOK" # Change the info item
    force-close-only-with-esc: true # Only close preview with ESC key

  aclist:
    show-only-current-world: true # Only show chests in the player's current world
    sort-by-expiration: true # Show expiring chests first
    show-uuid-in-hover: false # Hide UUID (useful for debugging if true)
```

#### 🛡️ Advanced Behavior Control

In `config.yml`:

```yaml
behavior:
  # ✅ RENAMED: From 'enabled-worlds' to 'disabled-worlds'
  disabled-worlds: ["world_the_end"] # Disable plugin in The End
  protect-from-entity-explosions: true # Protect from Creepers
  protect-from-block-explosions: false # Allow TNT to destroy chests
  force-clear-drops-on-death: true # Fix double-drop bug
```

---

### 💰 3. Economy Setup

SafeChest integrates with **Vault**. Make sure you have a compatible economy plugin installed (e.g., EssentialsX, CMI).

#### 💵 Charging for Commands

In `groups.yml` or `config.yml`, set prices:

```yaml
price-teleport: 50.0
price-fetch: 100.0
```

Players will be charged automatically when using `/sctp` or `/scfetch`.

> ✅ If Vault is not installed, these features are silently disabled — no errors. (`softdepend: [Vault]`).

---

### 🔄 4. Reloading Configurations

As an admin, you can reload all configurations **without restarting the server**:

```bash
/safechestreload
```

**Required Permission:** `safechest.reload`

This command:
- Reloads `config.yml`, `groups.yml`, and `lang.yml`.
- Clears expired chests from cache.
- Reinitializes the plugin container.
- **Does NOT break active chests or holograms.**

> 🚫 **Warning:** Avoid using `/reload` during heavy server activity. `/safechestreload` is much safer.

---

### 🛡️ 5. Permissions (Renamed!)

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `safechest.use` | Allows using the Death Chest system | `true` |
| `safechest.protect` | Allows protecting your chest from others | `true` |
| `safechest.protect.ignore` | Allows opening SafeChests protected of other players | `op` |
| `safechest.tp` | Allows using `/sctp` | `true` |
| `safechest.fetch` | Allows using `/scfetch` | `true` |
| `safechest.group.<name>` | Assigns player to a group (e.g., `safechest.group.vip`) | — |
| `safechest.reload` | Allows using `/safechestreload` | `op` |
| `safechest.admin` | ✅ **NEW:** Allows using `/safechestadmin` | `op` |

> ✅ Use LuckPerms, PermissionsEx, or any other permission manager to assign these.

---

### ❓ 6. FAQ & Troubleshooting — v0.0.5

**Q: Why aren’t my items being saved?**  
A: Make sure you have permission `safechest.use`. Also, check if the world is **NOT** listed in `behavior.disabled-worlds` in `config.yml`.

**Q: The hologram disappeared after a restart!**  
A: **Fixed in v0.0.3 and perfected in v0.0.5!** Holograms are now automatically restored and their timers are restarted on server start. If they’re still missing, check server logs for errors.

**Q: I get “Initializing... try again later”.**  
A: The database is still loading. Wait a few seconds and try again.

**Q: Can I change the chest to a Barrel or Shulker Box?**  
A: Yes! In `config.yml`, set globally:  
```yaml
material: "BARREL"
```
Or per-group in `groups.yml`:
```yaml
vip:
  material: "SHULKER_BOX"
```

**Q: How do I disable the death message buttons?**  
A: In `config.yml`, set `death-message.show-buttons: false`, or disable individual buttons like `show-button-fetch: false`.

**Q: My players are complaining about double drops!**  
A: Enable `behavior.force-clear-drops-on-death: true` in `config.yml` to fix this.

**Q: How do I make `/sctp` work even if there’s no “safe spot”?**  
A: Set `commands.teleport-unsafe-behavior: "force"` in `config.yml`.

**Q: How do I upgrade from v0.0.4?**  
A: **CRITICAL:** You must **rename your database table** from `angelchests` to `safechests` before starting the server. Also, update all permissions and commands from `angelchest` to `safechest`.

**Q: How do I see server stats?**  
A: Use the new admin command: `/safechestadmin stats`.

**Q: How do I delete a specific chest?**  
A: Use `/safechestadmin delete <uuid>`. You can find the UUID via `/safechestadmin inspect <player>`.

---

Ore Mining Speed is a lightweight NeoForge mod that allows players and modpack creators to customize mining speed multipliers for all (even modded) ores in Minecraft.

description: Distant Horizons variant of the World of Keralis modpack
body:
# WoKPack DH

**WoKPack DH** is the Distant horizons variant of WOKPack. Maintaining the same performance and quality of life features from the mainline WOKPack, but with vastly extended render distance.

## Focus Areas and Key Dependencies

### 1. Performance optimizations:
- **Sodium**: (including Reeses Sodium Options): A powerful rendering engine for better FPS.
- **Lithium**: Optimizes game logic for smoother gameplay.
- **FerriteCore**: Reduces memory usage to improve stability.
- **Krypton**: Enhances networking performance and reduces latency.
- **EntityCulling**: Reduces rendering load by skipping unseen entities.
- **ImmediatelyFast**: Optimizes block rendering.
- **ModernFix**: Addresses common compatibility and optimization issues.
- **Noisium**: Provides sound feedback for in-game events.
- **Dynamic FPS: Enables framerate cap when game window is not selected
- **Better Biome Reblend**: Replaces vanilla's biome blend algorithm with a more efficient one
- **ScalableLux**: Rewrites lighting engine to be more efficient

### 2. Additional Optifine parody features:
- **Iris**: Adds shader support for a visually stunning experience.
- **Polytone**: Enhances the overall aesthetic of your builds.
- **Continuity**: Adds seamless connected textures for a polished look.
- **Capes**: Adds customization options for player visuals.
- **JustZoom**: Offers enhanced zoom functionality.
- **Entity Model Features**: Adds Optifinelike entity model features
- **Entity Texture Features**: Adds Optifinelike entity texture features
- **LambDynamicLights**: Adds Optifinelike dynamic lights

### 3. Quality of life features:
- **WorldEdit**: Provides powerful tools for building and editing large structures.
- **Axiom**: Turns minecraft into 3d modeling software
- **Itemswapper**: Speeds up inventory management by swapping tools automatically.
- **Jade**: Displays helpful block and entity information.
- **Cubes Without borders**: add windowed borderless as a display option
- **Resourcify**: allows you to install and update resourcepacks (including wokflows) and shaderpacks from in game
- **3D-Skin-Layers**: Displays avatar skins layers as 3d
- **BetterF3**: Cleans up the f3 menu and makes it more readable
- **Bigshot**: Allows for higher resolution screenshots
- **Language Reload**: Allows for languages to load faster
- **Model Gap Fix**: Fixes gaps in models
- **More Chat History**: Allows you to scroll further up in chat
- **Remove Loading Screen**: Removes the loading screen, allowing you to get back into game faster
- **No Telemetry**: Removes telemetry
- **Smooth Skies**: removes line in the skybox

### 4. Distant Horizons:
- **Distant Horizons**: Increases render distance using LODs
- **Xaero's minimap**: Adds minimap
- **Xaero's worldmap**: Adds Dynmaplike worldmap
- **XaeroPlus**: Adds additional Xaero's mod features
---

**WoKPack** combines cutting-edge performance enhancements with immersive features and user-friendly improvements to provide a seamless Minecraft experience. This pack is designed to keep your game running smoothly while offering tools to expand your creativity whilst building and exploring around the World of Keralis Creative server and beyond.

body:
##  About
The GemsAttribute Mod adds some Attributes and Synergy to some new gems. When you wear them, their Synergy will produce very powerful effects, helping you better fight against monsters.

You can use Patchouli to get a guide book

It's open source, so you can refer to my code to help you learn some mod development.

##  Content
###  Attribute
- Amber:Reduces burning time
- Aquamarine:Add underwater movement efficiency
- CatsEyeStone:Add sneaking speed
- ConchPearl:Add swiming speed
- Helvite:Add movement speed
- Jade:Add Safe fall height
- Mahenge:Add Entity interaction distance
- Mica:Add knock back distance
- Partschinite:Add Armor value
- PhantomCrystal:Add explosion distance
- Ruby:Add attack damage
- Sapphire:Add attack speed
- SlimeCore:Add knock back
- Spinel:Add block interaction distance
- Topaz:Add extra oxygen consumption time
- Tsavorite:Add luck
### Synergy
- Absorb:Killing a creature grants 200% of its experience points
- BloodThirsty:Restores health equal to 50% of attack power when attacking
- Frenzy:Increases damage by 30%
- GuaranteedDamage:Each attack deals damage no less than 5% of the creature's maximum health
- HealthRecover:Gains Regeneration II for 5 seconds when health is below 30%
- ImmuneHarm:Immune to Poison, Wither, Slowness and Blindness
- Invisible:Gains Invisibility when crouching
- JumpResistance:Immune to fall damage
- NightVision:Grants Night Vision
- Perseverance:When taking fatal damage, deducts 10 experience levels and restores full health
- Resistance:Immune to 25% of incoming damage
- Slash:15% chance to instantly kill a creature when its health is below 45%
- TheLastGasp:Gains Strength II when health is below 25%
- WaterBreating:Grants Water Breathing
- Abhor:Inflicts Wither on the target when attacking

## Future
- Will add new gems
- Support 26.1 versions
- Add CurvingTable and New Mechanism
- Customized Bond Trigger Accessories
- Link Tinkers' Construct

## Issues
At present, no issues have been found. If you do come across any bugs, please submit an issue to my GitHub

- I don't think I will update the Fabric version because it would be very difficult for a novice like me to update both the loaders simultaneously.

- No,Because for Forge, I prefer Neoforge. I really dislike the cumbersome loading method of Forge.

#### Installation:
- Put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/saves/[Your World Here]/datapack" folder.
- ***DO NOT put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/resourcepacks" folder.***
- If you changed where Minecraft loads from, find that location and use that "saves" folder.

- From there, when you create a world and go to add datapacks, you can simply go to this folder and grab what you need.
- For identical recipes in multiple data packs, load desired recipes AFTER their duplicates

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)
  - Special Note: as of 5.5.0 (1.21.9), pack formating now has minor versions. All minor versions for any given major versions are intended to fully compatible (i.e. - 88.0, 88.1, etc.) and listed as only the major version (i.e. - 88).
- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

Major breaking changes to each version:
 - 2.0.0 MC 1.17: Advancement Format change - custom recipe "condition" ("items")
 - 3.0.0 MC 1.20.5: Recipe Format change - recipe "result"
 - 4.0.0 MC 1.21: Folder Name change
 - 5.0.0 MC 1.21.2: Recipe Format change - shaped "key" and shapeless "ingredients"

This is what they're meant for.\

title: Leashable players
description: Datapack that lets you put a collar on and leash other players (with consent!)
body:
Having a collar on permanently slows you down and makes you shockable, but the leash itself is purely cosmetic.

Look straight down for 5 seconds while crouching to get a collar and become leashable. Hold out a lead near leashable players to summon the hitbox.
Use '/tag remove @s leashable' to uncollar yourself
There are no current ways to reverse the process without cheats.

Crouch for 2.5 seconds while holding leads in the offhand and a solid block in the main hand to set the collar material of nearby leashable players.

Crouch for 2.5 seconds while holding leads in the main hand and any items in the offhand to set the collar tag of nearby leashable players.

Hold out a lighting rod to shock nearby leashable players.

I really made this instead of writing my college essay,,

title: Abyssfall Survival
description: A collapsing vertical world where light is scarce, oxygen limited, biomes inverted underground, and every descent triggers new environmental dangers and adaptive hostile behavior.
body:
Abyssfall Survival is a Fabric-based modpack designed to make underground exploration darker, more atmospheric, and more challenging without introducing custom coded gameplay systems. Instead, it builds its experience through a curated set of world-generation, ambience, lighting, mob-difficulty, and performance mods that enhance the natural Minecraft survival loop.

The pack expands cave environments using modern world-gen mods that add new biomes, underground structures, stone layers, decorative elements, and bioluminescent flora. Visibility is reduced through lighting and fog adjustments, creating a tense atmosphere when navigating narrow passages or large cavern systems. Some creature behaviors and spawn distributions are affected by included mods, increasing difficulty in deeper areas while keeping gameplay predictable and fair.

A strong focus on performance is maintained through optimization mods such as Lithium, Sodium, Starlight, FerriteCore, and Memory Leak Fix, ensuring stable framerates even in complex environments. The pack avoids unnecessary bloat and keeps all dependencies lightweight, fully compatible with Fabric Loader, and appropriate for long-term survival worlds.

Key Features

Expanded and more varied underground biomes

Darker, fog-driven lighting for a tense cave atmosphere

Bioluminescent plants and decorative cave enhancements

Adjusted mob difficulty and spawn variety in deeper regions

Complete Fabric compatibility with required dependencies

Performance-focused optimizations for smooth gameplay

Lightweight QoL additions such as AppleSkin, JourneyMap, and inventory helpers

Included Mod Categories (Accurate to Modlist)

World Generation: Mods like BetterNether, BetterEnd, Deeper Caves–compatible addons, new biome expansions, and underground enhancements reshape vertical exploration.

Ambience & Audio: AmbientSounds, Presence Footsteps, and particle mods increase immersion without altering core mechanics.

Lighting: LambDynamicLights and shading tweaks create low-light challenges while staying fully vanilla-friendly.

Mob & Survival Tweaks: Difficulty and behavior modifications from supported mods provide a more dangerous underground experience.

Performance: Sodium, Indium, Lithium, Starlight, FerriteCore, and other optimizers ensure high stability.

Quality of Life: Map tools, HUD improvements, and small utility mods support a cleaner but still challenging survival experience.

Abyssfall Survival is intended for players who want a darker, more atmospheric cave-focused survival world built entirely from existing Fabric mods — no custom mechanics, no misleading features, and no unnecessary complexity.

title: jules-quickstack

body:
When you press the keybind (K by default), it moves all items from your inventory into nearby containers that already contain those items.

The range in which to check for nearby chests can be configured in `config/quickstack-common.toml`. It is 16 by default. Note that all containers within the range are included, even ones blocked by other blocks.

Installing [Inventory Profiles Next](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-profiles-next) is **highly recommended**, that way you can lock your hotbar and other useful items which prevents them from being quick-stacked as well as dropped, shift-clicked, etc - press Alt and click on slots you want to lock, very useful even without quickstack.

Please note that this MOD has been entirely made by Google Jules AI. However I am using it in my heavily modded playthrough and it works, so enjoy. I personally can't live with quick stack and it is a crime that no one has made it for 1.21.1 NeoForge.

title: World Border Evolved
description: A mod that adds /worldbordermove, /battleroyale and /kit it is server sided but you can install it on the client for an orange world border when using /worldbordermove
body:
# **WorldBorderEvolved**
Take control of your server and host epic, automated multiplayer events with WorldBorderEvolved! This powerful, server-side mod gives you all the tools you need to create fully automated Battle Royales, Juggernaut matches, and much more, all with simple commands and deep customization.

It's the perfect tool for server owners who want to run fun, engaging, and unique games for their community.

## **Key Features**
👑 Fully Automated Battle Royale (/battleroyale)
Launch a full-scale Battle Royale game with a single command! Create your own unique game modes using easy-to-edit JSON configuration files.

Phased Border Shrinking: Customize every stage of the game, from the border's size and shrink speed to the damage it deals.

Total Automation: The mod can automatically spread players, clear inventories, assign starting kits, set game modes, and manage PVP rules.

Juggernaut Mode: Create an intense "Hunters vs. Hunted" scenario where one super-powered player must survive against everyone else!

## 🔁 **Automatic Event Looping (/autostart)**
Set up a continuous, hands-free loop of events! As soon as one game ends, the next one can begin automatically.

Weighted Randomizer: Add multiple game configs to the auto-start loop and assign each a "weight" to control how often it gets picked. Keep your events fresh and unpredictable!

Simple Toggle: Start and stop the event loop with a single command.

## 🗺️ **Advanced World Border Control (/worldbordermove)**
Go beyond the limits of vanilla commands with precise control over the world border.

Smooth Transitions: Move the border's center to new coordinates over a set time.

Random Movement: Send the border to a new, random location within its current size for a dynamic challenge.

## 🎒**Easy-to-Use Kit System (/kit)**
Quickly set up for any event with a simple and powerful kit system.

Save Inventories: Use /kit create <name> to save a player's entire inventory—including armor and off-hand items—as a kit.

Instant Loadouts: Give any player a saved kit instantly with /kit load <name>.

Deep Customization
JSON Configuration: Every game mode is controlled by an easy-to-edit JSON file. Tweak every variable to create your own signature events.

Custom Status Effects: Want everyone to have Speed II, or want your Juggernaut to have Strength and Resistance? Add any potion effect to players or the Juggernaut directly in the config files!

How it Works
Server-Side: This mod works entirely on the server. Your players do not need to install it to play!

Optional Client: If a player has the mod installed on their client, they will see a custom orange world border. If not, it will appear as the standard green.

title: TheDragon's Mini: End Rods Awaken
description: End Rods Awaken adds an upgraded version of the classic End Rods, that channels potion effects into a controllable aura.
body: [![CurseForge Versions](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/1343405.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/thedragons-mini-end-rods-awaken) [![CurseForge Downloads](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/short_1343405_downloads.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/thedragons-mini-end-rods-awaken) [![Modrinth Versions](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/game-versions/ITgb1CHd?label=Avaliable%20for&color=82ff80)](https://modrinth.com/mod/thedragons-mini-end-rods-awaken) [![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/ITgb1CHd?logo=modrinth&color=82ff80)](https://modrinth.com/mod/thedragons-mini-end-rods-awaken) [![Github](https://img.shields.io/badge/Give%20a%20Star%20on%20Github-fafbfc?logo=github&logoColor=black)](https://github.com/TheDragonSkull/End-Rods-Awaken-Mod) --- # 📖 About **End Rods Awaken** adds an upgraded version of the classic End Rods, the **Awakened End Rod**; a mystical block that channels potion effects into a controllable aura, in a similar way of how lingering potions work. By storing potions, it allows players to combine and manage effects in an area of influence. With its unique slots, locking system, and sculk sensor integration, the Awakened End Rod turns potion management into an interactive and strategic gameplay feature. --- # ✨ Features - 🧪 **Potion Management** – Store up to 3 potion effects and project them in a 4-block radius. - 🕒 **Dynamic GUI** – Custom interface with duration bars, effect icons, tooltips, and a clear button. - 🎨 **Visual Feedback** – Block tint and particles change to reflect active potion colors (single or blended). - ⚙️ **Automation** – Hopper-compatible potion slots for automated brewing systems. This mod supports multiplayer. If you find bugs please report so I can try to fix them. > Below you'll find how the Awakened End Rod behaves in-game: visuals, area effects, stacking rules, controls and interactions. # 🛠 Crafting Recipe --- # ⚙️ How it works ### Awakened End Rod Menu: ### Elements Explained | Nº | Element | Utility | |----|----------|---------| | 1 | Effect Duraton Bar | Shows a decreasing bar matching the effect duration; hover to check the exact time left | | 2 | Effect Icon & Amplifier Level | Shows the icon of the effect; hover to check the name and amplifier level | | 3 | Potion Slots | Takes the potion and returns the empty bottle | | 4 | Clear Effect Button | Clears the effect for the current slot | | 5 | Locked Slots | Locks a slot to prevent potions from being placed; toggled with Shift+Click | | 6 | Sculk Sensor Slot | Grants detection abilities depending on the type of sculk sensor inserted | ### Behavior: #### Slot rules & interactions - **You cannot insert a potion into a slot that already has an active effect.** You must first clear the slot (clear button) or wait for the effect to end. - You cannot insert instant effect potions nor any type of potion besides the normal ones. - **Locked slots** (toggled with Shift + Click on the slot icon) cannot accept items while locked. #### Area of effect - Any **mob or player within a 4-block radius** of the Awakened End Rod will receive the active effect(s) while they last. - Multiple different effects are applied simultaneously: each active slot contributes its effect to entities inside the radius. #### Combining effects & amplifiers - **Different effects** (e.g., Speed + Regeneration) stack and are applied together. - **Multiple potions of the same effect** combine into higher amplifier levels. - Example: *Poison I + Poison II → Poison III*. - The amplifier can increase up to a **maximum of VI**. - Durations are tracked per-slot: each slot has its own remaining time and contributes accordingly. #### Power toggle (turning the block off) - **Shift + Click on the block** toggles the block power state (on/off). - When turned **off**: - The rod **stops emitting light and particles**. - Active effects **stop being applied** (entities no longer receive the effects while the rod is off). - When turned **on** again, the rod resumes normal behavior. #### Sculk Sensor behavior - Placing a sensor into the dedicated sensor slot enables automatic activation based on nearby entities. - **When a sensor is equipped but no entity is detected**, the block remains turned off **but emits subtle particles** to indicate a sensor is installed and waiting for a trigger. | Sensor Type | Detects | Behavior | |-------------|---------|---------| | **Sculk Sensor** | Any mob or player | Activates the rod while any detected entity is within 4 blocks; deactivates when area is clear | | **Calibrated Sculk Sensor** | Players only | Same behavior but only triggers for players (ignores mobs) | #### Hoppers / Automation - The block is **hopper-compatible for the potion slots** (hoppers can be used to insert potions into those slots or to extract the empty bottles). - The sensor slot is **not** intended for hopper insertion/automation. #### Visuals & Particles - When a potion is placed in any potion slot, the End Rod **tints to that potion's color** and emits particles of the same color. - If multiple potions are present the tint/particles **blend** (additive color mixing) to reflect the combination of active effects. --- #### Quick reference | Property | Value | |---------:|:------| | Effect radius | 4 blocks | | Max amplifier | VI | | Block on/off toggle | Shift + Click (on the block) | | Toggle slot lock | Shift + Click (on the effect icon) | --- # 📷 Media ![awakened_end_rod_1](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/99dd1dcd-525b-464f-bcb0-0b83268b6fa1) --- # 📦 Dependencies **Forge** - [Minecraft Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/)

body:
# 🧪 Zombie Potion

**Temporarily become a zombie by drinking a custom potion. Burn in sunlight. Get ignored by hostile mobs. Feast on rotten flesh. Survive like the undead.**

Zombie Potion is a lightweight, survival-friendly mod that lets players **enter a “zombie state”** by drinking a special potion.  
While zombified, you'll behave like a vanilla zombie — both its strengths and weaknesses.

---

## ✅ Features

- 🧪 **Zombie Potion**  
  Drink it to become a zombie indefinitely (until cured or killed)

- 🧟‍♂️ **Zombie State Effects**:
  - 🧢 Automatically equips a **zombie head** for visual immersion
  - ☀️ Burn in daylight like a real zombie
  - 😶 Hostile mobs (zombies, skeletons, creepers, etc.) won’t target you
  - 🧄 Cure the state by drinking milk or upon death
  - 🥩 Rotten flesh becomes nutritious (like cooked beef)
  - 🍞 Normal food gives Hunger instead!
  - 🎙️ Random zombie groan sounds every 5–10 seconds

---

## 🔧 Configuration

This mod includes a simple config file to adjust:
- Groan sound frequency
- Visual effects toggle (zombie head, particles, etc.)
- Food behavior

---

## 🛠 Compatibility

- Minecraft: **1.20**
- Loader: **Forge 47.x**
- Multiplayer: ✅
- Modpack-friendly: ✅

---

## 📦 How to Install

1. Download the `.jar` file from the **Versions** tab
2. Place it into your `mods/` folder
3. Launch the game using **Forge 47.4**

---

## 🙌 License & Usage

This mod is open-source under the MIT license.  
Feel free to include it in modpacks, videos, or server builds — credit is appreciated!

---

🧪 Questions or bugs? Visit the [GitHub repo]([https://github.com/your/repo](https://github.com/yamataka22/minecraft-zombie-potion)) or leave a comment here on Modrinth!

title: SanityMC
description: SanityMC is an innovative Minecraft plugin that introduces a dynamic sanity system to enhance gameplay.
body:
## This plugin is archived until further notice. Do not worry, we are not abandoning this plugin!

### SanityMC is an innovative Minecraft plugin that introduces a dynamic sanity system to enhance gameplay. Players experience varying sanity levels based on environmental conditions, actions, and in-game events—ranging from subtle auditory cues to severe penalties like forced chat suppression and health loss. With extensive configuration options, gradual sanity adjustments, and integration with PlaceholderAPI, SanityMC offers immersive, customizable challenges.


Join the Discord to get updates earlier than others!


## Features:
### Sanity Tracking & Persistence


## Current & Maximum Sanity:
Each player has a current sanity value and a maximum sanity. By default, both start at a value defined in the config (typically 100), but players can increase their maximum sanity by consuming special upgrade items.
Persistence:
Both current and maximum sanity values are saved to disk (in sanityData.yml and maxSanityData.yml), ensuring that a player’s sanity persists between sessions.

## Gradual Sanity Adjustments


## Gradual Changes:
All sanity changes (whether gaining or losing sanity) occur gradually. For example, if an event causes a loss of 3 sanity, the plugin subtracts 1 sanity point every 0.5 seconds until the total loss is applied.
## Clamping:
A player’s current sanity is always clamped between 0 and their maximum sanity.

## Environmental & Gameplay Conditions


## Natural Drains & Gains:
Baseline Regeneration: Every 10 ticks (0.5 seconds), players gain +1 sanity.
Hunger Penalty: If a player’s food level falls below 6, they lose 1 sanity every 10 ticks.
Environmental Effects:
 Darkness, Rain, Caves, & Hostile Mobs: Conditions such as being in low light, during a storm, in a cave, or near hostile mobs trigger gradual sanity loss.
Nether & Nether Portals: Spending time in the Nether or standing in a Nether portal causes additional sanity loss.
Special Events:
Damage: Every time a player takes damage, they lose 0.25 sanity gradually.
Creeper Hiss: Occasionally, if a player’s sanity is 75 or below, a creeper hiss will play (only once every 45 seconds per player) and cause extra sanity loss.
Advancements: Completing an advancement rewards the player with +20 sanity over time.
Block Interactions: Breaking bells or monster spawners will drain sanity gradually, while certain actions like fishing grant sanity.

## Threshold Effects

As a player’s sanity decreases, different effects become active:

Sanity ≤75:
Constant gravel-step sounds play.
Occasional cave sounds add to the eerie atmosphere.
Sanity ≤49:
Hallucination mobs (zombies with no AI) spawn briefly.
Stone break sounds are played, and a custom command (e.g., a chat message) can be executed.
Sanity ≤24:
Jumpscare messages and random weapon swings occur.
A custom command is executed and players may briefly experience blindness.
Sanity <10:
Players receive weakness and take random damage.
Forced chat messages may appear, and they are prevented from chatting.
Death at 0:
When a player’s sanity reaches 0, the plugin sets their health to 0, causing them to die with a custom death message.



## Worldguard Support:
Currently there are 4 flags in the worldguard, more coming in future versions, only 2 really matters, sanity-gain, and sanity-loss, which will allow sanity gain/loss in a region. The other two, sanity-death, and pet-death, if enabled, sanity-death will drop sanity if a nearby player dies, pet-death will drop sanity if a nearby pet dies.



### The plugin is fully configurable via config.yml, where server admins can enable/disable individual conditions, set the intervals and amounts of sanity gain/loss, and customize threshold effect messages and commands. You can get real creative with the custom commands by creating custom commands using the Skript plugin.
## PlaceholderAPI integration allows you to display the current sanity value (e.g., via %sanity_level% placeholders) in scoreboards or chat.

title: Eggcellent Villager Transport
description: Villagers too hard to move with Boats or Minecarts? Why not use Eggs instead!
body:
# Eggcellent Villager Transport
Hey, you! Yeah, **YOU**!

Does it always feel like moving Villagers by Boat or Minecart is such a hassle? Do you wish you had something better?

Well, look no further! Eggcellent Villager Transport is the datapack for you! This pack allows you to turn your Villagers into Spawn Eggs for far easier transportation! No more laying miles of tracks or scooting along the grass in a Boat. Now you can simply pick up a Villager and go!

# Installation
To install this pack, simply drop it into the `datapacks` folder in your world save (no need to unzip it). Then run the function `evt:init` to initiate the datapack. (This will be changed in future versions so the pack starts itself.)

# How To Use
Throw an Egg at a Villager to convert it into a Spawn Egg. Place the Spawn Egg into an Item Frame (on the top of a block/on the ground) to summon the Villager. 

# Features
  - Gives the Item Frame back to the player who placed the Spawn Egg into the Item Frame
- Prevents any negative gossip a player would recieve from throwing an Egg at the Villager
- Clears all Job Site, Bed and Meeting Point data to allow the summoned Villager to claim new ones
- Spawn Egg cannot be placed in Survival (to prevent usage on Spawners)
- Can handle multiple summonings at once

# Credits
Thanks to these users on Reddit for helping me figure out how to go about getting certain aspects of the pack to function correctly:

title: Block Express
description: Stations that automatically connect your bases
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/hoV_Kz93Ni0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

To create your station; first, craft the Station Builder block.

 

    When you place this block, a station will be created at that location. If you place this block a second time, a railway will be established between the first and second stations, allowing for fast travel between your bases. You can also create connecting routes between more than two stations.

 

    For the Station Builder block to connect to the previous station, it must be at the same Y-coordinate, and the X and Z coordinates must be at least 20 blocks apart. Depending on the direction of the connected stations, some old tracks may become damaged; you can manually repair these sections.

 

   If you wish to disconnect from old stations and start a new station network from scratch, you will need to craft the Station Builder block again. Each time you craft a Station Builder, it resets your connection to the old station network. Therefore, ensure you craft enough Station Builder blocks before creating your initial station and starting your network.

 

   When you craft a Station Builder block, your connection to the old station network is reset, allowing you to set up a station at your desired Y-coordinate to start a new network.

   Conductor can spawn Blocktrain when you right click on him (cooldown 120 second)

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

   I haven't set a limit on the distance for creating railway. However, I recommend keeping this distance low depending on your computer's power. When I tested with 8GB of RAM, a distance of about 4000 blocks caused issues and posed a crash risk, so be careful.

title: Bales
description: Turns every block into HAY...
body:
# Bales  
Changes all blocks into HAY...  
_[Loafy](https://modrinth.com/mod/loafy) but for blocks._

**This mod is a client-side visual only mod.**

## Mod Requirements
- Fabric Loader for the corresponding version.  
    - 1.21+: [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/)/[Quilt](https://quiltmc.org/)  

## Recommended Mods
- [Enhanced Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/ebe)

## FAQ  
- **Can I use this in a modpack or video?**
    - Yes, you can use this mod in modpacks or videos. However, please note this mod changes ALL block models into `minecraft:hay_block` and thus may not be suitable for your modpack or video.  
- **Will this mod be ported to x.x.x?**  
    - I am unlikely to port to specific versions, but as this mod was made for fun, however you can still ask. Other developers are free to port this mod, as long as they adhere to the conditions of the LGPL-3.0-or-later license.  
- **I've got an idea for a werid mod!**
    - That's great! I highly suggest trying to make your own mods, the chaos you can cause can be AWESOME. That being said, I'm always up for a challenge, so feel free to reach out with your wacky ideas and I *might* just attempt it!
- **Can I change what block everything looks like?**
    - Yes! Just like loafy, you can adjust what model everything turns into in the config file.
      - Located in `%rundir%/config/mclm_bale.properties`.
- **Some blocks, like chests, and flowing water, aren't replaced. Why?**
  - These blocks don't use normal block models, thus aren't replaced. There is a config option called `replaceSpriteTextures` which when enabled, will replace the texture of sprites to the configured block model's particle. (Note: This is disabled by default as not all sprites are renderered properly, such as chests, and isn't compatibile with Sodium.)  
  - I reccommend installing [Enhanced Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/ebe) as this replaces some block entities with baked models, which fixes this problem.

##  
Also check out the [Cursed Mods Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/npoI3wH2).  

## Credits  
- [DarkSunShyne](https://darksunshyne.carrd.co/) created the icon artwork for this mod.  

_To anyone that does attempt to speedrun this, feel free to share your footage! I'd love to check it out!_

# Crystal Beam Attractor
End Crystal beams are very short-lived in the Minecraft world. They can be seen when re-spawning the Ender Dragon, yet they have great visuals that, if accessible, can be used in a lot of creative ways!  
Crystal Beam Attractor is a simple mod that adds an item to allow you to spawn beams from an End Crystal to any place that you want!

## Usage
Craft the Beam Link Tool.  
Right click on a block to save the position to link the beams to, then right click on the End Crystal that you want linked to that position. It is as simple as that.
If you want to remove a beam link, simply Sneak + Right Click with the tool on the End Crystal.

Note: If done in the end, the beams might be undone by respawning the Ender Dragon.

![Counter Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/487c7050df801c8248cdf79aeb9a3a70f5f51433.png) # OldCounter Welcome to OldCounter, the legacy release of a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft Bukkit server-management plugin! > Warning: This is the OLD version. It is end of life(EOL). We won't fix any issue, add any feature or give any support since now. A complete rewrite (NewCounter) is under active development. You can contact us if you need; ## Descriptions Does your Minecraft Server need a management plugin? Counter can help you! What is Counter? It is: - Essential server-management tools - A clean, modern chat interface - The combined features of many popular plugins Actually,we planned to make Counter a compound plugin in the future. ## Supports **This version of Counter has some problems:** - This build is frozen; all future work is going into the upcoming rewrite. - Simplified Chinese only (multi-language coming in the rewrite).
Known Issues - Gradient colors and boss-bars may render incorrectly. - Blank lines in UIs can appear in the wrong places. - Ban-duration calculations are inaccurate. - The plugin cannot reload itself. - Several commands don’t work from the console.
If you want to feedback, please contact we by using:
**E-Mail:** counter@kyoikumi.xyz
**Tencent QQ:** 2877165147

title: Infectious Goo
description: Adds a mysterious, gooey substance that slowly consumes your world over time.
body:
# Infectious Goo
This mod adds a new block, the 'Goo Block', which when placed will slowly consume the world over time and turn it all into goo. There is no way to stop it, so good luck :)

title: I'm messing around!
description: This is a mod where i just mess around (i will port it to other versions if people like it a lot)
body:
### **Purpose and things you should expect**

The purpose of this project is for me to make a stupid little mod where i add whatever i want.
From a microwave to a scuffed warden to an among us boss

This is what you should expect (there are more things)

- A microwave
- A candy dimension
- A fridge
- 2 counters
- A gun
- 3 mobs (1 tameable)
- A fork
- A comically big spoon
- Etc

### **Why you should download this mod**

This mod adds a lot of new stuff to minecraft and it will probably be updated very often

And also, if you really want op stuff, there's a lot of op stuff in this mod. For example: The fork and the spoon are multitools (and they deal a pretty good ammount of damage)

### **How to make the portals to get to the dimensions/doubts**

- Candyland: Honey portal
- Pastaland: Caramel planks portal
- How to get caramel planks: kill the among us boss and place the item it gives you in candyland

title: Damager ENW
description: Display damage and kill info with customizable animations.
body:
# Damager ENW

**Damager ENW** is a Minecraft plugin that enhances the damage and kill displays with customizable animations and messages.


![showcase](https://github.com/enwulf/Damager-ENW/blob/master/showcase.gif?raw=true)
## Features

- **Damage Display:** Shows damage dealt to entities with customizable text and animations.
- **Kill Display:** Shows special messages for kills with sequential or random messages.
- **Custom Animations:** Supports increase, decrease, and upward animations.
- **Configurable Display:** Control scale, opacity, duration, and more.



## Permissions
- `damagerenw.see` - Allows players to see damage displays and kill messages.

admin:
- `damagerenw.use` - Allows players to use the plugin commands.
- `damagerenw.reload` - Allows players to reload the plugin configuration.

title: No Players Online
description: Mod that makes the multiplayer tab screen not show anyone else.
body: Visually removes other players from the minecraft multiplayer tab screen. We made this as an aid for creepypasta style videos, mostly.

title: Pick It Up
description: Allows you to pick up chests and barrels!
body:
This datapack allows you to **pick up** chests and barrels through the craftable **Pick It Up**. --- ## Craft
Items needed - 6 Chains - 1 End Crystal - 1 Shulker Shell - 1 Anvil
> You can also obtain it via `/function pickitup:craft` --- ## How to use **Sneak on top** of a chest or barrel while **holding** the craftable item to **pick it up**! > It will also return a shulker shell. --- ## Notes The **picked up** container will **retain** its **name** as well as its items. --- [![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/kavio)

title: Copper and Iron Swap
description: This is a resource pack that changes the textures of most if not all instances of iron into copper and vise versa.
body:
This resource pack aims to have all instances of Iron turned into Copper and vise versa. Almost any instance of either has been swapped for the other, though I am merely just a little guy so please let me know if there's one I missed.

Made for Minecraft Java 1.20 but should work fine for other versions, will update if applicable.

title: DarkDots
description: A dark UI theme based around modern web interface design.  Clean, simple, and round.
body:
Have you ever thought that Minecraft's interface was too bright? Too unique? Too old-fashioned?
This pack fixes all of that!

All of Minecraft's UI elements have been redesigned from the ground up to feel darker and more modern, like something that could have jumped straight out of a web app.

All buttons are flat shapes with rounded corners!
Many icons have been redesigned for readability!
All UI panels have been rebuild with a strict light-on-dark color scheme!

Check out the screenshots for examples!

Note: I don't know how some of the textures are used. If you manage to find a texture in-game with a poorly drawn '?', please let me know how you found it!

title: Pipette
description: Pipette is a WYSIWYG pipe mod for items.
body:
Pipette is the WYSIWYG of pipe mods! Simplicity is key!

Pipette only works with items. There are no plans to support fluids or other mods at this time.

Pipette is somewhat efficient, but wasn't designed for large scale server use and may cause unwanted lag for very large amounts of interconnected pipes (in the thousands).

Visit the wiki for information on crafting recipes and usage.

title: LavaSponge [Fabric]
description: A Sponge that removes Lava.
body:
[![Gradle build](https://github.com/Ender-Development/LavaSponge-Fabric/workflows/Gradle%20build/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Ender-Development/LavaSponge-Fabric/actions) [![](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Ender-Development/LavaSponge-Fabric.svg)](LICENSE) [![](https://img.shields.io/github/release/Ender-Development/LavaSponge-Fabric.svg)](https://github.com/Ender-Development/LavaSponge-Fabric/releases)

 

Lava Sponge adds a - who guessed it - Lava Sponge, which sucks up lava instead of water. It is pretty useful, when adventuring through the nether and looking for Ancient Debris. Since it often generates next to lava lakes. After clearing the Lava the Sponge turns into it's wet state, where it needs to be dried before it can be used again. To dry a Lava Sponge it needs to be placed in the Overworld, where it will cool down. A Cool Lava Sponge needs to be mined with a diamond pickaxe.

 

(FYI: They won't get destroyed in lava or fire.)

title: TrailPaths (1.7-26.2)
description: Allows players to leave a path behind them while walking.
body:
# TrailPaths

TrailPaths is a simple and lightweight plugin that allows players to create a "path" behind them as they walk. You can configure any block type to change into another, and even set a timer to automatically reset the path to its original state. It is a unique, immersive addition for any server.

## ⭐ Key Features
- Customizable Trails: Define exactly which block types should be replaced and what they should turn into.
- Randomized Patterns: Use percentage-based chances to vary the appearance of your paths (e.g., a mix of Dirt and Coarse Dirt).
- Automatic Reset: Optionally configure the paths to revert to their original state after a set period, keeping your world clean.
- Toggleable: Players can easily turn their personal trail on or off whenever they like.

## ✏️ Commands
**/trails help**
- Description: View the plugin commands.
- Permission: TRAILS.HELP
**/trails reload**
- Description: Reloads the configuration files.
- Permission: TRAILS.RELOAD
**/trails**
- Description: Toggle your trail path on and off.
- Permission: TRAILS.TOGGLE
**/trails on**
- Description: Toggle your trail path on.
- Permission: TRAILS.TOGGLE
**/trails off**
- Description: Toggle your trail path off.
- Permission: TRAILS.TOGGLE

## ✏️ Permissions
- TRAILS.*: Grants access to all plugin commands and features.
- TRAILS.HELP: Allows the user to use the /trails help command.
- TRAILS.RELOAD: Allows the user to reload the configuration file.
- TRAILS.TOGGLE: Allows the user to toggle trail paths on/off.

## ⚡ Screenshots

![Walking](https://i.gyazo.com/e8abd82b7c6d504e710f05198102d139.gif)
