We are committed to helping you keep your server running smoothly. If you encounter any bugs, have feature requests, or need assistance, join our community on Discord.

title: CoryLib
description: Unified data storage and synchronization library for Minecraft mods. ⚙️
body:
# CoryLib⚡

**A Minecraft Library for unified data storage and synchronization library for Minecraft mods.**


> Designed for mods that need a clean way to store, retrieve, version, and synchronize data across server, dimension, player, and client contexts.

![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be5716eb4df8c4a1e89155a6c0727ddb64cf6bb9_0.webp)


## So, why CoryLib? 🤷‍♂️


Minecraft mods often reimplement the same data systems over and over:

- Dimension-specific state
- Client preferences
- Server-to-client sync
- Runtime-only transient data

**So CoryLib provides one fluent API for all of those cases.**


```
public static final CoryContext DATA = CoryData.init("my_mod");

public static final DataEntry<ServerPlayer, Integer> KILLS =
        DATA.player("kills", Codec.INT)
                .defaultValue(0)
                .storage(Storage.DISK)
                .version(1)
                .sync(SyncTrigger.IMMEDIATE)
                .build();
```


You can check the repository for details and guides. 

![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be5716eb4df8c4a1e89155a6c0727ddb64cf6bb9_0.webp)

title: Village Builder
description: Build amazing structures with a single click. Trade emeralds for your next empire!
body:
![Logo for the project](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03356ddb4271cc7460dc58f562aea97169bbca54.png)

# Village Builder
Build Thriving Settlements, One Contract at a Time 

Tired of spending hours hauling blocks just to flesh out a half-decent village? What if you could commission a professional to handle the heavy lifting—and pay for it all with emeralds?

Village Builder introduces a brand-new villager profession, the Builder, along with a game-changing system of building contracts that let you place fully-formed structures instantly, anywhere in the world.

Along with the extra villager profession, we've also added a custom Fort to the game. Want us to add more custom buildings? Leave a comment!

## Having trouble or just want to say Hi?
Join the [discord channel](https://discord.gg/bHSfXUKW3)

## Meet the Builder

![The Builder Villager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eef56672130d6c712581a23720bd2cffa5574e3c.png)

Wander into any village or set up your own trading post, and you might just spot a villager in a brand-new role. The builder will give you some dough for those unused blocks. But that's not all, their real specialty is building contracts.

For a fair price in emeralds, you can walk away with a contract that, when right-clicked on the ground, summons a complete structure before your eyes. No schematic files. No tedious block-by-block reconstruction. Just a building, exactly where you want it.

Craft, Combine, Customize

## How to use
When holding a contract in your hand, you'll see a blue outline on the ground where you will place a building. When right clicking, you place the building.
![Screenshot of the game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea7cee3420da88dfe4200ff8343c31ad6ab45688.jpeg)

## Custom Buildings
We've been working with a crack team of builder villagers to build some of the coolest custom buildings. We think you'll like them a lot. A few of the buildings we've added include, but are not limited to, a Castle, multiple different forts, an inn and a villager spawner!
![Screenshot of the castle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/107a7ad42657efa062394957cd92441684e2b868.jpeg)
![Screenshot of the Inn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c06846bf2f883b6385ad6afdaabc7914a003437.jpeg)

## Crafting

Not every building contract needs to stay as-is. Many contracts can be used in crafting recipes to transform or upgrade them.

    Convert you emeralds into a contract that can be used to craft specialised workshop: armorer, fletcher, weaponsmith, and more.

    Combine two standard house contracts to create one large house—perfect for growing villages or impressing your friends.

    AND MORE! Look in the recipe book after you craft your first Builder's Table to find out!

The system is designed to give you flexibility. Want a fountain as the centrepiece of your town square? Buy a fountain contract. Need a library next to your enchanting setup? There’s a contract for that.
Build the Village You Deserve

Forget the slow grind of manual construction. With Village Builder, you can lay out an entire settlement in minutes. Emeralds become a genuine currency for architecture, and every new building feels earned. Trades have been carefully balanced to keep the economy fair for both you and the villagers

## Getting Started

To bring a Builder into your world, you’ll need a Builder’s Table. Craft it using a standard crafting table and a single piece of paper. Place that table in any village (or your own base), and an unemployed villager will happily adopt the profession. Then the trading begins.

StashCache remembers items you have seen in storage containers and lets you search for them later with an in-game overlay.

Reqiuirements: [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

After installing, look into some chests. then:

Press `K`, type an item name/id/enchant/lore and StashCache shows where it has seen matching items. Select a result to add a client-side only waypoint so you can find it.

Works in Singleplayer and Muliplayer.

It should support:
- Chests, trapped chests, including double chests
- Barrels
- Shulker boxes
- Ender chests
- Hoppers
- Droppers
- Dispensers

title: ShiftFCmd
description: Open server menu in a flash with Shift + F
body:
[![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21f178aff2b64844fefeaf94a3a3a418440fd43f.png)](https://discord.gg/297Rg5RF8P)

# ShiftFCmd

Open server menu in a flash with Shift + F

![Demonstration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3927d3a7f710f31a4cb764a9813097b9e83060b.gif)

## Introduction

---

ShiftFCmd is a simple, practical Minecraft server plugin.

It allows players to quickly execute pre-configured commands when pressing `Shift + F`.

Suitable for opening menus, using common features, or handling simple but frequent interactions.

## Quick Start:

---

> This example uses the "zMenu" menu plugin as a demonstration.
> 
> In actual use, please replace the command part with the command players use to open menus on your server.

### First-time setup:

1. Download the latest version of ShiftFCmd
2. Place it in the server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server (use `stop` then start, do not use `reload`)
4. Run the command `sfcmd command player zm open basic_inventory`
5. Done

### Updating from an older version:

1. Download the latest version of ShiftFCmd
2. Place it in the server's `plugins` folder
3. Delete the old ShiftFCmd plugin
4. Restart the server (use `stop` then start, do not use `reload`)
5. Done (configuration files will be updated automatically)

## Features

---

- Execute one or more commands by pressing `Shift + F`
- Supports running commands as either `console` or `player`
- Most configuration options can be modified via commands — no need to edit config files directly
- Supports English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
- Built-in automatic update checking
- Automatic configuration file updates — no need to manually replace config files when upgrading from an older version
- Separate permission nodes for commands, making it easy to use with permission plugins such as LuckPerms

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|------|------|------|
| `/sfcmd reload` | `sfcmd.reload` | Reload language files and configuration files |
| `/sfcmd update` | `sfcmd.update` | Manually check for plugin updates |
| `/sfcmd language <en/zh/zh_TW>` | `sfcmd.language` | Switch the plugin language |
| `/sfcmd command <player/console> <command>` | `sfcmd.command` | Set the command executor and command content |
| `/sfcmd switchhand` | `sfcmd.switchhand` | Toggle whether the offhand swap action is preserved |

## Permissions

| Permission Node | Default | Description |
|------|------|------|
| `sfcmd.admin` | OP | Grants all management-related permissions |
| `sfcmd.reload` | OP | Allows use of `/sfcmd reload` |
| `sfcmd.update` | OP | Allows use of `/sfcmd update` |
| `sfcmd.update.notify` | OP | Allows receiving update notifications |
| `sfcmd.language` | OP | Allows use of `/sfcmd language` |
| `sfcmd.command` | OP | Allows use of `/sfcmd command` |
| `sfcmd.switchhand` | OP | Allows use of `/sfcmd switchhand` |

Notes:

- `sfcmd.admin` automatically includes `sfcmd.reload`, `sfcmd.update`, `sfcmd.update.notify`, `sfcmd.language`, `sfcmd.command`, and `sfcmd.switchhand`
- Administrators can use permission management plugins such as LuckPerms to assign these permissions to specific players

## Notes

---

This plugin detects `Shift + F` by listening for player sneaking and offhand-swap actions.

If a player changes their client key bindings, the trigger will change accordingly and may no longer be the default `Shift + F`.

---

title: WynnToolZ

body:
# WynnToolZ

This mod provides features and quality of life improvements for Wynncraft.  
For more information about the server, visit [https://wynncraft.com/](https://wynncraft.com/)

---
### Mounts
---
- **Mount Helper**: Highlights nearby powerups in the world with name labels and other relevant info.
- **Mount Stats Overlay**: A draggable, resizable, and lockable HUD showing your mount's stats, limits, level, and total energy. Includes **auto-updating** for real-time tracking.
- **Mount Item Overlay**: Adds potential info and stat bars on top of mount items (including Mount Potential and Level/Limit visualization), perfect for browsing the Trade Market.
- **Mount Camera**: Automatically switches perspective when you mount and dismount, with scroll zoom, offset controls, and a hold-to-look-around mode.
- **Mount Skin Reporting**: Collects the skin of every mount you purchase from an NPC to send to the WTZ API if you have linked the mod.

---
### Bank Filters
---
- Adds mount-specific filters to Wynntils bank search — search by **mount type**, **primary color**, or **secondary color**.

---
### Shopping & Trade Market
---
- **Shopping List**: A draggable in-game overlay with multiple lists, quantity tracking, and import/export functionality.
- **Trade Market Search**: Click any shopping list entry to instantly search for it in the Trade Market.

---
### User Interface
---
- **Look Line**: Draws a configurable line from your camera toward the block you're looking at — great for use with shoulder-surfing style mods.

---
### Quality of Life
---
- **Quick Back Navigation**: Right-click empty menu space to go back when available.
- **Overlay Tweaks**: Hide the Wynncraft UI while chat is open, or move it above the chat input (keeps NPC dialogue above the chat box).

---
### Miscellaneous
---
- **Shout TTS**: Reads Wynncraft shouts aloud using TikTok TTS voices, with volume control, random voice mode, and previews.

---
## Commands
- `/wtz link` — Opens the WynnToolZ authentication page to enable Mount Skin Reporting and other features.
- `/wtz link status` — Shows your current link and connection status.
- `/wtz unlink` — Removes the saved token.

The Wicker Witch Lives adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-3998, also known as The Wicker Witch Lives .


SCP-3998 appears as a human cadaver without any legs. At day it remains inactive and only creating a dripping yellow liquid, but at night it ignites, becoming a fiery omen that punishes those who attempted murder. Any player who has killed villagers or other players will be set on fire. However, water stops it from igniting.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-3998 spawn?

SCP-3998 can spawn anywhere on the overworld surface like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-3998.

► How can I reset a players kills?

You can decrease the counts of murder from players by using the command /reset_wickerwitch_kills

</details>



![SCP-3998](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f8beafd13e9b14b1d59d8aa2860fa68ec69ad7d.png)

SCP-3998 is a human skeleton without legs, fixed to a wooden cross. It does not move, but occasionally emits yellow dripping particles. At night SCP-3998 bursts into flames if not submerged in water or rain. It is fully fire-immune, and while burning, it ignites any player within 60 blocks who has recently killed three or more villagers or other players.

title: Keychain
description: Switch between Microsoft and offline Minecraft accounts in-game with the real Microsoft login. No codes, no restart, encrypted at rest.
body:
# Keychain

**Switch Minecraft accounts in-game without restarting.** A *Keychain* button is added to your title screen and pause menu. Click it, pick *Add Online*, and the **real Microsoft sign-in page** opens in your browser. Sign in normally — email, password, 2FA — and your account appears in the list. Click any saved account to switch to it instantly.


## Features

- 🔑 **One-click account switching** — click any saved account in the list, you're switched. No restart.
- 🌐 **Real Microsoft login** — opens `login.microsoftonline.com` in your browser. Same form Microsoft uses everywhere. Email, password, 2FA, all official.
- 👤 **Offline accounts** — pick a username, switch immediately. Same `OfflinePlayer:` UUID derivation vanilla uses.
- 🔒 **Encrypted at rest** — your saved tokens are AES-GCM-encrypted with a key tied to your machine. Anyone who copies your `.minecraft` folder gets unreadable data.
- 🚫 **Zero telemetry** — only talks to Microsoft and Mojang's official endpoints. No phoning home, no analytics.
- ⚡ **Tiny** — ~50 KB jar. No bundled browser, no native libs.
- 🧹 **Clean UI** — top-left button, two big actions, click-to-switch, right-click-to-remove.

## How it works

Keychain uses the **OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with PKCE** — the same flow MultiMC, Prism Launcher, and Auth Me use. When you click *Add Online*:

1. Keychain starts a tiny local HTTP server bound to `127.0.0.1` on a random free port.
2. Your default browser opens to the official Microsoft sign-in page.
3. You sign in with your real credentials. 2FA and security keys work normally.
4. Microsoft redirects back to `http://localhost:<port>/callback`.
5. Keychain captures the auth code, exchanges it through the standard Microsoft → Xbox Live → XSTS → Minecraft Services chain.
6. Your account appears in the list, encrypted to disk.

The local server only exists during the ~5-minute sign-in window and shuts down immediately afterwards.

## Privacy

- 🔐 **AES-GCM encryption** of `<gamedir>/config/account-switcher.json` using a key derived from your OS user + machine name. Tokens are unreadable on any other machine.
- 🚷 **No tokens in logs.** `latest.log` and crash reports never contain access tokens, refresh tokens, or auth codes.
- 🛡️ **PKCE + state parameter** — protects against code interception and CSRF.
- 🌐 **HTTPS-only** outbound traffic to: `login.microsoftonline.com`, `user.auth.xboxlive.com`, `xsts.auth.xboxlive.com`, `api.minecraftservices.com`. Nothing else.
- 🔒 **Loopback-only** local callback server (`127.0.0.1`, never reachable over your network).

## Installation

1. Install [**Fabric Loader**](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for Minecraft 26.1.x.
2. Download [**Fabric API**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/versions?g=26.1) and drop it into `%APPDATA%\.minecraft\mods` (Windows) / `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods` (macOS) / `~/.minecraft/mods` (Linux).
3. Drop the **Keychain** jar into the same folder.
4. Launch Minecraft. *Keychain* button is at the top-left of the title screen and pause menu.

## Compatibility

- ✅ **Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2** (Fabric)
- ✅ **Java 25**
- ✅ Client-side only (don't put it on your server)
- ⚠️ Mid-server account switching may kick you — switch from the title screen for cleanest behaviour.
- ⚠️ Skin doesn't refresh on a server you're already connected to. Disconnect and reconnect after switching.

## FAQ

**Why does the Microsoft consent screen say "Auth Me for Minecraft"?**
Keychain ships with a public Azure App ID registered by [Auth Me](https://modrinth.com/mod/auth-me) (axieum), used by ~9.6 million players. If that ever gets revoked, Keychain has a built-in *Use custom Azure ID* fallback to paste your own.

**Is this safe for my Microsoft account?**
Yes. The mod opens the real `login.microsoftonline.com` — you're signing in to Microsoft directly, not to me. Verify the URL bar. Same flow as the official Minecraft launcher and every major third-party launcher.

**Will my token file leak if I share my .minecraft folder?**
No. The file is AES-GCM-encrypted with a per-machine key. Unreadable elsewhere.

**Can I sign in to multiple accounts and switch?**
Yes — that's the entire point. Add as many as you want, click any one to switch.

**Does it work on servers?**
Yes for switching from the title screen / pause menu before joining. Switching mid-game on a server will likely get you kicked because the protocol session changes.

## Source & support

- 🐛 [**Report an issue**](https://discord.gg/RfdTE8JSAc)
- 💻 [**Source code**](https://github.com/Domsimus-63/Keychain/releases/tag/Fabric)


---

*Made by Domsimus.*

title: Infectionary
description: This project adds zombie apocalypse to the game, it's standalone, only add QOL mods with it.
body:
# 🧟 Infectionary

### Zombie apocalypse survival mod for Minecraft

> *Survive the infection. Scavenge. Adapt. Don’t turn.*

---

# 📋 Table of Contents

* [Overview](#overview)
* [Features](#features)
* [Installation](#installation)
* [Infection System](#infection-system)
* [Survival Systems](#survival-systems)
* [Items & Consumables](#items--consumables)
* [NPC System](#npc-system)
* [Structures & World Generation](#structures--world-generation)
* [Crafting Recipes](#crafting-recipes)
* [Starter Kit](#starter-kit)
* [Roadmap](#roadmap)
* [FAQ](#faq)
* [License](#-license)
* [Credits](#-credits)

---

# Overview

**Infectionary** transforms Minecraft into a brutal zombie apocalypse survival experience inspired by survival horror games and cinematic apocalypse worlds.

The world is no longer safe.

Cities are abandoned. Roads stretch through ruined settlements. Supplies are limited. Zombies aren’t just enemies — every hit risks infection.

Manage your stamina, thirst, injuries, and infection while scavenging through handcrafted abandoned structures and surviving against the collapse of civilization.

---

# Features

* 🦠 Advanced **5-stage infection system**
* 🧟 Zombie transformation on death
* ❤️ No natural health regeneration
* 💧 Thirst survival mechanic
* 🏃 Stamina system
* 💊 Medical & survival consumables
* 🏘️ Procedurally generated abandoned structures
* 🛣️ Expanding road-based world generation
* 🧍 NPC quest system
* 🎒 Spawn starter kit
* 🌍 Multiplayer compatible
* ⚙️ Built for **Fabric 26.1.2**

---

# Installation

## Requirements

* Minecraft `26.1.2`
* [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
* [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

## Steps

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft `26.1.2`
2. Download the latest Infectionary `.jar` from Releases
3. Place the `.jar` into your `.minecraft/mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft using the Fabric profile

---

# Infection System

## How Infection Works

Whenever a zombie attacks you, there is a **15% chance** of becoming infected.

Infection progresses through **5 stages**, each becoming more dangerous over time. If the infection reaches **Stage 5**, the player dies and reanimates as a zombie.

> ⚠️ Stage 5 is irreversible.

---

## Infection Stages

| Stage       | Symptoms                                      | Status             |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| **Stage 1** | Mild nausea, slight slowness                  | Easily treatable   |
| **Stage 2** | Increased nausea, minor damage over time      | Antidote effective |
| **Stage 3** | Weakness, visual distortion                   | Dangerous          |
| **Stage 4** | Heavy damage over time, severe disorientation | Final chance       |
| **Stage 5** | ☠️ Death & zombification                      | No cure            |

---

## Infection Treatment

| Item            | Effect                                     |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| **Antidote**    | Completely cures infection up to Stage 4   |
| **Suppressant** | Pauses infection progression for 2 minutes |
| **Painkiller**  | Temporary resistance effect                |

---

# Survival Systems

## ❤️ Manual Healing

Natural regeneration has been completely disabled.

You must rely on crafted medical supplies to survive injuries.

---

## 🏃 Stamina System

Stamina controls your ability to:

* Sprint
* Fight effectively
* Perform exhausting actions

Running out of stamina can leave you vulnerable during combat or escapes.

---

## 💧 Thirst System

Hydration is essential.

Keep water supplies stocked or risk dehydration penalties.

Purified water is safe — future updates may introduce contaminated water systems.

---

# Items & Consumables

## 🩺 Medical Items

| Item            | Effect                           | Notes                   |
| --------------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| **Bandage**     | Heals 2 hearts                   | Cheap emergency healing |
| **Medkit**      | Heals 4 hearts                   | Stronger medical item   |
| **Antidote**    | Cures infection up to Stage 4    | Ineffective at Stage 5  |
| **Suppressant** | Freezes infection progression    | Temporary solution      |
| **Painkiller**  | Grants Resistance for 10 seconds | Useful during combat    |

---

## ⚡ Consumables

| Item               | Effect                  |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| **Energy Drink**   | +25 Stamina, +25 Thirst |
| **Energy Bar**     | +25 Stamina             |
| **Purified Water** | +25 Thirst              |

---

## 🔧 Crafting Materials

Additional medical and crafting materials exist throughout the mod and are used in survival item recipes.

More crafting content will continue expanding in future updates.

---

# NPC System

The world contains survivors trying to stay alive.

Currently, Infectionary includes:

* 🧍 **5 NPCs**
* 📜 **3 quests per NPC**
* 🎯 Dialogue and interaction system

NPCs currently do **not** spawn naturally yet.

You can spawn them manually using:

```mcfunction
/npc
```

![npcs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b77e209aa91c3fb79f5d7ed009251d01ee5d4d97_0.webp)

---

# Structures & World Generation

The overworld is filled with abandoned remnants of civilization.

Current structures include:

* 🏠 Abandoned houses
* 🛣️ Road networks
* 🏘️ Settlements
* 🧱 Urban ruins
* 🚧 Environmental debris & apocalypse decorations

Structures are generated using Minecraft's jigsaw system for modular expansion and procedural layouts.

Future updates aim to massively expand:

* City generation
* Road systems
* Dynamic settlements
* World storytelling

![s1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9ad193881a4f248fba99d3828a3d22c973089f2_0.webp)
![s2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/904c3123f10ec020279503b0c375690a8e2b21ae_0.webp)
![s3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68b3634e0d5c12145389c5d33f3ef8be998312ab.png)

---

# Crafting Recipes

## Bandage

![bandage recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b99eefd3687fdae3945013a60b551f3010d4f6d.png)

---

## Medkit

![medkit recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82e723dce968974ff61c06e952bf2b03aba9417d.png)

---

## Antidote

![antidote recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b68aa5be907e75cf08f351aa6cc9a4b3deb6b46.png)

---

## Suppressant

![suppressant recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d212370a776cf2181cf7865ac4df81e88913b38.png)

---

## Purified Water

![water recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6dbb1a7ad2cc045ae6898d20bc5ee9af9626fa49.png)

---

# Starter Kit

When spawning into a new world for the first time, players receive a starter kit to help survive the early apocalypse.

| Item                  | Quantity |
| --------------------- | -------- |
| Iron Sword            | 1        |
| Iron Pickaxe          | 1        |
| Iron Axe              | 1        |
| Iron Shovel           | 1        |
| Iron Chestplate       | 1        |
| Bandage               | 4        |
| Medkit                | 1        |
| Purified Water Bottle | 8        |
| Painkiller            | 2        |

> 💡 Save your Medkit for emergencies. Bandages are better for smaller injuries.

---

# Roadmap

Planned future content includes:

* 🚰 Unsafe & contaminated water
* 🧟 More zombie variants
* 🏙️ Large abandoned cities
* 🚗 Vehicles
* 🔫 Advanced combat & weapons
* 🛒 Lootable apocalypse props
* 🧍 Naturally spawning NPC survivors
* 📖 Story-driven quests
* 🌎 Massive connected road generation

---

# FAQ

## Q: Can I cure Stage 5 infection?

> No. Once Stage 5 begins, death is inevitable.

---

## Q: Does Suppressant cure infection?

> No. Suppressant only pauses progression temporarily.

---

## Q: Can I drink river water?

> Not yet — but contaminated water mechanics are planned.

---

## Q: Does the mod support multiplayer?

> Yes. Infectionary is multiplayer compatible and optimized for servers.

---

## Q: How do I spawn NPCs?

Use:

```mcfunction
/npc
```

---

## Q: Where can I report bugs or give feedback?

> DM me on Discord: `@ick_y`

---

# 📜 License

All Rights Reserved.

---

# 🙏 Credits

* Forge Labs ❤️
* Fabric modding community

title: FurnacesPlus
description: Advanced furnace speed enhancement plugin for Minecraft servers
body:
# 🔥 FurnacePlus

**Advanced furnace speed enhancement plugin for Minecraft Paper servers**

FurnacePlus is a powerful plugin that provides players with permission-based furnace smelting speed increases. The plugin offers server administrators maximum control through real-time permission updates and flexible configuration options.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🚀 **Permission-Based Speed Control**: Flexible permission system with `furnaceenhanced.<number>` format
- ⚡ **Speed Increase Support**: Fast furnace smelting with visible progress
- 🔄 **Real-Time Updates**: Permission changes take effect immediately
- ⚙️ **Flexible Configuration**: Detailed config file for complete control
- 📊 **Statistics System**: Active furnace count and performance tracking
- 🛠️ **Admin Commands**: Reload and information display commands
- 🎯 **Optimization**: Low resource usage and high performance
- 🔧 **Debug Mode**: Detailed logging system for developers

---

## 📥 Installation

1. **Check Requirements:**
   - Java 17+
   - Paper 1.20+ server
   - Maven (for compilation)

2. **Compile the Plugin:**
   ```bash
   mvn clean package
   ```

3. **Upload JAR File to Server:**
   - Copy `target/furnaceplus-1.0.0.jar` to your server's `plugins` folder

4. **Start Server:**
   - The plugin will automatically create config files when the server starts

---

## 🔑 Permission System

### Permission Format
```
furnaceenhanced.<value>
```

### Value Examples:
- `furnaceenhanced.30` → 30% speed increase
- `furnaceenhanced.50` → 50% speed increase
- `furnaceenhanced.90` → 90% speed increase

### Priority System:
- If a player has multiple permissions, the **highest value** takes effect
- Example: If player has `furnaceenhanced.20` and `furnaceenhanced.50`, 50% speed increase applies

### Admin Permission:
- `furnaceplus.admin` → Access to plugin commands

---

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|-----------|
| `/furnaceplus help` | Display help menu | `furnaceplus.admin` |
| `/furnaceplus reload` | Reload plugin configuration | `furnaceplus.admin` |
| `/furnaceplus info` | Show plugin information | `furnaceplus.admin` |
| `/furnaceplus stats` | Show furnace statistics | `furnaceplus.admin` |

**Alternative:** `/fp` shortcut can be used

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

### config.yml
```yaml
# Plugin Settings
plugin:
  debug: false                    # Enable debug messages
  prefix: "&8[&6FurnacePlus&8]&r" # Plugin prefix

# Furnace Enhancement Settings
furnace:
  enabled: true                   # System enabled/disabled
  max-speed-increase: 90          # Maximum speed increase %
  update-interval: 2              # Update interval (ticks)
  real-time-updates: true         # Real-time permission updates

# Permission Settings
permissions:
  prefix: "furnaceenhanced."      # Permission prefix
  default-value: 0                # Default speed value

# Messages (Color codes supported)
messages:
  plugin-reloaded: "&aFurnacePlus successfully reloaded!"
  no-permission: "&cYou don't have permission to use this command!"
  furnace-enhanced: "&aYour furnace cooking speed: &e{speed}%"
  error-occurred: "&cAn error occurred while processing your request!"
  invalid-command: "&cInvalid command usage! Use: /furnaceplus reload"
```

---

## 📋 Usage Examples

### 1. Basic Permission Assignment
```bash
# Give player 30% speed increase
/lp user player permission set furnaceenhanced.30 true

# Give group 50% speed increase  
/lp group vip permission set furnaceenhanced.50 true
```

### 2. Multiple Permission Management
```bash
# Multiple speed permissions (highest value takes effect)
/lp user player permission set furnaceenhanced.20 true
/lp user player permission set furnaceenhanced.50 true  # This will be effective
```

### 4. Server Group Examples
```bash
# Membership levels
/lp group member permission set furnaceenhanced.10 true    # Member: 10% speed
/lp group premium permission set furnaceenhanced.30 true   # Premium: 30% speed  
/lp group vip permission set furnaceenhanced.50 true       # VIP: 50% speed
/lp group mvp permission set furnaceenhanced.75 true       # MVP: 75% speed
```

---

## 🔧 Advanced Settings

### Update Interval Optimization
```yaml
furnace:
  update-interval: 10  # Default (recommended)
  # 5  = More responsive, higher CPU usage
  # 20 = Lower CPU, less responsive
```

### Debug Mode
```yaml  
plugin:
  debug: true  # Prints detailed logs to console
```

### Speed Limits
```yaml
furnace:
  max-speed-increase: 90   # No speed increase above 90%
```

---

## 🚨 Troubleshooting

### 🔍 Common Issues

#### Problem: Plugin not loading
**Solution:**
- Ensure you're using Java 17+
- Use Paper 1.20+ server
- Check console errors

#### Problem: Permissions not working
**Solution:**
- Check permission format is correct: `furnaceenhanced.<positive_number>`
- Only positive numbers are supported for speed increases
- Ensure permission plugin like LuckPerms is active
- Check settings with `/furnaceplus info`

#### Problem: Furnace speed not changing
**Solution:**
- Check `furnace.enabled: true` in config
- Try placing new items in furnace
- Enable debug mode and check console logs

#### Problem: Performance issues
**Solution:**
- Increase `update-interval` value (e.g., 20)
- Set `real-time-updates: false`
- Disable unnecessary debug mode

### 📊 Debug Information

To enable debug mode:
```yaml
plugin:
  debug: true
```

This will print the following to console:
- Player furnace interactions
- Permission check results  
- Speed calculation details
- Performance metrics

---

## 📈 Performance Tips

1. **Optimize Update Interval**: Very low values increase CPU usage
2. **Clean Unused Permissions**: Remove unused permissions
3. **Disable Debug in Production**: Only use during testing
4. **Disable Real-time Updates if Not Needed**: Provides performance gains

title: Serene Pioneers 3
description: Serene Pioneers 3: Cozy Adventures, a Vanilla++ experience for builders and adventurers.
body:
# Serene Pioneers 3: Cozy Adventures
Explore, gather, build, cook, relax!

The third season of Serene Pioneers, focusing on providing an immersive, cozy, fun and improved Vanilla++ experience.</br>
Whether you want to just build a nice base, make big farms and cook all kinds of different foods, collect all kinds of fish, or go on adventures and explore new structures, dungeons and dimensions, this pack offers something for everyone. Just be cozy, immerse yourself in a world with new biomes and creatures.

The pack includes an ingame guide which purely aims to provide some general explanations and guidance for certain mods, items and mechanics.

## Highlights
- New and interesting world generation and biomes provided by Biomes o' Plenty, Geophilic and Nature's Spirit
- Dozens upon dozens of new structures to explore in the Overworld
- Overhauled combat: New attack patterns, rolling and new critical hit mechanics
- An overhauled End which still stays true to vanilla provided by Enderscape
- Looking for a challenge? Take on the Bosses of Mass Destruction, defeat them and craft amazing items from their loot!
- Explore The Aether, conquer its dungeons and defeat the final boss!
- Lots of new building materials and furniture to build your dream home
- Cook dozens of new food items thanks to Farmer's Delight and its addons or brew all kinds of beverages with Brewin' and Chewin'
- Collect all kinds of new fish and put them on display thanks to Tide 2 and Hybrid Aquatic
- Some recipes have been altered or removed to better suit the pack
- Ships with a handful of optional resource packs that fit the theme of the pack and help increase immersion
- Ships with Complementary Shaders and EuphoriaPatches preconfigured to provide an even more beautiful experience

### Configuration
The pack uses ConfiguredDefaults to handle configuration files. When you launch the pack for the first time it will copy all relevant configuration files into the `config` folder. If a config file already exists in that folder it will **not** be overwritten, unless during an update changes to specific settings have been made that need to be distributed to every client and server.

This also includes the `options.txt` file as well as the shaderpack configurations.

In order to restore a configuration to the pack's default you just have to delete the file and start the pack.

### Notes regarding shaders
As mentioned the pack ships with Complementary Shaders and EuphoriaPatches included and preconfigured to provide a close to vanilla but still visually stunning experience. You are of course free to add and use whichever shaders you like. If you do not like the preconfigured settings for Complementary Shaders you just have to open the shader settings (Alt+F10 by default), edit the shaderpack settings and click on "Reset" in the top. 

### Notes for server owners
- Disable the mod `Mod loading screen` (mod-loading-screen-....jar), otherwise the server will likely not boot
- The pack includes a couple of server specific mods which are not configured and only included for convenience:
  - [MiniMOTD](https://modrinth.com/plugin/minimotd): Lets you fully customize the MOTD and icon, including an automatic message if the server is in maintenance mode
  - [Mainenance Mode](https://modrinth.com/mod/maintenancemode): Lets you put the server into maintenance mode, making it so only select players can join as well as automatically making a backup if configured
  - [Simple Discord Link](https://modrinth.com/mod/sdlink): Lets you link the ingame chat to a Discord server, allowing people to chat with each other even when they're not ingame

title: Recipe Book Ferret
description: Recipe books in crafting tables and player inventory will consider and use the contents of nearby containers to fulfill recipes.
body:
# Recipe Book Ferret

## Features
This simple, lightweight quality-of-life mod makes recipe books from crafting tables and player inventory consider and use contents of nearby containers when determining which recipes can be crafted. There is no in-game UI. It all happens automatically.

If a recipe is deemed craftable based on the player inventory + container contents, when the player clicks on the recipe book entry's icon, ingredients will be pulled from containers if necessary to fill the crafting grid.

If the player closes the crafting screen while container-sourced ingredients are still inside the crafting grid, those items are returned to their original container.

### Currently Covers:
- Regular chests (including Copper Chests and Barrels)
- Shulker Boxes
- Ender Chests (optional, off by default)
- Chests inside Boats or Minecarts
- Chests attached to saddled Mules
- Bundles inside the player inventory
- ..theoretically any in-world entities implementing `Container`.

### ModMenu Options:
- container search area size: default search area is a 21x21x21 (radius=10) block space centered on the *player* (not the crafting table). This can be expanded up to 53x53x53, or reduced to 3x3x1.
- toggle EnderChest inclusion in container search. Defaults to off.

### Compatibility & Limitations: 

- **Currently only supports single player worlds. Multiplayer/Server support has not been implemented or tested yet.**
- Tested and working with Fabulously Optimized modpack on MC 1.21.11 with Fabric.
- Not tested with alternate crafting table-like items from other mods (example: Conquest Reforged's Sawhorse)
- Vanilla MC Furnace recipe books are able to see the contents of nearby containers (and will show matching recipes as craftable), but items will not be pulled into the furnace crafting grid when you click on the recipe icon.
- Chest, Ender Chests, and Shulker Boxes must be placed as blocks in the game world in order to be considered.

## Alternatives considered:

- "Bluetooth Chests" and "Craft from Chests" are the closest matches, but they both currently (as of Feb 7 2026) have a dependency for 'Recipe Book Access API' mod, which has not been updated since April 2025 and only supports up to MC version 1.21.5. This would require the user to manually-override install an 'out of date' mod as dependency. Also neither of these support Bundles, and I believe also do not support MuleChests, BoatChests, and MinecartChests.
- "Nearby Crafting" is the mod that 'Recipe Book Access API' mod references as an example of how the API should be used, but it also has not been updated since MC 1.21.5.
- "Tom's Simple Storage" provides similar functionality through its crafting terminal system, but is more complicated than what I wanted for these features.

## Built for: 

- Minecraft 1.21.11 
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4 
- Fabric API 0.141.2+1.21.11

## Other Mod Requirements:

 - YACL 3.8.2+
 - ModMenu 17.0.0-beta.2+

## License

CC0

# InvSee

A simple item marking mod for Minecraft.

## Features

**Mark Items in Containers**
- Press middle mouse button on any item to create a floating marker
- Shows item name, owner name, and container outline
- Works in any container - chests, machines, backpacks, etc.
- Also works with JEI items

**Slot Highlighting**
- Marked items get highlighted in all open containers
- Helps you quickly find matching items across inventories

**FTB Teams Support**
- Party members can see each other's marks
- Players not in a party can see marks from other solo players
- Party players and solo players cannot see each other's marks
- Without FTB Teams installed, all players see all marks

## Configuration

- Mark duration (1-60 seconds)
- Display range (16-256 blocks)
- Highlight duration
- Toggle tooltip display
- Toggle extra item info (durability, enchantments, energy, etc.)

## Mod Compatibility

- JEI - Mark items directly from recipe viewer
- Mekanism - Shows chemical tank info
- Applied Energistics 2 - Shows storage cell status
- FTB Teams - Team-based mark visibility

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge

## Important Notes

**Server Installation**
- This mod must be installed on both client and server for multiplayer
- JEI integration features only work on the client side
- If you see an error like `ResourceKey[minecraft:recipe_serializer / jei:jei_shaped]`, make sure JEI is **NOT** installed on the server (JEI is a client-only mod)

title: Smp Launch Plugin
description: SMP Launch is a streamlined and lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to automate the chaotic start of a new Survival Multiplayer (SMP) season. With the simple command /smpstart
body:
## Smp Launch Plugin
- SMP Launch is a streamlined and lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to automate the chaotic start of a new Survival Multiplayer (SMP) season. With the simple command /smpstart, server administrators can initiate a fully managed launch sequence, removing the need for manual moderation.
## ​Key features include
- ​Automated World Border: The plugin manages the world border dynamically, starting with a restricted radius (configured as initial-border-size, e.g., 32 blocks) that smoothly expands to a massive size (e.g., 5000 blocks) over a set duration, forcing early player interaction.
- ​PvP Grace Period: To ensure a fair start, PvP combat remains disabled for a configurable amount of time (the pvp-grace-period).
- ​Immersive Audio & Visuals: The launch experience is enhanced with customizable sound effects—such as an Ender Dragon growl on launch and a Wither spawn sound when PvP enables. It also features a built-in scoreboard (&6&lNothing SmP S3) to display the countdown and status.
- ​Full Customization: Almost every aspect is configurable via the YAML file, including countdown timers, border sizes, custom chat messages with color codes, and specific sound effects.
- You can Customize Smp name,time of border expansion,time of pvp enable etc on the config.yml (hexa code supported)
> ​**It is the perfect "set it and forget it" tool for hosting professional and exciting SMP grand openings.**

title: Liminality: The Backrooms
description: Get lost in the infinite yellow madness.
body:
# Welcome to the Backrooms

If you're reading this, you probably know exactly what you're getting into. I wanted to create a Backrooms mod that actually feels right and not just a bunch of yellow blocks, but a place that feels endless, empty, and maybe slightly wrong.

## Main Features

* **Infinite Level 0:** The classic Mono-Yellow. It generates infinitely, so you can wander for thousands of blocks seeing nothing but damp carpet and wallpaper. It’s lonely, which is exactly the point.
* **The Atmosphere:** I spent a lot of time trying to nail the vibe. The fluorescent lights buzz (sorry in advance), and the environment feels properly "liminal."
* **Seamless Integration:** It uses TerraBlender to handle the generation, so it should play nice with your other mods, even if the Backrooms themselves don't play nice with you.

---

## Dependencies & Recommendations

* **TerraBlender (REQUIRED):** This mod relies on TerraBlender for the terrain generation. You **must** have it installed, or the game will not launch.

### Highly Recommended for the Best Experience:

* **Sound Physics Remastered:** This is a game-changer. It adds reverberation and echoes that make the empty halls feel truly massive and isolating.
* **True Darkness:** Because when the lights go out in the Backrooms, it shouldn't just be dim—it should be pitch black.
* **AmbientSounds 6:** Adds those subtle background noises that make you feel like you're never quite alone.
* **Embeddium:** Recommended for performance, especially when generating infinite chunks.

> **⚠️ Beta Warning:** Just a heads up—this is currently a **BETA version**. That means you might encounter some bugs or weirdness that isn't intended (even for the Backrooms). I'm still working on polishing everything, so please bear with me and report any issues you find!

---

## How to Enter

I won't spoil it entirely, but let's just say you need to be careful where you step in the Overworld. Sometimes, reality just... breaks.

### But if you really want to know, here is a little hint:

> Try suffocating in a wall. It's not safe, but sometimes it's the only way out... or in.

**Enjoy the solitude!** (And let me know in the comments if you find anything weird.)

Want to create your own mod?

Join discord server: https://discord.gg/hSQpP4Mc

title: MMOProfilePerms
description: A Minecraft plugin for managing LuckPerms permissions attached to MMOProfiles' UUIDs, with live Bukkit attachments.
body:
# MMOProfilePerms

A lightweight Minecraft plugin for managing **LuckPerms permissions** attached to **MMOProfiles' fake UUIDs**, with live Bukkit attachments. Add, remove, and inspect permissions on a per-profile basis — **no relog required**.

---

## Features

- Fully supports **MMOProfiles** and **LuckPerms**
- Compatible with **proxy-mode** profiles
- Add or remove permissions without the need to re-log
- Supports **contexts** (e.g. `server=spawn`, `world=hub`)
- Automatically resolves **player names to current profile UUIDs**
- Use UUIDs directly for offline profiles
- Includes `/listprofiles` command for easy UUID discovery (click to copy)

---

## Commands

### `/mmoperm <player|UUID> <add|remove|check|permissions> [permission] [context...]`

- `add` / `remove`: Adds or removes a permission (uses LuckPerms & Bukkit attachment)
- `check`: Executes `lp user <uuid> info`
- `permissions`: Executes `lp user <uuid> permission info`

You can use either a **player name** (uses their current active profile) or **UUID** (useful for offline users).

---

### `/listprofiles <player>`

- Lists all profiles and UUIDs for the given player
- If run in-game, **clickable UUIDs** let you copy them to clipboard
- Console output is plain text

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.20+** (tested on Paper 1.21.4)
- **LuckPerms** (API 5.4+)
- **MMOProfiles**

---

## Installation

1. Drop the `.jar` file into your `/plugins` directory
2. Ensure **LuckPerms** and **MMOProfiles** are installed
3. Restart the server

---

## Why not use the LuckPerms API directly?

Because command dispatching is simple and supports LuckPerms contexts perfectly. It just works — no need for complex API integration.

---

## Support

Need help or want to suggest something? Join my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/JEqREs76yh) and open a ticket!

title: NativeLoader
description: A Fabric mod which allows you to use native code (like C++, C# NativeAOT) to modify the game, using JNA and JNI
body:
[English](#English)|[简体中文](#简体中文)

# English

NativeLoader is a compatibility-layer Fabric mod designed to modify game content in languages that can be compiled to native code except Java or Kotlin. It interacts with native code via JNI and JNA, giving native code enough flexibility and minimizing performance overhead.

# Use

NativeLoader itself is only responsible for calling native code and providing wrapper classes, and does not modify the game content, you need to use other languages that can be compiled to native code and publish them as dll/so/dylib to actually modify the game

> It is often necessary to use third-party libraries when writing code, which can avoid causing Invalid Memory Access by allowing users to interact directly with JNI

> Although this is not necessary, we recommend that libraries in other languages provide corresponding Java class bindings to provide a similar programming experience to Java

> The currently available library is [Mliybs.Minecraft.Fabric](https://github.com/Mliybs/Mliybs.Minecraft.Fabric) for C# NativeAOT

## Load your code

Assuming you have made a dll, you need to create a valid resource package in the nativepacks folder of the game directory (if it doesn't exist, the game will automatically create it when it starts running), and place your dll in the assets/arbitrary namespace ID/natives/ directory, for example:

![dll example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1becbdf4fe1aedf7210d54249ed659f235d46e3a.png)

> It is important to note that the path and file name must be valid identifiers and can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and ,.-_ characters

Once done, launch the game and the game will automatically load all dll/so/dylib in the natives path in all namespaces（the resource pack will also be loaded）

If your dll contains code to modify the game, you should be able to see the changes in the game

> If your dll is coming from someone else, make sure it's safe

# P.S

NativeLoader is currently in the development phase, but the basic functionality is complete

We expect that Mixin is unlikely to add support in the future, but reflection in Java is not limited to this (called directly via JNI functions)

NativeLoader needs more people to help improve it, contributions are welcome!

# 简体中文

NativeLoader是一个兼容层Fabric Mod，旨在通过除Java Kotlin以外的能编译成原生代码的其他语言修改游戏内容。它通过JNI和JNA与原生代码交互，不仅给了原生代码足够的灵活程度还尽可能减少了性能开销。

# 使用

NativeLoader本身只负责调用本机的原生代码以及提供包装类，并不会修改游戏内容，你需要使用其他能够编译成原生代码的语言并将它们发布成dll/so/dylib才能真正修改游戏

> 在编写代码的时候往往需要使用第三方库，这能够避免让用户直接与JNI交互导致Invalid Memory Access

> 尽管这不是必要的，但我们建议其他语言的库提供相对应的Java类绑定，尽力提供与Java相似的编程体验

> 目前的可用库有 [Mliybs.Minecraft.Fabric](https://github.com/Mliybs/Mliybs.Minecraft.Fabric)，用于C# NativeAOT

## 调用你的代码

假设你已经制作好了一个dll，你需要在游戏目录下的nativepacks文件夹（若不存在则游戏在开始运行时会自动创建）中创建一个合法的资源包（这个资源包后续也会用来存放资源），在assets/任意命名空间ID/natives/目录中放置你的dll，例如：

![dll example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1becbdf4fe1aedf7210d54249ed659f235d46e3a.png)

> 需要注意的是，路径和文件名必须是合法的标识符，只能包含小写字母，数字，以及,.-_几个字符

完成后，启动游戏，游戏就会自动加载所有命名空间中natives路径下的所有dll/so/dylib（资源包也会被强制加载）

如果你的dll中包含了修改游戏的代码，你应该就能在游戏中看到它的更改了

> 如果你的dll来自其他人，请确保它是安全的

# 附言

NativeLoader目前还处于开发阶段，但基本功能已完成

我们预计将来Mixin不太可能添加支持，但Java中的反射不受此限制（直接通过JNI函数进行调用）

NativeLoader需要更多人来帮助完善，欢迎所有人的贡献！

body:
**Freedom Plugin (Beta) – Dynamic World Border Management**  

The Freedom Plugin introduces a dynamic world border system for Minecraft servers, enhancing gameplay balance and fairness. Perfect for servers utilizing datapacks or custom world generation, it ensures equal opportunities for players by controlling exploration limits and providing a level playing field.  

### Key Features:  
- **Configurable World Border**: Easily customize border settings via `config.yml`.  
- **Automatic Expansion**: Set borders to expand based on server days, with adjustable wait times, increments, and maximum size.  
- **Smooth Transitions**: Enjoy seamless animations for border adjustments.  
- **Player Notifications**: Keep players informed with in-game updates.  
- **Admin Tools**: Debug, restore defaults, or manually adjust settings using simple commands.  
- **Easy Control**: Use `/freedom` to manage the plugin effortlessly.  

### Usage Context:  
Designed for multiplayer servers, especially those with datapacks or custom mechanics, the plugin fosters balanced gameplay by regulating exploration. It prevents early advantages from far-off looting and ensures fairness as all players gain equal access to new areas over time.  

**Note**: This is a beta release, and some features are still under development. Feedback is welcome to help improve the plugin!

title: Trident Killer
description: Trident Killer Feature Bedrock Edition for Minecraft Java Edition
body:
# **TridentKiller - Minecraft Java Edition Datapack**

**TridentKiller** is a datapack designed for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21 that replicates the unique behavior of tridents in Bedrock Edition, allowing their use in automated systems like XP farms. This datapack includes advanced checks to ensure tridents deal damage and generate experience only under specific conditions, bridging the gap between the two game versions.

## **Features**
- Tridents deal damage to nearby mobs when:
  - Fixed on moving blocks (e.g., trapdoors triggered by redstone).
  - Enchanted with **Channeling** and submerged in water.
- Automatic experience generation at the location of mob deaths.
- Detection of trident motion and rotation to prevent misuse.
- Fully compatible with trident-based automatic farms.

---

## **Installation**
1. **Download the datapack:**
2. **Install in your world:**
   - Place the datapack folder in `world/datapacks/`.
   - Ensure the datapack is enabled when creating or loading the world.
3. **Reload the datapack:**
   - In-game, type `/reload` to initialize the functions.

---

## **How to Use**

Follow these steps to set up your TridentKiller:

1. **Enchant your trident:**
   - Make sure the trident has the **Channeling** enchantment.
2. **Prepare the trapdoor setup:**
   - Throw the trident at a **trapdoor** connected to a **looping redstone activation system** using a powered comparator.
3. **Align the trident:**
   - Wait until the trident becomes **fully vertical** and aligned. Once aligned, deactivate the redstone system.
4. **Add water below:**
   - Place water directly **below the trapdoor**, where the trident will fall. This is the spot where mobs from your farm should gather.
5. **Break the trapdoor:**
   - Destroy the trapdoor, allowing the trident to drop into the water. 

Your TridentKiller is now fully functional and ready to automate mob killing and XP collection!

## **FAQ**

### **1. Will my farm stop working if the trident despawns due to Minecraft's mechanics?**
No need to worry! The trident used in this setup is marked with a special tag by the datapack, preventing it from despawning. Unless your world lasts over **68 real-world years**, your trident will remain in the game.

### **2. Do all tridents stay permanently in the game?**
Not at all. The datapack specifically tags only the tridents that meet certain conditions:
   - The trident must have the **Channeling** enchantment.
   - It needs to be thrown into a unique setup involving a **trapdoor** activated by a **redstone loop system**.
   
This ensures that only tridents in this unique state receive the tag. Without this system, the trident would behave normally and eventually despawn under typical Minecraft rules.

### **3. Can this cause damage to mobs in water under normal circumstances?**
No. The system is designed to prevent tagged tridents from causing damage unless they meet all the requirements:
   - The trident must be in **motion**.
   - It must have the **Channeling** enchantment.
   - It must be in **contact with water**. 
   
Without these conditions, the trident will remain inactive.

### **4. Why is the redstone system necessary?**
The redstone system ensures the trident enters a **specific alignment and motion state** that is nearly impossible to achieve manually. This state allows the trident to receive the special tag required for the TridentKiller to work, but it also ensures that unintended tridents don’t interfere with gameplay.

### **5. What happens if I break the farm accidentally?**
If the setup is broken, you can repeat the steps outlined in the "How to Use" section to reset it. The tagged trident will remain available for reuse.

### **6. Can I use multiple TridentKillers in one world?**
Absolutely! The datapack is designed to support multiple TridentKillers simultaneously, as long as each is set up correctly with its own tagged trident.

### **7. Is there a visual guide for setting up the TridentKiller?**  
Yes! Check out the **Gallery** section below for a step-by-step guide with images to help you set up your TridentKiller quickly and effectively. Visual instructions make the process even easier to follow!

If you have further questions, feel free to reach out or experiment with the setup to discover more!

---

## **Requirements**
- **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21**
- Tridents with the **Channeling** enchantment for use in water.

---

## **Contribution**
Contributions are welcome! Feel free to open issues or pull requests on the GitHub repository. If you find bugs or have suggestions for improvements, let us know.

---

## **License**
This datapack is available under the [MIT License](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT). You are free to use, modify, and share it, as long as proper credit is given.

---

title: SpeedTab
description: A customizable tab plugin for the Velocity Minecraft proxy.
body:
# SpeedTab  
SpeedTab is a customizable tab plugin for the Velocity Minecraft proxy. It allows you to set custom headers and footers in the Minecraft tab list across different servers, with support for colour codes and formatting.

## Features
- Customizable tab headers and footers.
- Different headers and footers for different servers.
- Support for Minecraft colour codes and formatting.
- Reload config with a command `/speedtabreload`.
- Permission node for the reload command.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release of SpeedTab from the top of the page.
2. Place the downloaded JAR file in the `plugins` directory of your Velocity server.
3. Start your Velocity server to generate the default configuration file.

## Commands
- Reload config - `/speedtabreload`

## Permissions
- Reload config - `speedtab.reload`
By default no one has the permission other than the console.
To grant the permission to a player, you will need a permissions plugin installed on Velocity, and in the backend server (eg: Paper).
This was tested with LuckPerms installed on Velocity and Paper, both connected up to the same MySQL server with the `speedtab.reload` permission applied to my player.

## Configuration

After running the server for the first time with SpeedTab installed, a default configuration file will be created in the `plugins/speedtab` directory.

### Configuration File

The configuration file `config.conf` allows you to customize the tab headers and footers. Here is the default configuration:

```hocon
default {
    tabTitle = "&aWelcome to &bSpeedTab!"
    tabFooter = "&cEnjoy your stay!"
}

servers {
    lobby {
        tabTitle = "&aWelcome to the &bLobby!"
        tabFooter = "&cEnjoy your time in the Lobby!"
    }
    survival {
        tabTitle = "&aWelcome to &bSurvival!"
        tabFooter = "&cEnjoy your time in Survival!"
    }
    // Add more servers as required.
}
```

For headers and footers for different servers to work, the server names should match exactly what you have in your velocity.toml file. The plugin will fallback to the default headers and footers if needed.

### Colour Codes
SpeedTab supports Minecraft colour codes and formatting codes. Use the following codes in your configuration file:

* &0 - Black
* &1 - Dark Blue
* &2 - Dark Green
* &3 - Dark Aqua
* &4 - Dark Red
* &5 - Dark Purple
* &6 - Gold
* &7 - Gray
* &8 - Dark Gray
* &9 - Blue
* &a - Green
* &b - Aqua
* &c - Red
* &d - Light Purple
* &e - Yellow
* &f - White
* &k - Obfuscated
* &l - Bold
* &m - Strikethrough
* &n - Underlined
* &o - Italic
* &r - Reset
* 
## License
SpeedTab is licensed under the AGPL-3.0 License. See the [LICENSE](https://github.com/AdrianJoeK/SpeedTab/blob/master/LICENSE) file for more details.

## Contributing
Contributions are welcome! Please open an issue or submit a pull request on the [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/AdrianJoeK/SpeedTab).

## Acknowledgements
* [Velocity](https://papermc.io/software/velocity) - The Minecraft proxy server that SpeedTab is built for.
* [Configurate](https://github.com/SpongePowered/Configurate) - The library used for configuration management.
* [MiniMessage](https://github.com/KyoriPowered/adventure-text-minimessage) - The library used for text formatting.

Do you ever considered to get better base protection? Are you too lazy to kill mobs? Do you ever wished that someone would collect items and exp for you?

 

Well Don’t worry this mod will definetly help by adding 10 different living toys with unique fightning styles and purposes as well.

minecraft toy defenders mod

Gunner:

Tiny Tank:

Air Balloon:

Can be crafted.

title: Text Styles
description: An advanced, modular, and highly personalizable text effect system for Minecraft.
body:
# Text Styles

**"Bring your text to life with dynamic animations and effects!"**

**An advanced, modular, and highly personalizable text effect system for Minecraft.**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/6NmpSmZ-qAE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## 📖 Description

**Text Styles** is a powerful refactor and expansion of the original text effects concept. It introduces a robust, registry-based system that allows for deeply personalizable text animations using simple tags. Whether you're writing in a book, on a sign, or just chatting, you can now add movement, color cycles, and unique reveal animations to your text.

Unlike other simple effect mods, **Text Styles** is designed for compatibility and extensibility, allowing other mods to register their own styles and parameters easily.

## 🌟 Features

- **Registry-Based System**: Every style is a registered object, making it easy to extend and maintain.
- **Deeply Personalizable**: Almost every aspect of an effect (speed, distance, frequency, etc.) can be adjusted via tag parameters.
- **Short Aliases**: Support for short tag names and parameter aliases (e.g., `<wb d=5>` instead of `<wobble distance=5>`), perfect for space-constrained areas like books and signs.
- **Minecraft Native Integration**: Styles are serialized using Codecs, ensuring they work perfectly with Minecraft's text system, NBT, and JSON.
- **Rich Animation Library**: Over 15 built-in styles including Wave, Rainbow, Glitch, Typewriter, and more.
- **Per-Glyph Rendering**: Advanced rendering that allows for smooth gradients and per-character animations.

## ⚙️ Compatibility

- **Minecraft Versions**:
  - Fully compatible with **26+**.
- **Modding Platforms**:
  - **Fabric**: ✅ Fully supported!
  - **NeoForge**: ✅ Fully supported!
- **Mod Compatibility**:
  - Works with any mod that uses standard Minecraft Components.

## 📦 Installation

1. **Download the mod**: Grab the latest version from [GitHub](https://github.com/RazorPlay01/Text-Styles) or your favorite mod hosting site.
2. **Install Fabric or NeoForge**: Ensure you have Fabric Loader or Neoforge Loader installed for your Minecraft version.
3. **Add the mod**: Place the `.jar` file into the `mods` folder of your Minecraft instance.
4. **Launch the game**: Start Minecraft and start experimenting with styles!

## 💡 How to Use

Simply wrap your text in tags like `<style_name params>your text</style_name>`. You can use full names or short aliases.

### ✅ Vanilla Formatting Support

You can now use **all official Minecraft formatting codes** inside the `< >` system:

#### **Colors**
- `<red>`, `<blue>`, `<gold>`, `<green>`, `<aqua>`, `<yellow>`, `<white>`, etc.
- `<dark_red>`, `<dark_blue>`, `<light_purple>`, etc.
- Legacy codes: `<§c>`, `<§4>`, `<§e>`, `<§l>`, etc.
- **Hex colors**: `<#ff0000>`, `<#00ffaa>`, `<#ffffff>`

#### **Styles**
- `<bold>` or `<b>` → **Negrita**
- `<italic>` or `<i>` → *Cursiva*
- `<underline>` or `<u>` → Subrayado
- `<strikethrough>` or `<s>` → Tachado
- `<obfuscated>` or `<k>` → Ofuscado
- `<reset>` or `<r>` → Resetear formato

### 🛠️ Available Styles & Parameters

| Style | Alias | Parameters (Full / Short) | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wobble** | `wb` | `distance`/`d`, `speed`/`s` | Vertical bobbing motion. |
| **Shake** | `sh` | `x`, `y`, `frequency`/`f` | Random jittery movement. |
| **Wave** | `wv` | `amplitude`/`a`, `frequency`/`f`, `speed`/`s`, `vertical`/`v` | Fluid wave-like motion. |
| **Rainbow** | `rb` | `speed`/`s`, `frequency`/`f`, `saturation`/`sat`, `brightness`/`bri` | Cycles through HSB colors. |
| **Bounce** | `bn` | `amplitude`/`a`, `speed`/`s`, `delay`/`dl` | Jumping/bouncing effect. |
| **Pulse** | `pl` | `intensity`/`i`, `speed`/`s`, `delay`/`dl`, `color`/`c` | Pulses in scale and color. |
| **Fade** | `fd` | `min_alpha`/`m`, `max_alpha`/`x`, `speed`/`s`, `delay`/`dl` | Fades in and out. |
| **Swing** | `sw` | `amplitude`/`a`, `speed`/`s`, `delay`/`dl` | Pendulum-like rotation. |
| **Glitch** | `gl` | `intensity`/`i`, `frequency`/`f` | Random offsets and color flashes. |
| **Turbulence** | `tb` | `intensity`/`i`, `speed`/`s` | Erratic but smooth movement. |
| **Gradient** | `gr` | `color1`/`c1`, `color2`/`c2`, `speed`/`s`, `frequency`/`f` | Smooth transition between two colors. |
| **Typewriter** | `tw` | `delay`/`dl`, `land`/`l`, `snap`/`sn` | Reveals characters one by one. |
| **Marquee** | `mq` | `min`/`m`, `max`/`x`, `vertical`/`v` | Scrolling marquee effect. |
| **Shadow** | `sd` | `color`/`c`, `x`, `y` | Custom offset shadow. |
| **Show After** | `sa` | `delay`/`dl` | Hides text for a set duration. |

### 🔍 Showcase Command

You can see all these effects in action in-game by running:
`/textstyles showcase`

## 🛠️ Contributing & Feedback

Contributions, ideas, and bug reports are always welcome!
- Found a bug? Report it on our [GitHub](https://github.com/RazorPlay01/Text-Styles/issues).
- Want to contribute? Feel free to fork the project and submit a pull request.

## 📄 License

This mod is licensed under the **MIT License**.

## ❤️ Acknowledgments

**Text Styles** was created by **[RazorPlay01]** to bring more expressiveness to Minecraft's text. Thank you for using the mod! If you enjoy it, please consider leaving a star on the repository!

title: HoverBoard
description: Fly like Marty McFly with this premium Hoverboard mod!
body:
****What is Hover Board?**** 

Hover Board is a Fabric mod that introduces a stylish and functional hoverboard to Minecraft. Designed for players who want a faster, more dynamic way to travel, this mod combines futuristic aesthetics with smooth physics-based movement.


****Key Features****

- Smooth Hover Physics: The board naturally floats 0.6 blocks above the ground, providing a cushioned glide over terrain.

- Enhanced Mobility: With a high step height of 2.1, the hoverboard can easily scale blocks and navigate uneven landscapes without losing momentum.

- Dimension-Specific Abilities:
Overworld/Nether: Perform high jumps to clear gaps and obstacles.
The End: Hold the jump key to defy gravity. The board will lock your height, allowing you to glide safely across the void between islands.

- Full Customization: Personalize your ride! Right-click the board with any Dye to change its color. If you want to return to the original look, simply use a Brush on it.

- Fire & Lava Immunity: The hoverboard is completely fireproof. It can travel across lava lakes without taking damage, making it a perfect companion for Nether exploration.

- Visual Flair: Dynamic cloud and End Rod particles trail behind you as you move, giving your travel a premium, high-tech feel.


****Why Download Hover Board?**** 

If you find horses too clunky or boats too limited, the Hover Board offers a versatile alternative. It’s not just a vehicle; it’s a tool for exploration that handles falls (zero fall damage while riding) and dangerous environments with ease.


****How to Use****

- Crafting: Create your board at a crafting table using Sticks, Iron Ingots, Obsidian, and a Redstone Torch.
- Riding: Place the board on the ground and right-click to mount it.
- Controls: Use standard movement keys. Use the Jump key for impulses in most dimensions, or hold it in the End to maintain your current altitude.
- Dyeing: Right-click with any dye to change the board's color. Use a Brush to clean it.

****Requirements****

- Minecraft: 1.21.10+
- Fabric Loader: >= 0.18.4
- Fabric API: >= 0.138.4

title: Star Rating
description: A Stardew Valley inspired star rating system that gives every item a chance to become legendary.
body:
# May the stars guide your adventure!

**Have you ever tended your crops in Stardew Valley, hoping for that iridium-quality harvest?**

**Now, that excitement comes to Minecraft!**


Star Rating adds random quality tiers to your food, weapons, tools, and armor — from ordinary Iron Star to legendary Netherite Star, and even the hidden Iridium Star.

Every item receives its own independent chance to gain a star when picked up, with rarer stars being harder to obtain. Different stars grant powerful bonuses such as attack damage, mining speed, armor, health regeneration, and more, with unique effects tailored to weapons, tools, armor, and food.

All star values, weights, and effects are fully configurable, and you can even create your own custom star tiers to shape your adventure exactly the way you like.

With a built-in coin economy and anvil upgrade system, you can use star coins to try to upgrade an item’s star — enjoy the thrill of a mystery box combined with strategic planning.


Ready to make every sword and every loaf of bread shine? 

### 🌟 Highlights：
- **Inspired by Stardew Valley** — core mechanics pay tribute to the beloved quality rating system.
- **Per‑Item Rolling** — each item in a stack is rolled independently; you might get multiple stars from one pickup.
- **Type‑Specific Bonuses** — weapons, tools, armor, and food each have unique bonuses, viewable by holding Shift.
- **Iridium Easter Egg** — Netherite star items have a 1% chance to become an Iridium Star with a special texture and increased value.
- **Fully Configurable** — add, remove, or tweak star tiers via JSON files; no restart required.
- **Coin Economy** — craft, upgrade, and recycle star coins for a complete progression loop.

### ⚙️ Configuration Guide：
**Main Config File：**

.minecraft/config/star_rating/star_rating-common.toml – Controls global parameters and feature toggles.


```
[general]
    star_chance = 0.5               # Probability of an item getting a star (0.0 ~ 1.0)
    enable_food_stars = true        # Enable star effects for food
    enable_weapon_stars = true      # Enable star effects for weapons
    enable_tool_stars = true        # Enable star effects for tools (mining speed & fortune)
    enable_armor_stars = true       # Enable star effects for armor
```

Changes take effect after /reload or rejoining the world.

**Star Effect Files：**

Inside config/star_rating/effects/, each star has its own .json file named after the star ID (e.g., iron_star_rating.json).

You can add, delete, or modify these files to define star weights and specific bonuses.

Full field list (all numeric fields are optional, defaulting to 0 or 1.0):



```
{
  "star": "iron_star_rating",        // Star ID (required)
  "weight": 25,                      // Random weight (required, higher = more common)
  "extraDamage": 1.0,                // Extra attack damage
  "attackSpeed": 0.5,                // Extra attack speed
  "reach": 0.5,                      // Extra reach distance
  "damageMultiplier": 0.1,           // Multiplicative damage bonus (0.1 = +10%)
  "armor": 1,                        // Extra armor points
  "toughness": 0.5,                  // Extra armor toughness
  "damageReduction": 0.02,           // Damage reduction percentage (0.02 = 2%)
  "breakSpeedMultiplier": 1.05,      // Mining speed multiplier (1.05 = +5%)
  "looting": 1,                      // Extra looting level
  "fortune": 1,                      // Extra fortune level
  "extraHunger": 4,                  // Extra hunger/saturation from food
  "regenDuration": 5,                // Regeneration duration (seconds)
  "regenAmplifier": 0,               // Regeneration level (0 = I)
  "resistanceDuration": 5,           // Resistance duration (seconds)
  "resistanceAmplifier": 0,          // Resistance level (0 = I)
  "absorption": 6,                   // Absorption health (temporary HP)
  "sell": [                          // Selling table (for potential extension, unused in current version)
    {"item": "star_rating:gold_coin", "count": 1, "weight": 10}
  ]
}
```

Tip: You only need to include the fields you want to set; omitted fields will use their default values. To add a completely new star, simply create a new JSON file in this directory – the mod will load it automatically.

**Custom Textures:**

Star icons are stored under assets/star_rating/textures/gui/stars/ and must match the star ID exactly (e.g., diamond_star_rating.png). When adding a new star, remember to provide the corresponding texture.

You can easily supply these textures using a Resource Pack or KubeJS, without needing to modify the mod itself.

title: OpenComputers Community Edition
description: Modular, persistent, programmable computers and robots.
body:
**Disclaimer**

This project is NOT an official OpenComputers release.

This is an unofficial continuation of OpenComputers.

This project is currently in beta. Features may change, and bugs or unexpected behavior may occur.

**Overview**

This mod adds computers that can be **programmed in Lua 5.2 and 5.3**, while preserving compatibility with existing OpenComputers software wherever possible. Computers **persist** across saves (i.e. execution resumes where the computer was saved when it is loaded again), they are highly **modular** (there are graphics cards, network cards, redstone cards, ...). If a compatible power generating mod is present, by default they will need power to run - however, like pretty much everything else about the mod, this can be changed in the config.

OpenComputers is designed to fit well with **survival gameplay**, and is played best in combination with other mods, which allow automating ore processing, and ideally crafting to some extent! Computers are not cheap to craft, so don't expect to build your first computer early when starting a new game. If you want an extra challenge, try the hard mode recipe set (see _.minecraft/config/opencomputers/user.recipes_ for more information).

There are a lot of components in the mod that can be used to extend computers, such as **motion sensors, holograms** and there are also **robots**.

Inter-operation with many other mods is provided via the Adapter block (for example reading power information from energy cells and so on).

For more information, please visit the **Wiki** at http://ocdoc.cil.li/ where, aside from blocks and items in the mod, the built-in Lua APIs are documented as well, so you can read up what you can actually do with the computers.

**Credit**
Thanks to the original author Sangar, Vexatos, payonel, magik6k, Lord Joda, and all GitHub contributors.

## What is Reworked TPA?
Reworked TPA is a lightweight, fully configurable teleportation plugin for Minecraft 1.21.11. Perfect for survival and multiplayer servers.

**Features:**
- `/tpa`, `/tpaccept`, `/tpdeny` with 30-second expiration
- `/back` to return to your death location

## Installation
1. Download the JAR from Modrinth.
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start the server; `playerdata.txt` and default `config.yml` will be generated automatically.

Modify `config.yml` to:
- Enable/disable commands
- Enable/disable death messages
- Customize join, first-time join, and leave messages

---

## Commands
- `/tpa <player>` — Request teleport to a player
- `/tpaccept` — Accept a teleport request
- `/tpdeny` — Deny a teleport request
- `/back` — Teleport back to your death location

description: Reorders Figura's runtime resource pack so its higher priority than the mod. Mainly for use with custom backends.
body:
# Figura Pack Reorder
This mod is quite simple. All it does is move [Figura](https://modrinth.com/mod/figura)'s runtime resource pack to be above Figura itself in terms of priority. Made with intention for use with custom backends such as [Nuovo](https://nuovo.zoid.one/).

This allows for custom backends to change existing assets rather than only being able to add new ones. (e.g. repurposing badges)

If using this mod for a custom backend, make sure you go to Figura settings and press `Redownload Assets` whenever you switch backend IPs.

Only versions that Figura supports are tagged, but the mod loads on every version I've tested >1.19.3, including through [Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector), so it should support future Figura versions.

This appears to have been intentional behaviour at one point, as it seems to work without this mod in versions <=1.19.3, but the offical backend doesn't use it and thus it has gone unpatched.

title: Totem on Death
description: A Minecraft mod that changes the death mechanic, forcing players to work together.
body:
**The mod is currently in beta, so bugs are to be expected, especially when updating it.**
**Please back up any worlds in which you are using the mod.**
# Totem on Death

Totem on Death introduces a death mechanic designed to encourage cooperation in multiplayer environments.

When a player dies, they can choose to respawn normally and lose an increasing number of items with each death, or they can respawn in Totem Mode.

In Totem Mode, players do not respawn immediately and do not lose their items. Instead, they enter a temporary respawn phase. During this phase, players must either:

1) wait for the respawn timer to expire (the default is 5 in-game hours). 
2) Return earlier by using a respawner block.

The purpose of this system is to encourage teamwork, as you require the help of other players to respawn more quickly without losing items.

## Respawner Blocks

The mod adds two types of Respawner blocks:

### Survival Respawner
- Craftable in Survival Mode
- Decays over time
- Disappears after use or when fully decayed
### Creative Respawner
- Available exclusively in Creative Mode
- Allows unlimited respawns
- Does not decay

Players can respawn by standing on a Respawner during the respawn phase.

## Crafting

![Respawner crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd9682b8d857dfac7a3d36e41f0cdd4832a70b91.png)

## Config

The following can be edited in the 'Totem-on-death.json' file (server-side):
- Time to respawn in seconds (TimeToRespawnInSeconds). Default: 5 hours.
- Whether the player should automatically respawn in Totem Mode (AlwaysRespawnInTotemMode). Default: false.

Do not edit the 'version' part of that configuration file.

## Keep Inventory

The 'Keep Inventory' function should work as normal.
