title: Rough Beginnings
description: Small early-game survival overhaul for that combines a heavily modified EarlyStage with Never Punching Trees and a few other things.
body:
# Rough Beginnings

An early-game survival overhaul for NeoForge 1.21.1. 

## Goal

- make those first 30 minutes of a fresh world feel like you're truly starting from scratch.

## What it does

- **Starting your world.** You need to really think about how your going to obtain your starting tools, do you have acess to gravel near by? Is there a lot of grass around you? Any dead bushes or leaves in sight? Those are all the new questions you'll need to ask yourself during your first day getting started in your new world.
- **Rocks everywhere.** Rocks scatter across every overworld biome on dirt or stone surfaces via anything that tags into `#minecraft:is_overworld`. Pick them up, place them as decoration , or chuck them at friends and foes!
- **Throwable rocks.** Snowball-style trajectory, 2 damage on hit. 85% chance the rock drops back so you can pick it up; 15% chance it shatters with stone particles and a satisfying crack.
- **Flint tools.** Sword, shovel, pickaxe, axe, hoe. Stronger than wood, slightly weaker than stone, wooden mining tier flint gets you cutting and digging without breaking the stone pickaxe needed for iron progression. Recipes need plant string for binding.
- **Crafting Rock.** A 3×3 surface you knap by hitting with a rock. Accepts any vanilla crafting recipe. Works as a primitive crafting table for when you can't make a real one yet.
- **Sieve.** Right-click to insert dirt, sand, gravel, etc. Then keep right clicking until items drop. Drops useful early-game items per the data pack: string, bone, clay, iron and gold nuggets, or even the rare diamond depending on what you Sieve!
- **Plant Fiber & Plant String.** Fiber drops from almost every type of grass. Twist 1 fiber into 2 strings.

## How it plays

1. Spawn in a fresh world. Punch grass, get plant fiber. Leaves are still hand-breakable for saplings/sticks.
2. Find 3 rocks on the ground create your crafting rock while holding onto your Knapping Rock.
3. Gather plant fibers from grass than twist your 4 fibers into 2 plant strings.
4. Place a crafting rock. Knap your first flint tools at the crafting rock.
5. Get wood and string for a Sieve. Sieve dirt and gravel for early bones, clay, and your first iron nugget. Cobble together better tools as the materials come in.
6. By the time you have a stone pickaxe, you've actually earned it.

## Compatibility

- **[Immersive Weathering](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-weathering)** (NeoForge port) — sandy dirt, silt, and grassy variants are sieve-able with themed loot.
- **[Salt](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/salt)** (NeoForge port) — `salt:salt_block` is hand-breakable.
- **[Still Life](https://modrinth.com/mod/still-life)** — rocks generate in all 108 of its biomes automatically (it tags into `#minecraft:is_overworld`).

No hard dependencies on any of the above — they're pure compat patches that activate when the mod is present.

## Configuration

`config/rough_beginnings-common.toml`:

| Option | Default | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `requirePreferredTool` | `false` | If true, you must use the matching tool category (pickaxe for stone, axe for wood, etc.) - not just *any* tool. |
| `alwaysAllowInstaBreak` | `true` | Instant-break blocks (tall grass, etc.) bypass the rule even without a tool. |
| `forceInCreative` | `false` | Apply the hand-breaking rule in creative mode too. |

For finer control, edit the `rough_beginnings:breakable` block tag and the `rough_beginnings:canbreak` item tag via a datapack. The data pack also defines per-block sieve drops in `data/rough_beginnings/sieve_drops/` - you can add your own without touching the jar.

## Credits & License

MIT-licensed. Built on:

- **[EarlyStage](https://github.com/Globox1997/EarlyStage)** by **Globox_Z** (MIT) - original Fabric mod whose rock, sieve, crafting rock, and flint tool concepts power the gameplay here. Heavily modified for NeoForge 1.21.1; most upstream features cut, rewritten, or restyled.
- **[Never Punching Trees](https://github.com/96Leaf/NeverPunchingTrees)** by **96_Leaf** (MIT) - the block-breaking restriction logic that became the "Hands Off" backbone.

Full breakdown of what came from where in the [ATTRIBUTIONS](https://github.com/QanoriaPorts/Rough-Beginnings-1.21.1/blob/main/ATTRIBUTIONS) file.

Admins can turn the Server off no matter what with:

•/ssdf
•/shutdownf

title: Velaris Core
description: Velaris Core is a lightweight Fabric client mod designed for QoL, PvP and HUD improvements
body:
#

⚡ Velaris Core

A lightweight Fabric PvP utility & performance mod designed to enhance combat awareness, visual clarity, and gameplay smoothness — without unnecessary bloat.

Minecraft • Fabric • PvP Utilities • Performance Improvements

--- # 🚀 Overview **Velaris Core** enhances the Minecraft PvP experience with useful gameplay utilities, visual indicators, and internal performance optimizations while remaining lightweight and fully configurable. The goal of Velaris is simple: > Provide powerful PvP utilities while keeping the client fast, minimal, and distraction-free. Every feature is designed to **improve gameplay awareness and responsiveness while preserving a vanilla-friendly experience.** --- # ✨ Current Features ## 👁️ SnapLook Quickly check behind you without turning your character. When activated, your camera temporarily rotates behind your player while your character continues facing forward. This allows you to monitor opponents chasing you during combat. **Default Keybind:** `Left Alt` **Use Cases** - Checking if an enemy is chasing you - Tracking players during fights - Maintaining situational awareness in PvP --- ## 🔍 Zoom Allows you to zoom in for better visibility when aiming, scouting, or building. Holding the zoom key smoothly reduces your field of view, making distant objects easier to see. **Default Keybind:** `C` **Benefits** - Better long-distance visibility - Improved aiming during PvP - Useful for building and scouting --- ## 💡 Fullbright See clearly in dark environments such as caves, nighttime, or underground areas. Fullbright removes darkness limitations, allowing you to maintain visibility without using gamma adjustments. **Benefits** - Clear visibility in caves - Easier exploration underground - Better awareness during night combat --- ## 🎯 Dynamic Crosshair A smarter crosshair that adapts based on what you're targeting. The crosshair dynamically reacts to entities and blocks, providing clearer visual feedback during combat and general gameplay. **Highlights** - Better targeting visibility - Minimalistic design - Useful during fast-paced PvP --- ## 🛡️ Armor HUD Displays your armor durability directly on your screen. Instead of opening your inventory during combat, you can quickly monitor your armor condition. **Benefits** - Prevents unexpected armor breaks - Improves combat awareness - Saves time during fights --- ## 📦 Shulker Preview Preview the contents of a Shulker Box without placing it. Simply hover over a shulker box in your inventory to instantly view its stored items. **Benefits** - Faster inventory management - Helpful for storage systems - Saves time while organizing items --- ## 📊 FPS & Ping Display Displays your **FPS (Frames Per Second)** and **network latency** directly on your screen. This helps you quickly monitor performance and detect lag during gameplay. **Useful for** - Identifying lag spikes - Monitoring connection stability - Checking client performance --- ## ❤️ Low Health Warning A subtle vignette effect appears when your health becomes critically low. This visual warning helps alert you during intense combat situations so you can react quickly. --- ## ⚡ Performance Optimizations Velaris includes internal optimizations that improve overall gameplay smoothness while keeping resource usage low. These optimizations reduce unnecessary work done by the client during rendering and gameplay updates. **Examples** - Reduced unnecessary rendering operations - Improved particle handling - Smarter entity visibility checks --- # ⚙️ Configuration Menu Velaris includes a built-in **configuration menu** allowing you to control every feature. From the menu you can: - Enable or disable individual features - Customize your gameplay experience - Keep the client minimal and tailored to your preferences **Open Config Menu** Default Keybind: `Right Shift` --- # 🎮 Designed For Velaris Core is designed primarily for: - PvP players - Competitive Minecraft gameplay - Lightweight client enhancements - Players who prefer performance-focused mods over large client packs --- # 📦 Installation 1. Install **Fabric Loader** 2. Download **Velaris Core** 3. Place the `.jar` file inside your `.minecraft/mods` folder 4. Launch Minecraft using Fabric --- # 🔮 Planned Features Velaris Core is actively being developed and more features are planned for future updates. ### 📊 CPS Counter Displays your current **Clicks Per Second**, useful for PvP players monitoring their clicking speed. ### 🎯 Hit Color Indicator Highlights entities when they are hit, making combat feedback clearer and easier to track. ### 👀 Player Direction Indicator Shows the direction nearby players are facing, improving situational awareness during fights. ### 🧠 Smart Performance Mode Automatically enables additional performance optimizations when FPS drops during intense gameplay situations. ### 🧱 Block Outline Enhancer Improves the visibility of block outlines while targeting blocks, making building and breaking more precise. --- # 💬 Philosophy Velaris focuses on **clarity, awareness, and performance**. Instead of overwhelming players with dozens of features, Velaris provides **carefully chosen utilities that enhance gameplay while keeping Minecraft feeling vanilla and responsive.**

title: Breeze Powder
description: A small mod that adds the ability to craft Breeze Powder from Breeze Rods, and adds several recipes and functionalities to the titular item.
body:
This mod adds the ability to craft Breeze Powder using two Breeze Rods. Much like Blaze Powder, Breeze Powder can be used a variety of ways, in crafting recipes, in potions, and it even has some effects when used or consumed under specific circumstances.



**Breeze Boost**

If Breeze Powder is used while the player is gliding with an Elytra, they will receive a short burst of vertical momentum, ideal for maximizing your air time. Unlike firework rockets, this doesn't propel you forward or increase your speed, it only gives you an upwards boost. Additionally, it takes a small amount of time to consume, meaning you'll have to be strategic about when you start using it, and you won't be able to use them to quickly take off from the ground.



**Breeze Breath**

If Breeze Powder is used while the player is underwater, it will restore some of their breath meter. Like the Breeze Boost, it takes a small amount of time to consume, meaning you'll have to be smart about when you choose to start using it.



**Breeze Freeze**

The chilly blast of wind released by Breeze Powder is capable of giving a Snow Golem the Fire Resistance effect for a substantial amount of time (five minutes,) allowing them to survive in warmer climates.

Additionally, when Breeze Powder is used on Ice, it will convert it to Packed Ice, and has a chance to spread the ice to nearby water source blocks. Alternatively, if used on Packed Ice, it has a one-third chance of converting it to Blue Ice. Finally, you can use the Breeze Powder on a cauldron containing water to convert it to a cauldron full of Powder Snow.



This mod also adds new crafting recipes for the following items:

- Eye of Ender
- Bucket of Powder Snow
- Snowball
- Ice
- Packed Ice
- Blue Ice
- Wind Charge
- Potion of Levitation, with Long and Strong variants.

### Soul Economy • God Forge • Ultimate Mace Power

Bring **soul-powered weapons** and a **fully immersive soul economy** to your Minecraft server.

Each mace includes:  
• **1 Passive Ability**

## 🐉 Dragon's Fury

---

# 🫀 Soul Heart System

**Core mechanics & utilities**

- **Soul Binding Chamber**  
  Open with: `/sm soul` — bind your Soul Heart and track progression.

- **Soul Forge**  
  Place the Soul Forge block and interact to forge maces via an in-game GUI.

- **Ritual System**  
  Build specific block patterns to trigger rituals that grant rare upgrades and hidden rewards.

- **Soul Heart Transfer**  
  `/sm giftsoul <player>` — gift/transfer your Soul Heart to another player.

- **Phoenix Tear**  
  A rare consumable used to **revive players** or **clear ban timers**.

---

# 🎨 Resource Pack (Required for full visuals)

To experience custom models & textures for all 7 maces, include the official resource pack in your plugin page so players can download it.

**Download (Resource Pack):**  
https://www.mediafire.com/file/ksijkolltekq23d/SoulMaces-Reborn.zip/file

**Installation (server-side recommended):**
1. Upload the ZIP to a public host (or keep this MediaFire link).  
2. Set in `server.properties`: `resource-pack=<direct-download-link>`  
3. Players will be prompted to download when they join the server.

---

# ✨ Key Features

- **7 Unique Soul Maces** with distinct passives & active modes  
- **Soul Economy**: bind a Soul Heart, collect soul energy, craft/upgrade maces  
- **Live Recipe Editor**: admins edit recipes IN-GAME (GUI) without restart  
- **Double-Shift Mode Switching** for instant ability swaps  
- **Passive Aura Manager**: passive effects auto-apply while holding a mace  
- **Death Penalty Timer** shown on Action Bar (configurable)  
- **Resource Pack Support** via `CustomModelData`  
- **Cooldown Manager**: per-ability cooldown tracking for balance

---

# 🔐 Permissions

| Permission         | Description                            | Default |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------|---------|
| `soulmaces.admin`  | Access all admin commands & GUIs       | OP only |

**Warning:** Only grant `soulmaces.admin` to trusted staff. It allows spawning maces, live recipe edits, phoenix items, and unbanning players.

---

# 📟 Commands

**Main:** `/soulmaces` — **Alias:** `/sm`

## 🟢 Player Commands (Everyone)
- `/sm soul` — Open Soul Binding Chamber  
- `/sm recipes` — View crafting recipes  
- `/sm giftsoul <player>` — Gift your Soul Heart  
- `/sm help` — Show help menu

## 🔴 Admin Commands (Requires `soulmaces.admin`)
- `/sm give <mace>` — Give a mace (inferno · aero · wither · sculk · thunder · void · dragon)  
- `/sm phoenix` — Give a Phoenix Tear  
- `/sm forge` — Give a Soul Forge block  
- `/sm customrecipe <item>` — Edit recipe live via GUI (items: inferno, aero, wither, sculk, thunder, void, soulforge, phoenixtear)  
- `/sm unban <player>` — Remove player's death penalty/ban timer  
- `/sm reload` — Reload config & recipes

---

# 📦 Installation

1. Download `SoulMaces.jar`  
2. Place inside server `/plugins/` folder  
3. Restart the server

On first run the plugin creates:  
- `config.yml`  
- `data.yml`  
- `messages.yml`

(Optional) Provide the resource pack (link above) to enable custom mace textures.  
Start forging with: `/sm forge` → place the Soul Forge and interact to begin crafting.

---

# ✅ Moderator-Friendly Notes

- Keep `soulmaces.admin` restricted to **trusted staff** only.  
- The plugin supports **in-game recipe editing** — we recommend logging recipe changes in staff audit logs.  
- Death penalty and revive mechanics are configurable in `config.yml` — adjust to fit server rules and fairness.  
- Resource pack usage is optional; the plugin functions without it (uses default placeholders).

title: Mustard Craft
description: A lightweight, classic-styled modpack with horror elements, based on a dream I had, adapted to be fully playable. Focused on exploration and unnerving atmosphere.
body:
# **DISCLAIMER**

Although not the main focus, this pack does contain jumpscares. It is fully compatible (and majority of playtesting has taken place) in multiplayer, although for the best experience it is recommended to play with a smaller group using the in-game proximity voice and text chat. Video settings are left open to change, however the defaults provide the intended atmosphere we were trying to create.


## **Main features**

- A unique, Beta-oriented style, combining with modern features and custom mechanics to create an entirely new feel.
- A custom-made main menu to fit the pack's atmosphere (with mostly shitpost/inside joke splashtexts)
- Horror aspects with unique mechanics and counterplay to be learned. No single particular aspect is overwhelmingly present, yet all have their own parts and locations where they shine the most. Some horror is simply ambient distractions, others will affect the way you approach various scenarios.
- Optional Beta world gen, with some custom structures to find and explore
- Gameplay tweaks to increase difficulty, and put a new spin on the vanilla mobs and mechanics you know.
- Full VR support, configured to still feel in line with the classic style as much as possible
- Built-in performance mods for incredibly smooth gameplay paired with the low graphics

  
## **Tips for survival**

**This modpack can be very unforgiving if you don't know some of the mechanics. Here I'm going to vaguely go over some main pointers that can help you get a gist of what to do, while giving minimum spoilers:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- No matter what, stay out of the dark; whether in a cave or approaching night. Torches held in your hand only provide visual lighting and will not actually help you, and they won't last forever when placed. More expensive or rare light sources last longer.
- Don't respawn if you die at night without a spawnpoint in a safe, well lit base. Just don't. You WILL get spawnkilled. If you want, you can Spectate from the death screen and respawn again in survival using a button in the inventory while you're in spectator
- Iron nuggets can be used to craft an Oil Canister, which can be used to re-light some light sources.
- Mobs may spawn with unique tools or abilities that give them dangerous capabilities. Always be on guard.
- When in multiplayer, players will enter a 'downed' state upon reaching 0 HP, and be forced into a crawl, unable to use items or jump. Other players will have 50 seconds to find and revive a downed player by holding right click on them. Multiple players reviving at the same time makes the process go faster.
- Manage your stamina well. If it drops all the way to zero, you will face the penalty of being unable to sprint until it regenerates to full. Stamina regenerates 2x faster if you aren't moving.
- Both the in-game voice chat and text chat are proximity-based, meaning you won't be able to hear people/see messages past a certain range. Players can use the /shout command in chat to significantly increase their text chat range.
  


</details>

# **🔪 Fervente's Butcher Knife** **A utility weapon mod that lets you efficiently harvest meat from animals with a specialized tool!** ![ https://shockbyte.com/billing/aff.php?aff=10999](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fad8ed912cd64e1610fd7eebe4e15ee02aa5976e.png) [Click Here](https://shockbyte.com/billing/aff.php?aff=10999) *** ## **📖 Overview** Fervente's Butcher Knife adds a unique utility weapon designed for efficient meat harvesting. Right-click passive animals with the Butcher Knife to instantly harvest meat without the hassle of traditional combat. Perfect for farms, survival gameplay and Modpack implementation! *** ## **✨ Features** ### 🔪 **The Butcher Knife** A specialized tool that combines combat and utility: * **Attack Damage:** 6.0 (3 hearts) * **Attack Speed:** 1.0 attacks/second (axe speed) * **Durability:** 250 uses * **Special Ability:** Right-click to harvest animals ### 🐄 **Harvest Mechanic** Right-click any compatible animal to perform a harvest: * **Harvest Damage:** 10.0 (5 hearts) - configurable * **Durability Cost:** 20 per harvest (12 total harvests) * **Cooldown:** 3 seconds between harvests * **Loot Compatibility:** Works with Looting enchantment for extra drops * **Fire Aspect Compatibility:** Automatically cooks meat when harvesting ### 🐷 **Compatible Animals** The Butcher Knife can harvest the following entities: * Cow * Pig * Sheep * Chicken * Rabbit * Mooshroom * Goat * Llama * Donkey * Horse * Mule * **Target Dummy** (from MmmMmmMmmMmm mod - for testing/debugging) ### ✨ **Enchantment Support** The Butcher Knife has **restricted enchantments** for balance: **Allowed Enchantments:** * ⚔️ **Sharpness** - Increases both combat and harvest damage * 🔥 **Fire Aspect** - Sets animals on fire, producing cooked meat * 💎 **Looting** - Increases meat drops from harvests * 🛡️ **Unbreaking** - Extends tool durability **Blocked Enchantments:** * ❌ Any other sword enchantments ### 🧰 **Crafting System** **Step 1: Butcher Knife Cleaver** (Crafting Component) ![Butcher Knife Cleaver](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_4e6f9fce-e6e8-481d-84dd-db35b93efc9a.png) _Any type of meat work in the corners_ **Step 2: Butcher Knife** (Final Tool) ``` Shapeless Recipe: - 1x Butcher Knife Cleaver - 1x Stick ``` ### ![Butcher Knife Recipe](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_a2a0ea55-cc43-4e8e-bffb-eb2a28baa5bb.png) ⚙️ **Configuration** All values are fully configurable via `ferventes_butcher_knife-common.toml`: ```toml [damage] harvestDamage = 10.0 # Damage dealt per harvest (10.0 = 5 hearts) weaponDamage = 6.0 # Base attack damage (for reference) [durability] maxDurability = 250 # Total tool durability harvestDurabilityCost = 20 # Durability used per harvest [cooldown] harvestCooldownTicks = 60 # Cooldown after harvest (60 = 3 seconds) [particles] particleCount = 20 # Blood particles spawned per harvest ``` *** ## **🎮 Gameplay Tips** ### 🌾 **Farming Strategy** 1. title: PBP Lightsabers
description: A simple mod that adds lightsabers to Minecraft in a vanilla-feeling way!
body:
A long long time ago in a galaxy far fary away, an amethyst asteriod crashed onto a little planet. The asteriod shattered into thousands of pieces which were buried deep underground. Using these new crystals, the ancient builders discovered a way to create a powerful weapon. For centuries the recipe was lost, but genius minds worked together to discover it once again. And now it's your turn. May the force be with you.

**How to make lightsabers**
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Combine an amethyst shard with red, green, blue, white, or purple dye in a crafting table to get a colored amethyst shard.

Combine two colored amethyst shards with a netherite ingot in a smithing table to get a colored netherite ingot.

With the netherite ingot, right click a block of amethyst to transform it into a colored amethyst block.

Right click the colored amethyst block four more times to grow the kyber crystal.

Once the kyber crystal is fully grown, you can mine it with a diamond pickaxe (or any diamond-level or higher pickaxe) to get the kyber crystal.

Stack two iron ingots on top of each other in the crafting table to make lightsaber hilts.

Put the lightsaber hilt in the bottom left corner of the crafting table, the kyber crystal in the middle, and a colored amethyst shard (matching the color of the kyber crystal) in the top right corner. And you have just made your very own lightsaber!

</details>

**_**This mod is in really early development, as I am working on other projects at the same time, eventually I will expand on this, adding to the lore and customization of the lightsabers :)**_**

title: Gamingecke Survival
description: Vanilla experience with Quality of Life features and more immersion.
body:
## Gamingecke Survival

Gamingecke Survival is a carefully curated Vanilla+ modpack focusing on performance, practical quality-of-life tweaks, and immersive visuals for smooth, familiar Minecraft gameplay.

### Features

- **Performance:** Mods like Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore, Dynamic FPS, and Dark Loading Screen ensure smooth framerates and stability, even in larger worlds.
- **Immersive atmosphere:** Shaders bring enhanced visuals, while Sound Physics Remastered adds realistic audio effects.
- **Navigation and mapping:** JourneyMap makes exploring and navigating worlds effortless, while Distant Horizons extends draw distance for breathtaking views.
- **Information and awareness:** Jade displays block and entity details, Lighty highlights mob-spawnable areas, and Shulker Box Tooltip shows container contents without opening them.
- **Quality of life improvements:** Mouse Tweaks streamlines inventory management, Zoomify allows precise zooming, Not Enough Animations enhances character movement, and Chat Heads makes player communication clearer.
- **Communication and social features:** Simple Voice Chat enables direct in-game voice communication, while Sit lets players sit for more natural interactions.
- **Utilities:** Auto Reconnect Reforged automatically reconnects you to servers after disconnections.

### Notes

- Simple Voice Chat and Sit require additional server-side setup for multiplayer.
- It's recommended to increase the amount of allocated memory, otherwise Distant Horizons may display warnings.
- Created for the [Gamingecke.space](https://discord.gamingecke.space/) server network but available to anyone seeking a relaxed Vanilla+ experience.

## Official Server

You can join the official Gamingecke.space Survival server without this modpack, but installing it is **highly recommended** to unlock features like **proximity voice chat** and a **greatly increased view distance**.

### How to Join the Server

1.  **[Install this modpack using the Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/modpack/gamingecke-survival#download)**
2.  Launch the game by pressing **Play**.
3.  Navigate to **Multiplayer**.
4.  Click **Add Server**.
5.  Enter the connection details:
    * **Name**: `Gamingecke Network` (or a name of your choice)
    * **Server Address**: `minecraft.gamingecke.space`
6.  Click **Done** and connect to the server.
7.  To enter the Survival world, use the **portal** or click the **grass block** item in your inventory.
8.  Enjoy your time on the server!

title: Spectrum Rush
description: A server-side mod for mini-game Spectrum Rush.
body:
# Abstract

[https://github.com/Viola-Siemens/Spectrum-Rush/blob/main/README.md](https://github.com/Viola-Siemens/Spectrum-Rush/blob/main/README.md)

[Design Requirements (DR)](https://github.com/Viola-Siemens/Spectrum-Rush/blob/main/DR.md)

This mod adds a mini-game named Spectrum Rush to Minecraft. When the game starts, n sheep of each of c colors (n*c in total) will be placed around the shared spawn point. Players are asked to collect wool items with corresponding colors within the specified time as many as possible. At the end of the game (operators use the stopping command or all rounds are finished), the player who scores the most wins the game, and a ranking list will be shown to all players.

# Sequence Diagram

![Sequence Diagram](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/892cb595be851a2e1591971ed1edc7d079d8b94c.png)

# Configuration

`SHEEP_COLORS`: A list with c elements. Each element represents a color of sheep/wool.

`COUNT_SHEEP_EACH_COLOR`: How many sheep of each color will spawn after the game starts.

`MAX_SPAWN_RADIUS`: The game area will be from (x0 - MAX_SPAWN_RADIUS, z0 - MAX_SPAWN_RADIUS) to (x0 + MAX_SPAWN_RADIUS, z0 + MAX_SPAWN_RADIUS), where (x0, z0) represents the shared spawn point.

`EACH_ROUND_TICKS`: Ticks (seconds * 20) of each round.

`TOTAL_ROUNDS`: How many rounds will we play. In each round, players will be given a single task to collect a certain color of wool item.

`SHEEP_SPEED_MODIFIER`: The speed modifier of sheep. Positive values make sheep move faster and make the game more difficult. Negative values make sheep move slower.

title: Activated Netherite
description: Improves Vanilla progression from Diamond to Netherite!
body:
### Why add this?

Obtaining Minecraft's most valuable gear requires minimal effort, with dedicated players achieving this within only 1 or 2 days on most vanilla servers.

Many servers have been forced to adopt arbitrary rules of "No Netherite until this date", but there should be a better way to progress without any of these rules, as it is impossible for any decently sized or public server to implement these rules.

### Mod Content

This mod changes nether progression by requiring your first Netherite template to be crafted together (activated) with a Nether Star dropped from the Wither.

![Crafting Recipe for an Activated Template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/oAPZn17t/images/b4c33cdf1a26d1d466b78edde3be6afa7b7c6e6f.png)

All further Netherite templates can be activated with the already activated one, and the activated templates can be duplicated.

As armor progression now requires killing the wither, the drop rate of wither skeletons skulls from the skeletons has increased from 2.5% to 15%, with each level of looting increasing the drop rate by a further 10% instead of 1%.

### Progression Overview

Now in order to obtain the most valuable loot in the game, not only do you have to explore a Bastion, but also fight Wither Skeletons in a Nether Fortress, before fighting Minecraft's most overlooked boss.

title: DynamicServerIcon Reborn
description: A small plugin that allows to dynamically update minecraft server icons
body:
DynamicServerIcon Reborn is a lightweight and configurable Minecraft plugin that allows you to change your server’s icon dynamically. It supports both manual control and an automatic carousel mode, enabling you to cycle through multiple icons at a defined interval.

The idea is inspired from another spigot plugin DynamicServerIcon

## Features

- Switch the server icon at any time using a simple command
- Carousel mode to automatically rotate between icons
- Customizable interval for icon rotation
- Command-based configuration with tab completion


## How to Enable Carousel Mode

1. **Install the Plugin**  
   Place the plugin JAR file into your server’s `plugins/` directory and restart the server.  
   This will generate the `plugins/DynamicServerIconReloaded/` folder structure automatically.

2. **Add Your Icons**  
   Upload your custom server icons (`.png` format, exactly 64x64 pixels) into the `plugins/DynamicServerIconReloaded/icons/` folder.

3. **Register Icons for Rotation**  
   Use the following command for each icon you want to include in the carousel: `/icon carousel add <filename.png>`

4. **Activate Carousel Mode**  
   Once your icons are registered, enable carousel mode with: `/icon mode carousel`

The plugin will now automatically rotate your server icon at the interval specified by `/icon carousel interval <numberofseconds>`.



## Installation

- Download the plugin JAR file and place it into your server’s /plugins folder.
- Restart your server.
- A folder named DynamicServerIcon will be created inside the /plugins directory.
- Add your .png icons (must be exactly 64x64 pixels) into the /plugins/DynamicServerIcon/icons/ folder.
- Use /icon set <filename> to manually change the server icon, or enable carousel mode via /icon mode carousel.

## Requirements

- Minecraft server running Spigot, Paper, or a compatible fork
- Java 17 or higher


## Commands


All plugin functionality is available through the `/icon` (or `/dynicon`) command and its subcommands.


| Command                                     | Description                                             |
|--------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| `/icon mode <manual \| carousel>`           | Select between the carousel and manual mode            |
| `/icon set <filename.png>`                 | Manually sets the current server icon for manual mode  |
| `/icon reload`                             | Reloads the plugin configuration                        |
| `/icon version`                            | Displays the current plugin version                     |
| `/icon carousel add <filename>`            | Adds an icon to the rotation list                      |
| `/icon carousel list`                      | Lists all icons in the carousel                         |
| `/icon carousel interval <seconds>`        | Sets the rotation interval in seconds                  |
| `/icon carousel remove <filename>`         | Removes an icon from the rotation list                 |

---

## Configuration

You can also manually edit the configuration file (`config.yml`):

```yaml
# Select between "manual" and "carousel"
mode: manual

# Icon to display when in manual mode
current-icon: default.png

# List of icons to display when in carousel mode
icon-list:
  - default.png

# Interval in seconds for carousel mode
interval: 10
```


## Third parties

This plugin uses bstats

## Bugs reporting

Please open an issue on [github](https://github.com/chaun14/DynamicServerIconReborn),
Or contact me on my discord [server](https://discord.gg/mwx4RdxhvR)

title: Realistic Time
description: Realistic Time is a datapack that introduces a fully immersive 1:1 real-time system in Minecraft. It synchronizes your in-game day with real-world time, creating a deeply atmospheric and consistent world.
body:
🌦️ Features
🕐 1:1 Real-Time Synchronization
Your Minecraft world ticks forward in real-time—1 second IRL = 1 second in-game. No more accelerated sunrises or rushed nights.

🌍 Custom Yearly Calendar

28-day year divided into 4 seasons

Seasonal transitions bring new visuals and effects (WIP)

Dynamic moon phases

🌬️ Custom Weather Engine (WIP)
Realistic weather progression independent of Minecraft’s default system:

Wind mechanics (Planned)

Localized storms (Planned)

Temperature-based weather changes (Concept phase)

📻 Dynamic News and Alerts System
A trigger-based interface displays contextual updates such as:

Current time of day

Moon phase

Season

Biome (WIP)

Wind conditions (WIP)

Active world events or warnings (e.g., approaching storms)

🛠️ Setup Instructions
To set up Realistic Time in your world:

Install the datapack as usual in your world save folder.

Run the following command once:

/function realistic_time:calibrate
This will initialize the system and set the world time to 6:00 AM.

⚠️ Important:
Do not use /time set or other /time commands after setup. This will break synchronization.

title: Bee Craft | Create
description: A Create modpack for the beecraft server
body:
Bee Craft | Create – A fully immersive, automation-focused survival experience for Minecraft 1.21.1

The Create Survival Modpack is a carefully curated modpack centered entirely around the brilliant and mechanical gameplay offered by the Create mod. It’s designed to provide players with a fresh, rewarding survival experience where creativity and engineering go hand in hand.

Rather than overwhelming you with dozens of unrelated mods, this pack focuses on enhancing and expanding the vanilla experience in a meaningful, focused way—bringing out the full potential of Create in a survival setting.

🛠️ Core Features:
Designed for Minecraft 1.21.1, with stable and tested mod integration

Fully built around the Create mod and its add-ons (if applicable)

Survival-friendly gameplay: explore, mine, build, automate, and survive

Adds quality-of-life improvements that enhance usability without breaking immersion

Carefully selected companion mods to complement Create's mechanics (e.g., performance enhancers, decoration mods, minor tech extensions)

Ideal for solo play or small multiplayer servers

🔧 Gameplay Focus:
This modpack gives players the tools and freedom to automate nearly every aspect of survival—from mining and farming to item sorting and transport. Create’s kinetic mechanics, rotational power, and modular systems open up endless possibilities for creative engineering.

Whether you're building elaborate factories, steampunk trains, or clever contraptions, this modpack offers the structure and stability to support it—all while preserving the classic survival challenge.

🎮 Who Should Play This?
If you're a fan of hands-on technical builds, automation, and problem-solving in Minecraft, this is the modpack for you. No magic, no complicated tech trees, no clutter—just a polished survival experience with room to dream big and build even bigger.

🌐 Multiplayer Support
The modpack runs smoothly on private servers and is especially enjoyable with friends, as you collaborate to build shared infrastructure, automate resource production, or challenge each other to create the most efficient machines.

title: Sanity Awareness
description: Gives a sanity system that players have to deal with in their world
body:
Sanity Awareness is a datapack that creates a sanity system for players to manage, good for those who wants an extra challenge. Sleeping will improve one's sanity by a huge margin. The rest of activities will be listed below that are impacted by the difficulty of the datapack.

Sanity Difficulty

Normal

All players will have to keep track of their sanity by checking the player list (if it has not been overridden). Every 10 seconds, the system will determine whenever you are near a visible mob/player and if you are in a dark area. Passive mobs and players yield the most sanity while hostile mobs yield less.

Insanity

Only activated by running this command /scoreboard players set #InsanityMode SA-Sanity 1, a lot of things will change. For starters, the Y-Level is now part of the variables that will be checked every 5 seconds instead of 10 seconds so don't go too high or low! The more you stay awake, you will become tired where that will decrease the amount of sanity you get from mobs/players. Being damaged by a mob will also drain your sanity! However to combat all of this, certain tasks will provide sanity such as trading, enchanting, taming, and eating.

To disable the Insanity difficulty, run the same command as you activated it but change the 1 to a 0.

title: clientgive
description: A simple clientside utility for spawning in any item within Creative mode.
body:
# clientgive
A simple clientside utility for spawning in any item within Creative mode.

## Installation
1. Download and run the [Fabric installer](https://fabricmc.net/use).
   - Click the "vanilla" button, leave the other settings as they are,
     and click "download installer".
   - Note: this step may vary if you aren't using the vanilla launcher
     or an old version of Minecraft.
2. Download the [Fabric API](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/fabric)
   and move it to the mods folder (`.minecraft/mods`).
3. Download clientgive from the [releases page](https://github.com/PyPylia/clientgive/releases)
   and move it to the mods folder (`.minecraft/mods`).
   

## Usage
- Without any arguments
  ```
  /clientgive minecraft:stick
  ```
  - This doesn't stack items, if there are no empty slots in the hotbar it will return an error.

- With a specified amount
  ```
  /clientgive minecraft:stick 16
  ```
  - Limited to between 1 and 64.

- With NBT data
  ```
  /clientgive minecraft:stick{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:sharpness", lvl:10s}]}
  ```

- With the SlotID
  ```
  /clientgive minecraft:stick 1 36
  ```
  - This can bypass the empty slot restriction.
  - Note: this uses the slot system in line with `CreativeInventoryActionC2SPacket`, many slots have different IDs than normal.


## More Info
More info can be found on our [README](https://github.com/PyPylia/clientgive/blob/main/README.md).

# Skyblock Essentials
### The Core Foundation for Hypixel Skyblock

Skyblock Essentials is a precision-built modpack containing only the specialized mods required for Hypixel Skyblock. No bloat, no unnecessary filler, and no intrusive extra additions. 

This pack is designed to be the **perfect foundation**. Instead of forcing you to spend hours downloading individual utility mods and troubleshooting conflicts, Skyblock Essentials provides a ready-to-go baseline for your Skyblock gameplay. It delivers the essential tools you need to play efficiently while keeping the core profile entirely clean, allowing you to easily fine-tune your game settings exactly how you like them.

---

# 📦 Smart Versioning System
### Knowing what is inside your download is key. This pack follows a specific logic regarding game versions, settings, and updates:

- `X.0.0` (**Game Version Update**): A major milestone release indicating that the modpack has shifted to a completely new version of Minecraft
- `x.X.0` (**Profile & Config Update**): A substantial content or layout update. This version includes up-to-date mod releases bundled directly with my personal settings, UI layouts, and fine-tuned configurations ready to play.
- `x.x.X` (**Mod Maintenance Patch**): A clean, baseline mod update. This version strictly updates the underlying mod files to their latest bug-free versions without altering or forcing any configuration/UI overrides.
---

# ✨ Why use Skyblock Essentials?
- **Strictly Skyblock**: No filler, no random additions, and no intrusive extras. Every single mod included is hand-picked to provide pure Hypixel Skyblock utility.
- **Tailored Experience**: You don't have to compromise. Keep it entirely vanilla-adjacent, or grab our dedicated `x.X.0` milestone to instantly inject a pre-configured performance engine and clean visual upgrades.
- **The Ultimate Baseline**: Built specifically as a rock-solid foundation. Use our custom settings as your starting point, read the patch notes for minor updates, and tweak your setup exactly how you want.

# 🛠️ How to Use
- **Choose your experience**: Head to the versions tab. Grab `X.0.0` if you want a blank canvas to build on, or `x.x.X` to get my personal, hand-tuned mod configurations right out of the box.
- **Enhance your game**: If your game is lagging or you want a cleaner look, simply update to the nearest `x.X.0` build to instantly load an optimized performance and visual stack.
- **Play and fine-tune**: Jump straight into Hypixel! Keep an eye on our patch notes for quick setting adjustments you can easily flip on yourself without reinstalling.

title: AI Builder - Minecraft AI Assistant
description: In-game AI assistant mod with natural language chat, AI-powered building, NBT/blueprint structure management, selection export, and web search.
body:
```markdown
# AI Builder - Minecraft AI Assistant Mod

A feature-rich Fabric mod that deeply integrates AI conversational capabilities into Minecraft. You can chat with AI using natural language, have AI build structures for you, manage NBT structure files, export selections, and even let AI search the web for information.


## ✨ Features 

### 🤖 AI Chat & Command Execution
- **`/ai <message>`** — Chat with AI in-game; AI understands both Chinese and English
- AI can execute in-game operations via natural language commands:
  - Place/fill blocks, clear areas
  - Give items, spawn entities
  - Set time and weather, teleport players
- **Multi-turn conversation memory** — AI remembers context
- **Screenshot support** — AI can "see" your game screen and respond accordingly

### 🏗️ Structure Management 
- **NBT Structure Browser** — A graphical interface similar to Litematica for browsing, searching, and placing `.nbt` structure files
- **TXT Blueprint System** — Supports two blueprint formats:
  - V1: Character grid + legend mapping, intuitive and readable
  - V2 (MCBLUEPRINT v2): Explicit coordinates + full block state properties, precise reproduction
- **`/ai build <name>`** — Quickly build a loaded blueprint via command
- **`/ai blueprints`** — List all available blueprints

### 📐 Selection Tools 
- Graphical selection interface with two-point selection
- **Selection Analysis** — Count block types and quantities within selection
- **Export to NBT** — Export selection as `.nbt` file (includes block entity data like chest contents, sign text)
- **Export to Blueprint** — Export selection as V2 format blueprint text
- Real-time selection highlight rendering

### 🌐 Web Capabilities
- **Web Search** — AI can search for the latest information via Tavily API
- **Web Scraping** — AI can access specified URLs to fetch web content
- Can automatically generate building commands based on web content

### ⚙️ Configuration & Settings
- **In-game Settings UI** — Press `K` to open, toggle:
  - AI chat screenshot
  - Multi-turn conversation memory
  - Web search
- **`/aiconfig`** — Configure API URL, key, model via command
- **`/ainew`** — Clear conversation history, start a new topic
- **`/ailog`** — Forward mod logs to chat for debugging

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/ai <message>` | Chat with AI |
| `/ai build <name>` | Build a specified blueprint |
| `/ai blueprints` | List all blueprints |
| `/ai reload_blueprints` | Reload blueprints |
| `/ainew` | Clear conversation history |
| `/aiconfig show` | View current configuration |
| `/aiconfig <key> <value>` | Modify configuration |
| `/aipos` | Show current coordinates |
| `/ailog [on/off]` | Toggle log display |
| `/ainbt` | NBT-related commands |

## 🔧 Configuration

A configuration file will be generated at `config/helloworld.properties` on first launch:

| Config Key | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `api_base_url` | AI API endpoint | Kimi API |
| `api_key` | API key | Must be set manually |
| `model` | AI model name | kimi-for-coding |
| `screenshot_enabled` | Screenshot feature | true |
| `context_enabled` | Multi-turn conversation | true |
| `web_search_enabled` | Web search | true |
| `tavily_api_key` | Tavily search API key | empty |

> ⚠️ You need to configure your own AI API key before use. Supports any OpenAI-compatible API.

## 📁 File Structure 

- `nbts/` — Store `.nbt` structure files, supports subfolder organization
- `txts/` — Store `.txt` blueprint files
- `config/helloworld.properties` — Mod configuration file

## 🎮 Keybinds

| Key | Function |
|-----|----------|
| `K` | Open mod settings UI |

## 📦 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) (≥ 0.15.0)
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Place the mod JAR file into `.minecraft/mods/` directory
4. Launch the game, press `K` to open settings, or use `/aiconfig` to configure your API key
```

title: ToolNovation
description: The simple and handy mod that allows renovating a broken tool along with its enchantments.
body:
# _**ToolNovation**_

**Minecraft 1.21.1 | NeoForge**

---

**_ToolNovation_** changes how broken gear works in Minecraft. Your tools, weapons and armor **won't disappear** when they hit 0 durability - instead they enter a **broken** state and stay in your inventory until you repair them. This works with **all vanilla and modded gear** automatically, with no custom items to replace what you already use.

## Features

### Broken Gear Stays With You
When a tool, weapon, or piece of armor reaches 0 durability, it doesn't vanish. It becomes **broken** - unusable until repaired, but never lost. Broken armor still provides 25% of its protection (configurable).

### Repair Forge
A dedicated block for restoring broken and damaged gear. Place an item in it together with the matching repair material, and each material restores **25% durability** (up to 4 materials per repair by default - enough for a full restore). The required material is whatever the item normally repairs with, so it works for vanilla and modded gear alike.

By default, broken items can **only** be repaired at the Repair Forge - anvil and grindstone repair are blocked so the broken mechanic can't be bypassed. You can re-enable vanilla repair in the config if you prefer.

### Enchantments
Five enchantments, each with a real trade-off:

- **Eternal Binding** - preserves all enchantments through a repair. Without it, repairing a broken item strips its enchantments. The enchantment shatters when used, so plan ahead.
- **Vampire's Touch** - heals 20% of damage dealt, but doubles durability loss. Incompatible with Mending.
- **Featherweight** - +50% attack speed, but you take 30% more damage while wielding it.
- **Reinforced** - keeps working at 50% power when broken instead of locking up, at the cost of -15% mining speed while intact.
- **Tempered Edge** - +2 attack damage, but the item wears out twice as fast. Incompatible with Mending.

### Charm System
The same effects are also available as **charms** - an alternative way to apply Vampire's Touch, Featherweight, Reinforced and Tempered Edge, each with a clearly listed upside and downside.

### Quality of Life
- **Wear penalty** - worn-out tools (10% durability or less) mine slower, warning you before they break.
- **Break feedback** - an action-bar message and particles when an item finally breaks.
- **Advancements** - for breaking and repairing your first item.
- **In-game config** - a settings screen via Cloth Config (optional), with optional Modern UI support for a nicer-looking interface.

## Configuration
Repair % per material, max materials per repair, whether repairs keep enchantments, whether anvil/grindstone repair is blocked, broken-armor protection level, break messages, and the wear-penalty thresholds are all configurable.

## Installation

Drop the JAR into your `mods` folder. Requires:
- **NeoForge** 21+ for Minecraft 1.21.1

Optional:
- **Cloth Config** - adds the in-game settings screen
- **Modern UI** - improves the look of the interface

## License

Apache 2.0

title: TierTagger (OuterTiers)
description: Shows OuterTiers, MCTiers, PvPTiers and SubTiers ranks next to player names in the tab list and as a nametag badge above their head. Client-side, no server install required.
body:
# TierTagger

A client-side mod that shows **MCTiers**, **OuterTiers**, **PvPTiers** and **SubTiers** rankings directly in Minecraft, in the tab list and above player heads.

No server installation needed. Works on any server.

---

## Features

**Tab list** — tier badges appear next to every player's name when you open the tab list. Supports dual badges to show two different tier lists side by side.

**Nametag** — a badge floats above each player's head in-world. Toggle on/off with F5. Gamemode-aware, so it always shows the relevant tier for the server you're on.

**Commands**
- `/tiertagger search <player>` — see a player's full tier breakdown across all services and gamemodes
- `/tiertagger compare <player1> <player2>` — compare two players side by side
- `/tiertagger help` — list all available commands

**Settings** — fully configurable in-game via Mod Menu. Customize colors, which tier lists to show, badge format, cache duration, and more.

---

## Install

1. Install [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for your Minecraft version
2. Add [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) to your mods folder
3. Drop TierTagger in and launch

[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional but gives you access to the in-game settings screen.

---

title: Balanced Anvils
description: Makes anvil experience costs make more sense.
body:
Balanced Anvils =============== Makes anvil penalties (experience cost, anvil usage increase) of certain anvil interactions more balanced. Balanced Anvils is fully functional as a **server-side mod**, but can be installed on the client and used in singleplayer too. --- Features -------- The experience costs added by repairing and renaming are removed. The anvil usages will not increase for renaming/repairing items. title: CNPC Curios API
description: Adds a Curios GUI to CustomNPCs entities, allowing NPCs to visually wear and render Curios accessories. Perfect for military and combat maps!
body:
# 📌 CNPC Curios

[简体中文] | [English]

---

## 简体中文

### 💡 关于本 Mod / About
**CNPC Curios** 是一款专为地图制作者设计的实用扩展 Mod。它在 **CustomNPCs (CNPC)** 的实体上成功添加了 **Curios** 饰品栏 GUI，让自定义 NPC 也能像玩家一样穿戴并渲染各式各样的饰品。

> **⚠️ 注意：** NPC 穿戴的饰品**没有任何属性或实际效果（功能无效）**，但饰品可以**完美在 NPC 身上进行视觉渲染**。只要玩家穿在身上能显示的饰品，NPC 就能同步渲染！这对于营造沉浸感、制作军事战斗地图或 RPG 剧情地图来说，是非常完美的视觉增强工具。

### ✨ 核心特性
* **专用 NPC 饰品界面：** GUI 格子非常丰富，支持绝大多数主流的饰品类 Mod。
* **完美的视觉渲染：** 告别过去 NPC 无法挂载背包、战术挂件或特殊配饰的痛点，轻松让你的 NPC 装备全副武装。
* **打破限制：** NPC 穿戴时会无视玩家穿戴时的部分前置限制条件。

### 🤝 特殊模组兼容性 (Special Compatibility)
本 Mod 对以下知名模组的饰品和装备做了**专门的深度兼容**，不仅能完美渲染，还优化了 NPC 的装备规则：
1. **Fracture Point** — 可以渲染其特色的战术装备与饰品。
2. **[MM] Modern Mayhem** — 针对其现代军事装备做了特殊处理。**打破了原版限制**：例如玩家装备夜视仪（Night Vision Goggles）通常需要先装备导轨类头盔，但通过本 Mod **直接给 NPC 穿戴即可正常渲染，无需任何头盔前置**！
3. **Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks** — 兼容其魔法饰品的视觉外观。

---

## English

### 💡 About The Mod
**CNPC Curios** is a utility extension mod tailored specifically for map creators. It integrates a dedicated **Curios** accessory slot GUI into **CustomNPCs (CNPC)** entities, allowing custom NPCs to equip and visually render various accessories just like players do.

> **⚠️ Note:** Accessories equipped by NPCs are **purely cosmetic and provide no attributes or gameplay effects**. However, they **render perfectly on the NPC's body**. If a Curios item can be visually seen on a player, it will render on the NPC! This makes it the ultimate tool for immersive military combat maps and RPG campaign development.

### ✨ Key Features
* **Expanded NPC Accessory GUI:** Provides plenty of slots and out-of-the-box support for the vast majority of Curios-based mods.
* **Flawless Visual Rendering:** No more naked NPCs—easily kit out your squads with backpacks, tactical gear, or magical trinkets.
* **Bypass Restrictions:** Automatically overrides certain strict equipment requirements when forced onto an NPC.

### 🤝 Special Compatibility
We have implemented **dedicated visual compatibility and rule-overrides** for accessories from the following prominent mods:
1. **Fracture Point** — Seamless rendering for its unique tactical gear and accessories.
2. **[MM] Modern Mayhem** — Specialized integration for modern military cosmetics. **Bypasses attachment requirements:** For instance, while players must wear a railed helmet to mount Night Vision Goggles, **NPCs can equip and render the NVGs directly without needing any helmet framework!**
3. **Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks** — Fully supports the visual rendering of its magical rings trinkets on NPC models.

title: Smooth8x
description: Smooth8x is an 8x8 Minecraft texture pack that will improve V-RAM usage or even improve FPS for low-end PCs. It's also a texture pack for someone who wants to experience Minecraft in a new way.
body:
## Smooth8x

Smooth8x is a texture pack created for the purpose of improving performance for low-end computers or for someone who wants to experience Minecraft in a new way.

## How does it improve performance?

Smooth8x works by having textures scaled to an 8x8 format instead of the default 16x16. This reduces the consumption of VRAM (Video Random Access Memory), which can lead to better performance or even higher FPS (Frames Per Second) if your GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) is old or does not have a lot of VRAM.

## Installation guide:

1. First, download the texture pack for your Minecraft version.
2. Next, move the .zip file out of your downloads folder, and place it into the "resourcepacks" folder.
3. After that, launch your game and navigate to: "Options -> Resourcepacks" and enable the texture pack.
4. Enjoy the texture pack!

(If you get a warning while enabling the texture pack, that says it is broken or outdated, then you can safely ingnore the warning.)

description: Quickly toggle items between your inventory and armor/offhand slots with configurable keybinds.
body:
[EN]
# AutoSwap

**AutoSwap** is a lightweight client-side utility mod that lets you instantly 
swap items between your inventory and armor/offhand slots using configurable 
keybinds — without needing to open your inventory repeatedly.

## ✨ Features

- **Configurable swap pairs** — set any two items to toggle in a specific slot
  (e.g. Elytra ↔ Netherite Chestplate, Totem ↔ Shield)
- **Auto slot detection** — selecting an item automatically picks the correct 
  slot (elytra → chestplate slot, totem → offhand, etc.)
- **Multiple profiles** — switch between swap setups (PvP, Elytra, Farm)
- **HUD feedback** — shows item icons and names after swapping, 
  or an error if the item isn't found
- **Multiplayer compatible** — works on servers
- **EN / RU language support** — toggle in mod settings

## 🎮 How it works

1. Open mod settings via **ModMenu**
2. Click **+ Add Swap** and then **✎ Edit**
3. Select two items and a target slot
4. Bind a key
5. Press the key in-game — items swap instantly

> AutoSwap only automates what you could do manually by opening your inventory. 
> It introduces no unfair mechanical advantage.

## 📦 Requirements

- Fabric Loader 0.17.3
- Fabric API
- ModMenu
- Minecraft 1.21.4, 1.21.8 or 1.21.11

[RU]
# AutoSwap

**AutoSwap** — лёгкий клиентский мод для быстрой смены предметов между 
инвентарём и слотами брони или левой руки. Больше нет необходимости постоянно открывать свой инвентарь во время боя.

## ✨ Возможности

- **Настраиваемые пары свапа** — задай любые два предмета для переключения 
  в нужном слоте (например Элитры - Нагрудник, Тотем - Щит)
- **Авто-определение слота** — выбор предмета автоматически определяет 
  правильный слот (элитры → нагрудник, тотем → левая рука и т.д.)
- **Профили** — переключайся между наборами свапов (PvP, Элитра, Фарм)
- **HUD подсказки** — показывает иконки предметов после свапа или 
  сообщение об ошибке если предмет не найден
- **Совместимость с серверами** — работает на серверах
- **Поддержка EN / RU** — переключение прямо в настройках мода

## 🎮 Как использовать

1. Открой настройки мода через **ModMenu**
2. Нажми **+ Добавить свап**, затем **✎ Изменить**
3. Выбери два предмета и целевой слот
4. Назначь клавишу
5. Нажми клавишу в игре — предметы поменяются мгновенно

> AutoSwap лишь автоматизирует действия, которые игрок 
> может выполнить вручную через инвентарь. 
> Никаких нечестных механических преимуществ.

body:
# 🔨 MaceSMP — The Ultimate Custom Mace Weapon System

Transform your SMP's combat experience with **MaceSMP**, a high-powered Paper/Spigot plugin tailored for Minecraft 1.21.1+. Instead of standard vanilla weapons, MaceSMP introduces three unique, high-tier weapon paths featuring custom execution matrices, celestial mechanics, and leveling progression.

---

## 🌟 Core Loop & Progression System
Every weapon starts at **Level 1** with baseline modifiers. 

*   **Upgrade by Domination:** Defeating another player updates your weapon's internal data container, permanently ranking it up (+1 Level and custom density modifiers) and splashing a server-wide visual achievement!
*   **The Hard-Core Risk:** If you die, your weapon **loses 1 Level** and drops a physically floating **Mace Level Container** on the ground. Anyone can steal your lost level container and right-click it to upgrade their own weapon!
*   **Crafting Alternative:** Don't want to hunt players? Assemble a **Mace Level Container** using rare vanilla assets (Gold Blocks, Diamonds, and an Eye of Ender) to advance your weapon potential safely.

---

## ☄️ Weapon Archetypes & Mechanics

### 🪽 The Angel Mace (Celestial & Utility)
*   **Level 1 — Astral Projection:** Right-click to depart your physical frame! Enter a **10-second Spectator Mode** to scout enemy lines. If your physical body is attacked, you immediately snap back. If it takes a fatal blow, trigger an automatic *Angel Resurrection* to restore your life and take flight!
*   **Level 2 — Beyond Potential:** Unleash creative-style flight for **10 seconds**, leaving a vortex of wind trails behind you. Upon expiration, explode violently to blow back your pursuers—with *built-in fall damage protection*!
*   **Level 3 — Angel Shower:** Command an orbital bombardment, striking all nearby entities with cascading lightning matrices.
*   **Bonus Action — Angel Beam:** Right-clicking while flying or resurrected shoots a 30-block energy beam, dealing precision instant damage.

### 💨 The Breeze Mace (Kinetic & Agility)
*   **Level 1 — Wind Burst:** Right-click to launch yourself forward/upward into the sky using raw kinetic velocity. Full fall-damage immunity included!
*   **Level 2 — Thunderous Smash:** Landing a smash attack from a fall distance strikes your target with real lightning, multiplying damage scales based on how high you fell.
*   **Level 3 — Cloud Jump:** Drop a massive shockwave circle beneath you, leaping extraordinarily high. When you finally hit the deck, a heavy kinetic explosion clears out the battlefield.

### 🩸 The Damage Mace (Raw Power & Berserker)
*   **Level 1 — Heavy Criticals:** Passively scales an extra +15 flat physical damage onto your base hits, spawning heavy particle trails.
*   **Level 2 — Adrenaline Rush:** Right-click to inject yourself with a 20-second burst of **Strength II** and **Speed II** to turn the tide of an asymmetric fight.
*   **Level 3 — Absolute Strength:** Arm an absolute blow. Your next successful attack bypasses standard calculations to instantly strike for **250.0 damage**, vaporizing your opponent in a flash of thunder.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Configuration
Admin commands require operator status or the `macesmp.admin` permission node.

*   `/givemace breeze` — Spawns the baseline Level 1 Breeze Mace structure.
*   `/givemace damage` — Spawns the baseline Level 1 Damage Mace structure.
*   `/givemace angel` — Spawns the baseline Level 1 Angel Mace structure.

### 🚀 Join Gift
To get the action started instantly, the plugin detects when a player logs into your SMP for the very first time and **automatically gifts them one random custom Mace archetype** to kick off their journey!

---

### 📦 Installation
1. Ensure your server runs **Paper** or **Purpur** (1.21.1 or higher).
2. Drag and drop the `MaceSMP.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Completely restart your server console.
4. Log in, become OP, and type `/givemace` to start testing!

body:
# Time Weather Biome Control

A Minecraft Fabric client-side mod that lets the player locally fake time, weather, and biome ambience.
the main motive of creating this mod is to change the sky appearance and weather. Custom sky texture packs have different skies for different biomes to alter between them easily without affecting the actual game can be done with this mod.
Default keybind: `0`

## Features

- Client-only keybind menu.
- Time slider from `0` to `24000`.
- Weather mode: vanilla, clear, rain, thunder.
- Fake biome selector.
- Presets saved in `config/time_weather_biome_control.json`.
- Smooth visual transitions for time and weather.
- Passive compatibility with Iris/shader packs and custom sky resource packs by reporting fake values through normal client world methods instead of drawing a replacement sky.

## Notes

The biome fake is intentionally visual/client-side. It does not change server logic, mob spawning, structures, or actual world data.

Shader packs and custom sky packs can still choose to ignore vanilla world time, weather, biome, or moon values. In that case the pack's own settings win.

title: Aden's Additions
description: This mod adds various special materials like Peridot, Perithyst, Peridot Composite and Copper Composite, all of which can be used to make new weapons, armor and mobs.
body:
![Title Display for the Aden's Additions Mod!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6ad0b8d82e9cd66e28c1c7854475d817a3e1fba.png)
**Aden's Additions** is a Minecraft mod that adds a new resource known as Peridot, which through careful crafting and interactions can be used to craft more powerful resources to be forged into weapons, mobs and special blocks. Peridot is able to be crafted into Peridot Composite Ingots and Perithyst Shards by merging Peridot with resources found across the world.

**Avaliable for Forge 1.20.1** [Previous versions require Terrablender as a dependency]

# **New Blocks and Items:**

### **Peridot, Peridot Composite Clump, Peridot Composite Ingot, Raptorial Armor Set:**

Peridot can be crafted into a Calcite Altar which can convert Budding Amethyst Blocks (which can now be crafted) into Budding Perithyst Blocks. When a Budding Perithyst Block has a Soul Campfire underneath, and Calcite Altars activated with Peridot, it will slowly convert the Budding Amethyst to Budding Perithyst. When a Raw Copper Block is placed on this "activated" Budding Perithyst Block, it will fracture into Peridot Composite Clumps. From there, Peridot Composite Clumps can be smelted into Peridot Composite Ingots, which can be used to craft Raptorial Armor. Raptorial Armor has the protection value of iron while having two times the durability of netherite. Raptorial Armor also comes with some special full set bonuses:

- Negated Fall: Applies the Negated Fall Effect, which completely negates fall damage at the cost of durability (every ten blocks fallen consumes one durability). 
- Camouflage: While wearing the full set, Aberrations will not become aggressive towards the player.
![Image showing the textures of Peridot, Peridot Composite Clump, Peridot Composite Ingot and the Raptorial Armor Set.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64c07d440d9326ef3a40c672a6087d61de2ee174.png)

### **Perithyst Shard, Perithyst Cluster Blocks, Perithyst Scythe:**

When the correct set-up (mentioned before) is utilized on Budding Perithyst Blocks, then Perithyst Crystals will begin growing. By harvesting Perithyst Shards, you are able to use them along with Peridot to craft the Perithyst Scythe. The Perithyst Scythe has a special ability where it allows the player to dash forward. The Perithyst Scythe also comes with some unique enchantments:

- Accelerate (Maximum Level: IV): Sets the maximum amount of dashes to three and increases the total dash distance and speed per level. 
- Fracture (Maximum Level: III): After using the dash ability, the next hit will do extra damage (the multiplier is based on the level). 
- Overcharge (Maximum Level: I): When the Perithyst Scythe only has one dash left, then instead of activating the cooldown, it consumes one Perithyst Shard to dash.

![Image showing the textures of the Perithyst Crystals, the Perithyst Shard and the Perithyst Scythe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30b7d7211b9818c04be397857e2f1d287e9db685.png)

### **Other Miscellaneous Additions:**

- Aberration Mob and Tattered Plate Blockset
- Potion Effects (Aberrant, Shard Synthesis and Negated Fall)
- Primordial Sand (Peridot Ore)
- Special Achievements
  
This is the second Minecraft Mod that I've ever made and I apologize if it's bad.

Thank you everyone who downloads my mod! :)

Diamond Banking is a server friendly economy and lightweight shop mod that aims at providing players with an easy shopping and trading expierence. With this mod you no longer need ender chests at shops nor do you need a large shop with chests and signs to show what they sell.

This mod is also designed to appeal to server admins as every transaction between players or player shops are logged on both the server and on both players, so should there ever be a dispute the admins can easily and effectively fetch the transaction to see what is true.

### Features
- A simple economy system based upon the long standing use of diamonds as currency.
- A shopping system that uses signs as the shop and chests for stock storage.
- Each players diamond bank account is tied to their game profile id which is unique.
- An effective transaction log feature aimed to assist with any player disputes.

## For a more thorough guide please see the Wiki

title: PlayerReports
description: Player Report Plugin - Evidence Logs & Staff GUI. Optimized for Staff Efficiency. The ultimate Report Player Plugin for Networks.
body:
# 🛡️ PlayerReports: Advanced Player Report Plugin

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.10-blue.svg)](https://github.com/UG88/PlayerReports)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Spigot%20%2F%20Paper-orange.svg)](https://papermc.io)
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/java-8+-red.svg)](https://www.oracle.com/java/)

**PlayerReports** is a professional, feature-rich **Advanced GUI Report System** designed for modern Minecraft networks. It streamlines the process of **reporting players** and managing those reports through an intuitive GUI, robust evidence collection, and seamless multi-server synchronization.

---

## 📝 Plugin Overview & Summary
Finding a reliable **player report plugin** or a robust **report player plugin** is essential for maintaining a healthy community. **PlayerReports** offers a complete moderation suite with:
*   **Centralized Staff Control**: A powerful dashboard for staff to manage every report across the network.
*   **Evidence-Based Moderation**: Staff can attach URLs and proof directly to reports, ensuring fair punishments.
*   **Network-Wide Scalability**: Built with large networks in mind, featuring MySQL sync and low-latency performance.
*   **Seamless Integration**: Hooks natively into popular punishment plugins and PlaceholderAPI.

Whether you're looking for an **advanced report system**, a **Minecraft reporting GUI**, or a **cross-server moderator tool**, PlayerReports provides the most efficient workflow for staff and players alike.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

*   **Dual Reporting Modes**: Allow players to report via an elegant **GUI Menu** or through interactive **Clickable Chat Messages**.
*   **Staff Command Center**: A powerful, paginated staff panel to view, claim, and process reports in real-time.
*   **Evidence Collection**: Built-in system for staff to attach URLs or proof to reports (with persistence during the UI flow).
*   **Tiered Alert System**: Differentiates between normal and high-priority alerts (triggered by escalation thresholds).
*   **Automatic Cleanup**: Configurable auto-closure of old reports to keep your database clean and optimized.
*   **Cross-Server Sync**: Support for MySQL polling ensures reports are synced across your entire network (BungeeCord/Velocity balanced).
*   **Punishment Integration**: Native support for **LiteBans**, **AdvancedBan**, **LibertyBans**, and more.
*   **Safe Spectating (SIP)**: Advanced teleportation system with `/reports !back` to return staff to their original location and gamemode automatically.
*   **Fake Report Protection**: Identify and log malicious reporters with a dedicated fake report management system.

---

## 📜 All Commands

### 👤 Player Commands
| Command | Alias | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/report <player>` | - | `playerreports.report` | Open the report menu for a player. |
| `/reportgui` | - | `playerreports.report` | Toggle between GUI and Chat reporting modes. |

### 👮 Staff Commands (`/reports`)
| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/reports` | `playerreports.staff` | Open the main staff dashboard. |
| `/reports <player>` | `playerreports.staff` | Open the report history for a specific player. |
| `/reports !logs` | `playerreports.staff` | View the archive of closed/resolved reports. |
| `/reports !fakes` | `playerreports.staff` | View reports flagged as "Fake Reports". |
| `/reports !back` | `playerreports.tp` | Teleport back to your previous location after spectating. |
| `/reports !toggle <normal|high>` | `playerreports.notify` | Toggle your personal report notification alerts. |
| `/reports !gui` | `playerreports.report` | Toggle your personal reporting preference (GUI/Chat). |

### 🛠️ Administrator Commands (`/reportsadmin`)
| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/reportsadmin reload [all|target]` | `playerreports.admin` | Reload config, messages, categories, or punishments. |
| `/reportsadmin delete <id>` | `playerreports.admin` | Permanently delete a specific report from the database. |
| `/reportsadmin note <id> <text>` | `playerreports.admin` | Add an administrative note to a report. |
| `/reportsadmin gui` | `playerreports.admin` | Toggle the **Global** GUI reporting mode for all players. |
| `/reportsadmin chat` | `playerreports.admin` | Toggle the **Global** Chat reporting mode. |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `playerreports.report` | Everyone | Allows players to use `/report`. |
| `playerreports.staff` | OP | Access to the staff panel and list commands. |
| `playerreports.notify` | OP | Receive notifications when a new report is filed. |
| `playerreports.tp` | OP | Permission to teleport to reported players and use `!back`. |
| `playerreports.close` | OP | Permission to close/resolve reports. |
| `playerreports.claim` | OP | Permission to claim active reports. |
| `playerreports.admin` | OP | Access to all administrative commands. |
| `playerreports.action.<name>` | OP | Permission to execute a specific punishment action. |

---

## 🧩 Placeholders

### PlaceholderAPI (PAPI)
| Placeholder | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `%playerreports_open_total%` | Total number of currently open/unresolved reports. |
| `%playerreports_claimed_total%` | Total number of reports currently claimed by staff. |

### Internal Message Placeholders
Used in `messages.yml` and punishment configurations:
*   `{target}`: The name of the reported player.
*   `{reporter}`: The name of the player who filed the report.
*   `{category}`: The category/reason chosen for the report.
*   `{reason}`: The detailed reason given.
*   `{id}`: The unique report ID.
*   `{count}`: Number of reports (used in thresholds).

---

## ⚙️ Installation

1.  Place `PlayerReports.jar` into your server's `plugins/` folder.
2.  Restart the server to generate default configuration files.
3.  **(Optional but Recommended)** Configure your MySQL/MariaDB details in `config.yml` for network syncing.
4.  Customize your report categories in `categories.yml` and punishments in `punishments.yml`.
5.  Reload the plugin using `/reportsadmin reload all`.

---

## 📞 Support & Links

*   **Documentation**: [Wiki Coming Soon]
*   **Discord**: [Join our Community](https://discord.gg/yourlink)

---
*Created with ❤️ by UG88*

title: WoKPack Vulkan
description: Experimental Vulkan mod variant of the World of Keralis server modpack
body:
# WoKPack Vulkan

**WoKPack Vulkan** is an experimental fork of WOKPack that prioritizes increased framerate and reduced lag. It does this by replacing the game's default renderer with Vulkan, a newer API than openGL, which (on systems that have good vulkan support) can drastically increase performance, and reduce lag spikes. But know that it is incompatible with shaders.

## Focus Areas and Key Dependencies

### 1. Performance optimizations:
- **VulkanMod**: Changes Minecraft's renderer from openGl to Vulkan for vastly improved performance on certain systems
- **FerriteCore**: Reduces memory usage to improve stability.
- **Krypton**: Enhances networking performance and reduces latency.
- **ModernFix**: Addresses common compatibility and optimization issues.
- **Noisium**: Provides sound feedback for in-game events.
- **Better Biome Reblend**: Replaces vanilla's biome blend algorithm with a more efficient one
- **ScalableLux**: Rewrites lighting engine to be more efficient

### 2. Additional Optifine parody features:
- **Polytone**: Enhances the overall aesthetic of your builds.
- **Continuity**: Adds seamless connected textures for a polished look.
- **Capes**: Adds customization options for player visuals.
- **JustZoom**: Offers enhanced zoom functionality.
- **Entity Model Features**: Adds Optifinelike entity model features
- **Entity Texture Features**: Adds Optifinelike entity texture features
- **LambDynamicLights**: Adds Optifinelike dynamic lights

### 3. Quality of life features:
- **WorldEdit**: Provides powerful tools for building and editing large structures.
- **Axiom**: Turns minecraft into 3d modeling software
- **Itemswapper**: Speeds up inventory management by swapping tools automatically.
- **Jade**: Displays helpful block and entity information.
- **Resourcify**: allows you to install and update resourcepacks (including wokflows) and shaderpacks from in game
- **3D-Skin-Layers**: Displays avatar skins layers as 3d
- **BetterF3**: Cleans up the f3 menu and makes it more readable
- **Bigshot**: Allows for higher resolution screenshots
- **Language Reload**: Allows for languages to load faster
- **Model Gap Fix**: Fixes gaps in models
- **More Chat History**: Allows you to scroll further up in chat
- **Remove Loading Screen**: Removes the loading screen, allowing you to get back into game faster
- **No Telemetry**: Removes telemetry
---

**WoKPack** combines cutting-edge performance enhancements with immersive features and user-friendly improvements to provide a seamless Minecraft experience. This pack is designed to keep your game running smoothly while offering tools to expand your creativity whilst building and exploring around the World of Keralis Creative server and beyond.

description: Turn zombies into the biggest threat. Increased spawn rates, sunlight immunity, infection mechanics and new weapons!
body:
A mod that aims to make zombies a more central and challenging part of the game by increasing their spawn rates, removing other hostile mobs, and introducing new infection mechanics.\
Perfect for enhancing the zombie experience without needing to install multiple separate mods and without losing Minecraft’s vanilla atmosphere.

---

### FEATURES:
- **Relentless Undead Hordes:**\
Zombies now spawn at a significantly higher frequency, even in broad daylight.\
They are completely immune to sunlight, meaning nowhere is truly safe anymore.
- **The Only Remaining Threat:**\
Other classic hostile mobs like Skeletons, Spiders, Creepers, and Endermen no longer spawn.\
To ensure you can still collect essential resources, zombies may occasionally drop items that are typically gathered from the absent mobs.
- **Infection Mechanic:**\
Each zombie attack has a chance to infect the player, reduced by the quality of their armor.\
Once infected, the player will eventually turn into a zombie, retaining whatever they had equipped.
- **Expanded Arsenal:**\
New vanilla-style weapons to broaden the combat variety, all craftable in survival mode.

---

### CONFIGURATION:
Some of the mechanics can be customized through gamerules
- **additionalZombieSpawnRate** (default = 10):\
The higher this value, the more frequently zombies will naturally spawn.\
If set to 0, zombies will follow the standard hostile mob spawning rules, meaning they will only appear during nighttime.
- **onlyZombies** (default = true):\
If enabled, skeletons, spiders, creepers, endermen and slimes will be replaced by zombies when spawning.
- **zombieSunlightImmunity** (default = true):\
If enabled, zombies will not burn in the sunlight.
- **doInfection** (default = true):\
If enabled, zombies can infect players when attacking.
- **doInfectionCure** (default = true):\
If enabled, the zombie infection can be cured by eating a Golden Apple (enchanted or not).

---
