title: Async Anticheat
description: A new off‑server detection architecture. Open by design.
body:
[dashboard link](https://asyncanticheat.com/)

![header](https://asyncanticheat.com/thread/header.webp)

## What if your anticheat ran somewhere else?
AsyncAnticheat moves detection off-server. The plugin only captures packets; all detection runs in the cloud. That means **no TPS impact from detection** and a clean, real-time dashboard to review evidence.

## How it works (fast version)
1. **Plugin** captures packets (PacketEvents, shaded)
2. **Batches** and uploads asynchronously
3. **Cloud API** dispatches to detection modules
4. **Dashboard** shows findings in real-time  
Your server never runs any detection logic.

## Dashboard
![dashboard-alt](https://asyncanticheat.com/thread/screenshots/dashboard-alt.webp)  
![modules](https://asyncanticheat.com/thread/screenshots/modules.webp)  
![finding](https://asyncanticheat.com/thread/screenshots/finding.webp)

## Detection coverage
Async Anticheat architecture is open so you can create your own private modules running on your own machines and connect them to your dashboard. I created 6 default modules, two per category:
- **Movement:** speed, fly, nofall, phase, step, timer
- **Combat:** reach, killaura, velocity, autoclicker
- **Interaction:** scaffold, nuker, fastplace, inventory  
Core = obvious cheats, low false positives  
Advanced = statistical analysis

You can enable them from the modules tab, and toggle on/off individual checks.

## Open Beta status
**Working**
- Packet capture + detection pipeline
- Web dashboard with real-time findings
- False positive reporting

**Not yet**
- Automatic kicks/bans (detection only for now)
- In-game alerts
- AAC may produce false positives or miss some detections.

## Supported platforms
Paper/Spigot 1.18+, Folia 1.19.4+. Java 21 required.  
Bungee/Velocity: install AsyncAnticheat on each backend server (not the proxy).

## Getting started (2 minutes)
1. Download: https://github.com/oraxen/asyncanticheat/releases  
2. Drop the JAR into `plugins/`  
3. Start the server  
4. Click the dashboard link in console  
5. Sign in (GitHub / Discord / Email)

## For anticheat developers
I'm building an API so custom checks can plug into the same pipeline. See [the relevant docs](https://asyncanticheat.com/docs/modules).

What it means is if you have an existing anticheat, you can port your checks to an AsyncAC module, this way your users will save performances, you will be able to keep your code private and the community will benefit from your experience.If you need help or have any questions, let me know.

## Pricing
You can host everything yourself, or use my own dashboard. **During the beta, I'll host everything for free** so I can get your feedback and improve the checks. In the future, I plan to fund the project by selling some advanced modules, but **if you've contributed** to the project (by reporting bugs, false positives, suggesting improvements, etc), **you will keep access for free** as a thank you.

## Links
- Website: https://asyncanticheat.com  
- Docs: https://asyncanticheat.com/docs  
- Dashboard: https://asyncanticheat.com/dashboard  
- GitHub: https://github.com/oraxen/asyncanticheat  
- Discord: http://JOIN_LINK_HERE

## FAQ
**Will this affect TPS?**  
Detection runs off-server; the plugin only captures + forwards packets asynchronously. I could not measure any impact on performances during my testings. Bandwith usage was also very limited as packets are highly compressed.  
![monitor](https://github.com/Th0rgal/mcpanel/blob/master/screenshots/monitor.webp?raw=true)

**What data is collected?**  
Movement/combat/block/inventory packets + UUID/session identifiers. No chat messages or server config. Data is retained for 7 days, then purged.

**Why no auto bans yet?**  
I need more data to ensure there are no false positives; I want to wait until I have more feedback.

## Get involved
This is an open beta, your feedback is precious to me and I will remember it.
- Found a false positive? Report it through the dashboard.
- Cheater slipped through? Report and undetected cheat on the player page.
- Have any feature idea? Feedback is welcome

title: OneChunkGuard
description: Just Place a Block - 1 Chunk Protection Plugin for Minecraft
body:
[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/onechunkguard?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&color=00AF5C&label=Modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/onechunkguard) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kamesuta/OneChunkGuard?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/kamesuta/OneChunkGuard/releases) [![bStats Servers](https://img.shields.io/bstats/servers/26619?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft&color=green)](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/OneChunkGuard/26619) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/kamesuta/OneChunkGuard?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE)
English | [日本語](https://github.com/Kamesuta/OneChunkGuard) > 🏆 **Just Place a Block - 1 Chunk Protection Plugin** for Minecraft OneChunkGuard is a simple land protection plugin that **anyone from beginners to Minecraft pros** can use easily. Leveraging the WorldGuard API, it combines intuitive no-command operation with convenience. ## 🚀 Why Choose OneChunkGuard? ### 🎮 **Full Survival Mode Support** - ⚔️ **No OP Required** - Regular players can protect their land - 🏗️ **Survival or Creative** - Works in any game mode - 🎯 **Fair System** - Everyone can protect the same amount (1 chunk) ### ✨ **Simple Usability** - 🎯 **Easy Protection Without Commands** - Just place a block for instant protection - 🎁 **Automatic Distribution System** - Protection blocks automatically given to new players - 👀 **Visual Feedback** - Player head display shows owner at a glance. Owner shown in action bar when entering chunks - ✨ **Chunk Visualizer** - Particles display chunk boundaries ### 🛡️ **Flexible Protection System** - 🏗️ **Multiple Protection Block Types** - Multi-layer protection like spawn areas (1x1 chunk), VIP areas (3x3 chunks) (configurable) - 📐 **Variable Chunk Range** - Freely configurable from 1x1 to NxN - 🏛️ **Parent Region Restrictions** - Protection blocks for specific areas only - 🔄 **Independent Protection Management** - Create and remove protection independently by area type ### 👥 **Collaboration Features** - 🤝 **Advanced Trust System** - Fine permission management per player - 💬 **Interactive TUI** - Intuitive menu displayed on right-click - 🎮 **Intuitive Setup** - Set co-players with just right-click and player name input ## 📋 Requirements - **Minecraft**: 1.20+ | **Java**: 21+ - **Server**: Spigot/Paper - **Dependencies**: - WorldGuard 7.0+ - WorldEdit 7.2+ ## 🚀 Installation 1. Install [WorldGuard](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldguard) and [WorldEdit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldedit) 2. Download the latest version from [Releases](https://github.com/Kamesuta/OneChunkGuard/releases) 3. Place `OneChunkGuard-X.X.X.jar` in the `plugins` folder 4. Restart the server 5. Confirm the plugin loaded successfully ## 🎯 How to Use (So Simple!) ### ✨ **Complete in 3 Steps! No Commands Needed!** #### 🔥 **1. Join the Server** ![Auto-distribution on login](https://github.com/Kamesuta/OneChunkGuard/blob/main/assets/login.png?raw=true) When you first join the server, a **protection block is automatically placed in hotbar slot 9**. Nothing to do! You can start protecting land immediately. #### 🏠 **2. Place the Block Where You Want to Protect** ![Block placement](https://github.com/Kamesuta/OneChunkGuard/blob/main/assets/place.png?raw=true) Just place the protection block where you want to protect. - The moment you place it, **1 chunk (16x16 blocks) is protected** - A player head is automatically placed on top, **owner clearly visible** - Particles show chunk boundaries, so you **instantly see the protected area** #### 👥 **3. Share with Friends (Optional)** ![Right-click menu](https://github.com/Kamesuta/OneChunkGuard/blob/main/assets/menu.png?raw=true) **Right-click** the protection block to display an intuitive menu: - **[Add Member]** click → `/trust playername` auto-filled - **[Remove Member]** click → `/untrust playername` auto-filled - **[Member List]** click → Shows trusted player list ### 📱 **As Easy as a Smartphone** | Action | Method | Result | |--------|--------|--------| | 🏠 **Land Protection** | Place block | Instant 1-chunk protection | | 👥 **Add Friend** | Right-click→Menu | Complete in 2 clicks | | 🔓 **Remove Protection** | Break block or `/unprotect` | Block returned & protection removed | | 👁️ **Check Owner** | Enter chunk | Shown in action bar | ### 💎 **Command List (No Need to Memorize!)** While you don't need to memorize commands, these are available: | Command | Description | When to Use | |---------|-------------|-------------| | `/unprotect` | Remove protection & return block | When removing from afar | | `/trust Steve` | Add Steve as trusted player | When menu is inconvenient | | `/untrust Steve` | Remove Steve from trusted list | When menu is inconvenient | | `/trustlist` | Show trusted player list | When you forgot who you added | ### 🎮 **Real Usage Examples** ``` 🎯 Case 1: Building Alone 1. Place protection block where you want to build 2. Done! Build freely 🤝 Case 2: Building with Friends 1. Place protection block 2. Right-click the block 3. Click [Add Member] 4. Enter friend's name and press Enter 5. Done! Friend can build too 🔄 Case 3: Moving to a New Location 1. Break old protection block (auto-collected) 2. Place in new location 3. Done! ``` ### 🛠️ **Admin Commands** Advanced commands for server administrators: | Command | Description | Example | |---------|-------------|---------| | `/giveprotectionblock [amount]` | Give protection blocks to player | `/giveprotectionblock Steve vip 1` | | `/giveprotectionblock ` | Give default protection block | `/giveprotectionblock Steve` | **Admin Command Features:** - 🎯 **Selector Support** - Minecraft selectors like `@p`, `@a`, `@r` can be used - 🎁 **Multiple Block Type Distribution** - Can specify configured types like default, vip **Permission Settings:** - `onechunkguard.admin` - Admin command usage permission - `onechunkguard.give` - Protection block distribution command permission ## ⚙️ Configuration Customize settings in `plugins/OneChunkGuard/config.yml`: ```yaml # Protection Block Settings protection-block: material: END_STONE # Protection block material display-name: "&6&lProtection Block" lore: - "&7Place this block to" - "&7protect a chunk" - "&cOne chunk per person!" # Protection Settings protection: min-y: -64 # Minimum protection height max-y: 320 # Maximum protection height max-trusted-players: 5 # Maximum trusted players # Messages (Customizable) messages: protection-created: "&aProtection activated!" # ... other messages ``` ## 🐛 Bug Reports & Feature Requests If you find a bug or have a feature request, please let us know at [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Kamesuta/OneChunkGuard/issues). ## 📊 Statistics This plugin uses [bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/OneChunkGuard/26619) to collect anonymous usage statistics. The statistics are collected anonymously and help improve the plugin. If you wish to disable statistics collection, you can do so in `plugins/bStats/config.yml`.

# dPoints

dPoints is a Minecraft Forge mod for tracking and managing player point balances in a server-authoritative manner, with client-side caching and optional integration with FTBQuests.

## Features

- Support for multiple custom currencies - configurable ingame
- Commands: `/dpoints add`, `/dpoints remove`, `/dpoints set`, `/dpoints get`
- API for modders: `PointsApi`
- FTBQuests integration: `PointTask` and `PointReward`
- Ideal for modpack developers to implement shop unlock systems, custom economies, and similar features

## Usage

- Use the in-game commands to manage points.
- Modders can call `PointsApi` methods in code.

## Configuration

No additional configuration required.

title: SToby's Borderless Polished Blocks
description:
Optifine used to have cool borderless polished blocks, and I have never seen a worthy replacement, so I made one!
This pack changes all the 'polished' variant stones in Minecraft!
body:
# Borderless Polished Blocks 

## Overview
Simply, I wanted to create a mod that has the elegance and simplicity of the old optifine connected textures for polished stone variants, without the pain of using optifine. With this resource pack, polished andesite, diorite, granite, tuff, deepslate and blackstone are now borderless textures, with as much honesty to the original texture as possible. For me, it makes them far more useful in gradients, walls, and other places that you don't want a 'tiled' feeling. Being as small as it is, this pack rarely needs updating.

## Contact Me
The only way to contact me is through Bluesky DMs; comments, requests, and bug reports should all go there.

https://bsky.app/profile/stoby.bsky.social

## Usage
You may freely use this pack, but attempting to re-create it without credit will lead to slightly miffed comments. To be honest, I have no idea if this idea is unique, so I will never know if you copy it, however, I do like credits lol.

## Support Me
A Kofi link is available if you love this pack, but only gift if you have spare disposable income, I made this pack in a few hours it's not that big of a deal lmao.

title: Pot of Gold
description: Adds a literal rare pot of gold at the end of a rainbow into your game.
body:
A part of my holiday series, this one is St. Patricks Day themed with tiny leprechauns, clover and a pot of gold all added into the game at world generation.

These structures are very rare, expect to have to travel thousands of blocks between structures to find more than one per world.

Also, now with 100% more leprechauns! These little guys may look cute, but you can plan on them being a bit more on the feisty side.

Also added: 4 leaf and 3 leaf clovers which spawn exclusivly near and around these structures. These clovers can be used to make a lucky, or unlucky stew, respectively.

ADDITIONAL MOD SUGGESTIONS::

Pair this with any of my other holday mods for a festive game. 

Curernt Holiday mods include:
Holloween Craft!

Easter Eggs!

Christmas Land!

More to come.... Eventually I'll prepare a full holiday themed modpack.

OPTIONAL DEPENDENCIES:

No other mods needed

MOD PACK DEVS:
This mod is mod pack friendly, it does not alter vanilla blocks, loot or recipes in any way. You may use it in your mod packs so long as proper credit is given.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The 3 leaf and 4 leaf clovers are found only near the pot of gold. Only one 4 leaf clover will spawn, look carefully at the leaves to find it.  Both can be used to make suspisious stew by replacing the flower in the recipe with the clover. Their effects are poison and luck respectivly.

These structures are not "OP". The amount of gold is worth the effort, but not game breaking.

</details>

title: Sparks & Steam
description: Explore, build, and tinker your way through Sparks & Steam, where there's always something new to try. Whether you're into machines, adventures, or just messing around, this modpack has a bit of everything.
body:
**Sparks & Steam: Where Creativity Meets Adventure!**

Sparks & Steam is a versatile Minecraft modpack that invites you to explore, build, and tinker to your heart’s content. Whether you’re a fan of intricate machines, daring adventures, or simply enjoy experimenting with new gameplay mechanics, this modpack offers something for everyone. From sprawling cities powered by the wonders of the Create mod to perilous journeys into reimagined structures like YUNG’s Better Dungeons, there’s always a new challenge or creation waiting for you.

Key Features:
- Diverse Gameplay: Dive into a richly modded world that includes improved NPC interactions with Villager Names, whimsical additions like Creeper Overhaul, and the culinary delights of Farmer’s Delight and its expansions.
- Enhanced Exploration: Discover overhauled biomes, structures, and dimensions with mods such as William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld, Incendium, Nullscape, and Amplified Nether. Treasure hunters will love the integration of Explorer's Compass and Waystones for seamless navigation.
- Industrial Creativity: Unleash your inner engineer with Create and its suite of add-ons, including Create Deco, Steam 'n' Rails, and Crafts & Additions. Build complex contraptions or charmingly simple gadgets to enhance your world.
- Immersive Atmosphere: Mods like Sound Physics Remastered, Dynamic Surroundings, and LambDynamicLights add realism and ambiance to every corner of your experience.
- Customization & Accessibility: Tailor your experience with visual and gameplay tools like AppleSkin, BetterF3, and Jade, ensuring you always have the information you need at your fingertips.

Sparks & Steam is updated regularly to bring you the latest mods and performance enhancements. It’s designed to provide a seamless, fun, and engaging experience for players of all styles. Whether you're starting a bustling industrial town, tackling revamped strongholds, or experimenting with the physics of Minecraft’s many systems, this modpack will keep you entertained for hours.

Tired of a cluttered HUD getting in the way of your gameplay? 

This mod shows essential stats like health and hunger are displayed seamlessly around your crosshair, giving you a clean, immersive screen while keeping critical information easily accessible. Press R to open the radial menu to select an item (assuming the keybind has not changed).

Perfect for explorers, combat players, and builders looking for a more engaging Minecraft experience!

On loadup, the HUD will be applied instantly. Press R to open radial and [ to revert back to standard Minecraft HUD. You are able to configurate some of the visuals such as the crosshair distance, radius size of the radial, and if the plus cross hair should be visible :)

This mod is currently only on NeoForge, but in sometime hopefully will include Fabric.

Note that that in terms of hearts, its only limited to one row. Future updates will hopefully add that feature. Theres a dedicated row for absorptions tho :D

Feel free to include this mod in your modpack as long as the mod and author is credited :)

## 🚧 Configuring Auto-Update > **⚠️ WARNING:**\ > Using this feature may break your worlds if any world gen mod is added/removed! Please proceed with caution. This feature requires MultiMC/Prism Launcher. I assume it works on the dedicated Modrinth launcher as well, but it is too unstable on my system to test. Do let me know the results if you test it and I can update this section. #### Instructions: 1. In MultiMC/Prism Launcher, click on the Frightful Exploration modpack and click edit. If you don't have it already, download it from Modrinth. 2. In the edit window, click the `Settings` button on the left and go to the `Custom Commands` tab. > **⚠️ WARNING:**\ > Do ***NOT*** click the settings button at the top of the window, those are your *global* settings and pasting the command from step 3 into them will break ***ALL*** other instances! 3. Click the checkbox at the top to allow overriding the global settings for this specific instance, and set your pre-launch command to the following: ``` $INST_JAVA -jar packwiz-installer-bootstrap.jar -g https://raw.githack.com/idiot-shinuki/frightful-exploration/main/forge/1.20.1/pack.toml ``` This command will run and check for an update from the GitHub repository every time you launch the instance. ## 📣 Attributions - This pack wouldn't have been possible without the original idea from CrimsonDoc.

title: NoJumbBreakCrops
description: Very simple plugin wich prevent unpermitted players to break crops by jumping on them.
body:
### NoJumpBreakCrops

This is a very simple Minecraft plugin which prevent unauthorized players
to break crops by jumping on them. This plugin **does not** have any other purpose !

Tested with Paper 1.16, 1.17, 1.18, 1.19, 1.20.
It should work with Bukkit, Spigot in **1.16+**.

*I made this plugin for a private server and I decided to share
it because maybe some people will find it useful.
I may or **may not** add some features.*

*The code could be better organized, but I think it's fine for what it does.*


#### Usage Infos
If you just want to install this plugin to prevent any non-op player from breaking crops
by jumping on them simply put the plugin in the plugins folder. That's all.

If you also want operators to be affected by the plugin set the *affectop* properties to true.

You can go further by using the permissions mentioned below.

#### Commands

- `/njbc` : show the plugin configuration.
- `/njbc <enable | disable>` : enable or disable the plugin.
- `/njbc affectop <true | false>` : if set to true default operators
  will be affected by the plugin if they do not have the permission
  `njbc.breakcrops` explicitly set to true.


#### Permissions

By default, all op players can break crops by jumping on them.

- `njbc.breakcrops` : if a player has this permission
  set to **true** they will be able to break crops by jumping on them.
  If this permission is explicitly set to **false** for a player *(even Operators)*
  ll not be able to break crops by jumping on them. False by default for everyone
  but operators bypass it if *affectop* is set to false.

- `njbc.admin` : permission to use the */njbc* command. False by default
  for non-op players.

#### Config File

- `affectop` (boolean) : true if operators are affected by the plugin.
- `enabled` (boolean) : true if the plugin is enabled.

![farty-banner](https://i.imgur.com/WQifNHL.png)
Sneak around like never before and leave a funny trail of "farts" behind you. This cheeky plugin lets you emit cool particle effects as you sneak in the game. Customize your sneaky style by choosing the type of particles, the sound effect, and where the magic happens, all through a simple config file. It's a barrel of laughs and loads of fun for you and your friends. Embrace the silliness with Farty plugin and bring some extra giggles to your world!

Sneak and let it rip!

---

[Demo](https://youtu.be/x7fTi1fb63A)

Plug and Play
Download and put it in your plugins folder.

---

Commands

    /fartreload - Reloads the configuration of the plugin.

Config
```
# Configuration file for Farty

# Particle settings
# https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Particle.html
particle: SNEEZE
particle_offset_x: 0.0
particle_offset_y: 0.1
particle_offset_z: -0.3

# Fart Chance in percentage
# Value of 0.5 means there is a 50% chance of the fart effect happening (it will happen about half of the time).
fart_chance: 0.5

# Sound settings
# https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Sound.html
sound: ENTITY_CREEPER_PRIMED
```

title: Inventors' Haven
description: Create based modpack
body:
# About 
Welcome to Inventors' Haven, a Minecraft modpack that combines the power of two incredible mods: Create and Applied Energistics 2 (AE2). Prepare to embark on a technological journey like no other as you delve into a world filled with limitless possibilities and boundless creativity.

Inventors' Haven brings together the innovation and engineering prowess of Create, a mod renowned for its focus on mechanical contraptions and automation, with the advanced logistics and storage systems offered by AE2. Together, these mods create a truly immersive and exhilarating experience, enabling players to design complex mechanisms, automate processes, and revolutionize their gameplay.

With Create, you can unleash your inner inventor and engineer, utilizing a wide range of intricate and versatile mechanical components to construct machines, contraptions, and transportation systems. Build complex mechanisms using gears, axles, belts, and pulleys to create impressive machines that can automate tasks, transport goods, and power your world with renewable energy.

AE2 brings cutting-edge technology to the forefront, providing a comprehensive storage and logistics system that revolutionizes the way you organize and manage resources. Utilize advanced storage units, such as the ME Drives and ME Storage Cells, to store massive quantities of items and access them instantly through the ME Terminal. Automate crafting processes with Molecular Assemblers, and streamline your logistical operations with ME Interfaces and ME Cables.

Inventors' Haven also features a carefully curated selection of complimentary mods that enhance and expand upon the core gameplay experience. From additional machinery and automation options to new tools, weapons, and exploration opportunities, every aspect of the modpack has been meticulously crafted to provide a balanced and immersive experience.

title: NearbyRespawner
description: A Bukkit plugin which respawns players at a random location near the death location.
body:
Have you ever moved away a large distance from your world spawn or spawn bed just to get killed by those annoying creepers and finding yourself respawning too far away from where you died? Then this Bukkit plugin has just been made for you!

This plugin tries to find a safe location around your latest death location and respawns you at the new safe location. As getting respawned next to the death location would be too easy, the plugin searches for a random location in a configurable radius around the death location (default: max 1000 blocks).

Searching for a safe location is done by checking the highest block of a random location. So you won't be randomly spawned unarmed in a cave next to a cave spider spawner. The plugin also tries to prevent respawning yourself in lava lakes and big oceans.

In case your normal respawn location (e.g. your spawn bed or world spawn) would be near your death location (default: max 1000 blocks), the plugin simply uses the normal respawn behavior letting you respawn in your safe house or world spawn.

## Configuration

The plugin allows to change some values described in the config.yml provided with this plugin. Load the plugin once to generate it.

## Commands

Currently, there are no commands available.

## Permissions

* `nearbyrespawner.random-respawn`: Allow players to get respawned at a random location (default: `true`)

# My other plugins

You can find them on [my website](https://selfcoders.com/projects/minecraft-plugins).

title: Skull
description: Obtain Custom Heads in Survival!
body:
⚠This project has been discontinued. Check out the better and upgraded version: Skull [Portable]

# Skull Obtain Custom and Player Heads in Survival! > You can find the values for custom heads on this site. # 📖Features This Data Pack allows you to get custom heads in vanilla minecraft using a villager and a Book&Quill. To do so, just summon the skull merchant, craft a bunch of heads, choose a head **value** or a **player name**, paste it in a Book&Quill (in case of the player head **sign the book** with the name of the player), and then add the trade to the merchant.
Craft a Head

Summon a Skull Merchant

- To **succesfully summon a Skull Merchant** the villager must be **unemployed**.
Add Trades for Custom and Player Heads

- **Add a trade for a custom head:** to add a trade for a custom head, simply paste the value of the head you want on a book, then shift and right-click on the villager to teach him the trade. - **Add a trade for a player head:** to add a trade for a player head, simply sign a book with the name of the player, then shift and right-click on the villager to teach him the trade. The book will be consumed and a new one will be given to you.
Remove the Last Trade

- To **remove** the last trade simply **hold an axe (of any type)** and shif+right-click on a Skull Merchant.
# 📤Uninstall the DataPack To uninstall the Data Pack run the command /function custom_heads:uninstall. When the uninstallation process is completed a confirmation message will be sent in the chat. ## 🔗External links ## ❗️Known Issues❗️ - From the second trade that will be added, at the end of the operation, the not updated villager trading UI will be opened. To see the new added trade, just close the UI and talk again to the villager. - When removing a trade, at the end of the operation the not updated villager trading UI will be opened. To see the changes (removed trade) just close the UI and talk again to the villager.

description: Make minor tweaks to chat, including collapse repeated messages, timestamps
body:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/105505041/194760784-ba165c29-d3a1-4879-950d-beb661dafe06.png)

# TweaksNotFound
Inspired by a comment jokingly made by a member of the Zedcraft community, I've created this mod in order to keep chat readable while people were constantly dying in minigames. Currently TweaksNotFound has a focus on small tweaks to the chat, though other small tweaks to the client are an option for the future.

## Goals
The main goals for this mod are:
 - Minor tweaks to the way existing information is shown to the player
 - All tweaks should have an option to disable it

## Screenshots
**Config:**  
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/105505041/194761279-0ca8dd63-b535-4be4-ad64-07e39b451c3e.png)  
**Sample:**  
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/105505041/194760784-ba165c29-d3a1-4879-950d-beb661dafe06.png)

## FAQ
**Can you make a Forge version?**  
I probably could, but this mod was made mainly for myself and a few friends. I won't be making a Forge port myself, but feel free to make a port yourself.

**Will you update it to Minecraft version 1.20.1?**
Yes, it's on the planning, but I can't say when it will be released yet.

**Can you update it to Minecraft version _x_?**  
I can, and I will when I'm in need for it. I'm open to Pull Requests for support for different versions. 

**Can you implement feature _y_?**  
If the feature can be implemented according to the goals for this mod, please open an issue with the suggestion (one suggestion per issue)

**This mod doesn't work in combination with mod _z_, can you make it work?**  
I can do my best, but it won't be my top priority unless I run into it myself. Please open an issue with the version of this mod and the other mod that don't work together. I'll pick it up when I've got time or somebody else might pick it up.

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1216400498488377467?label=Discord&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/anxzu6rA9F) [![Powered by StewBeet](https://img.shields.io/badge/Powered%20by-StewBeet-5865F2?colorA=%23E00000&colorB=%2300A000&logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://stewbeet.paralya.fr/) 📺 Old datapack showcase: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TqVvRwF2psQ 🏌️ Golf Ball is a datapack that transforms you into a golf ball in Minecraft, offering an immersive golfing experience!
⛳ The following two commands are your best friends: - 🎮 `/function golf_ball:summon`: Turns the player executing the command into a golf ball (e.g: `/execute as positioned 123 100 54 run function golf_ball:summon`) - 🔄 `/function golf_ball:respawn`: Rolls back the ball to the last shot position (e.g: `/execute as run function golf_ball:respawn`) ## 🆕 Physics Engines (since 1.6.0) Since Minecraft 26.2, you can alternatively summon the ball as a tiny **sulfur cube** holding an absorbed sponge (the vanilla "Golf Ball" archetype 🏌️) with `/function golf_ball:sulfur_cube`.
Bouncing, friction and air drag are then handled natively by the game through the new `bounciness`, `friction_modifier` and `air_drag_modifier` attributes - no per-tick physics functions! - ⚙️ Tune a ball's physics directly with attributes, e.g:
`/execute as on vehicle run attribute @s minecraft:bounciness base set 0.9`
(same for `minecraft:friction_modifier` and `minecraft:air_drag_modifier`) - 🧱 Swap the absorbed block to change the ball's archetype, e.g. a "Rubber Ball":
`/execute as on vehicle run item replace entity @s body with minecraft:oak_planks` - ⚠️ Vanilla limitation: a sulfur cube holding a block has its step height hardcoded to 0, so it cannot roll up slabs or snow layers. That's why the default `golf_ball:summon` still uses the scoreboard physics engine (cat base) with all the settings below. ## Configuration Commands ⚙️ Fine-tune your golfing experience with these powerful configuration commands!
Customize ball physics, movement dynamics, power settings and more - either globally for all new balls or locally for individual balls. 🎮 ⚠️ Using `/scoreboard players set` for all commands below (abbreviated as `/SPS`) ### Core Settings 🎯 | Setting | Global Command | Local Command | Default | Range | Description | |---------|---------------|---------------|----------|--------|-------------| | Strength Percentage 💪 | `/SPS #default_strength_percentage golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.strength_percentage ` | 50 | 0-100 | Controls the overall power of your shots | | Energy Loss 📉 (legacy) | `/SPS #default_energy_loss_percentage golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.energy_loss_percentage ` | -90 | -100-0 | Determines how much energy is lost on impacts (vanilla balls: use the `bounciness` attribute) | | Collision Multiplier 💥 (legacy) | `/SPS #default_collision_multiplier golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.collision_multiplier ` | 50 | 0-100 | Adjusts the intensity of collisions (vanilla balls are pushed natively) | | Y-Shots 🔼 | `/SPS #default_do_y_shots golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.do_y_shots ` | 0 | 0 or 1 | Enables/disables vertical shots | | Collision Detection 🎯 (legacy) | `/SPS #default_do_collision golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.do_collision ` | 1 | 0 or 1 | Toggles collision physics | | Minimum Power ⬇️ | `/SPS #min_power golf_ball.data ` | N/A | 40 | N/A | Sets the lower power limit | | Maximum Power ⬆️ | `/SPS #max_power golf_ball.data ` | N/A | 500 | N/A | Sets the upper power limit | ### Surface Friction Settings ⚡ (legacy engine only) Control how the ball behaves on different surfaces by adjusting friction values. Each value represents the percentage of speed retained per tick.
Vanilla sulfur cube balls use the block's real friction combined with the `friction_modifier` attribute instead. | Surface Type | Global Command | Local Command | Default | Range | Best For | |----------|--------------------------------|--------------------------------|---------------|--------|-----------| | Normal Friction 🔄 | `/SPS #k_normal golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.friction_normal ` | 90 | 0-100 | Standard terrain | | Fast Friction 🏃 | `/SPS #k_fast golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.friction_fast ` | 95 | 0-100 | Smooth surfaces | | Slippery Friction 🧊 | `/SPS #k_slippery golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.friction_slippery ` | 98 | 0-100 | Ice and similar | | Slow Friction 🐌 | `/SPS #k_slow golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.friction_slow ` | 85 | 0-100 | Rough terrain | | Very Slow Friction 🦥 | `/SPS #k_very_slow golf_ball.data ` | `/SPS @s golf_ball.friction_very_slow ` | 80 | 0-100 | Heavy resistance | ### Usage Tips 💡 - 🎯 For local commands targeting a specific ball, use this format: `/execute as on vehicle run scoreboard players set @s golf_ball.strength_percentage ` - 🎮 The "@s" selector refers to the golf ball currently being controlled by the player - ⚡ Surface friction values dramatically affect ball behavior - experiment to find the perfect settings! - 📁 View all available surface definitions in the [surfaces json](https://github.com/Stoupy51/GolfBall/blob/main/build/datapack/data/golf_ball/tags/block/surfaces) files - ⚠️ You may have fun with unrealistic configurations, but the physics will be wonky! ## ⭐ Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/chart?repos=Stoupy51/GolfBall&type=date&legend=top-left)](https://www.star-history.com/?type=date&repos=Stoupy51%2FGolfBall)

title: Sodium Boost

body:
![sodium banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5fde0367b262922214ad4a479bc19fd929c440b6_0.webp)

# Sodium Boost
**Sodium Boost** delivers an elite, performance-driven environment tailored specifically for purists who want to eliminate in-game lag while fully preserving the classic Minecraft feel. 

By integrating a hand-picked selection of top-tier rendering and system optimization modules, this profile dramatically accelerates frame rates and stabilizes performance—providing a flawlessly fluid experience across both budget desktop setups and mobile devices.

## Features

* 🚀 **Uncapped Frame Rates:** Experience a monumental jump in FPS, unlocking the true potential of your hardware compared to the default client.

title: Halfbright
description: Halfbright allows Minecraft to be brighter without looking worse. The better alternative to Fullbright / Gamma Utils Mods.
body:
# Halfbright

A fundamentally different approach to fullbright in modern Minecraft that looks great at any brightness level!

Brighten up your world without loosing shadows and light sources!

This is the Fullbright Mod I always wanted to have, but never managed to find.

![Halfbright solves the problem that other Fullbright mods have at 500% Gamma](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b474adadc513835c1efd9967203100097cdf25f.webp)

## About

Halfbright brightens up your world only half-way. This means that it makes dark spots brighter, while still having a perfect light transition going from 0 to 15 smoothly.

Halfbright avoids all kind of yellow light artifacts, brightness jumps and clamping. With Halfbright enabled, you can turn up the brightness just a bit so that you can see more in caves while not making everything 100% bright. This allows you to still see Lamps and Torches light up your world, even though the world is already brighter.

You can configure any value between 0.0 and 15.0 in steps of 0.5, and Halfbright will look great at any level. This means you can still have 'Full Brightness' when you really need it, but also have the option to just make the world just a little bit brighter. You can configure it just like you want!

## Why?

Traditional fullbright mods often attempt to raise the game's gamma levels to extreme values (e.g., 1200%). While this makes things visible, it introduces severe visual issues:
- **Poor Light Curves:** Smooth lighting is completely broken, resulting in flat, unnatural transitions.
- **Color Distortion:** Intermediate light levels look washed out or shift toward a harsh yellow tint.
- **Sodium Incompatibilities:** On modern Minecraft versions (like 1.21.x), performance mods like Sodium completely bypass the vanilla shader pipeline (`lightmap.fsh`), rendering shader-based fullbright mods inactive or broken.

## Features

- **Sodium Options Menu Integration:** Configurable via Sodium's Options interface with a toggle button and a slider to adjust the minimum light level.
- **Command Support:** Use `/halfbright` (with subcommands `toggle`, `enable`, `disable`, and `level <value>`).
- **Default Keybindings:**
  - `H` - Toggle Halfbright on/off.
  - `Arrow Up` - Increase the minimum light level.
  - `Arrow Down` - Decrease the minimum light level.

## Incompatabilities

While I don't know of any imcompatible mod yet, I'm sure there might be some problems with some other mods, so please let me know if you run into any issues!

Works with and without Sodium on both Fabric and Neoforge!

## How Halfbright Works

Instead of raising the global gamma, **Halfbright scales the lightmap directly on the CPU**.

1. **Lightmap Scaling:** The mod captures the 16x16 lightmap texture on the CPU.
2. **Dynamic Range Remapping:** It remaps the lower bounds of the light levels to start at a configurable minimum value (defaults to `8.0`).
3. **Curve Preservation:** By keeping all 16 steps in the lightmap and scaling them smoothly, the mod preserves Minecraft's smooth lighting curve. Shadows and caves remain visually pleasing, and nights stay dark and atmospheric while ensuring you can still clearly see your surroundings.
4. **Universal Compatibility:** By writing directly to the lightmap texture before uploading to the GPU, it works seamlessly with both vanilla rendering and custom rendering engines like **Sodium** on both **Fabric** and **NeoForge**.

title: Mythos

---

## English

**Mythos** is a **NeoForge 26.1** mod about mythical races, unique abilities, artifacts, and distinct playstyles.

It is inspired by fantasy origins and races, but built around its own myth system with active abilities, artifacts, progression, and multiplayer roles. Each myth is designed as more than a passive bundle of bonuses: every one fills a distinct niche with clear strengths, weaknesses, and social value for other players.

The mod currently includes:
- Human — a village and trading specialist
- Elf — a forest archer with the Elven Bow
- Dwarf — a miner-smith centered around ale and pickaxe tempering

The mod is required **on both client and server**.

title: JEIRecipeManager
description: JEIRecipeManager brings powerful recipe management right into your JEI interface. Whether you want to disable broken recipes, tweak existing ones, or create entirely new recipes on the fly, this mod lets you do it visually without ever leaving the game.
body:
Features:

- Disable / Enable Recipes — Click the toggle button on any recipe in JEI to disable or re-enable it. Disabled recipes are saved to config/disabled_recipes.json and synced to all clients.
- Add New Recipes — Click the "Add Recipe" button on any existing recipe to enter edit mode, then drag items from JEI onto input/output slots to create a brand new recipe based on the original template.
- Modify Recipes — Edit generated recipes at any time by clicking the edit button and adjusting ingredients.
- Delete Generated Recipes — Remove any recipe you created with one click.
- Text Input Editing — While in edit mode, left-click a slot to clear its contents, or middle-click an input slot to open the text edit screen and type an exact item ID (e.g. minecraft:diamond ) or tag (e.g. #forge:ingots/iron ).
- Show/Hide Disabled Recipes — Use /jrm showDisabled <true|false> to toggle whether disabled recipes remain visible (grayed out) in JEI.
- Server-Side Authority — All recipe changes require operator permissions. Changes take effect after /reload .

title: Universal Compression

body:
![Universal Compression logo image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47018c051c59989a4bdb3cfd84798a6e841ddf20.png)
# Universal Compression
Compress (nearly) _any_ block in the game into progressively denser stacks, **up to nine tiers deep**.

- No upfront configuration required. Every block from every installed mod is supported automatically at startup.
- Nine blocks of any type craft into one compressed block. That block is itself compressible. Repeat up to nine times. The math gets silly fast, and that is the point.
- A tier overlay renders on top of the parent block's texture so compressed blocks are always visually identifiable at a glance.
- Loot and recipe tables are generated virtually at runtime, meaning there are no datapack files bloating your instance for every possible block combination.
- Blocks or entire mods can be excluded via the config file if needed.

Requires NeoForge 1.21+. MIT licensed.

Config file located at <instance>/config/universalcompression-common.toml for most modded instances, or follow the below for a standard install of the Minecraft Launcher:
1. Keybind: Windows+R (this opens a small menu at the bottom of your screen)

body:
# G-Lottery

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/g-lottery)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/g-lottery)  ![Supported Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/nzw6wMpS)

## Description

G-Lottery is a feature-rich lottery system for Minecraft Java servers. Players can purchase tickets using various currencies, and periodic raffles distribute the accumulated pot to lucky winners. With support for offline players and multiple currency types.

## Features

- **Ticket System**: Players buy tickets to enter raffles
- **PlaceholderAPI support**
- **Multiple Currencies**: Support for Vault economy and item-based currencies
- **Offline Support**: Claim rewards even if offline during raffle
- **Statistics**: Track winners, pot amounts, and player tickets
- **Highly Configurable**: Customize prices, intervals, and messages
- **Admin Controls**: Automatic raffles, pot management, and settings
- **Automatic** winner anoucement

## Installation

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

    
1. Download G-Lottery.jar from the releases
   
2. Place in your `plugins/` folder
   
3. Restart your server

title: Walkie Talkie
description: The mod adds Walkie Talkies!
body:
# Walkie Talkie ![wt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2d5badbe9f53f0c2a4d2dae91a2aefb8b654abf_0.webp)

A Minecraft Fabric mod that adds functional walkie-talkies with real voice communication via [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) integration.

## Features

- **Real Voice Communication** — talk to other players on the same frequency using Simple Voice Chat
- **16 Channels (1–16)** — select any frequency through the in-game GUI
- **ON/OFF Toggle** — enable or disable your walkie-talkie at any time
- **Radio Sound Effects** — audio is processed with a radio effect (compression, noise); also supports distortion, echo, low-pass, and high-pass filters
- **Fake Sound System** — broadcast OGG audio files through a radio channel using commands
- **Custom Sounds** — power on/off clicks and ambient static noise play during transmissions
- **Full Inventory Scanning** — walkie-talkies in your inventory (not just hands) are detected and joined to channels

## Items

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| Walkie Talkie ![wt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2d5badbe9f53f0c2a4d2dae91a2aefb8b654abf_0.webp) | Standard working radio |
| Beta Walkie Talkie ![bwt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/259f8c41cf99b7ee0bc5494fb8cb5026b7909694_0.webp) | Alternative variant (functional) |
| Broken Walkie Talkie ![bwt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebb7dffdc672efc533e2d103e86e6e11bf23625b_0.webp) | Non-functional decorative item |

## Crafting

![Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a757d09273949c51d243896886bb3ecc4b62a9b3_0.webp)

## Usage

### Walkie Talkie ![wt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2d5badbe9f53f0c2a4d2dae91a2aefb8b654abf_0.webp)

1. **Craft** a Walkie Talkie
2. **Shift + right-click** to open the frequency selector GUI
3. **Click a channel** (1–16) to set your frequency
4. **Toggle ON/OFF** with the button at the bottom of the GUI
5. **Hold right-click** (PCM) with the walkie-talkie in hand to start transmitting
6. Release to stop transmitting — other players on the same channel will hear you

![GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e04af34b606253d54bd121b0892b84adca616dec.png)

![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f5cb5350de2d5430c638359e787ec9263c246b4.png)

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/sw4wt soundeffect` | List all available sound effects |
| `/sw4wt soundeffect <effect>` | Set a sound effect (radio, distortion, echo, lowpass, highpass, none) |
| `/sw4wt fakesound <file> <frequency>` | Play an audio file on a specific frequency |
| `/sw4wt stopfakesound <frequency>` | Stop a fake sound on a specific frequency |
| `/sw4wt listfakesounds` | List all configured fake sounds |
| `/sw4wt reloadfakesounds` | Reload fake sound configuration |

Place `.ogg` files in `config/sw4wt/fakesounds/`.

## Configuration

Config file: `config/sw4wt/sw4wt-config.json`

| Option | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `effect` | string | Current radio effect (radio, distortion, echo, lowpass, highpass, none) |
| `fakeSounds` | object | Map of frequency → audio file name |

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader **≥0.18.4**
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Super GUI Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/sgl)
- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)

description: Blazingly fast, privacy first, and zero clutter.
body:
This modpack is designed to provide a clean, optimized, and user-focused Minecraft experience. Its primary goals are performance, privacy, and usability, ensuring that players can enjoy smooth gameplay without unnecessary distractions or resource overhead. The modpack carefully selects mods and configurations that maximize FPS and reduce CPU/GPU load, making it ideal for both low-end and high-end systems.

Performance improvements include optimized chunk handling, smarter entity and lighting management, and streamlined rendering, allowing for larger view distances, higher simulation settings, and better stability during intense scenarios like large builds, redstone contraptions, or multiplayer servers.

Privacy is a key focus — the pack avoids mods that send telemetry or collect usage data, ensuring that the player’s environment remains secure and free from unwanted network calls or analytics.

Usability enhancements make the game more intuitive and enjoyable. This includes improved user interfaces, better control schemes, enhanced in-game information displays, and convenience-focused quality-of-life features that reduce repetitive actions while keeping Minecraft’s core mechanics intact.

Overall, this modpack is ideal for players who want a modern, efficient, and streamlined Minecraft experience that respects system resources, player privacy, and accessibility, while still allowing for extensive customization and high-performance gameplay.

title: Item Finder
description: A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21/1.21.1 that helps you locate items stored in nearby containers. It caches container inventories as you open them and displays a HUD with the nearest container holding your target item, along with colored outlines
body:
# Item Finder

[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-item--finder-00AF5C?logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-finder)

> **Work In Progress** — this mod is functional but still in early development. Expect rough edges, missing features, and bugs. Performance is not a priority yet and may be noticeably poor in some situations.

> **AI Assistance Disclosure** — portions of this mod were developed with the help of AI tools (Claude). The code has been reviewed and tested, but keep that in mind.

A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21/1.21.1 that helps you locate items stored in nearby containers. It caches container inventories as you open them and displays a HUD with the nearest container holding your target item, along with colored outlines rendered directly in the world.


## How It Works

Item Finder is **client-side only** — it does not require a server-side counterpart and works on both singleplayer and multiplayer. The trade-off is that containers must be **visited at least once** before they appear in search results. When you open a container, its contents are automatically recorded. When you close it, the cache is updated and a new search runs immediately.

A periodic background search re-runs every N ticks (configurable) so that distances stay current as you move around.

### Server Support (Optional)

For a better experience on servers, [Litematica](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/litematica) can be installed on the client alongside Item Finder. When Litematica is present, it enables finding items in containers near the player without needing to manually open each one.

However, this requires [Servux](https://github.com/sakura-ryoko/servux) to be installed **on the server** and the `entityDataSync` option to be enabled in the server-side Servux configuration. Without that, only the standard visit-and-cache approach will work.

## Features

### HUD Overlay
- Displays the current target item with its icon
- Shows the distance to the nearest container holding that item (e.g. `12.5m`)
- Shows how many containers hold that item (e.g. `3 boxes`)
- Shows your current position in the active list (e.g. `[4/25]`)
- Color-coded status: **green** = found, **red** = not found, **gray** = disabled
- Possition configurable in settings (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) is aware of other HUD elements and won't overlap the vanilla potions/status effects area etc

### World Rendering
- Draws box outlines around the nearest containers in the world
- **Green** boxes for the currently selected item's containers
- Optional **show through walls** mode (toggle in settings)

### Container Caching
- Automatically records container contents when you open and close them
- Stores item IDs and quantities for every slot (excludes your player inventory)
- Cache persists for the session; containers remain tracked until the game restarts

### Search & Distance Filtering
- Configurable **search radius** (4–128 blocks, default 32)
- Results sorted by distance, nearest first
- Search automatically refreshes on a configurable interval (1–200 ticks, default 20)

### Item Lists
- Load item lists from JSON files in `config/itemfinder/lists/`
- Each list is a named collection of item IDs
- Toggle individual items on/off; state is saved per list between sessions
- Navigate items with a hotkey (cycles through enabled items)
- **Auto-disable missing**: disables all items that aren't found in any cached container
- **Enable All / Disable All** buttons in the item manager

### Slot Highlighting
- When you open a container that holds your current target item, matching slots are highlighted in green
- Toggle-able in settings

### Item Manager GUI
- Shows all items in the active list with icons, counts, container count, and nearest distance
- Searchable/filterable list
- Per-item toggle buttons
- Summary stats: total items, enabled, disabled, found

### File Browser
- Browse and load `.json` list files from `config/itemfinder/lists/`
- Navigates subdirectories

### Config Screen
Accessible from Mod Menu or via hotkey. Two tabs:
- **Generic** — all numeric and boolean settings
- **Hotkeys** — view and rebind all keybindings

## Keybindings

| Action | Default Key | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Open List Browser | `I` | Browse and load an item list file |
| Next Item | `N` | Cycle to the next enabled item |
| Previous Item | `B` | Cycle to the previous enabled item |

All keybindings are configurable in the Hotkeys tab of the settings screen.

## Configuration

Config file: `config/itemfinder.json`

| Setting | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `searchRadius` | `32` | 4–128 | Block radius to include cached containers in results |
| `searchInterval` | `20` | 1–200 | Ticks between automatic search refreshes |
| `showThroughWalls` | `false` | — | Render container outlines through solid blocks |
| `highlightSlots` | `true` | — | Highlight matching slots in open containers |

## Item List Format

Place `.json` files in `config/itemfinder/lists/`. Example:

```json
{
  "name": "My List",
  "items": [
    "minecraft:diamond",
    "minecraft:iron_ingot",
    "minecraft:oak_log"
  ]
}
```

Item IDs follow the standard `namespace:item_id` format.

## File Locations

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `config/itemfinder.json` | Main configuration |
| `config/itemfinder/lists/*.json` | Item list definitions |
| `config/itemfinder/state.json` | Per-item enabled/disabled state |

## Building

Requires JDK 21.

```bash
./gradlew build
```

The output jar will be in `build/libs/`.

## TODO

### Container & Data
- Improve Litematica/Servux integration for syncing container data around the player.

---

- https://maven.fabricmc.net/docs/fabric-loader-0.18.6/net/fabricmc/api/package-summary.html

This mod adds a deadly boss, Morbid Harvester, who poses a huge threat to players. (Finished port of The Morbid Reborn mod)
- The Morbid Harvester is a reaper-like creature whose sole mission is to kill every living thing in the Minecraft world. 
- For every entity hit, he regenerates 2.5 hearts. 
- If you hit him too many times without him being able to hit back, he will start blocking. While blocking, he can't take damage. If you force him to block for longer than his liking, he will do a get-back move, creating a blastwave around him, knocking back any enemies as well as healing himself back up.
- This harvester has 250 hearts and very high defense.  He can be summoned in by putting a Wither Skeleton Skull on top of two Obsidian blocks, and right-clicking it with a Nether Star.
- If you, against all odds somehow manage to kill him, you will be rewarded with a great xp yield and 1-2 (depending on if your sword has looting on it) of his +40 attack damage arms. But beware, upon his death, he explodes into a rain of deadly arrows, which not even the best enchantments can save you from!    

![Morbid Harvester](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1249ec0b278eb1d0d75a2e5be9ab28051a83bb40.jpeg)
![Skill ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae660d190164ab65a909c4acdb799c0a84c0713a.jpeg)
### Enchantments
There are currently three new enchantments added by this mod, all of which are going to be essential to beat the Morbid Harvester.
1. Light Aura
For each level of Light Aura you have on a piece of armor, damage dealt by the Morbid Harvester is decreased by 5%. Max Level: 3
1. Purity
Having Purity on any of your armor pieces will make the Morbid Harvester unable to regenerate health from hitting you. Max Level: 1
1. Harvest
Increases damage dealt to the Morbid Harvester with 20% per level. Goes on sword. Max Level: 5

description: Kill to Grow! Start your journey as a tiny 0.25x scale player and steal the size of your enemies. Grow up to 10x your normal size with every kill! Perfect for survival challenges. (Requires Pehkui).
body:
📏 Size Stealer: The Ultimate Growth Challenge
Have you ever felt too small for this blocky world? Well, now you literally are!

Size Stealer is a unique progression mod for Fabric 1.20.1 that turns every combat encounter into a literal growth opportunity. You start your journey as a tiny, vulnerable creature and must fight your way up to become a towering giant.

🧬 How It Works:
The Tiny Beginning: Upon entering the world, your scale is set to 0.25x. You are smaller than a grass block, making the world look massive and dangerous.

Kill to Grow: Every time you defeat a mob (from a simple chicken to the Wither), you "steal" a bit of its essence, increasing your scale by +0.1.

No Limits (Almost): Keep hunting to grow larger and larger. You can reach up to 10x your original size, allowing you to walk over hills and look down upon trees.

✨ Key Features:
🚀 Smooth Scaling: Watch yourself grow in real-time thanks to the powerful Pehkui engine.

🎮 Dynamic Gameplay: Being small makes you faster but harder to reach blocks. Being a giant makes you a powerhouse but watch your head in caves!

🎬 Content Creator Ready: This mod is perfect for "100 Days" challenges, "Can I beat Minecraft as a Giant?" videos, and fun multiplayer sessions.

🛠️ Technical Requirements:
To make this mod work, you MUST install the following dependencies:

Fabric API — The core library for Fabric mods.

Pehkui — The engine that handles all the scaling magic.

📦 Installation:
Install Fabric Loader for 1.20.1.

Download Size Stealer, Fabric API, and Pehkui.

Drop all three .jar files into your mods folder.

Launch the game and start your growth!

body:
Sends your screenshots to the server! Save folders go missing and people go - archive your screenshots server-side!

Works in dedicated servers and LAN worlds! Screenshots for the LAN owner are not saved.  
Files are saved to `<world save>/collage/screenshots/<player id>/<timestamp>.png`.

Compatible with permissions! Permission key: `collage.screenshot`

title: BambooGolem
description: A banboo golem appears! Your city will become one step closer to peace.
body:
# Bamboo Golem

A Minecraft Fabric mod that adds a powerful Bamboo Golem entity with unique combat abilities.

## Features

### Bamboo Golem Entity
- **Custom Model & Animations**: Fully animated 3D model with walking and attack animations
- **Iaijutsu Combat Style**: Quick-draw sword attacks with visual slash effects
- **Projectile Immunity**: Teleports to dodge incoming projectiles (arrows, etc.)
- **Suffocation Escape**: Automatically escapes when stuck in walls

### Combat Abilities
- **Sweep Attack**: Area-of-effect melee attack with particle effects
- **Projectile Dodge**: Teleports up to 4 blocks away when hit by projectiles
- **Sound Effects**: 
  - Bamboo footstep sounds while walking
  - Trident throw sound for attacks
  - Enderman teleport sound when dodging

### Commands
- `/summon_bamboo_golem` - Summon a Bamboo Golem at your location

### Spawn Egg
- Available in the Creative Mode "Spawn Eggs" tab
- Right-click on the ground to spawn a Bamboo Golem
- Custom bamboo-themed texture

## Technical Details

- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.10
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric
- **Entity Base**: Iron Golem (customized)
- **Health**: 100 HP (same as Iron Golem)
- **Attack Damage**: 7-21 (varies by weapon)
- **Movement Speed**: 0.25

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.10
2. Install Fabric API
3. Place the mod JAR file in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft

## Usage

### Spawning
- Use the spawn egg from Creative inventory
- Use the `/summon_bamboo_golem` command

- 竹をテーマにしたカスタムテクスチャ

## 技術詳細

- **Modローダー**: Fabric
- **エンティティベース**: アイアンゴーレム（カスタマイズ済み）

4. Minecraftを起動

title: Proportional Shared Health
description: The fun concept of shared life but now compatible with origins & more
body:
This data pack links the health between all the players in the game, no matter where they are. Whenever one person takes damage, everyone does. And the same is true for natural regeneration.

Furthermore, this data pack is compatible with players of different health pools. This means it works for mods, such as origins.

# Installation
Simply download the data pack and put it into the "datapacks" folder inside the folder of the minecraft world, or just add it in when creating the world. By default, all players who enter the world will share their health with each other. However, if you head into the folder, and navigate over to data/ch/function/main.mcfunction, you can disable that feature by commenting out that line.

Furthermore, you can use ```/function ch:admin/enter``` on a specific player or players with the /execute command in order to add them into the health sharing, and likewise use ```/function ch:admin/leave``` to disable their health sharing.

title: Velocity Server Aliases
description: Adds fast server command aliases for Velocity. Lets players switch servers easily.
body:
# Velocity Server Aliases

## Overview
Simple plugin for Velocity Proxy that provides server command aliases/shortcuts. It makes it easier for players to move between servers in the network without typing complex commands.

## Plugin Information
- **Velocity Version**: 3.4.0-SNAPSHOT
- **Java**: 17+

## Default Aliases Configured
- `/lobby` → `server lobby`
- `/hub` → `server lobby`

**Note**: You can add more aliases by editing the `config.toml` file in the plugin folder.

## Custom Messages
The plugin supports configurable custom messages using:
- **Color codes**: `&a` (green), `&e` (yellow), `&c` (red), `&b` (cyan), `&f` (white)
- **Placeholder `{server}`**: Replaced with the target server name

### Configurable Messages:
- `connecting`: Message when connecting to a server
- `already_connected`: Message when you are already on that server
- `server_not_found`: Message when the server does not exist

---

# Velocity Server Aliases

## Overview
Plugin simple para Velocity Proxy que proporciona aliases/shortcuts para comandos de servidor. Facilita a los jugadores moverse entre servidores en la red sin escribir comandos complejos.

## Información del Plugin
- **Versión Velocity**: 3.4.0-SNAPSHOT
- **Java**: 17+

## Aliases Configurados (Por Defecto)
- `/lobby` → `server lobby`
- `/hub` → `server lobby`

**Nota**: Puedes agregar más aliases editando el archivo `config.toml` en la carpeta del plugin.

## Mensajes Personalizados
El plugin soporta mensajes personalizados configurables con:
- **Códigos de color**: `&a` (verde), `&e` (amarillo), `&c` (rojo), `&b` (cyan), `&f` (blanco)
- **Placeholder `{server}`**: Se reemplaza con el nombre del servidor de destino

### Mensajes Configurables:
- `connecting`: Mensaje al conectar a un servidor
- `already_connected`: Mensaje cuando ya estás en ese servidor
- `server_not_found`: Mensaje cuando el servidor no existe

title: Damienne's Bits 'n' Bobs
description: A Vanilla+ mod designed to fill in the gaps left by some other decoration mods. All sorts of new decor to try out, ranging from new Amethyst blocks to even a new Warped Wart crop!
body:
Damienne's Bits 'n' Bobs is a mod adding a bunch of small things. Mainly in the form of new building blocks, but also including some other new features.

As of v0.1, features include:


<details>
<summary>Roses</summary>

A familiar-yet-new flower, obtainable by trimming a Rose Bush in a Stonecutter.
![A rose bush being split into roses at a Stonecutter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63b805df3bde56ecf48ca6196784b44ef071ea2b.png)

Also available in several variants through dyeing, and craftable into beautiful rose bouquets!
![Various Roses and their associated Bouquets.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1995a323fbb7d57a12cea16c443c1244c747ac5d.png)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Gilded Quartz</summary>

![Gilded Quartz](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed732078e4aa2c0ff06ee39fcafae000d9951700.png)

A new variant of Quartz with connected textures. Check Gilded Deepslate's description for further details.

</details>


<details>
<summary>New Mud Blocks</summary>

A variety of new Mud Blocks have been added!
![A small structure showcasing Mossy Mud Bricks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44f556380482fe056af03dac6c322e4a0d72d588.png)
For one, we have Mossy Mud Bricks, something that I'm shocked wasnt a vanilla feature! It just makes sense!
![A small, wall-like structure showcasing Polished Mud](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89da86971363a374d5b6d5eabe43a74d81261ddf.png)
Next, we have Polished Mud, also available in a pillar form!
![Chiseled Mud Bricks with a pig face. Oink oink!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2a202626ce020bf665dd466426a8846d0b4b968.png)
Last but not least, we have Chiseled Mud Bricks, featuring the face of a pig! How adorable!

</details>


<details>
<summary>Stained Clay</summary>

Ever wished Minecraft had more pastel colors to work into your palette? Look no further than Stained Clay, a new set of colorful blocks!
![All 16 color variants of Stained Clay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90d84fdaa115da87e872cb05f3cf7328aa197d5d.png)
Some ideas where these colors work great include:
combining Brown Stained Clay with Mud Bricks!
![Brown Stained Clay blending in smoothly alongside Mud blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58618b68ca6fc73588a94060fd652b7278276344.png)
combining Black Stained Clay with Mud to add texture!
![Black Stained Clay blending amongst some mud blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15ac70ecf8374bf26003775ece1a8520bba6a319.png)
And much more!

</details>

(v0.0 Features)

<details>
<summary>Warped Wart</summary>

The inital focus of Bits 'n' Bobs, Warped Wart! We've all seen Warped Wart blocks on Warped Fungus trees, and wondered, what if we had that as a plant? That's what this is!

![The three growth stages of Warped Wart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46727c259ee6bb25b3816b3ad64e7e40f9899f5e.png)

While not quite as useful as Nether Wart, this new plant can be used to craft a new block palette, **Blue Nether Bricks!**

![The many variants of Blue Nether Bricks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f089ea922a3a324504cc12f925e958e20b3cdf01.png)

Also, just for consistency, this adds Chiseled Red Nether Bricks.

![Chiseled Red Nether Bricks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9705ee34e18133e9473095ea2bc147bc6bc73041.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Gilded Deepslate</summary>

Gilded Deepslate is a new variant of deepslate, coming in many types, with a connected texture forming an outline of a given material. Currently, these blocks exist in all vanilla armor trim materials.

![A showcase of all the Gilded Deepslate textures.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/129fe8d1cbc1635ddd8e0872ce30d23416b6190b.png)

Also, crafting Netherite Gilded Deepslate gives a new advancement:
![The advancement for crafting Netherite Gilded Deepslate, titled "Weird Flex But Okay"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7b5ed765df4369c71f83410472c4c00b87861b9.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary>The Amethyst Block Palette</summary>

Amethyst Blocks have been given many new decorative variants, great for building with! 

![A showcase of the various new Amethyst blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdc12fb455f0546f301b82356a2675523ce5399a.png)

Ranging from cut, to tiles, to bricks, to polished, to even amethyst pillars, you'll never be short of options to build with! Also, some of these blocks have connected textures (Trimmed Amethyst and Amethyst Pillars), which can make for some cool patterns!

</details>


<details>
<summary>Sanded Copper</summary>

Pretty self explanatory, this is just a smoother variant of copper.

![Showcase of all 4 levels of oxidation that Sanded Copper has.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/262ffbcbad7068c22da695fdbf2aedffca11b7fb.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Woven Wool</summary>

A new variant of wool, with a nice and wavy texture! Also available as carpets!

![Woven Wool and carpets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/323a251062bdd1d37727997a841ef0801ee6d01a.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Polished Tiles</summary>

A new decorative block, great for kitchens! Or if you wanna recreate Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria, I guess.

![Polished Tiles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/654a820df31c14fc2026c2565666219938e12fbf.png)

</details>



<details>
<summary>⚠️ INCOMPLETE FEATURES!! ⚠️</summary>

This mod is still a work-in-progress, so some features exist but aren't used! The main notable examples as of right now are **Purified** and **Refined Corruption**. While accessible in Creative mode, these blocks are entirely unobtainable in survival as of right now while I try to think of a balanced way to implement them. Stay tuned!! 

</details>

![](https://dpnw.site/assets/img/desc_card/cmd-perm.jpg) ## 명령어 ### 관리자 명령어 | 명령어 | 설명 | |--------|------| | `/dsp create ` | 새로운 칭호를 생성합니다. | | `/dsp set ` | 채팅에 표시될 칭호를 설정합니다. | | `/dsp delete ` | 지정한 칭호를 삭제합니다. | | `/dsp coupon ` | 지정한 칭호의 쿠폰 아이템을 설정합니다. (칭호 미입력 시 글로벌 쿠폰으로 설정) | | `/dsp givecoupon [username]` | 지정한 플레이어에게 칭호 쿠폰 아이템을 지급합니다. title: PotionsManager
description: Manage which potions aren't unusable and which cannot be brewed.
body:
# PotionManager

Version: 1.0.0  
Minecraft Version: 1.18+  

---

## Description
**PotionManager** allows server admins to manage which potions cannot be brewed, which cannot be used, and which are completely blocked. The configuration supports three sections: `disabled-brewing`, `disabled-using`, and `disabled-both`.

---

## Installation
1. Place `PotionManager.jar` in your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Start the server to generate the default configuration.
3. Edit `config.yml` to set your disabled potions.
4. Restart the server to apply changes.

---

## Configuration
```yaml
disabled-brewing:
  - HARMING
  - STRONG_HARMING

disabled-using:
  - HEALING
  - STRONG_HEALING

disabled-both:
  - POISON
  - STRONG_POISON

# WAUF(where are u from?)

Retrieve player location: Use the "/wauf <player>" command to obtain the geographic location of a specified player.
Operator permissions: Only server operators or players with the appropriate permission node can access the location information.
Offline access: Wauf stores player IP addresses in a YAML file, allowing for location retrieval even when the player is offline.

Instructions:

Install the Wauf plugin on your Minecraft server.
Grant appropriate permissions to players who should have access to the "/wauf" command.
Players can then use "/wauf <player>" to query the location of another player.
Wauf will display the approximate geographic location of the specified player, including country, state, city, latitude, and longitude.

permission node: wauf.use

Note: Wauf does not require the use of MaxMind API. Its usage is free and does not require any payments.

# Bungee Commands **Create your own custom BungeeCord commands** easily with this lightweight and user-friendly plugin! **BungeeCord Supported | Velocity Supported** ### ✏️ Custom Command Creation Define your own commands with aliases, permissions, and multiple actions. ### 💬 Dynamic Messages and Titles Send colorful, interactive messages and display titles with ease using MiniMessage formatting. ### 📝 Configurable Titles Set fade-in, stay, and fade-out times for titles, complete with customizable main and subtitle text. ### 🎵 Sound Support Play sounds using your custom commands. ### ✨ Interactive Components Add clickable links, hoverable text, and gradients to messages for a modern server experience. ### ⏳ Delays & Scheduling Add precise timing controls to your command sequences. - **If you want to use sounds, add PacketEvents to your server**, click the links for the [Bungee](https://github.com/retrooper/packetevents/releases/download/v2.8.0/packetevents-bungeecord-2.8.0.jar) and [Velocity](https://github.com/retrooper/packetevents/releases/download/v2.8.0/packetevents-velocity-2.8.0.jar) versions. You can reload, your changes with the command **/bcmd reload** ## Example Configuration: Here’s a simple example of how you can configure commands and titles: ``` config-version: 1.4 # Editor for minimessage: https://webui.advntr.dev/ # Free version can have only 3 commands messages: prefix: '[BungeeCommands] ' command_is_disabled_on_this_server: 'This command is disabled on this server!' no_permission: 'You do not have permission to execute this command!' commands: hub: enabled_servers: - "survival" aliases: - "lobby" permission: "hub.command" commands: - "send %player% lobby" - "@MESSAGE@ You have been sent to the lobby!" - "@ACTIONBAR@ Teleporting to the lobby..." - "@DELAY@ 3" - "@TITLE@ Example1" discord: permission: "hub.command" commands: - "@MESSAGE@ Link: Discord" - "@SOUND@ Example1" donate: permission: "donate.command" commands: - "@BROADCAST@ Link: Donate" titles: Example1: fadein: 10 stay: 20 fadeout: 10 title: "Hub" subtitle: "!!!" sounds: Example1: name: "ENTITY.PLAYER.LEVELUP" volume: 1.0 pitch: 1.0 # # Documentation # # If you want to enable the command on all servers, just remove the enabled_servers section # # Here is the list of all available custom tags: # # - @MESSAGE@ - Sends a message to the player | You can use
to create a new line # - @BROADCAST@ - Sends a message to all players on the server # - @ACTIONBAR@ - Sends a message to the action bar of the player # - @TITLE@ Name_of_the_title - Sends a title to the player # - @DELAY@ (seconds) - Waits for a certain amount of time before executing the next command # # Extra commands | PacketEvents API is required for these commands: # # - @SOUND@ Name_of_the_sound - Plays a sound to the player # https://javadocs.packetevents.com/com/github/retrooper/packetevents/protocol/sound/Sounds.html # # # In your commands, you can use the following placeholders: # - %player% - The player who executed the command # - %arg-1% - The first argument of the command # - %arg-2% - The second argument of the command # # If the player uses more than the set amount of arguments, the rest will be added to the last argument ``` **Legacy colors are not supported.** Please use MiniMessage formatting instead: [MiniMessage](https://webui.advntr.dev/) **If you have any questions or want to try the plugin. Feel free to contact me on discord: https://discord.gg/HsQryuwksP** / **[https://minexis.dev/](https://minexis.dev/)** [![test](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ce2838f8d83697f17def1a71449ceac19ff6c51.webp)](https://tamhost.cz/affiliate/minexis)

title: DeathFinder
description: A Plugin to let the Players find there last death point
body:
DeathFinder

🧭 Find your death location with a recovery compass — and remove it when you're close!

--- ## 🔍 Features - Gives players a **Recovery Compass** upon death. - Automatically removes the compass once the player is within a configurable **radius** of their last death location. - Includes a **`/setradius`** command to change the detection radius. - Fully configurable via a simple config file. - Lightweight and efficient – perfect for survival servers. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration In the plugin's `config.yml`, you'll find: ```yaml radius: 20 ``` This controls how close a player must be to their death location for the compass to be removed. --- ## 🧪 Commands & Permissions ### `/setradius ` - Set the radius in blocks to trigger compass removal. - **Permission:** `deathfinder.setradius` --- ## 📦 Installation 1. Download the plugin JAR from Modrinth. 2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder. 3. Restart or reload the server. 4. Optionally modify `config.yml` to suit your server setup. --- ## 💡 How It Works 1. When a player **dies**, they're assigned a **Recovery Compass**. 2. When they **respawn**, the compass is added to their inventory. 3. As they move, if they get within the configured radius of their **last death location**, the compass is **automatically removed**, and they're notified. --- ## ✅ Requirements - Minecraft 1.20+ (compatible with versions that support `Recovery Compass`) - Bukkit/Spigot/Paper server --- ## 📜 License MIT License --- Made by [BlackDev](https://modrinth.com/user/_blackdev_)
