description: The Spit Splat is a cute and tameable mod that will spawn on you at the slightest opportunity!
body: [](https://github.com/MModding/env-driven-assets) ## At this time, the port is not fully complete. I am reworking the internal content in order to improve the result of the port, since I am not limited by a third party application (contrary to the original version which uses MCreator). [![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/56f1b4c1016d7698f0bf00e1305c1a22123d819a8fb43181d8cb8139b0d3136d/68747470733a2f2f692e696d6775722e636f6d2f4b42396b5259562e706e67)](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) ![Spit Splat Banner](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_81df235c-e2e6-4a85-9b33-9245494e786b.png) ![Spit Splat GIF](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_8f51a8a0-0fe3-49ec-84d7-861d3dd41440.gif) You will find him floating above the oceans (except frozen and all deep oceans), he is aggressive when he sees a player but does not attack in close combat. Instead, he'll spit a bubble at you. This bubble will give you a new potion effect, the bubble trap. You will not take damage but will be stuck in a bubble, slowly floating upwards before popping as you fall. ![Bubble Showcase](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_d8cb9840-1b79-4cbd-8e45-00b3a49310b5.png) Spit Splat is tamable with some kelp (if you can approach him quickly enough !) and will become in turret mode when you right-click on him, defending the area and floating without moving. By killing a few Spit Splats, you will obtain a raw Spit Splat but also scales. The raw Spit Splat gives you the bubble effect for 2 seconds, allowing you to use it in climbing situations, to return to the surface of an ocean or to craft potions. While the cooked Spit Splat gives you the bubble effect, but also the slow falling effect when the bubble pop. Allowing you to reach the ground without taking any damage. ![Fishes](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_876bfd6d-baec-49ab-845d-023ce9f219cc.png) The scales are used to craft two weapons and some bubble potions/arrow: ![Potions](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_3410977e-33a3-4890-8174-bfe0258e3a13.png) ![Splatter Banner](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_c205b8cc-da78-46f2-987b-88b1400e1c6c.png) The Splatter is a weapon that is not very offensive but allows you to shoot a bubble at your enemies from a long distance. ![Splatter Shot](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_77372239-7996-411a-8fe0-7a663bd939a4.gif) ![Third Person](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_83647a68-0776-435f-8d02-4f9c0c592939.gif) ![Totem Banner](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_63205e40-381b-4b7f-a4b2-301a21c8aed3.png) The Splat totem, a totem that doesn't look powerful but contains the power of the Spit Splat, raising a wave around you and giving you the conduit power effect for 1 minute, the wave extinguishes the fire from you and your pets while putting the monsters in a bubble for 4 seconds. ### The totem can be used 50 times before breaking and its cooldown is 3 minutes. ![Totem Showcase](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_a9b8b3c6-2cec-485d-b7c0-ab1eed28822f.gif) ![Crafting Recipes Banner](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_8bd1ea33-b1fb-447c-b9df-4ebc16c473bc.png) ## The Splatter ![The Splatter Recipe](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_a558ff84-e947-46ed-8f4d-f1502aa4b9ec.png) ## Splat Totem ![Splat Totem Recipe](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/992031/description_f0fbd7fc-432c-470e-90e2-5f132d0447c1.png) ## You are also able to enable or disable all the features easily inside the config.yml. All the messages are also fully customizable. For further information about this plugin, please see the [wiki](https://github.com/OmegaWeaponDev/HyperVision/wiki). Where you are able to find all the in depth information about HyperVision, all the commands and permissions as well. *** ## **Features** Below you can find all the different features that I've implemented into the plugin. If you have any features that you're wanting added to this plugin. Please send me a feature request via the [issues](https://github.com/OmegaWeaponDev/HyperVision/issues) page, as that allows me to keep track of all the suggestions in one location. | Feature | Description | | ------- | ----------- | | Toggle Nightvision | Allows the user to toggle nightvision for themselves or other players. | | Keep NightVision on Login | Allows the user to keep their nightvision when they login/logout. | | Keep Nightvision on Death | Allows the user to keep their nightvision on death. | | Enable/disable Potion Effects| Allows the user to enable or disable the icon, ambient particles and normal particles effects from when they activate nightvision. | | List all players with nightvision | Generate a list of all the online players who currently have nightvision enabled | | Blindness after Nightvision over use| Determine how long they can use nightvision before they get blinded (Blindness will take effect after nightvision is removed) | | Limit command usage | Apply a configurable limit to how many times a player can use the nightvision command to enable nightvision *** ## Installation, Updating ### Installing: When it comes to installing the plugin, Simply drop the HyperVision-[version number].jar into your paper servers plugin folder and then start your server. ### Updating: Updating is very easy, all you're needing to do is download the new version of the plugin and replace the old version in your plugins folder. I have implemented an Auto Config Updater that will automatically update all the files if I have changed them in any way. *** ## **Support** If at any stage you come across a sneaky bug that I was unable to locate during testing please do not hesitate to get in contact with me so I am able to squash it quickly for you. When you are finding yourself in need to contact me about any of my plugins, if it is relating to a bug, please try and provide as much detail as possible, including server version, plugin version and the steps taken to get the bug. This allows me to focus on the bug a lot quicker and allows me to get an update released sooner in order to resolve the bug. ### **Discord** I have spent some time setting up a discord server that you are welcome to join at any time. Here you are able to seek help, have a chat, be informed of any updates or announcements and just be apart of a great community. You can join the community or invite your friends to the discord community by using this link: https://discord.gg/9nZTPcp *** Lastly, I would like to say Thank you for supporting my plugins and supporting me as a developer. While I am still somewhat new to plugin development I try to provide the best support and the best plugins for you guys (and girls). Again, Thank you.

title: Endpoem
description: A easy-to-use mod for Minecraft that adds an '/endpoem' command to replay the End Poem in-game with a built-in Chinese translation resource pack
body:
# 中文（简体）

**EndPoem 重放 & 中文翻译**

随时重看《Minecraft 终末之诗》，并可自由控制是否显示终末之诗。

## 主要功能

* **一键重放**：在聊天框输入 **`/endpoem`**，即可重放终末之诗。
* **指定玩家播放**：使用 **`/endpoem <player>`** 为指定玩家播放终末之诗。

  * 示例：`/endpoem @p`、`/endpoem @s`、`/endpoem 玩家名`
* **全体播放**：使用 **`/endpoem --all`** 为所有在线玩家播放终末之诗。
* **内置中文翻译**：内置中文终末之诗资源包，默认启用。如需英文原文，可前往 **设置 → 资源包** 关闭本模组的内置资源包。
* **玩家拒收设置**：客户端可关闭“允许显示 End Poem”。关闭后，客户端会拦截终末之诗界面，包括原版通关触发的终末之诗。
* **服务器尊重玩家选择**：当服务器也安装本模组时，玩家的拒收设置会同步给服务器，服务器执行 `/endpoem` 时会自动跳过已拒收的玩家。
* **配置界面**：支持通过默认快捷键 **O** 打开配置界面，也可通过 **Mod Menu** 打开。
* **可配置规则**：

  * `/endpoem` 命令权限等级，默认需要权限等级 `2`
  * 是否允许旁观者作为播放目标
  * 是否允许显示 End Poem

## 使用说明

* 对自己播放：`/endpoem`
* 指定目标播放：`/endpoem <player>`  
  例如：`/endpoem @p` / `/endpoem @s` / `/endpoem 玩家名`
* 对所有在线玩家播放：`/endpoem --all`

## 注意

* **请勿滥用命令攻击或骚扰其他玩家。**
* 如果玩家在客户端关闭了“允许显示 End Poem”，终末之诗界面会被拦截。
* 服务器安装本模组后，默认只有权限等级达到 `2` 的玩家可以使用 `/endpoem`，可在配置中修改

---

# English

**EndPoem Replay & Chinese Translation**

Rewatch Minecraft’s End Poem anytime, with optional control over whether the End Poem screen is shown.

## Features

* **Replay Anytime**: Type **`/endpoem`** in chat to replay the End Poem.
* **Play to a Specific Player**: Use **`/endpoem <player>`** to play the End Poem for a specific player.

  * Examples: `/endpoem @p`, `/endpoem @s`, `/endpoem PlayerName`
* **Play to Everyone**: Use **`/endpoem --all`** to play the End Poem for all online players.
* **Built-in Chinese Translation**: Includes a built-in Chinese End Poem resource pack, enabled by default. To switch back to the original English text, go to **Options → Resource Packs** and disable this mod’s built-in resource pack.
* **Player Opt-out Setting**: Clients can disable “Allow showing End Poem”. When disabled, the End Poem screen will be blocked locally, including the normal vanilla End Poem after completing the game.
* **Server Respects Player Choice**: If the server also has this mod installed, the client’s opt-out setting is synced to the server. `/endpoem` will automatically skip players who opted out.
* **Config Screen**: Open the config screen with the default **O** key, or through **Mod Menu**.
* **Configurable Rules**:

  * `/endpoem` permission level, default `2`
  * Whether spectator targets are allowed
  * Whether the End Poem screen is allowed


## Notes

* **Do not abuse the command to attack or harass other players.**
* If a player disables “Allow showing End Poem” on the client side, the End Poem screen will be blocked.
* When installed on a server, `/endpoem` requires permission level `2` by default. This can be changed in the config.

title: Realms Reborn Data Pack
description: Realms Reborn is a datapack I made for my Minecraft server that adds a bunch of new recipes, fixes some vanilla recipes, adjusts some structure loot tables, and adds two new structures.
body:
[![Partner](https://i.imgur.com/sf01XOZ.png)](https://billing.kinetichosting.net/aff.php?aff=1088)

This Datapack was made for my private Minecraft server but it is an essential vanilla+ pack for any world or server.

Structures:

- Two new structures: The witches gathering for swamp biomes, and the pillager camp for mega taigas.
- Tweaked pillager outpost tower and added vindicator on the top floor. 
- Trail Ruins now spawn in savannas and sparse jungles on top of the original biomes.
- Removed beetroot seeds from end city loot chests, and added iron/daimond enchanted axes and golden apples.
- Tweaked and rebalanced loot tables for suspicious sand/gravel in the following structures: Desert well, cold and warm Ocean Ruins, and Trail Ruins.
- Removed tridents from one of the trail chambers loot tables.
- Added spyglass to shipwreck map chest loot table.

Recipes:

- New dye recipes: Coal and charcoal can be crafted into black dye, resin clumps can be crafted into orange dye, turtle scute can be crafted into green dye, blue and yellow dye can be crafted into green dye, and armadillo scute can be crafted into brown dye.
- Red sand, red sandstone, and smooth red sandstone can now be crafted with red dye.
- Cut copper blocks can be uncrafted into copper ingots.
- Chiseled copper, copper doors, copper trap doors, copper grates, copper chests, and lighting rods can now be smelted down into copper ingots.
- Copper chains and copper bars can now be smelted into copper nuggets.
- Iron doors, iron trapdoors, minecarts, cauldrons, and hoppers can now be smelted into iron ingots.
- Chains, buckets, shears, heavy weighted pressure plates, and iron bars can now be smelted into iron nuggets.
- Light weighted pressure plates can be smelted into gold nuggets.
- Golden horse armor, copper horse armor, iron horse armor, golden nautilus armor, copper nautilus armor, and iron nautilus armor can now be smelted into a full ingot instead of just a nugget.
- Pistons, droppers, dispensors, levers, and observers can be crafted with blackstone and deepslate.
- Wool can be crafted into string.
- Completely remade deepslate recipes. Polished deepslate and all blocks made from polished deepslate now craft with normal deepslate instead of cobbled deepslate.
- The recipe for nether brick fences now matches the other fence recipes.
- Amethyst shards can be crafted from amethyst block, amethyst cluster, and all amethyst buds.
- Added recipes for smelting cobblestone slabs and stairs into stone slabs and stairs.
- Added a couple of missing stonecutter recipes for chiseled blackstone and deepslate.

Tweaks and Small Additions:

- One new advancement for killing a blaze with a snowball.
- Powered Rails and gold nuggets now distract piglins, and powered rails, bells, and light weighted pressure plates now anger piglins when broken.
- Many items classified as tools can be enchanted with curse of vanishing.
- Mining stone slabs and stone stairs without silk touch now drops cobblestone slabs or stairs.

title: ElytraHUD
description: Minimalist elytra HUD — durability, rockets, and flight speed at a glance. Fully customizable with a live preview.
body:
[![JOIN OUR DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN%20OUR%20DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA)

A clean, minimalist HUD that keeps the one thing that matters while flying — how much elytra you have left — right where you can see it, without cluttering your screen. At a glance it shows your elytra durability, how many firework rockets you are carrying, and your current flight speed, all in a single compact row.

![Elytra HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a73c8e392bf402915267f16d505f6e7cfd2db0a_0.webp)

**Client-side only** (no server installation required). **Fully compatible with singleplayer and multiplayer**.

**Please report any bugs, errors, or feature suggestions on Discord:** [https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE](https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE)

**What it shows:**
- A live durability bar that smoothly shifts green → amber → red as your elytra wears down, with the remaining percentage or the exact value.
- A pulsing low-durability warning so you know when to land or swap wings (configurable threshold).
- Your firework rocket count (counts your inventory and your offhand).
- Your current flight speed.
- Real elytra and rocket item icons, drawn straight from the game.

**Fully customizable, with a live preview:**
- Choose when the HUD appears: Always, only When Equipped, or only While Gliding.
- Place it in any of six screen positions from a visual grid, with free offsets and 50–200% scaling.
- Toggle each element on or off (icon, bar, rockets, speed), and switch the durability text between percent, value, or hidden.
- Tune background opacity, color-by-durability, and the low-durability warning.
- Every change is reflected instantly in the in-settings preview — what you configure is exactly what you get in game.

**Usage:**
Open the settings screen with the `/elytrahud` command (alias `/ehud`) or a customizable hotkey. On NeoForge you can also open it from the in-game mod list.

**Details:**
- All settings are stored locally in your client config folder (`config/elytrahud.json`).
- Available for Fabric, NeoForge, and Forge across a wide range of Minecraft versions.
- Fully translated into 10 languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, and Italian.

title: Displayer
description: Displayer Client Mod, lets you show custom text in screen
body:
# Displayer

[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11+-blue.svg)](https://www.minecraft.net/)

Displayer is a lightweight client-side mod designed to render **text displays and timers** in-game.

## ✨ What you can do

🖥️ **Display custom text** on screen with simple styling support  
⏰ **Create and manage timers** with live countdowns  
🎨 **Render clean UI elements** directly in-game  

## 🔄 How it works

Displayer receives custom data packets from a server (or external system) and renders them on the client side.  
All visual logic is handled locally, keeping performance smooth and the server completely vanilla-compatible.

## ⚙️ Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.11+  
- **Fabric Loader** (compatible version)  
- Optional: server/plugin or external system to send data  
- Displayer is **fully client-side**

## 🔧 For developers

### Basic integration

```java
// Example: sending a text display packet
public void displayText(Player player, String text, int x, int y) {
    String message = "text;" + text + ";" + x + ";" + y + ";1.0;true";
    player.sendPluginMessage(this, "displayer:text", message.getBytes());
}

````



<details>
<summary>Old Version 1.21.1-1.21.4</summary>

# Displayer

[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1+-blue.svg)](https://www.minecraft.net/)

Displayer is a mod specifically designed to display texts on screen.

## ✨ What you can do

🖥️ **Display dynamic text** on screen with visual effects  
⏰ **Create interactive timers** with progress bars  
🎯 **Manage quests** with objectives and visual progress  
🔧 **Handle customizable server variables**  
🎨 **Design immersive content** with colors and animations  

## 🔄 How it works

Displayer receives custom data packets from a Paper server and responds on the client side — from UI rendering to interactive messages and player controls. All logic and visual elements remain on the client side, ensuring a vanilla server experience.

## ⚙️ Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.1  
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.17.2+  
- **Compatible server plugin** to send packets  
- Displayer is **purely a client-side mod**  

## 🔧 For developers

### Basic integration
```java
// In your server plugin
public void displayText(Player player, String text, int x, int y) {
    String message = "welcome;" + text + ";" + x + ";" + y + ";1.0;true;true";
    player.sendPluginMessage(this, "displayer:text", message.getBytes());
}



</details>

title: default pvp and cpvp
description: Most of the modpack went into optimization and PvP, but the majority went into optimization
body:
# ⚔️ Default pvp and cpvp

**The pack for those who play to win.**  
Minimum lag, maximum control, zero visual clutter.

---

## 🎯 Who is this modpack for?

- Players on **not-so-powerful PCs** who need a stable 60+ FPS in battles
- Experienced PvP players who find vanilla clients lacking essential features
- Anyone tired of lag, crashes, and stutters during crucial fights

---

## ⚡ Key Features

| Category | What it provides |
|----------|------------------|
| **Optimization** | 2-5x more FPS, faster chunk loading, near-zero render latency |
| **Convenience** | Zoom on keybind, item hotkeys, ammo counter (for crossbows/bows), enhanced HUD |
| **Fair Play** | **No** cheats, autoclickers, or unfair advantages. Only server-allowed client-side improvements |

---

## 📦 What's Inside (Core Mods)

> *This list is tailored for Fabric 1.21.4 — if you're on a different version, simply replace with equivalents.*

### 🚀 Optimization
- **Sodium** — Global renderer speedup (+300% FPS)
- **Lithium** — Game & server logic optimization
- **Entity Culling** — Doesn't render entities you can't see
- **ImmediatelyFast** — Speeds up UI rendering
- **ModernFix** — Fixes memory leaks and micro-stutters

### ⚔️ PvP / Client Improvements
- **Zoomify** — Convenient hold-to-zoom (default: V)
- **Mouse Tweaks** — Convenient item management (drag-sorting)
- **Status Effect Timer** — Timers on effects (speed, regeneration, etc.)

---

---

## 🕹️ Controls (Default Keybinds)

- **C** — Open Zoomify menu (to change the zoom key)
- **V** — Hold to zoom
- **R** — Reload / sort inventory
- **U** — Open REI (item list)
- **P** — Show/hide damage indicator
- **F3 + Q** — Show all control combinations (vanilla Minecraft help)

> *All keys can be rebound in **Options → Controls**.*

---

## ✅ Advantages Over Other PvP Packs

- **Minimalism** — Only what's needed for gameplay and optimization, no decorative mods
- **Stability** — Tested compatibility between all mods
- **Fair Play** — No hidden advantages, allowed on most servers
- **Simplicity** — Install and play, no configuration needed

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Download the `.mrpack` file from this project.
2. Import it into the **Modrinth Launcher** (Import from file) or any other launcher that supports the Modrinth format.
3. Allocate **at least 2 GB of RAM** to the game (in your launcher settings).
4. Launch and enjoy!

---

## 📜 License

This pack is provided "as is". All mods belong to their respective authors and are used in accordance with their licenses. You are free to modify the pack for personal use, but do not re-upload it under your own name without credit.

---

## ❓ FAQ

**Will I get banned for using this modpack on servers?**  
No, if the server allows client-side improvements (Sodium, Zoom, indicators). On servers with strict anti-cheat, some mods (like Damage Indicator) may not work, but you won't get banned — the game will simply skip rendering them.

**Why no OptiFine?**  
Sodium + Lithium provide better FPS and are more compatible with other mods. If you need shaders, you can install Iris separately.

**Can I add my own mods?**  
Yes. The pack is easily expandable — just install additional mods through your launcher.

---

> **Pack Author:** *Kyn_F1xEwe*  
> **Pack Version:** 1.0.0  
> **Last Updated:** 13 April 2026

title: Selective Vanish
description: Server-side add-on for VanishMod that adds selective visibility control.
body:
🦝 About 🦝

SVanish is a simple server-side add-on for VanishMod. It introduces selective visibility control, allowing you to choose exactly who can see vanished players.

‼️ Server-side only:
SVanish only needs to be installed on the server. Clients are not required to install it.

✨ Features ✨

The original VanishMod includes a similar feature, but it relies on Minecraft’s /team system and it is disabled by default.

SVanish uses its own server-side SavedData system. This allows you to manage visibility permissions independently, without interfering with your server’s teams or whatever.

  • Independent System: No /team configuration required.
  • Persistent Storage: Data is saved directly in the server’s world.
  • Bulk Management: Manage multiple players at once using the group syntax from RaccoonCore.

Perfect for SMP and RP-focused servers!

🔗 Compatibility 🔗

  • Requires VanishMod
  • Requires RaccoonCore
  • Designed for Forge (I didn't learn NeoForge yet)
  • Should work fine with any other mods! But if it doesn't, please let me know by opening an issue here or on GitHub!

💻 Commands & Syntax 💻

 

Command Description
/sv allow <player> see <target> Allows a specific player to see the target while vanished.
/sv allow group [<p1, p2...>] see <target> Allows a group of players to see the target.
/sv deny <player> see <target> Revokes a player's permission to see the target.
/sv deny group [<p1, p2...>] see <target> Revokes a group of player's permission to see the target.
/sv clear <player> No one will be able to see this player in vanish anymore.
/sv clear group [<p1, p2...>] No one will be able to see this group of players in vanish anymore.
/sv get <player> Prints a list of all players who can currently see the target.

 

💡 Examples

  • /sv allow KamKeyke see Alio - Allows KamKeyke to see Alio when vanished.
  • /sv allow group {KamKeyke, Koretzy} see Alio - Allows KamKeyke and Koretzy to see Alio when vanished.
  • /sv deny KamKeyke see Alio - Revokes Kamkeyke's permission to see Alio in vanish; now only Koretzy can.
  • /sv clear Alio - Now no one can see Alio in vanish anymore.
###

title: Inventory Shuffle
description: Every once in a while your inventory is shuffled!
body:
# Inventory Shuffle

**Inventory Shuffle** periodically randomizes player inventories on the server. At fixed intervals, all item slots are shuffled - including main inventory, hotbar, armor, off-hand, ender chest, and the contents of shulker boxes. The mod is designed as a straightforward gameplay modifier that increases difficulty without changing core mechanics. **Yes, you can still beat the game!**

## Features

- **Timed Shuffle Events**: Every 2-5 minutes, all online players have their inventories shuffled.
- **Global Countdown Warning**: A boss bar appears 5 seconds before each shuffle, displaying a numeric countdown and progress indicator.
- **Complete Inventory Coverage**: Shuffles all 41 player inventory slots (main inventory, hotbar, armor, off-hand).
- **Ender Chest Included**: Each player's ender chest inventory is also shuffled.
- **Shulker Box Support**: Shuffles the contents of shulker boxes, including shulker boxes in ender chest.
- **Vanilla-Compatible**: Works seamlessly with vanilla Minecraft and most other mods (which do not change the inventory mechanics).
- **Server-Side**: Only the server (or the player hosting the world) needs the mod installed for multiplayer.

## Why Play?

This mod introduces periodic disruption to inventory management without altering core gameplay systems. Resource organization becomes a strategic challenge, especially during combat, exploration, or automation-heavy setups. It is suitable for challenge runs, multiplayer servers, and content creation scenarios where controlled unpredictability is desired.

title: MZZ's Desert Survival
description: Makes the whole world a desert; overhauls Minecraft's crafting recipes to provide unique progression and highlight Minecraft's overlooked features.
body:
(disclaimer: My use of bulleted points with bolded headers is not due to AI use, but because it is an effective way to write. I do not condone the use of AI; _Desert Survival_ is a 100% human project :D) # Preamble _Desert Survival_ is a vanilla-like datapack that, among much more significant changes, makes the whole world a desert. Without a tree to punch, you’ll find yourself working hard to survive through detoured and rerouted progression. Through changes to crafting, loot, and world generation, I’ve upped the difficulty, meaningfully extended all stages of the game, and brought some of _Minecraft's_ overlooked features to light. ### Desert Survival has: - **Less stuff.** The desert really is a blank slate. I’ve found ways to implement many interesting and/or beloved features, and the rest of _Minecraft's_ glut of features are nowhere to be seen. It’s a simpler life out here. - **Revitalized vanilla features.** Some features in _Minecraft_ are terribly outclassed or have absurd barriers to entry. Why craft a crossbow when you can use a bow? Why should you ride a camel when saddles are uncraftable? I’ve removed many of these barriers and better options to create a novel metagame. - **Decisions in progression.** By nature of having clear best options and linear progression, vanilla _Minecraft_ makes a lot of decisions for you. I’ve added a variety of competing choices for gear as well as multiple progression pathways throughout the game to counteract this. - **Mechanical depth.** What I mean by that, is that _Desert Survival's_ resources and features are all generally useful in multiple ways rather than being one-note. I’ve reworked many of these one-note features (why is wolf armor made of armadillo scutes? I made the recipe use copper instead) and excluded many others. You’ll never be unhappy to pick up an item other than diorite. - **Limited new content.** I didn’t want to take away from the vanilla feel, so the custom features that exist are aligned with vanilla principles, are designed to maintain immersion, and uphold the design principles I’ve detailed. They’re also really fun! ### Desert Survival isn’t: - **Strictly additive.** This datapack modifies many of _Minecraft's_ features and excludes many more, but it doesn't add much new content. _Desert Survival_ is a renovation, not an added floor. - **Divorced from vanilla.** I developed this datapack as a close alternative to vanilla _Minecraft_, not as a modded experience. A lot has been edited, but everything I’ve done is specifically chosen and designed to feel vanilla. - **Overly difficult.** This datapack's got a kick to it, but making the game difficult isn't the focus of _Desert Survival_. If you're good at vanilla survival, you'll be fine. - **Drawn out.** When I say I meaningfully extended progression, the emphasis is on the meaning. You won’t find yourself grinding, and you won’t be subjected to tedium. I went about _Desert Survival's_ lengthened progression in an intentionally natural way. **Enjoy the _Desert Survival_ experience! I guarantee you won’t miss your crafting table :)** # Rundown ## Avoid this section if you want to go in blind! Inaccuracies may be present if you are not playing the latest version. ### First Days
Spoiler
  • Collect sticks for tools and sugarcane to farm
  • Make a flint shovel as an early weapon
  • Hunting rabbits is a decent safe food source
  • Find a village ruins and kill the golem - it won't be happy to see you (in versions prior to 1.9)
    • Hay bales can be used to make a bed
    • Wheat, sugar, and raw rabbit can be combined into pemmican to get more food out of each piece of rabbit
    • Iron nuggets from the golem can be used for flint and steel
  • Break dry grass to find wheat seeds
  • Once night falls, kill a creeper
    • Gunpowder can be used for TNT and fire starters
  • Blowing up stone will get you your first set of real tools
  • A stone shovel and/or a stone spear are your best weapon options
  • Finding coal will let you build a campfire - make sure you have something to light it with
  • Killing camels or cooking rotten flesh gets you leather for armor and bowls
    • Spider eyes and rotten flesh can be used to make gruel, which can be cooked on a campfire to remove the negative effects
  • Dirt for farmland can be found in caves
    • Dirt can be used to make a composter; using a shovel to collect from a composter yields dirt as well as bone meal
  • Raw metals can be smelted on the campfire or in a furnace
    • Copper ingots can be made into lanterns, rails, and arrows, as well as copper tools
    • Iron ingots are used to make crossbows and a smithing table
  • Bundles and item frames (or shelves) in tandem are useful for storage
  • Obtaining certain workstations will allow you to craft a guidebook; doing so is recommended
### Arms and Armaments
Spoiler
  • By combining a stone tool with a gold block in a smithing table, a golden tool is created
  • By combining a golden tool with an iron block in a smithing table, an iron tool is created
  • Some similar upgrades exist outside of tools, such as upgrading a bundle with an iron block to get a hopper
  • Any piece of leather armour can be upgraded with a metal block to add an effect to the armour
    • Copper upgrades increase your movement speed
    • Gold upgrades increase your mining speed and block reach
    • Iron upgrades increase your defense, knockback, and knockback resistance
  • Certain "specialist" upgrades for leather armour exist; these are obtainable through crafting rather than smithing
  • Placing a filled cauldron over a lit campfire and dropping metal-upgraded armour into it separates the metal from the armour
  • Cactus flowers, gunpowder, glass bottles, and common mob drops can be used to make harmful splash bottles
    • Using rotten flesh produces bottles of toxin, which give the Wither effect
    • Using bones produces bottles of dust, which give the Slowness and Weakness effects
    • Using spider eyes produces bottles of acid, which give the Instant Damage effect
### Adventuring Time
Spoilers
  • Saddles can be easily crafted from leather and string and allow for camel riding
  • Maps can be made with paper, blue dye, green dye, and white dye, or by using white dye to reset a filled map
  • Trail ruins can be found uncommonly
  • Striped wolves are often present at trail ruins
  • Using a brush to extract relics from a trail ruin yields gold nuggets, iron nuggets, and lapis lazuli, as well as clay balls
  • Packed mud can be found in the architecture of a trail ruins
  • Occasionally, a fishing rod or temple map can be found in a block of suspicious gravel
  • Fishing rarely yields actual fish. This is the desert.
    • Fishing can yield enchanted gear as per vanilla, as well as driftwood crates which contain a large volume of fishing junk
  • Temple maps lead to desert pyramids, which contain abundant gold as well as pumpkin seeds and red sand
    • As well as being used for golems, pumpkins can be combined with sugar and a bottle to craft pumpkin puree
    • Like in vanilla, building a copper golem creates a copper chest; this is a good source of renewable storage
    • Placing mud, packed mud, clay, sand, or red sand underneath a composter will cause harvesting it with a shovel to yield that block in place of some dirt
  • Very rarely, dungeons can generate close to the surface
### Digging Deep
Spoilers
  • Hunting glow squids for their glow ink sacs is useful for making luminous gruel, which provides Night Vision
  • Many redstone devices are craftable
  • Dungeons (monster rooms) can be found more abundantly than in vanilla and contain valuable loot
  • Breaking the monster spawner in a dungeon yields three chains
  • Chains can be used in conjunction with diamonds, iron, and deepslate to craft reinforced deepslate
    • Reinforced deepslate can be used to upgrade leather armour, which doubles each piece's defense and provides extra niche protections but reduces movement speed
    • Reinforced deepslate can be used to upgrade a bowl to a bucket, which is necessary for creating a Nether portal
    • Reinforced deepslate can be used to upgrade tools and weapons into powerful variants
  • Chains can also be used in conjuction with iron nuggets to craft unbreakable chainmail armor
  • Similarly to leather armour and metals, chainmail armour can be upgraded using magical artifacts
    • Enchanted book upgrades increase maximum health at the cost of melee damage
    • Wither skeleton skull upgrades increase melee damage and movement speed at the cost of maximum health
  • Dungeon chests contain melon seeds, which provides an easy and stable food source
    • Melons, wheat, and glow ink sacs can be combined to make dungeoneer's stew, which gives Regeneration and Night Vision
  • Dungeon chests contain emeralds, which can be combined with sandstone (and, since update 1.9, prismarine crystals) to create end portal frames
### The Need to Go Deeper
Spoilers
  • The Nether lacks the two fungus forest biomes, with only the Soul Sand Valley, Nether Wastes, and Basalt Deltas present
  • Nether quartz can be used to craft quartz plating, which fully repairs a tool when used to upgrade it
  • Combining a leather armour piece with a quartz block and two gold blocks produces a golden armour piece
  • Nether Wastes
    • Brown mushrooms are useful for making rabbit stew
    • Red mushrooms are useful in tandem with nether wart for crafting positive potions
    • Both rabbit stew and mushroom stew, like gruel, are stackable
  • Soul Sand Valley
    • Wither skeletons spawn frequently
    • Dying mobs spawn crimson roots at their feet, which has a chance to drop nether wart when broken
  • Basalt Deltas
    • Magma cubes spawn frequently
      • Magma cream can be dropped in water to cool it into a slime ball and a block of obsidian
      • Obsidian can be used to craft enchanting tables, ender chests, and raw alloy
  • Bastion Remnants
    • Magma cube spawners and nether wart farms can be present
    • Chests contain obsidian, gold, and magma cream among other loot
    • Chains are abundant in the architecture of the bastion
  • Combining magma cream with an ender pearl creates an ender eye
  • Raw alloy can be smelted to obtain refined alloy
  • Refined alloy can be used to upgrade tools and leather armour similarly to reinforced deepslate; alloy-upgraded armour has fire protection and grants increased defense and melee damage
  • Using diamonds and other specific materials, enchanted books can be crafted into books with other enchantments; for example, any enchanted book when combined with a diamond and a rabbit's foot becomes an enchanted book with Looting I
### The Endgame
Spoilers
  • The End portal can be built anywhere due to end portal frames being craftable
  • The Ender Dragon fight is unmodified
  • The End is positioned directly over the Overworld; falling into the End void causes you to fall into the Overworld
  • Each player present at the Ender Dragon fight receives a loot chest when the fight is won, which contains a dragon head, an ender veil, and a levitation rod as well as other goodies
    • Throwing an ender pearl while wearing an ender veil teleports you to your spawnpoint
    • Holding the levitation rod in your mainhand gives you antigravity
    • Holding the levitation rod in your mainhand or offhand fully prevents fall damage from heights less than 384 blocks
  • The Wither fight is unmodified
  • The Nether star can be used for a variety of purposes
    • Upgrading an enchanted golden apple with a Nether star produces an Apple of Eden, which functions similarly to a Totem of Undying
    • Placing a Nether star in an item frame atop a monster spawner transforms it into a cornucopia, which produces a dungeon chest's worth of loot once per day
    • Placing a Nether star in an item frame atop a beacon creates a panoculus, which gives all players within 2000 blocks Night Vision
## Content added in release 1.8 (Catch Bigger Fish)
Spoilers
  • Upgrading a fishing rod with reinforced deepslate produces a reinforced fishing rod
  • The reinforced fishing rod catches fish far more often
  • Holding meat in your offhand uses it as bait for the reinforced fishing rod; using bait while fishing in open water will cause you to catch 1-3 guardians
  • The guardians each drop prismarine shards and crystals
    • Prismarine shards allow for the crafting of prismarine blocks
    • Prismarine crystals can be used to craft certain enchanted books as well as a flowstone, which increases movement and attack speed as well as breath capacity when held in the offhand
  • Killing piglins for porkchops and using the porkchops as bait fishes up the Elder Guardian
  • If you defeat the Elder Guardian, you will receive a trident in addition to a sponge and prismarine shards/crystals
## Content added in release 1.9 (Tomb Slayer)
Spoilers
  • Ancient talismans can be crafted from bricks, diamonds, and skulls
    • Skeleton skulls or wither skeleton skulls can be used
    • Skeleton skulls can be found while doing archaeology in desert pyramids
  • With a talisman in your inventory, archaeological digs will spawn powerful undead enemies
  • Undead enemies will drop treasures, more talismans, and sometimes a higher-level talisman
  • These treasures include diamonds, emeralds, chains, and rarely enchanted golden apples
  • Higher level talismans summon stronger enemies, which drop better loot
    • Level I talismans summon standard undead, which drop small amounts of treasure
    • Level II talismans summon undead warriors, which drop lots of treasure and some enchanted books
    • Level III talismans summon undead tyrants, which drop powerful enchanted books and unique gear
    • There are no level IV talismans... yet
  • The Lord Tyrant (holds a golden sword, accompanied by four husks) drops the Horn of Plenty
  • The Warrior Tyrant (holds a golden spear, accompanied by two parcheds) drops the War Crossbow
  • The Witch Tyrant (holds a golden hoe, accompanied by two witches) drops the Chemical Satchel

title: Login Cooldown
description: A plugin that prevents players from joining and leaving excessively, with a configurable limit on the number of times allowed within a set time frame.
body:
## Login Cooldown
A plugin that prevents players from joining and leaving excessively, with a configurable limit on the number of times allowed within a set time frame.

### Rationale
Originally created to address players spamming chat with repeated leave and join messages, especially as a spam tactic after being muted or a way to circumvent chat spam.

### Usage
`/logincooldown reload` - Reloads the configuration file
`/logincooldown set <joins-per|time-frame> <value>` - Directly modify one of the two config values

Both commands require `logincooldown.admin` permission.

`logincooldown.notify` - Players with this permission will receive the configurable notification message when someone is blocked from joining.

title: tnt tag
description: Explosive survival tag minigame for 20-25 players. Pass the TNT before it explodes! Last player standing wins across 6 intense rounds.
body:
# 💥 TNT TAG - Explosive Survival Tag Game

TNT TAG is an explosive survival-style tag minigame plugin for Minecraft servers, designed for 20-25 players. Get ready for intense 6-round matches where randomly selected players carry TNT and must pass it to others before time runs out!

## 🎮 Game Overview

- **Players:** 20-25 players per game
- **Duration:** Approximately 5 minutes (6 rounds total)
- **Objective:** Survive all 6 rounds without exploding. Last player standing wins!
- **Game Mode:** Survival tag with explosive consequences

## ✨ Key Features

### Dynamic Round System
- **6 Fixed Rounds** with escalating difficulty
- Round-specific TNT holder counts (from 1 player to 50% of survivors)
- Variable round durations (25-50 seconds)
- Special glowing effect in final rounds (Rounds 5-6)

### Balanced Gameplay Mechanics
- **Speed Boost:** TNT holders get Speed II, normal players get Speed I
- **No PVP Damage:** Players can only transfer TNT, no actual damage
- **No Splash Damage:** Only TNT holders explode when time runs out
- **Arena Boundaries:** Automatic teleport-back system prevents players from escaping

### Rich Visual & Audio Feedback
- **Scoreboard:** Real-time game state, round info, and survivor count
- **Action Bar:** Updates 2x per second with status and warnings
- **Boss Bar:** TNT holders see countdown progress bar
- **Title Messages:** Round start, TNT transfer, explosion, and victory announcements
- **Particle Effects:** Explosions, victory fireworks, game start effects
- **Sound Effects:** Countdown beeps, explosions, and atmospheric audio

### Auto-Start System
- Games automatically start when 20 players join
- 10-second countdown with visual and audio cues
- Automatic game creation and cleanup

## 📋 Round Breakdown

| Round | TNT Holders | Duration | Special Effect |
|-------|-------------|----------|----------------|
| 1 | 1 player | 40s | None |
| 2 | 25% of players | 30s | None |
| 3 | 25% of players | 30s | None |
| 4 | 50% of players | 25s | None |
| 5 | 33% of players | 40s | All Glowing ✨ |
| 6 | 33% of players | 50s | All Glowing ✨ |

## 💻 Commands

### Player Commands
- `/tnttag join [arena]` - Join a game
- `/tnttag leave` - Leave current game
- `/tnttag stats [player]` - View statistics
- `/tnttag list` - List available arenas

### Admin Commands
- `/tnttag setpos1` - Set arena corner 1
- `/tnttag setpos2` - Set arena corner 2
- `/tnttag creategame <arena>` - Create new arena
- `/tnttag delete <arena>` - Delete arena
- `/tnttag start <arena>` - Force start game
- `/tnttag stop <arena>` - Force stop game
- `/tnttag reload` - Reload configuration

## 🔧 Configuration

Fully customizable via `config.yml`:
- Minimum/maximum player counts
- Countdown duration
- Round-specific settings (TNT holders, duration, effects)
- Debug mode
- Messages in Japanese and English

## 📊 Statistics System

Tracks player performance:
- Games played
- Wins
- Rounds survived
- TNT tags given/received
- Total survival time

## 🎯 Perfect For

- **Mini-game Servers:** Add variety to your server's game rotation
- **Events:** Host tournaments with built-in statistics
- **Community Servers:** Great for 20+ player gatherings
- **Competition:** Built-in leaderboards via statistics

## 🌐 Multilingual Support

- **Japanese (日本語)** - Full support
- **English** - Full support
- Includes player guide documentation in both languages

## 📦 Requirements

- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.5+
- **Server Software:** Paper (recommended)
- **Java Version:** 21+
- **Players:** 20-25 recommended (minimum 4 for testing)

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest JAR file
2. Place in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure arenas using `/tnttag setpos1` and `/tnttag setpos2`
5. Create arena with `/tnttag creategame <arena>`
6. Players can join with `/tnttag join`

## 📖 Documentation

Comprehensive player guide included at `docs/index.html`:
- Game rules and mechanics
- Strategy tips
- Command reference
- HUD explanation
- Available in Japanese and English

## 🎨 Design Philosophy

TNT TAG was designed with these principles:
- **Fast-paced action** - Quick rounds keep energy high
- **Strategic depth** - Speed differential creates cat-and-mouse gameplay
- **Spectator-friendly** - Clear visual feedback for observers
- **Fair randomization** - Equal opportunity for all players
- **Scalable difficulty** - Progressive challenge across rounds

## 🐛 Bug Reports & Support

Found a bug? Have a suggestion?
- GitHub Issues: [Report here](https://github.com/yokmama/tnt_tag/issues)

## 👨‍💻 Credits

**Game Design:** Riku
*Implementation:** TNT TAG Development Team

## 📜 License

Licensed under MIT License. See LICENSE file for details.

---

**Ready to explode?** Download now and bring explosive fun to your Minecraft server! 💥

body:
# Nest's Level System

A simple leveling system that rewards players for various in-game activities with fully customizable XP rewards and progression tracking.

## Features

### Key Futures
- level progression with customizable XP requirements
- Player data saving
- Customizable messages with hex color support
- XP gain notifications

### Activity-Based XP Rewards
- **Mining**: Break blocks for XP (diamond, iron, coal, etc.)
- **Building**: Place special blocks like beacons and enchanting tables
- **Smelting**: Get XP for smelting ores and raw materials
- **Combat**: Earn XP for killing mobs and bosses
- **Crafting**: Receive XP for crafting items

### Commands & Permissions
- `/level` - Check your level and progress
- `/level check <player>` - View another player's level
- `/level set <player> <level>` - Set player level (admin)
- `/level reload` - Reload configuration (admin)

### Admin Features
- Modify player levels and XP
- Reload configuration without restart

### Placeholders
- `%levelsystem_level%` - Current player level
- `%levelsystem_xp%` - Current XP amount
- `%levelsystem_xp_needed%` - XP needed for next level
- `%levelsystem_progress%` - Progress percentage
- `%levelsystem_progress_decimal%` - Progress as decimal

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21 or higher
- Spigot, Paper, or compatible server software
- PlaceholderAPI (recommended for placeholders)

## Setup
1. Place the jar in your plugins folder
2. Start your server
3. Configure `config.yml` to your preferences
4. Restart or use `/level reload`

All XP values, messages, and settings are fully customizable through the configuration file.

title: RandomCamera
description: A camera that randomly teleport to specified points.
body:
# **Русский**

**Создан по образу и подобию камеры с MineShield с личными изменениями и улучшениями.**

**По всем вопросам обращаться ко мне в [Telegram](https://web.telegram.org/k/#@TerraStadis)**

## Основные функции

### Рандомный режим

- ```/rancam create ID Пример подписи```
  - Создание ракурса
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Только игрок


- ```/rancam delete ID```
  - Удаление ракурса
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Консоль и игрок


- ```/rancam teleport ID```
  - Телепорт к ракурсу
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Только игрок


- ```/rancam list```
  - Список, установленный для рандомного режима. 
  - Все ракурсы в списке, установленном для рандомного режима.  
  - Нужны права ```rancam.list```
  - Только игрок

- ```/rancam mode *```
  - intaractive
    - Стандартный, в котором с камерой могут взаимодействовать другие игроки.
    - Неубиваемая.
    - При её вылете плагин будет искать камеру до тех пор, пока она снова не зайдёт (в консоли будет писаться ```Камера не найдена```)
  - nonIntaractive 
    - Режим, в котором ни сама камера, ни игроки её сдвинуть не смогут.
    - Оставляет режим игры тот, что был при написании команды start.
    - При вылете плагин автоматически завершает работу камеры.

- ```/rancam start Игрок```
  - Превращает игрока в камеру, которая будет телепортироваться по заданным точкам по заданному в конфиге времени
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Консоль и игрок


- ```/rancam stop```
  - Остановить камеру
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Консоль и игрок


- ```/rancam reload```
  - Перезагружает конфиг (иногда нужно прописать 2 раза)
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Консоль и игрок


### Ручной режим

- ```/handcam set Игрок```
  - Устанавливает игрока, как камеру, которой можно управлять.
  - Нужны права ```handcam.set```.
  - Консоль и игрок.

- ```/handcam moveTo ID```
  - Телепортирует установленную камеру к указанному ракурсу.
  - Нужны права ```handcam.moveTo```.
  - Консоль и игрок.

- ```/handcam list```
  - Список, установленный для ручного режима.
  - Все ракурсы в списке, установленном для ручного режима.  
  - Только игрок.

## Конфиг
- ```cameraSwitchTime```
  - Измеряется в секундах.
  - По умолчанию 15.

## Списки ракурсов
Основная работа со списками происходит в ```/rancam lists *```:
- ```create <name>``` - создать свой список ракурсов.
- ```delete <name>``` - удалить список ракурсов.
- ```set <CurrentRanCameraList|CurrentHandCameraList> <name>``` - установить список для ручной или рандомной камеры. 

## Советы

У камеры есть такое интересное свойство - вылетать. Возможнно это связано с тем, что камера слишком далеко тепается и сервер это считает нарушением.

Для устранения этого инцидента можете скачать мод [AutoRelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/autorelog) и настройте его, чтобы камера могла переподключаться без надобности вмешательства извне.


Если вы собираетесь сворачивать окно, при этом не завершая стрим, скачайте мод [Borderless Fullscreen](https://modrinth.com/mod/borderless-fullscreen), настроив его, чтобы в полноэкранном режиме окно при переходе в другое приложение не сворачивалось.

Так же для того, чтобы камера не выходила в меню при сворачивании окна нажмите комбинацию клавишь ```F3 + P```


# **English**

**Created in the image and likeness of a MineShield camera with personal changes and improvements.**

**If you have any questions, please contact me at [Telegram](https://web.telegram.org/k/#@TerraStadis)**

## Main functions
### Random mode
- ``/rancam create ID Example title``
  - Creating a camera angle
  - You need the rights ``rancam.rancam``
  - Player only


- ``/rancam delete ID``
  - Deleting the camera angle.
  - Need the rights of ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Сonsole and player.


- ``/rancam teleport ID``
  - Teleport to the camera angle.
  - Need the rights of ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Player only.


- ``/rancam list``
  - The list set for random mode. 
  - All camera angles are in the list set for random mode.
  - Need the rights of ``rancam.list``.
  - Player only.

- ```/rancam mode *```
  - intaractive
    - A standard one in which other players can interact with the camera.
    - Unkillable.
    - When it crashes, the plugin will search for the camera until it logs in again (the console will say ```Camera not found```)
  - nonIntaractive 
    - A mode in which neither the camera itself nor the players can move it.
    - It does not change the game mode at startup.
    - Upon leaving, the plugin automatically shuts down the camera.


- ```/rancam start PLAYER```
  - Turns the player into a camera that will teleport to specified points according to the time specified in the config.
  - Requires the rights ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Сonsole and player.


- ``/rancam stop``
  - Stop the camera.
  - Need the rights of ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Сonsole and player.


- ``/rancam reload``
  - Reloads the config (sometimes you need to register 2 times).
  - Rights are needed ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Console and player.

### Manually mode

- ``/handcam set Player``
  - Sets the player as a camera that can be controlled.
  - You need the rights of ``handcam.set`'.
  - Console and player.

- ``/handcam moveTo ID``
  - Teleports the installed camera to the specified angle.
  - You need the rights of ``handcam.moveTo`'.
  - Console and player.

- ```/handcam list```
  - The list set for manual mode.
  - All camera angles are in the list set for manual mode. 
  - Player only.

## Config
- `cameraSwitchTime`
  - Measured in seconds.
  - Default is 15.

## Lists of camera angles
The main work with lists takes place in ```/rancam lists *```:
- ```create <name>``` - create your own list of camera angles.
- ```delete <name>``` - delete the list of camera angles.
- ```set <CurrentRanCameraList|CurrentHandCameraList> <name>``` - set a list for a manual or random camera.

## Tips

The camera has such an interesting property - disconnect. This may be due to the fact that the camera is moving too far away and the server considers it a violation.

To fix this incident, you can download the [AutoRelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/autorelog) mod and set it up so that the camera can reconnect without the need for outside interference.


If you are going to minimize the window without completing the stream, download the mod [Borderless Fullscreen](https://modrinth.com/mod/borderless-fullscreen), by configuring it so that in fullscreen mode, the window does not collapse when switching to another application.

Also, to prevent the camera from entering the menu when minimizing the window, press the key combination ``F3 + P``

title: NoVoidX
description: NoVoidX is a lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to enhance player experience by preventing accidental deaths from falling into the void. This plugin automatically teleports players who fall into the void back to a safe location, ensuring their survival
body:
# NoVoidX - No More Void Deaths! NoVoidX is a lightweight and essential Minecraft plugin designed to prevent players from losing their progress to the dreaded void. Say goodbye to frustrating deaths and lost items from accidental falls! This plugin intelligently detects when a player enters the void and safely teleports them back to a configurable, secure location, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience for everyone on your server. ## ✨ Features * **Void Fall Protection:** Automatically teleports players falling into the void to a safe, predefined location. Never lose your precious items to the abyss again! * **Highly Configurable:** Easily customize the teleportation destination, messages, and more via a simple `config.yml` file. Tailor the plugin to perfectly fit your server's needs. * **Lightweight & Efficient:** Designed for minimal server impact, ensuring smooth performance even on busy servers. * **Auto-Update Checker:** Stay up-to-date effortlessly! NoVoidX includes an integrated update checker to notify you of new versions, so you can always run the latest and greatest. * **Simple Reload Command:** Quickly reload the plugin's configuration without needing a server restart, making on-the-fly adjustments a breeze. * **Permission-Based Control:** Granular permissions allow you to control who can use the basic command and who can reload the plugin. * **Intuitive Tab Completion:** Enjoy seamless command usage with intelligent tab completion for `/novoidx` commands. ## 🚀 How it Works When a player falls below a configurable Y-level (typically the void level), NoVoidX springs into action. Instead of plummeting to their demise, the player is instantly teleported to a safe spawn point (configurable to be the world's spawn, their bed spawn, or specific coordinates). ## 🛠️ Configuration NoVoidX is designed to be highly configurable. Here's a snippet of the `config.yml`: ```yaml # NoVoidX Configuration enabled: true # Check update on startup check-update: true worlds: world: enabled: true # Set to false to disable NoVoidX for this world void-threshold: -128 # Y-coordinate threshold for void in the Overworld target-world: world_nether target-y: 512 ration: 8 # Ratio of teleportation to Nether world world_the_end: enabled: true void-threshold: -64 target-world: world target-y: 512 ration: 1 # Ratio of teleportation to Overworld # Duration of blindness effect in seconds after teleportation blindness-duration: 5 # Cooldown in seconds before a player can be teleported again teleport-cooldown: 3 # logging settings log: true # Enable or disable logging ``` ## 📦 Commands & Permissions
Spoiler | Command | Description | Permission | Default | | :--------------- | :--------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------- | :----------- | | `/novoidx` | Displays basic plugin information. | `novoidx.use` | `true` (all) | | `/novoidx reload`| Reloads the plugin's configuration. | `novoidx.reload` | `op` | | | | `novoidx.admin` (inherits) | `op` |
**NoVoidX is the simple yet powerful solution to prevent those frustrating void deaths on your Minecraft server. Install it today and let your players explore without fear of the abyss!** ### Made with 🗿 by SkyX

title: Aggressive Mobs
description: Simply put: all mobs are aggressive towards you now.
body:
# Aggressive Mobs

This Fabric mod makes all creatures in Minecraft aggressive, including passive ones like cows and pigs. Be careful, the world has become a much more dangerous place!

## Features

*   **Universal Aggression:** All creatures that are not normally hostile (except monsters, which already are) will now attack players on sight.
*   **Highly Configurable:** You can adjust the behavior of aggressive creatures using game rules.

## Game Rules

You can modify these game rules using the `/gamerule <ruleName> <value>` command.

*   `aggressiveMobsActivated` (default: `false`)
    *   Activates or deactivates the main functionality of the mod. Set to `true` to make creatures aggressive.
*   `aggressiveMobsSpeedPercentage` (default: `160`)
    *   Modifies the movement speed of aggressive creatures. 100% is normal speed.
*   `aggressiveMobsDamagePercentage` (default: `100`)
    *   Modifies the damage dealt by aggressive creatures. 100% is normal damage. (for mobs that do not have an attack attribute, it deals, at 100%, 1 heart of damage)
*   `aggressiveMobsKnockbackPercentage` (default: `100`)
    *   Modifies the knockback dealt by aggressive creatures. 100% is normal knockback.
*   `aggressiveMobsFollowRangePercentage` (default: `100`)
    *   Modifies the distance at which aggressive creatures will detect and pursue you. 100% is the normal range.

## Installation

1.  Make sure you have [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) installed.
2.  Download the mod's `.jar` file.
3.  Place the `.jar` file in your `mods` folder.

Have fun (and try to survive)!

title: Connected Dimensions
description: This datapack introduces a unique and immersive way to travel between dimensions by falling into the void or reaching the build height limits.
body:
# Connected Dimensions
This datapack introduces a unique and immersive way to travel between dimensions by falling into the void or reaching the build height limits. It creates a seamless connection between the Overworld, Nether, and End, allowing players to explore new strategies, build secret bases, and escape dangerous situations with ease.

## Features
**Overworld Void to Nether Roof:**
If a player falls into the void in the Overworld, they will safely land on the Nether roof from a great height without taking any damage. Perfect for quick access to the Nether roof!

**Nether Build Height to Overworld Bedrock Layer:**
When a player reaches the build height limit in the Nether, they will be transported to the bedrock layer of the Overworld. This creates a direct link between the two dimensions.

**Overworld Build Height to the End:**
Reaching the build height limit in the Overworld will transport the player to the End. This provides a unique way to access the End without needing to find a Stronghold.

**End Void to Overworld Sky:**
Falling into the void in the End will place the player high in the sky of the Overworld, where they will fall safely to the ground without taking any damage. A dramatic way to return to the Overworld!

**Consistent X and Z Coordinates:**
When traveling between dimensions, only the Y-coordinate changes. Your X and Z coordinates remain the same, allowing for precise travel, secret base connections, and strategic escapes.
## Compatibility
Made for version 1.21 to 1.21.1.

But might work for some older or newer versions as it uses simple code.
## Versions
For Datapack, Minecraft Version 1.21 - 1.21.1: Version - 1.0.x
## Issue page
[Issue Page](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/connected-dimensions/)

title: Schrodingers Chest
description: A Minecraft mod that adds not Schrödinger's Cat, but Schrödinger's Chest!
body:
# Schrödinger's Chest  

Inspired by Schrödinger's famous thought experiment, this mod asks one crucial question:  
*Why settle for Schrödinger's Cat when you can have Schrödinger's Chest?*  

Made for **Minecraft 1.21.1** & **Fabric Mod Loader**. 

---

## 📦 Features  

This mod is packed with quantum-inspired madness:  
-  **Schrödinger's Staff**: A powerful tool to manipulate loot and defy certainty.  
-  **Relic Item**: A mysterious resource to craft unique gear and surprises.  
-  **3 New Weapons/Tools**: Each comes with a twist—what material are they even made of?!  
-  **Schrödinger's Breakfast**: A surprise-packed meal with 10 random effects.  
-  **Custom Textures**: Every new item comes with its own custom design!  

---

## Schrödinger's Staff  

The **Schrödinger's Staff** is the ultimate tool for quantum chaos:  
- **Right-Click a unlooted Structure Chest**: Change its loot while keeping its loot table.  
- **Right-Click a Trapped Chest with One Item**: Replace it with a random item (surprise!).  
- Use it to obtain a **Relic Item**—but beware, it might cause some unexpected damage...  

---

## Relic Item  

The **Relic Item** is your key to crafting quantum gear:  
- **How to Obtain**: Use the **Schrödinger's Staff** on chests.  
- **What to Do With It**:  
  - Craft 3 mysterious new weapons or tools: the **Relic Axe**, **Relic Pickaxe**, and **Relic Sword**.  
  - Or... make yourself a chaotic breakfast treat!  

---

## Relic Weapons & Tools  

Think you know your gear? Think again. Schrödinger's tools and weapons keep you guessing until you use them!  
- **Weapons Included**: Relic Axe, Relic Pickaxe, and Relic Sword.  
  
### How They Work:  
- When you hit an entity, the weapon "decides" its material.  
- **Example**: Craft a Relic Sword → hit a zombie → congrats, you now have... a wooden sword? Or maybe it's made of diamonds?!  

---

## Schrödinger's Breakfast  

Feeling adventurous? Try **Schrödinger's Breakfast**, the ultimate quantum cuisine!  
- **How It Works**:  
  - Right-click to eat.  
  - Get one of **10 random effects** ranging from poison to speed. Deliciously unpredictable!  

---

made with <3 by Qwatrum

title: Vanilla Max
description: Boost your Minecraft experience while staying true to vanilla-style mechanics and systems.
body:
### What is Vanilla Max?

**It is my vision of what Minecraft could be without Microsoft and Mojang limiting what enters into the game**, without losing the sandbox aspect and remaining simple, using the vanilla crafting systems as much as possible and only introducing systems that are simple and intuitive to understand for any player. 

What motivated me to create this was that even though there are mods and modpacks that add many layers to the game, they are often overly complex making it difficult even for veteran Minecraft players to understand its mechanics, which causes them not to engage with those systems. **Vanilla Max brings its many features in a natural, seamless way into the game for any player to enjoy as they like**, and has something in it for all kinds of players!

![Splash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2107d63f3fe3cdfcd3cc5cca13703ad6fef122a4_0.webp)

## Features

- **One-click multiplayer** with **proximity-based voice chat**!
- **Airships and aircraft** that can be crafted comprehensibly through the crafting table and have intuitive controls
- **Ships** - you no longer will be able to traverse oceans with simple boats though!
- **Carts** for you to transport stuff on land by yourself or with a friendly help from horses, mules, donkeys or camels
- **Backpacks and sleeping bags** to enable you to explore further away from home without fear of going back to spawn or filling your inventory
- **Vinery** and winemaking
- **Several new mobs** - passive and hostile - including the ones that lost all mob votes!
- **Lots of new food**
- **New cooking system** for more complex recipes
- **Many new crops**
- **Improved fishing** and various new kinds of fish
- **Trinkets** with some pretty interesting effects
- **Several new small and larger structures**
- **Many revamped structures from vanilla**
- **Revamped Minecarts** that can be linked and go much faster
- **Elytra has a trinket slot** instead of taking up the chest slot
- **Revamped archeology** - and a new villager job with it!
- **Cameras** and photography!
- **Guard villagers** that can assist the player during raids and zombie attacks - and also attack misbehaving players
- **Gunpowder weaponry**: cannons for land, ships and airships, as well as flintlock guns - but they can also be in Pillager's and (rarely) Skeleton's hands!
- **Completely revamped End and Nether dimensions**
- **Backported wolves, tuff building blocks, crafter and bundles from 1.21**
- **Copper hoppers and pipes** for better storage arrays and redstone machinery
- **Lots of brand new decorations and furniture**
- **Many new wood types**
- **Several quality-of-life improvements and features**

body: **The Hunted Modpack** brings an immersive **horror experience** to Minecraft. With an expanded variety of **food**, new **tools**, and **armor**, you'll also face deadly new **mobs**. Survival becomes even more challenging with a **body part health** system, alongside **thirst**, and **temperature management**. Traditional healing is removed—**nutrition** and smart eating are key. Optimized for performance thanks to **Fabric**, you’ll experience smooth gameplay. Plus, prepare for a more intense challenge with **random respawns** spanning up to **2000 blocks** away!

title: Carnivorous Origins Savior
description: A datapack that lets your carnivorous origins eat foods from modded sources.
body:
This project was made because I was unaware of [Dietary Delights](https://modrinth.com/datapack/origins-dietary-delights). Please use that instead.

Original description below:

---
Alright, let's set the scene.

You're joining a new server with some friends. You've got the Origins mod set-up, and you've chosen one that only eats meat. Your friend invites you over for a massive feast, with massive modded meals and- oh. You can't eat the roast chicken, even though it's... definitely meat. Hm. That doesn't seem right.

Sounds like something you've run into? This pack almost definitely fixes it. It covers Farmer's Delight, a multitude of its add-on mods such as Nether's Delight and End's Delight, Create: Garnished, Create: Estrogen, the Aether, the Bumblezone, Supplementaries, Hexcasting, Alex's Caves, Croptopia...
Is your food mod of choice not on this list? That's fine! Head on over to the GitHub and start an issue, and it'll be on my radar to add it to the list.

Oh, and don't worry, vegetarians; plenty of non-meat non-vegetable foods are also properly tagged as edible by all. You won't be missing your gummies, candies, estrogen, custard, alcohol or donuts with this datapack!

*None of the mods mentioned are required, meaning you don't need to add even more food mods just to use this!* It just slots right into your world, no additional setup required!

If you want to use this in a video/post/site/etc. you may do so as long as you credit me for this datapack.

Join my discord!

Then go into minecraft and type /reload. Also go to options>resourcepacks and enable amethyst-equipment-rp. Also note that this will only work in 1.21.2+. Now you're all set! you can now craft amethyst tools and armor in Minecraft!

title: Copper+
description: An overhaul for Copper that adds gear and magic
body:
_Copper+ is currently in a low-priority redesign phase. It's low on my project priority list and I will not be actively making update logs or developing new features for a while._

**More of Items+**: [_Items Plus Series_](https://modrinth.com/collection/HR0F6Sea)
# Description

This mod adds Rosegold tools, the new Rosemail set of armor, and the copper wrench.

## Added Content

Below is all the content the latest version adds.

### Rosemail Armor

If you have enchanted golden armor, upgrade it in the Smithing table with a Waxed Copper Ingot.
What does this do?\
Upgrading Gold to Rosemail will increase its durability above Iron. This is also the only set of armor before the diamond level with toughness, and what makes it even more worthwhile is that you can now repair your once-golden armor with one of the most common ores: Waxed Copper Ingots!\
Lastly, Rosemail will also keep Piglins neutral making it an overall upgrade from Golden Armor in the Nether (_potential lore could be that they don't see that it's gold, but they smell it on you_).

![Upgrading to Rosegold and Rosemail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Tn3Y5GoR/images/f8f132f59da55dd3ec1f62ac3a32c2b547efe0a6.gif)

### Rosegold Tools

While on the way to getting diamond tools, you should also consider getting a Rosegold pickaxe along with some of the other Rosegold tools which all have the same efficiency and enchantability as golden tools while, just like the Rosemail armor, having the improved durability of iron tools and the ability to repair them with copper.\
Turn your gold tools into Rosegold, just as Rosemail, by upgrading them at the Smithing table with Waxed Copper Ingots.

![Upgrading to Rosegold and Rosemail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Tn3Y5GoR/images/f8f132f59da55dd3ec1f62ac3a32c2b547efe0a6.gif)

- - -

## Future Additions/Changes

This mod is _very_ early in the planning stage, so these ideas will likely change once I begin working on the full release.

**Charged Copper Block**\
When a Copper Block gets struck by lightning it will gain a 30% charge and divide that across directly connected copper blocks (1 distance max). if a Lightning Rod gets struck it will charge up to 9 Copper Blocks within 2 blocks from the rod and each Copper Block will get a charge depending on how many there are (8% if there are 7-9 blocks, 16% if there are 4-6, and 30% if there are 1-3). Once charged, they can be picked up and placed where ever you wish. Charged Copper Blocks will also send their charge through uncharged Copper Blocks, they won't become charged blocks but will instead just send it through them (similarly to a Redstone Torch charging Redstone Dust) with a max reach of 25 blocks.

**Charged Rosemail**\
When standing on top of a Charged Copper Block (or a Copper Block connected to one) the Rosemail will begin taking 2%/second of charge, and every 10 seconds it will lose 1% of its own charge. While the armor is charged the player will gain different abilities depending on the pieces of Rosemail they're wearing. Boots will likely increase the player's speed, Leggings their jump, and Chestplate mining speed. The Helmet is undecided, but the idea at the moment is it gives the player Night Vision, or it simply does nothing allowing it to be switched out with a stronger armor piece. Tools can also be charged, but only if the player has a piece of Rosemail armor.

- - -

**Status**: On Hold\
**Loader**: Fabric (_full release and beta_)\
**Stage**: Alpha

## SneefVanilla+ (for mc 1.20.1)
This is a collection of mods that are meant to keep the overall feel of vanilla minecraft intact, while making the world more engaging.

Worldgen is completely overhauled by mods like [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith) and [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic), and many structures are added and improved by a large collection of mods made available by [YUNGNICKYOUNG](https://modrinth.com/user/YUNGNICKYOUNG).

Player aesthetics are extended by mods such as [Cosmetic Armor](https://modrinth.com/mod/cosmetic-armor) and [Immersive Armors](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-armors). More block variants are available via [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped) and [Rechiseled](https://modrinth.com/mod/rechiseled).

This pack also includes the [Create Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) mod, and several of its additions.

title: McBorder
description: Better use of the border system provided by vanilla. Simultaneously supporting irregular boundaries.
body:
# McBorder Plugin Documentation

# Region

> Command /mb region-edit-mode can switch to region editing mode

## Usage

> In editing mode, simply input in the following format without adding /
> A region is composed of three or more points and can be configured directly in editing mode
> Region files are located in the region folder of the plugin configuration file

- add
  - Loads the current location into the last edited region node
- save
  - Saves the currently edited region as a configuration file. File name: region_id.yml
- exit
  - Exits editing mode
- tp <index>
  - Teleports to a specific node, you can use look to see all node numbers, tp number to teleport to that node
  - Note: it's a shift, teleport based on your own height, fly higher and then teleport, otherwise you might get stuck in a wall
- look
  - View the currently edited region
- region <id>
  - Switches the currently edited region to an existing one, if the specified id doesn't exist, it creates a new one. Remember to save after changes.
- id <id>
  - Sets the id of the currently edited region, affecting the file name
- display <display>
  - Sets the display name of the currently edited region
- weight <weight>
  - Sets the weight of the currently edited region. When regions overlap, the higher weight is considered the player's location
- world <world>
  - Sets the world of the currently edited region
- insert <index>
  - Inserts the current location as a node at a specific position
- flag <key> <value>
  - Adds a flag to the region
- set <index>
  - Set  the current location into region's nodes
- remove <index>
  - Remove the node from region
- clear
  - Clear now region's nodes


## Flags

- check-perm-move
  - Checks if the player has the specified permission within this node value. If not, it will prevent the player from moving within the region
- check-perm-join
  - Checks if the player has the specified permission within this node value. If not, it will prevent the player from moving into this region
- check-perm-tp-move
  - Similar to the above, but it prevents the player from teleporting within this region to another position in this region
- check-perm-tp-join
  - Similar to the above, prevents teleportation into this region
- deny-to
  - Prohibits movement from this region to other specified regions
  - Format: * indicates no movement to any other region, or specific names can be specified
  - Example: deny-to: "A,B,C,D" prohibits movement from this region to regions with IDs A, B, C, D
- deny-tp-to
  - Prohibits teleportation from this region to other regions, same format as deny-to
- deny-move-message
  - Message displayed when movement within the region is blocked
- deny-join-message
  - Message displayed when entry into this region is blocked
- deny-to-message
  - Message displayed when movement from this region to other regions is blocked
- deny-tp-join-message
  - Message displayed when teleportation into this region is blocked
- deny-tp-to-message
  - Message displayed when teleportation from this region to other regions is blocked

# Variables

- %BorderInfo_BorderSize% | Current world border size
- %BorderInfo_BorderCenterX% | X-coordinate of the current world border center
- %BorderInfo_BorderCenterZ% | Z-coordinate of the current world border center
- %BorderInfo_BorderOutDamage% | Damage value beyond the current world border
- %McBorder_Biome% | Biome of the player's current location
- %BorderInfo_Region_In_RegionID% | Returns whether the player is within the specified region name (returns: true/false)
- %BorderInfo_Region_Name% | Returns the display name of the region where the player is currently located

# Permissions

> McBorder.commandName
> {.is-success}

# Commands

- `/McBorder(mb) help`
  - View plugin help
- `/McBorder(mb) setborder <world> <size> [time]`
  - Set the size of the world border
- `/McBorder(mb) setcenter <world> <x> <z>`
  - Set the center point of the world border
- `/McBorder(mb) setplayer <player> <size> [time]`
  - Set the border size of the world the player is in and center it
- `/McBorder(mb) setplayerworld <player> [size] [world] [time]`
  - Set the border of the world the player is in, with more optional parameters
- `/McBorder(mb) reborder <world>`
  - Reset the border of the specified world
- `/McBorder(mb) replayer <player>`
  - Reset the border of the world the specified player is in
- `/McBorder(mb) setwarning <world> <warningDistance> <warningTime> <bufferDistance> <damageAmount>`
  - Set warning distance, warning time, buffer size, and damage amount beyond the border for a world
- `/McBorder(mb) increase <world> <increaseValue>`
  - Increase the size of the world border
- `/McBorder(mb) reduce <world> <reduceValue>`
  - Reduce the size of the world border
- `/McBorder(mb) getcenter <world>`
  - Get the center coordinates of the specified world
- `/McBorder(mb) getsize <world>`
  - Get the size of the specified world's border
- `/McBorder(mb) rtp <player> <world>`
  - Randomly teleport the specified player within the border of the specified world
- `/McBorder(mb) reload`
  - Reload the plugin
- `/McBorder(mb) upsetting`
  - Update borders via the configuration file
- `/McBorder(mb) region-edit-mode`
  - Enter region editing mode, keywords for region editing can be sent directly during this mode
