title: StatusTag
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that adds customizable status tags to players using Minecraft's scoreboard system.
body:
# Statustag – Fabric Mod

A lightweight Fabric mod that adds customizable status tags to players using Minecraft's scoreboard system.
Below is the English description, followed by the German version.

------------------------------------------------------------
# English
------------------------------------------------------------

## Description

Statustag is a lightweight Fabric mod that allows players and server admins to create custom status tags.
These tags appear as colored prefixes in the player's nametag using Minecraft's scoreboard team system.

All statuses and player assignments are automatically saved in "statustag.json" and restored when the server starts.
The mod supports all Minecraft standard text colors:
black, dark_blue, dark_green, dark_aqua, dark_red, dark_purple, gold, gray, dark_gray, blue, green, aqua, red, light_purple, yellow, white... and more 


## Features

- Create custom status tags
- Assign any tag to yourself or other players
- Choose from all Minecraft formatting colors
- Status tags appear as scoreboard prefixes
- Automatic saving/loading via statustag.json
- Works on servers only
- Fully compatible with other scoreboard systems


## Commands
```
/statusadd <id> <name> <color> - Creates a new status tag (requires permission level 2)
/statusremove <id> - Deletes an existing status (requires permission level 2)
/status <id> - Sets your own status
/status <id> <player> - Sets status for another player (requires permission level 2)
/status reset - Removes your own status
/status reset <player> - Removes another player's status (requires permission level 2)
```

------------------------------------------------------------
# Deutsch
------------------------------------------------------------

## Beschreibung

Statustag ist eine leichte Fabric-Mod, mit der Spieler und Admins eigene Status-Tags erstellen und verwalten können.
Diese Tags erscheinen als farbige Präfixe über dem Spielernamen über das Minecraft-Scoreboard-Team-System.

Alle Status und Spielerzuweisungen werden automatisch in "statustag.json" gespeichert und beim Serverstart geladen.
Die Mod unterstützt alle Minecraft Standardfarben:
black, dark_blue, dark_green, dark_aqua, dark_red, dark_purple, gold, gray, dark_gray, blue, green, aqua, red, light_purple, yellow, white... und mehr


## Funktionen

- Eigene Status-Tags erstellen
- Tags Spielern zuweisen oder entfernen
- Alle Minecraft-Formatierungsfarben verfügbar
- Tags erscheinen als Scoreboard-Präfixe
- Automatisches Speichern/Laden über statustag.json
- Funktioniert nur auf Servern
- Kompatibel mit anderen Scoreboard-Systemen


## Befehle
```
/statusadd <id> <name> <farbe> - Erstellt einen neuen Status (Benötigt Berechtigungsstufe 2)
/statusremove <id> - Löscht einen bestehenden Status (Benötigt Berechtigungsstufe 2)
/status <id> - Setzt deinen eigenen Status
/status <id> <spieler> - Setzt den Status eines anderen Spielers (Benötigt Berechtigungsstufe 2)
/status reset - Entfernt deinen eigenen Status
/status reset <spieler> - Entfernt den Status eines anderen Spielers (Benötigt Berechtigungsstufe 2)
```

title: PacketBlocks
description: A lightweight Spigot/Paper library for creating and managing client-side, packet-based Minecraft blocks.
body:
**PacketBlocks** is a **library** for Spigot/Paper servers that lets you create and manage **client-side blocks**.  

It does **not** do anything on its own — it provides APIs to:  
- Display blocks to specific players without modifying the world  
- Simulate block breaking with drops  
- Manage per-player visibility and metadata  
- Use utilities like bounding boxes and animations  

Perfect for custom maps, minigames, and advanced server features.  

📖 Full instructions and API usage are available in the [GitHub README](https://github.com/BitByLogics/PacketBlocks).  
🌐 API documentation (Javadocs): [https://bitbylogics.github.io/PacketBlocks/](https://bitbylogics.github.io/PacketBlocks/)

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)

- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

title: Better Craftable Gunpowder & more
description: Adds realistic, easy farmable new gunpowder recipe to the game as well as some minor new features. See all in the mods description.
body:
# Craft Gunpowder easily!
This Mod introduces a simple crafting recipe for vanilla gunpowder with just 3 ingredients.
The crafting recipe is **inspired by the real life** and how gunpowder is really made.

![The new crafting recipe for gunpowder](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32e429afeb9422c186b4a466f00c59da91e26827.png)

With a Piglin Bartering station and a simple blaze farm, this should be no problem at all.
## But wait, there is more:
This Mod introduces a new fuel item made from 4 gunpowder which burns for 30 seconds at a time!

![Crafting recipe for the better gunpowder fuel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e1de757819e22ea3c9371cd02b5a65697e42e87.png)
![The Better Gunpowder can be used to smelt for 30 seconds with just one single item!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5cec15c2d7e18a5315dfc51f1b79212949a486c5.png)

And you also can always **craft it back into regular gunpowder**. Usefull for item management or if you want to store your gunpowder more compact. For example at a gunpowder farm to prevent chests to fill too fast.

![Better Gunpowder being crafted back into regular minecraft gunpowder](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70210886dc52ef727b36808ffffffeba7a75074f.png)

## And there is even more:
You now can craft cheaper explosives with the new **Explosive Barrels**! Perfect for pirate themed builds as a dangerous decoration.

![Explosive Barrel crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b47154d4aaea45fc4ac1fc676de9db068ceb3d9e.png)
![Explosive Barrel in players inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14fbeb98d2c237f0946b155d985095695e9f3bd0.png)

You can light the Explosive Barrel in any way that you would do a normal TNT _(redstone, flame arrows, TNT explosion, flint and steel...)_

![Explosive Barrel from Better Craftable Gunpowder before exploding](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aafdf43877cd5b9f8cc94373edd668efbac278e1_0.webp)
![Explosive Barrel from Better Craftable Gunpowder after exploding (1.21.10)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a537c17306a83144853cefec3c0a8867c706a663.png)

_(Right now, the Explosive Barrel is just an extention of the TntBlock.class, feel free to make changes to this mod. The repository is on my GitHub (link in mod-menu))_

title: Lazuli
description: A personal library mod aiming to make modding less tedious.
body:
# Lazuli
Lazuli is a personal library mod made to make modding a little less tedious. This library is the culmination of all the foundational and API code that I wrote for my mods. I started to dislike having to rewrite it all every time, so I decided that it's time to make Yet Another Library Mod. You're welcome modpackers, now you'll have one extra mod to pad your mod counts with to make your modpacks look larger than they are :3 ## "Features" Lazuli ultimately boils down to tons of helper functions, and there are *quite a lot* of them at that. Here are the "highlights" or "interesting" things (I guess). - Blocks - Generic "block with entity" helpers (`AbstractBlockWithEntity`) - Energy-capable BE helpers (`IEnergyBE`, `AbstractEnergyBE`, `AbstractCapacitorBE`, `AbstractGeneratorBE`) - Inventory-capable BE helpers (`IInventoryBE`, `AbstractInventoryBE`) - Fluid-capable BE helpers (`IFluidBE`, `AbstractSingleTankBE`) - "Zoned" block entities, ripped from Minefactorial (`IZonedBE`) - Client Things - Particle helpers - A 2D particle engine for GUIs or wherever else you want to use them (`IParticleEngine2D`, `ScreenParticleEngine2D`) - Screen Helpers - Crafting - Ingredients/outputs for in-world blocks, entities, item entities, and fluids - Collections (a more flexible `WeightedRandomList` implementation, `HistoryList`) - Colours (`UnpackedColour`, `ColourPalette`) - Energy (`LazuliEnergyStorage`, `ProtectiveEnergyStorage`) - Fluids - Inventories (`ContainerUtils`, `RoundRobinInventory`, `GhostStackHandler`) - Items (`GhostItemStack`) - Mathematics (`CubicBezier`, `QuadraticBezier`) - Menus (`AbstractBlockEntityContainer`, `GhostSlot`, `SlotOutputOnly`) - Misc helpers (`TickScheduler`) - World helpers (`AABBHelpers`, `FakePlayerHelpers`, `Raycasting`) ## Usage Lazuli is extensively documented using Javadocs. I also publish source and Javadoc JARs for you to include via Gradle. To add Lazuli to your project, just add it as a `modImplementation` in Gradle: ```kts // Applies to all Gradle plugins repositories { // Modrinth maven is the easiest and most reliable place for me to publish at the moment. // I publish sources and JavaDocs here too. exclusiveContent { forRepository { maven("https://api.modrinth.com/maven") } filter { includeGroup("maven.modrinth") } } } dependencies { // Loom and Architectury Loom modImplementation("maven.modrinth:lazuli:VERSION") } ```

title: RoyalBattle
description: RoyalBattle is an advanced plugin for organizing large-scale PvP events in the style of "Battle Royale" on the Minecraft server. The plugin automates all stages of the game: from preparing and filling chests to determining the winner and managing the game
body:
_If you don't understand how the plugin works, go to the [WIKI](https://t.me/zdev_wiki)._

_**RoyalBattle is a plugin for conducting royal battles on your Minecraft server**_

**RoyalBattle is an advanced plugin for organizing large-scale PvP events in the style of "Battle Royale" on the Minecraft server. The plugin automates all stages of the game: from preparing and filling chests to determining the winner and managing the game stages.**

**Main functions**

**Full event automation:**

_The plugin itself controls the stages of the game: preparation, banning PvP, the main battle, narrowing the barrier, determining the winner._

**Synchronous filling of chests:**

_Quickly and safely fill chests with loot, taking into account chunks, delays and progress through BossBar. Support for setting the value of items for the center of the map._

**Flexible timer settings:**

_All timings (preparation, PvP ban, main game, barrier compression) are configured in config.yml._

**Barrier Management:**

_The barrier automatically starts to shrink after a set time, forcing the players to get closer._

**The participant system:**

_Only online players become participants at the time of the launch. New players are observers after the start. The Alive status persists even after logging out._

**Restrictions on breaking blocks:**

_Do not break blocks during preparation. After that, only those defined from the config, then any._

**PvP and immortality:**

_After preparing for 30 minutes, you cannot attack the players. After using the totem of immortality, the player becomes vulnerable._

**Localization:**

_All messages are rendered in lang.yml is easy to translate to your server._

**Logging and saving:**

_All information about the state of the game, the participants and the winner is saved between restarts. The winner is recorded in a separate win.yml file._

**How to set up**

Copy the jar file to the plugins folder of your server.
Restart the server and the config.yml, lang.yml, and win files will appear.yml and others.
Configure the parameters in config.yml:
Stage timers (game.timers)

**The list of allowed blocks to be broken**

Barrier Settings
Chest and Loot Settings
Translate or modify the messages in lang.yml if necessary.
Check your rights and grant the necessary permissions to the players/admins.
Use commands to control the game and loot.

**Why choose RoyalBattle?**

**Maximum automation** — does not require manual control of the stages.
**Flexible configuration** — suitable for servers of any size and style.
**Security and performance** — asynchronous processes do not load the server.
****Localization support** — adapts easily to any language.
Transparency** — all information about the winners and the course of the game is preserved.

**_RoyalBattle is an ideal choice for servers that want to host spectacular and honest PvP events with minimal effort on the part of the administration!_**

title: Legacy Clouds
description: A resource pack that brings back the clouds texture prior to 1.21.6
body:
Legacy Clouds is a simple resource pack that brings back the clouds texture prior to 1.21.6. This resource pack is for you if you want your gameplay to feel more nostalgic!

## Version format
Take this for example: **63.0**

**63** is the latest supported Minecraft's resource pack version. You can view it by looking at [this version.](https://misode.github.io/versions/?id=1.21.6-pre3)

**0** is the patch number where there is an update for the resource pack, but Minecraft's resource pack version doesn't change.

Usually, no matter the resource pack version, the minimum resource pack version will be **62**, equivalent to **25w21a**, the version where the clouds texture was changed.

title: Creaking Potion
description: Adds a new potion effect that temporarily makes an entity get immobilized like the Creaking
body:
### What does this mod do?
This mods adds two new potion effects, Stun and Dormant Stun. Only Dormant Stun is accessible without commands, and can be made by brewing a Resin Clump and water bottles in a brewing stand. This Potion of Dormant Stun can also be made into splash potions, lingering potions and tipped arrows.

### How does the stun work?
When an entity has the Dormant Stun effect, and the player who gave the effect looks at that entity they can't move until either the effect wears off or the player looks away. Note that this only works once, if the player looks away they can't be stunned again unless Dormant Stun is applied again.

### Wow, that sounds really cool! How do I get this mod?
The only requirement for this mod is [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), so just download that along with this mod and drop them both in your mods folder.

### Found a bug or want to suggest a feature?
Please head over to the [Github](https://github.com/Spyxar/CreakingPotion/issues) and make an issue.

# Squaremap - SimpleClans

This plugin integrates [SimpleClans](https://github.com/RoinujNosde/SimpleClans) with [Squaremap](https://github.com/jpenilla/squaremap).

## Features

- Displays clan bases on your map, with the clan's name and tag, in each world.
- Automatically updates the map every 5 minutes.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release from the [releases page](https://github.com/AkselGlyholt/Squaremap-SimpleClans/releases).
2. Place the downloaded file in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.

## Configuration

title: Dragon Trail
description: A simple plugin that adds a cool trail to the ender dragon.
body:
# Dragon Trail

![Modrinth Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/dfk4v4Y2?style=for-the-badge&label=Latest%20Version)

## Description

DragonTrailPlugin is a **plugin** that enhances the Minecraft experience by adding an **epic dragon-themed particle trail** behind every dragon in the world. The plugin continuously generates a **dense and extensive particle trail** as the dragon moves, mimicking the breath and energy of a dragon in flight. This creates a dynamic, magical effect that can be seen as the dragon flies through the world.

Additionally, this plugin provides a **command to toggle** the particle trail on or off, allowing server admins or players to manage the effect and optimize server performance. When enabled, the trail creates a constantly flowing pattern of particles following the dragon, ensuring that the action always feels immersive and visually exciting.

## Key Features
- **Dragon Particle Trail**: Adds a continuous, detailed dragon breath particle trail following each dragon in the world.
- **Toggler Command**: Use the `/toggledragontrail` command to turn the particle effect on or off, giving full control over whether the trail is active.
- **Automatic Activation**: The trail automatically activates for any dragon in the world, creating a seamless visual experience.
- **Performance Optimization**: Toggle the trail to reduce lag during high-traffic times on your server.
- **Works on All Dragons**: The plugin works with all dragon entities in Minecraft, creating a consistent effect across your world.

## Commands
- `/toggledragontrail`: Toggle the dragon particle trail effect on or off.  
  - **Usage**: `/toggledragontrail`
  - **Permissions**: Default: all players

## Installation
1. Download the `DragonTrail.jar` file.
2. Place the `.jar` file in your server's `/plugins` directory.
3. Restart or reload the server.
4. The plugin will now automatically generate a particle trail for all dragons in the world.

## Requirements
- Minecraft Server running **Bukkit/Paper/Purpur/Spigot 1.21+** or higher.
- **No additional dependencies** required.

# The Automaton
_"A moving mechanical device made in imitation of a human being. A bug in your system has caused you to gain sentience! You can reprogram yourself to perform actions while idle!"_
`Made for Fabric, Minecraft version 1.20.2, Origins version 1.12.10 impact: 1, Icon: Redstone Lamp`

### "The Script":
_"Edit your Script with ["Primary Active"] while holding a Paper, and then press ["Primary Active"] without holding it to Run it!"_
- [+] Fully Editable Script with 54 Slots!
- [+] Some of the Usable Items are visible ingame in The Origins GUI!

### "Overclock CPU":
_"Speed up your CPU by pressing ["Secondary Active"], or press ["Secondary Active"] while Sneaking to slow down!"_
- [+] Control how fast you want to follow the Script!
- [+] From 20 Actions per Second at fastest rate down to 0.2 Actions per Second (1 action per 5 seconds)!

### "Fuel Tank":
_"To run Your Script for one Cycle requires Fuel! Open up your Fuel Tank by holding a Furnace in your Mainhand and pressing ["Primary Active"]!_
 - One piece of Wood Log will give you fuel enough for 15 Cycles, Coal for 80, Blaze Rod for 120, Dried Kelp block for 700, Coal Block for 800, Lava bucket for 1000.
- Your fuel tank is a separate inventory with 5 slots, and it can handle multiple fuel sources, and it will deplete them in order of Best Fuel Source (as in, Lava first, Wood Last)
- One Cycle = One Script Loop

_Origin by Frucs!_

- Potato = Rotate down

- Lime Dye = Rotate left

- Sugar = Speed up CPU

title: Phoenix Feather Wand (Harry's Wand)
description: Resource pack for a wand with a phoenix feather. (Requires Optifine)
body:
This resource pack allows you to turn an ordinary stick into a Harry Potter wand simply by renaming it on an anvil. At first glance the wand looks shabby and dirty, but this is explained in these lines from the book Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire - *Harry glanced at his wand. She was all covered with gouges and fingerprints. He secretly tried to wipe the wand...*. The resource pack contains two types of wands: a regular version and a wand with the Incendio spell. To get a regular magic wand, take a regular stick and change its name to magic wand with the Incendio spell, take a torch and change its name to Incendio Wand. To get a Incendio Wand !![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/205a73e0b2d92402d2ea3deba020e0be8d3cfe2b.png)(the texture of the torch as a block will remain the same). The second wand goes well with the Dynamic Lighting mod, because then the wand really emits light like a torch. For now, the resource pack requires optifine and cannot work without it. But I'm going to make a version for fabric (you'll need Cit Resevn) and a version that will simply replace the textures of the stick and torch with magic wands. Also, the Incendio Wand has a broken texture, just one black cube, but it's a bit noticeable. If I have time, I'll try to fix the texture. I would be very grateful if you supported the project and me with a donation. Thank you all for your attention.

title: Minecraft Flex UI
description: Implement a Flex layout-based Minecraft GUI framework based on facebook's open source Yoga layout engine.
body:
# Minecraft Flex UI

# For ordinary players do not download the mod
In most cases the module is used by other module developers and is included in their mod Jar package

# Description
Based on `facebook` open source `Yoga` layout engine implements the `Minecraft` GUI framework based on the `Flex` layout.

A subset of the `Flex` standard is implemented on top of `Yoga` and most of the `CSS` properties are implemented as well.

The design concept of `MVC` is adopted to realize the one-way and two-way data binding.

Developers can design and implement complex UI interfaces on top of this, and this project can be used as `Yoga` engine embedded in the game as a non-exhaustive reference implementation of the game layout engine.

# Example

![example](https://github.com/moheng233/MFUI/raw/master/doc/example.gif)

```java
public class WidgetTestScreen extends WidgetScreen {
	protected StringBuilderObservable text = new StringBuilderObservable();

	public WidgetTestScreen() {
		super(Text.of("test"));
	}

	@Override
	public void widget(ScreenWidget root) {
		root.flexDirection.set(WidgetFlexDirection.Row)
				.justifyContent.set(WidgetJustify.Center)
				.alignItems.set(WidgetAlign.Center)
				.child(new BoxWidget()
						.background.set(RectDrawable.LIGHT_PANEL)
						.child(new LabelWidget()
								.text.binding(text.computed((StringBuilderObservable text) -> Text.of(text.getString())))
								.margin(WidgetEdge.All, 4))
						.child(new TextBoxWidget()
								.text.binding(text))
						.child(new ButtonWidget()
								.click.on((mouse) -> close())
								.child(new LabelWidget()
										.text.set(Text.of("取消"))))
				);
	}
}

```

# Data Binding
By default all bindings from `non-computed binding sources` are `bi-directional bindings`.
> Setting values for `computed binding sources` is ignored

**But most components will only operate `one-way` on bound values**

title: Beilin Entry Control
description: A Fabric server-side mod for Beilin Entry Control, designed for Beiyue member servers.
body:
## English Description
Beilin Entry Control is a Fabric server-side mod designed for Beiyue member servers.

This mod validates player access by communicating with the Beiyue API (beiyue.us). Players without permission or with active restrictions will be denied entry.

### Features
- Unified access control via Beiyue API
- Real-time ban and permission updates via WebSocket
- No persistent side effects (memory-only operations, no modification to other mods or game files)

### Requirements
- Beiyue member server access
- Fabric server with Fabric API installed
- Valid API key provided by Beiyue

This project is primarily intended for Chinese users.

---

## Beilin Entry Control（北约统一入服控制系统）

Beilin Entry Control 配套的 Fabric 服务端模组，面向 **北约成员服**。本模组通过与 beiyue.us 通信校验玩家权限、验证北约入服权。

本项目同时包含 Beilin Data Portability 附属模组。若需要建筑数据导出功能，请另见 [Beilin Data Portability](https://modrinth.com/mod/beilin-data-portability)。

---

### 功能概览

- **统一入服控制**\
  玩家进入服务器时，模组会向 `beiyue.us` 发起权限校验请求。若玩家未获批北约入服权，或存在一项/多项禁令，服务器将拒绝进入。

- **跨服禁令即时生效**\
  模组通过 **WebSocket** 持续同步状态。即使玩家已进入服务器，一旦权限变化相关限制也会立即生效。

- **网络高可用保障**\
  系统采用 **主从节点架构** 保障状态同步稳定性。WebSocket 主路径异常时，模组会自动切换至备用路径；若主、备路径同时失联，服务器将判定同步失效并清理所有在线玩家，确保禁令一旦下达立即生效。

- **无持久化副作用**
  - 所有逻辑仅在内存中运行；
  - 仅读取本模组自身的配置文件；
  - 不会修改其他模组或 Minecraft 的配置；
  - 移除本模组后，服务器将立即恢复为原版逻辑。

---

### 前置条件

在安装和使用本模组之前，请确保满足以下条件：

- **北约成员服务器身份**\
  本模组仅对北约成员服务器开放使用权限，非成员服务器暂不提供支持。

- **Minecraft 服务端环境**\
  服务器需运行 **Fabric 服务端**，并已正确安装 **Fabric API**，以确保模组能够正常加载和运行。

- **API 凭据获取**\
  该模组需要有效的 API 凭据。请向 Narek 获取专用的 `apiKey`，并按照配置说明将其添加至服务器配置文件中。

---

### 安装步骤

1. **搭建 Fabric 服务端**
   - 使用官方 Fabric Installer 搭建 Fabric 服务端。
2. **放入模组文件**
   - 将本模组的 `.jar` 文件放入服务器根目录下的 `mods` 文件夹。
3. **首次启动服务器**
   - 启动一次服务器，使模组完成初始化；
   - 此时会在 `config` 目录下生成配置文件 `beilin-entry-control.json`。
4. **停止服务器**
   - 关闭服务器进程，以便编辑配置文件。

---

### 配置说明

配置文件路径：`config/beilin-entry-control.json`

示例内容（仅示例，实际以生成文件为准）：

```json
{
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE",
  "baseHost": "beiyue.us",
  "wsBackupDnsHost": "saas.wiki-beilin.org",
  "wsPrimaryProbeIntervalSec": 10,
  "useHttps": true,
  "useWss": true
}
```

- **`apiKey`（必填）**
  - 向 Narek 申请获得的 API 密钥；
  - 首次生成时为占位值 `"YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"`，请务必替换；
  - 若缺失或为空，本模组会认为配置无效，拒绝正常工作。

- **`baseHost`**
  - 与 API 通信的主机名；
  - 默认值为 `"beiyue.us"`；
  - 仅在特殊环境（如内网、测试环境）需要修改。

- **`wsBackupDnsHost`**
  - WebSocket 备用路径使用的 DNS 主机名；
  - 默认值为 `"saas.wiki-beilin.org"`；
  - 仅在特殊环境（如内网、测试环境）需要修改。

- **`wsPrimaryProbeIntervalSec`**
  - 当 WebSocket 处于备用路径时，探测主路径恢复的间隔秒数；
  - 默认值为 `10`；
  - 通常无需修改。

- **`useHttps`**
  - 是否通过 `https://` 访问 HTTP API；
  - 仅在特殊环境（如内网、测试环境）需要修改。

- **`useWss`**
  - 是否通过 `wss://` 使用 WebSocket；
  - 仅在特殊环境（如内网、测试环境）需要修改。

修改完成后，保存配置文件，然后重新启动服务器。

---

### 服务器白名单设置

本模组不会修改任何原版或 Fabric 白名单配置，**需要服务器管理员手动调整白名单策略**：

- 若希望 **仅通过 Beilin Entry Control 控制入服**：
  - 请在 `server.properties` 中将 `white-list` 设为 `false`；
  - 或通过你习惯的方式关闭原版白名单；
  - 实际入服权限由 beiyue.us 决定。

- 若仍需 **配合原版白名单一起使用**：
  - 也可以保留白名单开启状态；
  - 此时入服需要同时满足「持有有效的北约入服权」与「在服务器白名单中」两个条件。

---

### 与 Portability 附属模组共存

[Beilin Data Portability](https://modrinth.com/mod/beilin-data-portability) 是本项目的附属模组，用于建筑数据可携带导出。它会复用 Beilin Entry Control 的 API 凭据和 WebSocket 推送通道，但不会替代入服控制逻辑。

- 若只需要统一入服控制，仅安装 Beilin Entry Control 即可。
- 若需要建筑导出功能，请同时安装 Beilin Entry Control 与 Beilin Data Portability。
- Portability 的配置、索引存储、导出流程与运维命令请查看 [Beilin Data Portability](https://modrinth.com/mod/beilin-data-portability)。

---

### 升级与移除

- **升级模组**
  - 停止服务器；
  - 替换 `mods` 目录中的旧版本 `.jar` 为新版本；
  - 保留原有的 `config/beilin-entry-control.json`，通常无需更改；
  - 重新启动服务器即可。

- **移除模组**
  - 停止服务器；
  - 从 `mods` 目录中删除本模组 `.jar` 文件；
  - 重新启动服务器；
  - 此时服务器将恢复为 **原版入服逻辑**，不再访问 beiyue.us API。

> 提示：如不再使用本模组，可根据需要手动删除 `config/beilin-entry-control.json`，这不会影响其他配置或存档。若服务器同时安装了 Beilin Data Portability，请一并参考 [Beilin Data Portability](https://modrinth.com/mod/beilin-data-portability) 中的移除说明。

---

### 安全性与透明度说明

- 本模组仅在内存中处理入服逻辑与事件，不主动写入任何数据文件。
- 不会修改其他模组或 Minecraft 的配置文件，也不会改动世界存档结构。
- 所有与 beiyue.us 的通信仅围绕入服控制、状态同步和导出任务推送相关接口进行。
- 本模组会为 Beilin Data Portability 转发导出任务推送，但不会自行记录建筑数据或生成导出文件。

如有任何其他疑问，请联系 Narek。

title: Login Music
description: A simple Minecraft mod that can play music when players join in the world.
body:
A simple Minecraft mod that can play music when players join in the world.

> This mod uses AI to assist in development.
>
> Inspired by TartaricAcid's [Net Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/net-music) !

| Milestone | Big changes                                                                                  |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1.1.0     | javafx has given place to `com.googlecode.soundlibs:mp3spi`, which provides MP3 support now. |
| 1.2.0     | the music config has changed to JSON type.                                                   |
| 1.2.1     | Music can be played directly through the Internet without downloading; lyrics support!       |
| 1.2.2     | Audio backend loading, Players can receive audio from other players on the server.           |                                                                                          |

The logo comes from [here](https://www.flaticon.com/free-icon/music_9325026?term=music&page=1&position=87&origin=search&related_id=9325026), designed by juicy_fish.

## Functions

- Play music
- Supported file types: mp3, wav
- Music Downloading screen
- Allow download switch
- Play different musics based on the player's name (uuid)
- Show lyrics while playing music

## File Structure

> **Destructive changes**: 
> 
> Since mod version 1.2.5, the config file's storage has been changed! If you upgrade from previous version, please move them to the new place!

All music files are stored in the `/data/login_music` folder.

```
{version folder}
├── config
│   ├── login_music-music.json      # Specific musics
│   └── login_music-client.toml     # Client config    
│
├── data/login_music        # Store music files
│   ├── MusicsCache
│   │   ├── music_1.mp3
│   │   ├── music_2.wav
│   │   └── ...
│   └── LyricsCache   
│       ├── music_1.lrc
│       ├── music_2.lrc
│       └── ...
└── ...
```

## Configuration

### Music Config JSON

**Since mod version 1.2.0, the music config has changed to JSON type, just as shown below.**

If you enter a server with this mod, the config file on the server has higher priority, which will cover your custom settings.

```json
{
    "musics": [
        {
            "id": "Default",
            "music": "Default.mp3",
            "musicUrl": "https://www.example.com/example.mp3",
            "lyric": "Default.lrc",
            "lyricUrl": "https://www.example.com/example.lrc" 
        }, {
            "id": "Steve",
            "music": "login_music.mp3",
            "musicUrl": "https://www.example.com/login_music.mp3",
            "lyric": "login_music.lrc",
            "lyricUrl": "https://www.example.com/login_music.lrc"
        }
    ]
}
```

> The music will be downloaded if `InternetAccess` is set `true` (the default setting is `false`), otherwise, the music is played through network audio streams, which may cause a short pause when entering a world.

For example, When a player named Steve enters the world, the mod will try to find the music matched the name `Steve` (in this case it's `login_music.mp3` ) in the folder `/LoginMusic` first.
Then try to download it from its related url if it has failed before.

> Tips: If there is a file with the same name in the folder, it will skip the download even if the file does not match the URL.

If more entries need to be configured, please follow the JSON's rule.

Since mod version 1.2.4, you can open Login Music Config from the main menu if `Cloth Config API` has been installed.

### Client Side

`login_music-client.toml` is effective only for the client:

```toml
[Lyrics]
    #Whether to show lyrics while playing music
    ShowLyrics = true
    #Defines the position of the lyrics
    #Allowed Values: UP, MIDDLE, DOWN
    LyricsPosition = "DOWN"
    #Defines the color of the lyrics you want to use
    LyricsColor = 16777215

[Music]
    #Range of music play (a non negative integer)
    # Default: 3
    # Range: 0 ~ 100
    range = 3
    #Whether to allow downloading music from the internet
    InternetAccess = false
    #Whether to play musics from other players
    AllowOthersMusic = true
```

### Server Side

`login_music-server.toml`:

```toml
[Selection]
    #Keywords for music selection (name/uuid)
    #Allowed Values: NAME, UUID
    type = "NAME"
```

## Command

All the commands need permission level 2.

| Command                           | Function                              |
|-----------------------------------|---------------------------------------|

title: Disenchant to Book
description: Disenchant to Book adds a simple inventory UI (default key: ') for moving enchantments onto books without typing commands. Click enchanted gear to pull selected enchants onto a blank book, or split enchanted books into separate volumes.
body:
# Disenchant to Book

Move enchantments from your gear onto books — right from your inventory.

Press **`'`** (apostrophe) to open a simple screen that looks like your inventory. Click an enchanted item, pick which enchantments you want, and pull them off into an enchanted book.

Works on tools, weapons, armor, and enchanted books that have **more than one** enchantment.

---

## What you can do

- **Take enchants off gear** — Select enchantments on a sword, pickaxe, armor piece, etc. They move onto a blank book in your inventory. You need at least one blank book for this.
- **Split an enchanted book** — If a book has two or more enchantments, you can move some of them onto a **new** enchanted book. At least one enchant must stay on the original book. You need an empty inventory slot for the new book. Books with only one enchantment cannot be split.
- **See what counts** — Enchanted items light up; plain items are dimmed so you know what to click.
- **Choose exactly what to move** — Click individual enchantments in the list before you extract.
- **Change the key** — Default is **`'`**. Rebind in **Controls → Disenchant to Book**, or in **Mod Menu** if you use it.

---

## How to use it

1. Press **`'`** to open the screen.
2. Click an enchanted item.
3. Click the enchantments you want to move.
4. **Gear:** keep a blank book in your inventory.
5. **Enchanted book (2+ enchants):** leave an empty slot for the new book, and do not select every enchant — one must stay behind.
6. Click **Extract to Book**.

You can still use normal inventory keys while the screen is open (drop items, move to hotbar, and so on).

---

## What you need

**Permissions:** You need permission to use cheats — **op level 2** on a server, or cheats turned on in single-player.

**Items:**
- **From gear:** at least one blank book.
- **From an enchanted book:** an empty slot for the new book, and the source book must keep at least one enchantment.

**Mods (required):**
- Minecraft **26.1.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.2** or newer

**Optional:** Mod Menu — for changing the keybind in the mod list.

---

## Single-player vs multiplayer

**Single-player:** Install the mod on your client. With cheats on, it just works — nothing shows up in chat.

**Multiplayer (best):** Put the same mod on the **server** and on **every player’s client** who will use it. Extracts happen quietly with no chat spam.

**Multiplayer (client only):** If the server does not have the mod, your client will run game commands instead. You will see those in chat, and you still need op level 2.

---

## Installation

1. Install **Fabric** and **Fabric API** for Minecraft 26.1.2.
2. Drop `disenchant_to_book-<version>.jar` into your client’s `mods` folder.
3. **Optional for multiplayer:** Add the same jar (and Fabric API) to the server’s `mods` folder and restart the server.

Players who use the screen still need the mod on their own game, even if the server has it.

Adds two gamerules to enable and control vanilla sapling growth.
This mod is only intended to be used to restore vanilla sapling growth when playing with other mods or datapacks that override the default `minecraft/worldgen/configured_feature`s for trees.

- `/gamerule doVanillaTreeGrowthAlways [true/false]`

- `/gamerule doDispensersForceVanillaTreeGrowth [true/false]`
  - Default Value: `true`
  - if `true`, if there is a Dispenser block adjacent to a sapling when it grows, it will use the vanilla tree generator. If there is not a dispenser, it will use the behavior defined in gamerule `doVanillaTreeGrowthAlways`

title: VeilMineX
description: It helps by adding Anti cheat and Anti Xray to your server to prevent cheating and xraying, You need protocol lib to be added to your plugin folder too.
body:
# VeilMineX

**VeilMineX** is a server-side Minecraft protection plugin built for server owners who want **Anti-Xray**, **mining intelligence**, and **lightweight anti-cheat tools** in one clean plugin.

It helps protect your server economy by hiding valuable blocks from X-ray users, tracking suspicious mining patterns, detecting impossible block interactions, and giving staff a simple dashboard to monitor alerts and player activity.

VeilMineX is designed for **Paper, Spigot, Purpur, and Folia-style servers**, with support planned for modern Minecraft versions including **1.20.x**, **1.21.x**, and **26.1.2**. It is built for **Java 17+** servers.

---

## Features

### Anti-Xray Protection

VeilMineX can hide valuable blocks from X-ray resource packs and hacked clients using packet-based obfuscation.

Supported protection ideas include:

* Ore hiding
* Fake block replacement
* Per-world Anti-Xray profiles
* Nether and Overworld protection
* Hidden chest/barrel/spawner support
* Proximity-based reveal
* Configurable reveal radius
* Round reveal mode using sphere distance
* Safe fallback if packet support is unavailable

The plugin does **not permanently change your world blocks**. It only changes what each player sees.

---

## Mining Intelligence

VeilMineX does more than just hide ores. It also watches for suspicious mining behavior.

It can track:

* High-value ore mining rate
* Diamond and ancient debris patterns
* Direct tunnel-to-ore behavior
* Suspicious ore ratios
* Mining reach problems
* Through-wall mining attempts
* Fast break or nuker-like behavior

This helps staff investigate possible X-ray users instead of relying only on instant bans.

---

## Lightweight Anti-Cheat Checks

VeilMineX includes lightweight checks focused mainly on mining and block interaction.

Included check types:

* Mining reach
* Mining angle
* Fast break
* Nuker
* Fast place
* Scaffold
* Ghost hand
* Ore path analysis
* Basic speed sanity
* Basic fly sanity
* NoFall sanity

By default, VeilMineX is designed to be **conservative**. It logs and alerts first instead of instantly banning players.

---

## Web Admin Panel

VeilMineX includes an optional web panel for server administrators.

The web panel can show:

* Online players
* Recent alerts
* Player suspicion scores
* Violation history
* Anti-Xray status
* Cache statistics
* Mining reports
* Compatibility status
* Enabled checks
* Plugin settings

Default web panel settings:

```yml
host: 127.0.0.1
port: 8765
```

The admin token is generated on first startup. Check your console or `plugins/VeilMineX/web.yml`.

For security, the web panel is local-only by default. Change the host manually only if you know what you are doing.

---

## Compatibility

VeilMineX is designed for:

* Paper
* Spigot
* Purpur
* Folia-style servers
* Minecraft 1.20.x
* Minecraft 1.21.x
* Minecraft 26.1.2
* Java 17+

Optional plugin support:

* ProtocolLib
* PlaceholderAPI
* LuckPerms
* DiscordSRV
* Floodgate / Geyser
* ViaVersion
* CoreProtect

**Note:** Packet-based Anti-Xray requires ProtocolLib or another supported packet provider. If no packet provider is installed, VeilMineX will still load, but Anti-Xray packet hiding will be disabled.

---

## Commands

### Main Commands

```text
/veilmine
```

Shows the main help menu.

```text
/veilmine status
```

Shows plugin status, Anti-Xray status, anti-cheat status, web panel status, cache information, and loaded modules.

```text
/veilmine reload
```

Reloads configuration files safely.

```text
/veilmine compat
```

Shows server compatibility information, including Minecraft version, Java version, server type, packet provider, and enabled features.

```text
/veilmine panic
```

Toggles panic mode. Panic mode disables punishments but keeps logging and alerts active.

---

### Alert Commands

```text
/veilmine alerts
```

Toggles staff alerts for yourself.

```text
/veilmine verbose
```

Toggles verbose alert mode.

---

### Player Investigation Commands

```text
/veilmine inspect <player>
```

Opens a player inspection GUI with violation history, mining data, suspicion score, and recent alerts.

```text
/veilmine report <player>
```

Generates a mining and violation report for a player.

```text
/veilmine clearvl <player> [check]
```

Clears a player’s violation level. You can clear all checks or only one specific check.

```text
/veilmine exempt <player> <seconds> <reason>
```

Temporarily exempts a player from checks. Useful for testing, staff actions, or custom events.

---

### Anti-Xray Commands

```text
/veilmine antixray test
```

Runs an Anti-Xray diagnostic test. It checks packet support, hidden blocks, replacement palettes, world height, invalid materials, cache status, and reveal settings.

```text
/veilmine cache clear
```

Clears the Anti-Xray cache.

```text
/veilmine cache stats
```

Shows cache hit rate, cache size, and obfuscation performance.

---

### Web Panel Commands

```text
/veilmine web status
```

Shows whether the web panel is running.

```text
/veilmine web url
```

Shows the local web panel URL.

```text
/veilmine web token
```

Regenerates the admin web token.

```text
/veilmine web restart
```

Restarts the web panel safely.

---

### Debug Commands

```text
/veilmine debug chunk
```

Shows Anti-Xray debug information for the chunk you are standing in.

```text
/veilmine debug compatibility
```

Shows detailed compatibility debug information.

---

## Permissions

```text
veilmine.admin
```

Gives access to all admin features.

```text
veilmine.command
```

Allows use of the main command.

```text
veilmine.status
```

Allows `/veilmine status`.

```text
veilmine.reload
```

Allows `/veilmine reload`.

```text
veilmine.compat
```

Allows `/veilmine compat`.

```text
veilmine.alerts
```

Allows receiving staff alerts.

```text
veilmine.verbose
```

Allows verbose alert mode.

```text
veilmine.inspect
```

Allows inspecting players.

```text
veilmine.report
```

Allows generating player reports.

```text
veilmine.cache
```

Allows cache commands.

```text
veilmine.web
```

Allows web panel commands.

```text
veilmine.web.token
```

Allows viewing or regenerating the web panel token.

```text
veilmine.exempt
```

Allows temporary player exemptions.

```text
veilmine.clearvl
```

Allows clearing violation levels.

```text
veilmine.debug
```

Allows debug commands.

---

## Bypass Permissions

```text
veilmine.bypass
```

Bypasses all VeilMineX checks.

```text
veilmine.bypass.antixray
```

Bypasses Anti-Xray protection.

```text
veilmine.bypass.anticheat
```

Bypasses anti-cheat checks.

```text
veilmine.bypass.mining-reach
```

Bypasses mining reach checks.

```text
veilmine.bypass.fast-break
```

Bypasses fast break checks.

```text
veilmine.bypass.nuker
```

Bypasses nuker checks.

```text
veilmine.bypass.proximity
```

Bypasses proximity reveal restrictions.

```text
veilmine.staff.see-real-blocks
```

Allows trusted staff to see real hidden blocks if enabled in config.

---

## Configuration

VeilMineX includes several configuration files:

```text
config.yml
```

Main plugin settings.

```text
messages.yml
```

Custom messages and colors.

```text
checks.yml
```

Anti-cheat check settings.

```text
web.yml
```

Web panel settings.

```text
logs/
```

Violation and mining logs.

```text
reports/
```

Generated player reports.

---

## Default Safety

VeilMineX is not designed to instantly ban players by default.

Default behavior:

* Low suspicion: log only
* Medium suspicion: staff alert
* High suspicion: cancel suspicious action
* Very high suspicion: optional punishment if configured

This makes the plugin safer for survival servers, SMPs, economy servers, and public communities where false positives must be avoided.

---

## Installation

1. Download the VeilMineX jar.
2. Place it inside your server’s `plugins` folder.
3. Install ProtocolLib if you want packet-based Anti-Xray.
4. Restart the server.
5. Run:

```text
/veilmine status
```

6. Run:

```text
/veilmine antixray test
```

7. Edit the config files if needed.
8. Use the web panel or commands to monitor alerts.

---

## Important Notes

VeilMineX is designed to make X-ray and suspicious mining much harder, but no Anti-Xray or anti-cheat plugin should be called “unbypassable.”

For best protection, use VeilMineX together with:

* Good staff moderation
* Backups
* CoreProtect or another rollback plugin
* Proper permissions
* Regular server updates
* Conservative punishment settings

---

## Best For

VeilMineX is useful for:

* Survival servers
* SMP servers
* Economy servers
* Lifesteal servers
* Semi-anarchy servers
* Public community servers
* Mining-based servers
* Servers that need better X-ray investigation tools

---

## Support

If something does not work correctly, run:

```text
/veilmine compat
/veilmine antixray test
/veilmine status
```

Then check the console logs and the files inside:

```text
plugins/VeilMineX/logs/
```

title: Lighten Up, Chunks!
description: This project re-calculates the lighting of every chunk in your world! Useful if you've optimised your world and your LODs are broken.
body:
**Lighten Up, Chunks!** is a Fabric mod for rebuilding lighting in already-generated chunks. It’s designed for worlds where saved light data is missing, broken, or stale, causing black chunks, dark patches, or incorrect long-distance rendering in tools like Voxy.

Instead of requiring players to manually travel through affected terrain, the mod processes existing chunks in bulk and writes corrected lighting back to disk. It supports whole-world scans, targeted region scans, and radius-based scans, with progress tracking, config options, and commands inspired by Chunky.

Features:
- Relight existing chunks in bulk
- World, region, and radius scan modes
- Designed for fixing broken saved lighting, not generating new terrain
- Writes corrected lighting to disk
- Sends updated chunk/light state back to connected clients
- Boss bar progress display with configurable info
- Mod Menu config support
- Singleplayer-friendly workflow
- Commands similar to Chunky

Use cases:
- Fix black or unlit chunks in old worlds
- Repair stale lighting after modpack changes or broken saves
- Improve distant world rendering for Voxy and similar LOD tools
- Relight a specific damaged area without touching the whole world
- Process an entire explored world over time

How to use with Voxy:
1. `/luc start` - wait until completion
2. `/voxy import current` - wait until completion
3. Enjoy your darkness-free world!

title: Ratchet
description: A PvP mod about Magic and Kinetics
body:
# **Ratchet**

**Ratchet** is a PvP mod about magic, kinetics, and mechanical weapons.

The main focus of this mod is adding weapons that reward strong positioning, and multi-tasking. Most **Ratchet** weapons are built around storing energy, releasing it at the right moment, and using that stored force to change how fights play out.

---

## **Ratchet Driver**

The **Ratchet Driver** is a balanced mechanical weapon that stores charge while blocking.

When the weapon has a stored charge, landing a hit deals bonus damage and releases a controlled shockwave around the target. This makes the **Ratchet Driver** useful for players who want a strong melee weapon without making it feel like pure raw damage.

The **Ratchet Driver** can use **Obliterate**, which lowers direct hit damage but greatly increases the power of the shockwave.

It can also use **Overcharge**, which adds two extra max charges and lets the weapon store even more energy, at the cost of backlash when pushed too far.

---

## **Overcrank Ratchet Driver**

The **Overcrank Ratchet Driver** is a more extreme version of the **Ratchet Driver**.

It stores much more charge, allowing for heavier follow-up attacks and stronger charged impacts. Critical hits can also add extra stored charge after a short delay, making it stronger when used aggressively and timed well.

Charged impacts from the **Overcrank Ratchet Driver** can also damage armor durability.

The **Overcrank Ratchet Driver** can use **Overcharge**, which pushes the charge limit even higher for stronger stored hits.

It can also use **Inversion**, which reverses the shockwave and pulls enemies inward instead of launching them away.

---

## **Heavy Ratchet Driver**

The **Heavy Ratchet Driver** is a slower and heavier **Ratchet** weapon built for brutal impact.

Charged strikes slam enemies downward, partially pierce armor, and create a much larger shockwave than the standard **Ratchet Driver**. This makes it better for heavy hits, area pressure, and punishing grouped enemies.

The **Heavy Ratchet Driver** can use **Obliterate**, which turns charged impacts into a much more destructive area blast.

It can also use **Overcharge**, which adds two extra max charges for even more devastating hits.

---

## **Latchet Rebounder**

The **Latchet Rebounder** is a mechanical ranged weapon that stores up to 5 charges.

When fired, it releases stored charge as a burst of instant hitscan shots. Stored charge slowly decays over time if left unused, so the weapon is strongest when charge is built and used intentionally.

The **Latchet Rebounder** can use **Rapid Fire**, which replaces stored charge with a sustained spinning barrage that ramps up as it fires.

It can also use **Railpiercer**, which fires stronger shots that pierce through one block and one target.

---

## **Ratchet Indexer**

The **Ratchet Indexer** is a utility device based around anchors and movement.

Right-clicking stores an anchor point. Sneak-right-clicking activates the device and changes what it does depending on its current mode.

In **Untuned** mode, the **Ratchet Indexer** indexes nearby living entities to the anchor.

In **Tuned** mode, it teleports the player to the anchor.

In **Half-Tune** mode, it sends nearby dropped items to the anchor.

---

## **Mechanical Tuner**

The **Mechanical Tuner** is used with the **Ratchet Indexer** to swap between **Untuned**, **Tuned**, and **Half-Tune** modes.

When used in the offhand, the **Mechanical Tuner** changes how the **Ratchet Indexer** behaves.

A **Ghast Tear** sends the player to the highest safe anchor point.

**Raw Iron**, **Raw Gold**, or **Raw Copper** sends the player to the lowest safe anchor point.

---

## **Enchantments**

**Rapid Fire** replaces the **Latchet Rebounder’s** stored charge system with a sustained automatic barrage.

This enchantment can only be applied to the **Latchet Rebounder**.

---

**Railpiercer** makes the **Latchet Rebounder** fire stronger piercing shots that pass through one block and one target.

This enchantment can only be applied to the **Latchet Rebounder**.

---

**Obliterate** reduces direct hit damage but heavily increases charged shockwave power.

This enchantment can be applied to the **Ratchet Driver** and **Heavy Ratchet Driver**.

**Obliterate** cannot be combined with **Overcharge**.

---

**Overcharge** adds 2 max charges to **Ratchet** weapons, allowing stronger stored attacks at the cost of backlash when pushed past their normal limits.

This enchantment can be applied to the **Ratchet Driver**, **Heavy Ratchet Driver**, and **Overcrank Ratchet Driver**.

**Overcharge** cannot be combined with **Obliterate**.

---

**Inversion** reverses the **Overcrank Ratchet Driver’s** shockwave so it pulls enemies inward instead of knocking them away.

This enchantment can only be applied to the **Overcrank Ratchet Driver**.

---

## **Materials**

**Ratchet Gear** is a mechanical component crafted from iron and netherite scrap.

It is used in most **Ratchet** weapon recipes.

---

**Latchet Barrel** is a rare weapon part found in Ancient Cities and from Archaeology.

It is used to craft the **Latchet Rebounder**.

---

This license allows others to use, modify, and redistribute this work, including for commercial purposes, as long as they give appropriate credit, indicate if changes were made, and distribute adaptations under the same license.

title: The Waiting
description: A world that watches you back.
body:
# The Waiting

**The Waiting** is a psychological horror mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric, built around tension, silence, paranoia, and the feeling that something in the world has started paying attention to you.

This mod is not about normal combat.  
It is not about constant attacks.  
It is not about loud horror every minute.

Instead, it is about what happens when normal survival slowly stops feeling safe.

## What kind of experience is this?

At first, the world may seem almost normal.

Then small things begin to feel wrong:

- Something appears far away and stays there
- Familiar places start to feel watched
- Silence starts to matter
- Your habits begin to feel noticed
- Things repeat in ways they should not
- The world feels less random and more aware

The horror comes from:

- Waiting
- Uncertainty
- Distance
- Repetition
- Being observed
- Familiar spaces becoming uncomfortable

This mod is meant to create the feeling that the world is not hostile in the usual way, but it is no longer neutral either.

## What to expect while playing

You should expect:

- Rare but memorable encounters
- Subtle visual unease from the start of the world
- Periods where nothing obvious happens, but the atmosphere still feels wrong
- Moments where the game reacts to how you behave
- A growing sense that your actions are being remembered
- Survival gameplay that becomes psychologically uncomfortable without turning into constant action horror

You should not expect:

- A combat-focused horror mod
- Nonstop jumpscares
- Constant chase scenes
- Obvious scripted horror every few minutes
- Frequent text explaining what you should feel

## Intended feeling

The goal of **The Waiting** is simple:

To make Minecraft feel like Minecraft, but no longer like a world that belongs only to you.

## Current state

This version is **0.1.0-alpha**.

That means:

- The mod is already playable
- The main atmosphere is already present
- The core idea is working
- Balance, pacing, and reliability are still being refined

## Content warning

This modification contains:

- Psychological horror
- Unsettling visual effects
- Sudden silence and distorted ambience
- Themes of being watched

Not recommended for players sensitive to:

- Anxiety-inducing atmosphere
- Darkness and isolation
- Unexpected visual or audio changes

This mod does not focus on combat. It is designed to make the world feel wrong.

## Installation

Required:

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- GeckoLib
- Java 21

Make sure all required dependencies are installed before launching the game.

## Final note

**The Waiting** is meant to be quiet.

If it works correctly, it should not always scare you immediately.

It should make you doubt the world first.

## Credits

Classic-style textures are used from the Minecraft Classic Edition resource pack:

https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/minecraft-classic-edition/gallery?version=1.21

Licensed under the MIT License.  
Original author(s): JS03

# TelentityX – Entity Teleportation Made Easy!

## Features

### 🐎 Vehicle Teleportation
From horses to minecarts, arrows, boats, and more — if you're riding it, **it comes with you** when you teleport! No more losing your ride after a `/tp` command.

### 👪 Passenger Teleportation
Got a pig in a boat? A baby zombie on a chicken? No worries — as long as they're passengers, they’ll travel with you and stay inside the vehicle post-teleport.

### 🔗 Leash Teleportation
If you’re holding a mob on a leash (like a dog or llama), it will automatically teleport with you wherever you go. Stay connected, stay safe!

## Installation & Setup

### Step 1: Install the Plugin
Drop the `TelentityX-XXXX.jar` file into your server’s **plugins/** folder, then restart your server. That's all for basic setup — it just works out of the box! 

> Tip: For a simple "plug-and-play" experience, no further steps are needed.

### Step 2: Configure Permissions (Optional)
If you want fine-grained control over who can teleport which entities, how, and where, follow these steps:

1. Assign specific permissions based on:
   - Entity types (`cow`, `boat`, etc.)
   - Teleport methods (`vehicle`, `passenger`, `lead`)

## 🔐 Permission Nodes

Here’s a breakdown of available permission nodes:

| Permission | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `telentity.teleport.*` | Teleport any entity type via vehicle, passenger, or lead. |
| `telentity.teleport.<entity_type>` | Teleport a specific entity type via any method. |
| `telentity.vehicle.*` | Teleport any entity as a vehicle. |
| `telentity.vehicle.<entity_type>` | Teleport a specific entity type as a vehicle. |
| `telentity.passenger.*` | Teleport any entity as a passenger inside another vehicle. |
| `telentity.passenger.<entity_type>` | Teleport a specific entity type as a passenger. |
| `telentity.lead.*` | Teleport any entity that is on a lead. |
| `telentity.lead.<entity_type>` | Teleport a specific entity type that is on a lead. |

---

## 🧩 Compatible With
- Vanilla Minecraft entities
- Custom mobs from plugins (if supported)
- All major teleportation commands/plugins like EssentialsX, Multiverse-Core, and more

## ⚠️ Not Compatible With
- **HuskHomes** (due to internal teleportation handling limitations) ❌
  If you use HuskHomes, entity teleportation may not work correctly during home or warp teleports.

## What's New in This Version?

Compared to the original **Telentity** or **HorseTpWithMe**, this version brings several important improvements:

- **Supports newer Minecraft versions up to 1.21.x**  
  Keep using the plugin on the latest game versions without compatibility issues.

- **Supports Folia/Canvas**

- **Bug fixes and performance improvements**  
  Resolved known issues such as incorrect passenger detachment and inconsistent teleport behavior.

- **Cleaner console output**  
  Unlike the original, this version **does NOT spam all available permissions at startup**, keeping your console clean and readable.

> Make teleportation seamless and intuitive with **TelentityX** — never lose your pet, mount, or passenger again!

title: Addoners Optimizers
description: High-performance Minecraft optimization mod that dynamically improves FPS and system efficiency while maintaining visual quality.
body:
# Addoners Optimizer

Addoners Optimizer is a client-side performance mod for Minecraft 1.26.1.2 (Fabric) that dynamically adjusts selected video settings based on real-time FPS measurements to help maintain smoother and more stable gameplay performance.

## How it works

The mod samples the player's FPS every second using a rolling average and applies one of three optimization levels:

* **LOW (≥80 FPS)** — minimal adjustments, prioritizing visual quality
* **MEDIUM (50–79 FPS)** — moderate reductions to selected graphics settings
* **AGGRESSIVE (<50 FPS)** — stronger reductions intended to improve frame stability on lower performance systems

A 3-second cooldown between changes helps prevent rapid setting fluctuations.

## Features

* Automatically adjusts:

  * Render distance
  * Particle settings
  * Smooth lighting
  * Shader quality settings
* Optional status HUD displaying:

  * Current FPS
  * Active optimization level
  * Shader detection state
* Shader-aware mode:

  * Reduces optimization aggressiveness when Iris or Canvas shaders are detected
* `.addoners` profile system:

  * JSON-based profiles for hardware tiers or shader packs
  * User-customizable optimization rules
* Built-in profiles for:

  * Quartzglow Shaderpack
  * Skygleam Shaderpack
* In-game configuration support through Mod Menu
* Structured debug logging to `logs/latest.log`

## Adjustable settings

Depending on the active optimization profile, the mod can dynamically modify:

* Render distance (2–32 chunks)
* Particle settings
* Smooth lighting
* Shadow quality levels
* Shader toggles through profile rules

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.26.1.2
* Fabric Loader 0.18.6 or newer
* Fabric API
* Java 25+
* Mod Menu (optional)

## Configuration

Config location:

`%appdata%/.minecraft/config/teamaddoners/modconfig.json`

Profiles folder:

`%appdata%/.minecraft/config/teamaddoners/profiles/`

No manual setup is required. The optimizer starts automatically when Minecraft launches.

## Performance notes

Performance impact and effectiveness may vary depending on:

* Hardware specifications
* Installed mods
* Shader packs
* World complexity
* Render resolution
* Server load

Testing was primarily performed on systems using Fabric with Sodium-based rendering environments under varying render distances and shader configurations.

title: LPDiscordLogger
description: LPDiscordLogger is a Minecraft Paper plugin that logs specific player commands executed by members of a designated LuckPerms group and sends these logs to a specified Discord channel via a webhook.
body:
# LPDiscordLogger

LPDiscordLogger is a Paper plugin that logs specific commands executed by players in a chosen LuckPerms group and forwards those logs to a Discord channel via a webhook. It helps server owners monitor important or sensitive administrative actions.

## Features

- **Command Logging**  
  Tracks and logs commands executed by players in a specified LuckPerms group.

- **Discord Webhook Support**  
  Sends command logs directly to a Discord channel using a configured webhook URL.

- **Highly Configurable**  
  Customize the target LuckPerms group, the Discord webhook URL, and the list of ignored commands through `config.yml`.

- **Reloadable Configuration**  
  Apply configuration changes at runtime using the `/lpdiscordreload` command, without restarting the server.

## Prerequisites

- **Minecraft Server** running Paper or another compatible PaperMC-based API  
- **LuckPerms** installed and configured  
- **Java 17 or newer** on the server

## Installation

1. **Download the Plugin**  
   Get the latest release from:  
   - [GitHub](https://github.com/PetalCat/LPDiscordLogger/releases)  
   - [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/lpdiscordlogger/versions)

2. **Place in Plugins Folder**  
   Move `LPDiscordLogger.jar` into your server’s `plugins` directory.

3. **Start the Server**  
   Launch the server. A default `config.yml` will be generated in `plugins/LPDiscordLogger`.

4. **Configure the Plugin**  
   Edit `plugins/LPDiscordLogger/config.yml` as needed:  
   - `discordWebhookUrl`: Your Discord webhook URL  
   - `targetGroup`: The LuckPerms group to monitor (e.g., `admin`)  
   - `ignoredCommands`: A list of command prefixes to exclude from logging (e.g., `/msg`, `/whisper`)

5. **Reload the Configuration**  
   Apply your changes instantly using `/lpdiscordreload` in-game or through the console.

## Configuration

Example `config.yml`:

```yaml
discordWebhookUrl: "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/your_webhook_url"
targetGroup: "admin"
ignoredCommands:
  - "/msg"
  - "/whisper"
  - "/tell"

title: CicadaLib
description: This is a core modding library designed to simplify complex systems in mod development.
body: # CicadaLib A technical library for structured and scalable mods This is a core modding library designed to simplify complex systems in mod development. It provides a structured foundation for creating consistent, maintainable, and feature-rich mods without having to rewrite the same low-level logic over and over. ## Features - Structured registration systems for blocks, items, and groups. Extended base implementations for blocks and items, reducing boilerplate code and ensuring consistent behavior. Developers can implement custom logic faster while keeping the code clean and predictable. Items and blocks behave consistently, with fewer errors in edge cases. - Enhanced tooltip system A flexible tooltip system allows you to create dynamic, multi-line, and context-sensitive descriptions with minimal code. Supports localization and conditional display logic. - Utilities for handling codecs and data Built-in support for Mojang serialization (codecs) simplifies saving, loading, and synchronizing complex data structures (e.g., block entities, configurations, user systems). -> Improved stability, fewer data corruption issues, and smoother interaction with the world. - Clean override and compatibility layer The mod standardizes interaction with vanilla systems, including safe handling of deprecated methods and API changes. Fewer crashes and better compatibility between my mods, especially across Minecraft versions. - Modular development approach Encourages the separation of logic into reusable components, simplifying the expansion and maintenance of large mods. Faster updates, more frequent new features, and long-term mod support. CicadaLib is designed for both developers and players: Developers get a faster and cleaner workflow with less repetitive code. Players get higher-quality mods with improved user interface, stability, and consistency. CicadaLib directly improves the overall mod experience by raising the technical standard of mods that depend on it. ## Dependency Notice This is a library mod. It is required for other mods that depend on CicadaLib and has no standalone purpose for gameplay.

## Enchantments

Digs a 1×2 area of stone. Incompatible with 3×3 Excavation.

### Obtaining
Obtained via villager trading, loot chests, etc. Cannot be acquired from the Enchanting Table.

## Anvil
Has no "Too expensive" limit and is unbreakable.

### Obtaining
Crafting.

## Disenchanting Table
Items inside the Disenchanting Table will display their enchantments. Whether text is shown on the Disenchanting Table and the text color can be modified in the config file.

### Usage
Right-click the Disenchanting Table while holding the item, then right-click the Disenchanting Table while holding a book to remove one enchantment and obtain an Enchanted Book, at the cost of 5 levels of experience.

### Obtaining
Crafting.

title: VeinMinerPro
description: High-performance, ore-only vein mining for modern  servers
body:
# ⛏️ VeinMinerPro
> **High-performance, ore-only vein mining for modern Paper/Spigot servers.**

VeinMinerPro is a lightweight utility designed for server owners who want the efficiency of chain-mining without the performance cost. Built on **Java 21**, it ensures your TPS stays at 20.0 while clearing entire ore veins in a single click.

---

### 🚀 Performance & Logic
* **Queue-Based BFS:** Optimized algorithm prevents server lag during large mining operations.
* **Smart Grouping:** Automatically connects Stone, Deepslate, and Nether ore variants.
* **Metadata Tracking:** Identifies player-placed blocks to prevent "storage mining" exploits.
* **Safety Buffer:** Automatically stops the process before your tool breaks (stops at 1 HP).

### 🛠️ Commands & Permissions
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/vm toggle` | Turn VeinMiner on/off | `veinminer.toggle` |
| `/vm reload` | Reload config.yml | `veinminer.reload` |
| `n/a` | Use the ability | `veinminer.use` |

---

### 💰 Support & Donations
If you enjoy this project and want to see more "Pro" features, consider supporting me!
[**Donate via PayPal: paypal.me/marbzy**](https://www.paypal.me/marbzy)

---

### 📦 Installation
1. Drop the jar into your `/plugins` folder.
2. Ensure you are running **Java 21** and **Paper/Spigot 1.20.1+**.
3. Configure your ore limits in `config.yml`.

title: Old Vein Miner
description:
The only VeinMiner for Minecraft 1.4.7
Old VeinMiner brings chain-mining to Minecraft 1.4.7 — a version no other VeinMiner mod supports.
body:
# The only VeinMiner for Minecraft 1.4.7

**Old VeinMiner** brings chain-mining to Minecraft 1.4.7 — a version no other VeinMiner mod supports.

Hold the activation key (`` ` `` by default) and break a block. The entire connected vein is mined instantly, with drops delivered straight to your inventory.

## Features

- **26-directional flood fill** — mines diagonally connected blocks, closest first
- **All mineable blocks** — ores, leaves (with shears), and any connected block type
- **Smart drops** — compacted into stacks, delivered to inventory (overflow drops at feet)
- **Tool durability** — consumed per block, stops if your tool breaks
- **Hunger cost** — proportional to blocks mined (configurable, or disable it)
- **Redstone-aware** — lit and unlit redstone ore treated as the same vein
- **Fully configurable** — max blocks, hunger cost, activation key, drop behavior

## Configuration

Edit `config/ovm.cfg` after first launch:

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `maxBlocks` | 64 | Max blocks mined per operation |
| `hungerPerBlocks` | 32 | Blocks per hunger point (0 = free) |
| `dropsToInventory` | true | Drops go to inventory vs. drop in world |
| `activationKey` | 41 | LWJGL keycode (41 = `` ` ``) |

## Install

1. Install [Minecraft Forge for 1.4.7](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/index_1.4.7.html)
2. Drop `ovm-*.jar` into your `mods/` folder
3. Launch the game

title: Trident Weathering
description: A mod that lets the Player control the Weather with a Trident!
body:
**Trident Weathering allows you to control Minecraft's weather using tridents in unique and immersive ways.**
### 🌧️ Summon Rain
Point your trident towards the sky (looking almost straight up) and hold the use button. After a few seconds, you'll see visual rain cues that gradually intensify until it finally starts raining for real. It's like performing a ritual to summon the storm.
### ⚡ Create Thunderstorms
Throw a trident with Channeling enchantment towards the sky while it's raining. If the trident is pointing almost vertically upward, lightning bolts will start striking around it. Once enough bolts have fallen (configurable), the weather will change to a full thunderstorm.
### ☀️ Clear the Skies
Place a trident in an active conduit. The conduit will channel its power through the trident to gradually clear the weather, removing rain and storms. If the chunk is loaded, you can leave the trident in the conduit and will never rain again in the world.

_All mechanics are fully configurable from the server, allowing you to adjust wait times, required lightning bolts, probabilities, and more. The mod is optimized for performance and works in both single player and multiplayer servers._

I'm planning to make an animated Minecraft video to introduce the mod, so stay tuned! ❤️

title: The Trial Maze
description: This mod turns the entire world into a Trial Chambers.
body:
This mod makes it so that the entire Overworld is replaced with a randomly generated maze of Trial Chambers. Be careful not to get lost! (_Hint: You can't avoid getting lost. It's inevitable._)

Chests with loot can occasionally be found around the world, giving you wood and pickaxes. In addition, large rooms (like the [Atrium](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Trial_Chambers_atrium_1_(1).png) or [Chamber 4](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Trial_Chambers_chamber_4.png)) generate randomly. Good luck!

<details>
<summary>Overworld Generation Details</summary>

Every structure that can generate in the Overworld is an edited version of one of the vanilla Trial Chambers rooms or structures. In addition to corridors, these rooms can spawn:

- [Atrium](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Trial_Chambers_atrium_1_(1).png)
  - _<small>In this room, the reliefs on the sides were removed, and the structure was made less tall by removing the walkways and vault at the top.</small>_
- [Chamber 4](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Trial_Chambers_chamber_4.png)
  - _<small>In this room, the walkways have been shifted to account for the opening positions. In addition, several new openings were added.</small>_
- [Slanted](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Trial_Chambers_slanted.png)
  - _<small>This room was barely edited (from a version I found in my world), except for the entrances being fixed.</small>_

</details>

<details>
<summary>Nether Generation Details</summary>

All of these structures were built myself after looking at a real fortress. There are many inaccuracies compared to real fortresses, but that's probably okay. Right?

In addition to open and closed corridors, these rooms can spawn:

- Lava intersection (with one square of lava in the middle). This room was not modified.
- Staircase with nether wart. This room was significantly compressed side-to-side to prevent it from being ridiculously large.

Open corridors can contain blaze spawners and closed corridors can contain chests (with loot identical to vanilla fortress loot).

</details>

NOTE: This mod is not finished! The End is not modified, and some more Trial Chambers rooms will be added soon.

title: BarkLock
description: Prevents accidental wood stripping. You can only remove bark from logs while sneaking.
body:
# **BarkLock**

BarkLock is a simple utility mod that tackles a common builder blunder: accidentally stripping the bark off log blocks. When you’ve got an axe in hand or you’re mid-build, it’s easy to misclick and ruin a log’s look. This mod adds a tiny safety net to keep that from happening.

With BarkLock installed, right-clicking a log with an axe does nothing—the bark stays put. If you actually want to take the bark off, just hold the sneak key (Shift) while right-clicking.

###  Main features:

**Safety first:** Stops accidental log edits while you’re moving around or building.

**Simple mechanic:** No fiddly menus or settings. Sneak to bypass the lock only when you need to.

**Server friendly:** Install it on a server to protect the world for everyone. Players don’t need the mod on their own setup to benefit from the protection.

 **Performance:** Tiny footprint, no hit to frame rate or loading times.

 **_Installation and compatibility:_** Built for Fabric Loader, compatible with Minecraft 1.21-1.21.11. Drop the jar into your mods folder and you’re good to go.

title: CobblemonPulse
description: CobblemonPulse is a Fabric mod adding dynamic broadcast messages for Pokémon events, with hoverable details and rarity-based notifications.
body:
# CobblemonPulse

**CobblemonPulse** is a Fabric mod for Minecraft that provides server-wide broadcast messages and notifications for Cobblemon Pokémon events, including wild spawns, captures, and defeats. It supports hover text with Pokémon details, custom sounds, and commands.

---

## Features

- Broadcast messages when Pokémon spawn, are captured, or defeated.
- Supports wild, shiny, legendary, ultrabeast and mythical Pokémon.
- Custom hover text showing Pokémon info (level, type, ability, form, nature, gender, world, biome, location).
- Optional sound effects for events.
- Custom commands triggered on events.
- Permission-based admin command for configuration reload.

---

## Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API**.
2. Place the `CobblemonPulse` mod `.jar` into your `mods` folder.
3. Make sure **Cobblemon** mod is installed as well.
4. Start your server.

---

## Configuration

CobblemonPulse uses a JSON configuration file located at:

```
config/cobblemonpulse/config.json
```
```json
{
  "language": "en_us",
  "spawn": {
    "normal": {
      "broadcast_enabled": true,
      "broadcast_message": "&2A wild &6{pokemon} &2has appeared near &b{player}&2!",
      "pokemon_hover": [
        "&7Pokémon: &f{pokemon} lv.{level}",
        "&7Types: &a{type}",
        "&7Ability: &f{ability}",
        "&7Form: &a{form}",
        "&7Nature: &f{nature}",
        "&7Gender: &a{gender}",
        "&7World: &f{world}",
        "&7Biome: &a{biome}",
        "&7Location: &f{x} {y} {z}"
      ],
      "sound_enabled": true,
      "sound": "minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup",
      "volume": 1.0,
      "pitch": 1.0,
      "command_enabled": true,
      "commands": []
    },
    "shiny": { ... },
    "legendary": { ... },
    "mythical": { ... },
    "ultrabeast": { ... }
  },
  "capture": { ... },
  "defeat": { ... }
}
```

You can reload the configuration in-game using:

```
/cobblemonpulse
```

Only users with the permission `cobblemonpulse.admin` can execute this command.

---

## Default Configuration

The default configuration includes spawn, capture, and defeat settings for normal, shiny, legendary, ultrabeast and mythical Pokémon.

(Full JSON configuration omitted for brevity. Refer to the default `cobblemonpulse.json` in the mod for complete details.)

---

## Placeholders

| Placeholder | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| `{pokemon}` | Pokémon name |
| `{player}`  | Player name |
| `{level}`   | Pokémon level |
| `{type}`    | Pokémon type(s) |
| `{ability}` | Pokémon ability |
| `{form}`    | Pokémon form |
| `{nature}`  | Pokémon nature |
| `{gender}`  | Pokémon gender |
| `{world}`   | World name |
| `{biome}`   | Biome name |
| `{x}` `{y}` `{z}` | Pokémon coordinates |

---

## Permissions

- `cobblemonpulse.admin` – Required to run `/cobblemonpulse` to reload the configuration.

---

## Events Handled

- **Spawn** – When a wild Pokémon appears.
- **Capture** – When a Pokémon is caught by a player.
- **Defeat** – When a Pokémon faints in battle.

---

title: Heart Revamp
description: Lightly revamps the heart textures.
body:
The vanilla textures for the heart types are iconic but flawed in my opinion. The shading feels oddly flat in comparison to the rest of the modern textures for the game. It's somewhat obvious that all of them besides the frozen heart textures are programmer art, so I decided to give them a light revamp. The withered hearts are notoriously hard to distinguish from empty hearts which is Not Good™ so I made it a bit brighter and slightly purplish. I made the empty hearts darker as well for the same reason.
I hope you enjoy, hypothetical audience.

description: Increase the output of Wood recipes from 3 to 4.
body:
Recipe downloads have been split into their own projects for better Modrinth App compatibility.\
Links to all recipes in description

This project has all Wood/Bark recipes changed to output 4 instead of 3.


#### Installation:
- Put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/saves/[Your World Here]/datapack" folder.
- ***DO NOT put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/resourcepacks" folder.***
- If you changed where Minecraft loads from, find that location and use that "saves" folder.
- For servers, put it in your world folder that matches where your server.properties file says.

#### For advanced users:
- IF you want to store it in your ".minecraft" folder, CREATE a folder called "datapack" and put it there.
- From there, when you create a world and go to add datapacks, you can simply go to this folder and grab what you need.
- For identical recipes in multiple data packs, load desired recipes AFTER their duplicates
