Руководства HBM подхватываются сразу при запуске игры и переводятся один за одним в фоне, не мешая вам, а при входе в игру вы получаете супер-классные русские мануалы HBM. Такая реализация была сделана из-за особенностей рендера мода.

Факт: в старых модпаках вроде тех, что на 1.7.10, 80% контента на английском, и Ru помогает с этим.

Примеры работы мода:
![Original](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64c3fd009967856f14f5418ebfa33109296fdf47.jpeg)![Translated](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33ccae24224ee3a5d72d0b62fdc12038d04bb8b8.jpeg)![Original HBM](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ec281985ed73efbffe5bc2c261b507951acd9ce_0.webp)![Translated HBM](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56cd8c310924cbfe342eca1322030f123da51f55_0.webp)![Tooltip Original](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4ade7a9e639d359a93204afaecb58a820f8f4fc_0.webp)![Tooltip Translated](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ce5acf8e87f0c63e0d648600de5c1fd8c843b6a_0.webp)


##
- Использует Google API
- Зависимостей нет
- Поддерживает все моды, никаких конфликтов!
- Переводит ТОЛЬКО с Английского на Русский
- Вы можете сами отредактировать готовый перевод в файлах кеша, если вам нужно, при перезапуске Майнкрафта мод подтянет кеш.
##

Настройки сохраняются в конфиге — при следующем запуске всё как было.
Кеш переводов: появляется в папке AutoTranslation в главной директории вашего Minecraft.

English:

Speak Minecraft in Russian!

Imagine: you launch your favorite 1.7.10 modpack full of awesome machines, items, books, weapons—and all the text is English only.

Meet Ru – AutoTranslator! Your personal interpreter for Minecraft that makes modded gameplay accessible and convenient.

~ It doesn’t just swap words—it preserves colors, line breaks, and helps when your English is rusty.

- Mod GUI: In your world press F6 to open the main menu and enable exactly what you need.
- Smart GUI/item translations: Buttons, block names, tooltips—everything in Russian.
- Caching: It remembers translations, so it doesn’t hit the API repeatedly.
- Instant screen translation: Need on-the-fly translating without a GUI? Press F7—every bit of text (menus, chat) turns Russian. Colors, spacing, and tooltip boxes adjust perfectly. The [RU] indicator in the top-right reminds you the magic is on!
- HBM/NTM super-support: Full manuals are translated end-to-end. HBM guides load at game start and get translated one by one in the background; when you jump in, you have fully Russian HBM manuals. This is tailored to HBM’s rendering quirks.

Fact: In legacy modpacks like 1.7.10, ~80% of content is English—Ru helps with that.

##

- Uses Google API
- No dependencies
- Compatible with all mods—no conflicts!
- Translates ONLY from English to Russian
- You can edit cached translations yourself; on the next launch the mod will pick them up.

##

Settings persist in the config—next launch stays as you left it.

Translation cache: stored in the AutoTranslation folder in your Minecraft root.

# Soulbound  BETA

**A Hardcore SMP Experience with Souls, Hearts, and Permanent Power**

> *Every death costs a heart. Every kill grants a soul.*

## Core Features

### Heart System
- Start with **10 hearts** (20 HP)
- **Lose 1 heart** when killed by another player
- **Gain 1 heart** when you kill someone
- **1–20 heart cap** – no one becomes invincible
- **-2 hearts** for environmental deaths (lava, void, creeper, fall)

### Soul Abilities
- Every PvP kill grants a **permanent random soul ability**
- Effects include:
  - Speed I/II
  - Fire Resistance
  - Strength I
  - Night Vision
  - Regeneration
  - Jump Boost
  - Haste
  - and more!
- **Stackable** – collect multiples for mastery

### Killstreak & Anti-Farming
- Track your **current & best killstreak**
- **60-second cooldown** per victim to prevent farming
- Special rewards & broadcasts at **5+ streak**

### Persistent Data
- All progress (hearts, kills, abilities, streaks) **saved to disk**
- Survives server restarts
- Stored per-player in `world/soulbound/players/`

---

## HUD & Controls

- **Clean overlay** in top-right corner ONLY ON SERVER
- Shows: **Hearts**, **Killstreak**, **Soul Abilities**

---

## Perfect For

title: SCP_STRANGE_LAB
description: SCP_STRANGE_LAB: is a mod for Minecraft about SCP Monsters and res
body:
**SCP Strange Lab**
SCP Strange Lab is an immersive Minecraft mod inspired by the SCP Foundation universe. Dive into a world of anomalous horrors, secure facilities, and containment protocols right in your game! This Forge mod for Minecraft 1.19.2 adds SCP-themed entities, structures, items, and mechanics to create thrilling survival and role-playing experiences. Whether you're a fan of the SCP lore or just love adding spooky twists to Minecraft, this mod lets you build containment sites, fight terrifying creatures, and manage anomalous effects for hours of eerie fun.

Developed over two months by a dedicated creator, it's designed to be balanced and atmospheric—perfect for solo adventures, horror servers, or creative builds. Note: Contains dark themes like violence and psychological horror; recommended for players 16+.

**Key Purpose**
Transform ordinary Minecraft worlds into classified SCP sites. Role-play as Foundation personnel containing anomalies, or survive as a D-Class subject in chaotic breaches. The mod emphasizes exploration, strategy, and tension, blending SCP storytelling with vanilla-friendly gameplay.

**What Makes It Appealing**
Horror Immersion: Encounter real SCP-inspired threats that feel alive and unpredictable.
Creative Freedom: Use custom blocks to construct massive labs or hidden bunkers.
Balanced Mechanics: Anomalous items offer powerful but risky effects—use them wisely to avoid disaster!
Easy Integration: Works seamlessly with Forge; no complex setups needed.

**Features**

**SCP Subjects**
SCP-096 (The Shy Guy): A silent, deadly entity that activates if you glimpse its face. It will relentlessly hunt you down—best to look away and run!
Facilities and NPCs
Complex Guards: Patrolling security personnel to protect your bases or add tension to explorations.
Chaos Squad: Insurgent forces for dynamic conflicts, perfect for multiplayer raids or story-driven events.

**Armor Sets**
Guard Armor: Sturdy protection inspired by Foundation security gear.
Chaos Squad Armor: Agile, offensive gear for insurgent playstyles.
SCP-049 Gear: Includes the Plaguedoctor's robe, syringe for "curing" mobs, and potions for experimental effects.
D-Class Uniform: Basic attire for undercover or prisoner role-play, with lightweight stats.

**Structures**
SCP Laboratory: Procedurally generated complexes filled with anomalies, puzzles, and hidden rooms. Generate your own secure facilities anywhere in the world!
Anomalous Meals
SCP-330 (Candy): Deceptively sweet treats that can be fatal—eating one has a chance to instantly kill the consumer, adding risk to scavenging.
SCP-207 (Cola Cans): Energizing drinks that grant temporary strength buffs (like Speed II and Strength I for 30 seconds), but overuse may lead to addictive debuffs. Configurable for servers!

**Custom Blocks**
Secure Building Blocks: Durable materials for constructing impenetrable containment chambers.
Dim Glowing Lamps: Low-light fixtures for creepy lab atmospheres—emits subtle red glow without full brightness.
Computer Blocks: Interactive terminals for "hacking" or lore displays; placeable like redstone components.
Fake Grass: Synthetic turf that blends into natural worlds but hides underground secrets.

**Weapons**
Pistol: A reliable handgun with moderate damage and quick fire rate—ideal for close-quarters defense.
AK-47: Powerful assault rifle for taking down tougher threats, complete with ammo crafting recipes. Balanced with recoil and limited magazine size.

**Installation & Requirements**
Install Forge: Download and install the recommended version for Minecraft 1.19.2 (Forge 43.2.0 or later) from the official site.
Download the Mod: Get SCP Strange Lab from Modrinth and place the .jar file in your mods folder.
Launch and Enjoy: Start a new world or load an existing one. No additional mods required, but compatible with performance enhancers.

title: Keep Default Noteblock
description: Resource pack addon that restores the default noteblock texture.
body:
## Don't like visual notes, but enjoy the rest of a resource pack? This addon might be the solution for you!


Some packs use "visual notes/pitches" as the default for their noteblock texture. However, this serves to be problematic if you use noteblocks in building — an essential part of Minecraft.

While this _cannot_ help with custom packs that have heavily changed textures from the default textures (unless you don't care if it's different), this **_should_** help with vanilla-like packs, or possibly other similar 16-bit resource packs. Your mileage may vary.

_"Why would I not just change this myself?"_, you might ask. Well, if you enjoy using the noteblock's visual notes from a resourcepack, this could serve as an enable/disable switch in your resourcepacks. Hence calling it an "addon." Simply move it over to enable/disable. Like an on/off switch!


Make sure to put this pack **ABOVE** the pack you are trying to change (i.e. the one that uses the visual notes).

### This pack will only be updated periodically. If the red incompatible warning bothers you enough, feel free to change the pack format accordingly. It should work regardless unless Mojang decides to wreck the file structure/formatting like they typically enjoy doing.

title: CombatSystem

body:
# CombatSystem

A lightweight and reliable PvP combat logging system for Minecraft servers.  
Designed to prevent unfair escapes and enforce real PvP consequences.

---

## ⚔️ Features

• Players automatically enter combat after hitting another player  
• Action bar displays a live, colored combat countdown  
• Sends chat messages when combat starts and ends  
• Logging out during combat results in instant death  
• Combat ends instantly if either player dies (killer or victim)  
• Blocks all commands during combat (except `/combat`)  
• Tells players exactly which command was blocked  
• Combat duration is fully configurable via `config.yml`  

---

## 🔧 Admin Tools

• `/combat reload` – Reloads the configuration file  
• Includes tab-completion for easy use  
• Requires `combat.reload` permission (default: OP only)

---

# Foodcraft
Welcome to Foodcraft! This mod adds many variants of food that you can get in Minecraft, including sliced foods, burgers, eggs, bacon, and more!

## How to use: Cutting Board
In Foodcraft, there is a block that is nessecarry for progression for making certain foods. This is the cutting board. To craft it, put two planks of wood (any type) in a crafting table. This will result in the cutting board being made.

To use it, craft an iron sword and right-click on the cutting board to slice the item on the cutting board.

## Custom villager type?
There is a new custom villager type in this mod, related with the cutting board. To get it, all you need to do is have a villager use a cutting board (as a profession block). The villager will then transform into a customer villager. The customer villager is a new villager type that you can serve food and receive emeralds.

There is still much more in this mod than just this, so find out by playing the mod!

title: Fact
description: An admin-based factions-style teams & chunk claiming mod.
body:
# Fact

A simple open source Minecraft (Forge 1.20.1) mod adds teams and chunk claiming in an admin-based system.

# Features
- Teams
- Chunk claiming
- Admin-based system
- Optimized Dynmap Integration

# Installation
Fact is only available for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1. We have no official support of custom server softwares that allow Forge + Plugin support, don't make issues if you have errors using the mod on those softwares.

1. Download the latest release from the Versions tab
2. Place the downloaded file in the `mods` folder of your Minecraft instance.
3. (Optional) Download the latest version of Dynmap Forge 1.20.1 and place it in the `mods` folder of your Minecraft instance.
4. Start the game and enjoy!

# Usage
- `/fact admin create <name>` - Create a team.
- `/fact admin delete <name>` - Delete a team.
- `/fact admin claim <team name>` - Claim the chunk you are standing in for the specified team.
- `/fact admin unclaim <team name>` - Unclaim the chunk you are standing in for the specified team.
- `/fact admin set_leader <player> ` - Force set the leader of the team you are in.
- `/fact admin leave` - Makes you leave the team you are in.
- `/fact admin join <name>` - Join a team.
- `/fact admin player join <player> <name>` - Makes a player join a team.
- `/fact admin player leave <player>` - Makes a player leave a team.
- `/fact set_leader <player>` - Makes you the leader of the team you are in. (Only works if you are the leader of the team)
- `/fact ally <name>` - Allows another team to mine/place blocks in your land
- `/fact unally <name>` - Disallows another team to mine/place blocks in your land

Github Repo: [https://github.com/lu2000luk/Fact/](https://github.com/lu2000luk/Fact/)

Author: https://linktr.ee/lu2000luk

title: Villagers stay still
description: Now the villagers can stay still
body:
## How to Use

<details>
<summary>Video Tutorial</summary>
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ZH1dPxFptEU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Use an anvil to rename **any** item in the game to `still`.  
Hold the renamed item and approach a villager. The villager will now be unable to move.

If you want the villager to move again, rename **any** item in the game to `move`.

- If a villager transforms in zombie villager, the zombie villager will be able to move.

title: Diamond Ore Banknotes
description: Changes the display of diamond ore blocks in the inventory to banknotes!
body:
# Diamond ore as banknotes in inventory!
"Diamond Ore Banknotes" is a unique resource pack for Minecraft, designed specifically for servers where diamond ore is the main currency. This resource pack provides players with a unique visual experience to relive the economics of the game by turning ordinary blocks of diamond ore into banknotes.
## Features
* **Unique banknote design.** The banknote textures have been carefully designed with Minecraft in mind. They fit perfectly with the original 16x16 texture resolution and the overall visual language of the game.
* **Preservation of the original block textures.** It is important to note that the resource pack retains the original textures of the diamond ore blocks in the world. This means that on the server you will still see the usual blocks of diamond ore with the old appearance. Only the display in the inventory has been replaced.
## Suitable for servers with an economy based on diamond ore
"Diamond Ore Banknotes" is ideal for servers where diamond ore plays the role of a currency. Thanks to this resource pack, players will be able to more clearly perceive the economic side of the game, visually imagining the value of their assets. This resource pack contributes to deepening into the game world and creating a unique atmosphere where diamonds become a real value.

title: PluralCraft
description: A minecraft mod for plural systems
body:
# & PluralCraft

A 1.19+ server side quilt mod for plural systems.

## todo

- implement coloured names
- investigate unsticking latch during preview
- skin proxying?
- nameplate changes
- better usage instructions

## installation

install the mod jar into the server. for preview support enable chat previews in the server.properties file
```properties
previews-chat=true
```

## Usage

create a system by running `/pc create`

- the list of current members can be viewed with `/pc member`
- members can be created with `/pc member new <name>`
- members can be managed with `/pc member <name> <subcommand>`
    - members can be deleted with `delete`
    - members display names can be queried with `display` and set with `display <name>`
    - members proxies can be listed with `proxy`, added with `proxy add <tag>`, and removed with `proxy remove <tag>`
- the current fronter can be set with `/pc front [fronter]` where no fronter prints the current fronter and `clear` clears the fronter
- autoproxy can be configured with `/pc autoproxy <type>`

### [WIP] early development

![AmenBreak Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc9006c37ed655daf8243fe0a01223d849b47751_0.webp)


# About Gestalten:

### What is a Gestalt?

A Gestalt is a invasive soul you'll have to implant into a mob, harvest and awaken within yourself.
After you successfully obtained a Gestalt, it acts as your own personal guardian and traversal tool.
But the Gestalt is depending on your well being, if you as a host are too weak the Gestalt will not be able to manifest. Make sure to keep yourself well fed to provide the Gestalt with enough energy, otherwise they might crash out.

### How do I get one?

In game you will find a instruction book eihter in the bonus chest or in chests near ruined nether portals, this book will have most information you'll need.
(otherwise read the spoiler section)
The Gestalt you awaken will depend on the mob you choose to use your fragile soul vessel on.



# Controls:

every key has a crouch and r-click variant 

G - to call and dismiss your awoken Gestalt.
(crouch tap for info screen, hold for exp siphon)

Z - first power tier

X - second power tier

C - third power tier

(your available powers depend on your Gestalts lvl)

(rebindable in key config)

(The info screen shows unlocked skins and currently available powers by lvl, with tool tips)

Ledge Grab - Press jump when looking at a ledge mid air

Gestalt Thorw - jump when crouching to get a boost

Wall Slide - crouch in mid air when touching a wall

Soul Projection - Pressing G when holding Guard lets the Gestalt rip out your soul and enabeling you to  reach a short distance away from your body.
Your real body is vulnerable during this and you'll get snapped back when your body is hit or your hunger gets too low.
You can end this mode by either right clicking your body or Guard G again as an emergency exit.
How far you can move away from your body is determined by your Gestalts RNG stat.


Everything past this are minor spoilers, if you want to go in blind you have all the information you need already


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

# How to get a Gestalt

Craft a brush > brush crying obsidian > cook the nether tear > combine the resonant powder with an amethyst on an anvil > use the empty soul vessel on any type of soul fire > use the fragile soul vessel on a mob > kill said mob > wait till the dormant Gestalt drained 15 lvls from you > Gestalt awakens

10 skins per gestalt 

### unlocking contitions:

1 - default

2 - 4 simple recolors available right away

5 biome - visit a gestalt specific biome 

6 trial - loot a trial vault 

7 penrose - pick up a chorus flower

8 warden - kill warden

### Future plans:

planned are 6 Gestalten in total

Update to new version somewhere along the line.

## About the Mod:

The mod is designed in a way so you'll have to intentionally engage with it, I do not want to clutter your inventory with useless items you'll use once and never again.
the only exception will be tutorial and lore documents you can find through archaeology.
These documents can be disposed off by using them as fuel in a furnace (burns 3 items).

The first of these can be found in the bonus chest and in chests next to a ruined nether portals. This first document should give you a good idea of how to obtain and use your gestalt without reading the spoiler section.


### Why did I make the mod?

I made this mostly for myself.
I really like the concept of having a stand but I kinda don't need the JoJo flavor in minecraft.
Few JoJo mods focus on the stand concept exclusively and are either outdated or add a whole bunch of random JoJo related items, I just simply wanted to create a more focused experience.
IF you are not bothered by the JoJo flavor tho I can whole heartedly recommend the two mods Ripples of the Past and Roundabout the JoJo mod, they're honestly way more feature complete and vastly more refined than this is ever planned to be.

title: ThinAir: ReLived
description: A NeoForge 1.21.1 port of Thin Air by fuzs and a foundation for more. The air isn't always breathable. Go too deep, too high, or into the wrong dimension and you'll need to come prepared. Respirators, air bladders, and soulfire can keep you alive.
body:
# Thin Air — NeoForge 1.21.1 Port

A faithful NeoForge port of [fuzs's Thin Air](https://modrinth.com/mod/thin-air). The air is not always breathable deep underground and in other dimensions.

The original mod is [archived on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/thin-air/versions) (last release: Minecraft 1.20.4). This fork brings it forward to **Minecraft 1.21.1** on NeoForge while staying close to the upstream design (not a ground-up rewrite) with some features added.

> ⚠️ Please report bugs for this port **only** in [this repository's issue tracker](https://github.com/kgbcupcake/ThinAir-ReLived/issues). Do not contact fuzs about issues specific to this port.

---

## What's Different

- **NeoForge-only**: Direct port of the 1.20.4 codebase and data, updated for NeoForge 1.21.1 APIs and datapack path changes (`recipe/`, `advancement/`, `loot_table/`, and so on).
- **Server-authoritative config**: Settings live in `thinair-server.toml` under each world's `serverconfig/` folder, with an optional in-game config screen (Mods menu) via Cloth Config.
- **Optional Curios**: Respirator uses the Curios head slot and Safety Lantern uses the Curios belt slot when [Curios](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) is installed; the mod works without it.
- **Optional Create integration**: Backtanks provide breathable air in yellow and red air when worn with a Diving Helmet (via [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)'s own equipment system, with an optional Curios back slot for the backtank itself); like Curios, none of this is required or bundled, the mod loads and works fine with neither installed.
- **Work in progress**: Full parity testing is ongoing.

---

## Features

- **Air quality levels**: Green, yellow, red, and blue air affect breathing and what equipment helps, by dimension and height.
- **Safety Lantern**: Shows nearby air quality by color; can be dyed and scraped with an axe.
- **Signal Torch**: Right-click to emit particles (configurable).
- **Respirator**: Protects against choking air (Curios head slot when available).
- **Air Bladder** / **Reinforced Air Bladder**: Portable air refill; reinforced variant crafted with netherite and copies durability from the ingredient bladder.
- **Bottle of Soulfire**: Emergency air restore in the Nether.
- Advancements, recipes, loot injections, drowned air-drain behavior, chunk air-quality sync, and English / Russian / Chinese lang files.

### Blocks

- **Safety Lantern**: shows nearby air quality by color; can be dyed and scraped with an axe
- **Signal Torch**: right-click to emit particles (configurable)

### Items

- **Respirator**: protects against choking air (Curios head slot when available)
- **Air Bladder** / **Reinforced Air Bladder**: portable air refill (reinforced recipe copies bladder durability)
- **Bottle of Soulfire**: emergency air restore in the Nether

### Advancements

- **Air Bladder**: use an Air Bladder to refill your air supply on the go
- **Blue Air**: breathe the life force given off by Soul Fire to maintain your air (but not increase it!)
- **Disco Lantern**: use a piece of Dye to manually change the color of a Safety Lamp (you can scrape the color off with an axe)
- **Respirator**: protect yourself from choking air with something like a Respirator
- **Safety Lantern**: use a Safety Lantern to check the air quality around you
- **Signal Torch**: right-click a torch to make it spew particles, perhaps to signal the exit of a cave
- **Soulfire Bottle**: restore your lungs with the souls trapped in a Bottle of Soulfire
- **Water Breathing**: breathe freely where there is no air at all

## Known limitations

Work still in progress compared to the original 1.20.4 release:

- Full parity testing (multiplayer, loot, advancements, worldgen-placed air providers) is ongoing

---
## Technical Info

| Dependency   | Version          | Notes                                                                 |
| ------------ | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| NeoForge     | 1.21.1           | Required                                                              |
| Java         | 21               | Required                                                              |
| [Curios](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) | 9.5.1+1.21.1 | Optional: respirator head slot, belt lantern, Curios rendering |
| [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) | 6.0.10-280 | Optional: backtank breathable air via Diving Helmet |
| [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) | 15.0.140 | Recommended: in-game config screen from the Mods menu; otherwise edit `serverconfig/thinair-server.toml` |

## Installation

1. Install [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/) for Minecraft 1.21.1.
2. Download or build `thinair-*.jar` from [Releases](https://github.com/kgbcupcake/ThinAir-ReLived/releases).
3. Drop the mod `.jar` into your `mods/` folder.
4. Optionally install [Curios](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) for respirator/lantern slot support, and/or [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) for backtank breathable-air support.
5. Launch the game.

After the first launch, change settings from the Mods menu config screen or by editing `<world>/serverconfig/thinair-server.toml` (air quality, signal torches, drowned choking, and air-provider bubble ranges).

---

## Credits

| Role                 | Author                                              |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Original mod         | [fuzs](https://modrinth.com/mod/thin-air)           |
| 1.21.1 NeoForge port | [Marie (kgbcupcake)](https://github.com/kgbcupcake) |

---

## References

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Original mod on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/thin-air)
- [Original source](https://github.com/Fuzss/thinair)
- [Curios](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios)
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)

---

## License

MIT — same as the [original Thin Air project](https://modrinth.com/mod/thin-air). Asset rights follow the upstream [LICENSE-ASSETS](https://github.com/Fuzss/modresources) terms where applicable.

title: Fabulously Vulkan
description: A modern Fabric optimization modpack powered by VulkanMod for superior rendering and massive FPS boosts.
body:
# 🚀 Fabulously Vulkan

Fabulously Vulkan is a lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack built around Vulkan-based rendering with the goal of delivering the smoothest and most responsive gameplay experience possible. Instead of adding unnecessary content or bloating the game with heavy features, this modpack focuses entirely on improving performance, reducing stuttering, lowering CPU overhead, and providing stable frametimes while keeping the experience clean and close to vanilla.

Designed for 🌐 multiplayer servers, ⚔️ PvP gameplay, 🌍 survival worlds, 🎥 content recording, and long play sessions, Fabulously Vulkan is made for players who want maximum responsiveness and smoother gameplay without sacrificing visual quality. Every included mod has been carefully selected to improve rendering efficiency, chunk loading, memory usage, gameplay stability, and overall performance.

Unlike traditional optimization packs that rely on OpenGL-based rendering through Sodium, Fabulously Vulkan uses Vulkan rendering to reduce CPU bottlenecks and improve frame pacing on many systems. Depending on hardware configuration, players may experience smoother movement, reduced lag spikes, faster chunk rendering, and more consistent gameplay, especially during combat, exploration, and multiplayer gameplay.

The modpack also includes ✨ Beryl shader support, allowing players to enjoy improved visuals, lighting, and atmosphere while maintaining excellent performance. The focus is to provide a balance between visuals and FPS so players can enjoy a smoother Minecraft experience without heavily impacting performance.

Fabulously Vulkan is especially beneficial for 💻 low-end and mid-range systems where frametime consistency and CPU optimization matter more than simply pushing unrealistic FPS numbers. The pack is lightweight, efficient, fast to launch, and designed to remain stable during both singleplayer and multiplayer gameplay.

# 📈 Expected Performance Improvements

Depending on hardware, drivers, and settings, players may experience:

• 🚀 Higher average FPS

• ❄️ Reduced stuttering and micro-freezes

• 🌍 Faster chunk rendering and loading

• ⚔️ Smoother movement and combat responsiveness

• 📊 Better frametime consistency

• 🧠 Lower CPU overhead

• ⚡ Reduced lag spikes during exploration

• 💾 Improved memory efficiency

• ⏱️ Faster world loading times

• 🎮 Better overall gameplay smoothness

• 🌐 Improved multiplayer responsiveness

Performance improvements may vary between systems, but the goal remains the same: deliver the smoothest Minecraft experience possible while keeping the game lightweight, stable, and visually enjoyable.

# 🖥 Recommended Usage

Fabulously Vulkan is recommended for:

• 🌐 Multiplayer servers

• ⚔️ PvP gameplay

• 🌍 Long survival sessions

• 💻 Low-end and mid-range PCs

• 📊 Players looking for smoother frametimes

• ✨ Players wanting lightweight shader support

# ⚠️ Important Notes

• VulkanMod is incompatible with Sodium and Iris.

• Some shaders and rendering-related mods may not function correctly.

• ✨ Shader support is provided through Beryl shaders.

• 🚀 For maximum FPS, disable V-Sync in-game and within your GPU settings if supported by your system, as Vulkan rendering may otherwise cap FPS to your monitor’s refresh rate.

• 🎯 Stability, frametime consistency, and smooth gameplay are prioritized over unrealistic FPS claims.

🖥️ Server Software | | Paper | Spigot | Purpur | |---|---|---|---| | Tab list, chat, nametag | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | Hex & gradient colors | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | Scoreboard anti-flicker | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | Hex/gradient in scoreboard lines | ✅ | ⚠️ Legacy only | ✅ | > **Recommended:** Paper or Purpur for full feature support. → [papermc.io/downloads](https://papermc.io/downloads) --- ## 📦 Dependencies - **LuckPerms** — `required` — [luckperms.net](https://luckperms.net/) - **PlaceholderAPI** — `optional` — [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi) --- ## 🎨 Color Support | Format | Example | Works in | |---|---|---| | Legacy `&` codes | `&6[VIP]` | Everywhere | | Hex `&#RRGGBB` | `&#FF5733[Admin]` | Everywhere | | Animated gradient | `text` | Everywhere | | Bold gradient | `&l[Owner]&r ` | Everywhere | --- ## 📋 Built-in Placeholders These work everywhere without PlaceholderAPI: | Placeholder | Description | |---|---| | `%player%` | Player name | | `%world%` | Current world name | | `%server_online%` | Online player count | | `%server_max_players%` | Max player count | | `%player_ping%` | Player ping in ms (plain number) | | `%lucktab_ping_colored%` | Ping colored green/yellow/red automatically | | `%lucktab_rank%` | Colored rank prefix | | `%lucktab_prefix%` | Same as `%lucktab_rank%` | | `%lucktab_suffix%` | Rank suffix | | `%lucktab_color%` | Rank name color | | `%lucktab_rank_display%` | Prefix + color + group name + suffix | | `%chatPrefix%` | Rank prefix in chat format | | `%chatSuffix%` | Rank suffix in chat format | With PlaceholderAPI any third-party placeholder like `%vault_eco_balance%` works too. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration Everything is controlled from `config.yml`: ```yaml # ── Prefix Source ───────────────────────────── # lucktab → use prefixes from this config (default) # luckperms → use prefixes directly from LuckPerms meta prefix-source: lucktab # ── Ping Colors ─────────────────────────────── ping-colors: good: 50 # ≤ 50ms → green medium: 100 # ≤ 100ms → yellow # > 100ms → red # ── Tab-List ────────────────────────────────── tab-list: show-only-same-world: false # ── Chat Format ─────────────────────────────── useChatFormat: true chatFormat: "%chatPrefix%%playerName% &8» &7%message%" # ── Rank Prefixes ───────────────────────────── # Format: "group;prefix;suffix;namecolor" # Top = highest priority | suffix can be empty: "group;prefix;;color" prefixes: - "owner;[Owner] ;;&#FF7700" - "admin;&#FF5555[Admin] &7;;&#FF5555" - "mod;ᖳFF[Mod] &7;;ᖳFF" - "vip;&6[VIP] &7;;&6" - "default;&7[Player] &7;;&7" # ── Header & Footer ─────────────────────────── # Per-world: add a section with the exact world name as key # Falls back to "default" if no world-specific design is found header-footer: enabled: true designs: default: header: - "" - " MyServer " - "" footer: - "" - "&fOnline: &b%server_online%&7/&b%server_max_players% &7| &fPing: %lucktab_ping_colored%" - "" # ── Scoreboard Sidebar ──────────────────────── # Per-world: add a design with the exact world name under "designs" scoreboard: enabled: true designs: default: title: "MyServer" lines: - "" - "&7Rank: %lucktab_rank%" - "&7Ping: %lucktab_ping_colored%" - "" - "&7World: &f%world%" - "" - "&7Online: &f%server_online%&8/&f%server_max_players%" - "" ``` --- ## 🔑 Commands & Permissions | Command | Permission | Default | |---|---|---| | `/lucktab reload` | `lucktab.reload` | OP | | `/lucktab migrate to-luckperms` | `lucktab.migrate` | OP | | `/lucktab migrate from-luckperms` | `lucktab.migrate` | OP | --- ## title: Reaper's Descendant
description: A mod that focuses on snowballing into Death Incarnate.
body:
# "I will guide you, but you do the work." Sell your soul to the **Cult of Death** and follow the footsteps of the old world to gain god-like strength. This mod centralizes around the _Reaper's Scythes_, they are the primary weapons and tools to your path of death. Reap the souls of innocents and use their souls to empower yourself onward towards **His** status, or use them up to gain tempoary boosts in combat. The Scythes are snowball weapons! They start off bad, and you have to gain power! Patience. Additions:
Spoiler

Scythes

  • Old Reaper's Scythe - "Passed down, generation after generation"
![glowing white purple scythe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70ebacebe23a0ed3a67807e9f4f2b3a40e54f754.png)

Your first and most important tool in your path! !!You need to get it through the Death Certificate before wielding!! Slay your enemies and innocents to reap their souls for buffs and an ability at 25: Rejuvinate!

Rejuvinate!: Use 10% of your souls to gain Absorption and Saturation. Stacks and resets time, so go wild!

  • Prime Reaper's Scythe - "Trust is bestowed, not bought"
![Glowing white/yellow blue scythe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7f0ae418d3740e86ea33905c34e2d3fdc2ae6f1.png)

By killing four Withers and using 150 souls - you did it! I'm not going to ask how or even why, but congrats! Buffs are better and an even better ability at 100 souls: Reap!

Reap!: Right-click to use 5% of your souls to afflict all entities in a 7 block radius with Reap effect, slowly reaping their soul and withering them from the inside. For each entity afflicted, gain a level of Absorption and Saturation. And players give two levels, great for PvP!

Tools

  • New World Reaper's Reforger - "Old knowledge stays within footsteps"
![Big hammer with purple and blue detailing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b134ec2f83da6f69b44947b4a0d740f645048b1a.png)

Tool used by the Old World's Cult of Death to forge the first ever Reaper's Scythe! Used to forge the Prime Reaper's Scythe on the Starred Reorger.

  • Bloodletting Knife - "Sacrifices are necessary on the path to the top"
![curvy dagger](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d61bcb47359d6b9b441d8bb3360d9bd1a4f99aa.png)

Used on the Death Shrine Confirmation to gain trust with the Cult of Death.

Locations

  • Death Shrine - "Old World is history, and history is never-ending"
![ intricate and detailed block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cab11ea0a2bcdfaae219e7e2b13a1c57af9bb388.png)

The Cult of Death was founded in the Soulsand Valley, and all of their shrines and churces can be found there.

Here lies the Death Shrine Confirmation. Used in tandem with the Bloodletting Knife reveals the Death Certificate, which is used to join into the Cult of Death and receive the Old Reaper's Scythe.

!!This is still in W.I.P. Bugs or unbalance is to be expected!!

title: Smart Inventory Manager
description: A lightweight Fabric client mod that adds safe icon buttons and keybinds to quickly sort inventories and common containers.
body:
# Smart Inventory Manager

Smart Inventory Manager is a client-side Fabric mod that adds fast, safe inventory sorting with clean icon buttons, keybinds, multiple sort modes, JSON config recovery, Mod Menu support, and broad localization.

Author: Matfi1

## Features

- Sort the player inventory from the inventory screen.
- Sort common containers: chest, barrel, shulker box, hopper, dispenser, and dropper.
- Use compact icon buttons instead of large text buttons.
- Switch sorting mode from an in-game icon button.
- The mode icon changes to match the selected sort mode.
- Long hover tooltips explain each icon.
- Settings are available from the main/pause menu and with a keybind.
- Sorting respects protected hotbar slots when `ignoreHotbar` is enabled.
- Sorting respects configured `lockedSlots`.
- Invalid config files are backed up and replaced with defaults.
- No mixins in the MVP.

## Sort Modes

- Item ID
- Category
- Count
- Durability
- Name A-Z
- Name Z-A

## Controls

Default keybinds:

- `I`: sort player inventory
- `O`: sort opened container
- `K`: open Smart Inventory Manager settings

You can change these in Minecraft's controls menu.

## Supported Versions

Built Modrinth jars are saved in `dist/modrinth/`.

| Minecraft | Jar |
| --- | --- |
| 1.21 | `SmIm-1.21.jar` |
| 1.21.1 | `SmIm-1.21.1.jar` |
| 1.21.2 | `SmIm-1.21.2.jar` |
| 1.21.3 | `SmIm-1.21.3.jar` |
| 1.21.4 | `SmIm-1.21.4.jar` |
| 1.21.5 | `SmIm-1.21.5.jar` |
| 1.21.6 | `SmIm-1.21.6.jar` |
| 1.21.7 | `SmIm-1.21.7.jar` |
| 1.21.8 | `SmIm-1.21.8.jar` |
| 1.21.9 | `SmIm-1.21.9.jar` |
| 1.21.10 | `SmIm-1.21.10.jar` |
| 1.21.11 | `SmIm-1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1 | `SmIm-26.1.jar` |
| 26.1.2 | `SmIm-26.1.2.jar` |

Minecraft `26.1` and `26.1.2` require Java 25.

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for your Minecraft version.
2. Install Fabric API for your Minecraft version.
3. Put the matching `SmIm-*.jar` file into your `mods` folder.
4. Optional: install Mod Menu to open the config screen from the mods list.

This is a client-only mod. It is not required on servers.

## Config

The config file is created here:

```text
config/smartinventorymanager.json
```

Config keys:

- `enableInventorySort`
- `enableContainerSort`
- `buttonSide`
- `buttonScale`
- `animationEnabled`
- `sortMode`
- `ignoreHotbar`
- `lockedSlots`

If the JSON is broken, Smart Inventory Manager renames it to a timestamped `.broken` backup and creates a new default config.

## Localization

Included languages:

- English (`en_us`)
- Russian (`ru_ru`)
- German (`de_de`)
- French (`fr_fr`)
- Spanish (`es_es`)
- Portuguese, Brazil (`pt_br`)
- Italian (`it_it`)
- Polish (`pl_pl`)
- Ukrainian (`uk_ua`)
- Turkish (`tr_tr`)
- Dutch (`nl_nl`)
- Czech (`cs_cz`)
- Hungarian (`hu_hu`)
- Chinese, Simplified (`zh_cn`)
- Chinese, Traditional (`zh_tw`)
- Japanese (`ja_jp`)
- Korean (`ko_kr`)

## Compatibility

Smart Inventory Manager uses Fabric screen events and avoids unsafe widget-list indexes. If a screen is not recognized, the feature path fails softly instead of crashing the client.

Manual compatibility test targets:

- Sodium
- Iris
- Mod Menu
- Mouse Tweaks
- Shulker Box Tooltip
- JEI
- libIPN

These are manual test targets, not full compatibility certifications. Mods that also move inventory slots may conflict if both mods sort at the same time.

## Building

Build all supported Modrinth files:

```bash
./scripts/build-modrinth.sh
```

Build one Minecraft version:

```bash
./gradlew clean build -PmcVersion=1.21.11
```

Build `26.x` with Java 25:

```bash
JAVA_HOME="$PWD/.jdks/jdk-25" ./gradlew clean build -PmcVersion=26.1
JAVA_HOME="$PWD/.jdks/jdk-25" ./gradlew clean build -PmcVersion=26.1.2
```

Successful jars are copied to:

```text
dist/modrinth/
```

## Manual Test Plan

- Open the player inventory.
- Confirm the sort and mode icons are outside the inventory GUI, not in the center.
- Open chest, barrel, shulker box, hopper, dispenser, and dropper.
- Click Sort in every supported screen.
- Switch sort modes and confirm the mode icon changes.
- Use keybinds for player inventory and container sorting.
- Change GUI scale and reopen screens.
- Corrupt the config JSON and confirm backup plus default regeneration.
- Launch with Mod Menu and confirm the config screen opens.
- Launch with Sodium/Iris and confirm the GUI still renders.

## Roadmap

Planned ideas for future releases:

- Quick Stack
- Restock Hotbar
- Auto Refill
- Interactive Slot Locking UI
- Clean Inventory

## License

MIT

title: AsutanTweaks
description: developed exclusively for asutarisucu
body:
# ﻿AsutanTweaks [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/asutarisucu/Asutantweaks.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) AsutanTweaks is a FabricMOD that runs client-side only.
It is developed exclusively for asutarisucu
Any requests for additional features will also be ignored. ## How to Press `B`+`C`to open config GUI.
you can also access the config GUI via [Mod Menu](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modmenu) ## Features ### LastUseCancel >If you have only one item in your main hand you cannot use it. ### ItemRestock >This is a feature implemented in [tweakeroo](https://github.com/maruohon/tweakeroo) as well, but when the hot bar is low on items, the items are replenished from the inventory.
>The timing of replenishment can be changed by changing the `Restock Count`.
>If `LastUseCancel` is enabled, it leaves one item in the inventory to be replenished. ### AutoFillInventory >Pick up items from the container so that the count of items in the Player's inventory is maximized. `LastUseCansel` and `ItemRestock` can be used together to replenish items without changing the structure of the items in the inventory. This means you can always transport the optimal amount of items. ### DisableVoidDive >When you try to fall into the Void, it automatically stops you from falling with fireworks.
>For each dimension, the height at which it is recognized as void can be changed.
>Setting `VoidDisconnect` to True will automatically disconnect the game when there are no fireworks or elytra.
>Resuming the game, however, will not save your life. ### SchematicRestrictionWhiteList >You can freely specify the BlockState to be checked in TweakerMore's `schematicBlockRestriction`
>Enter the BlockState you wish to check in the `RestrictionStateWhiteList` in lower or upper case. ### SimpleEntityRender >Simplifies Entity rendering and improves fps.
>If you have a large number of Entities clustered together, combine them into one.
>Enable `SimpleEntityRenderCount` to see how many Entities are grouped there.
>It also prevents ItemEntity from moving in a depressing way.
>Currently, it is only available for ItemEntity and MobEntity. ### EnderChestMaterialList >Add the contents of the ender chest to the count in [Litematica](https://github.com/maruohon/litematica)'s MaterialList.
>From the `EnderChestMaterialListWhiteList` and `EnderChestMaterialListBlocklist`, >you can specify the colors of the shulker box boxes to exclude from the count.
>If you want to use it in multiplayer, enable `serverDataSyncer` in [tweakermore](https://github.com/Fallen-Breath/tweakermore/tree/master) >and `debugNbtQueryNoPermission` in [Carpet](https://github.com/gnembon/fabric-carpet).
>You may not get it right the first time, but try several times. ### SearchHighlight >Highlight the location of the item set in HighLightItemList. >`SearchBlockHighlight` displays the block if it is located, > and `SearchContainerHighlight` displays the container in which the item is located. > The color and range can be set for each, > and you can also register your main hand items using hot keys. ### BlockUpdateViewer >Visualises which blocks will receive block updates when you place or break a block.
>Enable `PlacementUpdateViewer` to highlight update targets in **red** while holding a block item.
>Enable `BreakingUpdateViewer` to highlight update targets in **blue** while holding a mining tool.
>Enable `UpdateViewInstantOnly` to show only instant updates, excluding schedulable blocks such as pistons and observers.
>Enable `UpdateSuppressionView` to display a HUD warning (`CCE suppress Ready`) when the update chain contains positions that could trigger update suppression.

title: Lava Particles | More
description: An immersive client-side mod that brings Minecraft lava to life with custom boiling bubbles, more!
body:
# 🔥 Lava Particles | More **A simple client-side mod that makes Minecraft lava look and sound alive.** [![Minecraft Versions](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.1%20%7C%201.21.1-1f8b4c?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/lavalive) [![Loaders](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loaders-Fabric%20%7C%20Forge%20%7C%20NeoForge-df5926?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/lavalive) [![Side](https://img.shields.io/badge/Side-Client--Only-important?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/lavalive) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-LGPL--3.0--only-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/lavalive) --- **Lava Particles | More** is a client-side mod that completely changes how Minecraft lava feels. It adds dynamic bubbles, sizzling effects, volcanic geysers, and splash physics to make caves and the Nether look much more immersive.
--- ## ✨ Features ### 🌋 Lava Geysers & Eruptions * **Magma Geysers**: Large lava pools occasionally erupt with rising columns of heat-distortion waves, bubbles, and hot flying droplets. * **Ambient Sounds**: Eruptions are accompanied by deep, low-frequency volcanic rumbling. ### 🫧 Bubbling Effects * **Surface Bubbles**: Lava pools bubble actively with tiny fizzing pops on the surface. * **Deep Magma Bubbles**: Large magma bubbles rise slowly from the depths of lava lakes and burst at the surface. ### ☄️ Splash & Droplet Physics * **Landing Droplets**: Flying magma drops land on blocks, slide around, and slowly cool down (changing color from bright red to dark basalt) before disappearing. * **Water Interactions**: Droplets fizz and sizzle when landing in water, creating steam and rising water bubbles. * **Droplet Damage (Optional)**: Magma drops can deal minor fire damage (`0.5 hearts`) to players, with a customizable cooldown. ### 💨 Realistic Combustion * **Lava Sizzling**: Submerging or walking in lava creates dense columns of smoke, sparks, bubbling, and constant sizzling sound effects. --- ## 🛠️ Installation & Compatibility > [!NOTE] > **This mod is purely client-side!** You do not need to install it on servers to enjoy the visual atmospheric improvements in multiplayer. * **Supported Loaders**: Fabric, Forge, NeoForge * **Supported Versions**: Minecraft `1.20.1` & `1.21.1` * **Dependencies**: - **Fabric**: Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) for configuration GUI. - **Forge / NeoForge**: Requires [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config). --- ## ⚙️ Configuration Options You can customize everything in-game using the configuration menu: | Tab | Option Name | Description | Default Value | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Visuals** | **Check Frequencies** | Adjust update rates to optimize performance. | `1.0` | | | **Particle Spawn Multipliers** | Control the density of lava and smoke particles. | `1.0` | | | **Overworld Activity Multipliers** | Adjust eruption frequency outside the Nether. | `0.5` | | | **Magma Floor Stay Time** | How long droplets stay on the ground before cooling down. | `3.0s` | | | **Large Bubble Toggles** | Enable or disable large bubbling effects. | `true` | | **Audio** | **Mod Volume Multiplier** | Master volume control for custom sounds. | `1.0` | | | **Pop Sound Toggle** | Toggle the sound of small bursting bubbles. | `true` | | | **Rumble Sound Toggle** | Toggle deep volcanic rumbles. | `true` | | **Gameplay** | **Player Lava Sizzling** | Toggle steam and sizzling effects when in lava. | `true` | | | **Droplet Fire Damage** | Toggle whether magma droplets deal minor fire damage. | `true` | | | **Damage Cooldown** | Cooldown time between droplet damage ticks. | `3.0s` | --- ## 📄 License & Modpacks Distributed under the **GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (LGPL-3.0-only)**. **Modpacks**: You are free to include this mod in any public or private modpack! Please credit **stepqq** as the author.

- Up to 6 can occupy a single block space.
- Supports placement on the floor, ceiling, and all four walls.
  
Omni-Directional Blocks

- Lantern
- Quad Lantern
- Can be attached to floors, walls, and ceilings.
  
Number Decals

- Flat number decals.
- Right-click to cycle numbers from 0-9.

Placement & Building Support

title: SCWGFlags
description: Extra WorldGuard flags for protection.
body:
A lightweight plugin that adds some world guard flags that I think is missing from original plugin.

# Flags
- **Absolute break** (`absolute-break`)
  - When set to DENY, doesn't even let admins/ops to break blocks. No bypass permission. 
- **Absolute place** (`absolute-place`)
  - When set to DENY, doesn't even let admins/ops to place blocks. No bypass permission.  
- **Absolute interact** (`absolute-interact`)
  - When set to DENY, doesn't even let admins/ops to interact with blocks. No bypass permission.  
- Deny spawn reason (`deny-spawn-reason`)
  - Set of spawn reasons to prevent mobs from spawning with that reason.
  - E.g. when Natural and Spawner added to this flag. Mobs won't spawn naturally and from spawners but can be spawned with spawn eggs or commands.

# Version
Made and tested on 1.21. Depends on WorldGuard 7.x so should work down to 1.14 included.

title: CobbleDollarsCommandShop
description: CobbleDollars addon for configurable command-driven shops, ideal for servers and NPC-based setups
body:
# CobbleDollars Command Shops

CobbleDollars Command Shops is an addon for **CobbleDollars**. It adds **command-driven shops** that can be opened by name and fully managed on the server. The mod is built for servers that want more control over shop behavior, stock handling, access rules, and transaction logging without moving gameplay authority to the client.

## What it adds

- multiple custom shops with categories and offers
- custom prices and custom item counts per offer
- **per-player stock** for limited offers
- **unlimited** or **finite** stock
- automatic restocks with interval or daily reset rules
- optional purchase bonuses for bulk buys
- access rules for shops, categories, and offers
- support for player tags, advancements, dimensions, time ranges, and scoreboard values
- one **global bank** for all shops or a **local bank** per shop
- precise bank and shop matching with `item`, `stack`, `tag`, `mod`, `match.include`, and `match.exclude`
- exact stack matching, including item data/components
- shop enable/disable controls at runtime
- server-side validation and persistent stock data

## Server-side first

This mod is designed to be **server-authoritative**.

It does **not** replace CobbleDollars itself, does **not** replace CobbleDollars NPCs, and does **not** move shop logic to the client. It only takes over shop sessions opened through this addon.

If the same jar is installed on the client, the mod can also provide optional client-side UI enhancements. The core shop logic still remains on the server.

## Commands

Public commands:

- `/cdshops open <shop>`
- `/cdshops list`
- `/cdshops visibility list`

Admin commands (`permission level 2`):

- `/cdshops open <shop> <targets>`
- `/cdshops reload`
- `/cdshops restock <shop> all <players>`
- `/cdshops restock <shop> offer <offer> <players>`
- `/cdshops stock <shop> <player>`
- `/cdshops visibility <shop> status`
- `/cdshops visibility <shop> enable`
- `/cdshops visibility <shop> disable [message]`
- `/cdshops stats summary [window]`
- `/cdshops stats top <shops|offers|players|items> [window] [limit]`
- `/cdshops stats shop <shop> [window]`
- `/cdshops stats player <player|uuid> [window]`
- `/cdshops stats item <item> [window]`
- `/cdshops where`

## Configuration

On first server start, the mod generates its config files in:

```text
config/cobbledollarscommandshops/
  CONFIG_GUIDE.md
  audit.json
  feedback.json
  global_bank.json
  shops/
    general_store/
      shop.json
    blacksmith/
      shop.json
    explorer/
      shop.json
    syntax_showcase/
      shop.json
      bank.json
```

Transaction audit logs are written to:

```text
logs/cobbledollarscommandshops/audit.jsonl
```

The `/cdshops stats ...` admin commands read the active `audit.jsonl` file and any rotated `.jsonl.zip` archives on demand.

## Important files for writing shops and banks

If you want to understand how to write a `shop.json` or `bank.json`, start with these files:

- `config/cobbledollarscommandshops/CONFIG_GUIDE.md`  
  Main format reference generated by the mod on first start.
- `config/cobbledollarscommandshops/global_bank.json`  
  Default bank used as the fallback for all shops.
- `config/cobbledollarscommandshops/shops/syntax_showcase/shop.json`  
  Full example shop showing the supported matching syntax and conditions.
- `config/cobbledollarscommandshops/shops/syntax_showcase/bank.json`  
  Example of a shop-specific bank override.

Shop-specific bank files go here:

```text
config/cobbledollarscommandshops/shops/<shop_id>/bank.json
```

If no shop-specific `bank.json` exists, the mod uses:

```text
config/cobbledollarscommandshops/global_bank.json
```

## Support and questions

If you find a bug, please report it in the comments or open an issue. You can also contact me directly on CurseForge/Modrinth for more specific questions !
If you want to use or modify this code, please check the license first.

tested with :
- CobbleDollars-neoforge-2.0.0+Beta-5.1+1.21.1
- Cobblemon-neoforge-1.7.3+1.21.1
- CustomNPCs-Unofficial-NeoForge-1.21.1.20251230
- easy_npc-neoforge-1.21.1-6.14.0

title: Firearms
description: Resident Evil 4 inspired Firearms for Minecraft.
body:
## Description

Firearms is a Resident Evil 4 inspired datapack. Craft and upgrade guns from the original game, find Mousley and feed her Cheese to unlock bonus content, and delve into a large, procedurally generated castle to acquire pesetas!

## ![Firearms Icon](https://i.imgur.com/gv4LOVG.png) Firearms

There are 7 Firearms in total, and a Rocket Launcher. Hold a Firearm in your mainhand and right click to fire. Below is an explanation of all mechanics relevant to Firearms, as well as a breakdown of each one.

### Deadeye Mode

Sneaking while holding a Firearm will activate deadeye mode after some time, allowing bullets fired to deal critical hits.

### Ammo Usage

All Firearms use some kind of ammo to fire. You must have the correct ammo type in your inventory to load a clip. The ammo type for each Firearm is detailed in the breakdown table below. Ammo recipes are unlocked automatically when a Firearm enters your inventory.

### Reloading

Firearms can be manually reloaded by pressing F while in your mainhand. Reloading happens automatically when ammo reaches 0.

### Damage Falloff

Bullets fired experience damage falloff over certain ranges, particular to each Firearm. Some Firearms will require a close range to be effective, whereas others (such as the sniper rifle) can be used over any range without falloff. Deadeye critical hits can make up for some of that falloff.

### Maximum Range

There is also a fixed maximum range for each Firearm where, after a certain range, the bullet will no longer be effective at all.

### Piercing

Bullets are sometimes able to pierce multiple enemies with one shot, the number specific to each Firearm.

### Upgrading & Special Upgrades

Firearms can be upgraded at the Firearms Workshop (more on that below). Each Firearm can have its maximum ammo extended with an Extended Mag. Some Firearms can have damage falloff reduced with a Stabiliser. Every Firearm has a special upgrade that visually and uniquely modifies that Firearm.

### Breakdown

![SG-09 Icon](https://i.imgur.com/PDZWswE.png)
### SG-09
- Ammo Type: Copper Bullets ![Copper Bullets Icon](https://i.imgur.com/ZR1Tv1W.png)
- Damage: Low
- Deadeye Damage: Decent
- Damage Falloff: Low
- Piercing: 1 enemy
- Fire Rate: Very Fast
- Range: Close
- Magazine Capacity: 10/15 (upgraded)
- Special Upgrade: +Deadeye Speed (Reflex Sight)
![Reflex Sight Icon](https://i.imgur.com/AzhimRn.png)

A trusty pistol with a comfortable fire rate and nice magazine size. Its damage is nothing impressive, but ammo is easy to come by. Simple to craft in the early game and formidable in deadeye mode once fully upgraded.

![Red9 Icon](https://i.imgur.com/c60k8Ea.png)
### Red9
- Ammo Type: Copper Bullets ![Copper Bullets Icon](https://i.imgur.com/ZR1Tv1W.png)
- Damage: Decent
- Deadeye Damage: Decent
- Damage Falloff: Low
- Piercing: 1 enemy
- Fire Rate: Fast
- Range: Close
- Magazine Capacity: 8/12 (upgraded)
- Special Upgrade: +Damage (Red9 Stock)
![Red9 Stock Icon](https://i.imgur.com/uJEimnf.png)

A pistol with respectable damage, but trades off everything else. Less bullets are required to kill most mobs than the SG-09, making the Red9 a very ammo efficient choice. Can pack a punch when fully upgraded.

![W-870 Icon](https://i.imgur.com/2qPCYs9.png)
### W-870
- Ammo Type: Gold Shells ![Gold Shells Icon](https://i.imgur.com/bnxuEyN.png)
- Damage: High
- Deadeye Damage: High
- Damage Falloff: High
- Piercing: 3 enemies
- Fire Rate: Slow
- Range: Very Close
- Magazine Capacity: 6/8 (upgraded)
- Special Upgrade: +Fire Speed (Tactical Foregrip)
![Tactical Foregrip Icon](https://i.imgur.com/129bUi2.png)

A highly powerful shotgun with a tight spread. Capable of felling basic hostile mobs in one shell at close range, although it struggles to maintain damage over long distances.

![AK-47 Icon](https://i.imgur.com/4vlYwQv.png)
### AK-47
- Ammo Type: Iron Bullets ![Iron Bullets Icon](https://i.imgur.com/umqmcDb.png)
- Damage: Decent
- Deadeye Damage: Decent
- Damage Falloff: Decent
- Piercing: 2 enemies
- Fire Rate: Very Fast
- Range: Far
- Magazine Capacity: 20/40 (upgraded)
- Special Upgrade: +Max Range (Laser Sight)
![Laser Sight Icon](https://i.imgur.com/liISf74.png)

An assault rifle capable of quickly gunning down mobs. A large magazine size allows for a spray'n'pray approach, although this is very ammo inefficient. Remains effective over long distances when combined with the Laser Sight.

![Striker Icon](https://i.imgur.com/b6dSCe2.png)
### Striker
- Ammo Type: Gold Shells ![Gold Shells Icon](https://i.imgur.com/bnxuEyN.png)
- Damage: Decent
- Deadeye Damage: High
- Damage Falloff: High
- Piercing: 3 enemies
- Fire Rate: Fast
- Range: Very Close
- Magazine Capacity: 12/20 (upgraded)
- Special Upgrade: +Deadeye Speed (Reflex Sight)
![Reflex Sight Icon](https://i.imgur.com/AzhimRn.png)

A fast firing shotgun with a big magazine. The wide spread makes it easy to hit multiple enemies with one shell, but overall damage suffers. Deadeye mode is required to one shot basic hostile mobs.

![SR M1903 Icon](https://i.imgur.com/eo6EGrB.png)
### SR M1903
- Ammo Type: Large Iron Bullet ![Large Iron Bullet Icon](https://i.imgur.com/Lnuo1qz.png)
- Damage: High
- Deadeye Damage: Very High
- Damage Falloff: N/A
- Piercing: 10 enemies
- Fire Rate: Very Slow
- Range: Very Far
- Magazine Capacity: 5/7 (upgraded)
- Special Upgrade: +Deadeye Speed (Large Scope)
![Large Scope Icon](https://i.imgur.com/sFhZUO3.png)

A sniper rifle with an extremely long range and no damage falloff. When in deadeye mode it can one shot most mobs. However, its very slow to fire and has a small magazine capacity.

![Broken Butterfly Icon](https://i.imgur.com/AJjCYJI.png)
### Broken Butterfly
- Ammo Type: Diamond Round ![Diamond Round Icon](https://i.imgur.com/t5vjMHe.png)
- Damage: Very High
- Deadeye Damage: Very High
- Damage Falloff: High
- Piercing: 3 enemies
- Fire Rate: Slow
- Range: Close
- Magazine Capacity: 6/8 (upgraded)
- Special Upgrade: +Reload Speed (Quick Reloader)
![Quick Reloader Icon](https://i.imgur.com/mAddigj.png)

A magnum that's devastating at close range. Suffers from bad damage falloff which can be remedied by firing in deadeye mode. Although it can easily one shot most mobs, its ammo type is difficult to come by.

![Rocket Launcher Icon](https://i.imgur.com/caLlZEy.png)
### Rocket Launcher
- Ammo Type: Rocket ![Rocket Icon](https://i.imgur.com/5HtGY4g.png)
- Damage: High
- Deadeye Damage: N/A
- Damage Falloff: N/A
- Piercing: 1 enemy
- Fire Rate: Slow
- Range: Very Far
- Magazine Capacity: 1
- Special Upgrade: N/A

A rocket launcher that fires powerful, explosive rockets. Does good damage and has impressive range, but splash damage makes it dangerous to use in close combat.

## ![Firearms Workshop Icon](https://i.imgur.com/Zgym9FO.png) Firearms Workshop

The Firearms Workshop is a new block that's used to craft and upgrade Firearms.

![Firearms Workshop Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/nyKcAYM.png)

Firearms are crafted in a 3x1 table, with a set ordering of each part. Firearms parts are crafted inside a normal crafting table, with the recipes unlocking automatically after placing a Firearms Workshop.

Firearms can also be upgraded at the Workshop. Place a Firearm in the first slot and an upgrade in the adjacent slot. Buy upgrades from the Firearms Merchant with pesetas (details below).

Here's a list of every Firearm recipe craftable in the Workshop:

![SG-09 Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/TSv6dgf.png)
![Red9 Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/r2zgdlv.png)
![W-870 Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/nIzi8XU.png)
![AK-47 Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/s2KeRyu.png)
![Striker Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/CZIIBJi.png)
![SR M1903 Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/oCQyPZp.png)
![Broken Butterfly Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/By1B4HB.png)
![Rocket Launcher Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/OxlXHMk.png)

**Note:** You can type any Firearm's name into the recipe book to bring up the parts used to craft it.

## ![Ammo Icon](https://i.imgur.com/ZR1Tv1W.png) Ammo

There are 6 ammo types. Ammo recipes are unlocked when a Firearm enters your inventory. All ammo types use gunpowder in their recipes. To account for this, the difficulty of acquiring gunpowder has been reduced. Creepers can rarely drop extra gunpowder, and it can be found in the Castle inside of chests. It can also be bought from the Firearms Merchant for pesetas.

See the crafting recipes below:

![Copper Bullets Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/2RqlPEj.png)
![Gold Shells Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/INS5g0f.png)
![Iron Bullets Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/JxYwG7e.png)
![Large Iron Bullet Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/MwK6ksh.png)
![Diamond Round Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/XyY6DGW.png)
![Rocket Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/R5bP1gl.png)

## ![Firearms Merchant Icon](https://i.imgur.com/3ikj6k0.png) Firearms Merchant

The Firearms Merchant can be summoned by placing a Merchant Brazier. See the recipe below:

![Merchant Brazier Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/2U9Yoym.png)

The Merchant sells various upgrades for Firearms, as well as First Aid Spray, gunpowder and a map to the Castle - all for a new currency called pesetas. Pesetas can be found in the new Castle dungeon. (A Castle Map can also be bought for an emerald in case you haven't found a Castle naturally).

## ![Castle Icon](https://i.imgur.com/D9gEJ1h.png) The Castle

The Castle is a large, procedurally generated dungeon that contains difficult challenges as well as a new currency, pesetas. You can also find various hidden treasures that the Merchant will exchange for pesetas. Every Castle also comes equipped with a Firearms Merchant and Workshop located in the Grand Hall.

Valid biomes the Castle can spawn in:
- Meadow
- Grove
- Stony Peaks
- Snowy Slopes
- Wooded Badlands

The Merchant sells an explorer map that leads to a nearby Castle.

## ![Mousley Icon](https://i.imgur.com/1RjReFz.png) Mousley

Mousley is a little inventory companion who's eager to accompany you on your journey! She'll eat Cheese out of your inventory which will level up her Love Meter. Every 25% of the meter, she'll grant you an extra half heart and a piece of bonus content (a cosmetic). The health bonus stacks to 2 extra hearts at 100%, although you'll lose the bonus if she's not in your inventory.

Find Mousley by placing a Cheese Block. She'll eventually start eating it, indicated by a quiet nibbling sound. Break the Cheese Block while in this state to find Mousley! Failing to break it in time will result in Mousley running away and the Cheese Block being consumed.

## ![Cheese Icon](https://i.imgur.com/Jb7f34E.png) Cheese

Cheese is a new food item that's used to level up Mousley, but can also be eaten on its own. Acquire Cheese by curdling milk in a Curdling Pot. See the recipe for a Curdling Pot below:

![Curdling Pot Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/4JfRqiI.png)

The Curdling Pot is filled by right clicking it with a milk bucket. Right click again with coal once filled to start curdling! The Cheese will then be ready in about 30 seconds.

Cheese can also be crafted into a Cheese Wheel or Cheese Block. Cheese Wheels are better for saturation efficiency, whereas Cheese Blocks are good for long-term storage and for finding Mousley.

![Cheese Wheel Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/Bu6dlU5.png)
![Cheese Block Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/X6TLHhe.png)

## ![Bonus Content Icon](https://i.imgur.com/sZb5ZIT.png) Bonus Content

Bonus content is granted by Mousley, and includes four new cosmetics. Each cosmetic has its own special effect when worn. If you ever lose a cosmetic, it can be re-obtained by purchasing the Gift Box from the Firearms Merchant.

![Mouse Ears Icon](https://i.imgur.com/Wbaet7V.png)
### Mouse Ears
+Cheese Potency

Causes a regeneration effect upon eating Cheese or Cheese Wheels.

![Red Beret Icon](https://i.imgur.com/Yr0glOv.png)
### Red Beret
+Combat Knife Speed

Causes the Combat Knife to have no attack cooldown.

![Gas Mask Icon](https://i.imgur.com/hMiLccd.png)
### Gas Mask
+20% Firearms Damage

Grants +20% damage to all Firearms (excludes Rocket Launcher).

![Cat Ears Icon](https://i.imgur.com/OwFsQbS.png)
### Cat Ears
+Infinite Ammo

No ammo usage when reloading Firearms.

## ![Miscellaneous Icon](https://i.imgur.com/93WCvhO.png) Miscellaneous

There are a few other items that don't fall under the other categories.

### Green Herbs

Green Herbs are a new healing item that drops from basic hostile mobs (zombies, skeletons, creepers, spiders) as well as mobs in the Castle. They can also rarely drop from fully grown crops. Consume Green Herbs to heal 4 hearts.

### First Aid Spray

A more powerful version of a Green Herb. Instantly consumed and fully heals. Crafted as follows:

![First Aid Spray Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/Ym0wwPX.png)

### Combat Knife

A new combat option for close range. Faster than an iron sword but not very durable. Very effective when combined with the Red Beret.

![Combat Knife Crafting Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/gANcsoQ.png)

## Creative Mode

Any item in the datapack can be obtained by entering /function firearms:give/x into chat.

Here's a few shortcuts:
- /function firearms:give/all_firearms
- /function firearms:give/all_parts
- /function firearms:give/all_upgrades
- /function firearms:give/all_gifts
- /function firearms:give/all_treasures

## Credits

catbreadloaf, M1dnightAsh

M1dnightAsh made:
- The entire Castle
- Ornate Necklace
- Elegant Crown

TechnoGhosty, whose Leon S. Kennedy skin is featured in the thumbnail (see [here](https://www.planetminecraft.com/skin/leon-s-kennedy-jacket-resident-evil-4-1-8/)).

Thanks for playing with this datapack!

title: SmooHUD Dark
description: A smooth and colour-consistent HUD rework, using a dark colour scheme
body:
# SmooHUD Dark

SmooHUD (Smooth HUD) Dark transforms your HUD and makes it smooth and cohesive, using a dark and consistent colour scheme with as few (shades of) colours as possible to keep it simple and smooth.

As of v1.1, SmooHUD has support for [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin).

Attribute icons are also changed to be more colourful/contrasting and smooth.

This is the Dark version of SmooHUD, and currently this is the only version. SmooHUD will most likely be made available in more colour schemes in the future when I have time. I intend, but do not promise to at least release a Grey and Light (white) version of SmooHUD.

SmooHUD isn't the only SmooPack available. See below for SmooPacks that alter other parts of the GUI.

## SmooPacks

Check out all currently available SmooHUDs in the [SmooHUD Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/R1YmDDaC).

You can also download only the selected slot texture as a standalone resource pack by downloading any of the [SmooHUD Selector Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/eRZkOenV). This will become useful only if and once I add more colour schemes, as then you'll be able to mix and match colours.

If you want to have a smooth options background, download any of the [SmooBack Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/VZGPEYKa).

If you want to overhaul the rest of your GUI in the same style as SmooHUD, download any of the [SmooGUI Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/QRoetCy4).

description: Now the Wither has its own home — the Wither Fortress, and you can no longer outmaneuver it.│現在凋靈有了自己的家──凋靈堡壘，你再也無法巧勝它。
body:
**⚠️ This data pack requires the server-side mod [Bedrock Crafter](https://modrinth.com/mod/bedrock-crafter).│該資料包需要伺服器端模組[Bedrock Crafter](https://modrinth.com/mod/bedrock-crafter)。 ⚠️**
# Function│功能
- In the Nether, Wither Fortresses made of bedrock will generate, which include a main castle, roads, chest towers, and summoning towers.|在下界會生成由基岩組成的凋零堡壘，其中包含主堡、道路、寶箱塔、召喚塔。
  - Main Castle: The area where the Wither roams when idle, with four gates leading outwards.│主堡：凋零怪閒置狀態下活動的區域，有四個門向外延伸道路。
  - Roads: There are three types — straight roads, curved roads, and forked roads. Treasure chest towers always appear at the end of the road.│道路：有直線、彎道、岔路三種，末端總會生成寶箱塔。
    - Streetlights: There is a 5% chance that a streetlight will generate above each bedrock wall on the road, with a bedrock lamp at the top for illumination.│路燈：道路的每個基岩牆上方有5%概率生成，頂端有基岩燈做為照明。
  - Chest Tower: A tower with stairs leading to the top, where a treasure chest containing rich loot awaits.│寶箱塔：一座塔，有樓梯可以爬到塔頂，塔頂有一個寶箱，有豐厚的戰利品。

title: EzSeasons
description: Configure advanced resets for your world and other plugins
body:
## Make your server ready for wipe

Standalone season reset scheduler for Minecraft servers - EzSeasons

---

## Summary
EzSeasons schedules and broadcasts season resets for Bukkit and Paper servers. It is a focused reset Minecraft plugin designed for server owners who run periodic wipes, seasons, or server resets.

## Features
- Automatic season reset scheduling (explicit windows or duration-based)
- Explicit scheduling: `season.start` and `season.end`
- Fallback duration scheduling: `season.length-days`
- Optional recurring windows: `season.recurring`
- Reminder broadcasts: `season.reminder-minutes`, `season.reminder-message`
- Reset broadcast: `season.broadcast-message`
- Runtime admin commands and status reporting
- Developer API: `SeasonsApi`, `SeasonsIntegration`, `SeasonResetEvent`

## Quick Install (Bukkit / Paper)
1. Drop the plugin jar into your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Start or restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` to set schedule and messages.

## Example configuration (config.yml)
```yaml
season:
  enabled: true
  # Use explicit timestamps (millis) for a specific window, or leave 0 to use length-days
  start: 0
  end: 0
  recurring: false
  length-days: 30
  check-interval-minutes: 5
  broadcast-message: "Season resets in {time}!"
  reminder-minutes: [60, 30, 10, 1]
  reminder-message: "Season resets in {minutes} minute(s)!"
```

## Commands
- `/season` - show current status and next reset
- `/season admin reload` - reload plugin config
- `/season admin reset [reason]` - trigger an immediate reset (admin only)
- `/season admin setnext <unixMillis>` - set next reset time manually
- `/season admin clear-next` - clear next-reset override

## Permissions
- `lifesteal.season` (default: true) - allows `/season`
- `lifesteal.admin` (default: op) - allows all admin commands

## Developer API
Obtain `SeasonsApi` via Bukkit Services Manager. Available methods:
- `registerIntegration(SeasonsIntegration integration)`
- `unregisterIntegration(SeasonsIntegration integration)`
- `getIntegrations()`
- `triggerSeasonReset(String reason)`

Events published:
- `SeasonResetEvent`
- `SeasonsIntegrationRegisteredEvent`
- `SeasonsIntegrationUnregisteredEvent`

## Best Practices for Server Owners
- Always test reset behavior on a staging server before scheduling production wipes.
- Combine EzSeasons with your backup tooling - EzSeasons does not perform backups.
- Use `season.reminder-minutes` to announce the reset early and reduce player frustration.

## Support & License
- Source & docs: https://github.com/ez-plugins/EzSeasons
- Download (Modrinth): https://modrinth.com/plugin/ezseasons
- Report issues: https://github.com/ez-plugins/EzSeasons/issues
- License: MIT

title: Create TFMG: Network Fix
description: Fixes TFMG recipe fields not syncing over the network, causing JEI to display vat recipes without machine modules on dedicated servers.
body:
On dedicated servers, several TFMG recipe types do not serialize their custom fields into the network buffer. When the server sends recipes to clients, these fields arrive empty:

- **VatMachineRecipe** loses `machines`, `allowedVatTypes`, and `minSize` — JEI displays vat recipes without machine modules (mixer, centrifuge, electrodes) and without material overlays (firebrick, cast iron).
- **IndustrialBlastingRecipe** loses `hotAirUsage` — blast furnace recipes show incorrect hot air requirements.

This only affects dedicated servers. In singleplayer, recipes are loaded directly from JSON, so all fields are present.

### How it works

The mod uses Mixin to inject into the `writeAdditional(FriendlyByteBuf)` and `readAdditional(FriendlyByteBuf)` methods of both recipe classes. The missing fields are appended at the tail of the network buffer. No original TFMG code is replaced — the existing logic runs as-is.

description: This project adds a new amazing anti-Cheat to prevent those pesky hackers!
body:
Guardian Anti-Cheat – Powerful Protection for Paper 1.21.x

Guardian Anti-Cheat is a modern, high-performance anti-cheat plugin built specifically for Paper 1.21.x servers. Designed for accuracy, speed, and reliability, Guardian protects your server from unfair advantages while keeping gameplay smooth for legitimate players.

Using advanced movement analysis, packet validation, and behavioral detection systems, Guardian Anti-Cheat can identify a wide range of cheats in real time. The system continuously analyzes player actions to detect exploits such as fly hacks, speed hacks, reach, kill aura, autoclickers, scaffold, and other combat or movement modifications.

Guardian is built with a modular architecture, allowing server owners to easily configure and fine-tune detection checks to match their server’s gameplay style. Each check includes adjustable thresholds, detailed logging, and optional verbose alerts to help staff monitor suspicious behavior without overwhelming the console.

Key Features

🛡 Advanced Cheat Detection – Detects combat, movement, and packet-based cheats
⚡ Optimized for Paper 1.21.x – Lightweight and designed for high-performance servers
🔧 Highly Configurable – Customize checks, thresholds, and punishments
📡 Real-Time Staff Alerts – Instantly notify moderators when suspicious activity occurs
📊 Detailed Logging & Debug Tools – Track violations with clear and informative logs
🔌 Modular Check System – Enable, disable, or adjust individual detections
👨‍💻 Developer-Friendly API – Extend Guardian with custom checks or integrations

Guardian Anti-Cheat focuses on accuracy and stability, minimizing false positives while providing strong protection against modern cheat clients. Whether you run a competitive PvP network or a casual survival server, Guardian keeps your server fair, secure, and cheat-free.

title: Intensive Optimization
description: Intensive Optimization boosts FPS using mods like Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, FerriteCore, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast, C2ME, VMP, More Culling, and Enhanced Block Entities. It’s only for 1.19.4 for now, with more versions coming.
body: The **_Intensive Optimization_** modpack focuses on pushing Minecraft **1.19.4** to its highest possible framerate by combining a carefully selected set of performance‑oriented mods that overhaul rendering, simulation, memory usage, and GPU workload. It uses _Sodium, Lithium, and Starlight_ as the core trio for faster rendering, physics, and lighting; _FerriteCore, ModernFix, and LazyDFU_ to reduce memory pressure and smooth out garbage collection; _ImmediatelyFast, FastAnim, Enhanced Block Entities, and More Culling_ to cut down draw calls and simplify what the GPU has to render; and _C2ME, VMP, and Let Me Despawn_ to improve chunk loading, entity ticking, and world simulation. Additional refinements like_ Exordium, FastQuit, Krypton, and GPUBooster_ help reduce overhead in menus, networking, and overlays. Right now, the modpack is available only for Minecraft **1.19.4**, since many of these optimizations are version‑sensitive and require careful compatibility testing. Support for newer versions is planned, but not ready yet. Users who want to add Iris or Nvidium should do so cautiously, as shader engines and experimental renderers may conflict with the pack’s optimizations and are not officially supported. For even higher FPS, players can experiment with increasing **RAM allocation** (within reasonable limits) and trying different** Java arguments** from trusted optimization communities to find the best setup for your hardware.
