title: Mobs Love Darkness
description: This mod gives certain mobs a chance to fixate on and destroy nearby light sources, creating dangerous dark zones and rewarding players who pay attention.
body:
# Mobs Love Darkness

![Zombie with torch emitting darkness](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06200021d208e8553c9457b899007c93a793e55e.jpeg)

A Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1, 1.21.1 and 1.21.11 that gives certain mobs a chance to fixate on and destroy nearby light sources, creating dangerous dark zones and rewarding players who pay attention.

## What it does

Some mobs will occasionally lock onto nearby torches, lanterns, and campfires and attempt to destroy them. A fixated mob glows and emits soul fire particles, giving an observant player a chance to react before their lighting is gone. Once the mob reaches the light source it breaks it, playing a distinctive sound and returning to normal behavior in the newly created darkness.

Phantoms may occasionally destroy exposed torches during their swooping attacks, making open-air lighting somewhat vulnerable at night — but their erratic flight means covered lighting remains relatively safe.

Everything is highly configurable.

## Features

- Configurable list of eligible mob types — any mob can be added via config
- Configurable list of targetable blocks — works with any block ID including modded blocks
- Per-mob-type goal assignment chance — phantoms can be tuned separately from high-spawn mobs like zombies
- Optional glowing effect on fixated mobs for player readability
- Optional soul fire particle trail while fixating
- Optional distinctive sounds on fixation start and light source destruction
- Unreachable targets are blacklisted per-mob to prevent stuck behavior
- Block protection mod compatible — protected blocks are detected and blacklisted gracefully
- All behavior is server-side only, no client installation required for multiplayer

## Default behavior

By default, the following mobs are eligible for the light fixation goal:

| Mob | Default eligibility chance |
|---|---|
| Zombie | 5% |
| Husk | 5% |
| Zombie Villager | 5% |
| Zombified Piglin | 5% |
| Phantom | 75% |

The following blocks are targeted by default:

- Torch / Wall Torch
- Lantern
- Soul Torch / Soul Lantern
- Campfire / Soul Campfire

## Configuration

The config file is generated at `config/mobs-love-darkness.json5` on first launch. All fields include descriptions and valid ranges directly in the file.

| Config | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `LightSourceSearchRadius` | 16 | Block radius to search for light sources. Range: 1–128 |
| `LightSourceSearchRadiusVertical` | 4 | Vertical block radius to search for light sources. Range: 1–128 |
| `LightSourceBreakTimeTicks` | 20 | Ticks to break a light source (20 ticks = 1 second). Range: 1–1200 |
| `LightFixationChance` | 0.05 | Chance per second that an eligible mob fixates on a nearby light source. Range: 0.0–1.0 |
| `LightFixationSpeedMultiplier` | 0.85 | Movement speed multiplier while fixating (1.0 = normal speed). Range: 0.1–10.0 |
| `LightFixationCooldownTicks` | 200 | Ticks before a mob can fixate again after destroying a light source. Range: 0–72000 |
| `LightFixationMaxGoalTicks` | 600 | Maximum ticks spent on a single fixation attempt before giving up. Range: 100–72000 |
| `LightFixationGoalPriority` | 3 | Goal priority (lower = higher priority, vanilla zombie attack = 2). Range: 1–10 |
| `EnableParticles` | true | Soul fire particle trail on fixated mobs |
| `EnableSounds` | true | Sounds on fixation start and light source destruction |
| `EnableLightFixationGlowEffect` | true | Glowing outline on fixated mobs |
| `TargetableLightSources` | see above | List of block IDs to target, including modded blocks |
| `LightFixationEligibilityChancePerMobType` | see above | Per-mob-type chance to receive the goal on spawn |

## Performance guidance

Search cost scales cubically with radius — a radius of 128 checks ~500x more 
blocks than a radius of 16. Balance search radius against mob eligibility:

| Search radius | Recommended max eligible mobs |
|---|---|
| 16 (default) | ~50 |
| 32 | ~20 |
| 64 | ~5 |
| 128 | ~1-2 |

`LightSourceSearchRadiusVertical` (default: 4) also contributes to search cost. 
Increasing it significantly will reduce performance — keep it low unless your 
use case specifically requires searching underground.

These are rough guidelines. Actual impact depends on hardware and other mods.

### Adding modded mobs and blocks

Any valid block or entity registry ID works in the config lists:

```json
"LightFixationEligibilityChancePerMobType": {
    "minecraft:zombie": 0.05,
    "minecraft:phantom": 0.75,
    "alexsmobs:warped_mosco": 0.10
},
"TargetableLightSources": [
    "minecraft:torch",
    "minecraft:wall_torch",
    "supplementaries:oil_lamp"
]
```

## Compatibility

**Game rules**
- This mod respects the mobGriefing game rule. If mobGriefing is disabled when a mob spawns, it will not receive the light fixation goal. Mobs that already have the goal when mobGriefing is disabled will stand down gracefully without breaking blocks.

**Works with:**
- Sodium, Iris, Lithium, and other performance mods
- Mods that add new mob types — add them via config
- Mods that add new light source blocks — add them via config

**Does not affect:**
- Client-side dynamic lights from shader mods — only actual world blocks are targeted
- Bedrock Edition — Java only

**Potential conflicts:**
- Mods that completely replace mob AI goal selectors may prevent the goal from being injected
- If goal priority conflicts with another mod, adjust `LightFixationGoalPriority` in config (vanilla zombie attack goal is priority 2)

**Block protection mods (GriefPrevention, FTB Chunks, etc.)**
— protected blocks are detected after a break attempt and blacklisted, preventing repeated attempts. Note: FTB Chunks mob griefing protection on Fabric only covers Endermen by default and will not prevent this mod's block breaking — use the mobGriefing game rule for global protection instead.

## Known limitations

- There is no distinction between player-placed and world-generated blocks — blocks that are naturally generated can also be targeted
- Phantoms have imprecise torch-targeting due to their flight navigation — this is somewhat by design, as accurate phantom targeting would be difficult to counter
- Disabling the mobGriefing game rule prevents new mobs from receiving the goal and prevents blocks from being broken by mobs that already have it

## GitHub
https://github.com/AndartaMC/mobs-love-darkness

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) — feel free to include this mod in modpacks.

title: Hypixel Zombies Helper + Tracker
description: An essential companion mod for Hypixel Zombies. Automatically displays your lobby's stats, allows full stat lookups, and features an Alien Arcadium strategy guide.
body:
# Zombies Helper for beginners + Tracker > **Important:** For the mod to work correctly (tracking kills, rounds, and map detection), your Hypixel language must be set to **English**. You can change this in-game by typing `/lang` or using `/profile`.
Background I was tired of queueing into Hypixel Zombies and getting matched with random teammates who clearly had no idea what they were doing… I also got tired of constantly alt-tabbing just to remember the AA strategy, so I made this...
**Hypixel Zombies Helper + Tracker** is the ultimate all-in-one companion for Hypixel Zombies. It goes far beyond simple stat checking: it provides an intelligent **Lobby Stats HUD** with automatic player sorting, a real-time **Session Tracker** for your gold and kills, a dynamic **Win Chance** estimator, and a built-in **Strategy Guide**. Whether you're looking to avoid bad lobbies, track your personal growth with the new **Gold Earned** counter, or show off your progress on Discord with our advanced **Rich Presence**, this mod is built for serious players and beginners alike. Now featuring **Multi-Language Support** (English, Spanish, French, German) and ultra-fast parallel API lookups. ## Features - **Strategy Guide & Custom Support**: Displays the standard AAEco strategy for Alien Arcadium or your own **custom JSON strategies** placed in `.minecraft/config/zombieshelper/example.json`. - **Lobby Stats HUD**: Automatically shows every teammate's Best Round, Wins, Kills, and **Fastest Win** (now tracking your best time across Normal, Hard, and RIP) the moment you join a lobby. Includes a live loading counter `(2/4)` and clearly labels **(Nicked)** players. - **Win Chance HUD**: A compact percentage bar that appears in the lobby, estimating your team's probability of success based on a blend of Best Round and total Wins. - **Discord Rich Presence**: Your Discord status now dynamically reflects your game state (e.g., "Playing Alien Arcadium | Round 18 | Kills: 214"). This is a zero-dependency implementation that works out of the box. - **Session Logger**: A dedicated HUD panel to track your progress across your current play session, including Games Played, Wins, WLR, Kills, and Session Time. - **In-Game Stat Lookup**: Type `/zh w ` anytime to pull up a full stat sheet across all maps (Dead End, Bad Blood, Alien Arcadium, Prison) — including downs, revives, doors, windows, kills, deaths, best round, wins, and best fastest win time. - **Smart Player Detection & Speed**: The mod uses a **parallel triple API lookup** and session-based caching to identify players up to 3x faster. It returns results as soon as the first API responds, making the HUD appear nearly instantly. - **Fully Customizable UI**: Move the HUDs wherever you want or change their size from the OneConfig menu. Press **`Z`** (or type `/zh`) to open it. - **English & Spanish Support**: The mod is fully bilingual. You can swap the language from the OneConfig menu. ## Setup You'll need a Hypixel API key for the stat tracker to work. 1. Go to the [Hypixel Developer Portal](https://developer.hypixel.net/) and create a personal API key. 2. Press **`Z`** in-game (or type `/zh`) to open the mod menu, paste the key into the **Hypixel API Key** field, and click **Apply**. ### Custom Strategies You can now use your own round-by-round instructions! 1. Create a JSON file following the strategy format. 2. Place it in `.minecraft/config/zombieshelper_strategies/`. 3. Select your custom strategy in the OneConfig menu under **Strategies**. ## Commands The mod is controlled via the `/zh` command (aliases: `/zs`, `/zombieshelper`). You can also press **`Z`** at any time to open the configuration menu directly. The keybind can be changed from Minecraft's Controls settings. | Command | Description | |---|---| | `/zh w ` | Opens a full stat sheet for the specified player across all Zombies maps. | | `/zh debug` | Prints internal game-state info (current map, round, scoreboard lines) to help diagnose issues. | ## FAQ
Is this mod allowed / bannable on Hypixel? This mod is completely client-side. It simply reads the public tab-list and pulls information officially from the Hypixel API, without sending any weird packets or modifying gameplay mechanics. Like all mods, it is technically "use at your own risk," but it functions identically to standard HUD overlays.
How is the Win Chance calculated? The Win Chance HUD blends each teammate's Best Round (60%) and total Wins (40%) into a probability score. We use realistic ceilings (30 rounds / 50 wins) to keep the percentage accurate. Players identified as **(Nicked)** contribute a neutral 40% to keep the estimate fair.
Why does a player show up as "(Nicked)"? If the mod labels a player as (Nicked), it means their in-game name was definitively confirmed to not exist across multiple lookup APIs. This is a very reliable indicator that the player is using a nick. If the APIs simply fail due to a network error, the mod will inform you instead of incorrectly labeling them as nicked.
Why does a player show up with 0 / 0 / 0 stats? This usually means one of three things: they have never played Zombies, they are nicked, or the API request timed out. The mod automatically retries up to 3 times before giving up.
I am getting an API Error (Code 403), what does it mean? A 403 means your Hypixel API key has expired or is invalid. Open the `/zh` menu, paste a new key into the Hypixel API Key field, and click Apply.
The Strategy Guide isn't showing up? The guide appears once you are in a match and the first round has started. Ensure that: 1. The HUD is enabled in the `/zh` menu. 2. You have a valid strategy selected (Official or Custom). 3. You are playing on a map that has a strategy defined.
Can I use this on other Minecraft servers? No, this mod is strictly built around Hypixel's scoreboard format and API.
Does it work in all languages? While the mod has Multi-Language Support (English, Spanish, French, German), for the most stable and accurate experience, it is highly recommended to set your Hypixel language to English. You can change it in-game using /lang or through /profile.
--- > **Important:** For the mod to work correctly (tracking kills, rounds, and map detection), your Hypixel language must be set to **English**. You can change this in-game by typing `/lang` or using `/profile`. Requires **Minecraft Forge 1.8.9**. Just drop the jar in your mods folder and you're good to go!

title: Arcanum Unbound
description: Arcanum Unbound - is a mod that adds magic and artifact crafting. You as a wizard need to become strongest. The mod has an experimental philosophy of sacrifice and the price of strength, be ready for the challenges.
body:
# Arcanum Unbound

**Arcanum Unbound** is a dark-fantasy magic mod for **Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge)** focused on personal power, dangerous knowledge, and unstable progression.

This is not an ore-grind magic mod.  
Power comes from mastering **mana, sigils, relics, corruption, and forbidden soul mechanics**.

## Core Features

### Mana, Instability, and Corruption
Each player grows around a personal mana profile. Strong magic always comes at a cost: high-output casting builds **instability**, and **Abyss corruption** is part of the core risk-reward loop.

### Modular Sigil Magic
Spells are built from sigils in a dedicated interface. **Cores, forms, and modifiers** combine into different costs, behaviors, combat roles, and late-game builds.

### Progression Through Knowledge
Deeper magic is unlocked through key items, milestones, and survival choices. You do not start with full control over the system.

### Artifacts and Relics With Tradeoffs
Artifacts roll unique identities with powerful strengths and dangerous flaws. Weapons, relics, rings, and other wearable pieces support real build variety instead of simple stat stacking.

### Soul Mechanics and Death Manipulation
Forbidden rituals can store power in soul-bound objects and alter how death works. In multiplayer, this creates high-stakes interactions and dangerous long-term consequences.

### Weapon Imprinting
Rare imprinting allows existing weapons to be branded with special materials through smithing. Different materials create different combat identities rather than acting as simple upgrades.

### Rare World Discoveries
The world hides deeper magical finds, including **warped geode materials**, **structure relics**, and the ultra-rare **Deepwater Abyss** biome with its own hostile life.

### In-Game Guidebook
A full in-game guidebook provides progression help, crafting references, boss guidance, and system explanations, making the mod learnable in survival without depending on external wikis.

## World Style

**No new dimensions. Vanilla structures still matter.**

Arcanum Unbound stays grounded in the base world while adding rare and dangerous discoveries that make exploration feel heavier, stranger, and more deliberate.

## Utility and Flavor

- Structure Compass support for progression routing
- Visual corruption layer at high Abyss infection
- Ongoing UI, FX, SFX, and model polish
- Expanded Curios integration for relic builds

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.1
- **Loader:** NeoForge
- **Recommended NeoForge:** 21.1.219+
- **Dependency:** Curios API
- **support:** [boosty](https://boosty.to/strdsts)

title: Shaper
description: A support API for loading and exporting JSON voxel shapes for hitboxes
body:
# Shaper – Support Tool for Voxel Shape Exporting

**Shaper** is a support API for modders to **define, load, and export voxel shapes (hitboxes)** efficiently.  
You can either use the **Blockbench integration** (via the Shaper plugin) to export shapes directly, or write your own hitbox JSON files by hand. More details can be found in the wiki.  
Shaper supports **Fabric, Forge, and Quilt**.

## Key Features

| Feature                  | Description                                                                 |
|---------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Blockbench Integration** | Export hitboxes directly from Blockbench using the Shaper plugin.           |
| **Manual JSON Support**    | Write hitboxes manually in JSON format (see wiki for examples).             |
| **Voxel Shape Export**     | Uses flat JSON lists for easy editing and reuse.                            |                        |
| **Support Tool**           | Simplifies and speeds up hitbox creation for developers.                    |
| **Extensible & Modular**   | Fully compatible with Fabric, Forge, and Quilt modding pipelines.           |

# Item Progression
This mod adds a leveling system, which prevents players from using certain items before they reach a specified level in the corresponding skills.
The list of available skills and requirements is **fully configurable**.
Additionally the mod makes spawners and fully grown crop blocks drop a specified range of xp; this can be configured or disabled in the same config file.
<details>
<summary>Example Configuration</summary>

```json
{
  "skills": [
      {
        "name": "Example Skill 1",
        "iconItem": "minecraft:apple",
        "maxLevel": 100
      },
      {
        "name": "Example Skill 2",
        "iconItem": "minecraft:stick",
        "maxLevel": 50
      }
  ],
  
  ...

  "itemMap": {
    "minecraft:torch": 
    {
      "Example Skill 1": 20,

}
```

title: AwesomeKeycards
description: AwesomeKeycards lets you turn any item into a digital keycard, lock interactive blocks, and share access with trusted players.
body:
# AwesomeKeycards

**Author:** NeonDev  
**Platform:** PaperMC 1.21.8  
**Language:** Kotlin (2.3.0-Beta2) using Gradle + Shadow + run-paper.  
**Version:** 1.4.1

AwesomeKeycards lets you turn any item into a digital keycard, lock interactive blocks, and share access with trusted players. It is designed for modern survival servers that want lightweight door/loot protection without relying on heavy land-claim systems.

---

## Feature Highlights

- 🔐 **Custom-labeled keycards** – `/keycard create [global|team <team>] <label>` converts the held item with a unique ID, plus optional color/style/auto-close/double/notify/cooldown presets.
- 🚪 **Block locking** – lock doors, trapdoors, fence gates, buttons, chests, barrels, furnaces, shulkers, etc. Only matching keycards (or shared users) can interact.
- 👥 **Shareable access** – card owners can grant or revoke access via `/keycard access add/remove/list`, perfect for roommates or faction mates.
- 🧩 **Flexible key types** – create personal (default), `global`, or `team <name>` keys to match open-access lobbies or scoreboard-managed squads.
- 🎛️ **Command presets** – set accent color, effect style, auto-close timer, double-door sync, owner alerts, and cooldown defaults right on the `create` command.
- 📦 **Admin vault** – `/keycard vault` lists every keycard with quick cloning and revoke options that also clean up locks.
- 👁️ **Lock inspection** – shift-right-click a locked block with any keycard to see its linked key, owner, and a copyable ID (admins only).
- 🚪 **Door customization** – `/keycard door` (owner, no admin perm) controls auto-close timers, double-door syncing, owner alerts, cooldowns, style presets, nicknames, and a copy/paste clipboard for fast setup.
- 🌈 **Style presets** – pick classic, stealth, or spark effects per lock to change particle colors and sounds.
- 🔔 **Owner alerts** – optional pings when someone uses your lock, throttled to avoid spam.
- ⏱️ **Use cooldowns** – rate-limit rapid spam on doors or buttons with a per-lock delay.
- 🧾 **Door status HUD** – instant summary of the targeted lock’s nickname and toggles via `/keycard door status`.
- 🗂️ **Config clipboard** – copy/paste lock settings between doors to set up bases quickly.
- 🎨 **Visual feedback** – particle trails + jingles on lock/unlock and a subtle denied tone when access is blocked.
- 💾 **Persistent storage** – locks saved to `locks.yml`, cards + ACL to `keycards.yml`, ensuring safety across restarts.
- ⚙️ **Fine-grained permissions** – admin-only workflow for creating/locking, but anyone with the access permission can manage sharing for their own cards.
- 🧠 **Team watchdog** – optional allow/deny lists plus automatic pruning of team keys tied to removed teams keep ACLs clean.
- 📜 **Audit log** – `/keycard audits` tail recent lock/unlock attempts with player, key short ID, and location.

---

## Commands

| Command                                                                                                                                                               | Permission                                                         | Description                                                                                                         |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `/keycard create [global/team <team>] <label> [color=<name>] [style=<preset>] [autoclose=<seconds/off>] [double=<on/off>] [notify=<on/off>] [cooldown=<seconds/off>]` | `awesomekeycards.admin` | Converts the held item into a labeled keycard with optional defaults for future locks. |
| `/keycard lock`                                                                                                                                                       | `awesomekeycards.admin`                                            | Links the held keycard to the block you are looking at (6 block reach).                                             |
| `/keycard unlock`                                                                                                                                                     | `awesomekeycards.admin`                                            | Unlocks a block if you hold the linked keycard.                                                                     |
| `/keycard access add <player>`                                                                                                                                        | `awesomekeycards.access`                                           | Grants another player the ability to use the current keycard.                                                       |
| `/keycard access remove <player>`                                                                                                                                     | `awesomekeycards.access`                                           | Revokes access for a player.                                                                                        |
| `/keycard access list`                                                                                                                                                | `awesomekeycards.access`                                           | Lists everyone who can use the current keycard.                                                                     |
| `/keycard view`                                                                                                                                                       | `awesomekeycards.access`                                           | Displays owner, scope, and sharing details for the held keycard.                                                    |
| `/keycard door <status/autoclose/double/notify/cooldown/style/nickname/copy/paste>`                                                                                   | `awesomekeycards.access` (owner or admin)                          | Customize the targeted locked block: timers, double-door syncing, alerts, styles, nicknames, and clipboard actions. |
| `/keycard vault [page]`                                                                                                                                               | `awesomekeycards.admin`                                            | Browse all stored keycards, clone them, or revoke + clean locks.                                                    |
| `/keycard audits [player] [count]`                                                                                                                                    | `awesomekeycards.admin`                                            | Show the most recent audit lines; defaults to 10 entries.                                                           |

> Hold the keycard item in your main hand before running any command.  
> By default `awesomekeycards.admin` is OP-only, while `awesomekeycards.access` is granted to all players so they can manage their own cards.

Example: `/keycard create global Lobby color=gold style=sparks autoclose=5 double=off notify=on cooldown=3`

---

## Supported Blocks

- All **doors**, **trapdoors**, **fence gates**, and **buttons** (via Bukkit tags).  
- Utility blocks: levers, barrels, chests (normal & trapped), furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces, droppers, dispensers, hoppers, shulker boxes (all colors).  
- When locking double-doors, aim at the lower half; the plugin normalizes coordinates so both halves stay linked and, if enabled, will sync open/close on both sides.

---

## Keycard Types

- **Personal** – default behavior. Owner plus manually shared UUIDs can operate linked blocks.  
- **Global** – `/keycard create global <label>` lets every player interact with blocks locked to that key (great for spawn doors that still log activity).  
- **Team** – `/keycard create team <teamName> <label>` ties the lock to a vanilla scoreboard team (`/team add Guards`). Any member of that team can open the block without needing the physical item.  

Use `/keycard view` while holding a card to confirm its scope, owner, and share list before distributing copies.

---

## Door Customization (no admin needed)

Owners (or admins) looking at a locked block can run `/keycard door ...`:
- `status` – show nickname plus all toggles for the targeted lock.
- `autoclose <seconds|off>` – close doors/fence gates/trapdoors automatically after a delay.
- `double <on|off>` – open/close both halves of a double door together.
- `notify <on|off>` – ping the owner when others use the lock (throttled).
- `cooldown <seconds|off>` – add a short delay to prevent spammy toggling.
- `style <classic|stealth|sparks>` – change particles/sounds per lock.
- `nickname <name|off>` – friendly label shown in status/alerts.
- `copy` / `paste` – clone all these settings between locks to set up bases quickly.

Defaults you set on `/keycard create` (color, style, auto-close, double-door, alerts, cooldown) are saved on the keycard and applied to locks the next time you link that card to a block.  
All customization uses the `awesomekeycards.access` permission (default true) and only requires owning the key, not server admin.

---

## Configuration

- `teamAccess.allow` / `teamAccess.deny` (lists) gate which scoreboard teams can be used for team keycards; leave `allow` empty to allow all by default.
- `teamAccess.watchdogIntervalTicks` controls how often stale/blocked team keycards are pruned.
- Audit logs are written to `plugins/AwesomeKeycards/audit.log` and can be tailed in-game with `/keycard audits`.

title: SimpleWarps
description: A plugin that allows you to teleport to your custom warps.
body:
# SimpleWarps
#### By TomMustBe12
A clean, fast, GUI-based warp plugin for Paper/Spigot servers.  
Includes warp management commands, permissions, GUI menu, teleport particles, messages, and an automatic update checker.

---

## Features
- Create unlimited warps
- Delete warps
- Warp GUI menu
- Fully persistent storage
- No manual config editing
- Simple, clean commands

---

## Commands

- /setwarp <name>
Creates a warp at your current position.

- /delwarp <name>
Deletes the target warp.

- /warp <name>
Teleports you to the warp, or using just /warp shows a GUI of all warps.

---

## Permissions

- simplewarps.setwarp  
Allows creating a warp.
Default: op

- simplewarps.delwarp  
Allows deleting warps.
Default: op

- simplewarps.warp  
Allows using /warp and the GUI.
Default: everyone

---

## How To Use
1. Install the plugin into your `/plugins/` folder.
2. Restart the server.
3. Use `/setwarp home` to create your first warp.
4. Use `/warp home` to teleport home.
5. Use `/warp` to open the GUI of all warps.

Everything is saved automatically.

---

## Config
The plugin generates a config.yml that stores:
- Warp locations & names

You usually never need to modify it manually.

---

## Support
Need help or want more features?
Join the discord linked to this project.

title: JobPointsShop
description: A comprehensive Job Points voucher system for Minecraft servers using the Jobs Reborn plugin. Create redeemable vouchers, collectible event items, and custom items with full administrative control.
body:
# JobPointsShop - Jobs Reborn Addon

A comprehensive **Job Points management system** for Minecraft servers. Create redeemable vouchers, manage sellable items, and provide players with an intuitive economy system integrated with Jobs Reborn.

---

## Dependencies

**REQUIRED:** [JobsReborn](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/jobs-reborn.4216/)

This plugin is an addon for Jobs Reborn and will not work without it!

---

## Features

### Job Points Vouchers
- **Create vouchers** that players can redeem for job points
- **Single-use system** - vouchers are consumed when used
- **Auto-redeem** if player's inventory is full
- **Bulk distribution** with `/jgiveall` + custom messages
- **Mob drop vouchers** for special rewards

### Collectible Items
- **Event Vouchers** (`/jevent`) - Commemorative items for special events
- **Custom Collectibles** (`/jitem`) - Achievement rewards, rank-up items
- Cannot be redeemed - kept as memorabilia
- Shows event name and timestamp

### Advanced SellAll System
- **Visual GUI** for selling items with prices
- **Item Configuration GUI** - Place items directly to set prices 
- **Chat-based Q&A flow** - 3 simple questions to configure any item
- **Stack-only mode** - Require full stacks for selling
- **Per-block mode** - Sell any amount of items
- **Auto-sell system** with two modes:
  - `all` - Auto-sell all configured items when picked up
  - `hand` - Auto-sell only items matching hand

### Polish & Quality of Life
- **Cooldown system** (1 second) to prevent spam
- **Visual effects** - titles, sounds, particles
- **Full color support** with Minecraft color codes
- **Smart validation** - prevents invalid configurations
- **Real-time updates** - changes take effect immediately

---

## Item Configuration GUI (Best Feature!)

### How It Works
1. Type `/jobpointshop config` as admin
2. Place ANY item in the chest GUI
3. Answer 3 simple questions in chat:
   - **Q1:** How many items per stack? (16/32/64)
   - **Q2:** How much for 1 stack? (points)
   - **Q3:** Stack-only or per-block?

### Example
```
Admin places DIAMOND in GUI
Q1: 64          → Stack size is 64 items
Q2: 100         → 100 points for 1 full stack
Q3: block       → Players can sell any amount

Result: 100 ÷ 64 = 1.5625 points per diamond
- Sell 1 diamond = 1.56 points
- Sell 64 diamonds (1 stack) = 100 points
- Sell 640 diamonds (10 stacks) = 1000 points
```

**No more manual config.yml editing!**

---

## Commands

### Job Points Vouchers
| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/jgive <player> <points>` | Give a player a voucher | `jobpoints.admin` |
| `/jgiveme <points>` | Give yourself a voucher | `jobpoints.admin` |
| `/jmob <points>` | Create mob drop voucher | `jobpoints.admin` |
| `/jgiveall <points> [msg]` | Give all online players | `jobpoints.admin` |
| `/jevent <event name>` | Create event collectible | `jobpoints.admin` |
| `/jitem <title> <desc>` | Create custom collectible | `jobpoints.admin` |
| `/jcheck` | Check voucher details | `jobpoints.admin` |
| `/jhelp` | Show help menu | `jobpoints.admin` |

### Item Configuration
| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/jobpointshop config` | Open config GUI ⭐ | `jobpoints.admin` |
| `/sellallprice <item> <price>` | Set price (old method) | `sellall.admin` |
| `/sellallremove <item>` | Remove item | `sellall.admin` |
| `/sellallreload` | Reload config | `sellall.admin` |

### Player Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/sellall` or `/sall` | Open sell GUI | `sellall.use` |
| `/shand` | Sell all matching items | `sellall.use` |
| `/sauto [all\|hand]` | Toggle auto-sell | `sellall.use` |
| `/sellall prices` | View all prices | `sellall.use` |

---

## Player Usage

### Redeeming Vouchers
1. **Right-click** any Job Points or Mob Drop voucher
2. Voucher is **consumed** and points are added
3. See **title notification** and hear sound effect
4. If inventory is full, points are auto-redeemed

### Selling Items
1. Use `/shand` to quickly sell all matching items
2. Use `/sauto hand` to auto-sell items matching your hand
3. Use `/sauto all` to auto-sell all configured items
4. Open `/sellall` GUI to see prices and sell manually

---

## Installation

1. **Install** [JobsReborn](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/jobs-reborn.4216/) first (REQUIRED)
2. **Download** JobPointsShop-1.0.0.jar
3. **Place** in your server's `plugins/` folder
4. **Restart** your server
5. **Configure** permissions in your permission plugin
6. **Start** using `/jobpointshop config` to set up items!

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.x (Paper/Spigot)
- **Java:** 17+
- **Required:** Jobs Reborn (latest version)

---

## Use Cases

### For Server Owners
- **Event rewards** - Give commemorative vouchers for participation
- **Rank rewards** - Custom collectibles for rank-ups
- **Economy control** - Fine-tune item values with stack/block modes
- **Player engagement** - Auto-sell reduces inventory management hassle

### For Players
- **Easy selling** - `/shand` to quickly sell items
- **Auto-sell** - Never worry about full inventories
- **Clear pricing** - GUI shows exactly what each item is worth
- **Collectibles** - Keep event vouchers as memorabilia

See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for full terms.

This addon is proprietary software. **Do not redistribute, modify, or claim as your own.**

---

## Bug Reports & Support

Found a bug? Have a suggestion?

- **Discord:** dei0

---

## Credits

**Based on:** Jobs Reborn by Zrips  
**Platform:** Paper/Spigot 1.21.x  

---

## Links

- **Jobs Reborn:** [Spigot](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/jobs-reborn.4216/)

body:
DeathBroadcast is a lightweight, no-config, quality-of-life plugin for Minecraft servers.
Whenever a player dies, their exact death location (X, Y, Z) and the world they were in (Overworld, Nether, End) will be broadcasted in chat to all players.

# **⁉️ Why ?**
This removes the guesswork of where someone perished and makes recovering lost items much easier.

The player you see in the screenshot below, is the one that kept dying without knowing where. He's my source of inspiration for creating this plugin.

![screenshot of the chat message of a player dying in the nether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6537bb183190392a2d81c18809651959fc79abfd.png)

# **✅ Features**
- Shows exact death coordinates (X, Y, Z) in chat.
- Displays the world name (Overworld, Nether, End).
- Lightweight — no configuration needed.
- Small delay ensures the broadcast appears after the vanilla death message.
- Fully server-side — no mods or client installs required.

# **🛠️ Installation**
- Download the latest .jar file.
- Drop it into your server’s plugins folder.
- Restart your server — done!

# **⚡ Compatibility**
Works on Paper 1.20.x and above (so 1.21.x) as well as on forks like Purpur/Folia).

This is a small plugin that runs on all major Minecraft Servers.  
The only feature is listing the server as a LanServer in the Multiplayer-Menu of Minecraft.  

# Supported Servers
- Bukkit/Spigot/Paper 1.8+ (and Folia)
- Bungeecord 1.16+
- Velocity 3.0.1+

# What does it do exactly?
The same as the Minecraft Client when you open your world to LAN.  
It sends every 1.5 seconds a special message with the server port and MOTD to `224.0.2.60` on port 4445.
`224.0.2.60` is a Multicast Address which means that everyone in your local network that wants
to get messages sent to `224.0.2.60` will get them like your Minecraft Client when you're in the Multiplayer Menu.

That's all it does, so compatibility should not break when updating to newer Server versions.

# Config
To keep the plugin small and working on all servers, there is no config file.
Instead, Java System Properties are used, which you can set in your server startup script
using `-Ddev.redstones.lanservers.setting=value` before the `-jar` argument.

| Java System Property                     | Description                                       | Default Behaviour                |
|------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| `dev.redstones.lanservers.bindAddresses` | Comma separated list of IP addresses to send from | All interface addresses are used |

title: Teleport structure
description: An advanced teleportation system that allows players to build and link physical structures in the world to create a network of instant travel points.
body:
# TeleportStructure
## Build Your Own Travel Network!
---
**TeleportStructure introduces a balanced and immersive fast-travel system, moving away from simple commands. Players must gather resources and build physical structures in the world to create a permanent and rewarding travel network. It's the perfect solution for survival servers where convenience must be earned.**

---
## Features
* **Structure-Based Teleportation:** No more teleport commands! Travel happens by physically interacting with player-built structures in the world.
* **Fully Configurable:** Almost every aspect is customizable in a detailed `config.yml`, including portal materials, player limits, cooldowns, and all messages.
* **Survival Mechanics:** Enable options like `delete-on-break`, where destroying a portal's structure block will permanently remove the portal, and `allow-cross-world` to control inter-dimensional travel.
* **Visual & Audio Effects:** Make teleportation feel rewarding with configurable sounds and particle effects for creating and using portals.
* **Player-Managed Portals:** Players can set their portals to `public` or `private` and view all their portals in an intuitive `/portal list` GUI.
* **Admin-Friendly:** A full suite of permissions and commands allows server staff to manage any portal and reload the configuration on the fly.
* **Lightweight & Performant:** Designed to be efficient and have a minimal impact on your server's performance.

---
## How It Works (A Quick Guide)
<details>
  <summary>Click to see the creation process...</summary>
  
  1. **Build the Structures:** First, a player must build two identical structures in the world. By default, this is a Stone surrounded by 8 Gold Blocks.
  
  2. **Link the Points:** Using the `/portal create <name>` command, the player receives a special tool. They then left-click on the center block of the first structure and right-click on the center block of the second structure to create a permanent link.
  
  3. **Travel Instantly:** That's it! To teleport, the player simply steps into the space above one of the structures and is instantly transported to the other.
</details>

---
## Commands & Permissions

### Player Commands
* **`/portal create <name>`**
  * **Description:** Starts the portal creation process and gives the player the linking tool.
  * **Permission:** `teleportstructure.command.create`

* **`/portal remove <name>`**
  * **Description:** Removes one of your own portals.
  * **Permission:** `teleportstructure.command.remove`

* **`/portal list`**
  * **Description:** Opens a GUI listing all of your created portals and their details.
  * **Permission:** `teleportstructure.command.list`

* **`/portal public <name>`**
  * **Description:** Toggles one of your portals between public and private status.
  * **Permission:** `teleportstructure.command.public`

* **`/portal help`**
  * **Description:** Shows the command help message.
  * **Permission:** `teleportstructure.command.help`

### Admin Commands
* **`/portal list <player>`**
  * **Description:** Lists all portals owned by a specific player.
  * **Permission:** `teleportstructure.admin.list`

* **`/portal remove <portal_name>`**
  * **Description:** Forcefully removes any portal by its name. Requires admin permission to remove portals owned by other players.
  * **Permission:** `teleportstructure.admin.remove`

* **`/portal reload`**
  * **Description:** Reloads the `config.yml` file from disk.
  * **Permission:** `teleportstructure.admin.reload`

# Was inspired by [PeenixSC](https://www.youtube.com/@PhoenixSC)'s [video](https://youtu.be/tp8V0VmHyFU&t=25)
**This datapack was created for my video to play with friends. Found bug / order datapack / other - [Discord](https://discord.gg/dCWyMsE94D).**

**This datapack was intended to add the ability to leash a player to any entity.**

<details>
<summary>Showcase</summary>

## [ 1 ] Leashing

![Leashing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d87dba04b7708ada84e06318bc2a4e8c87315ea2.gif)

## [ 2 ] Players to entity

![Two player one pig](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/833f1bfa617c215b776224dfda1fc2487064b807.png)

## [ 3 ] [More in gallery](https://modrinth.com/datapack/leashed/gallery)
</details>

# Usage explanation:

Using the command, issue yourself a “Self-Lead”, using it you can leash yourself to any entity. Here are all the notes and commands:

- Give "Self-Lead" - **/function leashed:give_lead**;
- The "Self-Lead" item is not spent when used;
- A leader becomes immortal;
- Visualization of the lead is made by a straight line of particles;
- Which can be switched with - **/function leashed:gamerules/visual**;
- Up to five players can be leashed to a single entity;
- Because of the modifying and calculating motion, when a player is away from his “Leader”, the **game starts to lag** decently;
- You can only be unleashed using the command - **/function leashed:unleash**, it also kills the Leader;
- The current version of the datapack requires the [Modify Player Data](https://modrinth.com/mod/modify-player-data) mod.

<details>
<summary>FAQ about mod:</summary>
  
**Q: Where should I download the mod?**

**A:** If you are playing with friends LAN, **only hosting player** needs to download. If you play on a server, then **only in the server folder**. It's okay if someone also has a mod.

**Q: Why do I need to download this mod?**

**A:** This mod allows you to modify the player's NBT data, and the most important thing is **Motion**.

**Q: What about other alternatives from Minecraft itself?**

**A:** I was shaking my mouth at these alternatives. You can simply push the player only by levitation or invisible slimes, which cannot be normally invisible if summoned for a moment. And in any case, I made this datapack without worrying about optimization, further use after video or about other users, so I think you can accept it.
  
</details>

body:
# StringLib
A Minecraft Data Pack library that offers highly optimized implementations for many useful string manipulation utilities.\
Download: [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/stringlib)\
For inquiries, please contact **@silicatYT** on Discord.

## Features
- `concat`: Combine an arbitrary number of strings into a single string.
  - Example: `["123","456","789]` → `"123456789"`
- `find`: Get a list of indexes for instances of a string. You can also go in reverse and limit the number of results.
  - Example: `{String:"Looking for the last 'o' in this sentence", Find:"o", n:-1}` → `[22]`
- `replace`: Replace instances of a string with another string. You can also go in reverse and limit the number of replacements.
  - Example: `{String:"Bad example", Find:"Bad", Replace:"Great"}` → `"Great example"`
- `to_uppercase / to_lowercase`: Convert a string to uppercase or lowercase. Choose between a fast and a full version, the latter supporting the entire Unicode range.
  - Example: `"This is uppercase"` → `"THIS IS UPPERCASE"`
- `insert`: Insert a string at a specific index.
  - Example: `{String:"This is cool", Insertion:" really", Index:7}` → `"This is really cool"`
- `to_string`: Convert any data storage entry to a string.
  - Example: `127b` → `"127"`
- `to_number`: Convert a stringified number to a number.
  - Example: `"512"` → `512`
- `split`: Split a string into multiple, based on a separator character or string. Decide whether to keep or remove empty strings.
  - Example: `"Hello World"` → `["Hello", "World]`
- and more to come!

## How to use
You can find the utility functions in `stringlib:util/...`. In each function, there is a detailed guide for how to use it, along with a list of all the parameters.

## Credit
From CMDred:
- **SilicatYT**

## Good to know
- If you no longer need StringLib or want to upgrade to a newer version, you can run `/function stringlib:uninstall` to remove all the data storage and scoreboard entries.

## License
As per the MIT License, you are allowed to redistribute, modify and use StringLib as long as we are credited for the original work.

title: Fake Anticheat - Visual AC
description: Another fake anticheat to ward off hackers!
body:
**VACPlugin - Fake Anti-Cheat to Ward Off Hackers**

VACPlugin is a lightweight, non-intrusive plugin designed to deceive potential hackers on your Minecraft server by displaying fake anti-cheat messages. When a suspicious player attempts to run any of the specific `/vac` commands (like `/vac help`, `/vac checks`, `/vac notifs`, `/vac cpu`, or `/vac pdfix`), the plugin responds with a bold and red message stating "Insufficient Permissions". This serves as a deterrent, making hackers believe there is an active anti-cheat system in place when, in reality, the plugin is purely a psychological tool.

**Key Features:**
- Fake anti-cheat messages designed to trick hackers into thinking they're being watched.
- Commands that look like they check for various suspicious activities (like CPU usage, notifications, and checks).
- Simple to install and use—just drop it into your server's `plugins/` directory.

**How It Works:**
VACPlugin doesn’t actually perform any real anti-cheat checks or monitoring. Instead, it generates the illusion of an active anti-cheat system to discourage would-be cheaters from attempting to exploit your server. It can be particularly useful on servers where you want to give the impression of having robust security measures without the overhead of complex anti-cheat systems.

# **Important Note:**

This plugin is **not** a substitute for actual anti-cheat measures. It is purely a psychological deterrent and should be used in conjunction with real anti-cheat software for maximum server security.

# Autism Pride!

**Autism Pride!** is a tiny mod that replaces the title screen splash text with a friendly autism pride message, including the rainbow infinity sign commonly used by the neurodivergency community.

This mod is for members of the autistic community, like me, who felt a surprising lack of neurodivergency-focused mods in the gaming community. It also _technically_ counts as a library!

## Installation

- Install **[Quilt Loader](https://quiltmc.org)** and **[Quilted Fabric API / Quilt Standard Libraries](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl)**.
- Download the **[latest version of the mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/autism-pride!/versions)** for your respective Minecraft version.
- Drag **Autism Pride!** and **Quilted Fabric API / Quilt Standard Libraries** into your **mods** folder.
- **You're done!**

description: Makes early game progression slightly more difficult
body:
**BETTER PROGRESSION**

This mod is intended to slightly draw out Minecraft's early game by making some simple processes slightly harder. Feel free to use this in modpacks and YouTube videos!


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**HOW THE MOD WORKS:**


__________________________________
_Goal #1: Obtain a crafting table_

  Mine many logs, which drop sticks unless broken with an axe.
  
  Craft four sticks into a bundle of sticks.
  
  Craft four bundles of sticks into bundled planks.
  
  Craft four bundled planks into a crafting table.

________________________________________
_Goal #2: Obtain wooden and stone tools_

  Wooden tools are now crafted with bundles of sticks instead of planks.
  
  Stone and cobblestone, when mined with a wooden pickaxe, drop 1-2 rocks.
  
  Craft nine rocks into cobblestone.
  
  Stone tools can be crafted with stone only, meaning cobblestone has to be smelted.
  
  Craft eight cobblestone into a furnace.
  
  Obtain more cobblestone and smelt it.
  
  The resulting stone can be used to make stone tools!
  
  Stone and cobblestone, when mined with a stone pickaxe, drop 3-4 rocks.


____________________________
_Goal #3: Obtain iron tools_

  Iron ore drops 1-2 lumps of iron.
  
  Four lumps of iron can be crafted into raw iron.
  
  When raw iron is smelted in a furnace, the iron output is normal.
  
  When raw iron is smelted in a blast furnace, the iron output is doubled.
  
  This process also applies to gold.
  
  Stone and cobblestone, when mined with an iron pickaxe or better, drop themselves.

</details>

title: Codex
description: Satisfactory inspired codex with detailed descriptions on items.
body:
[![](https://cdn.mineblock11.dev/mineblock%20badge_64h.png)](https://discord.gg/UzHtJKqHny) [![](https://cdn.mineblock11.dev/modding-elite-badge.png)](https://ko-fi.com/mineblock11)

# Codex

Codex allows you to gain information and do quick calculations in a Satisfactory-style codex screen.

Currently, the mod is a proof of concept - but it is being actively developed.

I wouldn't consider it a replacement for Roughly Enough Items or Too Many Items - as those mods are more focused on the data part of the items.

Codex is more useful if you want to figure out **what** to do with an item, not **how**.

## Setup

Codex will guide you through it's setup screen when you launch the game for the first time with the mod:

![](https://i.imgur.com/3Lg6or9.gif)

These data sources are from [the data repository](https://github.com/mineblock11/Codex/tree/data) - and respect the license of the source.

## Showcase

### Quickmath Parser

The quickmath parser allows you to quickly evaluate arithmetic expressions.
This is especially useful for technical minecrafters - as it allows you to calculate various things such as shulker box capacity/redstone tick math using built in functions.

![](https://i.imgur.com/Gj1csmT.gif)

The quickmath parser also supports:

- [String Concatenation](https://imgur.com/qza71OB)
- [Boolean Evaluation](https://imgur.com/QAle7gw)

#### Quickmath Functions And Constants

**Functions**

- `stacksin(shulkers) = shulkers * 30`
- `shulkersof(stacks) = stacks / 30`
- `stacksof(items) = items / 64`
- `itemsof(stacks) = stacks * 64`
- `secsin(ticks) = ticks / 20`
- `ticksin(secs) = secs * 20`

**Constants**

- `STACK = 64`
- `SHULKER = 1920`
- `DAY =  72 * 24000`
- `HOUR = (72 * 24000) / 24`
- `MIN = (72 * 24000) / 24 / 60`
- `SEC = (72 * 24000) / 24 / 60 / 60`
- `MS =  (72 * 24000) / 24 / 60 / 60 / 1000`
- `MC_DAY = 24000`
- `MC_HOUR = 24000 / 24`
- `MC_MIN = 24000 / 24 / 60`
- `MC_SEC = 24000 / 24 / 60 / 60`
- `MC_MS = 24000 / 24 / 60 / 60 / 1000`


### Quicksearch

The quicksearch functionality allows you to quickly search for items - you can scroll the searchbar by dragging outside the list or using your scrollwheel.

Clicking on a search element opens it's codex page.

![](https://i.imgur.com/fQxQqrF.gif)

Item descriptions are from the sources you chose during codex setup.

## Contributing

Want to add support for your mod? Check out the [data repository](https://github.com/mineblock11/Codex/tree/data) which stores all the item descriptions and other miscelaneous content. 

*PS: The mod is All Rights Reserved currently as I do not see it fit for contributions. The data branch of the repository though is licensed by-file, not entirely as a whole. Please see `_index.json` for licensing of sources.*

title: BalancedClay
description: Makes clay balanced. (adds recipes to turn clay into any item)
body:
# BalancedClay
Makes clay balanced!

This plugin adds recipes to turn clay into any item! Contains an extensive configuration for disabling certain items as outputs, disabling certain types of recipes, as well as specifying a blacklist or a whitelist.

Currently supported recipe types are:
- **Crafting Table** (generates a unique shaped recipe for each item in the game)
- **Furnace** (Furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers, and campfires will all result in a random item when smelting clay)
- **Blast Furnace**
- **Smoker**
- **Campfire**
- **Smithing Table** (smithing tables will allow you to combine any item with clay to turn it into another item)
- **Stonecutter** (stonecutters will allow you to turn clay into any item)

Each recipe type can be toggled in the configuration.

<details><summary>Default Configuration</summary>

```yaml
# Whether clay should be able to be crafted into any item
enable-clay-crafting: true

# Whether clay should be able to be smelted into any item, separated into each smelter block
enable-clay-smelting:
  furnace: true
  smoker: true
  blast-furnace: true
  campfire: true

# Whether clay should be able to be turned into any item in a stonecutter
enable-clay-stonecutter: true

# Whether clay should be able to be turned into any item in a smithing table
enable-clay-smithing: true

# Items that clay should not be able to be turned into (materials)
blacklist:
  - clay_ball # Prevent crafting clay with a custom clay recipe
  - clay # Prevent crafting clay blocks with a custom clay recipe

# Whether to use the blacklist as a whitelist instead
use-blacklist-as-whitelist: false
```

</details>

## FAQ

### Q: Why would anyone want this?
A: Good question, a great question. This question is indeed very excellent. In fact, I'd say it's one of the questions of all time. Next question please.

### Q: Why clay?
A: Clay is the most balanced item, so it makes sense to make a plugin that balances it further. You can never outbalance the clay.

title: Just Essential Survival modpack
description: A performance-first Fabric modpack with precision tools, built specifically for redstone survival.
body:
# JES Modpack — Just Essential Survival

> **A lean, performance-first Fabric modpack built for redstone survival.**
> No bloat. No gimmicks. Just the mods that actually matter.


<!-- Markdown -->
[![Built on Fabulously Optimized](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/built-with/fabulously-optimized_64h.png)](https://download.fo)  
JES is designed around a single question: *what does a redstone survival player actually need?*

The answer is a tight, curated set of mods that covers four pillars — **performance**, **redstone tooling**, **survival quality-of-life**, and **visual polish** — without a single mod that doesn't earn its place. Every mod in this pack was chosen because it solves a real problem. Nothing made the cut just because it was popular.

## ✦ What's Inside

### ⚡ Performance
Sodium + Lithium + FerriteCore form the core. Rendering is fast, game logic is fast, and memory usage is genuinely lower than vanilla. ImmediatelyFast handles UI rendering acceleration on top of that.

### 🔴 Redstone & Building
Carpet gives you full control over redstone mechanics and server-side statistics. Tweakeroo adds a suite of client-side utilities for precision play. MiniHUD keeps the information you need visible without cluttering your screen. Litematica handles schematic projection so your builds stay on-plan.

### 🎒 Survival & Utility
JEI for recipe lookup. Mouse Tweaks for faster inventory management. ViaFabricPlus so you can connect to servers running different Minecraft versions without swapping installs. An auto-fishing assistant for the long hauls. e4mc for instant LAN-over-internet with friends — no port forwarding, no extra software.

### 🎨 Visuals & Animations
Iris Shaders with Indium for full shader support alongside Sodium. Continuity for connected textures. Smooth Swapping for fluid inventory animations. GUI transitions and scroll behavior that feel polished rather than snappy.

## ✦ At a Glance

| Category | Mods |
|---|---|
| Performance | Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast |
| Redstone & Building | Carpet, Tweakeroo, MiniHUD, Litematica |
| Survival & Utility | JEI, Mouse Tweaks, ViaFabricPlus, Auto Fishing, e4mc |
| Visuals & Animations | Iris, Indium, Continuity, Smooth Swapping |

## ✦ Requirements

- **Minecraft:** See version list on this page
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric
- **RAM:** 4 GB minimum, 4–6 GB recommended
- **Launcher:** Modrinth App or Prism Launcher recommended

## ✦ Shader Support

Iris Shaders is included out of the box. Load any compatible shader pack directly from Video Settings. No OptiFine needed.

## ✦ Multiplayer

The pack is multiplayer-ready. ViaFabricPlus lets you connect to servers on different versions. e4mc enables internet-accessible LAN worlds without port forwarding.

## ✦ Add Your Own Mods

This is an open Fabric pack. You're free to add any compatible Fabric mods on top of it.

---
Welcome to visit our [homepage](https://jes.lyrx.xyz/).

title: Poxy
description: Small mod that mixins into Voxy to make it "work" with Minecraft launchers on Android.
body:
# Poxy
Small mod that mixins into Voxy to make it "work" with Minecraft launchers on Android.

## WARNING
This mod will **NOT** guarantee that Voxy works properly on your device, so please do not report any issues while you are using Poxy.\
Please see the [GPU Compatibility Table](https://github.com/Jokypond/Poxy/blob/main/GPUCompatibilityTable.md) for more information.

## What does it do?
- Adds in LWJGL ZSTD and  LWJGL LMDB libraries for Android.
- Makes LMDB the default storage backend for Voxy.
- Makes Voxy use `libc.so` (Android libc) instead of `libc.so.6` (Standard Linux glibc)

## Why?
I was getting tired of having to build Voxy and go through the steps of adding these patches in myself, changing the settings, and creating a Redis server in Termux every time I wanted to try Voxy out on Android.

## License
GNU GPLv3. This mod does not redistribute Voxy.

title: Remote Access
description: Switch between nearby workstations instantly without closing your current crafting interface.
body:
# Side Access

Stop reopening workstations one by one.

Side Access lets you seamlessly switch between nearby functional blocks directly from inside your current interface. Open a crafting table, then cycle to nearby anvils, enchanting tables, cartography tables, looms, smithing tables, stonecutters, and more without ever closing the screen.

When compatible workstations are detected nearby, small navigation icons appear on the left and right sides of your inventory screen. Press your configured keys to instantly move to the previous or next workstation in range.

Perfect for:

* compact workshop builds
* multiplayer bases
* technical crafting rooms
* builders with dense utility setups

## Features

* Seamless workstation switching
* Minimal vanilla-style UI
* Configurable detection radius
* Configurable keybinds
* Supports multiple vanilla functional blocks
* Lightweight and performance-friendly
* Client-side quality of life improvement

## Supported Workstations

* Crafting Table
* Anvil variants
* Enchanting Table
* Cartography Table
* Loom
* Stonecutter
* Smithing Table
* Grindstone
* Furnaces
* Blast Furnaces
* Smokers
* Brewing Stands
* More planned

## Configuration

The mod includes configurable:

* workstation detection radius
* navigation keybinds
* icon size
* supported block behavior

Default detection radius:

```ini
radius = 5
```

Designed to feel like a natural extension of Minecraft’s inventory system rather than a separate modded interface.

title: UnsnappingLeads
description: Prevents leads from snapping during flight and teleportation. Adds passive mob leashing, entity Godmode, fence-to-fence ropes and more.
body:
# UnsnappingLeads
**Prevents leads from snapping during flight, teleportation, and high-speed movement.**

This plugin overrides vanilla behavior to ensure your mobs stay with you, no matter how fast you travel or how far you teleport.

---

## Key Features

* **Unsnapping Leads:** Leads never snap. Instead, mobs are automatically teleported 2 blocks behind you if the lead is about to break.
* **Teleportation Support:** Allow leashed mobs to teleport with you instantly.
* **Leash Passive Mobs:** Allows you to attach leads to normally unleashable passive mobs (Villagers, Pandas, Turtles, etc.).
* **Villager Control:** Optional toggle to allow/disallow Villagers from teleporting, even if other mobs are allowed to.
* **Elytra Flight Fix:** Bypasses the vanilla mechanic that snaps leads when using firework rockets.
* **Fence-to-Fence Leashing:** Create permanent rope connections between two fence posts up to 50 blocks away, complete with a visual distance indicator. 
* **Fence-to-Entity Leashing:** Introduced a "Reverse Tying" mechanic where clicking a fence post and then a mob ties them together instantly.
* **Pass Leads:** Securely hand off leashed mobs to other players by right-clicking them while facing each other.
* **Entity Godmode:** Mobs on a lead become invulnerable to damage (suffocation, fall damage, kinetic energy) while being towed.

## Additional Features

* **Smart Action Cancellation**: When tying fences together, the selection is now automatically cancelled if you switch to a different item in your inventory, ensuring temporary preview knots are cleaned up immediately. Simply hitting the preview knot also cancels the action.
* **Tethered Happy Ghasts:** Prevents Happy Ghasts from floating upward and breaking their leads, keeping them safely tethered to fences or players.
* **Configurable Snap Threshold:** Set the maximum distance a lead can stretch before breaking (25, 50, 100, or 200 blocks). This acts as the "safe limit" even when teleportation is disabled.

---


## Commands & Permissions

| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/uleads` | `unsnappingleads.admin` | Opens the GUI to toggle settings and thresholds. |

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62079d7c5203112c4de21b366d95077861aa39d7.png)

---

## Configuration

You can configure all settings in-game via the GUI (`/uleads`).

* **Teleport With Entities:** **Enabled** / Disabled
* **Villager Teleport:** **Enabled** / Disabled (Requires global teleport to be True)
* **Entity Godmode:** Enabled / **Disabled**
* **Leash Passive Mobs:** Enabled / **Disabled**
* **Fence Connect:** **Enabled** / Disabled
* **Pass Leads:** **Enabled** / Disabled
* **Teleport Threshold:** 25, **50**, 100, 200 blocks. (For a custom distance, edit the `config.yml` directly).


### If you encounter issues or have suggestions, please contact me on Discord: @euthanasia_enthusiast.

title: Superminer
description: Superminer adds the Explod enchantment to Minecraft, allowing your pickaxe to mine a 3×3×3 area with a single block break.
body:
Superminer adds the **Explod** enchantment to Minecraft, giving your pickaxe the ability to mine a large area with a single block break — perfect for strip mining, clearing out caves, or just getting through stone faster.

## Explod Enchantment

| Level | Area Mined |
|-------|-----------|
| I | 3×3×1 flat slice |
| II | 3×3×2 cube |
| III | 3×3×3 cube |

## Features

- **Pickaxes only** — Explod will only appear on pickaxes
- **Sneak to disable** — hold Shift to mine a single block as normal
- **Fortune & Silk Touch compatible** — enchantments on your pickaxe apply to all blocks broken in the area
- **Whitelist system** — only breaks blocks you allow in the config file, so you never accidentally destroy ores or anything you want to keep
- **Fully configurable** — edit `config/superminer.json` to control the block whitelist, enchanting table weight, and durability cost without restarting
- **Server-side only** — players do not need to install the mod on their client

## Default Whitelist

By default Explod only breaks common stone-type blocks: stone, cobblestone, deepslate, cobbled deepslate, granite, diorite, andesite, tuff, netherrack, blackstone, basalt, and end stone. Ores are intentionally excluded. You can add or remove any block by editing the config.

## How to Get It

- Enchant a pickaxe at an **enchanting table** (rare by default)
- Combine an **enchanted book** with a pickaxe at an **anvil**
- Use `/enchant @s superminer:explod 3` to apply it directly

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Fabric API
- Minecraft 26.1.2

title: Wolf Enchantments
description: Empower your furry companions with interesting and powerful new enchantments!
body:
The Wolf Enchantments mod adds a collection of new enchantments that will level up your furry companions! 

## Features
- Wolf Armor can now be enchanted at the enchanting table!
- Different types of enchantments for different play styles.
- Compatible with modded wolf armor, like [Iron Wolf Armor](https://modrinth.com/mod/iron-wolf-armor).
- Built in support for [Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions).

## Enchantments

### Dire
Turn your wolf into a direwolf using the dire enchantment! This enchantment has one level, and increases the size of your wolf by 50% and increases their max health by 10! (5 hearts)

### Reinforced
The Reinforced enchantment reduces how much durability damage wolf armor receives. Wolf armor already absorbs 100% of damage, so this enchantment effectively makes your wolf survive longer. It has four levels, and each level reduces durability damage by 20%, maxing out at 80%!

### Hunter Insight
The Hunter Insight enchantment greatly increases the amount of EXP dropped by mobs killed by your wolf. The wolf must get the last hit for the effect to apply. It has three levels, each increasing the amount of exp by 50%, maxing out at 150%. 

### Scavenger
The Scavenger enchantment increases the amount of items dropped by mobs killed by your wolf. It has three levels, each increasing the amount of items you can get. The amount of additional items dropped is similar to the sword enchantment Looting and depends on the mob.

### Swift Paws
The Swift Paws enchantment increases the movement speed of wolves. It has five levels and each level increases the movement speed by 10% maxing out at 50%.

### Fire Fang
With the Fire Fang enchantment your wolf will set mobs on fire when it attacks them. It has three levels, and each level increases the burn time by four seconds! Some mobs like chickens will also drop cooked versions of their items when killed. Wolf armor can only have one fang enchantment at a time.

### Ice Fang
With the Ice Fang enchantment, your wolf will slow mobs down when it attacks them. It has three levels, and each level increases how strong the effect is and how long it will last. Wolf armor can only have one fang enchantment at a time.

- Level 1 = Slowness I for 4 seconds.
- Level 2 = Slowness II for 4-6 seconds.
- Level 3 = Slowness III for 4-8 seconds.

### Thunder Fang
With the Thunder Fang enchantment, your wolf will sometimes summon lightning strikes when attacking. It has three levels, and each level increases the chance of a lightning strike by 10%. Your wolf will also be immune to lightning damage and damage caused by standing in fire. Wolf armor can only have one fang enchantment at a time.

### Poison Fang
With the Poison Fang enchantment, your wolf will poison mobs it attacks. It has three levels, and each level increases the potential duration of the poison. Keep in mind, spiders and undead mobs like zombies and skeletons are not affected by poison. Wolf armor can only have one fang enchantment at a time.

- Level 1 = Poison II for 1-5 seconds.
- Level 2 = Poison II for 1-7.5 seconds.
- Level 3 = Poison II for 1-10 seconds.

### Psychic Fang
With the Psychic Fang enchantment, your wolf will weaken mobs it attacks, reducing their melee damage by 8 (4 hearts). It has three levels, and each level increases the duration of the effect. Wolf armor can only have one fang enchantment at a time.

- Level 1 = Weakness II for 1-2.5 seconds.
- Level 2 = Weakness II for 2-4 seconds.
- Level 3 = Weakness II for 3-5.5 seconds.

### Curse of Restraint
The curse of restraint is a rare enchantment that can only be found in loot tables, trades, and other places curses can be found. This curse reduces the damage of your wolf by 100% and prevents it from targeting or attacking any mob! Your wolf will also be immune to virtually all sources of damage except void damage. This effect all but ensures your wolf will be safe on your adventures, but makes it not very useful for combat. Curses are not obtained through the enchanting table.


## Questions & Answers

**What are fang enchantments?**
Fang enchantments are a new category of enchantments added by this mod. They typically have effects related to combat and have the word fang in their name. Wolf armor can only have one fang enchantment at a time, so you need to choose which of the effects you want to use. This group of enchantments is also inspired by a category of attacks in Pokemon with the same name!

**Are these enchantments compatible with wolf armor from other mods?**
This mod should be compatible with most wolf armor mods, but there are a few requirements. The mod must add their item to the minecraft:enchantable/wolf_armor tag, and it must have an enchantability component. These are pretty simple requirements that mods like [Iron Wolf Armor](https://modrinth.com/mod/iron-wolf-armor) support.

**Does this mod have any required dependencies?**
Yes, this mod requires [Prickle](https://modrinth.com/mod/prickle), a cross-platform config library that provides useful features like default values and comments. 

**Can you (back)port this mod to support other Minecraft versions?**
There are no plans to backport this mod to older versions of the game, but I will update the mod to newer versions of the game when I have time.

## Sponsors

**This project is sponsored by Nodecraft. Use code [DARKHAX](https://nodecraft.com/r/darkhax) for 30% off your first month of service!**

title: Fast Sleep
description: FastSleep is a Minecraft modification that turns the boring night-skipping process into a dynamic experience. Instead of instant teleportation to the morning, the mod accelerates time, allowing farms to grow and mobs to move faster right before your eyes.
body:
**FastSleep** — is a Minecraft modification that turns the boring night-skipping process into a dynamic experience. Instead of an instant teleportation to morning, the mod speeds up time, allowing crops to grow and mobs to move faster right before your eyes.

# Main Features:
- Dynamic Time Warp: Time in the world begins to fly faster as soon as you go to bed. You can see the moon setting and the sun rising in real-time.
 
- Local Acceleration: While you sleep, the mod "boosts" game ticks within a specified radius around the player. This means your crops grow and mobs perform more actions while the world is accelerated.

- Full In-Game Configuration: Forget about endlessly editing config files. Manage all mod parameters using the /fs command.
 
- Bilingual Interface: Support for Russian and English languages with instant switching.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0ccCfN7CxvA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Control Commands
All mod management is handled via the /fs command.
- /fs Opens the help menu and a list of available parameters.
- /fs speed <number> Sets the time warp speed (1-1000).
- /fs radius <number> Sets the acceleration radius for crops/mobs (1-100 blocks).
- /fs mobs <true/false> Enables or disables mob acceleration within the radius.
- /fs crops <true/false> Enables or disables crop growth acceleration within the radius.
- /fs machines <true/false> Enables or disables machines acceleration within the radius.
- /fs lang <ru/en> Switches the language for mod commands and responses.

title: CosmicExtractions
description: Utility mod to improve QOL and enhance gameplay within the Extraction feature on CosmicSky.
body:
# What is CosmicExtractions?
CosmicExtractions is a utility mod designed by [Minecoin](https://discord.gg/minecoin) to improve the QOL and overall gameplay experience within the Extraction gamemode within CosmicSky. 
**All features and mechanics within this mod have been approved for use by the Cosmic Administration.**
# Key Features:
## Visual indicators for chest spawn locations
Whenever a player loots a chest within the Extraction world, this chest location is added to a permanent list stored within the player's config folder. In all future extraction runs, this location will be highlighted for the player with a blue indicator. Whenever a chest location is looted, the indicator becomes green for the rest of that Extraction run to help track where the player has already explored during each run. Over time, as players explore the map and discover every possible chest spawn, this feature allows players to clear large landmarks and search for chests more efficiently.
![Screenshot showing examples of blue and green chest location indicators.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a95e818b8e6f34faea8ed5b30608211f3e5c657.png)
## Improved audio queues for chest spawns
By default, whenever a chest is generated nearby, there is a very faint audio queue that is often very difficult to hear and almost impossible to pinpoint. This feature replaces the default sound with a much louder and more dynamic audio queue, which allows players to hear exactly how many chests spawn within a given area, as well as the precise direction of each chest relative to the player.
## Dynamic waypoints indicating the nearest exit zone
Whenever the Extraction timer gets low or an enemy player is nearby, it can be critical to locate the nearest exit zone. This feature automatically detects and permanently stores the locations of each exit zone within the Extraction world, and it automatically displays a waypoint at whichever exit zone is closest to the player, along with the distance.
![Screenshot showing waypoint indicating the location and distance of the nearest exit zone.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e1346db9a4efc8b944a1dc6e2ba4529dcf9197f_0.webp)
## Exit zone countdown timer
Whenever you activate an Extraction exit zone, the waypoint will turn yellow, and it will display a countdown indicating the number of seconds until the exit zone opens. This countdown is also displayed above the player's hotbar. Once the 60 second countdown is completed and the exit zone opens, the waypoint will turn green, and a new 10 second timer will be displayed.
![Screenshot showing yellow and green exit zone waypoints with a countdown timer.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/163711fee843db2e253c50366df1701cd83649a5.png)
## Local player list & join/leave alerts
This feature displays a list of all players currently in the same local server, which includes all players in your current Extraction world, as well as possibly some players in a different Extraction world. Once the Extraction timer hits 15 minutes and no more players can enter the same Extraction world, this list automatically stops adding new players who join the local server, because once the timer is below 15 minutes, those players must be joining a different Extraction world. Additionally, whenever a new player joins or leaves the Extraction world, an alert appears in the chat.
## Looted chest tracker
When doing an Extraction run, it's important to know how efficient your route was, and also to be able to complain if you looted a lot of chests and got nothing of value. Therefore, while in an Extraction run, there is a tracker at the top-left of the screen that indicates how many chests you have looted during that Extraction run. 
## Extraction cooldown alerts
Because there is a cooldown between Extraction runs, it's helpful to know exactly when this cooldown expires so you can go back in and do another run. This feature sends a chat alert, as well as an audio alert, whenever your Extraction cooldown has expired. This feature is able to track multiple accounts, and persists through closing and re-opening Minecraft, so it will still be useful even if you are running 2 or 3 different alts for Extraction. If you have the /skill for a shorter Extraction cooldown, be sure to indicate this within the config so that your alerts will be accurate.
## Config
Everyone has their own preferences, and you may want to tweak or disable certain aspects of the mod. Within the config (**default key is K**), players can enable/disable every aspect of the mod, as well as adjust certain settings such as the distance that chest indicators appear or the volume of the audio when a chest spawns nearby. If you would prefer a different keybind to open the config, that can be adjusted using Minecraft's Key Binds menu. If the config menu looks abnormal, try adjusting your GUI scale.
![Screenshot showing the config menu.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3dcf3c91f63d88625e63ba3f4af107fa7a82905.png)
### Technical Info:
If you want to manually edit your list of saved chest locations or saved exit points, you can find these files in %appdata% -> .minecraft -> config
