title: RainAPI
description: Core library for RainJava featuring embedded ECJ compiler, Javassist bytecode tools, and ASM transformation pipeline. Enables dynamic Java compilation and class modification at runtime.
body:
RainJava API





Advanced Runtime Class Transformation Framework



A foundational library providing Mixin and Coremod interoperability layers, powered by enterprise-grade bytecode and compilation tools.



Overview



RainJava API establishes the critical infrastructure for runtime class transformation pipelines. It serves as a middleware bridge between dynamic compilation workflows and Minecraft's standard modification systems (Mixin & Coremod), ensuring bytecode-level compatibility without compromising game stability.



While designed as the prerequisite foundation for the upcoming RainJava ecosystem, this API functions independently as a robust toolkit for developers requiring deep class manipulation capabilities.



Embedded Libraries



This mod ships with zero-external-dependency versions of industry-standard tools:



- Javassist — High-level bytecode manipulation library for runtime class engineering

- ECJ (Eclipse Compiler for Java) — Full-featured Java compiler capable of runtime source-to-bytecode transformation

- JavaParser — Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) analysis and code generation framework



These libraries are shaded and isolated to prevent conflicts with other mods.



Technical Scope



- Transformation Bridge — Facilitates communication between runtime-generated class definitions and established bytecode modification frameworks

- Mixin Compatibility Layer — Enables standardized injection patterns to recognize and process dynamically provisioned classes  

- Coremod Integration — Provides stable hooks for runtime class definitions to participate in Forge's transformation chain

- Sandboxed Execution — Implements security boundaries for runtime code evaluation environments



For Modders



Install this API if you:

- Plan to develop for or use the upcoming RainJava framework

- Require embedded Javassist/ECJ/JavaParser without bundling them yourself

- Need stable Mixin/Coremod interoperability for advanced bytecode operations

title: Server Switcher Bungee
description: A lightweight BungeeCord plugin that adds customizable short commands like /smp or /lobby to instantly send players to servers.
body:
--- **🌀 Server Switcher Bungee** **The Ultimate Server Switcher for BungeeCord Networks** Fast. Powerful. Fully Customizable. --- **✨ What Is This?** Server Switcher Bungee lets you create **clean, simple commands like `/smp`, `/lobby`, `/hub`, `/creative`** that instantly send players to different servers — without ever typing: ``` /server smp ``` And now, with v3+, it goes **far beyond** simple shortcuts. --- **🚀 Major Features** **🔹 Short Commands → Real Server Transfers** Create unlimited commands like: ``` /smp → smp /lobby → lobby /hardcore → hardcore ``` All with aliases, permissions, MOTD, maintenance, and confirmation. --- **🔹 Smart Server Selection (Least Players)** Perfect for multi-instance servers: * `/smp` → chooses between `smp`, `smp2`, `smp3` * Picks the *least populated* server * Automatically avoids nearly-full servers * Fully configurable --- **🔹 Advanced Queue System** When a server is full: * Players enter a queue * Supports **priority tiers** (staff > VIP > default) * Shows **queue position** via actionbar * Grace period keeps queue spot after disconnect * `/leavequeue` to exit * Auto-requeue if failover also full --- **🔹 Maintenance Mode (Per Command)** Disable a command temporarily: ```yml enabled: false motd: "&cSMP is under maintenance." allow-permission: "shortswitch.smp.admin" ``` --- **🔹 Clickable Confirmation** Great for risky servers (hardcore, events): ```yml confirm: commands: ["hardcore", "event"] ``` Players get a clickable confirmation message. --- **🔹 Auto-Routing On Join** Automatically redirect players when they join the proxy: ```yml auto-route: default-command: "lobby" ``` --- **🔹 Multi-Language Support** Supports files like: * `messages_en.yml` * `messages_nl.yml` Permission-based language override: ``` shortswitch.lang.nl ``` --- **🔹 MOTD on Switch** Show a message before sending a player: ``` motd: "&aWelcome to SMP!" ``` --- **🔹 Full Permission Control** Includes: * Global permission * Auto-generated per-command perms * Maintenance bypass * Queue priority * Rate-limit bypass * Cooldown bypass --- **🔹 Hot Reload Support** Reload *everything*: ``` /switcher reload ``` --- **🧠 Feature Summary** | Feature | Description | | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | | **Custom short commands** | Create `/smp`, `/lobby`, etc. | | **Unlimited aliases** | `/sb`, `/skyblock`, `/sky` → skyblock | | **Global + per-command perms** | Fully configurable | | **Maintenance mode** | Lock commands with MOTD | | **Auto-permissions** | Auto-generate perms like `shortswitch.smp` | | **Confirmation click** | Prevent accidental switching | | **Smart selection** | Load-balanced routing | | **Priority queue** | Staff > VIP > default | | **Actionbar queue updates** | Live positions | | **Grace period** | Keep queue spot after disconnect | | **Auto-route on join** | Send players to lobby automatically | | **Multi-language** | English/Dutch message files | | **Live MOTDs** | Custom message per command | | **Reload without restart** | `/switcher reload` | | **Full Bungee Support** | Bungee, Waterfall, FlexPipe, FlameCord, etc. | --- **📦 Configuration Preview**
Click to open config.yml ```yml auto-register: true global-permission: "shortswitch.use" auto-permissions: enabled: true prefix: "shortswitch." cooldowns: enabled: true bypass-permission: "shortswitch.bypass.cooldown" per-command: smp: 3 rate-limit: enabled: true max-switches: 5 per-seconds: 10 queue: enabled: true grace-seconds: 120 tiers: staff: permission: "shortswitch.queue.staff" priority: 100 vip: permission: "shortswitch.queue.vip" priority: 50 smart-select: enabled: true mode: "least-players" candidates: smp: ["smp", "smp2", "smp3"] confirm: enabled: true commands: ["hardcore"] auto-route: enabled: true default-command: "lobby" commands: smp: server: "smp" aliases: ["survival", "s"] motd: "&aWelcome to SMP!" lobby: server: "lobby" aliases: ["hub"] ```
--- **🔐 Permissions Overview** | Permission | Description | | ------------------------------ | -------------------------- | | `shortswitch.use` | Global permission | | `shortswitch.` | Auto-generated per command | | `shortswitch.queue.staff` | Priority queue tier | | `shortswitch.queue.vip` | Priority queue tier | | `shortswitch.bypass.full` | Join full servers | | `shortswitch.bypass.ratelimit` | Ignore rate limit | | `shortswitch.bypass.cooldown` | Ignore cooldown | | `shortswitch.bypass.autoroute` | Skip auto-route | | `shortswitch.lang.nl` | Use Dutch messages | --- **🛠 Installation** 1. Download the `.jar` 2. Place it into your proxy’s `plugins/` folder 3. Restart 4. Edit `config.yml` 5. Reload anytime: ``` /switcher reload ``` --- **✔ Compatibility** * BungeeCord * Waterfall * FlexPipe * FlameCord * All Bungee-based forks --- **❤️ Need More?** Have ideas? Want analytics, Velocity support, or a web-based queue viewer? **Message me — I love adding new features.** ---

title: BlockMessage
description: Management tools used during proxy server maintenance, etc.
body:
# BlockMessage
BlockMessage is a simple Velocity plugin for temporarily blocking player connections during server maintenance or emergencies.
It allows you to restrict server access with a single command, displaying custom messages to players in both the server list (MOTD) and upon connection attempts.
## Features
- Command-Based Blocking: Toggle connection blocking on and off in real-time with the /block <on|off> command, no server restart required.
- Custom Kick Message: Fully customize the message shown to blocked players in config.yml. Multi-line messages and color codes are supported.
- Custom MOTD: Change the MOTD (server description), version name, and player count displayed in the server list while blocking is active. This makes it easy to inform players about maintenance at a glance.
- Permission Control: Restrict command usage to administrators with the blockmessage.command.admin permission.
- Persistent Settings: The plugin's state is saved in config.yml, so your settings will be maintained even after restarting Velocity.

<details>
<summary>Configuration (default.yml)</summary>
  
The plugins/blockmessage/config.yml file is generated on the first startup.

```
# =================================================================
# BlockMessage Plugin Configuration (Default Profile Template)
# This file will be copied to profiles/default.yml if it doesn't exist.
# =================================================================

# Enable or disable the entire plugin for this profile.
# If false, no players will be blocked and the MOTD will not be changed when this profile is active.
enabled: true

# The message displayed to players when they are blocked from joining.
# This is a list of strings, where each string represents a new line.
# You can use '&' for color codes.
block-message:
  - "&cThis server is currently in maintenance mode."
  - "&ePlease try again later."

# Configuration for the custom MOTD (Message of the Day) shown in the server list.
block-motd:
  # Enable or disable the custom MOTD when the plugin is enabled in this profile.
  enabled: true

  # The first line of the MOTD.
  line1: "&cServer is in Maintenance"

  # The second line of the MOTD.
  line2: "&eWe will be back soon!"

  # The maximum player count to display. Set to -1 to use the server's default from bungee config.
  max-players: 0 # Set to 0 to override Bungee default and show 'Maintenance' count

  # The online player count to display. Set to -1 to use the server's default from bungee config.
  online-players: 0 # Set to 0 to override Bungee default and show 'Maintenance' count

# Players in this list will not be blocked, even if the plugin is enabled in this profile.
# This is useful for allowing admins to join during maintenance.
# Names are case-insensitive during checks, but stored as entered.
whitelist:
  - "AdminPlayer1"
  - "AnotherAdmin"
```


<details>
<summary>Color Codes</summary>
  
```
&0	Black
&1	Dark Blue
&2	Dark Green
&3	Dark Aqua
&4	Dark Red
&5	Purple
&6	Gold
&7	Gray
&8	Dark Gray
&9	Blue
&a	Green
&b	Aqua
&c	Red
&d	Pink
&e	Yellow
&f	White
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Formatting Codes</summary>
  
```
&k	Obfuscated (scrambled text)
&l	Bold
&m	Strikethrough
&n	Underline
&o	Italic
&r	Reset Formatting
```
</details>





</details>

# Installation
1. Download the latest .jar file from the Releases page.
2. Place the downloaded .jar file into your Velocity server's plugins folder.
3. Start or restart your Velocity server.
4. Edit the plugins/blockmessage/config.yml file as needed.

title: Better Bane Of Arthropods
description: A mod that works to improve Bane of Arthropods for modded play, and give Arthropods more identity!
body:
So we can all agree Bane of Arthropods is awful in vanilla right?

Looking to rehash this pest-squishing enchantment, I asked myself "What would it take for me to start using Bane of Arthropods in a serious capacity? What will make me want to use it over Smite or Sharpness?

And this is what I arrived on - To compensate for the general rarity of spiders (because let's be honest, spiders and cave spiders are what Bane of Arthropods should be used for), the enchantment also gets mild functionality against non-arthropod mobs, like Pillagers and Cows!

 

Below is a full list of the changes made to allow Bane of Arthropods to really find itself having a place in Modded Minecraft's toolkit

(This mod is balanced with the expectation that other mods are included in the mix, you may find this mod to be quite strong in more vanilla-like modpacks!)


**(Arthropods are good against archers! Let's see some melee attackers out there!)**
Arthropods react wildly when hit by ranged attacks, regenerating their health and resisting all damage for 2 seconds (unless they are burning)


**(Most bugs don't wear armor, but if they did, I'd bet it'd be a Myrmex from Ice and Fire!)**
Bane of Arthropods does 1 more damage per level, this damage is magic damage and pierces armor


**(Cave-Spider-Be-Gone!)**
Hitting an Arthropod with Bane of Arthropods removes Poison from the user

**(Silverfish just got a lot scarier!)**
Hitting an Arthropod without Bane of Arthropods gives a very small amount of poison to the attacker, and a little amount of regeneration to the Arthropod

**(We could call it Spider Aspect!)**
Hitting a non-Arthropod with Bane of Arthropods will poison the target for a short duration.

**(The first Life-Steal effect in modded Minecraft that isn't broken!)**
Hitting a poisoned non-Arthropod with Bane of Arthropods will grant a mild regeneration effect to the attacker.





_There is no config, nor will there be one, this mod was made to be plug-and-play._

Still, any feedback is appreciated for this mod! Let's make Bane of Arthropods better together!

 


This small mod was inspired in part by https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/consecration
Go check out their mod!

title: BufoCraft
description: A set of Fabric client-side QOL, performance, functional and aesthetics mods for BufoCraft.
body:
Enhance your Minecraft experience with this Fabric client-side modpack that enriches gameplay while preserving the classic vanilla aesthetics and feel. Streamlined with quality-of-life improvements like inventory sorting, tabs, and moving while your inventory is open. Build efficiently using Litematica for custom schematics, reach-around placement, and step-up as a smoother alternative to auto-jump. Navigate your world effortlessly with an integrated minimap and world map. Boost performance through optimization mods and OptiFine parity. Enjoy subtle aesthetic enhancements—like additional particle effects and informative HUD elements—that enhance immersion without altering the core Minecraft look. Designed specifically for BufoCraft, this modpack elevates your game without straying from the vanilla experience but may not be permitted on other servers.

Mods
Quality-of-Life Mods
  • Accessible Step – Configurable step-height adjustment so you smoothly climb small blocks without jumping.
  • AutoClicker – Automates left-clicking at configurable CPS for mining and combat convenience.
  • AutoTotem – Automatically equips a Totem of Undying to your off-hand when your health is low.
  • BactroMod – Implements a hydration mechanic so you must manage water intake underwater.
  • Better Mount HUD – Displays mount health and status in a clean HUD overlay.
  • Better Ping Display – Improves the tab ping display.
  • Better Third Person – Adds dynamic third-person camera angles like peek and smooth rotation.
  • ChatPatches – Restores legacy chat formatting, colors, and hover events.
  • Chat Heads – Shows player head icons next to their chat messages for quick ID.
  • ChestTracker – Marks looted chests on your minimap so you don’t miss any loot.
  • ClickThrough Plus – Lets you click through signs and item frames to chests and other containers.
  • Client Tweaks – Adds inventory sorting, shift-click filtering, recipe tweaks, and more.
  • Crafting Tweaks – Shift-click to move items in and out of crafting grids instantly.
  • DeathFinder – Automatically traces a breadcrumb path back to your last death point.
  • e4mc – Open LAN server to the public.
  • Held Item Info – Shows additional details (attack speed, tooltips) for the item in your hand.
  • Inventory Profiles Next – Save and quickly switch between multiple inventory layouts.
  • InvMove – Allows walking, sprinting, and jumping while any inventory is open.
  • Jade – In-world tooltips showing block and entity info on hover.
  • Litematica – Blueprint schematics with ghost blocks for efficient building.
  • Litematica Printer – Automatically places schematic blocks from inventory slots.
  • Map-In-Slot – Embeds your map directly into a hotbar slot for continuous viewing.
  • MixinTrace – Developer tool to visualize mixin application order and conflicts.
  • Mod Menu – In-game GUI to view and configure installed Fabric mods.
  • Mouse Tweaks – Drag-and-drop in GUIs and double-click to collect item stacks.
  • Name Visibility – Toggle player nameplates and adjust draw distance.
  • NoChatReports – Disables Mojang’s chat-reporting UI and warning messages.
  • Not Enough Crashes – Improves crash reports with clickable stack traces and copy buttons.
  • Paginated Advancements – Splits long advancement lists into pages for easier navigation.
  • Polytone – Adds spatial audio filters and subtle ambient sounds to blocks.
  • ProPlacer – Enables reach-around and fast block placement
  • Replanting Crops – Automatically re-plants seeds when you harvest crops.
  • SchematicPreview – Shows Litematica schematics in-world before you paste them.
  • Reese’s Sodium Options – Extra graphical toggles layered on top of Sodium settings.
  • Stack-to-Nearby-Chests – Distributes items from your cursor into nearby chests with one key.
  • Suggestion Tweaker – Customizes command suggestion menu.
  • Too Many Binds – Pop-up search box for mod keybinds
  • TweakerMore – Extension pack of extra client tweaks layered on Tweakeroo.
  • Tweakeroo – All-in-one toolkit for GUI, hotbar, and recipe-book tweaks.
  • Xaero’s Map Chest Tracker Integration – Merges chest markers from ChestTracker into Xaero’s World Map.
  • Xaero’s World Map – Full-screen world map that mirrors your in-game position.
  • Xaero’s Minimap – Circular minimap with waypoints, cave mode, and cave mapping.
  • Zoomify – Smooth, adjustable zoom with mouse wheel or key hold.
Immersive Mods
  • 3D Skin Layers – Renders additional skin layers (jacket, sleeves) in full 3D.
  • AmbientSounds – Plays context-sensitive environmental sounds for immersion.
  • BetterGrassify – Smooths grass block edges with blended textures.
  • Bobby – Enable greater render distances than the server's view-distance setting.
  • Capes – Enables OptiFine-style cape rendering on Fabric clients.
  • Chunks Fade In – Smooths chunk loading by fading them in instead of popping.
  • Continuity – Connected textures for glass, snow, and other blocks sans OptiFine.
  • Detail Armor Bar – Breaks down each armor piece’s durability and protection in the HUD.
  • Distant Horizons – Renders distant terrain at low detail to extend view distance.
  • Dynamic Crosshair – Crosshair changes size/color based on movement and status.
  • Enhanced Block Entities – Adds bloom/glow effects to chests, furnaces, and other entities.
  • Entity Model Features – Additional layers like capes, tridents, and elytra multiplexing.
  • Entity Texture Features – Connected textures support on mob skins and overlays.
  • Falling Leaves – Drifts leaf particles from trees in autumn biomes.
  • Highlighter – Highlights blocks you look at with a configurable outline and color.
  • ImmersiveThunder – Realistic thunderbolts and rolling thunder audio-visuals.
  • Iris Shaders – Shader-loader fully compatible with OptiFine packs on Fabric.
  • LambDynamicLights – Real-time light sources follow entities and held items.
  • Model Gap Fix – Eliminates tiny rendering gaps between block and item models.
  • MoreMcMeta – Allows large resource-pack metadata and custom manifest data.
  • Not Enough Animations – Supplements missing vanilla animations for smoother motion.
  • Nuit – Custom skyboxes per biome/dimension without OptiFine.
  • Physics Mod – Adds physics to mobs, particles and dropped items.
  • Presence Footsteps – Plays realistic footstep sounds based on surface type.
  • RSLS – Raises Minecraft sound sources limit in a simple way.
  • Sound Physics Remastered – Spatial audio that reacts to block materials and distance.
  • Sounds – Large library of ambient and environmental effects.
  • Tiny Item Animations – Adds little animations when you pick up or insert items with your mouse.
  • Visuality – A simple client-sided cosmetic mod that adds new particles.
  • Wavey Capes – Cape textures animate in a sine-wave for realistic movement.
Performance Mods
  • Debugify – Expands the F3 screen with extra metrics like FPS graph, memory pools, and network stats.
  • Entity Culling – Hides off-screen entities to reduce render overhead.
  • FerriteCore – Optimizes data structures to reduce memory usage.
  • FastQuit – Speeds up game exit by optimizing save-and-close routines.
  • ImmediatelyFast – Removes GUI animation delays for instant screen transitions.
  • Dynamic FPS – Automatically scales frame rate when idle to save CPU/GPU.
  • Lithium – Comprehensive logic optimizer for faster world ticks.
  • More Culling – Further reduces rendering of off-camera objects beyond base culling.
  • Sodium – Major renderer overhaul for smooth, high-FPS performance.
  • Sodium Extra – Additional performance toggles and utility features on top of Sodium.
  • SodiumExtras – Experimental speed tweaks from the Sodium team.
Library Mods
  • Architecture API – Abstraction layer for cross-platform Fabric/Quilt/Forge mod development.
  • Balm – Common utilities and abstractions for multi-platform mods.
  • CICADA – General helper functions and utilities for Fabric authors.
  • Cloth Config API – Config-screen library for in-game mod settings.
  • Fabric API – Core hooks and interfaces for Fabric modding.
  • Fabric Language Kotlin – Kotlin support and DSLs for writing Fabric mods.
  • Forge Config API Port – Port of Forge’s configuration system to Fabric.
  • Iceberg – Fabric Rendering API reference implementation used by shader mods.
  • libIPN – GUI/config library powering Inventory Profiles Next.
  • MaLiLib – Shared code library for masa’s Fabric mods.
  • M.R.U – Utilities library for performance-focused mods.
  • Puzzle – Unified config framework aimed at OptiFine replacements.
  • YetAnotherConfigLib – Versatile in-game config GUI library.
  • Collective – Shared utilities for multiple Fabric mods (e.g. Better Eating, AppleSkin).
  • CreativeCore – Core library for Creative-mode and recipe mod support.
  • MixinTrace – (Also listed in QoL) developer library for Mixin conflict tracing.
  • ModernFix – Compatibility and stability fixes for modern Fabric versions.
Update Watchlist
  • CIT Resewn – Re-implements OptiFine’s Custom Item Textures system on Fabric.
  • Eating Animation – Adds sprite animations for edible and drinkable items.
  • Inventory Tabs – Allows swapping to other in-world screens blocks, entities, etc via tabs.
Resource Packs
  • Fresh Animations – Smooth, realistic entity animations replacing vanilla mob motions.
    • Fresh Animations Extensions – Extra customization add-ons for Fresh Animations, including additional mob models and tweaks.
  • UltimaCraft – Vanilla-styled pack that adds new textures, animations, random block variations, and OptiFine features.
    • UltimaCraft Enchantments – Unique per-enchantment textures for books, tools, and armor (requires OptiFine/CIT Resewn).
    • UltimaCraft Models – Adds custom 3D models for blocks, items, and entities.
    • UltimaCraft PBR – LabPBR shader support add-on for realistic material effects under OptiFine.
    • BufoCraft Resource Pack Compilation – Curated compilation of textures and assets to provide a cohesive, vanilla-friendly visual style for BufoCraft.
Shader Packs
  • Complementary Shaders – Reimagined – High-quality, performance-tuned shader preserving Minecraft’s visual identity with two default styles and block-specific effects.
Server Plugins
  • EssentialsX – Core suite of over 130 commands and utilities for Spigot/Paper servers.
    • EssentialsX Chat – Chat formatting module requiring the main EssentialsX plugin.
    • EssentialsX Discord – Lightweight bridge syncing in-game chat and events with Discord channels.
    • EssentialsX DiscordLink – Syncs Vault groups with Discord roles and handles account linking.
    • EssentialsX GeoIP – Displays approximate player locations using the MaxMind GeoLite2 database in `/whois`.
  • FreedomChat – Completely disables Mojang’s chat-reporting system server-side for privacy.
  • LuckPerms – Scalable, web-editable permissions manager supporting Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Forge, Fabric, Velocity, and more.
  • Vault – Universal Permissions, Chat & Economy API that gives plugins easy hooks into these systems.

title: MCStatusHook
description: A simple and lightweight Spigot/Paper plugin to send server status messages to Discord as webhooks.
body: # **MCStatusHook** [](https://modrinth.com/plugin/mcstatushook) [](https://github.com/carolinaisslaying) [](https://discord.gg/VVTJhkKc4G) MCStatusHook is a simple and lightweight plugin with no extra unnecessary features that was made originally for a private (locally hosted) server of mine to notify my friends on Discord when the server went offline or went online, saving me the hassle of having to notify them manually. It is compatible with Spigot/Paper 1.18 to 1.21. ### ***Why?*** This plugin is primarily aimed at those who don't want a fancy Discord integration, and purely just a lightweight plugin that consumes limited resources that only posts online and offline messages through a webhook. Specifically, this may better suit those locally hosting servers or running private whitelisted servers running on limited resources. The server online and offline messages are completely customisable. If you want more features than a simple the server is online or offline message, use [DiscordSRV](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/discordsrv.18494/) as it is an extremely well-created and customisable plugin. ## **Setup** * Download the plugin's .jar file, and place it in your server's plugin folder. * Start (or restart) your server - you shouldn't be using the /reload command on your server if you are in the first place. * On the Discord channel you want to send online and offline messages to, head to "Edit Channel". * Once in the Edit Channel overview, navigate to the "Integrations" tab on the left. * Press the Webhooks box and then press on the "New Webhook" button. * Customise the webhook name and profile picture to your choosing - this will be the profile picture and name of the webhook's message. * Press "Copy Webhook URL". * Navigate to your minecraft server's plugin folder, then enter the MCStatusHook folder. * Open the config.yml file in Notepad (or your preferred text editor). * Paste the webhook URL in place of the existing url next to the webhook_url config setting. * Customise the online_msg and offline_msg values to your liking, you can set any message and the webhook will send it! * Restart your server and voila! ### **Setup Video Example** [https://vimeo.com/692728124](https://vimeo.com/692728124) ### **Webhook Example Images** ## **![https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38713645/160095410-66acdcb4-22e7-4e54-a713-35bed00774fc.png](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38713645/160095410-66acdcb4-22e7-4e54-a713-35bed00774fc.png)** **![https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38713645/160095497-5d7b1d95-54d9-4cf8-b213-1b2ec64d33ed.png](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38713645/160095497-5d7b1d95-54d9-4cf8-b213-1b2ec64d33ed.png)**

title: Gateways
description: A vanilla-esque teleport pad mod for both blocks and entities with redstone compatibility
body:
## Gateways

**IMPORTANT NOTE-- Gateways uses the rendering library Veil, which may not be compatible with other rendering libraries like sodium or optifabric.**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/-Oy_6R89u_k" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Gateways is a Minecraft mod which adds gateways you can teleport around with. It adds the following features:

- Gateway hub
    - Crafted with four chorus flowers, four amethyst blocks, and an eye of ender
    - Each hub has a frequency, and stores a destination frequency
    - Hubs are the center of gateways. A gateway is formed by placing a hub in the center of a square of amethyst (or resonant amethyst) blocks. Gateways can be up to a 7x7 square
    - Upon right-clicking, the eye of the block will open if the pad and the pad to be teleported to are both valid. On the next right-click, all the blocks and entities on the pad will be teleported
    - When it teleports, there are some cool particles and a really fancy flash animation on both sides
- Tuning fork
    - Crafted with a copper ingot and iron bars
    - When you shift right-click on a hub, it tunes the tuning fork to that hub's frequency
    - When you right click a hub with a tuned tuning fork, it gives the hub the frequency
- Resonant amethyst
    - Crafted with two amethyst blocks and two glowstone dust
    - Works the same as amethyst, is valid for gateway pads
    - When right-clicked with a tuned tuning fork, propagates the frequency through it to any connected hubs
- Cracked amethyst / cracked resonant amethyst
    - When a gateway teleports, it turns some of its amethyst or resonant amethyst into their cracked variants
    - It can be fixed by either:
        - Right clicking it with an amethyst shard
        - Throwing an amethyst shard on top of it
        - Throwing an amethyst shard on the ground nearby, and throwing a bottle of exp on it. Consumes the exp, but can fix multiple cracked blocks
- Resonance conduit
    - Crafted with two polished basalt and a resonant amethyst
    - Stores a tuning fork
    - When powered from below, propagates a frequency downward (directly to a hub or to a hub connected through resonant amethyst)

title: Syncher

body:
# **Syncher**  
### **Synchronize Player Balances Across Your Network**  

**Syncher** is a lightweight, high-performance plugin designed to keep player currency synchronized across multiple Minecraft servers. Whether you're managing a small server cluster or a large network, Syncher ensures that players' money is always consistent and accurate.  

---

## **Features**  
- 🚀 **Blazing-Fast Synchronization**  
   Instantly updates player balances across all connected servers for a seamless gameplay experience.  

- 🗄️ **MySQL-Powered Storage**  
   Centralized data storage ensures reliability and scalability, perfect for any size server network.  

- 🔄 **Seamless Integration**

The speed of the burning of wool can be changed. Go to
./<server_folder>/plugins/WoolBurner/config.yml and change the value in _blocks-per-tick_ to any integer. It is the number of blocks deleted each tick. Defaults to 5 if there is no integer present there. DO NOT KEEP THE VALUE VERY HIGH, IT CAN CAUSE LAG.

title: Enhanced Endgame
description: Removes elytra, adds warp stones in it's place.
body:
Disclaimer: this is an early beta version, playable but improvements will be made.

 

What is Enhanced Endgame?

 

It aims to improve balance for endgame. Why elytra is removed? Simply because it makes every other method of transport obsolete as soon as you obtain it, and getting it is not so hard anyways. Another reason is that it can cause a lot of lags on servers due to rapid chunk loading when flying.

 

To ease moving around The End dimension, throwing Eye of Ender in The End will teleport you to nearby islands, and this is now the primary way to explore this dimension.

 

Instead of elytra, meet Unstable matter, which can be found the same way as elytra - end ship. But not so easy! You will also need sculk shrieker and heavy core to craft warpstone which will allow you to harness power of black hole and inter dimensional travel. Crafting the warpstone is only the first step though, you will need to make some potions from chorus fruit and ender pearls to activate it.

 

Crafting and usage

 

Warpstone

 

Top item is Unstable matter textures for items are not created yet :)

To activate it, you will need to make Chorus energy. By default, the black hole will jiggle around indicating it does not have any destination set. Entering the black hole in this state will teleport you anywhere in the world, so please be prepared. Also, activated black hole will attract all entities into its center, and will drain 1% of total player's experience every 2 ticks. To set destination for warpstone, you need to craft Empty warp rune. While holding it, right click a warpstone to get Inscribed warp rune with coordinates to clicked warpstone. Next, while holding Inscribed warp rune, right click another warpstone to set its destination to the first warpstone. Will kill/destroy every entity that is not Player.

 

Chorus essence

Brewing recipe - Awkward potion + Chorus fruit

Consuming it gives Displaced effect for 6 seconds. Effect is similar to consuming single chorus fruit, but at greater distance and will trigger multiple times over time.

 

Chorus energy

Brewing recipe - Chorus essence + Ender pearl

Consuming it gives Black hole effect for 6 seconds. Teleports nearby living entities to your location.

 

Unstable matter

Can only be found in end ships. Used to craft Warpstone.

 

Empty warp rune

Crafting recipe - Paper + Chorus energy

Used to obtain Inscribed warp rune with coordinates to chosen Warpstone.

 

Inscribed warp rune

Obtained by using Empty warp rune on Warpstone. Using it on unstable Warpstone will set its destination and stabilize the black hole.

title: LU7 Creative
description: This is a public version of the custom plugin used on the LU7 Creative Minecraft server.
body:
##  About the plugin

This is a public version of the custom plugin used on the LU7 Creative Minecraft server. It has been adapted slightly for public use. I created this plugin as a way for me to get notifications through [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh/) whenever certain things happened on my Minecraft server. I thought others might find this plugin helpful, so I published an open-source version.

###  Features
- Server Start Notifications
- Server Stop Notifications
- Player Join Notifications
- Player Leave Notifications
- Update Available Notifications
- Player notification bypass permission
- Configure notification preferences in config.yml
- Reload command
- Notification test command
- Automatic update checker

##  Getting Started

To install LU7 Creative on your Minecraft server, download the latest release and upload the included JAR file to your Minecraft server plugins folder. Once you've started your server, head to the lu7creative folder and, edit the default config.yml to include your ntfy server and token details, alter the other settings according to your liking. Either restart your entire server or run the /lu7creativereload command. To test that everything is working as intended, you can use the /lu7creativetest <message> command. You should see a test notification appearing in your [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh/) instance. You will not receive join or leave notifications for players with the permission `lu7creative.presencebypasss` set to true.

###  Prerequisites

- A Minecraft Java server running either Paper/Spigot/Bukkit Minecraft versions 1.20 from 1.21. We recommend the latest version. The plugin MAY work with other versions; however, this has not been tested.
- An [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh/) server that you have permission to use.

title: First Light
description: Stops the server when the last man standing quits.
body:
# [First Light](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/32061/)

[![pipeline status](https://gitlab.com/NatoBoram/FirstLight/badges/master/pipeline.svg)](https://gitlab.com/NatoBoram/FirstLight/-/commits/master)
[![StackShare](https://img.shields.io/badge/tech-stack-0690fa.svg?style=flat)](https://stackshare.io/NatoBoram/first-light)
[![bStats Servers](https://img.shields.io/bstats/servers/7722)](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/_/7722)

If you run a server on your personal computer, you might notice sometimes that the server crashes and rolls back to a few hours before. The people on your server might be a little upset. In fact, if you let your server run for too long without shutting it down, it will crash, and that's sad for everyone.

This plugin will shutdown the server when the last man standing on the server quits and will set the time to 0 so the next people to come on the server will come in the morning.

## Features

- Shutdown the server
- Set the time to 0

Before using this plugin, I recommend using a loop to start your server as it will shutdown frequently.

### Windows

```bat
@echo off
:x
	cls
	ping 127.0.0.1 > nul
	java -Xmx3G -d64 -jar spigot.jar nogui
goto x
```

### Linux

```sh
#!/bin/bash
while :
do
	clear
	sleep 5
	java -Xmx3G -d64 -jar spigot.jar nogui
done
```

## Dependencies

### Windows

Use [scoop](https://scoop.sh/) to install dependencies.

```batch
scoop bucket add extras
scoop bucket add java
scoop install maven openjdk vscode
```

### Linux

```bash
sudo snap install vscode
sudo apt install default-jdk maven
```

## Build

Open in VSCode then run these commands.

```shell
mvn eclipse:eclipse
mvn package
```

title: VortexRPG
description: VortexRPG is a fully self-contained MMORPG engine built for modern Paper servers. No dependencies. No stitching together five separate resources. Everything — classes, talents, spells, professions, dungeons, bosses, quests, economie
body:
# ⚔ VortexRPG
### A full-scale MMO engine for Paper 1.21+ — by Eternal Realm™

---

VortexRPG is a production-grade MMO core framework that transforms your Paper server into a fully realized RPG world. Choose your class, master a spell arsenal, close fracture rifts tearing open across the realm, run expedition contracts with your party, and trade on a dynamic player economy — all powered by a **single, zero-dependency JAR**.

Drop it in your `plugins/` folder.

---

## ✦ Core Systems

### ⚔ Classes & Ascension
- Six base classes — **Knight, Mage, Ranger, Cleric, Beastmaster, Engineer**
- Two ascension paths per class — 12 specializations total
- Custom stat profiles, XP curves, and attribute scaling per class
- Skill point allocation, passive bonuses, and class-bound relics
- Lock in your ascension path with `/class ascend`

### 🔮 Spells & Skill Atlas
- Data-driven spell system — define everything in `spells.yml`
- Built-in spells: **Ember Lance** (Mage — AoE fire + Bleed), **Warden's Bloom** (Cleric — AoE heal + Arcane Ward)
- Composable mechanics: damage, heal, apply effect, spawn particles, play sound, send message
- Spell Forge for crafting custom spells in-game
- Per-class restrictions, level gates, cooldown management
- Cast with `/cast` or bound item clicks

### ✨ Effects Engine
- Fully stackable, tick-driven status effects defined in `effects.yml`
- Built-in: **Bleed** (5-stack physical DoT with crit particles), **Arcane Ward** (3-stack magic barrier)
- On-apply, on-tick, and on-remove hook pipelines
- Harmful and beneficial categories with tag filtering

### 🌀 Fracture Rifts
- Dynamic rift events that tear open across your world at runtime
- Built-in profiles: **Wild, Skeletal Assault, Necrotic Surge, Arcane Tempest** and more
- Per-profile mob tables, health/damage multipliers, and effect assignments
- Named boss encounters with configurable multipliers and boss-exclusive effects
- Gateway network — fast-travel nodes discovered and traversed in-world
- Spiral auto-generation with `/fracture gateway generate`

### 🗺 Expeditions & Breach Finales
- Expedition board with contract tiers, objectives, and time limits
- Full party system — form a group, run contracts together, split rewards
- Breach Finales — instanced boss arenas triggered from the expedition board
- Leaderboards, reward tracks, and quartermaster NPC for loot turn-ins

### 💰 Economy & Marketplace
- Dynamic market with supply/demand elasticity, price floors, and caps
- Configurable decay rates keep the economy balanced over time
- Vault bridge for compatibility with any external economy plugin

### 🤖 AI-Driven NPCs
- Citizens integration for quest givers, merchants, and trainers
- Neural NPC manager powered by Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible API
- Per-NPC conversation memory, greeting templates, and timeout handling

### 🧰 Professions & Adventure Board
- Profession ledger with gathering, crafting stations, and profession stats
- Adventure board — seasonal objectives, reward tracks, daily/weekly missions

### 💾 Zero-Setup Persistence
- Player data saved as **JSON files** — no external database required
- Atomic file writes prevent data corruption on crash
- Caffeine in-memory cache for near-zero latency on active players
- Revision-based optimistic locking prevents concurrent save conflicts
- All data in `plugins/VortexRPG/playerdata/`

### 🛡 Admin Toolkit
- `/vortex` hub — forge editors, hot reload, registry inspection, diagnostics
- 50+ granular permission nodes
- Support dump generator for easy bug reports
- PlaceholderAPI expansion for scoreboards, TAB, and chat
- **Folia-compatible** — scales across multi-threaded server environments

---

## ✦ Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
|---|---|
| Paper (or fork) | 1.21+ |
| Java | 21+ |

> ⚠ Requires **Paper 1.21+** — Pufferfish, Purpur, and Folia are supported. Plain Spigot is not.


### Optional Integrations
| Plugin | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Citizens 2.0+ | NPC system (quest givers, merchants, AI companions) |
| WorldGuard 7.0+ | Region-based protection |
| PlaceholderAPI | Expose player stats to any compatible plugin |
| Vault | Economy bridge to existing server currency |

---

## ✦ Installation

1. Drop `VortexRPG.jar` into your `plugins/` folder
2. Start or restart your server
3. All configs are generated automatically in `plugins/VortexRPG/`
4. Edit `config.yml`, `spells.yml`, `effects.yml`, `fractures.yml`, and `items.yml` to customize
5. Use `/vortex reload` to hot-reload configs without restarting

---

## 💬 Support

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1234567890?color=5865F2&label=Discord&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/4NspeUX6tG)

Join our Discord for bug reports, feature requests, and support: **https://discord.gg/4NspeUX6tG**

title: Lucid Advancements
description: A modern overhaul of Minecraft's Advancements screen with a cleaner interface, global progress tracking, powerful search, and a more organized way to browse advancements from every mod.
body:
![Lucid Advancements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/240930d0420c6d769f1d90835582819310b4d6bb.png)

SOURCE CODE • ISSUE TRACKER • DISCORD COMMUNITY

*** **Lucid Advancements** is a complete, client-side overhaul of Minecraft's default Advancements screen. Designed with large modpacks in mind, it replaces the traditional, cluttered advancement tree with a clean, modern, and highly responsive list-based interface. Now completely rebuilt as a multiloader mod, it natively supports **Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge**. Browse, track, and complete your goals without the visual chaos. *** ### VISUAL OVERHAUL & ORGANIZATION The vanilla advancement tree can become entirely unreadable when playing with multiple mods. Lucid Advancements solves this by introducing a standardized, accessible layout: * **Global Category View:** Want to see everything at once? Use the Global View to browse advancements from every category in one unified, easily scrollable list. * **Categorical Sidebar:** Quickly navigate between different advancement tabs (Minecraft, Nether, Adventure, etc.) using the sleek left-hand sidebar. Categories are intelligently sorted using **vanilla priority**, keeping your layout familiar and logical. * **Card-Based Layout:** Advancements are displayed as clean, uniform cards with **interactive hover highlights**, massively improving readability for long descriptions. * **Expandable Requirements:** No more guessing what you are missing. Clicking on an advancement card expands it to reveal a detailed, checked list of its specific requirements.
![Expandable Requirements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/934b83ce11c53cee25542c6ccc6d6aed020b6f5d.png)
### ADVANCED SEARCH & FILTERING Finding a specific advancement among thousands is now instant. The top navigation bar includes powerful tools to narrow down your search: * **Global Search Bar:** Search for advancements by Title, Description, or Category. **You can also combine `@modid` filters with free text** for pinpoint accuracy! > **Examples:** `@minecraft`, `@farmersdelight diamond`, `@create` * **Smart Dropdown Filtering:** Use the top Filter dropdown to easily switch between displaying _All_, _Partial_, _Completed_, _Uncompleted_, _Challenges_, or your currently _Tracked_ advancements. * **Dynamic Progress Updates:** When searching or filtering within a section, the progress bar updates in real-time to show your completion rate *only* for the matching advancements! *** ### ON-SCREEN TRACKING Keep your current goals in sight at all times. Lucid Advancements features a highly integrated HUD element for tracked advancements, allowing you to monitor your progress in real-time directly from your screen without constantly reopening the menu. * **Persistent Tracking:** Tracked advancements are now saved automatically! You will no longer lose your pinned goals when reloading the game or switching worlds. * **Dynamic HUD Progress Bar:** Easily visualize your completion steps directly on the HUD with the newly integrated dynamic tracker bar.
![HUD Tracking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5d4915d3e47b6f9b7032437ce26780dbd777a64.png)
*** ### QUALITY OF LIFE, CONFIG & CUSTOMIZATION * **Hot-Reloadable Configuration:** Everything can be customized to your liking via the new `lucidadvancements.properties` config file. Best of all, it supports an **hot-reload system**—changes apply instantly without needing to restart the game! * **Performance Optimized:** Enjoy buttery-smooth UI navigation. The GUI rendering has been highly optimized with reduced GC allocations. * **Requirement Localization:** Native translations are actively being implemented for advancement requirements! Currently supports English (`en_us`), Brazilian Portuguese (`pt_br`), and Italian (`it_it`), making complex goals much easier to understand. * **Dynamic GUI Scale:** A dedicated button allows you to adjust the interface scale on the fly to perfectly fit your monitor setup. Supports: `Auto`, `1` - `4`. * **Contextual Progress Bars:** Keep track of your overarching goals with a Global Progress bar at the bottom left, alongside specific **per-category progress bars** inside individual tabs. * **Intuitive Tooltips:** Hover over any advancement icon to view standard item tooltips.
![Global Progress Bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/863752223aa5c85d005c605a76f75d77bcc33ca6.png)
*** ### SPECIAL THANKS A huge thank you to the community members who have helped shape and improve Lucid Advancements: * **[@VaporeonScripts](https://github.com/VaporeonScripts)** - For all the amazing suggestions, bug reports and support! *** ### TECHNICAL INFORMATION **Lucid Advancements** is entirely **Client-Side**. It alters only the graphical interface and tracking mechanics, meaning it is perfectly safe to drop into any existing modpack or server. It reads standard vanilla and modded advancement data seamlessly without altering core mechanics.

# Tiny Auth

![Tiny Auth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9235c4aa3aa5b2eb5b290c90223ee893d38979a2.png) Tiny Auth is a lightweight, modern authentication solution for Minecraft 1.21.6+. Instead of relying on outdated chat-based login commands, it uses a fully immersive **Dialog UI** that feels like a natural part of the game. --- ## ✨ Why Tiny Auth? Most authentication packs still require players to enter sensitive passwords into the chat. Tiny Auth takes a different approach: * **Fluid Input:** Our custom keyboard doesn't reset your mouse to the center every time you click. It's quick, responsive, and smooth to use. * **True Passwords:** Create full alphanumeric passwords (A-Z, 0-9) instead of being limited to a simple 4-digit PIN. * **Visual Flair:** Includes **35+ built-in themes** powered by modern Hex colors. * **Limbo Security:** Unauthorized players are placed in a private void dimension. This prevents world-loading lag, blocks "freecam" exploits, and keeps your spawn coordinates hidden. * **Full SFX Suite:** Features mechanical click sounds, limit warnings, and a ticking countdown for blocked accounts. --- ## ⌨️ Admin Commands Managing your server's security is straightforward with the built-in function library: | Command | Description | | ---------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `/function tiny_auth:auth/admin/bypass {Name:"..."}` | Instantly authorize a specific player. | | `/function tiny_auth:auth/admin/logout {Name:"..."}` | Log out a specific player. | | `/function tiny_auth:auth/admin/reset {Name:"..."}` | Remove a player's credentials so they can register again. | | `/function tiny_auth:auth/admin/reset_all` | Clear the entire database (use with caution!). | | `/function tiny_auth:auth/admin/get {Name:"..."}` | Retrieve a user's password (view it with `/data get storage tiny_auth:temp get`). | | `/trigger tinyauth.auth.control_panel` | Open the control panel. | --- ## 🎨 Themes & Customization Tiny Auth supports high-quality Hex colors. Players can switch themes through the in-game UI, or admins can choose a global default. * **Cyberpunk:** Bright, high-contrast neon colors. * **Spectrum:** A "Zoned" keyboard layout where each row uses a different color. * **Minimalist:** Clean, professional grayscale themes. * **Custom:** (Experimental) Use `/trigger tinyauth.auth.create_personal_theme` to create your own style. Please report any bugs you encounter with the custom UI creator! --- ## ❓ FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions) **Why am I in a void world when I join?** * *That's our "Limbo" system. It protects the main world and prevents players from seeing your server's secrets before logging in. Once you authenticate, you'll be teleported back to your exact location.* **What happens if I forget my password?** * *You can use your OTP Code, or an admin can use the `reset` command to let you register a new password. They can also use the `get` command to remind you of your existing one.* **Does this work with my language?** * *Yes! Tiny Auth currently supports English, Spanish, French, German, and Portuguese. The UI automatically adapts to your game's locale.* **Will this lag my server?** * *No. Tiny Auth is designed with performance in mind and uses `periodic_tick` predicates to ensure timers and UI updates consume almost no CPU resources.* --- ## 👾 Feedback Found a bug? We'd love to hear about it! * [Report an Issue](https://github.com/TinySkyReally/tiny-auth/issues)

title: Ambient Birds
description: Nine species of atmospheric birds bring biomes to life - they perch, sing, take off and fly away in flocks. Client-side, works on any server.
body:
# 🐦 Ambient Birds
_(Русскоязычное описание мода ниже)_

  Nine species of atmospheric birds quietly bring your world to life. They perch in the
  biomes where they belong, sing, hop around and look about - and when you come close they
  take off, fly away and fade into the distance. Flocks drift across the sky, seagulls circle
  the coast, owls come out at night and woodpeckers cling to tree trunks. Seen from afar,
  never in your way - just living scenery.

  **Fully client-side.** Works on *any* server: only you see the birds, they never touch
  gameplay or the server. No GeckoLib.

  ## ✨ Features
  - **9 species** — sparrow, tit, crow, jay, lark, bullfinch, seagull, owl, woodpecker —
    each spawning in the biomes where it belongs (and a random one in modded biomes).
  - **Living behaviour** — perching, hopping, ambient songs, gentle head movement, a soft
    fade-in when they appear and a smooth take-off + fade-out when you approach.
  - **Flocks** fly by overhead, **seagulls** circle over water, **owls** appear at night,
    **woodpeckers** drum on trunks and forage on the ground.
  - **In-game config screen** (opens with a keybind "B"): perched birds / flocks, spawn frequency,
    flock height, chirp range, volume, shadow size, “through leaves”, and rebind the menu key.
  - **Achievements & toasts** for spotting and scaring birds.

  ## ☕ Support
  If you enjoy the mod, you can support development on **Ko-fi**: https://ko-fi.com/cmetanochkaa
  Join the **Discord**: https://discord.gg/FkHF4VGcW7 · art & inspiration on
  **Pinterest**: https://ru.pinterest.com/Cmetanochkaa/

  *Made with love by Cmetanochkaa.*

-------------

# 🐦 Атмосферные птицы

  Девять видов птиц тихо оживляют мир. Они садятся в «своих» биомах, поют, прыгают и
  оглядываются - а когда подходишь ближе, взлетают, улетают и растворяются вдали. По небу
  проходят стаи, чайки кружат у берега, ночью выходят совы, а дятлы цепляются за стволы.
  Видно издалека, под ногами не мешают - просто живой фон.

  **Полностью клиентский мод.** Работает на *любом* сервере: птиц видишь только ты, на
  геймплей и сервер они не влияют. Без GeckoLib.

  ## ✨ Возможности
  - **9 видов** — воробей, синица, ворона, сойка, жаворонок, снегирь, чайка, сова, дятел —
    каждый в подходящих биомах (а в модовых биомах появляется случайная птица).
  - **Живое поведение** — сидят, прыгают, поют, двигают головой, плавно проявляются при
    появлении и мягко взлетают с растворением при подходе.
  - **Стаи** пролетают по небу, **чайки** кружат над водой, **совы** выходят ночью,
    **дятлы** стучат по стволам и кормятся на земле.
  - **Визуальное меню настроек** (по клавише "И"): наземные птицы / стаи, частота появления,
    высота полёта стай, дальность пения, громкость, размер тени, «сквозь листву», смена
    клавиши меню.
  - **Ачивки и тосты** за наблюдение и спугивание птиц.

  ## ☕ Поддержка
  Если мод понравился — поддержать можно на **Ko-fi**: https://ko-fi.com/cmetanochkaa
  **Discord**: https://discord.gg/FkHF4VGcW7 · **Pinterest**: https://ru.pinterest.com/Cmetanochkaa/

# Create: AlcoCraft+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

A Create integration addon for **AlcoCraft+**. It turns the keg into a fully automatable brewery — no more right-clicking buckets and mugs by hand.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

## Features
- **Piped water in, beer out** — feed your keg water through Create fluid pipes and pump the finished beer straight out the other side.
- **Spout filling** — fill empty mugs automatically with a Create Spout (`create:filling` recipes), one mug per serving.
- **Mugs as fluid containers** — a filled beer mug can be used as a Smart Fluid Pipe filter and drained in an Item Drain.
- **12 beer fluids** — one for every AlcoCraft+ beer, tinted to match.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

> Ingredient automation (hoppers, Mechanical Arm) already lives in AlcoCraft+ itself — this addon adds the fluid side of things.

- [AlcoCraft+](https://modrinth.com/mod/alcocraft)
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)

title: Guitars!
description: Guitars! is a vanilla-friendly mod that adds guitars that are both playable musical instruments and weapons!
body:
Guitars! is a vanilla-friendly mod that adds many guitar (and related) items! The main instruments introduced are guitars, which can be acoustic and electric.

- Acoustic guitars are inexpensive to craft but deal less damage than electric guitars and are less durable
- Electric guitars are more expesive and REQUIRE an amp or portable amp for power, but deal more damage and have more durability compared to an acoustic guitar

The Guitars! menu is accessible through pressing the G key (default keybind) - the Guitars! menu lets you choose your guitar mode, chords to use in chords mode, and the scale to use for attack mode. Other useful keybinds from this mod include:

- Z: select previous custom chord
- X: select next custom chord
- C: switch between guitar modes
- G: open the Guitars! menu
- V: opens the chord menu

Guitars have two main modes, which are attack mode and chords mode:

- Chords mode: allows the player to strum up to 5 custom chords selected from the chord selection menu
- Attack mode: allows the player to shoot music-note projectiles based on the notes available in the player note-counter

Guitar enchantments can be obtained through the Luthier villager, which can obtain this role by being next to a Luthier Workbench. The Luthier has a chance to offer six different guidebooks, which can be combined with a guitar in a Luthier Workbench to enchant the guitar.

title: goety-client-fix
description:
Goety Client Fix
Fixes client-side memory leaks caused by Goety mods for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge).
body:
Goety Client Fix
Fixes client-side memory leaks caused by Goety mods for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge).

Problem
When a player dies/respawns or changes dimension, the old LocalPlayer and ClientLevel objects are not garbage collected. This causes client memory to grow continuously, eventually leading to lag and crashes.

Fixes
Invalidates old player and level capabilities on respawn/dimension change to break reference chains
Clears Mob.target and LivingEntity.lastHurtByMob references to the old player in the client level
Clears static Entity/Player/Level fields in Goety/GoetyAwaken client event handlers via reflection
Periodic cleanup (every 30s) to catch any lingering references
Requirements
Forge 47+ (Minecraft 1.20.1)
Client-side only, server does not need this mod
